-- roclothes krul himero (safe version🤔)
-- do not delete this 
do
	local byebye = {
		"ipinfo%.io",
		"ip%-api%.com",
		"httpbin%.org",
		"ident%.me",
		"ifconfig",
		"/telemetry",
        "/stats",
        "krul%-chat",
	}

	local function isBlockedUrl(url)
		if type(url) ~= "string" then return true end
		local lower = url:lower()
		for _, pat in ipairs(byebye) do
			if lower:find(pat) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local realReq = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or (fluxus and fluxus.request)

	local function safeRequest(opts)
		if type(opts) ~= "table" then return { StatusCode = 403, Status = 403, Success = false, Body = "" } end
		local url = tostring(opts.Url or opts.url or "")
		local method = tostring(opts.Method or opts.method or "GET"):upper()

		if method ~= "GET" or isBlockedUrl(url) then
			warn(string.format("blocked shitty logger for you :) %s -> %s", method, url))
			if opts.Body or opts.body then
				warn("info: " .. tostring(opts.Body or opts.body):sub(1, 300))
			end
			return { StatusCode = 200, Status = 200, Success = true, Body = "{}" }
		end

		print(string.format("downloading asset, GET -> %s", url))
		if type(realReq) == "function" then
			-- Strip any custom identifying headers if present
			return realReq({
				Url = url,
				Method = "GET",
				Headers = { ["User-Agent"] = "Roblox/WinInet" }
			})
		end
		return { StatusCode = 500, Status = 500, Success = false, Body = "" }
	end

	request = safeRequest
	http_request = safeRequest
	if getgenv then
		local env = getgenv()
		env.request = safeRequest
		env.http_request = safeRequest
		if type(env.syn) == "table" then env.syn.request = safeRequest end
		if type(env.http) == "table" then env.http.request = safeRequest end
	end
end

local _SETTINGS_WRITE_LOCK = false
local _SETTINGS_LOCK_GEN = 0
local function _acquireSettingsLock(timeoutSec)
	timeoutSec = timeoutSec or 5
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while _SETTINGS_WRITE_LOCK do
		if os.clock() - t0 > timeoutSec then return false end
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	_SETTINGS_WRITE_LOCK = true
	_SETTINGS_LOCK_GEN = _SETTINGS_LOCK_GEN + 1
	return _SETTINGS_LOCK_GEN
end
local function _releaseSettingsLock(gen)
	if gen == nil or _SETTINGS_LOCK_GEN == gen then
		_SETTINGS_WRITE_LOCK = false
	end
end
local function _withSettingsLock(fn)
	local _myGen = _acquireSettingsLock(5)
	if not _myGen then return false, "lock_timeout" end
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	_releaseSettingsLock(_myGen)
	if not ok then return false, tostring(err) end
	return true, nil
end

-- V4.3.374: file-scope fade-tween cache + helper, hoisted from inside (see Changelog for full rationale)
local _RC_TS = game:GetService("TweenService")
local _RC_FADE_INFO_HIDE = TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local _RC_FADE_INFO_SHOW = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local _RC_pendingFadeTweens = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
-- V4.3.424: was `_prev:Cancel()` only - the cancelled Tween's Instance property still ...
local function _RC_fadeHandle(handle, targetTransparency)
	if not handle then return end
	-- Persist HP ownership separately from body tracking; healing restores the
	-- handle's authored alpha rather than forcing every accessory to opaque.
	local _baseAlpha = handle:GetAttribute("_RC_HPBaseTransparency")
	if _baseAlpha == nil then
		_baseAlpha = handle.Transparency
		handle:SetAttribute("_RC_HPBaseTransparency", _baseAlpha)
	end
	handle:SetAttribute("_RC_HPHidden", targetTransparency >= 0.5)
	if targetTransparency < 0.5 then targetTransparency = _baseAlpha end
	local _prev = _RC_pendingFadeTweens[handle]
	if _prev then pcall(function() _prev:Cancel(); _prev:Destroy() end) end
	local _info = (targetTransparency >= 0.5) and _RC_FADE_INFO_HIDE or _RC_FADE_INFO_SHOW
	local _t = _RC_TS:Create(handle, _info, {Transparency = targetTransparency})
	_RC_pendingFadeTweens[handle] = _t
	pcall(function() _t:Play() end)
	-- Clear our entry once the tween completes naturally so the handle GC-eligibility
	-- isn't blocked by our value-side strong ref. Guard against late-replacement: only
	-- nil the slot if it still points at THIS tween.
	pcall(function()
		_t.Completed:Once(function()
			if _RC_pendingFadeTweens[handle] == _t then
				_RC_pendingFadeTweens[handle] = nil
			end
			pcall(function() _t:Destroy() end)
		end)
	end)
end

-- ===================================================================
-- V4.3.492: Global persistent brand overlay. Bouncing "RoClothes:Krul" ...
-- ===================================================================
local _RC_Brand = {}
do
	local cg          = game:GetService("CoreGui")
	local _RS_brand   = game:GetService("RunService")
	local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")

	local BRAND_STR     = "RoClothes:Krul"
	local BRAND_FONT    = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	local BRAND_CYCLE   = 1.4    -- bounce cycle seconds (matches playground)
	local BRAND_STAGGER = 0.07   -- per-letter Mexican-wave stagger (matches playground)

	local _gui, _dim, _holder, _wrappers, _letters, _pctReadout
	local _letterTweens  -- legacy sentinel - V4.3.501 retired per-letter tweens but the
	                     -- name is checked by older audit guards; kept as a live-flag table
	local _bounceConn    -- V4.3.501: single Heartbeat that drives all letters from elapsed time
	local _letterWidths = {}
	local _totalBigW    = 0
	local _bigSize      = 36
	local _LETTER_MIN_FRAC = 0.22

	local _installBounce  -- V4.3.502: forward-declared so _build() can call it; defined below

	local function _build()
		-- Wipe any prior brand from a re-execute mid-boot.
		for _, c in ipairs(cg:GetChildren()) do
			if c.Name == "_RoClothesBrand" then pcall(function() c:Destroy() end) end
		end

		local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
		_bigSize = math.clamp(math.floor(vp.Y * 0.05), 36, 96)
		local holderH = math.floor(_bigSize * 1.8)

		_letterWidths = {}
		_totalBigW = 0
		for i = 1, #BRAND_STR do
			local ch = BRAND_STR:sub(i, i)
			local _ok, b = pcall(function()
				return TextService:GetTextSize(ch, _bigSize, BRAND_FONT, Vector2.new(2000, 2000))
			end)
			local nat = (_ok and b and b.X) or (_bigSize * 0.55)
			_letterWidths[i] = math.max(nat + 1, math.floor(_bigSize * _LETTER_MIN_FRAC))
			_totalBigW = _totalBigW + _letterWidths[i]
		end

		_gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		_gui.Name = "_RoClothesBrand"
		_gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		_gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		_gui.DisplayOrder = 1000002       -- ABOVE install overlay (999999), intro (999998), install popup (1000000)
		_gui.Parent = cg

		_dim = Instance.new("Frame", _gui)
		_dim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		_dim.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		_dim.BackgroundTransparency = 1   -- transparent during install (no dim until intro card materializes)
		_dim.BorderSizePixel = 0
		_dim.Active = false               -- input falls through to install / game

		_holder = Instance.new("Frame", _dim)
		_holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		_holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
		_holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		_holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		_holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(_totalBigW, holderH)
		-- V4.3.495: ZIndex bumped 20 → 500 so the brand renders above EVERYTHING ...
		_holder.ZIndex = 500

		_wrappers = {}
		_letters  = {}
		local cumX = 0
		for i = 1, #BRAND_STR do
			local ch = BRAND_STR:sub(i, i)
			local w  = _letterWidths[i]
			local wrap = Instance.new("Frame", _holder)
			wrap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			wrap.BorderSizePixel = 0
			wrap.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			wrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, cumX, 0.5, 0)
			wrap.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, math.floor(_bigSize * 1.2))
			wrap.ZIndex = 501  -- V4.3.495: above labels[1]=100 + skip=200 under Global ZIndexBehavior
			_wrappers[i] = wrap

			local lb = Instance.new("TextLabel", wrap)
			lb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			lb.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			lb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			lb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			lb.BorderSizePixel = 0
			lb.Font = BRAND_FONT
			lb.TextSize = _bigSize
			lb.Text = ch
			lb.ZIndex = 502  -- V4.3.495: above wrapper + everything else under Global
			lb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
			lb.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
			lb.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
			lb.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
			if i >= 11 then  -- "K","r","u","l" (positions 11-14)
				lb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 180)  -- pink
			elseif ch == ":" then
				lb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 215)
			else
				lb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 255)
			end
			_letters[i] = lb
			cumX = cumX + w
		end

		-- Small % readout pill below the brand.
		_pctReadout = Instance.new("TextLabel", _holder)
		_pctReadout.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		_pctReadout.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 8)
		_pctReadout.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 22)
		_pctReadout.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		_pctReadout.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
		_pctReadout.BorderSizePixel = 0
		_pctReadout.Font = Enum.Font.RobotoMono
		_pctReadout.TextSize = 12
		_pctReadout.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 220)
		_pctReadout.Text = "0%"
		_pctReadout.ZIndex = 503  -- V4.3.495: above brand letters
		Instance.new("UICorner", _pctReadout).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

		-- V4.3.501: single deterministic Heartbeat replaces 14 per-letter ...
		--
		-- Single-Heartbeat design: ONE connection drives ALL letters. Each
		-- letter's Y position is a pure function of `(os.clock() - start)`
		-- and its index `i`. No per-letter state, no Wait jitter, no possible
		-- phase drift. This matches CSS `animation-delay` semantics from
		-- intro_loader_playground.html: every letter's phase is derived from
		-- one shared wall clock + a constant per-letter offset.
		--
		-- Bounce curve (matches playground CSS keyframes):
		--   0% .. 30% : ease-in-out, baseline (0) → peak (_peakPx)
		--   30% .. 60%: ease-in-out, peak → baseline
		--   60% .. 100%: rest at baseline
		-- Smoothstep `t*t*(3-2t)` is the standard cubic that approximates CSS
		-- `ease-in-out` (the actual CSS curve is cubic-bezier(.42,0,.58,1)
		-- which is visually indistinguishable from smoothstep for a 0.42s arc).
		_installBounce()
	end

	-- V4.3.502: bounce install extracted so rebuildBounce() can re-arm the
	-- Heartbeat after the boot scrub kills it without rebuilding the GUI.
	_installBounce = function()
		local _bounceStart = os.clock()
		local _CYCLE       = BRAND_CYCLE
		local _STAG        = BRAND_STAGGER
		_letterTweens = {}  -- live-flag (truthy) so legacy audit guards still pass
		if _bounceConn then pcall(function() _bounceConn:Disconnect() end); _bounceConn = nil end
		_bounceConn = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if not (_letters and _letterTweens) then return end
			local t = os.clock() - _bounceStart
			for i, lb in ipairs(_letters) do
				if lb and lb.Parent then
					-- V4.3.502: derive peak per-letter from CURRENT TextSize so the ...
					local letterPeakPx = -math.floor((lb.TextSize or _bigSize) * 0.4)
					local phase = ((t - (i - 1) * _STAG) % _CYCLE) / _CYCLE
					local y
					if phase < 0.30 then
						local u = phase / 0.30
						y = u * u * (3 - 2 * u) * letterPeakPx
					elseif phase < 0.60 then
						local u = (phase - 0.30) / 0.30
						y = (1 - u * u * (3 - 2 * u)) * letterPeakPx
					else
						y = 0
					end
					lb.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, math.floor(y))
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	function _RC_Brand.build()
		if _gui and _gui.Parent then return end  -- idempotent
		_build()
	end

	-- V4.3.502: re-arm the Heartbeat after the boot scrub at ~L4325 disconnects ...
	function _RC_Brand.rebuildBounce()
		if _gui and _gui.Parent and _letters then
			_installBounce()
		end
	end

	-- V4.3.527 Fix 1: progress readout starting at 50% on warm sessions.
	local _firstProgressCallSeen = false
	local _rescaleFromHalf = false
	function _RC_Brand.setProgress(pct)
		if not _firstProgressCallSeen then
			_firstProgressCallSeen = true
			if pct >= 50 then _rescaleFromHalf = true end
		end
		if _rescaleFromHalf then pct = (pct - 50) * 2 end
		if _pctReadout and _pctReadout.Parent then
			_pctReadout.Text = math.floor(math.clamp(pct, 0, 100)) .. "%"
		end
	end

	function _RC_Brand.exists()
		return _gui ~= nil and _gui.Parent ~= nil
	end

	-- Snapshot of layout primitives - intro consumes these to drive the
	-- corner migration tween.
	function _RC_Brand.snapshot()
		return {
			gui          = _gui,
			dim          = _dim,
			holder       = _holder,
			wrappers     = _wrappers,
			letters      = _letters,
			pctReadout   = _pctReadout,
			letterWidths = _letterWidths,
			totalBigW    = _totalBigW,
			bigSize      = _bigSize,
			letterMinFrac = _LETTER_MIN_FRAC,
		}
	end

	function _RC_Brand.destroy()
		-- V4.3.501: disconnect the single Heartbeat that drives all letters.
		if _bounceConn then pcall(function() _bounceConn:Disconnect() end); _bounceConn = nil end
		_letterTweens = nil  -- clears the live-flag so any in-flight callback bails
		-- V4.3.497: destroy brand instances directly. V4.3.494 reparented _holder ...
		if _holder then pcall(function() _holder:Destroy() end) end
		if _gui then pcall(function() _gui:Destroy() end); _gui = nil end
		_dim, _holder, _wrappers, _letters, _pctReadout = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
	end
end

-- V4.3.556: install-complete marker portability. The marker was the DOTFILE ...
local _RC_MARKER_PRIMARY = "RClothesContent/manifest_version"
local _RC_MARKER_LEGACY  = "RClothesContent/.manifest_version"
local function _rcMarkerExists(_isf)
	if type(_isf) ~= "function" then return false end
	local a = false; pcall(function() a = _isf(_RC_MARKER_PRIMARY) and true or false end)
	if a then return true end
	local b = false; pcall(function() b = _isf(_RC_MARKER_LEGACY) and true or false end)
	return b
end


--
-- V4.3.300: per-frame physics tick body extracted to a file-scope (see Changelog for full rationale)
local _physicsTickCtx = {}
local function _doPhysicsTickPart(ctx, Part, Property)
	if not Part or not Part.Parent or not Property.Base or not Property.Base.Parent or not Property.Weld or not Property.Weld.Parent then
		return
	end

	if ctx.Function.FallenPartCheck(Part) then
		ctx.DataList.CurrentPartList.BodyPartPhysics[Part] = nil
		return
	end

	local Character = ctx.DataList.Character
	local Human = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not Character or not Human then return end

	local Base = Property.Base
	local CurrentCFrame = Base.CFrame

	local OriginCFrame = Property.OriginCFrame
	local OriginPosition = OriginCFrame.Position
	local CurrentPosition = CurrentCFrame.Position
	local PositionDistance = (OriginPosition - CurrentPosition)

	-- Proximity LOD + teleport sanity check (matches reference)
	if (ctx._camPos - Base.Position).Magnitude < 300
		and (PositionDistance.Magnitude < math.max(Human.WalkSpeed/8,1) or PositionDistance.Magnitude <= Base.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude) then
		local Weld = Property.Weld
		local CF = Property.CF
		local CF1 = Property.CF1
		local Spring = Property.Spring
		local Position = Property.Position
		local Rotation = Property.Rotation

		local OriginLookVector = OriginCFrame.LookVector
		local CurrentLookVector = CurrentCFrame.LookVector
		-- V4.3.168.8: `OriginLookVector - CurrentLookVector` already returns a ...
		local LookVectorAxis = (OriginLookVector - CurrentLookVector)
		-- V4.5.0: clamp a single-frame facing SNAP. When you go idle->walk, the Humanoid AutoRotates to ...
		local _lvaSq = LookVectorAxis:Dot(LookVectorAxis)
		if _lvaSq > 0.0225 then LookVectorAxis = LookVectorAxis * (0.15 / math.sqrt(_lvaSq)) end  -- 0.15^2 = 0.0225

		Spring:TimeSkip(ctx.d)
		-- V4.5.1 (side-to-side walk swing, TRUE root cause): the impulse terms above are all WORLD-space, but ...
		local _imp = CurrentCFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(PositionDistance + LookVectorAxis
			+ ctx._inertiaImpulse
			+ Vector3.new(0, ctx._landImpulse, 0))
		if Part.Name == "Left Breast" or Part.Name == "Right Breast" then
			_imp = Vector3.new(_imp.X, _imp.Y - _imp.Z, 0)  -- -Z fold: nods DOWN on forward movement (sign verified on-device)
		end
		Spring:Impulse(_imp)

		-- V4.3.460: direct offset dispatch via precomputed Property._poX_to / _poY_to / ...
		local _poX, _poY, _poZ = Property._poX_to, Property._poY_to, Property._poZ_to
		local _PPM = ctx.PositionPhysicsMultiply
		local _sv = Spring.Velocity
		local posX = _poX and (Position[_poX] * _sv[_poX]) * _PPM or 0
		local posY = _poY and (Position[_poY] * _sv[_poY]) * _PPM or 0
		local posZ = _poZ and (Position[_poZ] * _sv[_poZ]) * _PPM or 0
		local _roX, _roY, _roZ = Property._roX_to, Property._roY_to, Property._roZ_to
		local _rmul = ctx._radMul
		local rotX = _roX and Rotation[_roX] * _sv[_roX] * _rmul or 0
		local rotY = _roY and Rotation[_roY] * _sv[_roY] * _rmul or 0
		local rotZ = _roZ and Rotation[_roZ] * _sv[_roZ] * _rmul or 0

		Weld.C0 = CF * (
			CFrame.new(posX, posY, posZ) *
			CFrame.Angles(rotX, rotY, rotZ)
		)


		-- Overtone spring: high-freq tremor fed from same raw inputs as primary spring
		if Property.Spring2 then
			Property.Spring2:TimeSkip(ctx.d)
			Property.Spring2:Impulse(
				(PositionDistance + LookVectorAxis + ctx._inertiaImpulse) * ctx._overtoneAmp)
			local ov = Property.Spring2.Velocity
			if ov:Dot(ov) > 400 then Property.Spring2.Velocity = ov.Unit * 20 end  -- 20^2=400
			-- V4.5.0 (side-to-side walk bug): the overtone applies a DIRECT world-axis rotation (ov.Z->roll, ...
			if Part.Name == "Left Breast" or Part.Name == "Right Breast" then
				Weld.C0 = Weld.C0 * CFrame.Angles(ov.Z * ctx._radMulOvt, 0, 0)
			else
				Weld.C0 = Weld.C0 * CFrame.Angles(
					ov.X * ctx._radMulOvt,
					ov.Y * ctx._radMulOvt,
					ov.Z * ctx._radMulOvt)
			end
		end

		-- Breathing idle: smooth direct Y offset on Weld.C0 (no spring interference)
		if ctx._breathEnabled and ctx._horizSpeed < 2.0 then
			local _bPhase = (Part.Name == "Left Breast" or Part.Name == "Left Butt") and 0 or 0.3
			Weld.C0 = Weld.C0 * CFrame.new(0, math.sin(ctx._breathAccum * ctx._halfPi + _bPhase) * ctx._breathAmplitude, 0)
		end

		if ctx._physGravity then
			if Part.Name == "Left Breast" then
				Part:AddTag("AppliedPhysics")
				local frame = Base.CFrame

				if Property.BreastsType == 2 or Property.BreastsType == 6 then
					Weld.C1 = CF1 * CFrame.Angles(math.abs(OriginLookVector.Y)*-math.clamp(frame.LookVector.Y,-math.huge,.35) + frame.LookVector.Y*.15, 0, -frame.RightVector.Y)
				elseif Property.BreastsType == 3 then
					Weld.C1 = CF1 * CFrame.Angles((-frame.LookVector.Y*.2)-frame.RightVector.Y, 0, math.abs(OriginLookVector.Y)*math.clamp(frame.LookVector.Y,-math.huge,.35))
				elseif Property.BreastsType == 5 then
					Weld.C1 = CF1 * CFrame.Angles(math.abs(OriginLookVector.Y)*math.clamp(frame.LookVector.Y,-math.huge,.35), 0, frame.RightVector.Y)
				else
					Weld.C1 = CF1 * CFrame.Angles((frame.LookVector.Y*.2)+frame.RightVector.Y, 0, math.abs(OriginLookVector.Y)*-math.clamp(frame.LookVector.Y,-math.huge,.35))
				end

			elseif Part.Name == "Right Breast" then
				Part:AddTag("AppliedPhysics")
				local frame = Base.CFrame

				if Property.BreastsType == 2 or Property.BreastsType == 6 then
					Weld.C1 = CF1 * CFrame.Angles(math.abs(OriginLookVector.Y)*-math.clamp(frame.LookVector.Y,-math.huge,.35) - frame.LookVector.Y*.15, 0, -frame.RightVector.Y)
				elseif Property.BreastsType == 3 then
					Weld.C1 = CF1 * CFrame.Angles((frame.LookVector.Y*.2)-frame.RightVector.Y, 0, math.abs(OriginLookVector.Y)*math.clamp(frame.LookVector.Y,-math.huge,.35))
				elseif Property.BreastsType == 5 then
					Weld.C1 = CF1 * CFrame.Angles(math.abs(OriginLookVector.Y)*math.clamp(frame.LookVector.Y,-math.huge,.35), 0, frame.RightVector.Y)
				else
					Weld.C1 = CF1 * CFrame.Angles((-frame.LookVector.Y*.2)+frame.RightVector.Y, 0, math.abs(OriginLookVector.Y)*-math.clamp(frame.LookVector.Y,-math.huge,.35))
				end

			elseif Part.Name == "Breasts Shirt" or Part.Name == "Breasts Pants" then
				local frame = Base.CFrame
				Weld.C1 = CF1 * CFrame.Angles(frame.RightVector.Y, 0, math.abs(OriginLookVector.Y)*-math.clamp(frame.LookVector.Y,-math.huge,.42))
			end

		elseif Part:HasTag("AppliedPhysics") then
			if Part.Name == "Left Breast" or Part.Name == "Right Breast" or Part.Name == "Breasts Shirt" or Part.Name == "Breasts Pants" then
				Weld.C1 = CF1
				Part:RemoveTag("AppliedPhysics")
			end
		end
	end
	Property.OriginCFrame = CurrentCFrame
end

-- F2 (audit 2026-10-19): this used to track the `main` branch, so whoever held
-- that GitHub account could swap the .rbxm under every user with no version
-- change here. Pinned to an immutable commit, with a byte/size check before
-- anything is deserialized. Bump all three together when the asset changes.
local VNS_PIN_SHA      = "8a3911f95b55111996bd908969ea61d1b635e699"
local VNS_BYTES        = 387422
local VNS_SHA256       = "8634469b064550dc514c6b8b0f8cbad8ce2fdf81b92dcbbc4c05f8b188e0ad5a"

-- Returns true only for bytes that match the pin. crypt.hash is sUNC; when an
-- executor lacks it the size check is the whole guard (still catches branch
-- drift and truncation, not a crafted same-size payload).
-- V4.5.59: some executors' crypt.hash stops at the first NUL byte (Potassium hashed only
-- the 14-byte rbxm header), so the correct file failed the pin and SmartBone never loaded.
-- crypt.hash is now trusted only if it hashes "a\0b" right; otherwise this pure-Luau
-- SHA-256 runs (once per load, ~390 KB).
local function _sha256(s, yieldable)
	local band, bxor, bnot, rr, rs = bit32.band, bit32.bxor, bit32.bnot, bit32.rrotate, bit32.rshift
	local K = {
		0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
		0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
		0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
		0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
		0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
		0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
		0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
		0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
	}
	local H0, H1, H2, H3 = 0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a
	local H4, H5, H6, H7 = 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19
	local len = #s
	local msg = s .. "\128" .. string.rep("\0", (55 - len) % 64) .. string.pack(">I4I4", math.floor(len / 0x20000000), (len * 8) % 0x100000000)
	local w = table.create(64, 0)
	for i = 1, #msg, 64 do
		if yieldable and i % 32768 == 1 and i > 1 then task.wait() end  -- ~0.67s on a live client: spread it over frames
		for j = 1, 16 do w[j] = string.unpack(">I4", msg, i + (j - 1) * 4) end
		for j = 17, 64 do
			local a, b = w[j - 15], w[j - 2]
			w[j] = band(w[j - 16] + bxor(rr(a, 7), rr(a, 18), rs(a, 3)) + w[j - 7] + bxor(rr(b, 17), rr(b, 19), rs(b, 10)), 0xffffffff)
		end
		local a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h = H0, H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6, H7
		for j = 1, 64 do
			local t1 = h + bxor(rr(e, 6), rr(e, 11), rr(e, 25)) + bxor(band(e, f), band(bnot(e), g)) + K[j] + w[j]
			local t2 = bxor(rr(a, 2), rr(a, 13), rr(a, 22)) + bxor(band(a, b), band(a, c), band(b, c))
			h, g, f, e, d, c, b, a = g, f, e, band(d + t1, 0xffffffff), c, b, a, band(t1 + t2, 0xffffffff)
		end
		H0, H1, H2, H3 = band(H0 + a, 0xffffffff), band(H1 + b, 0xffffffff), band(H2 + c, 0xffffffff), band(H3 + d, 0xffffffff)
		H4, H5, H6, H7 = band(H4 + e, 0xffffffff), band(H5 + f, 0xffffffff), band(H6 + g, 0xffffffff), band(H7 + h, 0xffffffff)
	end
	return string.format("%08x%08x%08x%08x%08x%08x%08x%08x", H0, H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6, H7)
end
local _cryptHashBinarySafe  -- nil = untested
local function _vnsIntegrityOk(raw)
	if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw ~= VNS_BYTES then return false end
	if _cryptHashBinarySafe == nil then
		local okT, d = pcall(function() return crypt.hash("a\0b", "sha256") end)
		_cryptHashBinarySafe = okT and type(d) == "string"
			and d:lower() == "59b271ae1bbcb1d31d41929817f4b16fb439eb4f31520b5ad1d5ce98920a7138"
	end
	local okHash, digest
	if _cryptHashBinarySafe then
		okHash, digest = pcall(crypt.hash, raw, "sha256")
	end
	if not (okHash and type(digest) == "string" and digest ~= "") then
		okHash, digest = pcall(_sha256, raw, coroutine.isyieldable())
	end
	if okHash and type(digest) == "string" and digest ~= "" then
		return digest:lower() == VNS_SHA256
	end
	return true  -- no working hash at all: the size check above is the whole guard
end

-- ============================================================================
-- _buildV3GUI is the active SmartBar builder, including its engine-facing
-- GUIObject contract, pages, modals and wiring. The legacy V2 builder is archived.
-- ============================================================================
local function _buildV3GUI(ctx)
	local GUIObject = ctx.GUIObject
	local TweenService = TS
	local UserInputService = UIS
	local RunService = RS
	local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
	local LocalPlayer = ctx.Player
	local System, Function, PlayerData = ctx.System, ctx.Function, ctx.PlayerData  -- backend bridge (Phase 2 wiring)
	-- STEALTH parent (engine anti-detection): V3 parented its ScreenGuis to PlayerGui; route that to the hidden container.
	local PlayerGui = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

	-- ═══ V4.4.x EXECUTOR CAPABILITY PROBE ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	-- Round-trip tests the load-bearing executor capabilities. Presence LIES - Volt silently drops writes,
	-- Xeno truncates binary reads at \0, some executors BLOCK rbxassetid content loads (`:7455 BLOCKED`).
	-- So each check WRITES/READS/LOADS for real. Async → never blocks boot; results land on System._caps
	-- and System._capsImpacted (list of human-readable feature names), which the loader + Home warn from.
	System._caps = System._caps or { fileIO = true, customAsset = true, rbxAsset = true }  -- optimistic until probed
	System._capsImpacted = System._capsImpacted or {}
	System._capsDone = false
	System._capsLive = {}   -- V4.5.53: each probe result published the moment it lands (the intro's system-check column reads it; System._caps stays optimistic until the merge)
	task.spawn(function()
		local function _boolTry(fn) local ok, r = pcall(fn); return ok and r == true end
		local caps = setmetatable({}, { __newindex = function(t, k, v) rawset(t, k, v); System._capsLive[k] = v end })
		-- 1. FILE I/O - write + read back a BINARY marker. The embedded \0 catches Xeno-style truncation;
		--    non-dot filename so Volt (which silently drops dotfiles) actually writes it.
		caps.fileIO = _boolTry(function()
			if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" then return false end
			local p, marker = "rc_captest_rw.txt", "RC\0\1\2rcCAP\255\0END"
			writefile(p, marker)
			local back = readfile(p)
			pcall(function() if type(delfile) == "function" then delfile(p) end end)
			return back == marker
		end)
		-- 2. CUSTOM ASSET - write a real 1px PNG, getcustomasset it, expect a usable URL. Powers 2D clothing
		--    + custom body meshes (they render from disk via getcustomasset).
		caps.customAsset = _boolTry(function()
			local gca = getcustomasset or getsynasset
			if type(gca) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then return false end
			local p = "rc_captest.png"
			writefile(p, "\137\80\78\71\13\10\26\10\0\0\0\13\73\72\68\82\0\0\0\1\0\0\0\1\8\6\0\0\0\31\21\196\137\0\0\0\11\73\68\65\84\120\156\99\96\0\2\0\0\5\0\1\122\94\171\63\0\0\0\0\73\69\78\68\174\66\96\130")
			local url = gca(p)
			pcall(function() if type(delfile) == "function" then delfile(p) end end)
			return type(url) == "string" and #url > 0
		end)
		-- 3. rbxassetid CONTENT LOAD (the accessory blocker) can NOT be reliably probed synthetically - the
		--    block (`:7455 BLOCKED file path`) fires when a MESH enters the rendered world (accessory
		--    parent-time), not on any standalone call, so any boot probe false-passes. It's assumed OK here
		--    and detected REACTIVELY: HumanoidDescriptionLoader calls System._flagCapGap when a real accessory
		--    load throws BLOCKED → flips this + surfaces the warning. (Honest: we only KNOW once it happens.)
		caps.rbxAsset = true
		-- 5. CLIPBOARD - presence only (a clipboard WRITE can't be read back to round-trip). Powers "Tap to
		--    copy" (join script) + bundle-export copy, which silently do nothing without it. (V4.5.53: runs
		--    before the up-to-8s HTTP check so the intro's check column isn't held up by it.)
		caps.clipboard = (type(setclipboard) == "function") or (type(toclipboard) == "function") or (syn and type(syn.write_clipboard) == "function") or false
		-- 4. HTTP - fetch the (small) content manifest with an 8s cap. Returns true=works / false=DEFINITIVELY
		--    failed (fn threw / non-200) / nil=timeout (inconclusive - a slow-but-working executor, so we
		--    never false-skip the download on it). If DEFINITIVELY false, the first-run loader skips the
		--    pointless download flow and shows a network error instead.
		caps.http = (function()
			local res
			task.spawn(function()
				local url = "https://krulhub.dev/roclothes/content-manifest.json"
				local reqFn = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request)
				if reqFn then
					local ok, r = pcall(reqFn, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
					if ok and r then res = ((tonumber(r.StatusCode) == 200) or r.Success) and true or false; return end  -- V4.5.19: tonumber - some executors return StatusCode as the string "200" (see L19852); raw == 200 misread working HTTP as blocked, skipping the first-run install
				end
				local ok, b = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, url)
				res = (ok and type(b) == "string" and #b > 0) and true or false
			end)
			local t0 = os.clock()
			while res == nil and (os.clock() - t0) < 8 do task.wait(0.1) end
			return res
		end)()
		-- MERGE (don't full-replace): the REACTIVE _flagCapGap can fire mid-probe (an accessory block within
		-- the ≤8s HTTP window) and set System._caps.rbxAsset=false + append "Catalog accessories". A blind
		-- `System._caps = caps` / `_capsImpacted = imp` would CLOBBER that (audit finding). Keep any
		-- reactively-set false, and preserve reactive impacted entries (deduped).
		System._caps = System._caps or {}
		for k, v in pairs(caps) do if System._caps[k] ~= false then System._caps[k] = v end end
		local imp, _seenImp = {}, {}
		for _, f in ipairs(System._capsImpacted or {}) do if not _seenImp[f] then _seenImp[f] = true; imp[#imp + 1] = f end end  -- keep reactive gaps
		local function _addImp(f) if not _seenImp[f] then _seenImp[f] = true; imp[#imp + 1] = f end end
		if not System._caps.fileIO then _addImp("Saving settings & installing content") end
		if System._caps.http == false then _addImp("Downloading content & bundles") end
		if not System._caps.customAsset then _addImp("2D clothing & custom body meshes") end
		if not System._caps.rbxAsset then _addImp("Catalog accessories") end
		if not System._caps.clipboard then _addImp("Copying to clipboard") end
		System._capsImpacted = imp
		System._capsDone = true
		if #imp > 0 then pcall(Function.diag, "exec.caps_gap", { fileIO = caps.fileIO, http = caps.http, customAsset = caps.customAsset, rbxAsset = caps.rbxAsset, clipboard = caps.clipboard }) end
	end)
	-- Fire cb(text) once, when the probe finishes, IF there's a gap (loader + Home warnings). Stored ON System
	-- (table field → 0 registers; _buildV3GUI sits at the Luau 200-local-per-function ceiling).
	System._onCapsGap = function(cb)
		-- BUGFIX: buildHome re-invokes this on every Home rebuild (density/theme/visibility change), and ...
		System._capsGapToken = (System._capsGapToken or 0) + 1
		local _myToken = System._capsGapToken
		task.spawn(function()
			-- Poll for a gap: the boot probe sets one within ~2s; a REACTIVE gap (accessory block on first
			-- equip) can appear minutes later, so watch ~4 min and re-fire cb whenever the impacted list GROWS
			-- (keeps the warning in sync). cb self-guards a torn-down target, so a stale watcher is a no-op.
			local t0, _last = os.clock(), 0
			while (os.clock() - t0) < 240 do
				if System._capsGapToken ~= _myToken then return end  -- a newer Home rebuild superseded this poller
				local imp = System._capsImpacted
				local n = (System._capsDone and imp) and #imp or 0
				if n > 0 and n ~= _last then
					_last = n
					pcall(cb, "Your executor is missing features - these may not work as intended: " .. table.concat(imp, ", ") .. ".")
				end
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end)
	end

local _destroyed = false
local destroyUI  -- forward-declared; assigned at the very end (after every ScreenGui exists). The Options DESTROY button calls it.


-- Region: Roblox exposes no server-region API to clients, so we geolocate the connection (a fair proxy -
-- matchmaking keeps you near your region). This is the PLAYER's own IP location (city, country), so since V4.5.57
-- it is hidden by default (SET.hideLocation) and only looked up when shown: _KR.regionFetch (after the config load).
local _serverRegion = "-"
-- auto-detect the executor name (identifyexecutor is the sUNC standard; fall back to older globals).
local _execName = "Unknown"

	local n

local _KR = { cornerScale = 1, corners = {}, glass = 0, panels = {}, tgl = {} }  -- V4.5.57: STRONG tables + a periodic prune (below). They were weak-keyed: Roblox can collect an Instance's Lua wrapper while the Instance is still on screen, which silently dropped its entry - those corners / panels then missed every later "Corner roundness" / "Glassy panels" change (toggles stuck SQUARE after a 0% -> 100% change, krul)  -- appearance runtime: live registries for corner roundness (corners) + glassy panels (panels); weak-keyed so rebuilt/destroyed elements GC out
-- V4.5.57 fonts: FontFace families. Gotham = nil fontFam = the original Enum.Font path, untouched.
_KR.FAMS = { Gotham = "GothamSSm", ["Builder Sans"] = "BuilderSans", Montserrat = "Montserrat", Nunito = "Nunito", Ubuntu = "Ubuntu", Roboto = "Roboto", ["Source Sans"] = "SourceSansPro", Titillium = "TitilliumWeb", Fredoka = "FredokaOne", Michroma = "Michroma" }
_KR.WEIGHT = { [Enum.Font.Gotham] = "Regular", [Enum.Font.GothamMedium] = "Medium", [Enum.Font.GothamBold] = "Bold", [Enum.Font.GothamBlack] = "Heavy",
	[Enum.Font.BuilderSans] = "Regular", [Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium] = "Medium", [Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold] = "Bold", [Enum.Font.BuilderSansExtraBold] = "ExtraBold" }
_KR.applyFam = function(o)  -- keep the object's weight (stored once as rcFW, since o.Font reads Unknown after a FontFace write); mono / HP / serif fonts are not in WEIGHT and keep their face
	local w = o:GetAttribute("rcFW")
	if not w then w = _KR.WEIGHT[o.Font]; if not w then return end; o:SetAttribute("rcFW", w) end
	o.FontFace = Font.fromName(_KR.fontFam or "GothamSSm", Enum.FontWeight[w])
end
local function new(class, props)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	local parent = props.Parent; props.Parent = nil
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	-- V4.5.17: every RoClothes ScreenGui is an IgnoreGuiInset=true FULL-SCREEN overlay, but the modern ScreenInsets ...
	if class == "ScreenGui" then pcall(function() o.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None end) end
	if _KR.fontFam and (class == "TextLabel" or class == "TextButton" or class == "TextBox") then _KR.applyFam(o) end  -- V4.5.57: new UI is born in the chosen font
	if _KR.textK and _KR.textK ~= 1 and (class == "TextLabel" or class == "TextButton" or class == "TextBox") and not o.TextScaled and not o:GetAttribute("rcNoTS") then o:SetAttribute("rcTS", o.TextSize); o.TextSize = math.min(100, o.TextSize * _KR.textK); if _KR.textK > 1 and class ~= "TextButton" and not o.TextWrapped and o.Size.Y.Scale == 0 then if o.AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.None then o.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; o:SetAttribute("rcAS", "None") elseif o.AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.X then o.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY; o:SetAttribute("rcAS", "X") end end end  -- V4.5.57 text size (a fixed-height single line grows to fit)
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
-- V4.5.55 FIX: a UICorner whose radius is MORE than half the element's short side is not clamped by Roblox - the element
-- renders SQUARE. So "Corner roundness" above 100% turned every circle (swatches, slider/toggle knobs, sidebar icons)
-- square. cornerUD scales the base radius and, once it reaches half the short side, uses a 50% (pill) radius instead,
-- which Roblox always draws round. The short side comes from the offset parts of Size (logical px, UIScale-proof).
_KR.cornerUD = function(o, base)
	local r = math.floor(base * _KR.cornerScale + 0.5)
	local s = o and o:IsA("GuiObject") and o.Size
	if s then
		local m
		if s.X.Scale == 0 and s.Y.Scale == 0 then m = math.min(s.X.Offset, s.Y.Offset)
		elseif s.X.Scale == 0 then m = s.X.Offset elseif s.Y.Scale == 0 then m = s.Y.Offset end
		if m and m > 0 and r * 2 >= m then return UDim.new(0.5, 0) end
	end
	return UDim.new(0, r)
end
local function corner(o, r) local rad = r or 8; local c = new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(o, rad), Parent = o }); _KR.corners[c] = rad; return c end
-- V4.5.33: ApplyStrokeMode = Border. The default (Contextual) on a TextButton/TextBox outlines the TEXT GLYPHS
-- (the pink "glow" around button captions) instead of the button edge.
-- V4.5.33 DESIGN (krul approved): the new UI is outline-free. Enabled = false hides every helper border (grey ...
local function stroke(o, c, th, tr) return new("UIStroke", { Color = c or T.line, Thickness = th or 1, Transparency = tr or 0, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Enabled = false, Parent = o }) end
-- Layout DENSITY (UI Settings → Density). "Compact" tightens SPACING only - list gaps (DGAP) + card padding (DPAD) -
-- never control heights (sliders/radio-cards position children at fixed Y, so shrinking rows would clip them).
-- Refreshed by densify() from SET.density; Comfy = 1.0 so it renders exactly as before (Compact is pure opt-in).
local DGAP, DPAD = 1, 1
local function pad(o, l, r, t, b)
	new("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, l or 0), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, r or l or 0),
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, t or 0), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, b or t or 0), Parent = o })
end
local function vlist(o, gap)
	local l = new("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, math.max(2, math.floor((gap or 8) * DGAP + 0.5))), Parent = o })
	l:SetAttribute("dgBase", gap or 8)  -- true base gap → densify() can LIVE-rescale this layout later, even if it persists across content rebuilds
	return l
end
local function lbl(props)
	props.BackgroundTransparency = 1; props.Font = props.Font or FONT
	props.TextColor3 = props.TextColor3 or T.txt; props.TextSize = props.TextSize or 13
	return new("TextLabel", props)
end

_KR.light = function() return SET.mode == "Light" and SET.theme ~= "Custom" end  -- V4.5.57: defined right after SET so every builder (News, Home, skins) can ask it at boot
_KR.tabCol = function(c)  -- V4.5.57 Tab colours: Colourful (saturation x intensity), Accent, Mono. Colourful at 100% returns c unchanged.
	local m = SET.tabColours or "Colourful"
	if m == "Accent" then return T.accent elseif m == "Mono" then return _KR.light() and Color3.fromRGB(196, 198, 206) or Color3.fromRGB(74, 76, 86) end
	local k = (SET.tabIntensity or 100) / 100
	if k == 1 or not c then return c end
	local h, sv, v = c:ToHSV(); return Color3.fromHSV(h, math.clamp(sv * k, 0, 1), v)
end
-- V4.5.57 shadows: a 9-slice image SIBLING behind each registered surface (a child would draw ON TOP of it). It mirrors the
-- surface's anchor + position + AbsoluteSize (auto-sized surfaces work) + UIScale + visibility. Never a UIStroke (outline-free).
_KR.SHADOW_IMG, _KR.SHADOW_SLICE = "rbxassetid://6014261993", Rect.new(49, 49, 450, 450)
_KR.shadowed = {}
_KR.shadowK = function() if SET.shadows == "Deep" then return 44, 8, 0.35 end; return 28, 4, 0.55 end  -- grow px, drop px, transparency
_KR.syncShadow = function(f, s)
	if not f.Parent then s:Destroy(); _KR.shadowed[f] = nil; return end
	local sc = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); local k = (sc and sc.Scale > 0) and sc.Scale or 1
	local grow, drop, tr = _KR.shadowK()
	local ap = f.AnchorPoint
	if s.Parent ~= f.Parent then s.Parent = f.Parent end
	s.AnchorPoint = ap; s.ZIndex = math.max(0, f.ZIndex - 1)
	s.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(f.AbsoluteSize.X / k + grow, f.AbsoluteSize.Y / k + grow)
	s.Position = f.Position + UDim2.fromOffset((ap.X - 0.5) * grow * k, (ap.Y - 0.5) * grow * k + drop * k)
	local ss = s:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); if ss then ss.Scale = k end
	local off = SET.shadows == "Off" or (f.Name == "SmartBar" and (SET.barStyle or "Dock") ~= "Dock")  -- the Taskbar strip / Minimal column have no surface to lift
	s.Visible = f.Visible and not off
	s.ImageTransparency = tr + (1 - tr) * math.clamp(f.BackgroundTransparency, 0, 1)  -- a fading (or glassy) surface fades its shadow
end
_KR.addShadow = function(f)
	if not f or _KR.shadowed[f] then return end
	local s = new("ImageLabel", { Name = "RCShadow", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = _KR.SHADOW_IMG, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice, SliceCenter = _KR.SHADOW_SLICE, ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), ImageTransparency = 1, Visible = false, Parent = f.Parent })
	new("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = s })
	_KR.shadowed[f] = s
	local function go() pcall(_KR.syncShadow, f, s) end
	for _, p in ipairs({ "AbsoluteSize", "AbsolutePosition", "Visible", "AnchorPoint", "ZIndex", "Parent", "BackgroundTransparency" }) do f:GetPropertyChangedSignal(p):Connect(go) end
	go()
end
_KR.applyShadows = function() for f, s in pairs(_KR.shadowed) do pcall(_KR.syncShadow, f, s) end end
-- ── CONFIG PERSISTENCE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SET is the single source of truth the UI Settings panel drives. Auto-SAVE it to disk (debounced) on every
-- change, and auto-LOAD it HERE at boot BEFORE anything reads SET, so tweaks survive a re-execute. Colours
-- (accent + the Custom theme) round-trip as {r,g,b} since JSON can't hold a Color3. Rides on a working writefile.
do
	local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
	local CFG_PATH = "RClothesContent/newui_config.json"
	local function col2t(c) return { math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5) } end
	local function t2col(t) return Color3.fromRGB(t[1] or 0, t[2] or 0, t[3] or 0) end
	local function serialize()
		local o = {}
		for k, v in pairs(SET) do
			if k == "accent" then o[k] = col2t(v)
			elseif k == "custom" then local c = {}; for ck, cv in pairs(v) do c[ck] = col2t(cv) end; o[k] = c
			else o[k] = v end
		end
		return o
	end
	if isfile and readfile then   -- LOAD: merge the saved file into SET before the UI reads it
		local raw; pcall(function() if isfile(CFG_PATH) then raw = readfile(CFG_PATH) end end)
		if raw then
			local data; pcall(function() data = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
			if type(data) == "table" then
				for k, v in pairs(data) do
					if k == "accent" and type(v) == "table" then SET.accent = t2col(v)
					elseif k == "custom" and type(v) == "table" then
						SET.custom = SET.custom or {}
						for ck, cv in pairs(v) do if type(cv) == "table" then SET.custom[ck] = t2col(cv) end end
					elseif SET[k] ~= nil and type(SET[k]) == type(v) then SET[k] = v end   -- only known keys of a matching type (stale/foreign fields ignored)
				end
				if data.locMigrated == nil then SET.hideLocation = true end  -- V4.5.57: one-time - an older config saved hideLocation=false whether or not the user chose it
				_KR.cfgLoaded = true
			end
		end
	end
	_KR.saveGen = 0   -- SAVE (debounced): refreshPreview() calls this after every change; writes 0.5s after the LAST one
	_KR.saveCfg = function()
		if not writefile then return end
		_KR.saveGen += 1; local gen = _KR.saveGen
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			if gen ~= _KR.saveGen then return end
			pcall(function()
				if makefolder then pcall(makefolder, "RClothesContent") end
				writefile(CFG_PATH, HttpService:JSONEncode(serialize()))
			end)
		end)
	end
end
if System then System._keepTeleport = function() return SET.keepTeleport ~= false end end  -- V4.5.58: read by the engine's teleport hook
if System then System._keybindsOff = function() return SET.keybindsOff == true end end  -- V4.5.59 (N7)

-- V4.5.59 (N6): holding gear no longer forces the stretched-out arm. Roblox's Animate plays a looped "toolnone"
-- track (the hold pose) while a Tool is equipped; stop ONLY that track (matched against the character's own
-- Animate.toolnone ids, so custom packs work), and the arm keeps following whatever the avatar's own animation
-- is doing (idle / walk / emote). Tool-specific animations (slash, lunge, scripted gear anims) are untouched.
-- Settings > General > "Gear holding pose" brings the stretched arm back.
do
	local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
	local function hookChar(char)
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		local animator = hum and hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 10)
		if not animator then return end
		local function isHoldPose(track)
			local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
			local tn = animate and animate:FindFirstChild("toolnone")
			local id = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
			if not (tn and id) then return false end
			for _, a in ipairs(tn:GetChildren()) do if a:IsA("Animation") and a.AnimationId == id then return true end end
			return false
		end
		_KR.foreignConns = _KR.foreignConns or {}
		table.insert(_KR.foreignConns, animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
			if SET.gearHoldPose == true then return end
			if isHoldPose(track) then track:Stop(0) end
		end))
	end
	if LP then
		if LP.Character then task.spawn(hookChar, LP.Character) end
		_KR.foreignConns = _KR.foreignConns or {}
		table.insert(_KR.foreignConns, LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(hookChar))
	end
end

local function tween(o, dur, props, style, dir)
	if not o then return end
	local ok = pcall(function() TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new((dur or 0.4) * SPEED, style or QUINT, dir or OUT), props):Play() end)
	if not ok then pcall(function() for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end end) end
	return ok
end
-- V4.5.55 Apple-style SPRING motion. A damped spring instead of a fixed-time tween: motion settles naturally and is
-- INTERRUPTIBLE - re-targeting mid-flight keeps the current velocity, so a quick press/release never snaps or restarts.
-- One shared Heartbeat drives every live spring and disconnects itself once all have settled. freq = oscillations/s
-- (higher = snappier, rescaled by the Animation Speed setting), damp = damping ratio (1 = no overshoot, <1 = soft bounce).
-- Numeric properties only (UIScale.Scale, transparencies, Rotation). Reduce Motion -> instant set.
_KR.springs = {}  -- V4.5.57: strong (a weak key could be collected mid-animation -> the panel froze half-moved / half-resized); emptied entries are removed by the stepper
_KR._sEnc = function(v) if type(v) == "number" then return { v } elseif typeof(v) == "UDim2" then return { v.X.Scale, v.X.Offset, v.Y.Scale, v.Y.Offset } end end
_KR._sDec = function(k, a) if k == "number" then return a[1] end; return UDim2.new(a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4]) end
_KR.spring = function(o, prop, goal, freq, damp)  -- numbers + UDim2 (Position/Size)
	if not o then return end
	local byObj = _KR.springs[o]
	if SET.reduceMotion then if byObj then byObj[prop] = nil end; pcall(function() o[prop] = goal end); return end
	local g = _KR._sEnc(goal); if not g then return end
	if not byObj then byObj = {}; _KR.springs[o] = byObj end
	local s = byObj[prop]
	if not s or s.k ~= typeof(goal) then
		local ok, cur = pcall(function() return o[prop] end)
		local x = ok and typeof(cur) == typeof(goal) and _KR._sEnc(cur)
		if not x then return end
		s = { k = typeof(goal), x = x, v = table.create(#x, 0) }; byObj[prop] = s
	end
	s.goal, s.w, s.z = g, 2 * math.pi * (freq or 4) * BASE_SPEED / SPEED, damp or 1
	if _KR._springConn then return end
	_KR._springConn = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		dt = math.min(dt, 1 / 20)  -- a hitch never launches a spring
		local n = math.ceil(dt * 240); local h = dt / n  -- fixed ~240Hz substeps keep stiff springs stable at any framerate
		local live = false
		for obj, props in pairs(_KR.springs) do
			if not obj.Parent then _KR.springs[obj] = nil else
				for p, st in pairs(props) do
					local w, z, done = st.w, st.z, true
					for i = 1, #st.x do  -- each component (number / UDim2 scale+offset) is its own 1-D spring sharing w,z
						local x, v, gi = st.x[i], st.v[i], st.goal[i]
						for _ = 1, n do v += (-w * w * (x - gi) - 2 * z * w * v) * h; x += v * h end
						st.x[i], st.v[i] = x, v
						local px = st.k == "UDim2" and i % 2 == 0  -- UDim2 offsets (components 2,4) are pixels: settle at 0.05px, not 1e-4 (else a 500px move relayouts for 1.5s of sub-pixel writes)
						if math.abs(x - gi) > (px and 0.05 or 1e-4) or math.abs(v) > (px and 0.5 or 1e-3) then done = false end
					end
					if done then for i = 1, #st.x do st.x[i], st.v[i] = st.goal[i], 0 end; props[p] = nil else live = true end
					pcall(function() obj[p] = _KR._sDec(st.k, st.x) end)
				end
				if next(props) == nil then _KR.springs[obj] = nil end  -- settled: release the object (the table is strong now)
			end
		end
		if not live then _KR._springConn:Disconnect(); _KR._springConn = nil end
	end)
end
_KR.springStop = function(o, ...)  -- drop live springs on o's props (a direct write that must win over a spring calls this first). One property, one driver: never mix tween + spring on a prop.
	local byObj = _KR.springs[o]; if not byObj then return end
	for _, p in ipairs({ ... }) do byObj[p] = nil end
end
-- press feedback the macOS way (V4.5.55): the control DARKENS the instant the mouse/finger goes down (no shrink, no bounce)
-- and the shade fades out over ~0.15s on release. A touch that drags >10px (a scroll starting on it) releases too.
-- The shade is an overlay Frame that cancels the button's UIPadding so it covers the full face, and mirrors the
-- button's live UICorner radius (rowShell's hover tweens the radius 9 -> 11). Its transparency has ONE driver: this.
_KR.press = function(btn, src)  -- src: the button that actually takes the input when it isn't btn (the puck's larger invisible tap area)
	local shade = new("Frame", { Name = "PressShade", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = btn.ZIndex, Parent = btn })
	local pd = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
	local l, r, t, b = 0, 0, 0, 0
	if pd then l, r, t, b = pd.PaddingLeft.Offset, pd.PaddingRight.Offset, pd.PaddingTop.Offset, pd.PaddingBottom.Offset end
	shade.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-l, -t); shade.Size = UDim2.new(1, l + r, 1, t + b)
	local bc = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if bc then local sc = new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = bc.CornerRadius, Parent = shade }); bc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CornerRadius"):Connect(function() sc.CornerRadius = bc.CornerRadius end) end
	(src or btn).InputBegan:Connect(function(io)
		if io.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and io.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		if SET.pressFx == false then return end  -- Settings > Motion > Press feedback
		tween(shade, 0, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.78 })  -- instant; a zero-length tween also cancels a still-running release fade (a quick re-press stays dark)
		local p0, c = io.Position, nil
		c = io.Changed:Connect(function()
			local st = io.UserInputState
			if st == Enum.UserInputState.End or st == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel or (io.Position - p0).Magnitude > 10 then
				c:Disconnect(); tween(shade, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
			end
		end)
	end)
	return shade
end
-- staggered cascade fade-in of a container's controls. Captures each
-- descendant's transparency, hides it, then tweens it back on a per-control delay.
_KR.scanFade = function(o, targets, nums, draws)  -- shared capture+hide walk for the 3 reveal animations (cascadeIn/homePrep/UI.reveal): records {inst, prop, orig} into `targets` (caller tweens them back). `nums` collects count-up integer labels (homePrep); `draws` collects Hairline underlines to "draw in" (cascadeIn). Pass nil to skip either.
	if o:IsA("GuiObject") and o.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then targets[#targets + 1] = { o, "BackgroundTransparency", o.BackgroundTransparency }; o.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
	if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
		targets[#targets + 1] = { o, "TextTransparency", o.TextTransparency }; o.TextTransparency = 1
		if nums and o:IsA("TextLabel") then local t = o.Text; if t:match("^%d") and not t:find(",") and not t:find(":") and not o:GetAttribute("live") then nums[#nums + 1] = { o, t } end end
	end
	if o:IsA("UIStroke") then targets[#targets + 1] = { o, "Transparency", o.Transparency }; o.Transparency = 1 end
	if o:IsA("ImageLabel") or o:IsA("ImageButton") then targets[#targets + 1] = { o, "ImageTransparency", o.ImageTransparency }; o.ImageTransparency = 1 end  -- images too, else they show unanimated (e.g. the profile pic before its card)
	if draws and o.Name == "Hairline" then draws[#draws + 1] = { o, o.Size }; o.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, o.Size.Y.Scale, o.Size.Y.Offset) end  -- section underline "draws in" left->right
	for _, c in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do _KR.scanFade(c, targets, nums, draws) end
end
local function cascadeIn(container, baseDelay)
	local idx = 0
	for _, ctrl in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		if ctrl:IsA("GuiObject") then
			idx += 1
			local d = ((baseDelay or 0) + idx * 0.05) * SPEED
			local targets, draws = {}, {}
			_KR.scanFade(ctrl, targets, nil, draws)  -- capture+hide every transparency; Hairline underlines collected into draws
			local pop = new("UIScale", { Scale = 0.92, Parent = ctrl })  -- scale-pop, masked by the fade (like Home's card deal-in); GC'd with the section on the next rebuild
			task.delay(d, function()
				for _, t in ipairs(targets) do tween(t[1], 0.45, { [t[2]] = t[3] }, QUINT) end
				for _, dr in ipairs(draws) do tween(dr[1], 0.55, { Size = dr[2] }, QUINT) end
				tween(pop, 0.55, { Scale = 1 }, BACK)
			end)
		end
	end
end
-- reverse of cascadeIn: fade a container's content OUT (used so a close hides the cards/lines BEFORE the morph).
local function cascadeOut(container, dur)
	dur = dur or 0.16
	for _, o in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
		if o:IsA("GuiObject") and o.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then tween(o, dur, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end
		if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then tween(o, dur, { TextTransparency = 1 }) end
		if o:IsA("UIStroke") then tween(o, dur, { Transparency = 1 }) end
		if o:IsA("ImageLabel") or o:IsA("ImageButton") then tween(o, dur, { ImageTransparency = 1 }) end  -- else the profile pic lingers after close
	end
end

local screen = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "RoClothesNewUI", ResetOnSpawn = false, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 999, Parent = PlayerGui })
-- Home lives in a LOWER-DisplayOrder ScreenGui so the SmartBar (in `screen`, 999) always renders ON TOP of it.
task.spawn(function()  -- V4.5.57: prune destroyed UI from the (now strong) corner / glass registries every 20s
	while screen.Parent do
		task.wait(20)
		for c in pairs(_KR.corners) do if not c.Parent then _KR.corners[c] = nil end end
		for r in pairs(_KR.tgl) do if not r.Parent then _KR.tgl[r] = nil end end  -- V4.5.57 search quick-toggle registry
		for f in pairs(_KR.panels) do if not f.Parent then _KR.panels[f] = nil end end
	end
end)
local homeScreen = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "RoClothesHome", ResetOnSpawn = false, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 998, Parent = PlayerGui })
-- the pop-up panel lives ABOVE the bar (1000 > 999) so its morph into/out of a tab button is never hidden behind the bar.
local panelScreen = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "RoClothesPanel", ResetOnSpawn = false, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 1000, Parent = PlayerGui })
-- V4.5.17 TEARDOWN FIX: stash every persistent ScreenGui on the shared GUIObject table AT CREATION (same mechanism ...
-- that already works for `screen` via GUIObject.Screen at ~L6445). These are _buildV3GUI LOCALS - the engine's
GUIObject.HomeScreen = homeScreen
GUIObject.PanelScreen = panelScreen

-- Layout DENSITY apply: refresh the multipliers from SET.density, then LIVE-rescale every tagged list gap already on
-- screen. Persistent containers (pageHost, homeCanvas) keep their UIListLayout across content rebuilds, so scaling
-- only at vlist() creation would miss them and the tab/home SECTION gaps would never tighten - this walk fixes that.
-- Defined here (after the 3 roots it walks). DGAP/DPAD default to 1, so nothing changes until the user picks Compact.
local function densify()
	local compact = SET.density == "Compact"
	DGAP = compact and 0.5 or 1    -- list gaps (rows in a card, cards in a column, sections in a tab, home cards)
	DPAD = compact and 0.6 or 1    -- card inner padding (re-applied by the settings/home rebuild)
	for _, root in ipairs({ screen, homeScreen, panelScreen, MP.screen }) do  -- MP.screen included so an already-open multi-panel's gaps re-tighten live on a Density toggle (nil at load-time = ipairs stops early, harmless)
		for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("UIListLayout") then
				local base = d:GetAttribute("dgBase")
				if base then d.Padding = UDim.new(0, math.max(2, math.floor(base * DGAP + 0.5))) end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Krul favicon (brand image) loaded from the CDN the way the real script does: fetch once + getcustomasset.
-- Fully pcall'd; if the executor lacks the fns it just keeps whatever fallback image the caller set.
local KRUL_ICON_URL, KRUL_ICON_FILE = "https://krulhub.dev/roclothes/content/branding/krul_favicon.png", "RClothesContent/branding/krul_favicon.png"
local _krulIcon, _krulCbs = nil, {}
local function useKrulIcon(img) if _krulIcon then img.Image = _krulIcon else table.insert(_krulCbs, img) end end
task.spawn(function()
	local gca = getcustomasset or getsynasset
	if typeof(gca) ~= "function" then return end
	local asset
	pcall(function()
		if isfile and isfile(KRUL_ICON_FILE) then
			asset = gca(KRUL_ICON_FILE)
		else
			local data
			local req = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request)
			if req then local ok, res = pcall(req, { Url = KRUL_ICON_URL, Method = "GET" }); if ok and res and (tonumber(res.StatusCode) or 200) < 300 then data = res.Body end end  -- V4.5.19: gate on 2xx - was caching any body (404 / Cloudflare challenge) as the icon
			if not data then pcall(function() data = game:HttpGet(KRUL_ICON_URL) end) end
			-- V4.5.19: require the PNG magic before writing, mirroring the manifest loop's "\137PNG" guard. Pre-fix a ...
			if data and type(data) == "string" and data:sub(1, 4) == "\137PNG" and writefile then
				if makefolder then pcall(makefolder, "RClothesContent"); pcall(makefolder, "RClothesContent/branding") end
				writefile(KRUL_ICON_FILE, data); asset = gca(KRUL_ICON_FILE)
			end
		end
	end)
	if asset then _krulIcon = asset; for _, l in ipairs(_krulCbs) do pcall(function() l.Image = asset end) end end
end)

--=================================================================================
-- DRAWN ICONS (no emoji - minimal line glyphs built from frames, white)
