local IC = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local function mkIcon(name, sizePx)
	local sz = sizePx or 20
	local f = new("Frame", { Name = "Icon", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz) })
	local function bar(x, y, w, h, rot, rad)
		local o = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = IC, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0.5, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), Rotation = rot or 0, Parent = f })
		if rad then corner(o, rad) end; return o
	end
	local function ring(d, thick, x, y)
		local o = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x or 0, 0.5, y or 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d), Parent = f })
		corner(o, d); new("UIStroke", { Color = IC, Thickness = thick or 1.5, Parent = o }); return o
	end
	local function box(w, h, thick, rad, x, y)
		local o = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x or 0, 0.5, y or 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), Parent = f })
		corner(o, rad or 3); new("UIStroke", { Color = IC, Thickness = thick or 1.5, Parent = o }); return o
	end
	if name == "home" then
		bar(-4, -3, 2, 9, 42, 1); bar(4, -3, 2, 9, -42, 1); box(11, 8, 1.5, 2, 0, 3)
	elseif name == "body" then
		ring(7, 1.5, 0, -4); bar(0, 4, 12, 7, 0, 3)
	elseif name == "clothes" then
		bar(0, -5, 4, 2, 40, 1); bar(0, -1, 14, 2, 0, 1); bar(-6, 3, 2, 7, 22, 1); bar(6, 3, 2, 7, -22, 1)
	elseif name == "catalog" then
		box(12, 12, 1.5, 3, 0, 0); bar(-3, -3, 3, 3, 0, 2)
	elseif name == "bundles" then
		box(13, 11, 1.5, 2, 0, 1); bar(0, 1, 13, 1.5); bar(0, -2, 1.5, 5)
	elseif name == "edit" then
		bar(0, 0, 3, 13, 45, 1); bar(4.5, 4.5, 4, 3, 45)
	elseif name == "settings" then
		ring(11, 1.5); ring(3.5, 3); bar(0, -7, 2, 3, 0, 1); bar(0, 7, 2, 3, 0, 1); bar(-7, 0, 3, 2, 0, 1); bar(7, 0, 3, 2, 0, 1)
	elseif name == "player" then  -- target reticle
		ring(11, 1.5); bar(0, 0, 2.5, 2.5, 0, 1); bar(0, -8, 2, 4, 0, 1); bar(0, 8, 2, 4, 0, 1); bar(-8, 0, 4, 2, 0, 1); bar(8, 0, 4, 2, 0, 1)
	elseif name == "recolor" then  -- three colour dots
		bar(-3, -2, 4.5, 4.5, 0, 3); bar(3, -2, 4.5, 4.5, 0, 3); bar(0, 4, 4.5, 4.5, 0, 3)
	elseif name == "damage" then  -- health cross
		bar(0, 0, 11, 3, 0, 1); bar(0, 0, 3, 11, 0, 1)
	elseif name == "options" then  -- sliders
		bar(0, -5, 13, 2, 0, 1); bar(4, -5, 3.5, 3.5, 0, 2); bar(0, 0, 13, 2, 0, 1); bar(-3, 0, 3.5, 3.5, 0, 2); bar(0, 5, 13, 2, 0, 1); bar(3, 5, 3.5, 3.5, 0, 2)
	-- V4.5.57 setting-card glyphs (the Settings-page panel layout)
	elseif name == "scale" then  -- double arrow
		bar(0, 0, 14, 1.6, 0, 1); bar(-5, -2, 5, 1.6, 45, 1); bar(-5, 2, 5, 1.6, -45, 1); bar(5, -2, 5, 1.6, -45, 1); bar(5, 2, 5, 1.6, 45, 1)
	elseif name == "wave" then  -- zigzag spring
		bar(-5, 0, 7, 1.8, 55, 1); bar(0, 0, 7, 1.8, -55, 1); bar(5, 0, 7, 1.8, 55, 1)
	elseif name == "lock" then
		ring(8, 1.5, 0, -3); box(12, 8, 1.5, 2, 0, 3); bar(0, 3, 1.6, 3, 0, 1)
	elseif name == "eye" then
		box(15, 9, 1.5, 5); bar(0, 0, 4, 4, 0, 2)
	elseif name == "gravity" then  -- down arrow onto a floor
		bar(0, -2, 1.6, 10, 0, 1); bar(-2.2, 1.5, 5, 1.6, 45, 1); bar(2.2, 1.5, 5, 1.6, -45, 1); bar(0, 7, 13, 1.6, 0, 1)
	elseif name == "spark" then
		bar(0, 0, 1.8, 14, 0, 1); bar(0, 0, 14, 1.8, 0, 1); bar(0, 0, 1.6, 9, 45, 1); bar(0, 0, 1.6, 9, -45, 1)
	elseif name == "power" then
		ring(12, 1.5, 0, 1); bar(0, -5, 1.8, 8, 0, 1)
	elseif name == "key" then
		ring(7, 1.5, -4, 0); bar(3, 0, 9, 1.6, 0, 1); bar(6, 2, 1.6, 3.5, 0, 1)
	elseif name == "spark2" then  -- particles: three dots
		bar(-4, 3, 3, 3, 0, 2); bar(4, 3, 3, 3, 0, 2); bar(0, -4, 3, 3, 0, 2)
	else
		ring(10, 1.5)
	end
	return f
end

--=================================================================================
-- TOAST  (top-right, long Quint slide + fade)
--=================================================================================
local toastHost = new("Frame", { Name = "Toasts", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 500), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = screen })
new("UIListLayout", { VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top, HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), Parent = toastHost })
local _toasts = {}  -- title -> record: a rapid same-title toast (a dragging slider) UPDATES one card (with an x-count) instead of stacking dozens
local function _toastDismiss(card)
	local slot = card and card.Parent
	if not (slot and slot.Parent) or slot:GetAttribute("rcLeaving") then return end
	slot:SetAttribute("rcLeaving", true)
	_KR.spring(card, "Position", UDim2.new(1.15, 0, 0, 0), 2.6, 1)  -- V4.5.55: slides back out past the right edge, opaque (critically damped; keeps velocity if it was still sliding in)
	-- V4.5.34: then collapse its height so the remaining toasts glide up into the gap (they used to jump)
	task.delay(0.3 * SPEED, function()
		if not slot.Parent then return end
		pcall(function()
			slot.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None; slot.ClipsDescendants = true
			slot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, slot.AbsoluteSize.Y)
			tween(slot, 0.22, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) }, QUINT)
		end)
		task.delay(0.24 * SPEED, function() pcall(function() slot:Destroy() end) end)
	end)
end
local function _toastGlyph(parent, kind, col)  -- tiny, font-safe drawn kind glyph in `col` (no unicode -> renders on any executor/old client)
	local function bar(x, y, w, h, rot) new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0.5, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), Rotation = rot or 0, Parent = parent }) end
	if kind == "ok" then bar(-2.5, 1.5, 2, 5, 45); bar(1.5, -1, 2, 9, -45)          -- check
	elseif kind == "err" then bar(0, 0, 2, 11, 45); bar(0, 0, 2, 11, -45)            -- cross
	elseif kind == "warn" then bar(0, -2, 2, 6); bar(0, 4.5, 2, 2)                   -- ! (bar + dot)
	else bar(0, -4.5, 2, 2); bar(0, 1.5, 2, 6) end                                   -- i (dot + bar)
end
local function toast(title, desc, kind, silent)  -- silent: an in-place update that ONLY changes the description (no x-count bump) - used for live progress (Redownload)
	if SET.notify == false then return end   -- Notifications off (Behavior): suppress all toasts
	title = title or ""; kind = kind or "info"
	local col = ({ ok = T.good, err = T.bad, warn = T.warn, info = T.accent })[kind] or T.accent
	local dwell = ((kind == "err" or kind == "warn") and 6 or 3.2) * math.clamp((SET.toastTime or 100) / 100, 0.5, 3)   -- errors/warnings LINGER; ok/info stay brief; x Settings > Behavior > Notification time
	-- SAME TITLE already up? update in place, bump the x-count, reset the countdown (kills slider-drag spam + shows repetition).
	local ex = _toasts[title]
	if ex and ex.card.Parent then
		ex.descL.Text = desc or ""; ex.descL.Visible = (desc ~= nil and desc ~= "")
		if not silent then ex.count += 1; ex.countL.Text = "x" .. ex.count; ex.countPill.Visible = true end  -- progress updates skip the count so it doesn't read "x47"
		ex.left, ex.dwell = dwell, dwell
		return
	end
	-- cap concurrent (oldest out) so they never march off-screen.
	local live = {}; for _, c in ipairs(toastHost:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("Frame") and not c:GetAttribute("rcLeaving") then live[#live + 1] = c end end
	while #live >= 4 do local o = table.remove(live, 1); _toastDismiss(o:FindFirstChild("ToastCard")) end   -- V4.5.34: the oldest slides out too (was destroyed instantly)
	local slot = new("Frame", { Name = "ToastSlot", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = toastHost })  -- V4.5.55: the LIST child; the card inside it is free to slide (UIListLayout children ignore Position, so the old slide never rendered)
	local card = new("Frame", { Name = "ToastCard", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.new(1.15, 0, 0, 0), Parent = slot })  -- x 1.15 = just past the right screen edge
	corner(card, 10); stroke(card, T.line, 1); pad(card, 12, 12, 11, 11); vlist(card, 8)
	if _KR.styleCard then _KR.styleCard(card) end  -- V4.5.57: the style's card surface
	local tanim = SET.toastAnims  -- honor the "Toast pop-in" setting (V4.5.55 macOS: gates the slide only - notifications slide in, they don't pop)
	local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = card })
	local chip = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = col, BackgroundTransparency = 0.12, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = row }); corner(chip, 6)
	_toastGlyph(chip, kind, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))   -- kind icon: semantic-coloured chip + white glyph
	local col2 = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = row }); vlist(col2, 2)
	local titleL = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 16), Text = title, Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.txt, TextSize = 13, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = col2 })
	local descL = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = desc or "", TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextSize = 11, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = col2 }); descL.Visible = (desc ~= nil and desc ~= "")
	local countPill = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 15), BackgroundColor3 = col, BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, Parent = row }); corner(countPill, 6)
	local countL = lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "x1", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextSize = 10, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = countPill })
	local track = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = T.line, BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = card }); corner(track, 2)
	local fill = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = track }); corner(fill, 2)   -- countdown: drains as it auto-dismisses
	local hit = new("TextButton", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 6, Parent = row })
	if tanim then _KR.spring(card, "Position", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), 2.8, 1) else card.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) end  -- V4.5.55: slides in from the right edge on a spring
	local rec = { card = card, descL = descL, count = 1, countL = countL, countPill = countPill, left = dwell, dwell = dwell, hovered = false }
	_toasts[title] = rec
	hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function() rec.hovered = true end)    -- hover PAUSES the countdown (desktop)
	hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function() rec.hovered = false end)
	hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() rec.left = 0 end)   -- click / tap dismisses NOW
	task.spawn(function()   -- countdown loop: drain the fill; freeze while hovered; dismiss at 0
		while card.Parent and rec.left > 0 do
			local dt = task.wait()
			if not rec.hovered then rec.left = rec.left - dt; if fill.Parent then fill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(rec.left / rec.dwell, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0) end end
		end
		if _toasts[title] == rec then _toasts[title] = nil end
		_toastDismiss(card)
	end)
end

-- V4.4.x: REACTIVE capability-gap flag. The engine calls this when a REAL runtime block confirms a missing ...
System._flagCapGap = function(feature, capKey)
	if type(feature) ~= "string" then return end
	System._capsImpacted = System._capsImpacted or {}
	for _, f in ipairs(System._capsImpacted) do if f == feature then return end end  -- already flagged
	if capKey then System._caps = System._caps or {}; System._caps[capKey] = false end
	System._capsImpacted[#System._capsImpacted + 1] = feature
	System._capsDone = true
	pcall(function() toast("Executor limitation", feature .. " may not work on this executor.", "warn") end)
end

--=================================================================================
-- COMPONENTS  (varied motion: hover Quint, press pop, toggle bounce, slider grow)
--=================================================================================
local UI = {}
function UI.panelRootOf(o) while o and o ~= game do if o:GetAttribute("PanelRoot") then return o end; o = o.Parent end end  -- nearest panel root (single OR multi) above a control
-- quick scale-pop on an element when its value changes (reuses one UIScale so rapid repeats don't stack). On the UI
-- table (not a top-level local) to stay under Luau's 200-local main-chunk cap.
function UI.pop(o)
	local s = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or new("UIScale", { Parent = o })
	s.Scale = 1.16; tween(s, 0.3, { Scale = 1 }, BACK)
end
-- show/hide a conditional control with a fade + scale-pop on REVEAL (instant hide). animate=false just sets .Visible.
function UI.reveal(o, show, animate)
	if not animate then o.Visible = show; return end
	if o.Visible == show then return end  -- already in the target state - don't re-animate
	if not show then o.Visible = false; return end
	o.Visible = true
	local sc = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or new("UIScale", { Parent = o })
	sc.Scale = 0.9; tween(sc, 0.4, { Scale = 1 }, BACK)
	local targets = {}; _KR.scanFade(o, targets)  -- capture+hide, then tween back (no stagger - one control). Now fades images too, which the old inline fadeIn missed.
	for _, t in ipairs(targets) do tween(t[1], 0.3, { [t[2]] = t[3] }) end
end
-- ambient idle: a looping (reversing) tween for a gentle "breathe"/shimmer. NOTE: Roblox does NOT auto-cancel a tween
-- when its target is Destroy()ed - an infinite (-1) tween keeps ticking forever and roots the dead instance, so we
-- Cancel it on Destroying (a tab rebuild Destroy()s these). Gated at creation by the motion settings. On the UI table.
function UI.breathe(o, props, dur)
	if not SET.cardAnims or SET.reduceMotion then return o end
	pcall(function()
		local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new((dur or 1.8) * SPEED, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), props)
		tw:Play(); o.Destroying:Connect(function() tw:Cancel() end)  -- rebuild Destroy()s o → stop the loop so it can't leak
	end)
	return o
end
-- lightweight demo state store: stateful controls auto-persist by (page, label) so settings survive tab switches.
local S, _curPage = {}, ""
-- V4.5.57 UI STYLES: every panel surface follows SET.barStyle. One skin per style, read when a row / panel is BUILT
-- (pages rebuild on every open, and A.applyStyle rebuilds whatever is open), so all rows, toggles, sliders, dropdowns,
-- buttons and segs restyle through rowShell. rowT/panelT = the surface's own transparency (the "Glassy panels"
-- setting can only make it MORE see-through: A.applyGlass uses max(rcBaseT, glass)).
--   Dock (macOS): translucent light cells with a hairline edge, generous radius.  Taskbar (Windows 11): solid flat grey
--   cells, small radius, near-opaque Mica panel.  Minimal: no cell boxes at all - hairline dividers only, soft glass panel.
_KR.SKINS = {
	Dock = { rowT = 0, rowHiT = 0, rowR = 12, rowS = 0.9, panelT = 0.04, panelR = 18, panelS = 0.86, cardT = 0.06, cardR = 14, chipT = 0.35, chipR = 8, homeT = 0.08, homeR = 16 },
	Taskbar = { solid = true, rowT = 0, rowHiT = 0, rowR = 6, rowS = 0.93, panelT = 0.03, panelR = 8, panelS = 0.9, cardT = 0, cardR = 7, chipT = 0, chipR = 4, homeT = 0, homeR = 8, flatHome = true },
	Minimal = { rowT = 1, rowHiT = 0.95, rowR = 10, rowS = 1, div = true, panelT = 0.05, panelR = 22, panelS = 1, cardT = 0.06, cardR = 18, chipT = 0.5, chipR = 11, homeT = 0.3, homeR = 20, flatHome = true, glassHome = true },
}
-- floating cards (notifications, option picker, dialogs): the style's surface colour, see-through and radius
-- V4.5.57: a whole dialog / sheet follows the panel layout - the card surface (styleCard), every inner box + button corner
-- (Settings page = small squared radii, Floating sheet = soft pills, Classic = as built), and anything that sat in the
-- card colour ON the card (secondary buttons, list rows) is lifted so it doesn't vanish into it. Original radii are kept in
-- an attribute, so a reused dialog (the shared modal) restyles cleanly on every open.
_KR.cornerPass = function(root)  -- every inner box / button corner of a built view in the panel layout's language (original radius kept in an attribute)
	if not root then return end
	local ps = _KR.pStyle()
	for _, o in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if o:IsA("UICorner") and o.Parent and o.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local p = o.Parent
			local r0 = o:GetAttribute("rcR0"); if r0 == nil then r0 = _KR.corners[o] or o.CornerRadius.Offset; o:SetAttribute("rcR0", r0) end
			local hh = p.Size.Y.Offset
			if not (hh > 0 and r0 >= hh / 2 - 0.5) then  -- pills / dots stay round
				local btn = p:IsA("TextButton") and (p.Text ~= "" or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel") ~= nil)
				local r = r0
				if ps == "Taskbar" then r = btn and 4 or math.min(r0, 6)
				elseif ps == "Minimal" then r = btn and math.max(10, math.floor(math.max(hh, 24) / 2)) or math.max(r0, 12) end
				_KR.corners[o] = r; o.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(p, r)
			end
		end
	end
end
_KR.styleTree = function(card)
	if not card then return end
	_KR.styleCard(card)
	_KR.cornerPass(card)
	local lift = T.card:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.07)
	for _, o in ipairs(card:GetDescendants()) do
		if (o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("Frame")) and o.BackgroundTransparency < 0.5 and o.BackgroundColor3 == T.card then
			o.BackgroundColor3 = lift  -- a T.card box on the (T.card) card was invisible
		end
	end
end
-- V4.5.57: the engine's own popups (mesh-loading notice, content installer + its popup, data-server popup) are built with raw
-- Instance.new outside this UI's scope. They follow the panel layout once they appear: the layout's corner language and no
-- outline (the UI is outline-free; their amber/grey card borders were the only outlines left). Text strokes stay.
_KR.FOREIGN = { RoClothesMeshNotice = true, _RoClothesInstallPopup = true, _RoClothesInstaller = true, _RoClothesDataPopup = true }
_KR.restyleForeign = function(root)
	if not root then return end
	for _, o in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if o:IsA("UIStroke") and o.Parent and o.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") and not (o.Parent:IsA("TextLabel") or o.Parent:IsA("TextButton") or o.Parent:IsA("TextBox")) then o.Enabled = false end
	end
	_KR.cornerPass(root)
end
for _, host in ipairs({ game:GetService("CoreGui"), (gethui and pcall(gethui) and gethui()) or nil }) do
	pcall(function() _KR.foreignConns = _KR.foreignConns or {}; table.insert(_KR.foreignConns, host.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c) if _KR.FOREIGN[c.Name] then task.defer(function() pcall(_KR.restyleForeign, c) end) end end)) end)
end
_KR.styleCard = function(f)
	local k = _KR.skin()
	f.BackgroundColor3 = T.card  -- every style: the card colour (a T.bg card hid the dialog's T.bg2 name field completely)
	f.BackgroundTransparency = k.cardT
	local c = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner"); if c then _KR.corners[c] = k.cardR; c.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(f, k.cardR) end
end
-- small controls inside a built page (input boxes, keybind keys, toggle/slider tracks, small buttons): same COLOUR (so their
-- own hover tweens stay consistent), the style's see-through + radius. Marked so a second pass never compounds.
_KR.skinPass = function(root)
	if not root then return end
	local k = _KR.skin()
	for _, o in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if (o:IsA("Frame") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox")) and o.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and o.Size.Y.Offset > 0 and o.Size.Y.Offset <= 36 then
			local bc = o.BackgroundColor3
			if bc == T.bg or bc == T.bg2 or bc == T.card then
				local base = o:GetAttribute("rcChipT"); if base == nil then base = o.BackgroundTransparency; o:SetAttribute("rcChipT", base) end
				if base < 0.5 then o.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(base, k.chipT) end
				if k.solid and (bc == T.bg or bc == T.bg2) then o.BackgroundColor3 = T.bg:Lerp(T.card, 0.45) end  -- Taskbar: inputs are a dark GREY well on the flat grey cell, not pure black
				local c = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
				if c then local b0 = o:GetAttribute("rcChipR"); if b0 == nil then b0 = _KR.corners[c] or 8; o:SetAttribute("rcChipR", b0) end
					local r = (b0 >= o.Size.Y.Offset / 2) and b0 or k.chipR  -- pills (toggle tracks, round X) stay pills
					_KR.corners[c] = r; c.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(o, r) end
			end
		end
	end
end
-- V4.5.57 LAYOUTS (krul: "add all of them, so the user can freely customize it"): the Home page and the tab panels each pick a
-- layout separately from the bar style. "Auto" = the bar style's own (Dock -> Dashboard + Classic, Taskbar -> Start menu +
-- Settings page, Minimal -> Typographic + Floating sheet). The panel CONTROL language (cells, toggles, sliders, segs, section
-- titles, close button) follows the panel layout: Classic = the Dock look, Settings page = Windows 11, Floating sheet = Minimal.
_KR.HOMES = {

	Start = { w = 620, ww = 1000, place = "corner", cap = 1, side = true },  -- ww: the two-column arrangement on a short landscape screen (phone)
	Widgets = { w = 700, ww = 1000, place = "left", cap = 1, side = true, clock = true },
	Type = { w = 1120, place = "center", cap = 1.25, clock = true },

_KR.homeLay = function() local v = SET.homeLayout; if v and v ~= "Auto" and _KR.HOMES[v] then return v end; local st = SET.barStyle or "Dock"; return (st == "Taskbar" and "Start") or (st == "Minimal" and "Type") or "Dashboard" end

_KR.topInset = function()  -- V4.5.57: a top Taskbar starts BELOW Roblox's top bar, so everything that clears the bar from the top adds this
	if SET.barStyle ~= "Taskbar" or not SET.barTop then return 0 end
	local y = 0; pcall(function() y = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset().Y end); return y
end
-- Home-style coloured surfaces: o = a white-base frame with gradient g whose FIRST key is the surface's own colour.
-- Dock keeps the gradient; Taskbar = flat Windows-widget tint; Minimal = coloured glass (cells = faint white glass).
_KR.tintSurface = function(o, g, small)
	local k = _KR.skin(); local c = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if _KR.light and _KR.light() and not g:GetAttribute("rcLight") then  -- V4.5.57 light mode: each surface keeps its own hue as a pastel (dark fills under dark text failed contrast)
		local kp, out = g.Color.Keypoints, {}
		for i, p in ipairs(kp) do out[i] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(p.Time, p.Value:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.8)) end
		g.Color = ColorSequence.new(out); g:SetAttribute("rcLight", true)
	end
	if c then local r = small and k.chipR + 2 or k.homeR; _KR.corners[c] = r; c.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(o, r) end
	if not k.flatHome then o.BackgroundTransparency = small and 0 or k.homeT; return end
	local ac = g.Color.Keypoints[1].Value
	g.Enabled = false
	if k.glassHome then
		if small then o.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); o.BackgroundTransparency = 0.92 else o.BackgroundColor3 = ac:Lerp(T.bg, 0.25); o.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 end
	else
		o.BackgroundColor3 = small and T.card:Lerp(ac, 0.32):Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.11) or T.card:Lerp(ac, 0.22); o.BackgroundTransparency = 0  -- cells clearly lighter than their card
	end
end
_KR.rowColor = function(k, hi) if k.div then return Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end; return hi and T.cardHi or T.card end  -- Dock/Taskbar cells = the palette's card colours, so rows match every other T.card surface (tiles, buttons, picker options) and THEIR hover tweens
local function rowShell(parent, h, order)
	local k = _KR.skin()
	local r = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = _KR.rowColor(k), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h or 40), LayoutOrder = order or 1, Parent = parent })
	r:SetAttribute("rcBaseT", k.rowT); r.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(k.rowT, _KR.glass); _KR.panels[r] = true  -- glassy-panels: born at the current glass + registered, so a live "Glassy panels" change updates it
	local rc = corner(r, k.rowR); local s = stroke(r, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1, k.rowS); pad(r, 12, 12, 0, 0)
	if k.div then new("Frame", { Name = "Div", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = r }) end
	-- hover: a touch brighter + a touch rounder. The REST look is read back from attributes, so a caller that recolours
	-- its row (primary button) sets rcRestC/rcBaseT and hover-out returns to THAT, not to the plain cell.
	r.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if not SET.hoverFx or SET.reduceMotion then return end; if r:GetAttribute("rcNoHover") then return end; tween(r, 0.28, { BackgroundColor3 = _KR.rowColor(k, true), BackgroundTransparency = math.max(k.rowHiT, math.min(_KR.glass, k.rowHiT)) }); tween(s, 0.28, { Transparency = math.max(0, k.rowS - 0.06) }); tween(rc, 0.28, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor((k.rowR + 2) * _KR.cornerScale + 0.5)) }) end)
	r.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if r:GetAttribute("rcNoHover") then return end; tween(r, 0.28, { BackgroundColor3 = _KR.rowColor(k), BackgroundTransparency = math.max(r:GetAttribute("rcBaseT") or k.rowT, _KR.glass) }); tween(s, 0.28, { Transparency = k.rowS }); tween(rc, 0.28, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(k.rowR * _KR.cornerScale + 0.5)) }) end)
	return r, s
end

_KR.cardHead = function(r, title, text, right, kind)  -- r = a rowShell, title = its label, right = px the control needs. Returns true when a description was added.
	local e = _KR.SDESC[tostring(text or "")] or (tostring(text):match("^Strip ") and { "clothes", "What comes off when this piece tears" }) or nil
	local hasD = e ~= nil
	local ico = mkIcon(e and e[1] or "options", 18)
	ico.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5); ico.Position = (kind == "slider") and UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0); ico.Parent = r
	for _, o in ipairs(ico:GetDescendants()) do
		if o:IsA("Frame") and o.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then o.BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2 elseif o:IsA("UIStroke") then o.Color = T.txt2 end
	end
	title.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero; title.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center; title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	if kind ~= "slider" then r.Size = UDim2.new(r.Size.X.Scale, r.Size.X.Offset, 0, hasD and 58 or 46) end
	if hasD or kind == "slider" then title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 10); title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(30 + right), 0, 20)
	else title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 0); title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(30 + right), 1, 0) end
	local d
	if hasD then d = lbl({ Name = "Desc", Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30), Size = UDim2.new(1, -(30 + right), 0, 16), Text = e[2], TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 11.5, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = r }) end
	if kind ~= "slider" then
		-- V4.5.57 responsive card (krul: "Aut..." + one word per line in narrow columns). Wide = icon | title + description | control.
		-- When the text would get under 140px, the card STACKS: title and description take the full width (wrapped, never cut),
		-- the control drops to its own line at the bottom right, and the toggle's On/Off caption hides (the switch shows it).
		-- Middle widths keep the old behaviour: the description takes a 2nd line instead of being cut off.
		local tPos, tSize, iPos = title.Position, title.Size, ico.Position
		local ctrls, onoff, ctrlH, tw = nil, nil, 30, nil
		local TS = game:GetService("TextService")
		local function collect()  -- the control parts are right-anchored children (some are made AFTER cardHead, e.g. the toggle switch)
			ctrls = {}
			for _, c in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c ~= title and c ~= ico and c ~= d and c.AnchorPoint.X == 1 then
					if c:GetAttribute("rcOnOff") then onoff = c else ctrls[#ctrls + 1] = { o = c, ap = c.AnchorPoint, pos = c.Position, size = c.Size }; if c.Size.Y.Scale == 0 then ctrlH = math.max(ctrlH, c.Size.Y.Offset) end end
				end
			end
		end
		local function layout()
			if not r.Parent or ico.AbsoluteSize.X < 1 or ico.Size.X.Offset <= 0 then return end
			local sc = ico.AbsoluteSize.X / ico.Size.X.Offset  -- the icon's fixed logical size gives the UIScale factor (independent of the row height we change below)
			local pdg = r:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
			local cw = r.AbsoluteSize.X / sc - (pdg and (pdg.PaddingLeft.Offset + pdg.PaddingRight.Offset) or 0)  -- content width in layout px
			if not ctrls then collect() end
			local tw0 = (kind == "field") and (cw * 0.54 - 36) or (cw - 30 - right)  -- the text column width (a field's box takes the right 46%)
			local narrow = tw0 < 140
			local f = d and ((d.Font ~= Enum.Font.Unknown) and d.Font or FONT)
			local h
			if narrow then
				title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 10); title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 20); ico.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20)  -- icon beside the title, not centred on the taller card
				local dh = 0
				if d then
					dh = math.ceil(TS:GetTextSize(d.Text, d.TextSize, f, Vector2.new(math.max(40, cw), 1e4)).Y) + 2
					d.TextWrapped = true; d.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None; d.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 34); d.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, dh)
				end
				for _, c in ipairs(ctrls) do
					local ph = (c.size.Y.Scale > 0) and ctrlH or c.size.Y.Offset
					c.o.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(c.ap.X, 1); c.o.Position = UDim2.new(c.pos.X.Scale, c.pos.X.Offset, 1, -8 - math.floor((ctrlH - ph) / 2))  -- centred on the control line (a small chevron sat low)
					if c.size.Y.Scale > 0 then c.o.Size = UDim2.new(c.size.X.Scale, c.size.X.Offset, 0, ctrlH) end  -- a full-height part (dropdown value, switch hit area) would centre in the whole card
				end
				if onoff then onoff.Visible = false end
				h = 34 + ((dh > 0) and (dh + 8) or 0) + ctrlH + 12
			else
				title.Position, title.Size, ico.Position = tPos, tSize, iPos
				if kind == "field" then title.Size = UDim2.new(0.54, -36, tSize.Y.Scale, tSize.Y.Offset) end  -- keep a field's text clear of its input box
				for _, c in ipairs(ctrls) do c.o.AnchorPoint = c.ap; c.o.Position = c.pos; c.o.Size = c.size end
				if onoff then onoff.Visible = true end
				local wrap = false
				if d then
					if not tw then tw = TS:GetTextSize(d.Text, d.TextSize, f, Vector2.new(10000, 100)).X end
					wrap = tw > tw0 + 0.5
					d.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30); d.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd; d.TextWrapped = wrap
					d.Size = (kind == "field") and UDim2.new(0.54, -36, 0, wrap and 30 or 16) or UDim2.new(1, -(30 + right), 0, wrap and 30 or 16)
				end
				h = d and (wrap and 72 or 58) or 46
			end
			if r.Size.Y.Offset ~= h then r.Size = UDim2.new(r.Size.X.Scale, r.Size.X.Offset, 0, h) end
		end
		r:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(layout); task.defer(layout)
	end
	local row = r.Parent and r.Parent.Parent  -- a side-by-side pair (cols) -> stack it full width
	if row and row:GetAttribute("rcCols") then
		local l = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
		if l and l.FillDirection ~= Enum.FillDirection.Vertical then
			l.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical; l.Padding = UDim.new(0, 7)
			for _, c in ipairs(row:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) end end
		end
	end
	return hasD
end
_KR.cardBox = function(r, w, zOver)  -- the Fluent combo-box well behind a dropdown / cycler value
	local b = new("Frame", { Name = "Combo", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 4, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 30), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.94, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Parent = r }); corner(b, 4)
	for _, o in ipairs(zOver) do o.ZIndex = 2; for _, d in ipairs(o:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("GuiObject") then d.ZIndex = 2 end end end
	return b
end
UI.hoverFill = function(btn, rest, hi)  -- hover brighten for a button that opted out of AutoButtonColor (rest -> hi on MouseEnter, back on leave). Gated on the "Hover effects" setting, like rowShell.
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if SET.hoverFx and not SET.reduceMotion then tween(btn, 0.18, { BackgroundColor3 = hi or T.cardHi }) end end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(btn, 0.18, { BackgroundColor3 = rest }) end)
end
_KR.closeSkin = function(btn, dur)  -- V4.5.57: the X's rest look for the panel layout: Classic = rounded card chip; Settings page = flat square (red on hover); Floating sheet = a bare x
	local ps = _KR.pStyle(); local c = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner"); local s = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	local r = (ps == "Taskbar" and 4) or (ps == "Minimal" and 40) or (btn:GetAttribute("rcCloseR") or 8)
	if c then _KR.corners[c] = r; c.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(btn, r) end
	local props = { BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BackgroundTransparency = (ps == "Dock") and 0 or 1 }
	if dur then tween(btn, dur, props) else btn.BackgroundColor3 = props.BackgroundColor3; btn.BackgroundTransparency = props.BackgroundTransparency end
	if s then if dur then tween(s, dur, { Color = T.line }) else s.Color = T.line end end
	for _, x in ipairs(btn:GetChildren()) do if x:IsA("Frame") then if dur then tween(x, dur, { BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2 }) else x.BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2 end end end
end
UI.closeBtn = function(parent, sizePx, cornerPx, hoverDur)  -- the round close (X) button shared by the single panel + every Multi-Panel panel. Two rotated Frames form the X; barLen preserves the original 26->11 / 24->10 size ratio. Returns the button (caller wires MouseButton1Click).
	sizePx, cornerPx, hoverDur = sizePx or 26, cornerPx or 8, hoverDur or 0.25
	local barLen = math.floor(sizePx * 11 / 26 + 0.5)
	local btn = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sizePx, sizePx), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Parent = parent }); corner(btn, cornerPx); btn:SetAttribute("rcCloseR", cornerPx); local s = stroke(btn, T.line, 1)  -- V4.5.57: shape per panel layout via _KR.closeSkin (below)
	new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(barLen, 1.6), Rotation = 45, Parent = btn })
	new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(barLen, 1.6), Rotation = -45, Parent = btn })
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		local ps = _KR.pStyle()
		if ps == "Taskbar" then tween(btn, hoverDur, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(196, 43, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 0 }); for _, x in ipairs(btn:GetChildren()) do if x:IsA("Frame") then tween(x, hoverDur, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) }) end end  -- Windows: the close turns red
		elseif ps == "Minimal" then for _, x in ipairs(btn:GetChildren()) do if x:IsA("Frame") then tween(x, hoverDur, { BackgroundColor3 = T.txt }) end end  -- a bare x that just brightens
		else tween(btn, hoverDur, { BackgroundColor3 = T.cardHi }); tween(s, hoverDur, { Color = T.bad }) end
	end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() _KR.closeSkin(btn, hoverDur) end)
	_KR.closeSkin(btn)
	return btn
end
function UI.button(parent, text, kind, order, onClick, ht)
	local r = rowShell(parent, ht or 40, order)  -- ht lets a button be a taller tile (varied heights / bento)
	local fill = kind == "primary"
	if fill then r.BackgroundColor3 = T.accentD; r.BackgroundTransparency = 0; r:SetAttribute("rcBaseT", 0); r:SetAttribute("rcNoHover", true); UI.breathe(new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 25, Color = ColorSequence.new(T.accent, (SET.accentGrad or "Off") ~= "Off" and T.accent2 or T.accentD), Parent = r }), { Rotation = 45 }, 2.6) end  -- ambient: the primary CTA's gradient angle drifts for a subtle sheen
	_KR.press(r)  -- V4.5.55 macOS: darkens on press (no shrink, no click-time pop)
	lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = text or "Button", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = fill and T.txt or T.accent, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = r })
	local busy, last = false, 0  -- debounce: a 2nd click within 0.1s or while onClick is still running is ignored (same window the old 0.1s pop-yield gave)
	r:SetAttribute("rcKind", "action")  -- V4.5.57 search
	r.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if busy or os.clock() - last < 0.1 then return end; busy, last = true, os.clock(); local okC, errC = true, nil; if onClick then okC, errC = pcall(onClick) end; busy = false; if not okC then warn("[RoClothes] button \"" .. tostring(text) .. "\": " .. tostring(errC)) end end)  -- V4.5.68: an error in onClick left busy=true = the button dead until its page was rebuilt
	return r
end
function UI.toggle(parent, text, state, order, onChange)
	local r = rowShell(parent, 42, order)
	local tl = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0), Text = text or "Toggle", TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = r })  -- V4.5.49: long labels end in "..." instead of running into the switch
	local stL  -- V4.5.57 Settings-page card: "On" / "Off" beside the switch, like Windows 11
	if _KR.cardOn(parent) then stL = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 20), Text = "", TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = r }); stL:SetAttribute("rcOnOff", true); _KR.cardHead(r, tl, text, 92, "toggle") end
	local track = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 22), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = r }); corner(track, 11); local ts = stroke(track, T.line, 1)
	local fill = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = track }); corner(fill, 11); new("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(T.accent2, T.accent), Parent = fill })
	local knob = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = track }); corner(knob, 8)
	local on = state and true or false
	local knobOn = (_KR.pStyle() == "Taskbar") and T.bg or T.txt  -- V4.5.57: Windows 11 toggles carry a DARK knob on the accent
	local function knobPos() return on and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0) end
	local function paint(a)
		if stL then stL.Text = on and "On" or "Off" end
		if a then _KR.spring(knob, "Position", knobPos(), 3.5, 1); tween(knob, 0.3, { BackgroundColor3 = on and knobOn or T.txt2 }); tween(fill, 0.35, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1 }, QUINT); tween(ts, 0.3, { Color = on and T.accent or T.line })  -- V4.5.55 macOS: critically damped slide, no stretch/bounce
		else knob.Position = knobPos(); knob.BackgroundColor3 = on and knobOn or T.txt2; fill.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1; ts.Color = on and T.accent or T.line end
	end
	paint(false)
	-- hit area confined to the switch (right), not the whole row - clicking the label / empty space no longer toggles it
	local hit = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, stL and 90 or 52, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Parent = r })  -- card: the On/Off text is part of the target
	hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() on = not on; paint(true); if onChange then onChange(on) end end)  -- the knob slide is the feedback (no extra scale pop)
	r:SetAttribute("rcKind", "toggle"); _KR.tgl[r] = { get = function() return on end, flip = function() on = not on; paint(true); if onChange then onChange(on) end end, set = function(v) v = v and true or false; if v ~= on then on = v; paint(true) end end }  -- V4.5.71: set = repaint only (no onChange)  -- V4.5.57: settings search flips it from the results
	return r
end
function UI.slider(parent, text, value, min, max, order, onChange, resetTo, noPersist)  -- resetTo: default -> one-tap "R" reset. Slider values always seed from the supplied live value; noPersist remains accepted for existing callers.
	min, max = min or 0, max or 100
	local r = rowShell(parent, 52, order)
	r:SetAttribute("rcKind", "slider")  -- V4.5.57 search
	local tl = lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 9), Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 16), Text = text or "Slider", TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = r })
	local valL = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 9), Size = UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 16), Text = tostring(value or min), Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.accent, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = r })
	local track = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 34), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = r }); corner(track, 3)
	local fill = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = track }); corner(fill, 3); new("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(T.accent2, T.accent), Parent = fill })
	local knob = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), BackgroundColor3 = T.txt, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Parent = track }); corner(knob, 6); local kGlow = stroke(knob, T.accent, 0)  -- accent ring, brightens while dragging
	do local st = _KR.pStyle()  -- V4.5.57 per-style slider: Taskbar = Fluent thumb (white disc, accent centre); Minimal = a hairline track
		if st == "Taskbar" then local dot = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4, Parent = knob }); corner(dot, 6); track.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4); track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 35)
		elseif st == "Minimal" then track.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3); track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 35) end
	end
	local v = math.clamp(value or min, min, max)
	local function setPct(p, animate)
		p = math.clamp(p, 0, 1); v = math.floor(min + (max - min) * p + 0.5); valL.Text = tostring(v)
		if animate then tween(fill, 0.2, { Size = UDim2.new(p, 0, 1, 0) }); tween(knob, 0.2, { Position = UDim2.new(p, 0, 0.5, 0) })
		else fill.Size = UDim2.new(p, 0, 1, 0); knob.Position = UDim2.new(p, 0, 0.5, 0) end
	end
	setPct((v - min) / (max - min), false)
	if resetTo ~= nil then  -- one-tap "R" reset to the default (real script's Edit sliders)
		valL.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 16); valL.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 9)  -- make room on the right for the R button
		local rb = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 18), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "R", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 11, Parent = r }); corner(rb, 6); stroke(rb, T.lineSoft, 1); UI.hoverFill(rb, T.card, T.cardHi)
		rb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setPct((math.clamp(resetTo, min, max) - min) / (max - min), true); if onChange then onChange(v) end end)
	end
	local dragging, armed, sx, sy = false, false, 0, 0  -- armed = a touch landed but we're waiting to see if it's a horizontal DRAG (engage) or a vertical SCROLL (ignore)
	local function fromX(x) setPct((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track.AbsoluteSize.X), false); if onChange then onChange(v) end end
	local function _grow() tween(knob, 0.25, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16) }, BACK); tween(kGlow, 0.2, { Thickness = 2.5 }); tween(valL, 0.2, { TextColor3 = T.txt }) end
	local function _shrink() tween(knob, 0.3, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12) }, QUINT); tween(kGlow, 0.28, { Thickness = 0 }); tween(valL, 0.28, { TextColor3 = T.accent }) end
	local DRAG_SLOP = 8  -- px of HORIZONTAL travel a touch must make before the slider engages. Below this a stray tap or a vertical scroll that grazes the track leaves the value untouched (mobile: scrolling no longer nudges sliders).
	-- drag/tap zone confined to the track band (bottom), not the label + value row above it
	local hit = new("TextButton", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", ZIndex = 2, Parent = r })
	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(io)
		if io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true; _grow(); fromX(io.Position.X)  -- desktop: click-to-jump immediately (a mouse can't "scroll" through a control)
		elseif io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then armed = true; sx, sy = io.Position.X, io.Position.Y end  -- mobile: arm, don't move yet - wait for the gesture direction
	end)
	-- these are on the GLOBAL service (a drag can leave the row), so they MUST be disconnected when the row is
	-- destroyed on a page rebuild - otherwise every slider leaks a pair per (re)build for the whole session.
	local c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(io)
		if not (io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then return end
		if dragging then fromX(io.Position.X)
		elseif armed then
			local dx, dy = math.abs(io.Position.X - sx), math.abs(io.Position.Y - sy)
			if dy > DRAG_SLOP and dy >= dx then armed = false  -- vertical intent = a scroll: bow out, never touch the value
			elseif dx > DRAG_SLOP and dx > dy then dragging = true; armed = false; _grow(); fromX(io.Position.X) end  -- horizontal intent = a deliberate slider drag: engage
		end
	end)
	local c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(io) if io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then if dragging then _shrink() end; dragging = false; armed = false end end)
	r.Destroying:Connect(function() c1:Disconnect(); c2:Disconnect() end)
	if _KR.cardOn(parent) then  -- V4.5.57 Settings-page card: icon + title + description on top, the track under them (indented to the text)
		local y = _KR.cardHead(r, tl, text, 64, "slider") and 58 or 40
		r.Size = UDim2.new(r.Size.X.Scale, r.Size.X.Offset, 0, y + 16)
		valL.Position = UDim2.new(1, valL.Position.X.Offset, 0, 12)
		track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, y); track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, track.Size.Y.Offset)
		hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, y - 11); hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 26)
	end
	return r
end
-- V4.5.59: a body-type card's picture = the real mesh in a ViewportFrame (front 3/4 view, framed by its size). The mesh
-- is fetched in a task (a cold mesh yields) and dropped if the picker was closed meanwhile.
function UI._meshSketch(fr, field, n)
	local vp = new("ViewportFrame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 178), LightColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, 0.6), ZIndex = fr.ZIndex, Parent = fr }); corner(vp, 7)
	local wait = lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "...", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 12, ZIndex = fr.ZIndex + 1, Parent = fr })
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, p, size = pcall(System.getBodyTypePreview, field, n)
		if not vp.Parent then if ok and p then p:Destroy() end; return end
		wait:Destroy()
		if not (ok and p) then lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "No preview", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 11, ZIndex = fr.ZIndex + 1, Parent = fr }); return end
		p.Parent = vp
		local d = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 1.9 + 0.3
		local cam = Instance.new("Camera"); cam.FieldOfView = 40
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(d * 0.45, d * 0.2, -d), Vector3.new())
		cam.Parent = vp; vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	end)
end
function UI.dropdown(parent, text, options, order, onPick, rich)  -- rich (V4.5.57): picture-card picker spec, see UI.openDropdown
	local key = _curPage .. "\1d:" .. (text or "")
	-- V4.5.69: options may be a FUNCTION returning the list, read each time the picker opens (the Player list was a
	-- snapshot from when the page was built: players who joined later never showed, ones who left stayed).
	local optsFn = (type(options) == "function") and options or nil
	if optsFn then local okO, o = pcall(optsFn); options = (okO and type(o) == "table") and o or {} end
	-- A plain row; tapping opens the centered option-picker modal (UI.openDropdown) instead of an inline drop that
	-- shoves the layout down. Looks like a proper window and never disturbs the bento grid around it.
	local head = rowShell(parent, 42, order or 1)
	local tl = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0), Text = text or "Dropdown", TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = head })
	local cur = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 1, 0), Text = S[key] or options[1] or "-", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.accent, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = head }); UI.breathe(cur, { TextColor3 = T.accent:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.25) }, 2.6)  -- ambient value glow
	local chevF = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = head })
	new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.txt3, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.33, 0, 0.4, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 1.6), Rotation = 45, Parent = chevF }); corner(chevF)
	new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.txt3, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.67, 0, 0.4, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 1.6), Rotation = -45, Parent = chevF })
	if _KR.pStyle() == "Minimal" then chevF:SetAttribute("rcRest", -90); chevF.Rotation = -90 end  -- V4.5.57 Floating sheet: value + a right chevron, like a list row
	if _KR.cardOn(parent) then _KR.cardHead(head, tl, text, 124, "dropdown"); cur.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, 0); cur.Size = UDim2.new(0, 84, 1, 0); _KR.cardBox(head, 120, { cur, chevF }) end  -- V4.5.57 Settings-page card: a combo box on the right
	head.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		tween(chevF, 0.16, { Rotation = (chevF:GetAttribute("rcRest") or 0) + 180 }, QUINT)  -- quick nudge for press feedback; springs back when the modal closes
		if optsFn then local okO, o = pcall(optsFn); if okO and type(o) == "table" then options = o end end
		UI.openDropdown(text or "Select", options, S[key] or options[1], function(opt)
			cur.Text = tostring(opt); UI.pop(cur); S[key] = tostring(opt); if onPick then onPick(opt) end
		end, function() tween(chevF, 0.25, { Rotation = chevF:GetAttribute("rcRest") or 0 }) end, UI.panelRootOf(head), (type(rich) == "function") and rich() or rich)
	end)
	return head
end
-- info card (Home dashboard block): title + desc + a body you drop stats/controls into.
function UI.card(parent, title, desc, order, accent)
	-- WHITE base: a UIGradient multiplies BackgroundColor3, so a white base lets the gradient show its true colour.
	local c = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = order or 1, Parent = parent })
	corner(c, 11); local cs = stroke(c, T.lineSoft, 1); pad(c, 15, 15, 13, 13); vlist(c, 8)
	-- per-card accent gradient: the card's OWN colour up top fading down into neutral grey, not one gradient for every card.
	local ac = accent or Color3.fromRGB(74, 46, 96)
	local cg = new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 55, Color = ColorSequence.new(ac, ac:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 0.55)), Parent = c })  -- fully coloured (accent -> darker accent), NO grey, like the Volt/Discord cards
	c:SetAttribute("rcTinted", true); _KR.tintSurface(c, cg, false)  -- V4.5.57: the card keeps its colour in every style (Taskbar tint / Minimal coloured glass)
	c.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(cs, 0.3, { Color = T.line }) end)
	c.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(cs, 0.3, { Color = T.lineSoft }) end)
	lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 21), Text = title or "", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 17, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = c })
	if desc and desc ~= "" then lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = desc, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 12.5, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = c }) end
	local body = new("Frame", { Name = "Body", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = c }); vlist(body, 8)
	return c, body
end
-- 2-column stat grid: items = { {"value","label"}, ... }
-- count a numeric stat up from 0 to its value (micro-animation). Skips time "MM:SS" and non-numeric text.
local function countUp(label, text, dur)
	text = tostring(text)
	if text:find(":") then label.Text = text; return end
	local num, rest = string.match(text, "^(%d+)(.*)$")
	if not num then label.Text = text; return end
	local target, steps = tonumber(num), 16; dur = dur or 0.55
	task.spawn(function()
		for s = 1, steps do
			if not label.Parent then return end
			label.Text = tostring(math.floor(target * s / steps + 0.5)) .. rest
			task.wait(dur / steps)
		end
		if label.Parent then label.Text = text end
	end)
end
function UI.stats(body, items, order, accent)
	local wrap = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = order or 1, Parent = body }); vlist(wrap, 8)
	-- cells are a dark tint of the card's OWN accent colour (not grey) so the card + its cells read as one colour.
	local ac = accent or Color3.fromRGB(74, 46, 96)
	local cTop, cBot = ac:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 0.5), ac:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 0.7)
	local vals = {}  -- caption -> value label, so callers can update a cell live (e.g. the uptime counter)
	local function makeCell(parent, it, wScale)
		local cell = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(wScale, wScale < 1 and -4 or 0, 0, 50), Parent = parent }); corner(cell, 8); stroke(cell, T.lineSoft, 1); pad(cell, 11, 11, 7, 7)
		new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 40, Color = ColorSequence.new(cTop, cBot), Parent = cell })  -- cell tinted with the card's accent colour
		local vLbl = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), Text = "", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 14, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = cell }); vLbl.Text = it[1]  -- set directly; the Home entrance count-ups these AFTER reveal (counting here, behind the fade, both hid the count and let the entrance capture a mid-count value)
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 21), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = it[2], TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 11.5, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = cell })
		vals[it[2]] = vLbl
		if it.copy then  -- tap the whole cell to copy a payload (e.g. the server-join script) to the clipboard
			local sp = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Active = true, Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 6, Parent = cell })
			sp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				local payload = (type(it.copy) == "function") and it.copy() or it.copy
				local ok = false; if setclipboard and payload and payload ~= "" then ok = pcall(setclipboard, payload) end
				toast(it[2], ok and "Copied to clipboard." or "No setclipboard on this executor.", ok and "ok" or "warn")
				vLbl.Text = ok and "Copied!" or "Tap to copy"; task.delay(1.1, function() if vLbl.Parent then vLbl.Text = it[1] end end)  -- brief inline confirm, then revert
			end)
		end
		if it[4] then  -- privacy: hide the VALUE TEXT ITSELF (no cover overlay). The real text isn't even in the
			-- label until revealed, so it's screenshot-safe. Tap the cell to reveal it, tap again to re-hide.
			local HIDDEN = "•  •  •   tap to reveal"
			vLbl.Text = HIDDEN; vLbl.TextColor3 = T.txt3
			local sp = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Active = true, Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 6, Parent = cell })  -- whole-cell tap target
			local shown = false
			sp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				shown = not shown
				tween(vLbl, 0.14, { TextTransparency = 1 })  -- fade out, swap the text, fade back in (a clean reveal)
				task.delay(0.14, function() if vLbl.Parent then vLbl.Text = shown and it[1] or HIDDEN; vLbl.TextColor3 = shown and T.txt or T.txt3; tween(vLbl, 0.2, { TextTransparency = 0 }) end end)
			end)
		end
	end
	-- VARIED sizes: an item tagged "full" takes a whole row; the rest pair two-per-row (a lone one goes full).
	local i, ro = 1, 0
	while i <= #items do
		ro += 1
		local rowF = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50), LayoutOrder = ro, Parent = wrap })
		new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = rowF })
		local it = items[i]
		if it[3] == "full" then makeCell(rowF, it, 1); i += 1
		else
			local nxt = items[i + 1]
			if nxt and nxt[3] ~= "full" then makeCell(rowF, it, 0.5); makeCell(rowF, nxt, 0.5); i += 2
			else makeCell(rowF, it, 1); i += 1 end
		end
	end
	return wrap, vals
end
-- one "big number + caption" stat (optional green dot before the caption), matching the site's live counter.
local function fmtNum(n) local s = tostring(math.floor(n)); return (s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")) end
local function miniStat(parent, value, caption, order, dot, numSize)
	numSize = numSize or 21
	local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(96, numSize * 4), 46), LayoutOrder = order, Parent = parent })
	local vlab = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, numSize + 3), Text = value, Font = FONTB, TextSize = numSize, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = f })
	local capRow = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, numSize + 5), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12), Parent = f })
	new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = capRow })
	if dot then local d = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), BackgroundColor3 = T.good, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = capRow }); corner(d, 3)
		task.spawn(function() task.wait(1.6); while d.Parent do tween(d, 0.9, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.55 }); task.wait(0.95); tween(d, 0.9, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }); task.wait(0.95) end end) end  -- ambient breathing pulse (starts after the entrance so it doesn't fight the reveal)
	lbl({ AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Text = caption, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 9.5, Font = FONTB, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = capRow })
	return vlab
end

local _pH, _pS, _pV, _pApply = 0, 1, 1, nil
local function _pRefresh()
	local col = Color3.fromHSV(_pH, _pS, _pV)
	_sv.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(_pH, 1, 1)
	_svDot.Position = UDim2.new(_pS, 0, 1 - _pV, 0); _hueDot.Position = UDim2.new(_pH, 0, 0.5, 0)
	_prev.BackgroundColor3 = col
	_hexL.Text = string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(col.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(col.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(col.B * 255 + 0.5))
end

	chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() _pH, _pS, _pV = pc:ToHSV(); _pRefresh() end)
end
_hexL.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local s = (_hexL.Text or ""):gsub("%s", ""):gsub("^#", "")
	if s:match("^%x%x%x$") then s = s:sub(1, 1):rep(2) .. s:sub(2, 2):rep(2) .. s:sub(3, 3):rep(2) end
	if s:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then
		local c = Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(s:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(s:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(s:sub(5, 6), 16))
		_pH, _pS, _pV = c:ToHSV()
	end
	_pRefresh()  -- valid: moves the map/hue/preview to it; invalid: puts the current colour's code back
end)
local _svDrag, _hueDrag = false, false
local function _svAt(px) _pS = math.clamp((px.X - _sv.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, _sv.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1); _pV = 1 - math.clamp((px.Y - _sv.AbsolutePosition.Y) / math.max(1, _sv.AbsoluteSize.Y), 0, 1); _pRefresh() end
local function _hueAt(px) _pH = math.clamp((px.X - _hue.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, _hue.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1); _pRefresh() end

_pk2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(io) if io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then _svDrag, _hueDrag = false, false end end)

_pCancelBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() pickerScreen.Enabled = false end)
-- Close ONLY on a click genuinely OUTSIDE the card. This does NOT rely on Active sinking (which keeps leaking on
-- this executor): even if a click on the card reaches the dim, the bounds check keeps the picker open. io.Position
-- and AbsolutePosition are both raw (IgnoreGuiInset) screen coords, so they line up.
_pDim.InputBegan:Connect(function(io)
	if io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local p, cp, cs = io.Position, _pCard.AbsolutePosition, _pCard.AbsoluteSize
		if p.X < cp.X or p.X > cp.X + cs.X or p.Y < cp.Y or p.Y > cp.Y + cs.Y then pickerScreen.Enabled = false end
	end
end)
end  -- close the picker do-block

-- ===== generic confirm/prompt modal (reused). buttons = { {text=, kind="primary"?, onClick=} , ... }; opt. text field. =====
-- Wrapped in `do…end`: the _m* element locals are used ONLY by showModal + the InputBegan closure, so scoping them
-- makes them upvalues (freed from the main chunk) - reclaims registers for multi-panel (Luau 200-local cap). BUT
-- `modalScreen` IS referenced OUTSIDE (openHome's ownGui set + the DESTROY teardown), so it must be forward-declared,
-- not scoped into the block - otherwise it reads nil outside and `{ [modalScreen]=true }` throws "table index is nil".
local showModal, modalScreen  -- forward: showModal (dialogs/Bundles), modalScreen (openHome ownGui + DESTROY)
do
modalScreen = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "RoClothesModal", ResetOnSpawn = false, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 1003, Enabled = false, Parent = PlayerGui })
