_KR.HL.tab = function(id) if _KR.openTabId then _KR.openTabId(id) end end
_KR.HL.newsList = function() return _KR.newsItems or {} end
_KR.HL.catCol = function(c) return (_KR.newsCat and _KR.newsCat(c)) or T.accent end  -- (catCol itself darkens on light)
-- light weight (the Minimal layouts' thin type); falls back silently where FontFace weights aren't available
_KR.HL.light = function(l) pcall(function() l.FontFace = Font.new(l.FontFace.Family, Enum.FontWeight.Light) end); return l end
-- a text button with its own hover (kind: "accent" filled | "soft" faint white | "ghost" text only). Returns btn, label.
_KR.HL.btn = function(parent, text, kind, size, onClick, order)
	local rest = (kind == "accent" and T.accentD) or T.card
	local restT = (kind == "accent" and 0) or (kind == "soft" and 0) or 1
	local b = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = kind == "soft" and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or rest, BackgroundTransparency = kind == "soft" and 0.92 or restT, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = size or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30), AutomaticSize = size and Enum.AutomaticSize.None or Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = order or 1, Parent = parent })
	corner(b, 8); if not size then pad(b, 14, 14, 0, 0) end
	local l = lbl({ Size = size and UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = size and Enum.AutomaticSize.None or Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Text = text, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = (kind == "ghost") and T.accent or T.txt, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = b })
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if not SET.hoverFx or SET.reduceMotion then return end
		if kind == "soft" then tween(b, 0.16, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.84 }) elseif kind == "accent" then tween(b, 0.16, { BackgroundColor3 = T.accent }) else tween(b, 0.16, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 }) end end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if kind == "soft" then tween(b, 0.16, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.92 }) elseif kind == "accent" then tween(b, 0.16, { BackgroundColor3 = T.accentD }) else tween(b, 0.16, { BackgroundTransparency = restT }) end end)
	_KR.press(b)
	if onClick then b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() onClick(function(t) if l.Parent then l.Text = t or text end end) end) end
	return b, l
end
-- "Label ›" text link: the arrow carries the accent, the text brightens on hover
_KR.HL.link = function(parent, text, onClick, order, size)
	local b = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, (size or 13) + 8), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = order or 1, Parent = parent })
	local hex = string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(T.accent.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(T.accent.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(T.accent.B * 255 + 0.5))
	local l = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, RichText = true, Text = text .. ' <font color="' .. hex .. '">›</font>', Font = FONTB, TextSize = size or 13, TextColor3 = T.txt2, Parent = b })
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(l, 0.15, { TextColor3 = T.txt }) end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(l, 0.15, { TextColor3 = T.txt2 }) end)
	if onClick then b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onClick) end
	return b
end
-- glyphs for the non-tab tiles (UI Settings / News / Guide / Chat / Discord) - drawn from frames like mkIcon, white
_KR.HL.glyph = function(kind, sz)
	if kind == "uiset" then return mkIcon("options", sz) end
	local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz) })
	local u = sz / 20
	local function bx(x, y, w, h, r) local o = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x * u, 0.5, y * u), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, w * u), math.max(1, h * u)), BackgroundColor3 = IC, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = f }); if r then corner(o, r * u) end; return o end
	if kind == "news" then bx(0, -5, 14, 2.2, 1); bx(0, 0, 14, 2.2, 1); bx(-2.5, 5, 9, 2.2, 1)
	elseif kind == "guide" then lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "?", Font = FONTB, TextSize = math.floor(17 * u), TextColor3 = IC, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = f })
	elseif kind == "chat" then bx(0, -1, 16, 11, 4); local t = bx(-4, 5, 5, 5); t.Rotation = 45
	elseif kind == "discord" then local b = bx(0, 0, 17, 12, 5); local e1 = bx(-3.5, 0, 3, 3.4, 1.5); local e2 = bx(3.5, 0, 3, 3.4, 1.5); e1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242); e2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242)
	elseif kind == "join" then bx(0, 3, 14, 2.2, 1); bx(0, -3, 2.2, 10, 1); local a = bx(-2.4, -6, 2.2, 6, 1); a.Rotation = -45; local b2 = bx(2.4, -6, 2.2, 6, 1); b2.Rotation = 45 end
	return f
end
-- a news "hero": the category's gradient + the KRUL mark, upgraded to the real post image when the News view already cached it
_KR.HL.hero = function(parent, item, h, r)
	local cc = _KR.HL.catCol(item and item.cat)
	local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = parent }); corner(f, r or 10)
	new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 35, Color = ColorSequence.new(cc:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.08), cc:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.55)), Parent = f })
	lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 26), Text = "KRUL", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 20, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextTransparency = 0.8, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = f })
	local hit = item and item.image and _KR.A and _KR.A._newsImg and _KR.A._newsImg[item.image]
	if hit and hit.path then
		local exists = false; pcall(function() exists = (isfile and isfile(hit.path)) or false end)
		if exists then local ok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, hit.path); if ok and type(asset) == "string" then local il = new("ImageLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = asset, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, Parent = f }); corner(il, r or 10); if hit.gif then il.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(hit.fw or 0, hit.fh or 0) end end end
	end
	return f
end
-- the four headline numbers every layout shows; fills `put(key, label)`-returned labels live. keys: players, friends, up, runs
_KR.HL.feed = function(L, alive)
	if L.players then _KR.HL.tick(L.players, 3, _KR.HL.players) end
	if L.up then _KR.HL.tick(L.up, 1, function() return _KR.HL.up(L.upShort) end) end
	if L.ping then _KR.HL.tick(L.ping, 2, _KR.HL.ping) end
	if L.time then _KR.HL.tick(L.time, 1, _KR.HL.time) end
	for _, k in ipairs({ "friends", "friendsCap", "runs", "runsCap" }) do if L[k] then L[k]:SetAttribute("live", true) end end
	if L.friends or L.friendsCap then
		_KR.HL.friends(function(inS, on, tot)
			if L.friends and L.friends.Parent then countUp(L.friends, tostring(on)) end
			if L.friendsCap and L.friendsCap.Parent then L.friendsCap.Text = inS .. " in this server" .. (tot and ("  ·  " .. math.max(0, tot - on) .. " offline") or "") end
		end)
	end
	if L.runs or L.runsCap then
		local first = true
		_KR.HL.stats(alive, function(on, rn)
			if L.runs and L.runs.Parent and rn then animateNumber(L.runs, rn, fmtNum, not first) end
			if L.runsCap and L.runsCap.Parent and on then L.runsCap.Text = (L.runsFmt or "%s online now"):format(fmtNum(on)) end
			first = false
		end)
	end
end
-- tabs + extras for launcher grids. Each = { label, color, glyph builder, action }
_KR.HL.launchers = function()
	local out = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(_KR.sections or {}) do
		local hid = type(SET.hiddenTabs) == "table" and SET.hiddenTabs[s.id]
		if s.id == "player" or not hid then local sid = s.id; out[#out + 1] = { s.label, _KR.tabCol(s.color), function(z) return mkIcon(s.icon, z) end, function() _KR.HL.tab(sid) end } end
	end
	out[#out + 1] = { "UI Settings", Color3.fromRGB(233, 74, 128), function(z) return _KR.HL.glyph("uiset", z) end, _KR.HL.settings }
	out[#out + 1] = { "News", Color3.fromRGB(79, 125, 224), function(z) return _KR.HL.glyph("news", z) end, function() _KR.HL.news() end }
	out[#out + 1] = { "Guide", Color3.fromRGB(138, 99, 210), function(z) return _KR.HL.glyph("guide", z) end, _KR.HL.guide }
	out[#out + 1] = { "Chat", Color3.fromRGB(124, 92, 214), function(z) return _KR.HL.glyph("chat", z) end, function() _KR.HL.chat() end }
	out[#out + 1] = { "Discord", Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242), function(z) return _KR.HL.glyph("discord", z) end, _KR.HL.discord }
	return out
end
_KR.HL.hair = function(parent, order, t) return new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = t or 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order or 1, Parent = parent }) end
_KR.HL.hrow = function(parent, h, gap, order, align)  -- a horizontal row frame
	local r = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), LayoutOrder = order or 1, Parent = parent })
	new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, gap or 8), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, HorizontalAlignment = align or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = r })
	return r
end

-- ── Start menu (Windows 11) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
_KR.HL.Start = function(h)
	local name, uname = _KR.HL.who()
	local menu = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.bg:Lerp(T.card, 0.35), BackgroundTransparency = 0.02, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = h }); corner(menu, 10)
	vlist(menu, 0)
	local body = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = menu }); pad(body, 26, 26, 24, 18); vlist(body, 14)
	local cards, L = {}, {}
	-- search: filters the pinned grid as you type; Enter opens the first match
	local sw = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.card:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.07), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = body }); corner(sw, 17)
	local sline = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = sw }); corner(sline, 1)
	do local mg = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, -1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = sw }); new("UIStroke", { Color = T.txt3, Thickness = 1.6, Parent = mg }); corner(mg, 5)
		new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 2, 1, 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 1.8), Rotation = 45, BackgroundColor3 = T.txt3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = mg }) end
	local box = new("TextBox", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", PlaceholderText = "Search tabs, settings and news", PlaceholderColor3 = T.txt3, Font = FONT, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = T.txt, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ClearTextOnFocus = false, Parent = sw })
	box.Focused:Connect(function() tween(sline, 0.2, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 2) }, QUINT) end)
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function() tween(sline, 0.2, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2) }, QUINT) end)
	cards[#cards + 1] = sw
	-- the notice, as a slim InfoBar (same text as the Dashboard card: _KR.HL.WARN)
	local info = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(64, 22, 30), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = body }); corner(info, 6); pad(info, 40, 14, 10, 10)

		lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "!", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = d }) end
	lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, RichText = true, Text = "<b>Notice</b>   " .. _KR.HL.WARN, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(246, 214, 220), TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Parent = info })
	cards[#cards + 1] = info
	-- Pinned: every visible tab + UI Settings, News, Guide, Chat, Discord
	local pinned = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = body }); vlist(pinned, 8)
	do local r = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = pinned }); lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "Pinned", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 14, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = r }) end
	local grid = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = pinned })
	new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 7, -4, 0, 74), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = grid })
	local tiles = {}
	for i, it in ipairs(_KR.HL.launchers()) do
		local b = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = grid }); corner(b, 6)
		local sq = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 9), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38), BackgroundColor3 = it[2], BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = b }); corner(sq, 9)
		local ic = it[3](22); ic.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); ic.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5); ic.Parent = sq

		b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if SET.hoverFx and not SET.reduceMotion then tween(b, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.94 }) end end)
		b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(b, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end)
		_KR.press(b); b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(it[4])
		tiles[#tiles + 1] = { b = b, name = string.lower(it[1]), go = it[4] }
	end
	box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		local q = string.lower(box.Text); for _, t in ipairs(tiles) do t.b.Visible = (q == "") or (t.name:find(q, 1, true) ~= nil) end
	end)
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if not enter or box.Text == "" then return end; for _, t in ipairs(tiles) do if t.b.Visible then t.go(); return end end end)
	cards[#cards + 1] = pinned
	-- Session: the four live numbers + a status line (FPS / ping / location / version / executor / content)
	local ses = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 4, Parent = body }); vlist(ses, 8)
	do local r = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = ses }); lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 1, 0), Text = "Session", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 14, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = r })
		local lk = _KR.HL.link(r, "Copy join script", _KR.HL.join, 1, 12); lk.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5); lk.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0) end
	local row = _KR.HL.hrow(ses, 58, 6, 2)
	local function cell(cap, i)
		local c = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -5, 1, 0), LayoutOrder = i, Parent = row }); corner(c, 6); pad(c, 12, 8, 9, 8)
		local v = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), Text = "-", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 17, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = c })
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 23), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = cap, TextSize = 10.5, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = c })
		return v
	end
	L.players = cell("Players here", 1); L.friends = cell("Friends online", 2); L.up = cell("In this server", 3); L.runs = cell("Total runs", 4)
	L.friends.Text = "0"; L.runs.Text = _KR.HL._rn and fmtNum(_KR.HL._rn) or "-"
	local st = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = "", TextSize = 10.5, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = ses })
	_KR.HL.fps(st, function(f, m) return string.format("FPS %d  ·  Ping %s  ·  %s  ·  %s  ·  %s  ·  %s  ·  Mem %d MB", f, _KR.HL.ping(), _KR.HL.where(), _RC_VER, _execName, _KR.HL.content(), m) end)
	cards[#cards + 1] = ses
	-- Recommended: the latest four news posts (tap = open that story) <-> Credits (footer button swaps them)
	local rec = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 5, Parent = body }); vlist(rec, 8)
	local rhead = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = rec })
	local rtitle = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 1, 0), Text = "Recommended", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 14, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = rhead })
	do local lk = _KR.HL.link(rhead, "All news", function() _KR.HL.news() end, 1, 12); lk.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5); lk.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0) end
	local ngrid = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = rec })
	new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 50), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = ngrid })
	for i, it in ipairs(_KR.HL.newsList()) do
		if i > 4 then break end
		local b = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = ngrid }); corner(b, 6)
		local sq = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = b }); corner(sq, 7)
		local cc = _KR.HL.catCol(it.cat); new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 45, Color = ColorSequence.new(cc, cc:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.5)), Parent = sq })
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 17), Text = it.title or "", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = b })
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 14), Text = (it.cat or "News") .. "  ·  " .. (it.date or ""), TextSize = 10.5, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = b })
		b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if SET.hoverFx and not SET.reduceMotion then tween(b, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.94 }) end end)
		b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(b, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end)
		local idx = i; b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() _KR.HL.news(idx) end)
	end
	local cgrid = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Visible = false, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = rec })
	new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 24), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = cgrid })
	for i, p in ipairs(_KR.HL.CREDITS) do
		local c = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = cgrid })
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(0.42, 0, 1, 0), Text = p[1], Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = c })
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0.42, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.58, 0, 1, 0), Text = p[2], TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = c })
	end
	cards[#cards + 1] = rec
	if _KR.HL.wide() then  -- phone landscape: search / warning / pinned on the left, session / recommended on the right
		local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = body })
		new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 22), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = row })
		local cl = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -11, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = row }); vlist(cl, 14)
		local cr = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -11, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = row }); vlist(cr, 14)
		sw.Parent = cl; info.Parent = cl; pinned.Parent = cl; ses.Parent = cr; rec.Parent = cr
	end
	-- footer: you on the left, quick actions on the right (on a darker strip, like the real Start menu)
	local foot = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58), LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = menu }); corner(foot, 10)
	new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = foot })  -- squares off the strip's TOP corners (only the menu's bottom corners are round)
	_KR.HL.avatar(foot, 32, { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0.5, 0) })
	lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 68, 0.5, -16), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 17), Text = name, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = foot })
	lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 68, 0.5, 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 14), Text = uname, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = foot })
	local acts = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = foot })
	new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = acts })
	local credOn = false
	_KR.HL.btn(acts, "Credits", "soft", nil, function(set)
		credOn = not credOn; ngrid.Visible = not credOn; cgrid.Visible = credOn; rtitle.Text = credOn and "Credits" or "Recommended"; set(credOn and "Hide credits" or "Credits")
	end, 1)
	_KR.HL.btn(acts, "Executor Guide", "accent", nil, _KR.HL.guide, 2)
	cards[#cards + 1] = foot
	_KR.HL.feed(L, function() return menu.Parent ~= nil end)
	return { header = menu, letters = {}, host = menu, cards = cards }
end

-- ── Widgets board (Windows 11) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
_KR.HL.Widgets = function(h)
	local wide = _KR.HL.wide(); local W = _KR.homeWidth("Widgets")
	local name = _KR.HL.who()
	local board = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.08, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = h }); corner(board, 12); pad(board, 18, 18, 16, 18); vlist(board, 12)
	local cards, L = {}, {}
	-- top: time + date, you + Customize (UI Settings)
	local top = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56), LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = board })
	L.time = _KR.HL.light(lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 36), Text = "", TextSize = 34, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = top }))
	lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 38), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16), Text = _KR.HL.date(), TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = top })
	local tr = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 32), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = top })
	new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 10), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = tr })
	_KR.HL.avatar(tr, 30, { LayoutOrder = 1 })
	lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Text = name, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = tr })
	_KR.HL.btn(tr, "Customize", "soft", nil, _KR.HL.settings, 3)
	cards[#cards + 1] = top
	-- the grid: fixed row heights. Tall: 3 columns, News spans two rows, Quick actions two columns. Wide (phone): 4 columns x 2 rows
	local GAP, COLS = 10, wide and 4 or 3
	local RH = wide and { 118, 150 } or { 124, 116, 150 }
	local SP = wide and { sv = { 1, 1, 1, 1 }, fr = { 2, 1, 1, 1 }, se = { 3, 1, 1, 1 }, rc = { 4, 1, 1, 1 }, qa = { 1, 2, 2, 1 }, nw = { 3, 2, 1, 1 }, cr = { 4, 2, 1, 1 } }
		or { sv = { 1, 1, 1, 1 }, fr = { 2, 1, 1, 1 }, nw = { 3, 1, 1, 2 }, se = { 1, 2, 1, 1 }, rc = { 2, 2, 1, 1 }, qa = { 1, 3, 2, 1 }, cr = { 3, 3, 1, 1 } }
	local gridH = (#RH - 1) * GAP; for _, v in ipairs(RH) do gridH = gridH + v end
	local grid = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, gridH), LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = board })
	local cw = (W - 36 - (COLS - 1) * GAP) / COLS
	local function widget(sp, title, dot, tint)
		local col, row, cs, rs = sp[1], sp[2], sp[3], sp[4]
		local y = 0; for r = 1, row - 1 do y = y + RH[r] + GAP end
		local hgt = 0; for r = row, row + rs - 1 do hgt = hgt + RH[r] end; hgt = hgt + (rs - 1) * GAP
		local w = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = tint or T.card, BackgroundTransparency = 0.1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor((col - 1) * (cw + GAP)), y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(cs * cw + (cs - 1) * GAP), hgt), Parent = grid }); corner(w, 10); pad(w, 14, 14, 12, 12)
		local hd = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), Parent = w })
		local d = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), BackgroundColor3 = dot, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = hd }); corner(d, 2)
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, 0), Text = title, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = hd })
		w.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if SET.hoverFx and not SET.reduceMotion then tween(w, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }) end end)
		w.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(w, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 }) end)
		cards[#cards + 1] = w
		return w
	end
	local function big(w, y, size) return lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y or 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, (size or 28) + 4), Text = "-", Font = FONTB, TextSize = size or 28, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, RichText = true, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = w }) end
	local function cap(w, y, text) return lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), Text = text or "", TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Parent = w }) end
	-- Server: players + a fill bar; tap copies the join script
	local sv = widget(SP.sv, "Server", Color3.fromRGB(47, 158, 111))
	L.players = big(sv); cap(sv, 62, "Players  ·  " .. _KR.HL.where())
	local barT = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -14), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = sv }); corner(barT, 2)
	local barF = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(47, 158, 111), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = barT }); corner(barF, 2)
	task.spawn(function() while barF.Parent do local p = game:GetService("Players"); barF.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(#p:GetPlayers() / math.max(1, p.MaxPlayers), 0.02, 1), 1); task.wait(3) end end)
	lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12), Text = "Tap to copy the join script", TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = sv })
	sv.MouseButton1Click:Connect(_KR.HL.join)
	-- Friends
	local fr = widget(SP.fr, "Friends", Color3.fromRGB(79, 111, 224))
	L.friends = big(fr); L.friends.Text = "0"; lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 60), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = "online", TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = fr })
	L.friendsCap = cap(fr, 80, "")
	-- News (tall): the latest post, tap = read it
	local items = _KR.HL.newsList(); local it = items[1]
	local nw = widget(SP.nw, "News", Color3.fromRGB(226, 74, 94))
	local nb = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = nw }); vlist(nb, 6)
	if it then
		_KR.HL.hero(nb, it, wide and 40 or 86, 8).LayoutOrder = 1
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = it.title or "", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = nb })
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = (it.date or "") .. "  ·  " .. (it.cat or "News"), TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = _KR.HL.catCol(it.cat), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = nb })
		for i = 2, wide and 1 or 3 do local o = items[i]; if o then  -- the next posts: title left, date right, hairline between (the wide one-row News has no room)
			_KR.HL.hair(nb, 2 * i + 2, 0.92)
			local r = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), LayoutOrder = 2 * i + 3, Parent = nb })
			lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 1, 0), Text = o.title or "", TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = r })
			lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 72, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Text = o.date or "", TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = r })
		end end
	else lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), Text = "No news right now.", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = nb }) end
	nw.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() _KR.HL.news(1) end)
	-- Session + RoClothes reach
	local se = widget(SP.se, "Session", Color3.fromRGB(154, 90, 209))
	L.up = big(se, 26, 24); local seCap = cap(se, 58, ""); _KR.HL.fps(seCap, function(f, m) return "In this server  ·  FPS " .. f .. "  ·  " .. m .. " MB\nPing " .. _KR.HL.ping() .. "  ·  " .. _KR.HL.where() end)
	local rc = widget(SP.rc, "RoClothes", Color3.fromRGB(224, 163, 63))
	L.runs = big(rc, 26, 24); L.runs.Text = _KR.HL._rn and fmtNum(_KR.HL._rn) or "-"; L.runsCap = cap(rc, 58, "Total runs"); L.runsFmt = "Total runs  ·  %s online now\n" .. _RC_VER .. "  ·  " .. _KR.HL.content()
	-- Quick actions (wide) + Credits
	local qa = widget(SP.qa, "Quick actions", Color3.fromRGB(233, 74, 128))
	cap(qa, 24, "Saved bundles: " .. _KR.HL.bundles() .. "  ·  Executor: " .. _execName)
	local qr2 = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = qa })  -- 2nd row: the Home links this layout has no other place for
	new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = qr2 })
	_KR.HL.btn(qr2, "Join script", "soft", nil, _KR.HL.join, 1); _KR.HL.btn(qr2, "All news", "soft", nil, function() _KR.HL.news() end, 2)
	local qr = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -36), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = qa })
	new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = qr })
	_KR.HL.btn(qr, "Executor Guide", "accent", nil, _KR.HL.guide, 1)
	_KR.HL.btn(qr, "Open Chat", "soft", nil, function(set) _KR.HL.chat(set) end, 2)
	_KR.HL.btn(qr, "Join Discord", "soft", nil, _KR.HL.discord, 3)
	local cr = widget(SP.cr, "Credits", Color3.fromRGB(150, 156, 170))
	local cl = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -22), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = cr }); vlist(cl, 0)
	for i, p in ipairs(_KR.HL.CREDITS) do lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14.5), RichText = true, Text = "<b>" .. p[1] .. "</b>  " .. p[2], TextSize = 10.5, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = cl }) end
	-- Heads up: the full warning, full width
	local hu = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(64, 22, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 0.05, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = board }); corner(hu, 10); pad(hu, 14, 14, 12, 12); vlist(hu, 4)
	do local r = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = hu })
		local d = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(232, 72, 86), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = r }); corner(d, 2)
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, 0), Text = "Notice", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 172), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = r }) end
	lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = _KR.HL.WARN, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 214, 220), TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = hu })
	cards[#cards + 1] = hu
	L.upShort = false
	_KR.HL.feed(L, function() return board.Parent ~= nil end)
	return { header = top, letters = {}, host = board, cards = cards }
end

-- ── Typographic (Minimal) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
_KR.HL.Type = function(h)
	local W = _KR.HOMES.Type.w
	local name = _KR.HL.who()
	local NEWS_W = 360
	local wrap = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = h })
	new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 70), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = wrap })
	local left = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, W - NEWS_W - 70, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = wrap }); vlist(left, 18)
	local cards, L = {}, {}
	local clockB = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = left }); vlist(clockB, 0)
	L.time = _KR.HL.light(lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 104), Text = "", TextSize = 100, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = clockB }))
	_KR.HL.light(lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), Text = _KR.HL.date(), TextSize = 24, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = clockB }))
	cards[#cards + 1] = clockB
	local hello = _KR.HL.hrow(left, 36, 12, 2)
	_KR.HL.avatar(hello, 34, { LayoutOrder = 1 })
	lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, RichText = true, Text = "Welcome home, <b>" .. name .. "</b>", TextSize = 16, TextColor3 = T.txt2, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = hello })
	cards[#cards + 1] = hello
	-- one row of four big numbers with tiny captions, hairline separated
	local glance = _KR.HL.hrow(left, 62, 28, 3)
	local function num(cap, i)
		local c = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = i * 2, Parent = glance })
		local v = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, Text = "-", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 32, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = c })
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 40), Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 13), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Text = cap, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = c })
		if i > 1 then new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.85, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i * 2 - 1, Parent = glance }) end
		return v
	end
	L.players = num("PLAYERS", 1); L.friends = num("FRIENDS ONLINE", 2); L.up = num("IN SERVER", 3); L.runs = num("TOTAL RUNS", 4)
	L.friends.Text = "0"; L.runs.Text = _KR.HL._rn and fmtNum(_KR.HL._rn) or "-"; L.upShort = true
	cards[#cards + 1] = glance
	local links = _KR.HL.hrow(left, 24, 24, 4)
	_KR.HL.link(links, "Executor guide", _KR.HL.guide, 1, 14)
	local chatLk = _KR.HL.link(links, "Open chat", nil, 2, 14); chatLk.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() _KR.HL.chat() end)
	_KR.HL.link(links, "Join Discord", _KR.HL.discord, 3, 14)
	_KR.HL.link(links, "Join script", _KR.HL.join, 4, 14)
	_KR.HL.link(links, "UI Settings", _KR.HL.settings, 5, 14)
	cards[#cards + 1] = links
	-- the quiet notice + status + credits, small and dim
	local foot = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 5, Parent = left }); vlist(foot, 6)
	do local r = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = foot }); pad(r, 16, 0, 0, 0)
		local d = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, -16, 0, 5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(232, 72, 86), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = r }); corner(d, 3)
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = _KR.HL.WARN, TextSize = 11.5, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = r }) end
	local st = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = "", TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = foot })
	_KR.HL.fps(st, function(f, m) return string.format("FPS %d  ·  Ping %s  ·  %s  ·  %s  ·  %s  ·  %s  ·  %d saved bundles", f, _KR.HL.ping(), _KR.HL.where(), _RC_VER, _execName, _KR.HL.content(), _KR.HL.bundles()) end)
	do local names = {}; for _, p in ipairs(_KR.HL.CREDITS) do names[#names + 1] = p[1] end
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = "Credits:  " .. table.concat(names, "  ·  "), TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = foot }) end
	cards[#cards + 1] = foot
	-- right: the latest post as a featured story + the next three as quiet rows
	local nc = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, NEWS_W, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = wrap }); vlist(nc, 10)
	lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = "LATEST", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.accent, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = nc })
	local items = _KR.HL.newsList()
	if items[1] then
		local feat = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = nc }); vlist(feat, 8)
		_KR.HL.hero(feat, items[1], 190, 16).LayoutOrder = 1
		local tl = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = items[1].title or "", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 19, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = feat })
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15), Text = (items[1].cat or "News") .. "  ·  " .. (items[1].date or ""), TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = _KR.HL.catCol(items[1].cat), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = feat })
		feat.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(tl, 0.15, { TextColor3 = T.accent }) end); feat.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(tl, 0.15, { TextColor3 = T.txt }) end)
		feat.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() _KR.HL.news(1) end)
	end
	for i = 2, 4 do
		local o = items[i]
		if o then
			_KR.HL.hair(nc, i * 2 + 1)
			local r = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), LayoutOrder = i * 2 + 2, Parent = nc })
			local tl = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, 0), Text = o.title or "", TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = r })
			lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Text = o.date or "", TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = r })
			r.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(tl, 0.15, { TextColor3 = T.txt }) end); r.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(tl, 0.15, { TextColor3 = T.txt2 }) end)
			local idx = i; r.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() _KR.HL.news(idx) end)
		end
	end
	_KR.HL.link(nc, "All news", function() _KR.HL.news() end, 20, 13)
	cards[#cards + 1] = nc
	_KR.HL.feed(L, function() return wrap.Parent ~= nil end)
	return { header = clockB, letters = {}, host = wrap, cards = cards }
end

-- ── Glance column (Minimal) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
_KR.HL.Glance = function(h)
	local name, uname = _KR.HL.who()
	local col = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.22, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = h }); corner(col, 20); pad(col, 20, 20, 18, 16); vlist(col, 12)
	local cards, L = {}, {}
	local tb = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64), LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = col })
	L.time = _KR.HL.light(lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), Text = "", TextSize = 46, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = tb }))
	lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 47), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), Text = _KR.HL.date(), TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = tb })
	cards[#cards + 1] = tb
	local me = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = col })
	_KR.HL.avatar(me, 32, { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0) })
	lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 17), Text = name, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 14, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = me })
	lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 18), Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 14), Text = uname, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = me })
	cards[#cards + 1] = me
	-- quiet stat rows with hairlines
	local rows = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = col }); vlist(rows, 0)
	local function srow(k, i)
		if i > 1 then _KR.HL.hair(rows, i * 2 - 1, 0.92) end
		local r = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 27), LayoutOrder = i * 2, Parent = rows })
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 1, 0), Text = k, TextSize = 12.5, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = r })
		return lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 1, 0), Text = "-", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = r })
	end
	L.players = srow("Players here", 1); L.friends = srow("Friends online", 2); L.up = srow("In this server", 3); L.ping = srow("Ping", 4)
	srow("Location", 5).Text = _KR.HL.where(); L.runs = srow("Total runs", 6)
	L.friends.Text = "0"; L.runs.Text = _KR.HL._rn and fmtNum(_KR.HL._rn) or "-"
	cards[#cards + 1] = rows
	-- the latest post as one tinted card
	local it = _KR.HL.newsList()[1]
	if it then
		local cc = _KR.HL.catCol(it.cat)
		local hc = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = cc:Lerp(T.bg, 0.55), BackgroundTransparency = 0.1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 4, Parent = col }); corner(hc, 14); pad(hc, 14, 14, 12, 13); vlist(hc, 4)
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 13), Text = "LATEST  ·  " .. string.upper(it.date or ""), Font = FONTB, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = cc:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.45), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = hc })
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = it.title or "", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 14, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = hc })
		hc.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if SET.hoverFx and not SET.reduceMotion then tween(hc, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }) end end)
		hc.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(hc, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 }) end)
		hc.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() _KR.HL.news(1) end)
		cards[#cards + 1] = hc
	end
	local acts = _KR.HL.hrow(col, 32, 6, 5)
	_KR.HL.btn(acts, "Guide", "soft", UDim2.new(1 / 3, -4, 1, 0), _KR.HL.guide, 1)
	_KR.HL.btn(acts, "Chat", "soft", UDim2.new(1 / 3, -4, 1, 0), function(set) _KR.HL.chat(set) end, 2)
	_KR.HL.btn(acts, "Discord", "soft", UDim2.new(1 / 3, -4, 1, 0), _KR.HL.discord, 3)
	cards[#cards + 1] = acts
	local lk = _KR.HL.hrow(col, 20, 16, 6)
	_KR.HL.link(lk, "UI Settings", _KR.HL.settings, 1, 12); _KR.HL.link(lk, "All news", function() _KR.HL.news() end, 2, 12); _KR.HL.link(lk, "Join script", _KR.HL.join, 3, 12)
	cards[#cards + 1] = lk
	local fn = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 7, Parent = col }); vlist(fn, 6)
	lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = _KR.HL.WARN, TextSize = 10.5, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = fn })
	local st = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 13), Text = "", TextSize = 10.5, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = fn })
	_KR.HL.fps(st, function(f) return _RC_VER .. "  ·  " .. _execName .. "  ·  FPS " .. f .. "  ·  " .. _KR.HL.bundles() .. " bundles" end)
	do local names = {}; for _, p in ipairs(_KR.HL.CREDITS) do names[#names + 1] = p[1] end
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = "Credits: " .. table.concat(names, " · "), TextSize = 10.5, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = fn }) end
	cards[#cards + 1] = fn
	if _KR.HL.wide() then  -- phone landscape: time / you / stats on the left, news / actions / small print on the right
		local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = col })
		new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 22), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = row })
		local cl = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -11, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = row }); vlist(cl, 12)
		local cr = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -11, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = row }); vlist(cr, 12)
		for _, c in ipairs(col:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c ~= row then c.Parent = (c.LayoutOrder <= 3) and cl or cr end end
	end
	_KR.HL.feed(L, function() return col.Parent ~= nil end)
	return { header = tb, letters = {}, host = col, cards = cards }
end

local function buildHome(h)
	do local lay = _KR.homeLay(); _KR._hlWideBuilt = _KR.HL.wide(); h.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(_KR.homeWidth(lay), 0)  -- V4.5.57: each layout has its own design width
		if lay ~= "Dashboard" and _KR.HL[lay] then return _KR.HL[lay](h) end end
	local name = (LocalPlayer.DisplayName ~= "" and LocalPlayer.DisplayName) or LocalPlayer.Name
	if SET.hideName then name = "Hidden" end  -- privacy: mask the display name everywhere it appears
	local uname = SET.hideName and "@hidden" or ("@" .. LocalPlayer.Name)
	local GAP = 12  -- base card gap; Compact density is now applied globally via vlist/DGAP (don't double-dial here)
	-- Home is a horizontal split: the dashboard (main, left) + a tall narrow info rail (right) holding Warning +
	-- Credits. Both live inside the fit-to-screen canvas, so it scales as ONE unit on every device (desktop AND
	-- mobile); moving Warning/Credits off the bottom row also shortens the canvas so the dashboard fits bigger.
	local RAIL_W = 340
	-- header spans the full canvas top (LayoutOrder 1, above the split) so the dashboard cards AND the info
	-- rail both begin below it - the Warning/Credits align with the Server/Friends row, not the header text.
	local w = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58), LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = h })
	local split = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = h })
	new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, GAP + 4), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = split })
	local main = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -(RAIL_W + 16), 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = split }); vlist(main, GAP)
	local rail = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(RAIL_W, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = split }); vlist(rail, GAP)
	-- "RoClothes:Krul" as INDIVIDUAL letters so each can wave (Heartbeat) + fly from/into the favicon.
	-- Colours match the intro loader: "RoClothes" near-white, ":" grey, "Krul" pink; soft black stroke.
	local BRAND, HSIZE = "RoClothes:Himeros", 24
	local letters, cumX = {}, 0
	_KR.glyphW = _KR.glyphW or {}  -- per-glyph width memo: the brand is a fixed string at fixed HSIZE/FONTB, so a settings-driven Home rebuild reuses measurements instead of re-running GetTextSize every time
	for i = 1, #BRAND do
		local ch = BRAND:sub(i, i)
		local col = (i >= 11) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 180) or (ch == ":" and Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 215) or Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 255))
		if _KR.light() then col = (i >= 11) and Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 112) or (ch == ":" and T.txt3 or T.txt) end  -- V4.5.57: dark brand on the light backdrop
		local wpx = _KR.glyphW[ch]; if not wpx then wpx = 12; pcall(function() wpx = math.ceil(TextService:GetTextSize(ch, HSIZE, FONTB, Vector2.new(1e4, 1e4)).X) + 1 end); _KR.glyphW[ch] = wpx end  -- memoized per glyph
		local ll = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, cumX, 0, _homeBaseY), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(wpx, HSIZE + 6), Text = ch, Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = col, TextSize = HSIZE, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = w })
		ll.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0); ll.TextStrokeTransparency = _KR.light() and 1 or 0.45
		ll:SetAttribute("rcNoTS", true); ll.TextSize = HSIZE  -- V4.5.57: the wordmark is measured per glyph at HSIZE, so Text size leaves it alone
		letters[i] = { lbl = ll, x = cumX }
		cumX = cumX + wpx
	end
	lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 40), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15), Text = "Welcome home, " .. name, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = w })
	-- V4.4.x: executor-capability warning beside the logo (red) - appears only if the boot probe found a gap.
	local capsHomeWarn = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(340, 54), Text = "", Font = FONT, TextSize = 12.5, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 120), TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Visible = false, ZIndex = 5, Parent = w })
	System._onCapsGap(function(txt) if capsHomeWarn and capsHomeWarn.Parent then capsHomeWarn.Text = txt; capsHomeWarn.Visible = true end end)
	local _, leftCol, rightCol = twoCol(main, 1)
	local function fmtT(u) return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", math.floor(u / 3600), math.floor(u / 60) % 60, u % 60) end
	-- Server card (green) -> left column
	local plrs = game:GetService("Players")
	local ping = "-"
	pcall(function() ping = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()) .. " ms" end)
	local up = 0; pcall(function() up = math.floor(time()) end)
	local sCard, sbody = UI.card(leftCol, "Server", "Information on the session you're in.", 1, Color3.fromRGB(34, 92, 74))
	local _, svals = UI.stats(sbody, {
		{ #plrs:GetPlayers() .. " playing", "Players" },
		{ plrs.MaxPlayers .. " max", "Maximum players" },  -- V4.5.49: was "N can join" over "Maximum players"
		{ ping, "Latency" },
		{ fmtT(up), "In server for" },
		(SET.hideLocation and { "Hidden", "Location", "full" } or { _serverRegion, "Location", "full" }),  -- V4.5.24 Fix: dropped the `true` (tap-to-reveal mask) from the real-region branch - it masked the region when privacy was OFF and showed a plain "Hidden" when ON (inverted). No mask needed on either branch: "Hidden" is already privacy-safe.
		{ "Tap to copy", "Join script", "full", copy = function()
			local pid, jid = 0, ""; pcall(function() pid, jid = game.PlaceId, game.JobId end)
			return ('game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(%d, "%s", game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer)'):format(pid, jid)
		end },
	}, nil, Color3.fromRGB(34, 92, 74))
	if not SET.hideLocation and svals["Location"] then _KR.regionFetch(function(r) if svals["Location"].Parent then svals["Location"].Text = r or "-" end end) end  -- V4.5.57: fills in when the lookup lands
	-- live counter: "In server for" ticks every second while the card exists (HH:MM:SS).
	local upL = svals["In server for"]
	if upL then task.spawn(function()
		while upL.Parent do local u = 0; pcall(function() u = math.floor(time()) end); upL.Text = fmtT(u); task.wait(1) end
	end) end
	-- Latency ticks live every ~2s so it always shows the LATEST ping (not the one-shot value from build time).
	local pingL = svals["Latency"]
	if pingL then task.spawn(function()
		while pingL.Parent do local ms; pcall(function() ms = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()) end); if ms then pingL.Text = ms .. " ms" end; task.wait(2) end
	end) end
	-- Friends card (blue) -> right column, top. Counts fetched async, count up when they land.
	local fCard, fbody = UI.card(rightCol, "Friends", "See which of your friends are around.", 1, Color3.fromRGB(52, 62, 128))
	local _, fvals = UI.stats(fbody, { { "0", "In server" }, { "-", "Offline" }, { "0", "Online" }, { "-", "All" } }, nil, Color3.fromRGB(52, 62, 128))
	-- all four are filled by the async fetch below; mark them so the entrance count-up leaves them alone (else it can overwrite the fetched value back to 0).
	for _, k in ipairs({ "In server", "Online", "Offline", "All" }) do if fvals[k] then fvals[k]:SetAttribute("live", true) end end
	task.spawn(function()
		local inServer, online, total = 0, 0, nil
		pcall(function()
			local o = LocalPlayer:GetFriendsOnline(200)
			if type(o) == "table" then online = #o; for _, f in ipairs(o) do if f.GameId == game.JobId then inServer += 1 end end end
		end)
		pcall(function()  -- total friends INCL. offline - GetFriendsAsync is paginated, so walk every page
			local fp = game:GetService("Players"):GetFriendsAsync(LocalPlayer.UserId); local n = 0
			while true do for _ in ipairs(fp:GetCurrentPage()) do n += 1 end; if fp.IsFinished then break end; fp:AdvanceToNextPageAsync() end
			total = n
		end)
		if fvals["In server"] and fvals["In server"].Parent then countUp(fvals["In server"], tostring(inServer)) end
		if fvals["Online"] and fvals["Online"].Parent then countUp(fvals["Online"], tostring(online)) end
		if total and fvals["All"] and fvals["All"].Parent then countUp(fvals["All"], tostring(total)) end                              -- real total (was a "-" placeholder)
		if total and fvals["Offline"] and fvals["Offline"].Parent then countUp(fvals["Offline"], tostring(math.max(0, total - online))) end  -- offline = total minus online (was a "-" placeholder)
	end)

			tween(ws, 1.1, { Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 32, 42) }); tween(signStroke, 1.1, { Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 70) }); tween(sign, 1.1, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 28, 40) }); task.wait(1.15)

			chatLbl.Text = ok and "Open Chat" or "Failed - retry"
			task.wait(1); _gcBusy = false
		end)
	end
