end
function PAGES.body(h)
	-- BENTO: a flow of section tiles; within each, controls pair 2-up (dropdowns, stiffness/damping sliders, swatches,
	-- toggles). The body-map stays full-width. Still scrolls (huge tab) but roughly half the height it was.
	-- Phase 2 wiring helpers: V3's sliders show INTEGERS in a display range [dmin,dmax]; the engine
	-- fields live in a real range [lo,hi]. _sd seeds the display value from engine state; _wr returns
	-- an onChange that maps the display integer back to the engine value (mirrors V2 _wireSlider).
	local function _gp(f) return System and System.getPD and System.getPD(f) end
	local function _sd(field, lo, hi, dmin, dmax, ddefault)
		local cur = _gp(field)
		if type(cur) ~= "number" then return ddefault end
		local span = (hi - lo); if span == 0 then span = 1 end
		return math.clamp(math.floor(dmin + (cur - lo) / span * (dmax - dmin) + 0.5), dmin, dmax)
	end
	local function _wr(field, lo, hi, dmin, dmax, phys)
		return function(v)
			local span = (dmax - dmin); if span == 0 then span = 1 end
			local eng = lo + (v - dmin) / span * (hi - lo)
			if phys then if System and System.setPhysicsField then System.setPhysicsField(field, eng) end
			elseif System and System.setPD then System.setPD(field, eng) end
		end
	end
	-- WIRED (merge): body-type dropdowns are engine-driven. Options come from System.getBodyTypeLabels()
	-- (indexed by the PD field key) capped at System.getBodyTypeMax(); disabled types (label == false, e.g.
	-- ButtType 4/5 = no mesh) are skipped. Picking maps the option label back to its real type NUMBER and
	-- writes System.setPD(field, n) -- the SAME engine path V2's _bodyTypeDrawerRow used (V2 L3387). The
	-- current PD value seeds the shown selection. Returns the current numeric type (Breasts uses it for the Bra row).
	local _BTL = (System and System.getBodyTypeLabels and System.getBodyTypeLabels()) or {}
	local _BTM = (System and System.getBodyTypeMax and System.getBodyTypeMax()) or {}
	local function _bodyDrop(parent, text, field, order, onPickType)
		local labels = _BTL[field] or {}
		local maxT = _BTM[field] or 1
		local function nameFor(v) if v == 0 then return "Type 0 (none)" end; local l = labels[v]; if l == nil or l == false then return "Type " .. tostring(v) end; return l end
		local opts, toType = {}, {}
		opts[1] = "Type 0 (none)"; toType[opts[1]] = 0  -- V4.5.74: no RoClothes mesh for this piece (your own body / catalog Full Body shows)
		for t = 1, maxT do
			if labels[t] ~= false then local nm = nameFor(t); opts[#opts + 1] = nm; toType[nm] = t end
		end
		local cur = (System and System.getPD and System.getPD(field)); if type(cur) ~= "number" then cur = 1 end
		S[_curPage .. "\1d:" .. text] = nameFor(cur)  -- seed the shown value from live PD (engine is ground truth)
		-- V4.5.59: the picker shows every type as a card with its REAL mesh in 3D (built when the picker opens, so the
		-- page itself costs nothing extra; the meshes come from the same cache the avatar build uses).
		local function _rich()
			local items = {}
			for _, nm in ipairs(opts) do
				local t = toType[nm]
				items[nm] = { name = nm:gsub("%s+%[SmartBone%]", ""), desc = nm:find("SmartBone", 1, true) and "SmartBone physics" or "",
					sketch = (t ~= 0) and function(fr) UI._meshSketch(fr, field, t) end or nil }
			end
			return { items = items }
		end
		UI.dropdown(parent, text, opts, order, function(o)
			local n = toType[o]
			-- V4.5.73: picking a Torso / Arm / Legs type while a catalog Full Body is worn brings that base mesh back on top
			if n and System and System.fullBodyMeshPick then pcall(System.fullBodyMeshPick, field) end
			if n and System and System.setPD then System.setPD(field, n) end
			if onPickType then onPickType(n) end
		end, (System and System.getBodyTypePreview) and _rich or nil)
		return cur
	end
	-- BODY TYPES
	local bt = tile(h, "Body Types", 1)
	-- Breasts + its Type-6 Bra sub-cycle live together (full-width); the Bra cycler only shows when Type 6 is picked.
	local braWrap = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = bt }); vlist(braWrap, 7)
	local braRow  -- forward; the Breasts onPick closure captures it.
	local _curBreasts = _bodyDrop(braWrap, "Breasts", "BreastsType", 1, function(n) if braRow then UI.reveal(braRow, n == 6, true) end end)
	-- Bra sub-cycle (BreastsType == 6): None -> Bra 1 -> Bra 2, engine-driven via getBraState/cycleBra (mirrors V2 L3427).
	do
		local _bs = (System and System.getBraState and System.getBraState()) or "none"
		local _braInit = (_bs == "bra1" and "Bra 1") or (_bs == "bra2" and "Bra 2") or "None"
		braRow = UI.cyc(braWrap, "Bra", { "None", "Bra 1", "Bra 2" }, 2, function() if System and System.cycleBra then System.cycleBra() end end, _braInit)
	end
	braRow.Visible = (_curBreasts == 6)  -- re-sync to live BreastsType after a rebuild.
	local bt1 = cols(bt, 2, 2); _bodyDrop(bt1[1], "Torso", "TorsoType", 1); _bodyDrop(bt1[2], "Arm", "ArmType", 1)
	local bt2 = cols(bt, 3, 2); _bodyDrop(bt2[1], "Legs", "LegsType", 1); _bodyDrop(bt2[2], "Butt", "ButtType", 1)
	do  -- V4.5.77: Cock is a body type (the 9 cock items, picked here instead of the Clothes list)
		local names = (System and System.COCK_TYPES) or {}
		local opts, toType = { "Type 0 (none)" }, { ["Type 0 (none)"] = 0 }
		for i, n in ipairs(names) do opts[#opts + 1] = n; toType[n] = i end
		local cur = (System and System.getCockType and System.getCockType()) or 0
		S[_curPage .. "d:Cock"] = (cur > 0 and names[cur]) or opts[1]
		local cc = cols(bt, 4, 2)
		UI.dropdown(cc[1], "Cock", opts, 1, function(o) local n = toType[o]; if n and System and System.setCockType then System.setCockType(n) end end)
		UI.toggle(cc[2], "Cock Twitching", (System and System.getCockTwitch and System.getCockTwitch()) and true or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setCockTwitch then System.setCockTwitch(st) end end)
	end
	-- SCALE
	local sc = tile(h, "Scale", 2)
	local sc1 = cols(sc, 1, 2); UI.slider(sc1[1], "Breasts Scale", _sd("BreastsScale", 0.5, 2.5, 50, 250, 100), 50, 250, 1, _wr("BreastsScale", 0.5, 2.5, 50, 250)); UI.slider(sc1[2], "Butts Scale", _sd("ButtsScale", 0.5, 2.5, 50, 250, 100), 50, 250, 1, _wr("ButtsScale", 0.5, 2.5, 50, 250))
	UI.slider(sc, "Legs Scale", _sd("LegsScale", 0.5, 2.5, 50, 250, 100), 50, 250, 2, _wr("LegsScale", 0.5, 2.5, 50, 250))
	UI.slider(sc, "Cock Scale", _sd("CockScale", 0.5, 2.5, 50, 250, 100), 50, 250, 3, _wr("CockScale", 0.5, 2.5, 50, 250))  -- V4.5.77
	-- V4.5.52 UI regroup (krul, option C): FIT (moved from the old Settings tab), ONE Physics card (toggles + every
	-- slider), First Person (body-map + POV + start-in-first-person), Appearance, Idle Motion.
	-- FIT & VISIBILITY
	local fit = tile(h, "Fit & Visibility", 3)
	local ft1 = cols(fit, 1, 2); UI.toggle(ft1[1], "Accessory Size Lock", (_gp("AccessorySizeLock") and true) or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("AccessorySizeLock", st) end end); UI.toggle(ft1[2], "Mesh Size Lock", (_gp("MeshSizeLock") and true) or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("MeshSizeLock", st) end end)
	local ft2 = cols(fit, 2, 2); UI.toggle(ft2[1], "Hide Mesh Base Parts", (_gp("MeshBasePartInvisible") and true) or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("MeshBasePartInvisible", st) end end); UI.toggle(ft2[2], "Realtime Transparency", (_gp("RealtimeBodyTransparency") and true) or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("RealtimeBodyTransparency", st) end end)
	-- PHYSICS (one card: on/off switches first, then the tuning sliders)
	local ph = tile(h, "Physics", 4)
	local pt1 = cols(ph, 1, 2); UI.toggle(pt1[1], "Body Part Physics", (_gp("BodyPartPhysics") and true) or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("BodyPartPhysics", st) end end); UI.toggle(pt1[2], "SmartBone Physics", (_gp("SmartBoneEnabled") and true) or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("SmartBoneEnabled", st) end end)
	local pt2 = cols(ph, 2, 2); UI.toggle(pt2[1], "Physics Obey Gravity", (_gp("PhysicsObeyGravity") and true) or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("PhysicsObeyGravity", st) end end)
	do local _ts = _gp("tailSettings"); UI.toggle(pt2[2], "Tail Physics", (type(_ts) == "table" and _ts.tailPhysicsEnabled and true) or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setPDNested then System.setPDNested("tailSettings", "tailPhysicsEnabled", st) end end) end
	local ph1 = cols(ph, 3, 2); UI.slider(ph1[1], "Breasts Stiffness", _sd("BreastsStiffness", 0.5, 30, 1, 30, 12), 1, 30, 1, _wr("BreastsStiffness", 0.5, 30, 1, 30, true)); UI.slider(ph1[2], "Breasts Damping", _sd("BreastsDamping", 0.01, 1.5, 1, 150, 40), 1, 150, 1, _wr("BreastsDamping", 0.01, 1.5, 1, 150, true))
	local ph2 = cols(ph, 4, 2); UI.slider(ph2[1], "Butts Stiffness", _sd("ButtsStiffness", 0.5, 30, 1, 30, 12), 1, 30, 1, _wr("ButtsStiffness", 0.5, 30, 1, 30, true)); UI.slider(ph2[2], "Butts Damping", _sd("ButtsDamping", 0.01, 1.5, 1, 150, 40), 1, 150, 1, _wr("ButtsDamping", 0.01, 1.5, 1, 150, true))
	local ph3 = cols(ph, 5, 2); UI.slider(ph3[1], "Cock Stiffness", _sd("CockStiffness", 0.5, 30, 1, 30, 12), 1, 30, 1, _wr("CockStiffness", 0.5, 30, 1, 30, true)); UI.slider(ph3[2], "Cock Damping", _sd("CockDamping", 0.01, 1.5, 1, 150, 40), 1, 150, 1, _wr("CockDamping", 0.01, 1.5, 1, 150, true))
	local pm1 = cols(ph, 6, 2)
	do
		local _pp = (System and System.getPositionPhysicsMultiply and System.getPositionPhysicsMultiply()) or 1
		local _rp = (System and System.getRotationPhysicsMultiply and System.getRotationPhysicsMultiply()) or 4
		UI.slider(pm1[1], "Position Physics Multiply", math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(_pp) or 1) + 0.5), 0, 20), 0, 20, 1, function(v) if System and System.setPositionPhysicsMultiply then System.setPositionPhysicsMultiply(v) end end)
		UI.slider(pm1[2], "Rotation Physics Multiply", math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(_rp) or 4) + 0.5), 0, 20), 0, 20, 1, function(v) if System and System.setRotationPhysicsMultiply then System.setRotationPhysicsMultiply(v) end end)
	end
	-- TAIL (V4.5.57, krul: "I don't see anything about tail other than tail physics"): the engine's tail tuning lived in the
	-- player data (stiffness, damping, swing, twist, float, wag) but never had controls. The engine reads them every frame.
	;(function()  -- own function: the Body page builder is near Luau's 200-local limit
		local tl = tile(h, "Tail", 5)
		local ts = _gp("tailSettings"); if type(ts) ~= "table" then ts = {} end
		local function set(field, v) if System and System.setPDNested then System.setPDNested("tailSettings", field, v) end end
		local L0, A0 = Vector3.new(13, 8, 13), Vector3.new(0, 25, 0)  -- the shipped defaults (swing = linear, twist = angular)
		local la = (typeof(ts.linearAmplitude) == "Vector3") and ts.linearAmplitude or L0
		local aa = (typeof(ts.angularAmplitude) == "Vector3") and ts.angularAmplitude or A0
		local t1 = cols(tl, 1, 2)
		UI.toggle(t1[1], "Tail Wag", ts.wagAnimationEnabled ~= false, 1, function(st) set("wagAnimationEnabled", st) end)
		UI.slider(t1[2], "Wag Speed %", math.floor((tonumber(ts.wagAnimationSpeed) or 1) * 100 + 0.5), 20, 300, 1, function(v) set("wagAnimationSpeed", v / 100) end, 100)
		local t2 = cols(tl, 2, 2)
		UI.slider(t2[1], "Tail Stiffness", math.floor((tonumber(ts.stiffness) or 96) + 0.5), 20, 200, 1, function(v) set("stiffness", v) end, 96)
		UI.slider(t2[2], "Tail Damping", math.floor((tonumber(ts.damping) or 9) + 0.5), 1, 30, 1, function(v) set("damping", v) end, 9)
		local t3 = cols(tl, 3, 2)
		UI.slider(t3[1], "Tail Swing %", math.floor(la.X / L0.X * 100 + 0.5), 0, 300, 1, function(v) set("linearAmplitude", L0 * (v / 100)) end, 100)
		UI.slider(t3[2], "Tail Twist", math.floor(aa.Y + 0.5), 0, 60, 1, function(v) set("angularAmplitude", Vector3.new(0, v, 0)) end, 25)
		UI.slider(tl, "Tail Float %", math.floor((tonumber(ts.timeScale) or 1) * 100 + 0.5), 30, 150, 4, function(v) set("timeScale", v / 100) end, 100)
	end)()
	-- FIRST PERSON (body-map + POV). V4.5.71: "Start in first person" moved to Settings > Startup & Execute
	local fp = tile(h, "First Person", 6)
	UI.hint(fp, "Tap a part to hide it in first person.", 1)
	local _, mapRight = bodyMap(fp, 2)  -- V4.5.55: no onTail -> the dead tail chip is not built
	UI.toggle(mapRight, "First Person POV", (_gp("FPerson") and true) or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("FPerson", st) end end)  -- inside the purple box, on the right
	-- APPEARANCE
	local ap = tile(h, "Appearance", 7)
	do UI._toneCyc = {}; local _tv = { "Base", "Dark", "Use NippleColor" }; local _tc = _gp("Tone"); UI.cyc(ap, "Skin", { "Tone: Base", "Tone: Dark", "Tone: Use NippleColor" }, 1, function(o, i) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("Tone", _tv[i]) end end, (_tc and ("Tone: " .. tostring(_tc))) or nil, UI._toneCyc) end
	-- WIRED (merge): Skin/Nipple swatches. UI.swatch opens the shared HSV picker (openColorPicker) seeded from the
	-- chip's current colour; on Apply it fires onPick(c) -> System.setPD("SkinTone"/"NippleColor", c).
	local ap2 = cols(ap, 2, 2)
	do
		local _sk = (System and System.getPD and System.getPD("SkinTone"))
		UI.swatch(ap2[1], "Skin Tone", (typeof(_sk) == "Color3" and _sk) or Color3.fromRGB(248, 215, 195), 1, function(c) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("SkinTone", c) end end)
		local _np = (System and System.getPD and System.getPD("NippleColor"))
		-- V4.5.33: every nipple/areola painter only reads NippleColor when Tone == "Use NippleColor", so picking ...
		UI.swatch(ap2[2], "Nipple Color", (typeof(_np) == "Color3" and _np) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 167, 169), 1, function(c)
			if System and System.setPDFields then System.setPDFields({ Tone = "Use NippleColor", NippleColor = c })
			elseif System and System.setPD then System.setPD("NippleColor", c) end
			if UI._toneCyc.set then UI._toneCyc.set("Tone: Use NippleColor") end
		end)
	end
	-- IDLE MOTION
	local im = tile(h, "Idle Motion", 8)
	local im1 = cols(im, 1, 2); UI.toggle(im1[1], "Breathing Idle", (_gp("BreathingEnabled") and true) or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("BreathingEnabled", st) end end); UI.toggle(im1[2], "Overtone Spring", (_gp("OvertoneEnabled") and true) or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setPD then System.setPD("OvertoneEnabled", st) end end)
	local im2 = cols(im, 2, 2); UI.slider(im2[1], "Breathing Amplitude", _sd("BreathingAmplitude", 0, 0.05, 0, 100, 25), 0, 100, 1, _wr("BreathingAmplitude", 0, 0.05, 0, 100)); UI.slider(im2[2], "Overtone Amplitude", _sd("OvertoneAmplitude", 0, 1, 0, 100, 50), 0, 100, 1, _wr("OvertoneAmplitude", 0, 1, 0, 100))
end
function PAGES.clothes(h, sticky)
	-- WIRED (merge): real engine-driven dynamic grid. Mirrors V2 Pages._renderClothes - pulls the cloth registry from
	-- System.getClothesList() ({name,hidden,krulHosted,equipped}), applies the All/2D (KrulHosted) segment + search text
	-- as LOCAL filters, skips Hidden entries, builds a tile per cloth with an EQUIPPED badge. A click either toggles a
	-- normal cloth (System.toggleCloth) or, for a KrulHosted cloth NOT yet equipped, opens the KrulType modal first
	-- (System.clothNeedsType && !System.isClothEquipped). The grid re-renders on seg switch, search commit, and after equip.
	local render  -- forward; the seg/search closures capture it.
	local _tab, _search = nil, ""  -- _tab: nil = All, "2d" = KrulHosted only
	-- STICKY: the filter seg + search pin above the scrolling grid (they stay put while you scroll the clothes)
	local sw = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = sticky }); pad(sw, 14, 10, 4, 8)
	local top = cols(sw, 1, 2)
	UI.seg(top[1], { "All", "2D" }, 1, function(o, i) _tab = (i == 2) and "2d" or nil; if render then render() end end)
	UI.field(top[2], "Search clothes", "", 1, true, function(t) _search = t or ""; if render then render() end end, nil, true)
	-- V4.5.52 UI regroup: Naked Mode (was on Options) + the Recolor tab, folded in as "Recolor equipped..." above the grid
	local rcFold
	do
		local er = cols(h, -2, 2)
		local nkT = UI.toggle(er[1], "Naked Mode", (System and System.getNaked and System.getNaked()) and true or false, 1, function(st) if System and System.setNaked then System.setNaked(st) end end)
		-- V4.5.71: the N key / Reset change Naked Mode too; keep this switch showing the shared record (one slot: the page rebuilds per visit)
		if System then System.onNakedChanged = function(on) local t = _KR.tgl[nkT]; if t and t.set and nkT.Parent then t.set(on) end end end
		rcFold = new("Frame", { Name = "RecolorFold", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Visible = false, LayoutOrder = -1, Parent = h }); vlist(rcFold, 8)
		UI.button(er[2], "Recolor equipped...", nil, 1, function()
			local show = not rcFold.Visible
			if show and not rcFold:GetAttribute("built") and PAGES.recolor then rcFold:SetAttribute("built", true); PAGES.recolor(rcFold) end  -- build on first open (registers System.renderRecolorList for live refresh). A flag, not a child count: the panel entrance adds a UIScale.
			UI.reveal(rcFold, show, true)
		end)
	end
	-- empty-state label + the grid host live in the scrolling body; render clears+rebuilds only the grid host.
	local emptyLbl = lbl({ Name = "Empty", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Text = "", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 11.5, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Visible = false, Parent = h })
	local gridWrap = new("Frame", { Name = "ClothesGridWrap", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = h })
	-- V4.5.70 (mobile perf): a toggle used to destroy and rebuild every tile + its 3D preview (~150 ViewportFrames).
	-- When the same tiles are shown in the same order (sig), only the badges change: update them in place.
	local _built = nil  -- { sig, grid, setBadge }
	render = function()
		if not (gridWrap and gridWrap.Parent) then return end
		local list = (System and System.getClothesList and System.getClothesList()) or {}
		local needle = string.lower(_search or "")
		local items, shown = {}, 0
		local sigT = {}
		local prevQ = {}  -- V4.5.59 (N8): {cell, clothName} built after the grid, one per frame
		for _, e in ipairs(list) do
			if not e.hidden then
				-- tab filter: All => everything; 2d => KrulHosted only. search: plain case-insensitive substring (no Lua patterns).
				local tabMatch = (_tab == nil) or (_tab == "2d" and e.krulHosted)
				local searchMatch = (needle == "") or (string.find(string.lower(e.name), needle, 1, true) ~= nil)
				if tabMatch and searchMatch then
					shown = shown + 1
					local nm = e.name
					sigT[#sigT + 1] = (e.krulHosted and "k" or "-") .. nm
					items[#items + 1] = {
						name = nm,
						sub = e.krulHosted and "KrulHosted" or nil,
						badge = e.equipped and "EQUIPPED" or (e.krulHosted and "2D") or nil,
						badgeColor = e.equipped and T.good or T.accent,
						preview = (System and System.getClothPreview) and function(cell) prevQ[#prevQ + 1] = { cell, nm } end or nil,
						onClick = function()
							-- KrulHosted + not-yet-equipped -> ask Shirt/Pants first; else toggle + re-render.
							if System and System.clothNeedsType and System.clothNeedsType(nm)
								and not (System.isClothEquipped and System.isClothEquipped(nm)) then
								krulTypeDialog(nm)
							elseif System and System.toggleCloth then
								System.toggleCloth(nm); if render then render() end
							end
						end,
					}
				end
			end
		end
		local sig = table.concat(sigT, "\0")
		if _built and _built.sig == sig and _built.grid.Parent == gridWrap then
			for i, it in ipairs(items) do _built.setBadge(i, it.badge, it.badgeColor) end
			prevQ = {}  -- tiles + previews kept; a preview build still running from the last full render carries on
		else
			for _, c in ipairs(gridWrap:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
			local grid, _, setBadge = UI.tiles(gridWrap, items, 1, (items[1] and items[1].preview) and 132 or 64)  -- prevQ fills DURING UI.tiles
			_built = { sig = sig, grid = grid, setBadge = setBadge }
		end
		if #prevQ > 0 then
		-- V4.5.59 (N8) "see the meshes": a STATIC 3D view per tile (a blocky dummy wearing the cloth, System.getClothPreview,
		-- engine-cached). Static ViewportFrames cost nothing per frame once drawn; building is serialized + cancelled by a
		-- newer render so a re-render mid-build (equip, search) never stacks work. krul chose this over live 3D per tile.
		local tok = {}; UI._clothPrevTok = tok
		task.spawn(function()
			for _, q in ipairs(prevQ) do
				if UI._clothPrevTok ~= tok then return end
				local cell = q[1]
				if cell.Parent then
					local ok, m = pcall(System.getClothPreview, q[2])
					if UI._clothPrevTok ~= tok or not cell.Parent then if ok and m then m:Destroy() end; return end
					if ok and m then
						local vp = new("ViewportFrame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 34), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -52), Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 178), LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, 0.6), Parent = cell })
						m.Parent = vp
						-- frame the CLOTH (its parts, not the dummy's body) so small pieces read at tile size; 2D clothes
						-- (no cloth parts) keep the whole-body view
						local lo, hi
						for _, bp in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do
							if bp:IsA("BasePart") and not ({ Head = 1, Torso = 1, ["Left Arm"] = 1, ["Right Arm"] = 1, ["Left Leg"] = 1, ["Right Leg"] = 1 })[bp.Name] then
								local h2 = bp.Size / 2
								lo = lo and lo:Min(bp.Position - h2) or (bp.Position - h2)
								hi = hi and hi:Max(bp.Position + h2) or (bp.Position + h2)
							end
						end
						local centre, d
						if lo then
							local ext = hi - lo
							centre = (lo + hi) / 2; d = math.max(ext.X, ext.Y, 1.4) * 1.7 + 1
						else
							local cf, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
							centre = cf.Position; d = math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 1.3 + 0.5
						end
						local cam = Instance.new("Camera"); cam.FieldOfView = 40
						cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(centre + Vector3.new(d * 0.25, d * 0.08, -d), centre)
						cam.Parent = vp; vp.CurrentCamera = cam
					end
				end
				task.wait()
			end
		end)
		end
		-- the hotSwap tail re-fires this grid after any equip change; refresh an opened Recolor fold with it
		if rcFold and rcFold:GetAttribute("built") and System and System.renderRecolorList then pcall(System.renderRecolorList) end
		if shown == 0 then
			emptyLbl.Text = (needle ~= "" and ('No clothes match "' .. _search .. '".'))
				or (_tab == "2d" and "No 2D (KrulHosted) clothes installed yet.")
				or "No clothes available."
			emptyLbl.Visible = true
		else
			emptyLbl.Visible = false
		end
	end
	UI._renderClothesGrid = render  -- expose to krulTypeDialog via the UI upvalue (re-render after a Shirt/Pants pick)
	if System then System.renderClothesList = render end  -- V1 parity: let the hotSwap tail refresh EQUIPPED badges when a background path (peer/bundle/reset) mutates CurrentClothes. Self-guards on a stale grid (L3791).
	render()
end
function PAGES.catalog(h, sticky)
	-- V4.5.68 (krul): the "By ID" tab is gone. Its job moved into the Search box below, which understands names, item /
	-- bundle / outfit ids and pasted catalog / profile links, and shows matching PEOPLE above the item grid.
	local browser = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = h }); vlist(browser, 8)
	local function _gpd(f) return System and System.getPD and System.getPD(f) end
	-- BROWSER view - WIRED (merge): real engine-driven catalog browser mirroring V2 Pages._renderCatalog (L4104) +
	-- _renderEquipped (L4210). The GUI owns search / category / filters / cursor-stack (the bridge is stateless); the
	-- grid fetches one page via System.catalogLoadPage behind an in-flight gate (task.spawn), renders a tile per item
	-- with an EQUIPPED badge (System.catalogIsEquipped), async-fills missing name/price (System.catalogItemDetails,
	-- SERIALIZED + token-cancelled per render - mobile-freeze fix), and tapping applies via System.catalogApplyItem.
	local renderGrid, renderEquipped  -- forward: chips, strip, tiles, pager + remove buttons all trigger a re-render
	-- page-scope state (rebuilt each open; mirrors V2 L4002-4015). Category rows come from the engine (getCatalogCats).
	local _catCats = (System and System.getCatalogCats and System.getCatalogCats()) or { { label = "All", cat = 1 } }
	local _catCatRow = _catCats[1]
	for _, _cr in ipairs(_catCats) do if _cr.label == SET.catCategory then _catCatRow = _cr; break end end  -- V4.5.33: remembered category
	local _catSearch = ""
	local _catFilters = { creator = SET.catCreator or "", sort = SET.catSort or "", period = SET.catPeriod or "AllTime" }  -- V4.5.33: remembered filters
	local function _catRemember(k, v) SET[k] = v; if _KR.saveCfg then pcall(_KR.saveCfg) end end
	-- V4.5.33 infinite scroll: _catGen bumps on every new search (stale fetches/fills drop out); _catTiles holds every
	-- loaded tile so equip changes repaint in place; _catSeen de-dupes across pages; _catFetching = gen in flight or false.
	local _catNextCursor, _catFetching, _catGen, _catPages = nil, false, 0, 0
	local _catTiles, _catSeen = {}, {}
	local CAT_MAX_PAGES = 20  -- 600 items; keeps memory/thumbnail load sane on phones
	local _equippedFillToken  -- newest equipped-name fill job wins; older serialized fills self-cancel
	local loadMore  -- forward: the scroll watcher calls it
	local topr = cols(browser, 1, 1)  -- V4.5.71: Search only (Save Outfit lives on the Bundles tab)
	-- V4.5.68 PEOPLE row: users matching the search (headshot, display name, @name); tap = wear that user's avatar,
	-- tap the one you are wearing = take it off. Hidden until a text search finds someone.
	local people = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 3, Visible = false, Parent = browser }); vlist(people, 6)
	local peopleHead = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), Text = "People", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = people })
	local peopleRow = new("ScrollingFrame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 104), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X, ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.line, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = people })
	new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = peopleRow })
	local _peopleTok = 0
	local function paintPeople()
		local cur = tostring(_gpd("CatalogUsername") or ""):lower()
		for _, c in ipairs(peopleRow:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("TextButton") then c.BackgroundColor3 = (cur ~= "" and c:GetAttribute("rcUser") == cur) and T.accentD or T.card end  -- outline-free UI: the worn one is filled
		end
	end
	local function showPeople(list)
		for _, c in ipairs(peopleRow:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end end
		people.Visible = #list > 0
		peopleHead.Text = "People (" .. #list .. ")"
		for i, u in ipairs(list) do
			local card = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 100), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = peopleRow }); corner(card, 10)
			card:SetAttribute("rcUser", u.name:lower())
			local img = new("ImageLabel", { BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52), Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. u.id .. "&w=150&h=150", Parent = card }); corner(img, 26)
			lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 64), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 15), Text = u.displayName, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 11, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = card })
			lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 79), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 13), Text = "@" .. u.name, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = card })
			card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if not (System and System.setCatalogUsername) then return end
				local wearing = tostring(_gpd("CatalogUsername") or ""):lower() == u.name:lower()
				System.setCatalogUsername(wearing and "" or u.name)
				toast("Catalog", wearing and ("Removed @" .. u.name .. "'s avatar") or ("Wearing @" .. u.name .. "'s avatar"), "ok")
				paintPeople()
			end)
		end
		paintPeople()
		peopleRow.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end
	-- the Search box: a link or a number = wear that item / bundle / outfit; a profile link = that user's avatar;
	-- text = search the catalog AND people
	local function smartSearch(t)
		t = tostring(t or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
		_peopleTok += 1
		local tok = _peopleTok
		local id, kind = t:match("/catalog/(%d+)"), "asset"
		if not id then id = t:match("/bundles/(%d+)"); kind = id and "bundle" or nil end
		local profileId = not id and t:match("/users/(%d+)")
		if not id and not profileId and t:match("^%d+$") then id, kind = t, nil end
		if profileId then
			people.Visible = false
			task.spawn(function()
				local okN, nm = pcall(PS.GetNameFromUserIdAsync, PS, tonumber(profileId))
				if okN and nm and System and System.setCatalogUsername then System.setCatalogUsername(nm); toast("Catalog", "Wearing @" .. nm .. "'s avatar", "ok")
				else toast("Catalog", "That profile could not be found.", "warn") end
			end)
			return
		end
		if id then
			people.Visible = false
			task.spawn(function()
				toast("Catalog", "Looking up " .. id .. "…")

		end

			showPeople((ok and type(list) == "table") and list or {})
		end)

	-- V4.5.33: filters as ONE compact chip bar (was three full rows). Sort folds the time window in ("Bestselling - past ...

			{ "Bestselling - past week", "Bestselling", "PastWeek" }, { "Bestselling - past day", "Bestselling", "PastDay" },
			{ "Most favorited - all time", "MostFavorited", "AllTime" }, { "Most favorited - past month", "MostFavorited", "PastMonth" },

		local function sortName()
			for _, o in ipairs(SORT_OPTS) do
				if o[2] == (_catFilters.sort or "") and (o[2] == "" or o[2] == "RecentlyCreated" or o[3] == (_catFilters.period or "AllTime")) then return o[1] end
			end
			return "Recommended"
		end
		local function chip(order)

			b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if SET.hoverFx and not SET.reduceMotion then tween(b, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = T.cardHi }) end end)
			b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(b, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = T.card }) end)
			return b
		end
		local sortChip, creatorChip = chip(1), chip(2)

			local cn = _catFilters.creator or ""

		local function setCreator(v)
			_catFilters.creator = (v or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
			_catRemember("catCreator", _catFilters.creator); paintChips(); renderGrid(true)
		end

			UI.openDropdown("Sort by", names, sortName(), function(opt)
				for _, o in ipairs(SORT_OPTS) do
					if o[1] == opt then
						_catFilters.sort, _catFilters.period = o[2], o[3]
						_catRemember("catSort", o[2]); _catRemember("catPeriod", o[3])
					end
				end
				paintChips(); renderGrid(true)
			end, nil, UI.panelRootOf(sortChip))
		end)
		creatorChip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local cur = _catFilters.creator or ""
			UI.openDropdown("Creator", { "Any creator", "Roblox", "Other creator..." }, (cur == "" and "Any creator") or (cur == "Roblox" and "Roblox") or "Other creator...", function(opt)
				if opt == "Any creator" then setCreator("")

			end, nil, UI.panelRootOf(creatorChip))

	local function makeDrawer(title)
		-- V4.5.39: the drawer body is a TextButton, not a Frame - a Frame lets taps on its empty area fall through to the
		-- catalog tiles underneath (krul: "I can interact with stuff behind it"). A GuiButton on top swallows the tap.
		local d = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Selectable = false, BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.05, 0), Visible = false, ZIndex = 20, Parent = catBody }); corner(d, 10)
		local head = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), Parent = d }); pad(head, 12, 8, 0, 0)
		local tl = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), Text = title, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = head })
		local x = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "X", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = T.txt2, Parent = head }); corner(x, 13)
		local body = new("ScrollingFrame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 38), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -38), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.line, Parent = d }); pad(body, 10, 10, 2, 10); vlist(body, 6)
		local o = { frame = d, body = body, title = tl, isOpen = false }
		function o.open() o.isOpen = true; d.Visible = true; d.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.05, 0); tween(d, 0.25, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0) }, QUINT) end
		function o.close() o.isOpen = false; tween(d, 0.2, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.05, 0) }); task.delay(0.22, function() if not o.isOpen and d.Parent then d.Visible = false end end) end
		x.MouseButton1Click:Connect(o.close)
		return o
	end
	-- V4.5.38: ONE "Wearing" drawer replaces Equipped + Strip. Section 1 = YOUR AVATAR: every accessory you wore before ...
	local eqDrawer = makeDrawer("Wearing")
	local function barChip(order, onClick)
		local b = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt2, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = chipBar }); corner(b, 13); pad(b, 12, 12, 0, 0)
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onClick)
		return b
	end
	local eqChip = barChip(3, function()
		if eqDrawer.isOpen then eqDrawer.close() else eqDrawer.open(); if UI._renderAvatarItems then UI._renderAvatarItems() end end
	end); eqChip.Text = "Wearing"
	do
		local body = eqDrawer.body
		local function sect(txt, order) lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), Text = txt, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = body }) end
		sect("YOUR AVATAR", -7)
		UI.hint(body, "What you wore before RoClothes. Tap an item to hide or show it.", -6)
		local acts = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), LayoutOrder = -5, Parent = body })
		for i, spec in ipairs({ { "Hide all", true }, { "Show all", false } }) do

			local ab = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = spec[1], Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) * 0.5, (i - 1) * 4, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = T.txt2, Parent = acts }); corner(ab, 8); UI.hoverFill(ab, T.card, T.cardHi)

			end)
		end
		local grid = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = -4, Parent = body })
		local gl = new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 0, 108), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = grid })
		local empty = UI.hint(body, "Nothing from your own avatar is on right now.", -3); empty.Visible = false
		new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.line, BackgroundTransparency = 0.4, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), LayoutOrder = -2, Parent = body })
		sect("FROM THE CATALOG", -1)
		UI._avatarCount, UI._catalogCount = 0, 0
		UI._paintWearing = function()
			local n = (UI._avatarCount or 0) + (UI._catalogCount or 0)
			eqChip.Text = (n > 0) and ("Wearing (" .. n .. ")") or "Wearing"
			eqChip.TextColor3 = (n > 0) and T.accent or T.txt2
			eqDrawer.title.Text = eqChip.Text
		end
		-- 3D preview of the real accessory (no web lookup): the handle cloned into a ViewportFrame, oriented the way it
		-- sits on the body (inverse of its attachment), camera from the front-right.
		local function preview(parent, inst, dim)
			local vp = new("ViewportFrame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64), Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 195), LightColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, 0.6), ImageTransparency = dim and 0.65 or 0, Parent = parent }); corner(vp, 7)
			pcall(function()
				local h = inst:FindFirstChild("Handle")
				if not (h and h:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
				local c = h:Clone()
				for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("Constraint") or d:IsA("WrapLayer") or d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Sound") then d:Destroy() end
				end
				local att = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
				local rot = att and att.CFrame:Inverse() or CFrame.new()
				c.Anchored = true
				c.CFrame = rot - rot.Position
				c.Parent = vp
				local sz = c.Size
				local d = math.max(sz.X, sz.Y, sz.Z) * 1.9 + 0.3
				local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
				cam.FieldOfView = 40
				cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(d * 0.35, d * 0.25, -d), Vector3.new())
				cam.Parent = vp
				vp.CurrentCamera = cam
			end)
			return vp
		end
		local _tok = 0
		UI._renderAvatarItems = function()
			if not grid.Parent then return end
			local items = (System and System.getAvatarItems and System.getAvatarItems()) or {}
			UI._avatarCount = #items
			UI._paintWearing()
			empty.Visible = #items == 0
			if not eqDrawer.isOpen then return end  -- tiles (ViewportFrames) are only built while the drawer is open
			_tok += 1
			local myTok = _tok
			for _, ch in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do if not ch:IsA("UIGridLayout") then ch:Destroy() end end
			local cgl = catRight:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGridLayout", true)  -- follow the catalog grid's 2-up / 3-up choice
			gl.CellSize = UDim2.new((cgl and cgl.CellSize.X.Scale > 0.4) and 0.5 or (1 / 3), -6, 0, 108)
			local needs = {}
			for i, it in ipairs(items) do
				local _it = it
				local tile = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = it.hidden and T.bg or T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = grid }); corner(tile, 9); pad(tile, 6, 6, 6, 6)
				preview(tile, it.inst, it.hidden)
				local nm = lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 68), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = it.label, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = it.hidden and T.txt3 or T.txt, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = tile })
				lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 83), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12), Text = it.hidden and "Hidden - tap to show" or (it.layered and "Layered - tap to hide" or "Tap to hide"), TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = it.hidden and T.accent or T.txt3, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = tile })
				tile.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					if System and System.toggleAvatarItem then System.toggleAvatarItem(_it.key) end
					UI._renderAvatarItems()
				end)
				if it.assetId then needs[#needs + 1] = { id = it.assetId, lbl = nm } end
			end
			task.spawn(function()  -- catalog names where the item maps to a known asset; serialized, cancelled by a newer render
				for _, nd in ipairs(needs) do
					if _tok ~= myTok then return end
					local okD, d = pcall(function() return System.catalogItemDetails and System.catalogItemDetails(nd.id) end)
					if _tok ~= myTok then return end
					if okD and d and d.name and nd.lbl.Parent then nd.lbl.Text = d.name end
					task.wait()
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	local grid = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = catRight })
	local gridLayout = new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 0, 100), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = grid })  -- 3-up (2-up on narrow panels, see below)

	local footLbl = lbl({ Name = "CatFooter", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = 3, Text = "", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = catRight })
	do
		-- LAYOUT: size catBody so toolbar + sections + catBody exactly fill the panel's view (no outer scroll unless the
		-- sections above are tall; min 240). topInCanvas ignores the current scroll so outer scrolling doesn't resize it.
		-- Absolute* values are post-UIScale -> divide by k. Also picks 2-up tiles on narrow (phone) panels.
		local conns = {}
		local function layout()
			if not catBody.Parent then for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end; table.clear(conns); return end
			local k = catWrap.AbsoluteSize.X / CAT_SIDE_W; if k <= 0 then return end
			gridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(((catRight.AbsoluteWindowSize.X / k) < 300) and 0.5 or (1 / 3), -6, 0, 100)
			local sf = catBody:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
			if sf then
				local topInCanvas = catBody.AbsolutePosition.Y - sf.AbsolutePosition.Y + sf.CanvasPosition.Y
				local h = math.max(240, (sf.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y - topInCanvas - 12) / k)
				if math.abs(catBody.Size.Y.Offset - h) > 1 then catBody.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h) end
			end
		end
		conns[#conns + 1] = catBody:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(layout)
		conns[#conns + 1] = catRight:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteWindowSize"):Connect(layout)
		conns[#conns + 1] = catRight:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function() if loadMore then loadMore() end end)  -- infinite scroll
		task.defer(function()
			local sf = catBody.Parent and catBody:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
			if sf then conns[#conns + 1] = sf:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteWindowSize"):Connect(layout) end
			layout()
		end)
	end
	-- V4.5.59 (N11): bundle breakdown. Lists the bundle's own items (AssetService:GetBundleDetailsAsync, Asset entries
	-- only - the UserOutfit entry is the whole look) as thumbnail tiles; tapping one wears / removes just that item
	-- through the normal catalog path, so it shows in Equipped and saves like any single catalog pick.
	UI._bundleItemsDialog = function(bundle, onChanged)
		showModal(tostring(bundle.name or "Bundle"), "Tap an item to wear just that piece.", { { text = "Close" } }, false, nil, function(box)
			local status = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), Text = "Loading items...", TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextSize = 12, Parent = box })
			local sc = new("ScrollingFrame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 250), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, Visible = false, Parent = box })
			new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 0, 96), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = sc })
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, d = pcall(function() return game:GetService("AssetService"):GetBundleDetailsAsync(tonumber(bundle.id)) end)
				if not box.Parent then return end
				local items = {}
				if ok and type(d) == "table" and type(d.Items) == "table" then
					for _, bi in ipairs(d.Items) do
						local tn = (typeof(bi.Type) == "EnumItem" and bi.Type.Name) or tostring(bi.Type or "")
						if (tn == "Asset" or tn:match("%.Asset$")) and tonumber(bi.Id) then items[#items + 1] = { id = tonumber(bi.Id), name = bi.Name, itemType = "Asset" } end
					end
				end
				if #items == 0 then status.Text = ok and "This bundle has no separate items." or "Couldn't load this bundle - try again."; return end
				status.Visible = false; sc.Visible = true
				for i, item in ipairs(items) do
					local cell = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = sc }); corner(cell, 8)
					new("ImageLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -34), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. item.id .. "&w=150&h=150", Parent = cell })
					local nl2 = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -3), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 26), Text = tostring(item.name or ("ID " .. item.id)), TextSize = 10.5, TextWrapped = true, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Parent = cell })
					local function paint()
						local eq = System and System.catalogIsEquipped and System.catalogIsEquipped(item)
						cell.BackgroundColor3 = eq and T.card:Lerp(T.accent, 0.22) or T.card
					end
					paint()
					local busy = false
					cell.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
						if busy or not (System and System.catalogApplyItem) then return end
						busy = true; nl2.Text = "..."
						local res = System.catalogApplyItem(item)
						busy = false; nl2.Text = tostring(item.name or ("ID " .. item.id))
						if res == false then toast("Catalog", System.catalogLastError or "Couldn't equip that item.", "warn") end
						paint(); if onChanged then onChanged() end
					end)
				end
			end)
		end)
	end
	-- TILES. Equip state is repainted in place (paintTile) so loaded pages survive an equip; no prices are shown.
	local function paintTile(t)
		local eq = (System and System.catalogIsEquipped and System.catalogIsEquipped(t.item)) or false
		t.eq = eq
		t.cell.BackgroundColor3 = eq and T.card:Lerp(T.accent, 0.22) or T.card  -- equipped = accent tint (the UI is outline-free)
		t.badge.Visible = eq
	end
	local function buildTile(it, order)
		local _thumbKind = ((it.itemType == "Bundle" or it.assetType == "Bundle") and "BundleThumbnail") or "Asset"  -- bundles need type=BundleThumbnail (type=Outfit expects an OUTFIT id)
		local _thumbUri = (it.id and ("rbxthumb://type=" .. _thumbKind .. "&id=" .. tostring(it.id) .. "&w=150&h=150")) or ""
		local c = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = grid }); corner(c, 9); local csc = new("UIScale", { Parent = c }); pad(c, 8, 8, 8, 6)
		local img = new("ImageLabel", { BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 68), Image = _thumbUri, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Parent = c }); corner(img, 6)  -- V4.5.57: a soft dark well (was a pure-black box behind every thumbnail)
		local nameLbl = lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 72), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = tostring(it.name or ("ID " .. tostring(it.id))), Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = c })
		local bd = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 15), BackgroundColor3 = T.accentD, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Visible = false, Parent = c }); corner(bd, 5); lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "EQUIPPED", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextSize = 8, ZIndex = 3, Parent = bd })
		local busy = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 68), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, Text = "", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 4, Visible = false, Parent = c }); corner(busy, 6)
		local t = { item = it, cell = c, badge = bd, nameLbl = nameLbl, eq = false }
		if _thumbKind == "BundleThumbnail" and UI._bundleItemsDialog then  -- V4.5.59 (N11): pick single items from this bundle
			local ib = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 64), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 18), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "Items", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 10.5, TextColor3 = T.txt, ZIndex = 5, Parent = c }); corner(ib, 6)
			ib.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() UI._bundleItemsDialog(it, function() renderGrid(false); renderEquipped() end) end)
		end
		c.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(csc, 0.18, { Scale = 1.04 }, QUINT) end)  -- hover-lift
		c.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(csc, 0.18, { Scale = 1 }, QUINT) end)
		local _busy = false
		c.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if _busy or not (System and System.catalogApplyItem) then return end
			-- bundles/emotes/gear load over the network for a second or two: show it, block double taps, and toast the
			-- reason when an item can't be worn instead of failing silently.
			_busy = true
			busy.Text = t.eq and "Removing..." or "Equipping..."; busy.Visible = true
			local _res = System.catalogApplyItem(it)
			_busy = false
			busy.Visible = false
			if _res == false then toast("Catalog", System.catalogLastError or "Couldn't equip that item.", "warn") end
			renderGrid(false); renderEquipped()  -- repaint every loaded tile's equip state + the Equipped list
		end)
		paintTile(t)
		return t
	end
	-- One page fetch for generation `gen`. cursor "" = first page. Appends tiles; a newer search drops the result.
	local function fetchPage(gen, cursor)
		_catFetching = gen
		if cursor == "" then statusLbl.Text = "Loading…"; statusLbl.Visible = true; footLbl.Text = "" else footLbl.Text = "Loading more…" end
		task.spawn(function()
			task.wait()  -- let the loading text paint before the (blocking on mobile) page fetch
			-- the call must NOT be wrapped in an `and`-chain - that truncates the multi-value return to one value
			local items, nxtCur, err
			if System and System.catalogLoadPage then
				items, nxtCur, err = System.catalogLoadPage(_catCatRow, _catSearch, cursor, _catFilters)
			end
			if gen ~= _catGen or not grid.Parent then return end
			_catFetching = false
			if not items then
				if cursor == "" then statusLbl.Text = "Fetch failed - try again" .. (err and (" (" .. tostring(err) .. ")") or ""); statusLbl.Visible = true
				else footLbl.Text = "Couldn't load more - scroll to retry" end
				return
			end
			_catNextCursor = nxtCur
			_catPages += 1
			local needs = {}
			for _, it in ipairs(items) do
				local key = tostring(it.itemType) .. ":" .. tostring(it.id)
				if it.id and not _catSeen[key] then
					_catSeen[key] = true
					local t = buildTile(it, #_catTiles + 1)
					_catTiles[#_catTiles + 1] = t
					-- async name/type fill for assets only (catalogItemDetails is an ASSET lookup - wrong for bundle ids)
					if it.itemType ~= "Bundle" and ((not it.name) or it.name == ("ID " .. tostring(it.id)) or (not it.assetType)) then needs[#needs + 1] = t end
				end
			end
			statusLbl.Visible = (#_catTiles == 0)
			if #_catTiles == 0 then statusLbl.Text = "No results." end
			local more = (_catNextCursor ~= nil and _catNextCursor ~= "") and _catPages < CAT_MAX_PAGES
			footLbl.Text = more and "" or ((#_catTiles > 0) and "End of results" or "")
			-- SERIALIZED fill (executor HTTP can block the main thread on mobile): one at a time, a frame apart, dropped
			-- the moment a newer search starts.
			task.spawn(function()
				for _, t in ipairs(needs) do
					if gen ~= _catGen or not t.cell.Parent then return end
					local d = System and System.catalogItemDetails and System.catalogItemDetails(t.item.id)
					if gen ~= _catGen then return end
					if d then
						if d.name then t.item.name = d.name; if t.nameLbl.Parent then t.nameLbl.Text = d.name end end
						if d.assetType then t.item.assetType = d.assetType end
					end
					task.wait()
				end
			end)
			task.defer(function() if loadMore then loadMore() end end)  -- a short page may not fill the view: keep going
		end)
	end
	loadMore = function()
		if not grid.Parent or _catPages == 0 or _catFetching == _catGen then return end
		if not (_catNextCursor and _catNextCursor ~= "") or _catPages >= CAT_MAX_PAGES then return end
		if (catRight.CanvasPosition.Y + catRight.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y) < (catRight.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - 400) then return end  -- not near the grid's bottom yet
		fetchPage(_catGen, _catNextCursor)
	end
	-- renderGrid(true) = new search (category / search / filter change): clear + page 1. renderGrid(false) = repaint the
	-- equip state of every loaded tile (after equip/unequip/remove), keeping the pages already scrolled through.
	renderGrid = function(newSearch)
		if not grid or not grid.Parent then return end
		if not newSearch and _catPages > 0 then
			for _, t in ipairs(_catTiles) do if t.cell.Parent then paintTile(t) end end
			return
		end
		if not newSearch and _catFetching == _catGen then return end  -- first page already on its way
		_catGen += 1
		for _, ch in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do if not ch:IsA("UIGridLayout") then ch:Destroy() end end
		_catTiles, _catSeen, _catPages, _catNextCursor = {}, {}, 0, nil
		fetchPage(_catGen, "")
	end
	-- register so the engine hotSwap tail (peer/bundle/reset) re-paints the visible grid (mirrors V2 L4201).
	UI._renderCatalog = renderGrid; if System then System.renderCatalog = renderGrid end
	-- Equipped drawer: "Remove all" (confirmed, one rebuild via System.catalogRemoveAllEquipped) + the per-item list.
	local eqAll = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "Remove all", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = T.bad, LayoutOrder = 1, Visible = false, Parent = eqDrawer.body }); corner(eqAll, 8)
	local eqBox = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = eqDrawer.body }); vlist(eqBox, 8)
	eqAll.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		showModal("Remove all?", "Take off every catalog item you equipped.", {
			{ text = "Cancel" },
			{ text = "Remove all", kind = "primary", onClick = function()
				if System and System.catalogRemoveAllEquipped then System.catalogRemoveAllEquipped() end
				renderEquipped(); renderGrid(false)
			end },
		})
	end)
	-- THE EQUIPPED RENDERER (mirrors V2 Pages._renderEquipped L4210): rebuild rows from getCatalogEquipped; each row =
	-- name + Remove -> catalogRemoveEquipped(id, slot). Names resolve async via catalogItemDetails (serialized, cancel-token).
	renderEquipped = function()
		if not eqBox or not eqBox.Parent then return end
		for _, ch in ipairs(eqBox:GetChildren()) do if not ch:IsA("UIListLayout") then ch:Destroy() end end
		local list = (System and System.getCatalogEquipped and System.getCatalogEquipped()) or {}
		local eqGrid = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = eqBox })  -- V4.5.59 (N5)
		new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 0, 112), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = eqGrid })
		local _needs = {}
		local i = 0
		for _, e in ipairs(list) do
			local _e = e
			i += 1
			local nm0 = "ID " .. tostring(e.id)
			-- V4.5.59 (N5): a thumbnail card per item (see what it is instead of reading a name); X removes it.
			local _kind = tostring(e.kind or "")
			local _isBundle = string.find(string.lower(_kind), "bundle", 1, true) ~= nil
			local card = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = eqGrid }); corner(card, 9); stroke(card, T.lineSoft, 1)
			new("ImageLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -38), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
				Image = "rbxthumb://type=" .. (_isBundle and "BundleThumbnail" or "Asset") .. "&id=" .. tostring(e.id) .. "&w=150&h=150", Parent = card })
			local nameLbl = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 1, -4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 28), Text = nm0, TextSize = 11, TextWrapped = true,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = card })
			local rm = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 4), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "X", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.bad, TextSize = 12, Parent = card }); corner(rm, 11)
			rm.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if System and System.catalogRemoveEquipped then System.catalogRemoveEquipped(_e.id, _e.slot) end
				renderEquipped(); renderGrid(false)
			end)
			if e.name then nameLbl.Text = tostring(e.name) else _needs[#_needs + 1] = { e = _e, nameLbl = nameLbl } end
		end
		if i == 0 then UI.hint(eqBox, "Nothing from the catalog.", 1) end
		UI._catalogCount = i  -- V4.5.38: the chip/title count = your-avatar items + catalog items
		if UI._renderAvatarItems then UI._renderAvatarItems() elseif UI._paintWearing then UI._paintWearing() end
		eqAll.Visible = i > 1
		-- SERIALIZED name fills (cache-first inside the bridge); a per-render token cancels a stale fill (V2 L4236-4249).
		local _tok = {}; _equippedFillToken = _tok
		task.spawn(function()
			for _, nd in ipairs(_needs) do
				if _equippedFillToken ~= _tok then return end
				if nd.nameLbl and nd.nameLbl.Parent then
					local d = System and System.catalogItemDetails and System.catalogItemDetails(nd.e.id)
					if _equippedFillToken ~= _tok then return end
					if d and d.name and nd.nameLbl and nd.nameLbl.Parent then nd.nameLbl.Text = d.name end
				end
				task.wait()
			end
		end)
	end
	-- register the equipped sidebar so the engine hotSwap tail re-paints it after a peer/bundle/reset (mirrors V2 L4253).
	UI._renderEquipped = renderEquipped; if System then System.renderEquipped = renderEquipped end
	paintCats()  -- highlight the active category chip
	-- initial paint: load the first page + the equipped sidebar when the Browser view FIRST opens (mirror V2 L4257-4264,
	-- which defers the network fetch until Browser is shown rather than firing it on build under the By-ID default view).
	local _catFirstOpen = false
	browser:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if browser.Visible and not _catFirstOpen then
			_catFirstOpen = true
			renderGrid(true); renderEquipped()
		end
	end)
end
-- V4.5.62 BUNDLE PREVIEW PANEL: tapping a bundle tile opens this instead of wearing it blind. It DOCKS beside the panel it was
-- opened from (left, else right; on a phone with no room it sits over that panel's own list) and follows it, so it never covers
-- the middle of the screen. Top: the preview dummy WEARING the bundle (System.getBundleMannequin: its clothing pieces, Roblox
-- shirt/pants/accessories, outfit items, body colours), drag to turn it. Then body facts and item thumbnails. Wear / Remove keeps
-- the panel open; Close, the X, tapping the same tile again, switching tabs or closing the panel closes it. One viewport, built
-- only on tap (phones).
local _bp = {}
local function _bpClose()
	if System then System._bundleLookWant = nil end  -- a queued preview build for a closed panel is dropped
	if _bp.conns then for _, c in ipairs(_bp.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end end
	if _bp.frame then pcall(function() _bp.frame:Destroy() end) end
	_bp = {}
end
UI._bundlePreviewClose = _bpClose
local function _bpActive(nm)
	local g = System and System.getPD
	if not g then return false end
	if g("CurrentBundle") == nm or g("CurrentPreset") == nm then return true end
	local cb = g("CurrentClothingBundles")
	return type(cb) == "table" and table.find(cb, nm) ~= nil
end
UI._bundlePreviewDialog = function(nm, active, onWear, anchor)
	if _bp.frame and _bp.name == nm then _bpClose(); return end  -- same tile again = close
	_bpClose()
	local info = System and System.getBundlePreview and System.getBundlePreview(nm)
	local root = anchor and UI.panelRootOf(anchor)
	local screen = root and root:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector")
	if not (info and root and screen) then if onWear then onWear() end return end
	local KIND = { community = "Community bundle", mine = "My bundle", clothing = "Clothing bundle", preset = "Preset (body settings only)" }
	local function num(x) return tostring(math.floor(x * 100 + 0.5) / 100) end
	local facts = {}
	local function fact(s) facts[#facts + 1] = s end
	local function typeScale(label, ty, sc)
		if ty or sc then fact(label .. (ty and (" type " .. ty) or "") .. (sc and ("  x" .. num(sc)) or "")) end
	end
	typeScale("Breasts", info.breastsType, info.breastsScale)
	typeScale("Butt", info.buttType, info.buttsScale)
	typeScale("Legs", info.legsType, info.legsScale)
	if info.armType then fact("Arms type " .. info.armType) end
	if info.torsoType then fact("Torso type " .. info.torsoType) end
	if info.physics or info.smartBone then fact("Physics: " .. ((info.physics and info.smartBone) and "body + SmartBone" or (info.smartBone and "SmartBone" or "body"))) end
	if #info.clothing > 0 then
		local shown = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(#info.clothing, 6) do shown[i] = info.clothing[i] end
		fact("Clothing: " .. table.concat(shown, ", ") .. (#info.clothing > 6 and (" +" .. (#info.clothing - 6) .. " more") or ""))
	end
	if info.meshEdits > 0 then fact("Custom mesh edits: " .. info.meshEdits) end
	if info.outfitId then fact("Includes a Roblox outfit") end
	if info.username then  -- V4.5.63: old username bundles copy a LIVE avatar; frozen ones keep the look from when they were saved
		fact(info.userFrozen and ("Look copied from " .. info.username .. " (saved, never changes)") or ("Copies " .. info.username .. "'s CURRENT avatar: it changes when they change it"))
	end
	local thumbs = {}
	local function addThumb(id, cap) if id then thumbs[#thumbs + 1] = { id = id, cap = cap } end end
	addThumb(info.shirt, "Shirt"); addThumb(info.pants, "Pants"); addThumb(info.graphic, "Graphic")
	for _, id in ipairs(info.accessories) do addThumb(id, "Accessory") end
	for _, id in ipairs(info.tail) do addThumb(id, "Tail") end
	for _, id in ipairs(info.catalogAccessories) do addThumb(id, "Catalog") end
	for _, id in ipairs(info.catalogTail) do addThumb(id, "Tail") end
	local MAXT, W, HEAD, FOOT = 12, 270, 50, 52

	local f = new("Frame", { Name = "BundlePreview", BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, 420), ZIndex = 20, Active = true, Parent = screen })
	corner(f, 14); pcall(stroke, f, T.line, 1); pcall(_KR.addShadow, f)
	local us = new("UIScale", { Parent = f })
	local tok = {}
	_bp = { frame = f, name = nm, conns = {}, tok = tok }
	local function conn(sig, fn) _bp.conns[#_bp.conns + 1] = sig:Connect(fn) end
	-- header
	lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 10), Size = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0, 18), Text = nm, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 15, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 21, Parent = f })
	lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 29), Size = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0, 14), Text = KIND[info.tab] or "Bundle", TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextSize = 11.5, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 21, Parent = f })
	local xb = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "x", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = T.txt2, ZIndex = 21, Parent = f }); corner(xb, 8)
	xb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(_bpClose)
	-- body (scrolls)
	local sc = new("ScrollingFrame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, HEAD), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -(HEAD + FOOT)), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollBarThickness = 3, ZIndex = 21, Parent = f })
	vlist(sc, 8)
	local vp = new("ViewportFrame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 230), LayoutOrder = 1, Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 178), LightColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6), ZIndex = 21, Parent = sc }); corner(vp, 10)
	local status = lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "Building your look...", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 22, Parent = vp })
	local hint = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 12), Text = "", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 10, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 22, Parent = vp })
	if #facts > 0 then
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Text = table.concat(facts, "\n"), TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextSize = 12, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 21, Parent = sc })
	end
	if info.username and not info.userFrozen and info.tab == "mine" and System.freezeBundleUser then
		local fz = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = 3, BackgroundColor3 = T.card, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "Freeze this look (keep " .. info.username .. "'s avatar as it is today)", TextWrapped = true, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt, ZIndex = 21, Parent = sc }); corner(fz, 8)
		local busy = false
		fz.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if busy then return end
			busy = true; fz.Text = "Saving..."
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, msg = System.freezeBundleUser(nm)
				toast("Bundles", tostring(msg or (ok and "Saved." or "Failed.")), ok and "ok" or "warn")
				if ok and _bp.tok == tok then _bpClose(); UI._bundlePreviewDialog(nm, active, onWear, anchor) elseif fz.Parent then busy = false; fz.Text = "Freeze this look" end
			end)
		end)
	end
	if #thumbs > 0 then
		local grid = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 4, ZIndex = 21, Parent = sc })
		new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 4, -6, 0, 70), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = grid })
		for i = 1, math.min(#thumbs, MAXT) do
			local t = thumbs[i]
			local cell = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 21, Parent = grid }); corner(cell, 8)
			new("ImageLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -20), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. t.id .. "&w=150&h=150", ZIndex = 22, Parent = cell })
			lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -2), Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 14), Text = t.cap, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextSize = 10, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 22, Parent = cell })
		end
		if #thumbs > MAXT then
			lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 16), LayoutOrder = 5, Text = "+" .. (#thumbs - MAXT) .. " more items", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 21, Parent = sc })
		end
	end
	-- footer: Wear / Remove (stays open) + Close
	local wear = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -10), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -15, 0, 34), BackgroundColor3 = T.accentD, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = T.txt, ZIndex = 21, Parent = f }); corner(wear, 9)
	local close = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -15, 0, 34), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg2, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "Close", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = T.txt2, ZIndex = 21, Parent = f }); corner(close, 9); pcall(stroke, close, T.line, 1)
	local function paintWear() wear.Text = _bpActive(nm) and "Remove" or "Wear" end
	paintWear()
	wear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if onWear then onWear() end
		task.delay(0.15, function() if _bp.tok == tok then paintWear() end end)
	end)
	close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(_bpClose)
	-- docking
	local function place()
		if _bp.tok ~= tok then return end
		if not (root.Parent and root.Visible and anchor.Parent and anchor:IsDescendantOf(root)) then _bpClose(); return end
		local rs = root:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local s = (rs and rs.Scale > 0) and rs.Scale or 1
		us.Scale = s
		local sp, ss = screen.AbsolutePosition, screen.AbsoluteSize
		local rp, rsz = root.AbsolutePosition - sp, root.AbsoluteSize
		local w, gap = W * s, 10
		local x, y, h
		if rp.X >= w + gap + 6 then x, y, h = rp.X - w - gap, rp.Y, rsz.Y
		elseif ss.X - (rp.X + rsz.X) >= w + gap + 6 then x, y, h = rp.X + rsz.X + gap, rp.Y, rsz.Y
		else x, y, h = rp.X + 8, rp.Y + 8, rsz.Y - 16 end  -- no room beside it (phone): over the panel's own list, never mid-screen
		-- V4.5.69 (narrow phones): the overlay kept its full 270 px width and a 260 px minimum height, so on a panel / screen
		-- narrower or shorter than that it ran off the edge (Wear / Close cut off). Fit it to the screen, then keep it on it.
		local wpx = math.min(w, math.max(160 * s, ss.X - 12))
		h = math.min(math.clamp(h, 260 * s, 560 * s), math.max(200 * s, ss.Y - 12))
		x = math.clamp(x, 6, math.max(6, ss.X - wpx - 6))
		y = math.clamp(y, 6, math.max(6, ss.Y - h - 6))
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(x), math.floor(y))
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(wpx / s), math.floor(h / s))
	end
	place()
	conn(root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"), place)
	conn(root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), place)
	conn(root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), place)
	conn(screen:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), place)
	conn(anchor.AncestryChanged, place)
	-- the mannequin (yields on first build; cached per bundle after that)
	task.spawn(function()
		-- V4.5.63: the real build on a hidden copy of you (body meshes and all); the dressed mannequin is the fallback
		local ok, m = false, nil
		local why
		if System.getBundleLook then ok, m, why = pcall(System.getBundleLook, nm) end
		if ok and not m and (why == "cancelled" or why == "busy") and _bp.tok == tok then  -- a Wear/rebuild pre-empted it: retry once that build is done
			status.Text = "Waiting for your outfit to finish..."
			local t0 = os.clock()
			repeat task.wait(0.2) until _bp.tok ~= tok or not (System._realBuildActive and System._realBuildActive()) or os.clock() - t0 > 30
			if _bp.tok == tok then status.Text = "Building your look..."; ok, m, why = pcall(System.getBundleLook, nm) end
		end
		local plain = false
		if not (ok and m) and _bp.tok == tok then ok, m = pcall(System.getBundleMannequin, nm); plain = true end
		if _bp.tok ~= tok or not vp.Parent then if ok and m then m:Destroy() end; return end
		if not (ok and m) then status.Text = "Couldn't build the preview."; return end
		status.Visible = false
		-- V4.5.68 (preview plan Task 6): say when items failed, or when only the plain mannequin could be shown
		local function noteFor(model)
			local n = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("rcLoadFails"))
			if plain then return "Couldn't build your look, showing a plain preview. Drag to turn" end
			if n and n > 0 then return "Some items couldn't load (" .. n .. "). Drag to turn" end
			return "Drag to turn"
		end
		hint.Text = noteFor(m)
		local wm = Instance.new("WorldModel"); wm.Parent = vp  -- skinned meshes (SmartBone/VNS) need a WorldModel to deform
		local function show(model)
			model.Parent = wm
			local idle = model:GetAttribute("rcIdleAnim")
			if type(idle) == "string" and idle ~= "" then pcall(function()  -- the bundle's animation pack: its idle, looped (no pack = standing still)
				local h = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local animator = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", h)
				local a = Instance.new("Animation"); a.AnimationId = idle
				local tr = animator:LoadAnimation(a); tr.Looped = true; tr:Play(0.1)
			end) end
		end
		show(m)
		if why == "stale" then  -- built on an older look of yours: shown at once, the fresh build swaps in when ready
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok2, m2 = pcall(System.getBundleLook, nm, { force = true })
				if ok2 and m2 and _bp.tok == tok and wm.Parent then m:Destroy(); m = m2; show(m2); hint.Text = noteFor(m2) elseif ok2 and m2 then m2:Destroy() end
			end)
		end
		local cf, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
		local centre = cf.Position
		local d = math.max(size.Y, size.X * 1.25) * 1.5 + 1.5
		local cam = Instance.new("Camera"); cam.FieldOfView = 40; cam.Parent = vp; vp.CurrentCamera = cam
		local yaw = 0.3
		local function aim() cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(centre + Vector3.new(math.sin(yaw) * d, d * 0.12, -math.cos(yaw) * d), centre) end
		aim()
		local dragging, lastX = false, 0
		local function isPress(io) return io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch end
		conn(vp.InputBegan, function(io) if isPress(io) then dragging = true; lastX = io.Position.X; sc.ScrollingEnabled = false end end)
		conn(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(io)
			if dragging and (io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				yaw -= (io.Position.X - lastX) * 0.012; lastX = io.Position.X; aim()
			end
		end)
		conn(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(io) if dragging and isPress(io) then dragging = false; sc.ScrollingEnabled = true end end)
	end)
end
function PAGES.bundles(h, sticky)
	-- WIRED (merge): real engine-driven bundles grid + the cross-tab detecting-bundle flow. Mirrors V2 Pages.bundles /
	-- Pages._renderBundles (L4278-4408): the seg drives System.setBundleTab + re-render; tiles come from
	-- System.getBundleList(tab,search) ({name,tab,active}); a normal click applies (System.applyBundle) and - when an
	-- Options action is armed on UI._detectingBundle - the click instead COPIES (exportBundle name,"clipboard") or
	-- DELETES (deleteBundle + clearBundle if it was the active one) that bundle, then disarms. The renderer is registered
	-- onto System.renderBundles (hotSwap re-paint) and stashed on UI._renderBundles. Engine tab ids: community/mine/clothing/preset.
	local TAB_IDS = { "community", "mine", "clothing", "preset" }
	local TAB_LABELS = { community = "Community", mine = "Mine", clothing = "Clothing", preset = "Presets" }
	local render  -- forward; the seg/search closures capture it
	local _tabIdx = 1
	do  -- seed the active tab from the engine (mirrors V2 L4293-4296)
		local at = System and System.getActiveBundleTab and System.getActiveBundleTab()
		if at then for i, id in ipairs(TAB_IDS) do if id == at then _tabIdx = i; break end end end
	end
	local _tab = TAB_IDS[_tabIdx]
	local _search = ""
	if System and System.setBundleTab then System.setBundleTab(_tab) end
	-- per-segment count badges (read once from the engine, like the old mock's bcounts; counts are total-per-tab)
	local _counts = (System and System.getBundleCounts and System.getBundleCounts()) or {}
	local bcounts = { _counts.community or 0, _counts.mine or 0, _counts.clothing or 0, _counts.preset or 0 }
	-- STICKY: a detect-hint banner (shown only when an Options action is armed) + the 4-way seg + search pin above the grid
	local sw = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = sticky }); pad(sw, 14, 10, 4, 8); vlist(sw, 8)
	local hint = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 30, 18), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 1, Visible = false, Parent = sw }); corner(hint, 8); stroke(hint, T.warn, 1); pad(hint, 10, 10, 7, 7)
	local hintLbl = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = "", TextColor3 = T.warn, TextSize = 11.5, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = hint })
	UI.seg(sw, { "Community", "Mine", "Clothing", "Presets" }, 2, function(o, i) _tab = TAB_IDS[i] or "community"; if System and System.setBundleTab then System.setBundleTab(_tab) end; if render then render() end end, _tabIdx, nil, bcounts)
	UI.field(sw, "Search bundles", "", 3, true, function(t) _search = t or ""; if render then render() end end, nil, true)
	-- actions (scroll): Save Outfit (accent primary) | Export Bundle | Manage Deleted
	local ab = cols(h, 1, 3)
	UI.button(ab[1], "Save Outfit", "primary", 1, saveOutfitDialog)
	UI.button(ab[2], "Export Bundle", nil, 1, exportBundleDialog)
	UI.button(ab[3], "Manage Deleted", nil, 1, function() if UI._manageDeletedDialog then UI._manageDeletedDialog() end end)
	-- V4.5.59 Mine tab: Rename / Update the bundle you are wearing (only bundles you saved). Same "acts on the applied
	-- bundle" model as Export Bundle: apply it, change your look, press Update.
	local mine = cols(h, 2, 2)
	local mineRow = mine[1].Parent
	local function _activeMine()
		local n = System and System.getPD and System.getPD("CurrentBundle")
		if type(n) ~= "string" or n == "" or n == "nil" then n = System and System.getPD and System.getPD("CurrentPreset") end
		return (type(n) == "string" and n ~= "" and n ~= "nil") and n or nil
	end
	UI.button(mine[1], "Rename", nil, 1, function()
		local n = _activeMine()
		if not n then toast("Rename", "Apply one of your bundles first, then press Rename.", "warn"); return end
		showModal("Rename Bundle", 'New name for "' .. n .. '"', {
			{ text = "Cancel" },
			{ text = "Rename", kind = "primary", onClick = function(t)
				local ok, msg = System.renameBundle(n, t)
				toast("Rename", tostring(msg), ok and "ok" or "warn"); if render then render() end
			end },
		}, true, n)
	end)
	UI.button(mine[2], "Update with my look", nil, 1, function()
		local n = _activeMine()
		if not n then toast("Update", "Apply one of your bundles first, change your look, then press Update.", "warn"); return end
		showModal("Update Bundle", 'Replace "' .. n .. '" with the look you are wearing now?', {
			{ text = "Cancel" },
			{ text = "Update", kind = "primary", onClick = function()
				local ok, msg = System.updateBundle(n)
				toast("Update", tostring(msg), ok and "ok" or "warn"); if render then render() end
			end },
		})
	end)
	-- empty-state label + grid host live in the scrolling body; render clears+rebuilds only the grid host
	local emptyLbl = lbl({ Name = "Empty", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 4, Text = "", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 11.5, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Visible = false, Parent = h })
	local gridWrap = new("Frame", { Name = "BundlesGridWrap", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = h })
	render = function()
		if not (gridWrap and gridWrap.Parent) then return end
		mineRow.Visible = (_tab == "mine")
		for _, c in ipairs(gridWrap:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
		-- reflect any armed Options bundle action in the hint banner (mirrors V2 L4350-4361)
		local armed = UI._detectingBundle
		if armed == "delete" then hintLbl.Text = "Click a bundle below to DELETE it."; hint.Visible = true
		elseif armed == "export_copy" then hintLbl.Text = "Click a bundle below to COPY its template to the clipboard."; hint.Visible = true
		else hint.Visible = false end
		local list = (System and System.getBundleList and System.getBundleList(_tab, _search)) or {}
		local items = {}
		for _, e in ipairs(list) do
			local nm = e.name
			items[#items + 1] = {
				name = nm,
				sub = TAB_LABELS[e.tab] or e.tab,
				badge = e.active and "ACTIVE" or nil,
