local pageHost = new("ScrollingFrame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 46), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -46), BorderSizePixel = 0, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.line, ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.45, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, Parent = panel }); pad(pageHost, 14, 10, 4, 16); vlist(pageHost, 8)
-- STICKY zone: grid tabs pin their filter/search row here (2nd arg to their page fn) so it stays put while the grid
-- scrolls; empty (0 height) on every other tab. pageHost + the top fade get pushed below it by syncSticky().
local stickyBar = new("Frame", { Name = "Sticky", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 46), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = panel })
-- scroll edge fades: content dissolves into the panel bg at the top/bottom instead of hard-cutting at the edge.
-- (parented to the panel, not the scroll, so they stay put while content scrolls under them. T.bg = panel's resting bg.)
local function pageEdgeFade(atTop, yTop, h)
	local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6, AnchorPoint = atTop and Vector2.new(0.5, 0) or Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, h), Position = atTop and UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, yTop) or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), Parent = panel })  -- inset 16px so the fade clears the panel's rounded corners
	local up = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	local dn = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = atTop and up or dn, Parent = f })
	return f
end
local topFade = pageEdgeFade(true, 46, 16)  -- top (just under the header divider)
local botFade = pageEdgeFade(false, 0, 18)  -- bottom
topFade.Visible = false; botFade.Visible = false  -- hidden during the morph so no black bars flash on open/close
-- push pageHost + the top fade below the sticky zone (its height is 0 when empty, so non-grid tabs are unaffected)
_KR.syncStickyZone = function(hostFrame, stickyFrame, headerH, fadeFrame)  -- keep a scroll host BELOW the sticky zone's live height (shared by the single panel + every Multi-Panel panel). ÷UISCALE: AbsoluteSize is POST-scale (the panel is UISCALE'd) but the host offset is LOGICAL; was overlapping the sticky row on <1.0 (mobile) devices.
	local sh = math.ceil(stickyFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y / UISCALE)
	hostFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, headerH + sh)
	hostFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(headerH + sh))
	if fadeFrame then fadeFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, headerH + sh) end
end
local function syncSticky() _KR.syncStickyZone(pageHost, stickyBar, 46, topFade) end  -- single panel: 46px header + the top edge-fade
stickyBar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(syncSticky); syncSticky()
-- Edge fades FOLLOW the scroll: the top fade only appears once you've scrolled DOWN (so it never dims the first
-- section header at rest - that was the subtle grey tint), the bottom fade only while there's more content below.
-- A tab whose content fits shows neither.
local activeTab, panelOpen, activeBtn, activeColor = nil, false, nil, T.accent  -- [V3 MERGE FIX] declared ABOVE refreshFades (which reads panelOpen); was declared ~65 lines later => panelOpen compiled as a nil GLOBAL => edge-fades were dead on every tab.
local function refreshFades()
	if not panelOpen then topFade.Visible = false; botFade.Visible = false; return end
	-- V4.5.57: the fades are SOLID panel-colour gradients - on a see-through panel (style skins / Glassy panels) they read
	-- as a hard black band over the last row (krul). Content just clips at the panel edge there instead.
	if panel.BackgroundTransparency > 0.3 then topFade.Visible = false; botFade.Visible = false; return end
	topFade.BackgroundTransparency = panel.BackgroundTransparency; botFade.BackgroundTransparency = panel.BackgroundTransparency  -- never more solid than the panel itself (a solid fade on a see-through panel = black band)
	local pos = pageHost.CanvasPosition.Y
	local maxScroll = math.max(0, pageHost.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - pageHost.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
	topFade.Visible = pos > 3
	botFade.Visible = pos < maxScroll - 3
end
_KR.refreshFades = refreshFades  -- V4.5.57: a section-tab switch changes the page height without scrolling
pageHost:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(refreshFades)

-- ===== option-picker modal (opened by every UI.dropdown instead of an inline drop). Parented INTO the panel so it
-- ALWAYS fits perfectly inside the tab and resizes with it: the dim fills the panel (scale 1,1), the card insets from

-- whole picker draws above the tab content, which tops out at ~6 (the edge fades). =====

local _dCloseCb  -- the opener's onClose (chevron spring-back), fired on pick OR backdrop-tap dismissal
local function hideDropdown() dropLayer.Visible = false; dropLayer.Parent = panel; if _dCloseCb then local cb = _dCloseCb; _dCloseCb = nil; pcall(cb) end end  -- hide + RE-HOME to the single panel; FIRE the opener's close cb (chevron spring-back) so it isn't left stuck rotated
UI._dropClose = function()   -- V4.5.34: shrink + fade out (was an instant vanish)
	if not dropLayer.Visible then return end
	UI._dropTok = (UI._dropTok or 0) + 1; local tok = UI._dropTok
	if SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then
		tween(_dDim, 0.14, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }); tween(_dScale, 0.14, { Scale = 0.94 })
		task.delay(0.14 * SPEED, function() if UI._dropTok == tok then dropLayer.Visible = false end end)
	else
		dropLayer.Visible = false
	end
end
UI.openDropdown = function(title, options, current, onChoose, onClose, root, rich)  -- rich = { items = { [option] = { name, desc, sketch(frame) } } } -> a 2-column grid of picture cards
	UI._dropTok = (UI._dropTok or 0) + 1   -- cancel a pending animated close
	if _dCloseCb then local cb = _dCloseCb; _dCloseCb = nil; pcall(cb) end   -- another panel's dropdown is still open -> spring ITS chevron back before we re-home the shared picker into THIS panel (else it's left stuck rotated)
	_dTitle.Text = tostring(title or "Select")
	for _, c in ipairs(_dScroll:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("TextButton") or c.Name == "RichGrid" then c:Destroy() end end
	if rich and rich.items then  -- V4.5.57 picture cards: a sketch of each option, its name, one line on what it does, and a check on the current one
		local stl = SET.barStyle or "Dock"; local rad = (stl == "Taskbar") and 4 or ((stl == "Minimal") and 14 or 10)
		local grid = new("Frame", { Name = "RichGrid", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ZIndex = DZ + 3, Parent = _dScroll })
		new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -5, 0, 152), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = grid })
		for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
			local sel = (tostring(opt) == tostring(current)); local info = rich.items[tostring(opt)] or {}
			local ob = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = sel and T.accentD or T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = DZ + 3, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = grid }); corner(ob, rad); _KR.press(ob)
			local sk = new("Frame", { Name = "Sketch", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 82), ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = DZ + 4, Parent = ob })
			if info.sketch then pcall(info.sketch, sk) end
			lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 94), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 18), Text = info.name or tostring(opt), Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = T.txt, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = DZ + 4, Parent = ob })
			lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 113), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32), Text = info.desc or "", TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = DZ + 4, Parent = ob })
			if sel then  -- a check badge on the current choice
				local ck = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = DZ + 6, Parent = ob }); corner(ck, 10)
				new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 11), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 2), Rotation = 45, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = DZ + 7, Parent = ck })
				new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 9), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2), Rotation = -50, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = DZ + 7, Parent = ck })
			else
				ob.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(ob, 0.18, { BackgroundColor3 = T.cardHi }) end)
				ob.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(ob, 0.18, { BackgroundColor3 = T.card }) end)
			end
			ob.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() _dCloseCb = nil; UI._dropClose(); if onClose then onClose() end; if onChoose then onChoose(opt) end end)
		end
	end
	for i, opt in ipairs((rich and rich.items) and {} or options) do
		local sel = (tostring(opt) == tostring(current))  -- the current value gets an accent fill so it's obvious at a glance
		local ob = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = sel and T.accentD or T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), ZIndex = DZ + 3, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = _dScroll }); corner(ob, 8); pad(ob, 12, 12, 0, 0)
		local st = (not sel) and stroke(ob, T.lineSoft, 1) or nil
		lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Text = tostring(opt), TextColor3 = sel and T.txt or T.txt2, Font = sel and FONTB or FONT, TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = DZ + 4, Parent = ob })
		if not sel then
			ob.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(ob, 0.18, { BackgroundColor3 = T.cardHi }); if st then tween(st, 0.18, { Color = T.line }) end end)
			ob.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(ob, 0.18, { BackgroundColor3 = T.card }); if st then tween(st, 0.18, { Color = T.lineSoft }) end end)
		end
		ob.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() _dCloseCb = nil; UI._dropClose(); if onClose then onClose() end; if onChoose then onChoose(opt) end end)
	end
	_KR.skinPass(_dScroll)  -- V4.5.57: option rows follow the style (see-through / radius)
	local rows = #options
	local tgt = root or panel; dropLayer.Parent = tgt
	do local pw = tgt:GetAttribute("rcPickerW"); if pw and rich and rich.items then pw = math.max(pw, 480) end; _dCard.Size = pw and UDim2.fromOffset(pw, 0) or UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 0) end  -- V4.5.57: a wide host (UI Settings) gets a normal-width picker, not a 1140px one
	do local pc, dc = tgt:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner"), _dDim:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner"); if pc and dc then dc.CornerRadius = pc.CornerRadius end end  -- the dim matches ITS panel's corners (a r16 dim inside an r8 Taskbar panel left undimmed corner slivers)  -- panel-aware: the picker opens INSIDE the panel whose dropdown was tapped
	local capH = (tgt == panel) and PANEL_H or (tgt.AbsoluteSize.Y / UISCALE)  -- BOTH the single panel and every MP frame carry a UIScale=UISCALE (see MP.make), so a multi-panel's AbsoluteSize is POST-scale → ÷UISCALE to get the LOGICAL height the _dScroll list Size is set in (else the list is cramped on mobile where UISCALE<1)
	local listH = (rich and rich.items) and (math.ceil(rows / 2) * 162 - 10) or (rows * 34 + math.max(0, rows - 1) * 5)  -- picture cards: 2 per row, 152 tall + 10 gap
	_dScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.min(listH, math.max(68, capH - 82)))  -- list height capped to the target panel
	_dCloseCb = onClose
	dropLayer.Visible = true
	_dDim.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tween(_dDim, 0.18, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 })
	_dScale.Scale = 0.92; tween(_dScale, 0.2, { Scale = 1 }, QUINT)
end
_dDim.InputBegan:Connect(function(io)  -- close on a click OUTSIDE the card (bounds-checked; doesn't rely on Active sinking on Volt)
	if io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local p, cp, cs = io.Position, _dCard.AbsolutePosition, _dCard.AbsoluteSize
		if p.X < cp.X or p.X > cp.X + cs.X or p.Y < cp.Y or p.Y > cp.Y + cs.Y then UI._dropClose(); if _dCloseCb then _dCloseCb() end; _dCloseCb = nil end
	end
end)

-- a tab button's on-screen footprint (bottom-centre position + size), so the panel morphs from/into the button ITSELF.
local GUI_INSET = Vector2.new(0, 0); pcall(function() GUI_INSET = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset() end)
local function btnFootprint(btn)
	if btn and btn.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
		local ap, asz = btn.AbsolutePosition, btn.AbsoluteSize
		-- + GUI_INSET: on an IgnoreGuiInset ScreenGui, AbsolutePosition under-reports by the topbar inset, so the
		-- panel's offset positioning needs the inset added back to actually land ON the button.
		-- size divided by UISCALE because the panel carries a UIScale (avoids double-scaling the collapsed footprint).
		return UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(ap.X + asz.X / 2 + GUI_INSET.X), math.floor(ap.Y + asz.Y / 2 + GUI_INSET.Y)), UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(asz.X / UISCALE), math.floor(asz.Y / UISCALE))
	end
	local _p = panelOpenRect(); return _p, PANEL_MIN
end
local function buildPageInto(host, sticky, id)  -- build a tab's content into ANY scroll host + sticky zone (single OR a multi-panel)
	if _curPage == "edit" and id ~= "edit" and System and System.hideGizmo3D then pcall(System.hideGizmo3D) end  -- RIG POSER: drop the 3D handles when leaving the Edit tab
	_curPage = id  -- stateful controls key their persisted value to this tab; captured at build time (builds are synchronous)
	for _, c in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") and not c:IsA("UIPadding") then c:Destroy() end end
	for _, c in ipairs(sticky:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end  -- reset the sticky zone; grid tabs re-fill it via the 2nd arg
	local b = PAGES[id]; if b then b(host, sticky) end
	_KR.skinPass(host); _KR.skinPass(sticky)  -- V4.5.57: small controls follow the style
	_KR.sectionize(host, sticky, id)  -- V4.5.57: Settings page / Floating sheet split long tabs into section tabs
	if _KR.srchIndexPage then pcall(_KR.srchIndexPage, host, id) end  -- V4.5.57 search: a real build refreshes this tab's entries
	host.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	if _KR.fadeInto then _KR.fadeInto(host.Parent) end  -- if UI-transparency is ON, fade this freshly-built panel to match (BEFORE the cascade, so the cascade reveals to the faded value instead of fighting it)
	if SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then
		cascadeIn(host, 0.16)  -- "Card animations" gates the page cascade
		-- V4.5.34: the content rises ~14px into place with the cascade, via the host's top PADDING (rows in a UIListLayout
		-- can't be offset, and the host's Position is owned by _KR.syncStickyZone - moving it pushed content under the sticky bar)
		local padI = host:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
		if padI then
			local base = host:GetAttribute("rcRising") and host:GetAttribute("rcPadBase") or padI.PaddingTop.Offset
			host:SetAttribute("rcPadBase", base); host:SetAttribute("rcRising", true)
			padI.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, base + 14)
			tween(padI, 0.5, { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, base) }, QUINT)
			task.delay(0.52 * SPEED, function() if host.Parent and padI.PaddingTop.Offset == base then host:SetAttribute("rcRising", false) end end)
		end
	end
end
local function buildPage(id)  -- single-panel wrapper: unchanged behaviour (the one panel's pageHost + stickyBar)
	hideDropdown()  -- close any open dropdown-picker when the tab (re)builds
	buildPageInto(pageHost, stickyBar, id)
end
local function setActive(id)
	for tid, t in pairs(tabs) do tween(t.dot, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }); _KR.spring(t.iconScale, "Scale", tid == id and 1 or 0.9, 3.5, 1) end
	if _KR.movePill then _KR.movePill(id) end   -- V4.5.34: one pill slides to the active tab (replaces the per-tab dot in single-panel mode)
end
local function setHeadIcon(id)
	pIconHost:ClearAllChildren()
	local s = SECTION_BY_ID[id]
	local ic = mkIcon(s and s.icon or id, 20); ic.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); ic.Parent = pIconHost
end
-- the panel collapses onto the button, but the button is a top->dark GRADIENT, so a solid accent looks brighter
-- than the button. tabTone darkens the collapse colour to the button's average so they match on close.
local function tabTone(c) return c:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 0.16) end
local function popOpen(id, label, color, btn)
	-- V4.5.17: RESIZE the panel to the LIVE viewport BEFORE building the page. PANEL_W/H were computed ONCE at load from `vp`; a device rotation (portrait load -> landscape) then left the panel sized for the TALLER screen, so it covered ~56% of a short landscape phone ("single panel blocks the useful part"). Recompute from the CURRENT viewport (matches popOpen's existing live-width `pw` at L~4465 + fitHome's live-vp pattern). The panel RENDERS at *UISCALE, so also cap the rendered height to ~58% of the live height, keeping the avatar visible behind/above the bottom-docked panel.
	do
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera; local lv = cam and cam.ViewportSize
		local lvw2, lvh2 = (lv and lv.X) or vp.X, (lv and lv.Y) or vp.Y
		PANEL_W = math.floor(math.min(580, lvw2 - 32))
		PANEL_H = math.max(120, math.floor(math.min(328, lvh2 - 124, lvh2 * 0.58 / (UISCALE > 0 and UISCALE or 1))))
	end
	activeTab = id; activeBtn = btn; activeColor = color or T.accent; setActive(id); pTitle.Text = label or id; pDesc.Text = SECTION_DESC[id] or ""; setHeadIcon(id); _KR.headLay(); buildPage(id)
	local fp, fs = btnFootprint(btn)
	-- the panel opens to the SmartBar's width (never wider than the bar) -- it follows the bar's size.
	local lvw = (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X) or vp.X  -- LIVE viewport: the load-time vp goes stale on a desktop window resize, letting the centred panel overflow both edges
	local pw = PANEL_W; if bar.AbsoluteSize.X > 10 and (SET.barStyle or "Dock") == "Dock" then pw = math.clamp(math.floor(bar.AbsoluteSize.X / UISCALE), 300, math.max(300, lvw - 24)) end  -- V4.5.19: math.max floor on the clamp MAX - on a viewport narrower than 324px (tiny window / emulator) lvw-24 < 300, so max < min and math.clamp THREW, crashing every tab-open
	_KR._panelFullW = pw  -- remember the bar-derived full width so a drag back to the bar/top dock restores it (panelOpenRect)
	-- COLLAPSED = the button itself: its footprint, its colour, a centred logo, header hidden.
	_KR.springStop(panel, "Position", "Size")  -- V4.5.55: a re-open mid-spring (e.g. mid-close) must start from the button, not the stale spring state
	panel.Position = fp; panel.Size = fs; panel.BackgroundColor3 = tabTone(activeColor); panel.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(_KR.glass, 0.5)  -- glassy-panels: open at the chosen translucency, not forced opaque
	panelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(11 * _KR.cornerScale + 0.5)); panelStroke.Transparency = 1
	pIconHost.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5); pIconHost.Visible = true  -- the morph always starts from the icon on the button
	pTitle.TextTransparency = 1; pDesc.TextTransparency = 1; pClose.Visible = false; panel.Visible = true  -- Visible set AFTER the collapse position, so the first frame renders ON the button
	-- MORPH: the button box expands into the card, its colour bleeds to the card colour, the logo slides to the top-left.
	if SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then
		local _op, _os = panelOpenRect(pw); _KR.spring(panel, "Position", _op, 2.4, 1); _KR.spring(panel, "Size", _os, 2.4, 1); tween(panel, 0.6, { BackgroundColor3 = T.bg }, QUINT)  -- V4.5.55: the card grows out of its button on a spring (iOS app-open feel; interruptible)
		tween(panelCorner, 0.6, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(_KR.skin().panelR * _KR.cornerScale + 0.5)) }, QUINT); tween(panel, 0.6, { BackgroundTransparency = math.max(_KR.skin().panelT, _KR.glass) }, QUINT)  -- V4.5.57: the style's panel radius + see-through
		tween(panelStroke, 0.55, { Transparency = 0 })
		tween(pIconHost, 0.6, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 21) }, QUINT)
		task.delay(0.32 * SPEED, function() tween(pTitle, 0.4, { TextTransparency = 0 }); tween(pDesc, 0.4, { TextTransparency = 0 }); pClose.Visible = true; if panelOpen and _KR.panelLay() == "Sheet" then pIconHost.Visible = false end end)  -- V4.5.57: the floating sheet has no header icon
		task.delay(0.6 * SPEED, function() if panelOpen and activeTab == id then refreshFades() end end)  -- edge fades reflect the scroll (never dim the top header at rest)
	else  -- "Card animations" off → snap straight to the open state (no morph)
		local _sp, _ss = panelOpenRect(pw); panel.Position = _sp; panel.Size = _ss; panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.bg
		panelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(_KR.skin().panelR * _KR.cornerScale + 0.5)); panel.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(_KR.skin().panelT, _KR.glass); panelStroke.Transparency = 0; pIconHost.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 21)
		pTitle.TextTransparency = 0; pDesc.TextTransparency = 0; pClose.Visible = true; pIconHost.Visible = _KR.panelLay() ~= "Sheet"
		task.delay(0.05, function() if panelOpen and activeTab == id then refreshFades() end end)
	end
end
local function openTab(id, label, color, btn)
	if MP._tabSwitching then return end  -- a switch morph is mid-flight → ignore taps until it settles (else the 2nd tap re-reads the still-stale activeBtn/activeColor and snaps the panel back to a wrong button). On MP table = no new top-level local.
	if panelOpen and activeTab ~= id and SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then
		MP._tabSwitching = true
		-- V4.5.34 SWITCH (krul: snappier): the card stays open; the old content + title fade out, then the new page ...
		topFade.Visible = false; botFade.Visible = false
		tween(pTitle, 0.12, { TextTransparency = 1 }); tween(pDesc, 0.12, { TextTransparency = 1 }); cascadeOut(pageHost, 0.12)
		task.delay(0.13 * SPEED, function()
			if not panelOpen then MP._tabSwitching = false; return end  -- V4.5.68: closed during the fade: don't revive the tab on a closed panel (pill stuck on it)
			activeTab = id; activeBtn = btn; activeColor = color or T.accent; setActive(id)
			pTitle.Text = label or id; pDesc.Text = SECTION_DESC[id] or ""; setHeadIcon(id); _KR.headLay()
			buildPage(id)
			tween(pTitle, 0.3, { TextTransparency = 0 }); tween(pDesc, 0.3, { TextTransparency = 0 })
			task.delay(0.35 * SPEED, function() if panelOpen and activeTab == id then refreshFades() end end)
			MP._tabSwitching = false
		end)
		return
	end
	panelOpen = true
	popOpen(id, label, color, btn)
end
local function closePanel()
	if not panelOpen then return end
	hideDropdown()  -- dismiss any open dropdown-picker along with the panel
	if activeTab == "bundles" then UI._detectingBundle = nil end  -- V4.5.33: closing Bundles cancels an armed Delete/Copy pick (else the next tap, even much later, deletes instead of applying)
	pIconHost.Visible = true  -- V4.5.57: the sheet hid it; the collapse shrinks back onto the icon
	panelOpen = false; local fp, fs = btnFootprint(activeBtn); local col = activeColor; activeTab = nil; activeBtn = nil; setActive(nil); pClose.Visible = false; topFade.Visible = false; botFade.Visible = false
	if SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then
		-- STEP 1: the content + title fade out first, so you never see the cards/lines during the collapse.
		tween(pTitle, 0.16, { TextTransparency = 1 }); tween(pDesc, 0.16, { TextTransparency = 1 }); cascadeOut(pageHost, 0.16)
		-- STEP 2: only THEN does the emptied card morph back into its button (logo to centre, shrink + recolour).
		task.delay(0.22 * SPEED, function()
			if panelOpen then return end
			tween(pIconHost, 0.45, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) }, EXPO)
			_KR.spring(panel, "Position", fp, 2.6, 1); _KR.spring(panel, "Size", fs, 2.6, 1); tween(panel, 0.45, { BackgroundColor3 = tabTone(col) }, EXPO)  -- V4.5.55: critically damped spring, shrinks INTO the button (no undershoot); keeps velocity if it interrupts the open
			tween(panelCorner, 0.45, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(11 * _KR.cornerScale + 0.5)) }, EXPO)
			tween(panelStroke, 0.28, { Transparency = 1 })
			task.delay(0.45 * SPEED + 0.05, function() if not panelOpen then panel.Visible = false end end)
		end)
	else
		_KR.springStop(panel, "Position", "Size"); panel.Visible = false  -- "Card animations" off → just hide it (no collapse morph)
	end
end
local function onTabClick(id, label, color, btn)
	if homeOpen and closeHome then closeHome() end
	if SET.multiPanel then MP.open(id, label, color, btn)
	elseif activeTab == id and panelOpen then closePanel()
	else openTab(id, label, color, btn) end
end
pClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closePanel)
_KR.sections = SECTIONS  -- V4.5.57: the Home layouts' launcher tiles
_KR.openTabId = function(id)  -- open a tab from Home (Start menu tiles etc.): Home closes, the tab opens from its bar button
	local s = SECTION_BY_ID[id]; if not s then return end
	local t = tabs[id]
	if homeOpen and closeHome then closeHome() end
	task.delay(0.08, function() onTabClick(id, s.label, _KR.tabCol(s.color), t and t.btn) end)
end
-- WIRED (merge): cross-tab jump used by the Options detecting-bundle flow (Copy Template / Delete Bundle arm UI._detectingBundle
-- then call this to switch to the Bundles tab, where the next tile click consumes the armed action). Stashed on the UI table
-- so PAGES.options (defined earlier) can reach it without a new main-chunk local. Reads tabs/SECTION_BY_ID at call time.
if System then System.uiToast = toast end  -- V4.5.33: lets the engine raise a GUI toast (Function._warnUnattached)
UI._goBundles = function()
	local sec = SECTION_BY_ID and SECTION_BY_ID["bundles"]
	local t = tabs and tabs["bundles"]
	-- V4.5.33: multi-panel with Bundles already docked -> just repaint it (banner); onTabClick would TOGGLE it closed (and closing disarms)
	if SET.multiPanel and MP.panels and MP.panels["bundles"] then if UI._renderBundles then pcall(UI._renderBundles) end; return end
	if sec and t and t.btn then onTabClick(sec.id, sec.label, _KR.tabCol(sec.color), t.btn) end
end
-- ===== Multi-Panel Mode core (SET.multiPanel) - up to 5 lightweight docked panels around the perimeter, center clear.
-- Placed here (panel / vp / buildPageInto / mkIcon now exist); overwrites the early MP.open/closeAll stubs. =====
MP.screen = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "RoClothesMulti", ResetOnSpawn = false, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 1000, Enabled = false, Parent = PlayerGui })
GUIObject.MultiScreen = MP.screen  -- V4.5.17: creation-site stash so BREAKER.Destroying can destroy it by reference (MP is a _buildV3GUI local = invisible to the teardown closure; MP.host is a child of MP.screen so this covers it too)
MP.host = new("Frame", { Name = "MPHost", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Parent = MP.screen })  -- persistent full-screen host: every docked panel parents HERE (not MP.screen directly), so one relayout can tile them all + one descendant walk fades them
function MP.edgeStart(r, vpx)  -- the off-screen start/exit point for a panel at rect r, by which perimeter edge it's docked to (shared by the open entrance AND the Home-takeover slide). vpx optional: pass it in a loop so viewport width isn't re-read per panel.
	vpx = vpx or (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X) or 1280
	local cx = r.x + r.w / 2
	if cx < vpx * 0.34 then return r.x - (r.w + 24), r.y
	elseif cx > vpx * 0.66 then return r.x + (r.w + 24), r.y
	elseif SET.barTop then return r.x, r.y + (r.h + 24) else return r.x, r.y - (r.h + 24) end
end
function MP.setVisible(v)  -- Home takeover: slide the panels OUT to their docked edges (not a sudden disappear), then disable; on return, enable + slide them back IN
	MP._visTok = (MP._visTok or 0) + 1; local tok = MP._visTok  -- cancels an in-flight fade so a fast Home re-toggle can't mis-hide
	if not v then hideDropdown() end   -- close any OPEN docked-panel dropdown before hiding, else it ghosts back over the panels when Home closes (MP.close already does this; setVisible didn't)
	local vpx = (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X) or 1280  -- read once, passed into edgeStart so the loops below don't re-read viewport width per panel
	if v then
		MP.screen.Enabled = true
		MP.relayout(false)  -- rects current (the bar edge / viewport may have changed while Home was up); positions set synchronously, overwritten by the edge-start below before the frame renders
		if SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then
			for _, id in ipairs(MP.order) do local inst = MP.panels[id]
				if inst and inst.rect then local sx, sy = MP.edgeStart(inst.rect, vpx); _KR.springStop(inst.frame, "Position"); inst.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx, sy); _KR.spring(inst.frame, "Position", UDim2.fromOffset(inst.rect.x, inst.rect.y), 2.6, 1) end
			end
		end
	elseif SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion and #MP.order > 0 then
		for _, id in ipairs(MP.order) do local inst = MP.panels[id]
			if inst and inst.rect then local sx, sy = MP.edgeStart(inst.rect, vpx); _KR.spring(inst.frame, "Position", UDim2.fromOffset(sx, sy), 3.5, 1) end
		end
		task.delay(0.3 * SPEED, function() if MP._visTok == tok then MP.screen.Enabled = false end end)  -- disable only AFTER the slide-out; token guards a re-show landing mid-slide
	else
		MP.screen.Enabled = false
	end
end
function MP.syncTabs()  -- multi mode: light up EVERY open panel's bar button (dot + full-size icon), dim the rest. (single mode uses setActive for the ONE active tab.)
	for tid, t in pairs(tabs) do
		local on = MP.panels[tid] ~= nil
		tween(t.dot, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1 })
		_KR.spring(t.iconScale, "Scale", on and 1 or 0.9, 3.5, 1)
	end
end
function MP.retheme()  -- re-colour open multi-panels live on a theme / accent change (their chrome + content were built with the OLD T palette, so they'd otherwise stay the old colour)
	for _, id in ipairs(MP.order) do
		local inst = MP.panels[id]
		if inst and inst.frame then
			inst.frame.BackgroundColor3 = T.bg; inst.frame:SetAttribute("rcBaseT", _KR.skin().panelT); inst.frame.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(_KR.skin().panelT, _KR.glass)  -- V4.5.57 style skin
			local fc = inst.frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner"); if fc then _KR.corners[fc] = _KR.skin().panelR - 2; fc.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(inst.frame, _KR.corners[fc]) end
			local s = inst.frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"); if s then s.Color = T.line end
			pcall(_KR.mpHeadLay, inst.frame)  -- V4.5.57: header follows the panel layout
			buildPageInto(inst.host, inst.sticky, id)  -- rebuild the content in the new colours (accent controls, etc.)
		end
	end
end
_KR.mpHeadLay = function(f)  -- V4.5.57: a docked panel's header in the panel layout (Classic = icon + title; Settings page = breadcrumb over the title; Floating sheet = a thin title, no icon, no rule)
	local head = f:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame"); if not head then return end
	local ic, tl, cr, ln = head:FindFirstChild("HeadIcon"), head:FindFirstChild("HeadTitle"), head:FindFirstChild("HeadCrumb"), f:FindFirstChild("HeadLine")
	if not tl then return end
	local pl = _KR.panelLay()
	if ic then ic.Visible = pl ~= "Sheet" end
	if ln then ln.Visible = pl ~= "Sheet" end
	if cr then cr.Visible = pl == "Settings" end
	tl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5); tl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0.5, 0); tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 1, 0); tl.TextSize = 14
	pcall(function() tl.FontFace = Font.new(tl.FontFace.Family, Enum.FontWeight.Bold) end)
	if pl == "Settings" then tl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0); tl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 16); tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0, 18); tl.TextSize = 15
	elseif pl == "Sheet" then tl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 1); tl.TextSize = 18; _KR.HL.light(tl) end
	local x = head:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextButton"); if x and x:GetAttribute("rcCloseR") then _KR.closeSkin(x) end
end
function MP.make(id, label, color)  -- one docked panel: header (icon+title+X) + scroll host + sticky; content via buildPageInto
	local f = new("Frame", { Name = "MP_" .. id, BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 300), Parent = MP.host })
	pcall(_KR.addShadow, f)  -- V4.5.57 shadows
	_KR.panels[f] = true; f:SetAttribute("rcBaseT", _KR.skin().panelT); f.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(_KR.skin().panelT, _KR.glass)  -- glassy-panels: a docked panel inherits the current translucency (V4.5.57: never below its style's own)
	new("UIScale", { Scale = UISCALE, Parent = f })  -- scale the WHOLE panel like the single panel does (relayout sets a LOGICAL Size, this renders it back to the screen rect) → content density MATCHES the single panel instead of being double-shrunk to UISCALE² and not filling
	f:SetAttribute("PanelRoot", true)
	corner(f, _KR.skin().panelR - 2); stroke(f, T.line, 1)  -- V4.5.57: the style's radius
	local head = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), Parent = f }); pad(head, 12, 10, 0, 0)
	local iconHost = new("Frame", { Name = "HeadIcon", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = head })
	local sec = SECTION_BY_ID[id]; local ic = mkIcon((sec and sec.icon) or id, 20); ic.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); ic.Parent = iconHost
	lbl({ Name = "HeadTitle", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 1, 0), Text = label or id, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 14, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = head })
	lbl({ Name = "HeadCrumb", Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0, 12), Text = "RoClothes  \u{203A}  " .. (label or id), TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 10, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Visible = false, Parent = head })
	local x = UI.closeBtn(head, 24, 7, 0.2)
	new("Frame", { Name = "HeadLine", Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 40), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = T.lineSoft, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = f })
	_KR.mpHeadLay(f)
	local sticky = new("Frame", { Name = "Sticky", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 44), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = f })
	local host = new("ScrollingFrame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 44), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -44), BorderSizePixel = 0, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.line, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, Parent = f }); pad(host, 12, 8, 4, 14); vlist(host, 8)
	local function syncMPSticky() _KR.syncStickyZone(host, sticky, 44, nil) end  -- Multi-Panel: 44px header, no edge fade (shared _KR.syncStickyZone)
	sticky:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(syncMPSticky); syncMPSticky()
	x.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() MP.close(id) end)
	-- DRAG-TO-DOCK: a transparent handle over the header (minus the close X) lets you drag this panel to a
	-- different perimeter zone; on release it SNAPS to the zone under the cursor (Left / Right / centre-Top).
	local dragHit = new("TextButton", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), ZIndex = 3, Parent = head })
	do
		local dragging, K, lastZone = false, Vector2.new(0, 0), nil
		local function mpZone(cx, cy, vp) return (cy < vp.Y * 0.34 and cx > vp.X * 0.34 and cx < vp.X * 0.66) and "T" or (cx < vp.X * 0.5 and "L" or "R") end
		local function follow(io)  -- RESIZE f to the hovered slot's shape (top-left anchored), and pin the cursor to its header (horizontal centre, ~18px below top)
			local vp = (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
			local zone = mpZone(io.Position.X, io.Position.Y, vp)
			if zone ~= lastZone then  -- hovered a different zone → morph f to that slot + re-highlight
				lastZone = zone
				MP.userZone = MP.userZone or {}; MP.userZone[id] = zone
				MP.relayout(true)  -- other panels glide into the (occ+1) split; f's slot is RESERVED (skipped) into MP._dragSlot
				MP.dragGhost(MP._dragSlot)  -- outline the reserved slot (relayout's EXACT rect, so it aligns with where the panel drops)
			end
			f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(io.Position.X + K.X - f.AbsoluteSize.X / 2), math.floor(io.Position.Y + K.Y - 18))
		end
		local startM, moved = nil, false
		dragHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(io)
			if io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = true; MP._dragging = id; startM = io.Position; moved = false
				local scr = f:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui"); local inset = Vector2.new(0, 0); pcall(function() inset = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset() end)
				K = (scr and scr.IgnoreGuiInset) and inset or Vector2.new(0, 0)
				lastZone = nil  -- DRAG-SLOP: don't shrink/reflow/re-dock until the finger actually travels (a bare header tap does nothing)
			end
		end)
		local mc, me
		mc = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(io)
			if dragging and f.Parent and (io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				if not moved and startM and (io.Position - startM).Magnitude > 8 then moved = true; _KR.springStop(f, "Position"); _KR.spring(f, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(210 / UISCALE), math.floor(132 / UISCALE)), 4, 1) end  -- real drag: shrink to the proxy
				if moved then follow(io) end
			end
		end)
		me = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(io)
			if dragging and (io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				dragging = false; MP._dragging = nil; MP.dragGhost(nil)
				if not f.Parent then return end
				if moved then  -- only a real drag re-docks + reflows; a tap leaves everything in place
					local vp = (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
					MP.userZone = MP.userZone or {}; MP.userZone[id] = mpZone(io.Position.X, io.Position.Y, vp)
					MP.relayout(true)
				end
			end
		end)
		f.Destroying:Connect(function() pcall(function() mc:Disconnect() end) pcall(function() me:Disconnect() end) if MP.userZone then MP.userZone[id] = nil end if MP._dragging == id then MP._dragging = nil; MP.dragGhost(nil) end end)  -- destroyed mid-drag (InputEnded is disconnected first): clear the stuck drag state + hide the ghost, else MP.set skips this id forever + the outline lingers
	end
	buildPageInto(host, sticky, id)
	MP.panels[id] = { id = id, frame = f, host = host, sticky = sticky }
	return MP.panels[id]
end
function MP.set(id, x, y, w, h, animate)  -- move/resize one panel's frame to a screen-px rect
	local inst = MP.panels[id]; if not inst then return end
	if id == MP._dragging then return end  -- an active drag owns this panel's Position; don't fight it
	inst.rect = { x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h }  -- SCREEN px (MP.open's entrance slides the newcomer in screen px)
	local pos, size = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(w / UISCALE), math.floor(h / UISCALE))  -- Position = screen px (not affected by the frame's own UIScale); Size = LOGICAL so the frame's UIScale renders it back to w×h screen
	if animate and SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then _KR.spring(inst.frame, "Position", pos, 2.6, 1); _KR.spring(inst.frame, "Size", size, 2.6, 1)  -- V4.5.55 macOS: Mission-Control glide (interruptible, no bounce)
	else _KR.springStop(inst.frame, "Position", "Size"); inst.frame.Position = pos; inst.frame.Size = size end
end
function MP.relayout(animate, instantId)  -- adaptive perimeter: place every open panel around the L/R/top edges. instantId SNAPS that one panel (its own entrance animates it in) while the rest glide.
	-- TUNING NOTE (user, 2026-07-07): only the EXTREME centre must stay clear (so the avatar shows). The centre strip is
	-- pinned to the SmartBar's width + centred on it; the side columns run full-height on the edges, just OUTSIDE that strip.
	local n = #MP.order; if n == 0 then return end
	MP._dragSlot = nil  -- during a drag this gets set to the dragged panel's RESERVED slot rect (below) so the drag preview + ghost use relayout's EXACT geometry
	MP.zones = MP.zones or { { "R" }, { "L", "R" }, { "L", "R", "R" }, { "L", "L", "R", "R" }, { "L", "L", "R", "R", "T" } }  -- perimeter layout per open-panel count; built ONCE (was a fresh literal every relayout). Centre strip (T) only at 5.
	local vp = (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1280, 720)  -- LIVE viewport (the load-time upvalue goes stale on window resize) - same pattern as fitHome/fitSettings
	local margin, gap = 12, 10
	-- V4.5.17: MPHost sits in a ScreenGui whose coord space is inset-SHIFTED on mobile (device safe area) -> MPHost.AbsolutePosition.X is negative, so raw-viewport x placements render off the left edge (the left column bled ~47px off-screen; the whole 2x2 grid looked shifted left with dead space on the right). Offset every HORIZONTAL placement by the host's own left inset so the grid centers on the VISIBLE screen. It is 0 on desktop / edge-to-edge (AbsolutePosition.X == 0), so this is a no-op there. (Vertical already self-corrects: topMargin uses GUI_INSET.Y, which equals the host's top inset.)
	local insetX = math.max(0, math.floor(-((MP.host and MP.host.AbsolutePosition.X) or 0) + 0.5))
	local topMargin = math.max(margin, GUI_INSET.Y + gap)  -- start BELOW the Roblox topbar (coreui: menu/chat/etc.); reuse the boot-cached inset instead of a GetGuiInset() service call every resize tick
	local minCenter = 140  -- the EXTREME centre stays clear (avatar shows through) when no centre strip is shown
	local hasTop = n >= 5  -- a centre (top/bottom) strip appears ONLY at 5 panels now (desktop); mobile caps at 4 → L/R columns only, no strip
	if MP.userZone then for _, _id in ipairs(MP.order) do if MP.userZone[_id] == "T" then hasTop = true; break end end end  -- ...OR when a panel was dragged to the centre-top
	local barW = (bar and bar.AbsoluteSize.X > 10 and (SET.barStyle or "Dock") == "Dock") and bar.AbsoluteSize.X or (vp.X * 0.42)  -- V4.5.57: Taskbar spans the screen / Minimal is a thin column -> use the default strip width
	local center, bHalf = vp.X / 2, barW / 2
	local sideW
	if hasTop then
		sideW = math.floor(center - bHalf - margin - gap)  -- FILL right up to the bar-width centre strip (no awkward empty gap beside it); only the strip-wide centre stays clear for the avatar
	else
		sideW = math.min(math.clamp(math.floor(vp.X * 0.32), 300, 460), math.floor((vp.X - 2 * margin - minCenter) / 2))  -- no strip: moderate columns, keep the extreme centre clear
	end
	sideW = math.max(160, sideW)
	local topH = math.clamp(math.floor(vp.Y * 0.33), 230, 350)   -- top-centre strip height (taller per user 2026-07-11: 0.24/185-270 -> 0.27/205-300 was too subtle -> now 0.33/230-350). Tune this one line.
	local barClear = BAR_Y + math.ceil(BAR_H * UISCALE * (SET.barSize or 1)) + gap + _KR.topInset() + ((SET.barStyle ~= "Minimal") and math.floor(18 * UISCALE) or 0)  -- V4.5.57: + the collapse chevron above the bar; x barSize so docked side columns reserve the right room past a Small/Large bar (+ the top Taskbar's inset)
	local zones = MP.zones[n]  -- centre strip (T) ONLY at 5 panels (desktop); mobile caps at 4 → everything on the L/R sides
	local left, right, top = {}, {}, nil
	for i, id in ipairs(MP.order) do local z = (MP.userZone and MP.userZone[id]) or zones[i] or "R"; if z == "T" then if not top then top = id else right[#right + 1] = id end elseif z == "L" then left[#left + 1] = id else right[#right + 1] = id end end  -- userZone (drag-to-dock) wins over the auto per-count layout
	-- the SmartBar is CENTRE-aligned, so a side column (far L/R edge) only reserves the bar's edge WHERE they overlap in X.
	local barL, barR = center - bHalf, center + bHalf  -- the bar's real X span (V4.5.57: Dock side Left/Right moves it off-centre)
	if (SET.barStyle or "Dock") == "Dock" and bar and bar.AbsoluteSize.X > 10 then barL = bar.AbsolutePosition.X + insetX; barR = barL + bar.AbsoluteSize.X end
	local leftHit = (margin + sideW) > barL             -- does the left column overlap the bar in X?
	local rightHit = (vp.X - margin - sideW) < barR     -- ...the right column?
	local colShiftL = 0  -- V4.5.57: Minimal's icon column sits on the left edge -> the left column starts past it
	if SET.barStyle == "Taskbar" then leftHit, rightHit = true, true  -- the strip spans the whole bottom/top edge
	elseif SET.barStyle == "Minimal" then leftHit, rightHit = false, false; colShiftL = _KR.colW() + 14 end
	local stripY = SET.barTop and (vp.Y - margin - topH) or topMargin
	local function sideRange(hit)  -- vertical [top, bottom] for a side column; TOP always clears the Roblox topbar (topMargin); reserves the bar's own edge only where they overlap in X
		if SET.barTop then return (hit and barClear or topMargin), (vp.Y - margin) else return topMargin, (vp.Y - (hit and barClear or margin)) end
	end
	local function placeCol(ids, cx, hit, minTop)
		local c = #ids; if c == 0 then return end
		local cTop, cBot = sideRange(hit); if minTop and minTop > cTop then cTop = minTop end; local span = cBot - cTop; local h = math.floor((span - gap * (c - 1)) / c)
		for i, id in ipairs(ids) do
			local y = math.floor(cTop + (i - 1) * (h + gap))
			if id == MP._dragging then MP._dragSlot = { x = math.floor(cx), y = y, w = sideW, h = h }  -- reserve, don't place: the dragged panel follows the cursor
			else MP.set(id, math.floor(cx), y, sideW, h, animate and id ~= instantId) end
		end
	end
	do local fullW = sideW; sideW = math.max(160, sideW - colShiftL); placeCol(left, insetX + margin + colShiftL, leftHit); sideW = fullW end  -- V4.5.57: Minimal's left column is NARROWED by the icon column it starts past (shifting it at full width slid it under the centre strip)
	placeCol(right, insetX + vp.X - margin - sideW, rightHit)  -- (no clock reserve: Minimal's corner clock only shows on Home, where the docked panels are hidden - reading its Visible here raced the style switch and dropped the right column 66px)
	if top then local tw = math.min(barW, vp.X - 2 * margin)
		if top == MP._dragging then MP._dragSlot = { x = math.floor(insetX + center - tw / 2), y = stripY, w = math.floor(tw), h = topH }
		else MP.set(top, math.floor(insetX + center - tw / 2), stripY, math.floor(tw), topH, animate and top ~= instantId) end
	end  -- centre strip = SmartBar width, centred on the bar (aligned with it)
end
function MP.dragGhost(slot)  -- DRAG-TO-DOCK preview: outline the ONE slot the dragged panel will land in (relayout reserves it in MP._dragSlot). The other panels reflow live via relayout, so this slot sits empty + visible and its rect matches relayout EXACTLY.
	if not MP._ghost then
		MP._ghost = new("Frame", { Name = "DragGhost", BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.82, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 0, Parent = MP.host })
		corner(MP._ghost, 14); local s = stroke(MP._ghost, T.accent, 2); s.Transparency = 0
	end
	if not slot then MP._ghost.Visible = false; return end
	MP._ghost.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(slot.x, slot.y); MP._ghost.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(slot.w, slot.h); MP._ghost.Visible = true
end
function MP.open(id, label, color, btn)
	if MP.panels[id] then MP.close(id); return end  -- already open → tapping its bar button CLOSES it (toggle) - consistent with single-panel mode (tap the active tab to close). Docked panels never overlap, so a front-most "focus" was moot.
	-- MOBILE caps at 4 panels, DESKTOP at 5 (the 5th is the centre strip, which only fits a big screen). V4.5.17: the old gate was TouchEnabled+AccelerometerEnabled, but the Studio device emulator (and some phones) report AccelerometerEnabled=FALSE while KeyboardEnabled/MouseEnabled stay TRUE (the PC's persist through emulation) -> a phone wrongly got cap 5. Robust gate: touch AND (accelerometer OR a phone-small viewport, min side <= 550px). A real PC (no touch) always keeps 5; a touch PC keeps 5 unless its window is phone-tiny.
	local cap = 5; pcall(function()
		local vpS = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		local smallScreen = vpS ~= nil and math.min(vpS.X, vpS.Y) <= 550
		if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and (UserInputService.AccelerometerEnabled or smallScreen) then cap = 4 end
	end)
	if #MP.order >= cap then toast("Multi-Panel", cap .. " panels open - close one first.", "warn"); return end
	-- V4.5.33: MP.screen is created disabled and was only ever enabled by closeHome -> setVisible(true), so with ...
	if not homeOpen and not MP.screen.Enabled then MP._visTok = (MP._visTok or 0) + 1; MP.screen.Enabled = true end
	MP.order[#MP.order + 1] = id
	local inst = MP.make(id, label, color)
	MP.relayout(true, id)  -- existing panels GLIDE to their new slots; the newcomer SNAPS to its slot (instantId) so the entrance below isn't fought by a relayout tween
	MP.syncTabs()          -- light up this tab's bar button (its panel is now open)
	local r = inst.rect
	if SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion and r then
		-- entrance: slide IN from the docked edge (directional - matches where it lands) + a soft scale, while the content cascades in
		local sx, sy = MP.edgeStart(r)
		_KR.springStop(inst.frame, "Position"); inst.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx, sy)
		_KR.spring(inst.frame, "Position", UDim2.fromOffset(r.x, r.y), 2.6, 1)  -- V4.5.55 macOS: slides in from its docked edge, no bounce
	end
end
function MP.close(id)
	local inst = MP.panels[id]; if not inst then return end
	if dropLayer.Parent == inst.frame then hideDropdown() end  -- ONLY if the shared picker is homed in THIS panel: re-home it before we destroy the frame. If it belongs to another still-open panel, leave it alone (don't dismiss someone else's dropdown).
	MP.panels[id] = nil
	if id == "bundles" then UI._detectingBundle = nil end  -- V4.5.33: same as closePanel - closing Bundles cancels an armed Delete/Copy pick
	for i, v in ipairs(MP.order) do if v == id then table.remove(MP.order, i); break end end
	MP.syncTabs()  -- dim this tab's bar button (its panel is gone)
	if SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then   -- V4.5.34: slide back out to the docked edge + fade (mirror of MP.open's entrance)
		local r = inst.rect
		if r then local sx, sy = MP.edgeStart(r); _KR.spring(inst.frame, "Position", UDim2.fromOffset(sx, sy), 3, 1) end
		cascadeOut(inst.frame, 0.26); tween(inst.frame, 0.28, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
		task.delay(0.34 * SPEED, function() pcall(function() inst.frame:Destroy() end) end)
	else inst.frame:Destroy() end
	MP.relayout(true)
end
function MP.closeAll() for _, id in ipairs({ table.unpack(MP.order) }) do MP.close(id) end end
if workspace.CurrentCamera then  -- window resize (desktop/windowed) → re-tile the docked panels to the new viewport. Mobile viewports don't resize, so this is a no-op there.
	MP.vpConn = workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function() if MP.screen.Enabled and #MP.order > 0 then MP.relayout(false) end end)  -- captured so destroyUI can disconnect (was stacking on re-run)
end

-- V4.5.55 macOS Dock magnification: while the MOUSE moves over the SmartBar, each tab icon scales by its distance to the
-- cursor (gaussian falloff ~1.6 buttons wide, peak x1.42: a 20px icon grows to ~28px inside its 40px unclipped button).
-- Icon-only (iconScale), so no button box / bar width ever changes. Touch never sends MouseMovement -> phones unaffected.
-- X only: `screen` is IgnoreGuiInset, and the topbar inset only shifts Y, so io.Position.X and AbsolutePosition.X agree.
_KR.dockMag = function(mx)
	if mx == nil and not _KR._dockOn then return end  -- nothing magnified -> leave the icons (and any intro deal-in) alone
	_KR._dockOn = mx ~= nil
	for _, t in pairs(tabs) do
		if t.rest and t.btn.Visible and t.icon.Visible then
			local m = 1
			if mx then local w = math.max(1, t.btn.AbsoluteSize.X); local d = (mx - (t.btn.AbsolutePosition.X + w / 2)) / (w * 1.6); m = 1 + ((SET.dockMagAmt or 142) / 100 - 1) * math.exp(-d * d) end  -- peak = Settings > SmartBar > Magnification %
			_KR.spring(t.iconScale, "Scale", t.rest() * m, 5, 1)
		end
	end
end
_KR.dockMove = function(io)
	if io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and SET.dockMag ~= false and (SET.barStyle or "Dock") == "Dock" and SET.hoverFx and not SET.reduceMotion and bar.Visible then _KR.dockMag(io.Position.X) end
end
bar.InputChanged:Connect(function(io) _KR.dockMove(io) end)
bar.MouseLeave:Connect(function() _KR.dockMag(nil) end)  -- any leave resets; if the mouse is still over the bar the next move re-magnifies (no counter to get stuck)
local function makeTab(sec, order)
	local col = sec.color
	local b = new("TextButton", { Name = "Tab_" .. sec.id, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = bar })
	corner(b, 11); new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(col, col:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.32)), Parent = b })
	local hoverFill = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = IC, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = b }); corner(hoverFill, 11)
	local sheen = stroke(b, IC, 1, 1)
	local hoverGlow = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), BackgroundColor3 = IC, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = b }); corner(hoverGlow, 15)   -- V4.5.34: soft hover glow behind the icon
	local ic = mkIcon(sec.icon or sec.id, 20); ic.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); ic.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5); ic.Parent = b
	local iconScale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 0.9, Parent = ic })
	local lb = lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = sec.label or sec.id, Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = IC, TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Visible = false, Parent = b })  -- "Labels" bar mode shows this INSTEAD of the icon (A.applyBarLabels toggles visibility + re-widths the button)
	local dot = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -7), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), BackgroundColor3 = IC, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = b }); corner(dot, 3)
	tabs[sec.id] = { btn = b, dot = dot, iconScale = iconScale, icon = ic, label = lb, col = col }  -- col: A.applyStyle restores the tile colour when leaving Minimal
	-- hover: edge sheen + a subtle fill only. No lift, no scale pop - the icon stays put (user asked for no push-up).
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if _KR.tipShow then _KR.tipShow(b, sec.label or sec.id) end
		tween(sheen, 0.25, { Transparency = 0.25 })
		tween(hoverFill, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.82 })
		if SET.hoverFx and not SET.reduceMotion then hoverGlow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18); tween(hoverGlow, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.78, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32) }) end
	end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if _KR.tipHide then _KR.tipHide() end
		tween(sheen, 0.25, { Transparency = 1 })
		tween(hoverFill, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
		tween(hoverGlow, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	end)
	local function iconRest() return ((SET.multiPanel and MP.panels[sec.id] ~= nil) or (not SET.multiPanel and activeTab == sec.id)) and 1 or 0.9 end  -- the size setActive/syncTabs would give it
	tabs[sec.id].rest = iconRest  -- for Dock magnification (assigned AFTER iconRest exists)
	b.InputChanged:Connect(function(io) _KR.dockMove(io) end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() _KR.dockMag(nil) end)
	_KR.press(b)  -- V4.5.55 macOS Dock: the whole tab darkens on press (overlay child; b's box never changes - movePill/btnFootprint read it)
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() onTabClick(sec.id, sec.label, col, b) end)  -- opens immediately (no 0.1s pop-yield); setActive/syncTabs spring the icon to its new rest size
	return b
end
for i, sec in ipairs(SECTIONS) do makeTab(sec, 2 + i) end  -- all 11 tabs, one bar button each
-- V4.5.34: the sliding ACTIVE-TAB PILL. Lives on `screen` (above the bar, outside its clip) and is placed from the
-- active button's on-screen box; follows the bar when it moves/resizes; hides when the tab isn't visible.
_KR.tabPill = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 20, Parent = screen }); corner(_KR.tabPill, 2)
new("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(T.accent, T.accent2), Parent = _KR.tabPill })
_KR.tabPillGlow = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1, 14, 0, 10), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 19, Parent = _KR.tabPill }); corner(_KR.tabPillGlow, 5)
new("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }), Parent = _KR.tabPillGlow })
_KR.movePill = function(id, instant)
	local p = _KR.tabPill; if not (p and p.Parent) then return end
	_KR.pillId = id
	local t = id and tabs[id]
	local function hide() tween(p, 0.2, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }); tween(_KR.tabPillGlow, 0.2, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end
	if not t or SET.multiPanel then hide(); return end
	local b = t.btn; local ap, asz = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
	local bp, bs = bar.AbsolutePosition, bar.AbsoluteSize
	if asz.X <= 0 or ap.X + asz.X / 2 < bp.X or ap.X + asz.X / 2 > bp.X + bs.X or ap.Y + asz.Y / 2 < bp.Y or ap.Y + asz.Y / 2 > bp.Y + bs.Y then hide(); return end   -- clipped away (bar compressed); V4.5.57: Y too (Minimal column)
	local pos = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(ap.X + asz.X / 2 + GUI_INSET.X), math.floor(ap.Y + asz.Y - 6 * UISCALE + GUI_INSET.Y))
	p.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(asz.X * 0.55), math.max(3, math.floor(4 * UISCALE)))   -- bigger so it reads at a glance
	if SET.barStyle == "Minimal" then  -- V4.5.57: a short vertical accent bar just left of the round button (sidebar-style), not an underline cutting into the circle
		pos = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(ap.X - 7 * UISCALE + GUI_INSET.X), math.floor(ap.Y + asz.Y / 2 + GUI_INSET.Y))
		p.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(3, math.floor(3 * UISCALE)), math.floor(asz.Y * 0.5))
	end
	if instant or p.BackgroundTransparency > 0.95 or not (SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion) then p.Position = pos
	else tween(p, 0.38, { Position = pos }, QUINT) end
	tween(p, 0.2, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }); tween(_KR.tabPillGlow, 0.25, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.55 })
end
for _, sig in ipairs({ "AbsolutePosition", "AbsoluteSize" }) do
	bar:GetPropertyChangedSignal(sig):Connect(function() if _KR.pillId then _KR.movePill(_KR.pillId, true) end end)
end

-- profile avatar on the bar ("my picture"), leftmost via LayoutOrder 0
local avatar = new("ImageButton", { Name = "Avatar", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false, Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. LocalPlayer.UserId .. "&w=48&h=48", LayoutOrder = 0, Parent = bar })
corner(avatar, 19); local avs = stroke(avatar, T.line, 1)
if not SET.barAvatar then useKrulIcon(avatar) end  -- Krul favicon is the DEFAULT bar icon; the "Show my avatar" setting keeps the rbxthumb headshot instead
avatar.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(avs, 0.25, { Color = T.accent }); _KR.tipShow(avatar, "Home") end)
avatar.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(avs, 0.25, { Color = T.line }); _KR.tipHide() end)
-- FULL-SCREEN HOME (dim + game blur, floating cards on the left). The favicon opens it.
-- base MUST be white: a UIGradient MULTIPLIES the BackgroundColor3, so a dark base multiplies the gradient to
-- black (that was the "stuck on black" bug). White base -> the gradient shows its true vampiric colours.
local homeView = new("Frame", { Name = "HomeView", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, Parent = homeScreen })
-- Backdrop kept NEUTRAL GREY (the cards carry the colour, not the background).
local homeBg = new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new({ ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 48)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 30)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(33, 33, 39)) }), Parent = homeView })
-- V4.5.57 wallpaper: an image behind Home / Settings / News (it lives in homeView, so it only shows there; never over gameplay)
_KR.wall = new("ImageLabel", { Name = "Wallpaper", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ImageTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 0, Parent = homeView })
_KR.wallDim = new("Frame", { Name = "Dim", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 0, Parent = _KR.wall })
_KR.wallCache = {}  -- link -> custom asset, so a reload (dim slider, settings rebuild) never re-downloads + re-registers the image (that blanked it = flashing)
_KR.wallDimApply = function()  -- opacity + dim, live (sliders call this; no reload). Dim scales with opacity so a see-through wallpaper doesn't darken the game too
	local on = _KR.wall.Image ~= ""
	local op = math.clamp((SET.wallOpacity or 100) / 100, 0, 1)
	_KR.wall.ImageTransparency = on and (1 - op) or 1
	_KR.wallDim.BackgroundTransparency = on and (1 - math.clamp((SET.wallDim or 45) / 100, 0, 0.8) * op) or 1
end
_KR.loadWall = function()
	local src = tostring(SET.wallpaper or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	local W = _KR.wall
	local function off(msg) SET.wallpaper = ""; _KR._wallSrc = nil; W.ImageTransparency = 1; W.Image = ""; _KR.wallDimApply(); if msg then pcall(toast, "Wallpaper", msg, "warn") end end
	local function show(img) if W.Image ~= img then W.Image = img end; W.ImageTransparency = 0; _KR._wallSrc = src; _KR.wallDimApply() end
	if src == "" then return off() end
	if src == _KR._wallSrc and W.Image ~= "" then return show(W.Image) end  -- same wallpaper: nothing to reload
	local id = src:match("^(%d+)$") or src:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or src:match("[?&]id=(%d+)")
	if id then return show("rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. id .. "&w=768&h=432") end  -- a thumbnail works for Image AND Decal ids
	if not src:match("^https?://") then return off("Paste an image ID or an image link.") end
	if _KR.wallCache[src] then return show(_KR.wallCache[src]) end
	local gca = getcustomasset or getsynasset
	if not (gca and writefile) then return off("Image links need an executor that supports custom images. Use an image ID instead.") end
	if _KR._wallBusy == src then return end  -- this link is already downloading
	_KR._wallBusy = src
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(src) end)
		if _KR._wallBusy == src then _KR._wallBusy = nil end
		if SET.wallpaper ~= src then return end  -- replaced while downloading
		if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" or #body < 8 then return off("That link didn't load.") end
		local png, jpg = body:sub(1, 8) == string.char(137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10), body:sub(1, 3) == string.char(255, 216, 255)  -- PNG / JPEG signatures
		if not (png or jpg) then return off("That link isn't a PNG or JPG image.") end
		local h = #body; for i = 1, #body, math.max(1, math.floor(#body / 4096)) do h = (h * 31 + string.byte(body, i)) % 2147483647 end  -- a content fingerprint: a different image never reuses a cached file name (the engine caches custom assets by path)
		local path = "RClothesContent/wallpaper/" .. tostring(h) .. (png and ".png" or ".jpg")
		local ok2, asset = pcall(function() if makefolder and not (isfolder and isfolder("RClothesContent/wallpaper")) then makefolder("RClothesContent/wallpaper") end; writefile(path, body); return gca(path) end)
		if not ok2 or not asset then return off("Couldn't save the image on this executor.") end
		_KR.wallCache[src] = asset
		if SET.wallpaper == src then show(asset) end
	end)
end
-- BACKGROUND AMBIENT (SET.ambient): a gentle sway of the backdrop gradient while Home is on screen. Manual sine (not a
-- tween) so toggling it off snaps back to 90 with no lingering tween to fight; reads SET.ambient live -> the Motion
-- toggle takes effect instantly, no rebuild. reduceMotion also stills it.
task.spawn(function()
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while homeView.Parent do
		if homeView.Visible and SET.ambient and not SET.reduceMotion then
			homeBg.Rotation = 90 + math.sin((os.clock() - t0) * 0.35) * 8
			task.wait()
		else
			if homeBg.Rotation ~= 90 then homeBg.Rotation = 90 end
			task.wait(0.4)
		end
	end
end)
-- Home is designed at a FIXED width (2 columns) and the whole canvas scales to the device via a UIScale,
-- so mobile gets the EXACT same layout as desktop, just smaller. The scroll frame matches the scaled canvas width.
local HOME_W = 960
-- Home does NOT scroll: it FITS the screen. A plain frame holds the fixed-width canvas; fitHome() scales it to fit.
local homeScroll = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 44), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(HOME_W * UISCALE), 300), BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = false, Parent = homeView })
local homeCanvas = new("Frame", { Name = "Canvas", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(HOME_W, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = homeScroll }); vlist(homeCanvas, 12)
local homeCanvasScale = new("UIScale", { Scale = UISCALE, Parent = homeCanvas })
-- scale the fixed 900px-wide canvas so its FULL width + height fit the viewport (no scroll, adapts to any screen).
local function fitHome()
	task.wait()  -- let any pending AutomaticSize.Y settle so we read the true content height
	do local last = -1; for _ = 1, 6 do local hh = homeCanvas.AbsoluteSize.Y; if math.abs(hh - last) < 0.5 then break end; last = hh; task.wait() end end  -- V4.5.57: nested auto-size (grids in auto frames) can take a few frames
	local cur = homeCanvasScale.Scale
	local ch = homeCanvas.AbsoluteSize.Y / (cur > 0 and cur or 1)  -- LOGICAL height (AbsoluteSize is post-scale). Measured at the CURRENT scale, NOT by flashing to scale 1 -- on mobile that flash briefly rendered the full-width (960px) parked dashboard back on-screen behind Settings, because the parked off-screen offset (~viewport width) is LESS than the full canvas width. This was the bar-size "Home layers below Settings" bleed.
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera; local vps = cam and cam.ViewportSize  -- read ViewportSize ONCE (a Vector2) instead of marshaling it twice for .X and .Y
	local vw = (vps and vps.X) or vp.X
	local vh = (vps and vps.Y) or vp.Y
	-- V4.5.17: PHONE-ONLY Home enlargement. On a small (phone) viewport, trim the top/side margins + the bar gap so the tall dashboard fills more of the short screen; DESKTOP keeps its original roomier reserves untouched. OVERFLOW-PROOF by construction: topBase == topM and the position floor is <= topM, so when Home fills availH its bottom lands EXACTLY at (vh - barSpace) and can never pass the SmartBar. (The earlier all-screens attempt overflowed because topBase 20 fell BELOW the 36px floor, shoving Home down into the bar.) Gate on viewport size (min side <= 550px), which cleanly excludes desktop (min side ~730+).
	local isPhone = math.min(vw, vh) <= 550
	local barPad, topM, sideM, floorY = 30, 44, 48, 36  -- desktop reserves (identical to the original)
	if isPhone then barPad, topM, sideM, floorY = 20, 14, 22, 10 end  -- phone: tighter margins -> Home renders larger, still clears the bar by barPad(20)px
	if SET.barStyle == "Minimal" then sideM = sideM + 2 * (_KR.colW() + 14) end  -- V4.5.57: keep the centred Home clear of the left icon column
	local barSpace = BAR_Y + math.floor(BAR_H * UISCALE * (SET.barSize or 1)) + barPad  -- x barSize so Home reserves room below a larger/smaller bar; barPad is ALSO the guaranteed gap above the bar
	if SET.barStyle ~= "Minimal" then barSpace = barSpace + math.floor(18 * UISCALE) end  -- V4.5.57: + the collapse chevron that sits just above the bar (it overlapped Home's bottom banner)
	local HL = _KR.HOMES[_KR.homeLay()] or _KR.HOMES.Dashboard  -- V4.5.57 Home layouts
	local HW = _KR.homeWidth(_KR.homeLay())
	if HL.place ~= "center" then  -- Start menu (corner) / Widgets (left) / Glance (right): pinned to an edge, the game stays visible beside it
		local mn = SET.barStyle == "Minimal"
		local edgeL = 14 + (mn and (_KR.colW() + 14) or 0)
		local botC = (not mn and not SET.barTop) and (barSpace - barPad + 14) or (isPhone and 10 or 18)  -- just above the bar + its chevron
		local topC = (not mn and SET.barTop) and (barSpace - barPad + 10 + _KR.topInset()) or topM
		topC = math.max(topC, GUI_INSET.Y + (isPhone and 4 or 10))  -- never under Roblox's top bar (menu / chat buttons)
		local aW, aH = vw - edgeL - 14, vh - topC - botC
		local s = math.max(0.3, math.min(aW / HW, (ch > 0) and (aH / ch) or 1, HL.cap))
		homeCanvasScale.Scale = s
		local sw, sh = HW * s, ch * s
		homeScroll.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.ceil(sw), math.ceil(sh))
		local ox = (homeView.AbsoluteSize.X - vw) / 2  -- the inset-widened screen (mobile) is wider than the viewport
		local x = (HL.place == "right") and (ox + vw - 14 - sw) or (ox + edgeL)
		local y
		if HL.place == "corner" then y = (SET.barTop and not mn) and topC or (vh - botC - sh) else y = topC + (aH - sh) / 2 end
		homeScroll.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(x), math.floor(math.max(floorY, y)))
		return
	end
	if HL ~= _KR.HOMES.Dashboard then sideM = sideM + (isPhone and 80 or 0); topM = math.max(topM, GUI_INSET.Y + 4) end  -- V4.5.57 Typographic: its type runs edge to edge, so on a phone give it real margins and keep it under Roblox's top bar
	local availW, availH = vw - sideM, vh - barSpace - topM
	-- cap 1.3 (not 1.0): let Home ENLARGE to fill a big screen instead of sitting tiny + centered; still scales DOWN to fit small screens.
	local fit = math.min(availW / HW, (ch > 0) and (availH / ch) or 1, HL.cap)
	local s = math.max(0.3, fit)  -- pure fit-to-screen (the old "UI scale %" multiplier was replaced by UI transparency)
	homeCanvasScale.Scale = s
	local sw, sh = HW * s, ch * s
	homeScroll.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.ceil(sw), math.ceil(sh))
	local topBase = SET.barTop and (barSpace + 8 + _KR.topInset()) or topM  -- when the SmartBar is on top, push the dashboard below it; else = the top margin (== topM, so Home's bottom is exactly vh-barSpace and the barPad gap above the bar is guaranteed)
	-- V4.5.17: center on homeView's OWN width, not the raw viewport. On mobile the ScreenGui's coordinate space is inset-widened (device safe-area), so homeView is WIDER than the viewport and shifted left; centering by raw vw then left-biased the dashboard by half the inset (~47px on an S25U). homeView.AbsoluteSize.X == vw on desktop/edge-to-edge, so this is a no-op there.
	homeScroll.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor((homeView.AbsoluteSize.X - sw) / 2), math.max(floorY, math.floor(topBase + (availH - sh) / 2)))
end
local A = {}  -- UI-settings apply namespace: the many small apply fns live as table fields, which keeps them off Luau's 200-local main-chunk limit
_KR.A = A  -- V4.5.57: the Home layouts (built above this point) read A.clockText / A._newsImg through _KR
-- ── Home side panels: left = UI Settings, right = News & Announcements (slide in from the edges) ──────────
local resetSides, placeSideButtons, goTo  -- forward
-- a titled sub-card inside a side view (controls / content go straight into it).
-- Shrink a side view (via a UIScale) so its FULL height fits the viewport - the settings content can be tall.
local function fitSide(panel)
	task.spawn(function()
		local sc = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or new("UIScale", { Parent = panel })
		sc.Scale = 1; task.wait()  -- measure at natural size
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera; local vps = cam and cam.ViewportSize  -- read ViewportSize ONCE (a Vector2) instead of marshaling it twice for .X and .Y
		local vw = (vps and vps.X) or vp.X
		local vh = (vps and vps.Y) or vp.Y
		local w, h = panel.AbsoluteSize.X, panel.AbsoluteSize.Y
		local mn = SET.barStyle == "Minimal"  -- V4.5.57: reserve the bar (+ its chevron) top AND bottom (the view is centred), or Minimal's column on both sides - the News list ran into the Taskbar strip
		local barZone = mn and 40 or (BAR_Y + math.floor(BAR_H * UISCALE * (SET.barSize or 1)) + 16 + math.floor(18 * UISCALE) + _KR.topInset())
		local sideZone = mn and 2 * (_KR.colW() + 14) or 0
		sc.Scale = (w > 0 and h > 0) and math.max(0.4, math.min((vw - 40 - sideZone) / w, (vh - math.max(80, barZone * 2)) / h, 1)) or 1  -- scale-to-fit BOTH axes on the LIVE viewport (was height-only + stale vp, so News stayed too big on mobile)
	end)
end
-- ── UI Settings: floating cards on the LEFT, a live PREVIEW pane on the RIGHT (no big wrapper container) ──────
-- Sized with MARGINS (not full-screen), centred. LEFT = every card in a 2-col grid (all visible, NO scroll);
-- RIGHT = the preview, shown directly (no sandbox box).
-- Settings is a FIXED-size canvas scaled to fit the screen - EXACTLY like Home. The whole UI (cards + preview) shrinks
-- to fit any device: no reflow, no scroll, no fragile content measurement (which is what kept clipping on mobile).
local SET_W, SET_H = 1180, 640  -- V4.5.55: fixed size (one category on screen at a time) - no longer grows to the tallest column
local settingsPanel = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, vp.X + 40, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SET_W, SET_H), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 8, Parent = homeView })
local settingsScale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = settingsPanel })
settingsPanel:SetAttribute("PanelRoot", true); settingsPanel:SetAttribute("rcPickerW", 420); settingsPanel:SetAttribute("rcNoCards", true)  -- V4.5.57: a dropdown in UI Settings opens its picker HERE (with no root it went into the hidden tab panel, so tapping Home layout / Panel layout showed nothing)
local function fitSettings()  -- pure viewport math on the FIXED panel size - reliable, no visibility/layout dependency
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera; local vps = cam and cam.ViewportSize  -- read ViewportSize ONCE (a Vector2) instead of marshaling it twice for .X and .Y
	local vw = (vps and vps.X) or vp.X
	local vh = (vps and vps.Y) or vp.Y
	local barZone = BAR_Y + math.floor(BAR_H * UISCALE) + 16  -- SmartBar footprint (gap-from-edge + scaled height + clearance). The panel is centred, so reserve it 2x to clear the bar whether docked Bottom OR Top. V4.5.16: tall (now-labelled) settings content was touching the bar.
	local sideZone = (SET.barStyle == "Minimal") and 2 * (_KR.colW() + 14) or 0  -- Minimal's column sits on the left edge
	-- V4.5.57: sized from the SCREEN only (+ 2 x 70px for the side nav buttons). It used to be capped by the Home button's spot, which follows the HOME LAYOUT's width -> Settings came out ~15% smaller in Taskbar / Minimal (krul: "too small to even see")
	settingsScale.Scale = math.max(0.3, math.min((vw - 40 - 140 - sideZone) / SET_W, (vh - math.max(96, barZone * 2)) / settingsPanel.Size.Y.Offset, 1))  -- setMaxScale: keep clear of the Home nav button (placeSideButtons)  -- fit the panel's ACTUAL height (fillSettings grows it to the tallest column, floored at SET_H) so tall content never overflows on mobile
end
fitSettings()
pcall(function() MP.setVpConn = workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fitSettings) end)
do

end

_KR.miniBox = function(sc, p) p.BorderSizePixel = 0; p.ZIndex = p.ZIndex or 12; p.Parent = p.Parent or sc; return new("Frame", p) end
_KR.miniTxt = function(sc, p) p.BackgroundTransparency = 1; p.ZIndex = p.ZIndex or 13; p.Parent = p.Parent or sc; p.Font = p.Font or FONTB; p.TextColor3 = p.TextColor3 or Color3.new(1, 1, 1); p.TextScaled = true; return new("TextLabel", p) end
-- V4.5.57 picture-card specs for the Home / Panel layout pickers. "Auto" names what it resolves to in the current bar style.
_KR.layoutRich = function(kind)
	local st = SET.barStyle or "Dock"
	local names = (kind == "home") and _KR.HOME_NAMES or _KR.PANEL_NAMES
	local function labelOf(id) for _, p in ipairs(names) do if p[1] == id then return p[2] end end; return id end
	local auto, D
	if kind == "home" then
		auto = (st == "Taskbar" and "Start") or (st == "Minimal" and "Type") or "Dashboard"
		D = { Dashboard = "Everything at a glance: centred cards over a dimmed game.", Start = "A compact corner card. The game stays visible.", Widgets = "Tiles down the left side. The game stays visible.", Type = "Big type over the blurred game. Calm and minimal.", Glance = "A slim column on the right. The game stays visible." }
	else
		auto = (st == "Taskbar" and "Settings") or (st == "Minimal" and "Sheet") or "Classic"
		D = { Classic = "Cards in a grid. The original look.", Settings = "A Windows-style list: icon, title, description, control.", Sheet = "A floating list with quiet text tabs." }
	end
	local items = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(names) do
		local id, label = p[1], p[2]
		local real = (id == "Auto") and auto or id
		items[label] = {
			name = (id == "Auto") and ("Auto \u{00B7} " .. labelOf(real)) or label,
			desc = (id == "Auto") and "Follows your bar style." or D[id],
			sketch = function(f) if _KR.miniScene then local sc = _KR.miniScene(f, {}); if kind == "home" then _KR.miniHome(sc, real) else _KR.miniPanel(sc, real) end end end,
		}
	end
	return { items = items }
end
