	elseif lay == "Type" then
		tx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(edgeL + 0.06, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.36, 0.26), Text = A.clockText(), Font = FONT, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left })
		bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(edgeL + 0.06, 0.44), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.035), BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2 })
		for i = 1, 4 do bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(edgeL + 0.06 + (i - 1) * 0.085, 0.54), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.055, 0.06), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) }) end
		for i = 1, 3 do bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(edgeL + 0.06 + (i - 1) * 0.095, 0.67), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.075, 0.025), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent }) end
		local h = bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.17), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(194, 85, 127) }); corner(h, 3)
		bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.51), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.035), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
		bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.58), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.02), BackgroundColor3 = T.txt3 })
	elseif lay == "Glance" then
		local m = bx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.97, 0.05), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.27, botY - 0.08), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.22 }); corner(m, 5)
		tx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.04), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.12), Text = A.clockText(), Font = FONT, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = m })
		for i = 1, 5 do bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.24 + i * 0.07), Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.7, Parent = m }) end
		local c = bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.7), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.12), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(194, 85, 127):Lerp(T.bg, 0.55), Parent = m }); corner(c, 3)
		for i = 1, 3 do bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1 + (i - 1) * 0.28, 0.86), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.24, 0.07), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.85, Parent = m }) end
	end
end
_KR.miniPanel = function(sc, pl)
	local function bx(p) return _KR.miniBox(sc, p) end
	local function tx(p) return _KR.miniTxt(sc, p) end
	local st = SET.barStyle or "Dock"
	local f
	if st == "Minimal" then f = bx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.52, 0.76) })
	elseif st == "Taskbar" then f = bx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.82), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.52, 0.7) })
	else f = bx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.82), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.56, 0.7) }) end
	f.BackgroundColor3 = T.bg; corner(f, (pl == "Settings" and 3) or (pl == "Sheet" and 8) or 5)
	local acc = (SECTION_BY_ID and SECTION_BY_ID.body and SECTION_BY_ID.body.color) or T.accent
	local function rowsAt(y0, n, cells, step)
		for r = 1, n do
			local y = y0 + (r - 1) * step
			if cells then local c = bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, y), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, step - 0.025), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, Parent = f }); corner(c, pl == "Settings" and 1 or 3)
				local tg = bx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.95, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.13, 0.42), BackgroundColor3 = (r % 2 == 1) and T.accent or T.bg, ZIndex = 13, Parent = c }); corner(tg, 6)
				bx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 0.18), BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2, ZIndex = 13, Parent = c })
			else bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.07, y + step * 0.45), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.34, 0.025), BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2, Parent = f })
				bx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.93, y + step * 0.45), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.14, 0.025), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, Parent = f })
				bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.07, y + step - 0.004), Size = UDim2.new(0.86, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.82, Parent = f }) end
		end
	end
	if pl == "Classic" then
		local ic = bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.05), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.1), BackgroundColor3 = acc, Parent = f }); corner(ic, 2)
		tx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.13, 0.04), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.08), Text = "Body", TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = f })
		bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.13, 0.13), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.025), BackgroundColor3 = T.txt3, Parent = f })
		rowsAt(0.24, 5, true, 0.145)
	elseif pl == "Settings" then
		tx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.03), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.05), Text = "RoClothes \u{203A} Body", Font = FONT, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = f })
		tx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.09), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.1), Text = "Body", TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = f })
		for i = 1, 4 do bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05 + (i - 1) * 0.16, 0.24), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.025), BackgroundColor3 = (i == 1) and T.txt or T.txt3, Parent = f }) end
		bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.285), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.018), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, Parent = f })
		rowsAt(0.34, 4, true, 0.15)
	else
		tx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.07, 0.04), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.13), Text = "Body", Font = FONT, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = f })
		tx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.05), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.09), Text = "\u{00D7}", Font = FONT, TextColor3 = T.txt2, Parent = f })
		for i = 1, 4 do bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.07 + (i - 1) * 0.17, 0.22), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.025), BackgroundColor3 = (i == 1) and T.txt or T.txt3, Parent = f }) end
		bx({ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.07, 0.262), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.012), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, Parent = f })
		rowsAt(0.3, 5, false, 0.13)
	end
end

local function miniToggle(parent, on, pos)
	local t = new("Frame", { Position = pos, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 22), BackgroundColor3 = on and T.accent or T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = parent }); corner(t, 11); if not on then stroke(t, T.line, 1) end
	local k = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = on and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), BackgroundColor3 = on and T.txt or T.txt2, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = t }); corner(k, 8)
end
local function renderPreviewVisual(key, stage)
	pad(stage, 6, 6, 6, 4)
	-- sub(i,n,label,hot): one framed mini-screen in a row of n, labelled underneath; hot = accent-highlighted (the current choice)
	local function sub(i, n, label, hot)  -- one mini-screen STACKED top-to-bottom (n rows), labelled under each. No card bg; the CURRENT choice is marked by the accent label only.
		local f = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, (i - 1) / n, 4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1 / n, -24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 9, Parent = stage })
		lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, i / n, -3), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15), Text = label, Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = hot and T.accent or T.txt3, TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 9, Parent = stage })
		return f
	end
	local function onoff(build) local cur = SET[key]; build(sub(1, 2, "On", cur == true), true); build(sub(2, 2, "Off", cur == false), false) end  -- two side-by-side On / Off examples, current one highlighted
	-- mini REAL-UI components (so previews look 1-to-1, just minified): the SmartBar pill (icon squares) + a real card.
	local function miniBar(parent, w)
		local bar = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w or 122, 26), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = parent }); corner(bar, 13); stroke(bar, T.line, 1)
		local row = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 9, Parent = bar }); new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Parent = row })
		local cols = { T.accent, Color3.fromRGB(124, 92, 214), Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 180), Color3.fromRGB(216, 177, 90), Color3.fromRGB(58, 209, 122), T.accent2 }
		for i = 1, 6 do local ic = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), BackgroundColor3 = cols[((i - 1) % #cols) + 1], BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row }); corner(ic, 5) end
		return bar
	end
	local function miniCard(parent, w, hgt)
		local c = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, hgt), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = parent }); corner(c, 8); stroke(c, T.lineSoft, 1)
		new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 40, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48), Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30)), Parent = c })
		return c
	end
	-- V4.5.57 STYLE-AWARE MINI SCREEN for the previews: the game (sky, floor, the avatar), the bar drawn in the CURRENT style
	-- (or o.style) with its real options, and optionally an open panel / multi-panels / a notification. Drawn from primitives
	-- (the old realBar CLONED the live bar - a full-width Taskbar clone ran right out of the preview pane). o = {style, top,
	-- side, labels, size, clock, clockText, collapsed, panel, mp, toast, mag, magAmt}; every field defaults to the live setting.
	local function scene(parent, o)
		o = o or {}
		local st = o.style or SET.barStyle or "Dock"
		local top = SET.barTop == true; if o.top ~= nil then top = o.top end; if st == "Minimal" then top = false end
		local side = o.side or SET.barSide or "Center"
		local labels = SET.barLabels == true; if o.labels ~= nil then labels = o.labels end
		local sz = o.size or SET.barSize or 1
		local clockOn = SET.clockShow ~= false; if o.clock ~= nil then clockOn = o.clock end
		local ctext = o.clockText or A.clockText()
		local k = (_KR.SKINS[st] or _KR.SKINS.Dock)
		local sc = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(104, 164, 214), BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 9, Parent = parent }); corner(sc, 8)
		new("UIAspectRatioConstraint", { AspectRatio = 16 / 9, Parent = sc })
		new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.52), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.48), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(137, 141, 149), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = sc })
		local fig = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.8), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.07, 0.36), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 9, Parent = sc })
		for _, pr in ipairs({ { 0.3, 0, 0.4, 0.22, Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 48) }, { 0.1, 0.24, 0.8, 0.38, Color3.fromRGB(13, 105, 172) }, { 0.12, 0.63, 0.36, 0.37, Color3.fromRGB(164, 189, 71) }, { 0.52, 0.63, 0.36, 0.37, Color3.fromRGB(164, 189, 71) } }) do
			new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromScale(pr[1], pr[2]), Size = UDim2.fromScale(pr[3], pr[4]), BackgroundColor3 = pr[5], BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = fig })
		end
		local function bx(p) p.BorderSizePixel = 0; p.ZIndex = p.ZIndex or 10; p.Parent = p.Parent or sc; return new("Frame", p) end
		local function txt(p) p.BackgroundTransparency = 1; p.ZIndex = p.ZIndex or 11; p.Parent = p.Parent or sc; p.Font = p.Font or FONTB; p.TextColor3 = p.TextColor3 or Color3.new(1, 1, 1); return new("TextLabel", p) end
		local items = {}
		for _, s in ipairs(SECTIONS) do local hid = type(SET.hiddenTabs) == "table" and SET.hiddenTabs[s.id]; if s.id == "player" or not hid then items[#items + 1] = s end end
		local u = math.max(4, math.floor(7 * sz + 0.5))
		local av = SET.barAvatar and Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 48) or T.accent
		local ay = top and 0 or 1
		local colW = 0
		if o.collapsed then  -- the bar folded into its little pill
			local px = bx({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 7), BackgroundColor3 = T.card })
			corner(px, 4)
			if st == "Minimal" then px.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5); px.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0)
			elseif st == "Taskbar" then px.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, ay); px.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, ay, top and 4 or -4)
			else px.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, ay); px.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, ay, top and 4 or -4) end
			return sc
		end
		if st == "Taskbar" then
			local strip = bx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, ay), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, ay), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, u + 8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 10, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 })
			local row = bx({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = strip }); new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Padding = UDim.new(0, 3), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = row })
			local a = bx({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(u, u), BackgroundColor3 = av, Parent = row }); corner(a, 40)
			for i, s in ipairs(items) do local w = labels and math.floor(u * 2.4) or u; local t = bx({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, labels and math.max(2, math.floor(u * 0.4)) or u), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = row }); corner(t, 2) end
			if clockOn then txt({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, u + 4), Text = ctext, TextSize = math.max(7, u), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = strip }) end
		elseif st == "Minimal" then
			local col = bx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, BackgroundTransparency = 1 }); new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 3), HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = col })
			local a = bx({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(u, u), BackgroundColor3 = av, Parent = col }); corner(a, 40)
			for i, s in ipairs(items) do local w = labels and math.floor(u * 2.4) or u; local t = bx({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, u), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 22), BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = col }); corner(t, 40) end
			colW = labels and math.floor(u * 2.4) or u
			-- (no clock during play: Minimal's clock lives on the Home page)
		else
			local ax, pxS, pxO = 0.5, 0.5, 0
			if side == "Left" then ax, pxS, pxO = 0, 0, 4 elseif side == "Right" then ax, pxS, pxO = 1, 1, -4 end
			local b = bx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.new(pxS, pxO, ay, top and 4 or -4), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, u + 6), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundColor3 = T.bg }); corner(b, 4); pad(b, 3, 3, 0, 0)
			new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = b })
			local a = bx({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(u, u), BackgroundColor3 = av, LayoutOrder = -1, Parent = b }); corner(a, 40)
			if clockOn then txt({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(u * 3.4), u), Text = ctext, TextSize = math.max(6, u - 1), LayoutOrder = 0, Parent = b }) end
			local mid = math.ceil(#items / 2)
			local mg = (o.magAmt or SET.dockMagAmt or 142) / 100
			for i, s in ipairs(items) do
				local m = 1
				if o.mag and i == mid then m = mg elseif o.mag and math.abs(i - mid) == 1 then m = 1 + (mg - 1) * 0.45 end
				local hgt = math.floor(u * m + 0.5)
				local t = bx({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(labels and math.floor(u * 2.4) or hgt, hgt), BackgroundColor3 = _KR.tabCol(s.color), LayoutOrder = i + 1, Parent = b }); corner(t, 2)
			end
			if o.mag then b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.floor(u * mg + 0.5) + 6) end
		end
		local function panelRect(p, z)  -- a little panel in this style: its corner + a few cell rows
			z = z or 12
			p.BackgroundColor3 = T.bg; p.ZIndex = z
			local f = bx(p); corner(f, math.max(2, math.floor(k.panelR / 4)))
			local inner = bx({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 5), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -10), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z + 1, Parent = f }); new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, k.div and 4 or 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = inner })
			for r = 1, 4 do
				if k.div then bx({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.78, LayoutOrder = r, ZIndex = z + 1, Parent = inner })
				else local c = bx({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.2, 0), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, LayoutOrder = r, ZIndex = z + 1, Parent = inner }); corner(c, math.max(1, math.floor(k.rowR / 4))) end
			end
			return f
		end
		local edgeL = (st == "Minimal") and (colW + 9) or 4
		local barGap = (st ~= "Minimal") and (u + 12) or 4
		if o.mp then  -- multi-panels docked around the edges (the centre stays clear for the avatar)
			local topOff = (top and st ~= "Minimal") and barGap or 4
			local botOff = (not top and st ~= "Minimal") and barGap or 4
			panelRect({ Position = UDim2.new(0, edgeL, 0, topOff), Size = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 1, -(topOff + botOff)) })
			local rTop = topOff
			panelRect({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, rTop), Size = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0.5, -(rTop + botOff) / 2 - 2) })
			panelRect({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -botOff), Size = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0.5, -(rTop + botOff) / 2 - 2) })
		elseif o.panel then
			if st == "Minimal" then panelRect({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, edgeL, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.55) })
			elseif st == "Taskbar" then panelRect({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, ay), Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, ay, top and barGap or -barGap), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.5) })
			else panelRect({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, ay), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, ay, top and barGap or -barGap), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.46) }) end
		end
		if o.toast then  -- a notification in the chosen corner, stepping around the style's clock / column / strip like the real one
			local tl, tb = o.toast:find("left") ~= nil, o.toast:find("Bottom") ~= nil
			local x = tl and edgeL or -4
			local y
			if tb then y = -((st == "Taskbar" and not top) and barGap or 4) else y = 4 end
			local c = bx({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(tl and 0 or 1, tb and 1 or 0), Position = UDim2.new(tl and 0 or 1, x, tb and 1 or 0, y), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.16), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, ZIndex = 13 }); corner(c, math.max(2, math.floor(k.cardR / 4)))
			local d = bx({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), BackgroundColor3 = T.good, ZIndex = 14, Parent = c }); corner(d, 2)
			bx({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 13, 0, 5), Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ZIndex = 14, Parent = c })
			bx({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 13, 0, 11), Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = T.txt3, ZIndex = 14, Parent = c })
		end
		return sc
	end

LocalPlayer.UserId .. "&w=100&h=100") or "", ZIndex = 9, Parent = sub(i, 2, opt, hot) }); corner(chip, 24); stroke(chip, hot and T.accent or T.line, hot and 1.6 or 1)
			if not isAv then useKrulIcon(chip) end
		end
	elseif key == "bar" then  -- V4.5.57: both edges in the CURRENT style, with a panel open (shows where panels land)
		pickRows({ "Bottom", "Top" }, SET.barTop and 2 or 1, function(p, op) scene(p, { top = (op == "Top"), panel = true }) end)
	elseif key == "barStyle" then
		pickRows({ "Dock", "Taskbar", "Minimal" }, (SET.barStyle == "Taskbar" and 2) or (SET.barStyle == "Minimal" and 3) or 1, function(p, op) scene(p, { style = op, panel = true }) end)
	elseif key == "homeLayout" then  -- V4.5.57: every Home layout over the game in the CURRENT bar style, 2 per row
		local cur = _KR.homeLay()
		for i, op in ipairs({ "Dashboard", "Start", "Widgets", "Type", "Glance" }) do
			local cx, cy = (i - 1) % 2, math.floor((i - 1) / 2)
			local q = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(cx * 0.5, 4, cy / 3, 4), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -8, 1 / 3, -24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 9, Parent = stage })
			lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(cx * 0.5 + 0.25, 0, (cy + 1) / 3, -4), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 14), Text = (op == "Type" and "Typographic") or (op == "Start" and "Start menu") or op, Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = (op == cur) and T.accent or T.txt3, TextSize = 10.5, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 9, Parent = stage })
			_KR.miniHome(scene(q, {}), op)
		end
	elseif key == "panelLayout" then  -- V4.5.57: the three panel layouts, each open over the game in the current bar style
		local pl = _KR.panelLay()
		pickRows({ "Classic", "Settings page", "Floating sheet" }, (pl == "Settings" and 2) or (pl == "Sheet" and 3) or 1, function(p, op) _KR.miniPanel(scene(p, {}), (op == "Settings page" and "Settings") or (op == "Floating sheet" and "Sheet") or "Classic") end)
	elseif key == "barSide" then
		pickRows({ "Left", "Center", "Right" }, (SET.barSide == "Left" and 1) or (SET.barSide == "Right" and 3) or 2, function(p, op) scene(p, { style = "Dock", side = op }) end)
	elseif key == "clockShow" then
		pickRows({ "Shown", "Hidden" }, (SET.clockShow ~= false) and 1 or 2, function(p, op) scene(p, { clock = (op == "Shown") }) end)
	elseif key == "clock24" then
		pickRows({ "24h", "12h" }, SET.clock24 and 1 or 2, function(p, op) scene(p, { clock = true, clockText = (op == "24h") and "15:45" or "3:45 PM" }) end)
	elseif key == "barLabels" then
		pickRows({ "Icons", "Labels" }, SET.barLabels and 2 or 1, function(p, op) scene(p, { labels = (op == "Labels") }) end)
	elseif key == "barSize" then
		pickRows({ "Small", "Default", "Large" }, ((SET.barSize or 1) < 1 and 1) or ((SET.barSize or 1) > 1 and 3) or 2, function(p, op) scene(p, { size = ({ Small = 0.85, Default = 1, Large = 1.2 })[op] }) end)
	elseif key == "autoHide" then
		pickRows({ "Always shown", "Folds after 4s idle" }, SET.autoHide and 2 or 1, function(p, op, i) scene(p, { collapsed = (i == 2) }) end)
	elseif key == "multiPanel" then
		pickRows({ "One panel", "Multi-Panel" }, SET.multiPanel and 2 or 1, function(p, op, i) scene(p, { panel = (i == 1), mp = (i == 2) }) end)
	elseif key == "dockMag" or key == "dockMagAmt" then
		pickRows({ "Mouse over the Dock", "Resting" }, 1, function(p, op, i) scene(p, { style = "Dock", mag = (i == 1) }) end)
	elseif key == "toastPos" then
		local ps = { "Top-right", "Top-left", "Bottom-right", "Bottom-left" }
		local ci = 1; for i2, v in ipairs(ps) do if v == (SET.toastPos or "Top-right") then ci = i2 end end
		pickRows(ps, ci, function(p, op) scene(p, { toast = op }) end)
	elseif key == "notify" or key == "toastTime" then
		pickRows({ "On", "Off" }, (SET.notify == false) and 2 or 1, function(p, op, i) scene(p, { toast = (i == 1) and (SET.toastPos or "Top-right") or nil }) end)
	elseif key == "tabs" then  -- the bar as it is now (hidden tabs left out) + which are hidden
		local hid = {}
		for _, s2 in ipairs(SECTIONS) do if type(SET.hiddenTabs) == "table" and SET.hiddenTabs[s2.id] then hid[#hid + 1] = s2.label end end
		scene(sub(1, 1, (#hid == 0) and "All tabs shown" or ("Hidden: " .. table.concat(hid, ", ")), #hid == 0), {})
	elseif key == "mode" or key == "contrast" or key == "panelTint" or key == "accentGrad" or key == "accentAnim" or key == "tabColours" or key == "tabIntensity"
		or key == "textScale" or key == "uiFont" or key == "blurAmt" or key == "wallpaper" or key == "wallOpacity" or key == "wallDim" or key == "shadows" or key == "corner" or key == "glass" then
		-- V4.5.57 previews for the Appearance options (krul: "some of the previews are quite useless" - they fell back to the bare value).
		-- Each shows a mini panel over the game, drawn with the option's REAL effect (the palette is derived with the option swapped in).
		local function palWith(over)
			local keys, keep = { "mode", "contrast", "panelTint", "accentGrad" }, {}
			for _, k in ipairs(keys) do keep[k] = SET[k]; if over[k] ~= nil then SET[k] = over[k] end end
			local ok, p = pcall(_KR.palette)
			for _, k in ipairs(keys) do SET[k] = keep[k] end
			return ok and p or T
		end
		local function fixT(l, size) l.TextSize = size; l:SetAttribute("rcNoTS", true) end  -- exact sizes (the live text-size pass must not rescale a preview)
		local function sample(parent, p, o)
			o = o or {}
			local rad = o.radius or 8
			if o.shadow then
				new("ImageLabel", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, o.shadow[2]), Size = UDim2.new(0.62, o.shadow[1], 0.74, o.shadow[1]), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = _KR.SHADOW_IMG, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice, SliceCenter = _KR.SHADOW_SLICE, ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), ImageTransparency = o.shadow[3], ZIndex = 11, Parent = parent })
			end
			local f = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.74), BackgroundColor3 = p.bg, BackgroundTransparency = o.glass or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 12, Parent = parent })
			new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, rad), Parent = f })
			local ts = o.ts or 1
			local function t(txt, par, x, y, col, size, bold, right)
				local l = new("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y), Size = UDim2.new(1, -x - 6, 0, math.ceil(size * ts) + 2), Text = txt, TextColor3 = col, Font = bold and FONTB or FONT, TextXAlignment = right and Enum.TextXAlignment.Right or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 14, Parent = par })
				fixT(l, size * ts)
				if o.font then l.FontFace = Font.fromName(o.font, bold and Enum.FontWeight.Bold or Enum.FontWeight.Medium) end
				return l
			end
			local function grad(fr) local a2 = (o.flat and p.accent) or p.accent2; new("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(a2, p.accent), Parent = fr }); fr.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
			t("Body", f, 8, 5, p.txt, 11, true)
			local r1 = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 22), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 18), BackgroundColor3 = p.card, BackgroundTransparency = o.glass and math.max(0, o.glass - 0.1) or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 13, Parent = f }); new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(rad * 0.6)), Parent = r1 })
			t("Jiggle physics", r1, 6, 2, p.txt2, 9)
			local tg = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 11), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 14, Parent = r1 }); new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0), Parent = tg }); grad(tg)
			local r2 = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 44), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 18), BackgroundColor3 = p.card, BackgroundTransparency = o.glass and math.max(0, o.glass - 0.1) or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 13, Parent = f }); new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(rad * 0.6)), Parent = r2 })
			local tr = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, -1), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = p.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 14, Parent = r2 })
			local fl = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 15, Parent = tr }); grad(fl)
			local bt = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 18), BackgroundColor3 = p.accentD, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 13, Parent = f }); new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(rad * 0.6)), Parent = bt })
			if not o.flat then new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 25, Color = ColorSequence.new(p.accent, ((SET.accentGrad or "Off") ~= "Off" or o.gradOn) and p.accent2 or p.accentD), Parent = bt }); bt.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
			local bl = t("Apply", bt, 0, 3, p.txt, 9, true); bl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center; bl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
			return f
		end
		local function closest(list, v) local bi, bd = 1, math.huge; for i, x in ipairs(list) do local d = math.abs(x - (v or 0)); if d < bd then bi, bd = i, d end end; return bi end
		if key == "mode" then
			pickRows({ "Dark", "Light" }, (SET.mode == "Light") and 2 or 1, function(p, op) sample(scene(p, {}), palWith({ mode = op })) end)
		elseif key == "contrast" then
			pickRows({ "Standard", "High" }, (SET.contrast == "High") and 2 or 1, function(p, op) sample(scene(p, {}), palWith({ contrast = op })) end)
		elseif key == "panelTint" then
			local vals = { 0, 20, 40 }
			pickRows({ "None", "20%", "40%" }, closest(vals, SET.panelTint), function(p, op, i) sample(scene(p, {}), palWith({ panelTint = vals[i] })) end)
		elseif key == "accentGrad" then
			pickRows({ "Off", "Subtle", "Bold" }, (SET.accentGrad == "Bold" and 3) or (SET.accentGrad == "Subtle" and 2) or 1, function(p, op) sample(scene(p, {}), palWith({ accentGrad = op }), { gradOn = op ~= "Off" }) end)
		elseif key == "accentAnim" then
			local f = sub(1, 1, ((SET.accentAnim or "Off") == "Off") and "Off: the accent stays put" or ("The accent travels through these (" .. SET.accentAnim .. ")"), (SET.accentAnim or "Off") ~= "Off")
			local row = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 9, Parent = f })
			new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), Parent = row })
			local base = (_KR.palette and _KR.palette().accent) or T.accent
			for i = 0, 8 do local d = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), BackgroundColor3 = _KR.hueShift(base, i * 40), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row }); new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0), Parent = d }) end
		elseif key == "tabColours" or key == "tabIntensity" then
			local opts, set
			if key == "tabColours" then opts, set = { "Colourful", "Accent", "Mono" }, function(i) SET.tabColours = opts[i] end
			else opts, set = { "40%", "100%", "150%" }, function(i) SET.tabColours = "Colourful"; SET.tabIntensity = ({ 40, 100, 150 })[i] end end
			local cur = (key == "tabColours") and ((SET.tabColours == "Mono" and 3) or (SET.tabColours == "Accent" and 2) or 1) or closest({ 40, 100, 150 }, SET.tabIntensity)
			local keepC, keepI = SET.tabColours, SET.tabIntensity
			for i, op in ipairs(opts) do
				set(i)
				local f = sub(i, #opts, op, i == cur)
				local row = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 9, Parent = f })
				new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), Parent = row })
				for j, s2 in ipairs(SECTIONS) do local d = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), BackgroundColor3 = _KR.tabCol(s2.color), BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = j, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row }); new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7), Parent = d }) end
			end
			SET.tabColours, SET.tabIntensity = keepC, keepI
		elseif key == "textScale" then
			local vals = { 90, 100, 110, 120 }
			pickRows({ "90%", "100%", "110%", "120%" }, closest(vals, SET.textScale), function(p, op, i) sample(scene(p, {}), T, { ts = vals[i] / 100 }) end)
		elseif key == "uiFont" then
			local f = sub(1, 1, SET.uiFont or "Gotham", true)
			sample(scene(f, {}), T, { font = (_KR.FAMS and _KR.FAMS[SET.uiFont or "Gotham"]) or "GothamSSm", ts = 1.15 })
		elseif key == "blurAmt" then  -- a GUI can't blur the game; a frosted layer of matching strength stands in
			local vals = { 0, 50, 100 }
			pickRows({ "Off", "Medium", "Strong" }, closest(vals, SET.blurAmt), function(p, op, i)
				local sc = scene(p, {})
				new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215), BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (vals[i] / 100) * 0.55, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11, Parent = sc })
			end)
		elseif key == "wallpaper" or key == "wallOpacity" or key == "wallDim" then
			local has = _KR.wall and _KR.wall.Image ~= ""
			local f = sub(1, 1, has and ("Opacity " .. (SET.wallOpacity or 100) .. "%  ·  Dim " .. (SET.wallDim or 45) .. "%") or "No wallpaper set: paste an image ID or link", has)
			local sc = scene(f, {})
			if has then
				local op = math.clamp((SET.wallOpacity or 100) / 100, 0, 1)
				local w = new("ImageLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = _KR.wall.Image, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ImageTransparency = 1 - op, ZIndex = 11, Parent = sc })
				new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp((SET.wallDim or 45) / 100, 0, 0.8) * op, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11, Parent = w })
			end
			sample(sc, T)
		elseif key == "shadows" then
			local specs = { false, { 18, 3, 0.55 }, { 30, 6, 0.35 } }
			pickRows({ "Off", "Soft", "Deep" }, (SET.shadows == "Deep" and 3) or (SET.shadows == "Soft" and 2) or 1, function(p, op, i) sample(scene(p, {}), T, { shadow = specs[i] or nil }) end)
		elseif key == "corner" then
			local vals = { 0, 100, 200 }
			pickRows({ "Square", "Default", "Round" }, closest(vals, SET.corner), function(p, op, i) sample(scene(p, {}), T, { radius = math.floor(8 * vals[i] / 100) }) end)
		elseif key == "glass" then
			local vals = { 0, 35, 70 }
			pickRows({ "Solid", "35%", "70%" }, closest(vals, SET.glass), function(p, op, i) sample(scene(p, {}), T, { glass = vals[i] / 100 }) end)
		end
	else
		local val = SET[key]
		local txt = (type(val) == "boolean") and (val and "ON" or "OFF") or tostring(val)
		lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44), Text = txt, Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = ((type(val) == "boolean") and val) and T.accent or T.txt, TextSize = 34, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 9, Parent = stage })
	end
end
local function renderPreview(key, label)
	if _KR._prevKey == key and _KR._prevLabel == label then return end  -- key alone isn't unique (Accent swatch + Custom-colours row both use "accent") - compare label too, else the heading stays stale
	_KR._prevKey = key; _KR._prevLabel = label
	for _, c in ipairs(previewBody:GetChildren()) do if not c:IsA("UIPadding") then c:Destroy() end end
	lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), Text = label or key, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 18, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 8, Parent = previewBody })
	local dl = lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 27), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = PREV_DESC[key] or "", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 12.5, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 8, Parent = previewBody })
	local stage = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -70), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 8, Parent = previewBody })
	do  -- V4.5.57: the stage starts below the description's REAL height (a fixed 36px box cut long descriptions off after 3 lines)
		local function fitStage() local k = math.max(settingsScale.Scale, 0.05); local h = 27 + math.ceil(dl.AbsoluteSize.Y / k) + 8; stage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -math.max(70, h)) end
		dl:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitStage); task.defer(fitStage)
	end  -- transparent: the demo shows directly, no sandbox box
	pcall(renderPreviewVisual, key, stage)
	if SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then local sc = new("UIScale", { Scale = 0.97, Parent = stage }); tween(sc, 0.3, { Scale = 1 }, BACK) end  -- gentle materialise on each preview swap (GC'd with the stage on the next render)
end
local function refreshPreview() if _KR.saveCfg then _KR.saveCfg() end; if _KR._prevKey then local k, l = _KR._prevKey, _KR._prevLabel; _KR._prevKey = nil; renderPreview(k, l) end end  -- auto-save the config (debounced) + re-render the CURRENT preview so its demo reflects a live SET change. refreshPreview is called after EVERY settings change (A.apply ends with it; the preview-only toggles call it directly), so it's the one save chokepoint.
local function clearPreview() for _, c in ipairs(previewBody:GetChildren()) do if not c:IsA("UIPadding") then c:Destroy() end end; _KR._prevKey = nil end  -- tears down the preview so its animation loops stop (called when the menu closes)
-- ── News & Announcements - master-detail (left headline list ↔ right inline reader pane), backend-driven ─────
local newsPanel, renderNews  -- forward: newsPanel drives the carousel, renderNews is called by the live fetch (Phase B)
;(function()  -- V4.5.57: News lives in its OWN function (was a do-block): the builder is at Luau's 200-local ceiling and the executor compiler counts do-block locals toward it ("Out of local registers ... ind")
	local PW, PH = 1040, 700  -- FIXED design size (like Settings' SET_W/SET_H); fitSide scales-to-fit both axes, so it shrinks to the device instead of adapting-then-staying-big
	newsPanel = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, vp.X + 40, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PW, PH), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 8, Parent = homeView })
	local hd = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), ZIndex = 8, Parent = newsPanel })
	local hdT = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = "News & Announcements", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 22, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 8, Parent = hd })
	local hdS = lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 25), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15), Text = "Latest from KrulHub - pick a story on the left.", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 8, Parent = hd })  -- ZIndex 8: above the Settings-page card (7)
	-- MASTER-DETAIL layout: left = a compact scrollable headline list, right = the selected story read inline (no full-screen overlay).
	local list = new("ScrollingFrame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 58), Size = UDim2.new(0.34, -10, 1, -58), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollBarThickness = 4, ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.line, ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.5, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, ZIndex = 8, Parent = newsPanel }); vlist(list, 7); pad(list, 1, 8, 2, 8)
	local nDiv = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0.34, 0, 0, 64), Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -78), BackgroundColor3 = T.line, BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8, Parent = newsPanel })  -- divider between list + detail
	-- V4.5.57 News per panel layout (krul approved the demo): Classic = this two-pane reader; Settings page = a Windows 11 page
	-- (card behind it, breadcrumb + title, category pivot, thumbnail cards, a reading card); Floating sheet = editorial (a plain
	-- headline index + a large light headline, no boxes). _KR.newsStyle re-lays the view; rows + the reader read the style live.
	local nBg = new("Frame", { Name = "NewsCard", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-22, -18), Size = UDim2.new(1, 44, 1, 36), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 7, Parent = newsPanel }); corner(nBg, 8)
	local nRead = new("Frame", { Name = "ReadCard", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 7, Parent = newsPanel }); corner(nRead, 8)
	local nPivot = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 50), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 8, Parent = newsPanel })
	local _newsCat = "All"
	local detail = new("ScrollingFrame", { Position = UDim2.new(0.34, 16, 0, 56), Size = UDim2.new(0.66, -16, 1, -56), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, ScrollBarThickness = 5, ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.line, ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.4, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, ZIndex = 8, Parent = newsPanel }); vlist(detail, 11); pad(detail, 2, 12, 2, 14)
	-- CANVAS driven MANUALLY (not AutomaticCanvasSize): with the panel's fitSide UIScale above it, AutomaticCanvasSize left
	-- dead scroll space at the bottom on mobile. AbsoluteContentSize is POST-scale → ÷ the effective ancestor scale, + the
	-- detail's own top/bottom padding (2+14). The do-block scopes both locals so they never touch the 200-local budget.
	do
		local dl = detail:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
		local function syncCanvas()
			local k = 1; local o = detail; while o and o.Parent do local s = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); if s then k = k * s.Scale end; o = o.Parent end
			detail.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, math.ceil(dl.AbsoluteContentSize.Y / math.max(k, 0.01)) + 16)
		end
		dl:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(syncCanvas); syncCanvas()
	end
	local NEWS = {
		-- V4.5.57: shown until the live news lands (and kept if it never does) - was four made-up June posts with a random picsum image
		{ title = "Loading news...", date = "", cat = "Community", new = false, body = "No news yet." },
	}
	local NEWS_CAT = { Update = Color3.fromRGB(96, 150, 240), Event = Color3.fromRGB(233, 74, 128), Community = Color3.fromRGB(72, 200, 130), Guide = Color3.fromRGB(214, 174, 88) }
	local function catCol(c) local r = NEWS_CAT[c] or T.accent; if _KR.light() then r = r:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.38) end; return r end  -- V4.5.57: darker on light
	local function loadNewsImage(parent, url)  -- proxy the external image via /chat/img, write to disk, getcustomasset, overlay it; animates GIF sprite-sheets. Cached per-URL for the session so re-opening a story is instant (no re-download / re-write), which is what removes the load hitch.
		if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then return end
		local function apply(asset, m)  -- overlay the loaded asset + size the slot to its aspect. Shared by the cache-hit path and the fresh download so the layout is identical either way.
			if not parent.Parent then return end
			-- FULL WIDTH, no black bars: size the slot to the image's OWN aspect (full width, height derived) so it fills exactly.
			-- Crop (not Fit) so a missing dimension fills the slot instead of letterboxing to black. The clamp is a wide sanity bound only.
			local il = new("ImageLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = asset, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8, Parent = parent }); corner(il, 12)
			local deco = parent:FindFirstChild("Deco"); if deco then deco.Visible = false end  -- real image is up: hide the placeholder badges so they can't block it
			local imW, imH = m.imW, m.imH
			if m.gif then  -- the proxy returns a sprite-sheet PNG + metadata; flip-book it (Roblox can't animate a gif)
				imW, imH = m.fw, m.fh
				il.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch; il.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(m.fw, m.fh)
				task.spawn(function() local f = 0; while il.Parent do f = (f % m.frames) + 1; il.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(((f - 1) % m.cols) * m.fw, math.floor((f - 1) / m.cols) * m.fh); task.wait(m.durs[f] or 0.08) end end)
			end
			if imW and imH and imW > 0 and imH > 0 then
				parent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.floor((0.66 * PW - 30) / math.clamp(imW / imH, 0.2, 6)))  -- slot height = KNOWN logical width / real aspect (deterministic, scale-independent; plain offset keeps AutomaticCanvasSize correct)
			end
		end
		local cache = A._newsImg; if not cache then cache = {}; A._newsImg = cache end  -- session cache: url -> { path, dims, gif metadata }
		local hit = cache[url]
		if hit then  -- already fetched this story this session: reuse the on-disk file, NO network and NO re-write (this is what kills the navigation hitch)
			local exists = false; pcall(function() exists = (isfile and isfile(hit.path)) or false end)
			if exists then local oka, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, hit.path); if oka and type(asset) == "string" then apply(asset, hit); return end end
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local req = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request)
			local wf, gca = writefile, getcustomasset
			if not (req and wf and gca) then return end
			-- V4.5.20 FIX: news images now live on krulhub.dev/news-img (self-hosted, R2). The /chat/img proxy ...
			local fetchUrl
			if url:match("^https?://krulhub%.dev/") then
				fetchUrl = url
			else
				local enc = url; pcall(function() enc = game:GetService("HttpService"):UrlEncode(url) end)
				fetchUrl = "https://krulhub.dev/chat/img?u=" .. enc
			end
			local ok, res = pcall(req, { Url = fetchUrl, Method = "GET" })
			if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" or not res.Body or (tonumber(res.StatusCode) or tonumber(res.Status) or 200) >= 300 then return end  -- V4.5.19: tonumber - a string StatusCode ("200") made "200">=300 THROW here (ordered string-vs-number compare) inside this bare task.spawn, killing every news-image load for the session
			local hdr = res.Headers or res.headers or {}
			local function H(k) return hdr[k] or hdr[string.lower(k)] or hdr[string.upper(k)] end
			local ext = string.find((H("Content-Type") or ""), "jpeg") and ".jpeg" or ".png"  -- getcustomasset validates the extension
			local pathf = "krulnews_" .. tostring(#res.Body) .. "_" .. (url:gsub("%W", ""):sub(-14)) .. ext
			local already = false; pcall(function() already = (isfile and isfile(pathf)) or false end)
			if not already then task.wait(); if not pcall(wf, pathf, res.Body) then return end end  -- yield so the ~1MB synchronous write lands on a fresh frame (not the click's); skip the write entirely if already on disk
			local oka, asset = pcall(gca, pathf)
			if not oka or type(asset) ~= "string" or not parent.Parent then return end
			local m = { path = pathf, imW = tonumber(H("X-Img-W")), imH = tonumber(H("X-Img-H")) }
			if (H("X-Img-Type") or "") == "gif" then
				m.gif = true
				m.frames = tonumber(H("X-Frames")) or 1; m.cols = tonumber(H("X-Cols")) or 1
				m.fw = tonumber(H("X-Frame-W")) or 100; m.fh = tonumber(H("X-Frame-H")) or 100
				m.durs = {}; for d in string.gmatch(tostring(H("X-Durations") or ""), "[^,]+") do m.durs[#m.durs + 1] = (tonumber(d) or 80) / 1000 end
			end
			cache[url] = m  -- remember for instant re-views this session
			apply(asset, m)
		end)
	end
	local function imageBlock(parent, item)  -- category-tinted placeholder; overlays the real image/GIF (loadNewsImage) when item.image is set
		local img = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.floor((0.66 * PW - 30) * 9 / 16)), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 8, Parent = parent }); corner(img, 12)  -- FULL WIDTH; height = the KNOWN logical content width (0.66·PW − insets) ÷ aspect (16:9 placeholder; loadNewsImage sets the real aspect). A PLAIN OFFSET height, NOT a UIAspectRatioConstraint - the constraint + Scale-width combo silently broke the detail ScrollingFrame's AutomaticCanvasSize (image vanished + body clipped on PC). Crop fills it → full width, no bars.
		new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 40, Color = ColorSequence.new(catCol(item.cat):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26), 0.12), catCol(item.cat):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 19), 0.72)), Parent = img })
		-- Placeholder badges live in one group so loadNewsImage can hide them the moment the real image loads - otherwise
		-- they sit ON TOP of the photo and block its content (the reader header below already shows the category + date).
		local deco = new("Frame", { Name = "Deco", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 9, Parent = img })
		lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -8), Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 34), Text = "KRUL", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextTransparency = 0.84, TextSize = 24, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 9, Parent = deco })
		local tag = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12), Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundColor3 = catCol(item.cat), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = deco }); corner(tag, 6); pad(tag, 8, 8, 0, 0)
		lbl({ AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Text = string.upper(item.cat or "News"), Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextSize = 10.5, ZIndex = 9, Parent = tag })
		if item.new then local nb = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 12), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 20), BackgroundColor3 = T.bad, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = deco }); corner(nb, 6); lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "NEW", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextSize = 10, ZIndex = 9, Parent = nb }) end
		if item.image then loadNewsImage(img, item.image) end  -- overlay the real image/GIF (stays on the gradient if it can't load)
		return img
	end
	-- News title + body just use Roblox's NATIVE AutomaticSize.Y (see renderDetail): the ACTUAL TextLabel render, exact on
	-- every client. Every GetTextSize variant mismatched the mobile client's text layout (it over-counted lines → the
	-- body-to-button gap that no measuring-math fixed). The manual detail canvas reads AbsoluteContentSize, so it tracks the
	-- AutomaticSize'd heights automatically - same as the image (deterministic offset) at the top: nothing is hand-measured.
	-- DETAIL pane: render the selected story inline (image + title + meta + full body + action button).
	local _shownItem  -- the story currently in the reader; lets a live re-render skip rebuilding an unchanged one
	local function sameNews(a, b) return a and b and a.title == b.title and a.body == b.body and a.image == b.image and a.link == b.link and a.linkLabel == b.linkLabel and a.cat == b.cat and a.date == b.date end
	local function renderDetail(item)
		if item and sameNews(item, _shownItem) then return end  -- SAME story on a 60s-poll re-render → keep the pane (don't reload the image or snap the reader's scroll back to the top)
		_shownItem = item
		for _, ch in ipairs(detail:GetChildren()) do if not (ch:IsA("UIListLayout") or ch:IsA("UIPadding") or ch:IsA("UIScale")) then ch:Destroy() end end
		if not item then
			lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), Text = "No news right now.", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = detail })
			return
		end
		local ps = _KR.pStyle()
		local im = imageBlock(detail, item); im.LayoutOrder = 1  -- loadNewsImage sizes the slot to each image's aspect (full width, no bars)
		if ps ~= "Dock" then local uc = im:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner"); if uc then local r = (ps == "Taskbar") and 6 or 18; uc:SetAttribute("rcR0", r); _KR.corners[uc] = r; uc.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(im, r) end end
		local body = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = 8, Parent = detail }); pad(body, 4, 6, 12, 4); vlist(body, ps == "Minimal" and 12 or 9)
		local tt = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = item.title, Font = FONTB, TextSize = (ps == "Minimal" and 36) or (ps == "Taskbar" and 20) or 22, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextWrapped = true, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = 8, Parent = body })
		if ps == "Minimal" then _KR.HL.light(tt) end
		if ps == "Taskbar" then lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15), Text = (item.cat or "News") .. "  ·  " .. (item.date or ""), TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = 8, Parent = body })
		elseif ps == "Minimal" then lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = string.upper((item.cat or "News") .. "  ·  " .. (item.date or "")), Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 0, ZIndex = 8, Parent = body })
		else lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15), Text = string.upper(item.cat or "News") .. "   ·   " .. (item.date or ""), TextColor3 = catCol(item.cat), Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = 8, Parent = body }) end
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = item.body or "", TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextSize = (ps == "Minimal") and 15 or 14, LineHeight = (ps == "Minimal") and 1.15 or 1, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, LayoutOrder = 3, ZIndex = 8, Parent = body })  -- NATIVE AutomaticSize.Y = the real render height on any client (GetTextSize mismatched the mobile text layout → the gap)
		local function act() local lnk = item.link or "discord.gg/no"; local ok = setclipboard and pcall(setclipboard, lnk:find("://") and lnk or ("https://" .. lnk)); toast("Discord", ok and (lnk .. " copied.") or "No clipboard on this executor.", ok and "ok" or "warn") end
		if ps == "Minimal" then  -- a text link with an accent arrow, like the Typographic Home
			local esc = tostring(item.linkLabel or "Join Discord"):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")
			local tl = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), RichText = true, Text = "<b>" .. esc .. '</b>  <font color="#' .. T.accent:ToHex() .. '">→</font>', Font = FONT, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = T.txt, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 4, ZIndex = 8, Parent = body })
			tl.MouseButton1Click:Connect(act)
		else UI.button(body, item.linkLabel or "Join Discord", "primary", 4, act) end
		if _KR.cornerPass then pcall(_KR.cornerPass, detail) end  -- V4.5.57: the panel layout's corners
		detail.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)  -- reset scroll to top on each switch (no UIScale on the ScrollingFrame - it breaks AutomaticCanvasSize, which clipped long article bodies)
	end
	-- MASTER list: compact headline rows; the selected row is highlighted (bg + accent bar) and drives the detail pane.
	local _selRow, _selIdx = nil, 1
	local function setRowSel(row, on)
		tween(row, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = on and (row:GetAttribute("rcOnT") or 0) or (row:GetAttribute("rcOffT") or 1) })
		local sb = row:FindFirstChild("SelBar"); if sb then tween(sb, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1 }) end
		local tl = row:FindFirstChild("Title"); if tl and row:GetAttribute("rcAccentSel") then tween(tl, 0.15, { TextColor3 = on and T.accent or T.txt }) end
	end
	local function selectRow(row, item, idx)
		if _selRow == row then return end
		if _selRow and _selRow.Parent then setRowSel(_selRow, false) end
		_selRow, _selIdx = row, idx; setRowSel(row, true); renderDetail(item)
	end
	local function headlineRow(item, idx)
		local ps = _KR.pStyle()
		if ps == "Taskbar" then  -- a Windows card: category thumbnail + a two-line title + "Category · date"
			local row = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.96, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 74), LayoutOrder = idx, ZIndex = 8, Parent = list }); corner(row, 6)
			row:SetAttribute("rcOnT", 0.9); row:SetAttribute("rcOffT", 0.96); row:SetAttribute("rcHovT", 0.93)
			local th = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row }); corner(th, 6)
			new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 40, Color = ColorSequence.new(catCol(item.cat), catCol(item.cat):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 19), 0.7)), Parent = th })
			lbl({ Name = "Title", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 10), Size = UDim2.new(1, -86, 0, 34), Text = item.title, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row })
			lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 48), Size = UDim2.new(1, -86, 0, 15), Text = (item.cat or "News") .. "  ·  " .. (item.date or "") .. (item.new and "  ·  New" or ""), TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 11.5, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row })
			return row
		elseif ps == "Minimal" then  -- plain text over a hairline; the picked one turns accent
			local row = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), LayoutOrder = idx, ZIndex = 8, Parent = list })
			row:SetAttribute("rcOnT", 1); row:SetAttribute("rcHovT", 1); row:SetAttribute("rcAccentSel", true)
			new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row })
			lbl({ Name = "Title", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 1, -1), Text = item.title, TextSize = 14, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row })
			lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 1, -1), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Text = item.date or "", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row })
			return row
		end
		local row = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = T.cardHi, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56), LayoutOrder = idx, ZIndex = 8, Parent = list }); corner(row, 10)
		local sb = new("Frame", { Name = "SelBar", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 32), BackgroundColor3 = catCol(item.cat), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row }); corner(sb, 2)
		local dot = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 12), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), BackgroundColor3 = catCol(item.cat), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row }); corner(dot, 3)
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 9), Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 13), Text = string.upper(item.cat or "News"), Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = catCol(item.cat), TextSize = 10, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row })
		lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 9), Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 13), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Text = item.date or "", TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 10.5, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row })
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, item.new and -60 or -26, 0, 20), Text = item.title, Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.txt, TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row })
		if item.new then local nb = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 36), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 15), BackgroundColor3 = T.bad, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = row }); corner(nb, 5); lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "NEW", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextSize = 8.5, ZIndex = 9, Parent = nb }) end
		return row
	end
	renderNews = function(items)
		items = (items and #items > 0) and items or NEWS
		_KR.newsItems = items; _KR._newsRows = {}  -- V4.5.57: the Home layouts show the latest posts + open a story
		for _, ch in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do if not (ch:IsA("UIListLayout") or ch:IsA("UIPadding")) then ch:Destroy() end end
		_selRow = nil
		local keep = math.clamp(_selIdx or 1, 1, #items)  -- keep the reader on the same slot across live re-renders
		local rRef, iRef
		local filt = (_KR.pStyle() == "Taskbar") and _newsCat ~= "All" and _newsCat or nil
		for i, it in ipairs(items) do
			if filt and it.cat ~= filt then continue end
			local row = headlineRow(it, i)
			_KR._newsRows[i] = { row = row, it = it }
			row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() selectRow(row, it, i) end)
			row.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if _selRow ~= row then tween(row, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = row:GetAttribute("rcHovT") or 0.55 }) end end)
			row.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if _selRow ~= row then tween(row, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = row:GetAttribute("rcOffT") or 1 }) end end)
			if i == keep then rRef, iRef = row, it end
		end
		if not rRef then local mi; for i in pairs(_KR._newsRows) do if not mi or i < mi then mi = i end end; if mi then rRef, iRef, keep = _KR._newsRows[mi].row, _KR._newsRows[mi].it, mi end end  -- the kept story was filtered out -> the first one shown
		if rRef then selectRow(rRef, iRef, keep) else _shownItem = nil; renderDetail(nil) end
		if _KR.cornerPass then pcall(_KR.cornerPass, list) end  -- V4.5.57: the panel layout's corners
	end
	_KR.newsCat = catCol
	_KR.openNews = function(i)  -- a Home layout's news item: select that story, then slide to the News view
		if i and _newsCat ~= "All" and _KR.newsCatSet then _KR.newsCatSet("All") end  -- a Home news item always lands on its story
		local r = i and _KR._newsRows and _KR._newsRows[i]
		if r and r.row.Parent then selectRow(r.row, r.it, i) end
		if goTo then goTo("news") end
	end
	renderNews()
	do  -- the pivot (Settings page): All / Update / Event / Community, a short accent pill under the picked one
		local pills, ind = {}, new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 3), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Parent = nPivot }); corner(ind, 2)
		local x = 0
		for _, c in ipairs({ "All", "Update", "Event", "Community" }) do
			local w = math.ceil(game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(c, 16, FONTB, Vector2.new(400, 30)).X) + 6  -- V4.5.57: measured at the LARGEST text size (built once), so Text size 120% still fits
			local b = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 26), Text = c, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = T.txt3, ZIndex = 9, Parent = nPivot })
			pills[c] = { b = b, x = x, w = w }; x = x + w + 22
			b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if _KR.newsCatSet then _KR.newsCatSet(c) end end)
		end
		_KR.newsCatSet = function(c)
			_newsCat = pills[c] and c or "All"
			for k, p in pairs(pills) do p.b.TextColor3 = (k == _newsCat) and T.txt or T.txt3 end
			local p = pills[_newsCat]; ind.BackgroundColor3 = T.accent; ind.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.x + math.floor(p.w / 2) - 9, 27)
			renderNews(_KR.newsItems)
		end
	end
	_KR.newsStyle = function()
		local ps = _KR.pStyle()
		nBg.BackgroundColor3 = T.card; nBg.BackgroundTransparency = (ps == "Taskbar") and 0.04 or 1
		nRead.Visible = (ps == "Taskbar"); nDiv.Visible = (ps == "Dock"); nPivot.Visible = (ps == "Taskbar")
		hdT.Font, hdT.TextColor3, hdT.TextSize, hdT.Position, hdT.Size = FONTB, T.txt, 22, UDim2.new(), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
		hdS.Visible = true; hdS.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 25)
		if ps == "Taskbar" then
			hdS.Text = "RoClothes  ›  News"; hdS.Position = UDim2.new()
			hdT.Text = "News"; hdT.TextSize = 24; hdT.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16); hdT.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
			list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 94); list.Size = UDim2.new(0.34, -10, 1, -94)
			detail.Position = UDim2.new(0.34, 16, 0, 98); detail.Size = UDim2.new(0.66, -24, 1, -104)
			nRead.Position = UDim2.new(0.34, 4, 0, 92); nRead.Size = UDim2.new(0.66, -4, 1, -92); nRead.BackgroundTransparency = 0.96
		elseif ps == "Minimal" then
			hdT.Text = "NEWS"; hdT.Font = Enum.Font.Code; hdT.TextSize = 12; hdT.TextColor3 = T.txt3; hdS.Visible = false
			list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 34); list.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, -10, 1, -34)
			detail.Position = UDim2.new(0.36, 0, 0, 26); detail.Size = UDim2.new(0.64, 0, 1, -26)
		else
			hdT.Text = "News & Announcements"; hdS.Text = "Latest from KrulHub - pick a story on the left."
			list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 58); list.Size = UDim2.new(0.34, -10, 1, -58)
			detail.Position = UDim2.new(0.34, 16, 0, 56); detail.Size = UDim2.new(0.66, -16, 1, -56)
		end
		_shownItem = nil; _selRow = nil
		_KR.newsCatSet("All")  -- rebuilds the rows + the reader in the new style (keeps the story that was open)
	end
	_KR.newsStyle()
	-- LIVE: poll krulhub.dev/news so the feed is backend-controlled + updates itself; re-renders ONLY when the
	-- payload changes (so it doesn't interrupt scrolling/reading); falls back to the built-in NEWS if HTTP is blocked.
	task.spawn(function()
		local lastRaw; task.wait(0.6)
		local lastFetch
		while newsPanel.Parent do
			-- V4.5.72: one fetch at boot (the Home "Latest" card is built when Home opens and showed "Loading news..." when
			-- the first fetch only started then), after that only while Home is open (the News view AND the Home layouts'
			-- latest posts live there). This used to fetch every 60 s all session, UI closed or not. Closed: check again
			-- in 5 s, no HTTP. Reopened after 60 s+: fetch right away.
			while lastFetch and newsPanel.Parent and not (homeView.Visible and os.clock() - lastFetch >= 60) do task.wait(homeView.Visible and 1 or 5) end
			if not newsPanel.Parent then break end
			lastFetch = os.clock()
			local res
			local req = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request)
			if req then local ok, out = pcall(req, { Url = "https://krulhub.dev/news", Method = "GET" }); if ok and type(out) == "table" then res = out.Body end end
			if not res then pcall(function() res = game:HttpGet("https://krulhub.dev/news") end) end
			if not res and not _KR.dataOfflineAuto then  -- both request() and game:HttpGet failed -> krulhub.dev unreachable. Announce ONCE via a NON-BLOCKING toast; the built-in feed still shows. (A full-screen modal here sank all screen input at boot - a background failure must never grab a blocking popup.)
				_KR.dataOfflineAuto = true; toast("Data servers", "Couldn't reach krulhub.dev - showing the built-in news feed.", "warn")
			end
			if res and res ~= lastRaw then
				lastRaw = res
				local d; pcall(function() d = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(res) end)
				if d and type(d.items) == "table" and #d.items > 0 then renderNews(d.items) end
			end
		end
	end)
end)()
_curPage = "uiset"  -- state-store prefix for the settings controls
