-- V4.5.57 Appearance sections: rows carry rcSub = "Colour" | "Text" | "Surfaces"; only SET.apSub's rows are visible.
_KR.apSubTag = function(row, group) if row then row:SetAttribute("rcSub", group); row.Visible = (group == (SET.apSub or "Colour")) end; return row end
local function fillSettings()
	_curPage = "uiset"  -- a SmartBar tab open may have moved _curPage; restore it so controls key + the clear-loop below stay consistent
	for k in pairs(S) do if type(k) == "string" and k:sub(1, 6) == "uiset\1" then S[k] = nil end end
	for _, c in ipairs(setLeft:GetChildren()) do if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end end
	-- V4.5.55 macOS System Settings layout (krul): a SIDEBAR of categories on the left, ONE category's controls beside it,
	-- the live preview in its own pane on the far right. Only one section is on screen, so the panel is a fixed size and
	-- never shrinks to fit (it used to grow to the tallest of 3 columns and scale every control down).
	local CATS = { { "Appearance", Color3.fromRGB(233, 74, 128) }, { "Motion", Color3.fromRGB(88, 120, 236) }, { "SmartBar", Color3.fromRGB(64, 160, 230) }, { "Tabs", Color3.fromRGB(72, 190, 120) }, { "Layout", Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 230) }, { "Privacy", Color3.fromRGB(120, 128, 150) }, { "Behavior", Color3.fromRGB(240, 150, 60) } }
	local side = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 0.965, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(0, 196, 1, -8), Parent = setLeft }); corner(side, 12); pad(side, 8, 8, 8, 8)
	local sideList = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -44), Parent = side }); vlist(sideList, 2)
	local pagesHost = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(212, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -212, 1, -8), Parent = setLeft })
	local pages, bodies, items, first, curSec = {}, {}, {}, {}, nil
	local function showCat(name, animate, preview)
		_KR._setCat = name
		for n, pg in pairs(pages) do pg.Visible = (n == name) end
		for n, it in pairs(items) do local on = n == name; it.btn.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1; it.txt.TextColor3 = on and (_KR.light() and T.txt or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)) or T.txt2 end  -- selected = accent pill, white label
		if animate and SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then pages[name].CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero; cascadeIn(bodies[name], 0) end
		local f = first[name]; if preview and f then renderPreview(f[1], f[2]) end  -- touch has no hover: picking a category shows its first preview
	end
	for i, c in ipairs(CATS) do
		local name = c[1]
		local b = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = T.accentD, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), LayoutOrder = i, Parent = sideList }); corner(b, 8)  -- V4.5.57: dark accent pill (a bright-accent pill swallowed the pink Appearance icon)
		local ic = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = c[2], BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = b }); corner(ic, 6)  -- macOS-style coloured rounded-square icon
		local tx = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 1, 0), Text = name, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = b })
		_KR.press(b)
		b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if SET.hoverFx and _KR._setCat ~= name then tween(b, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.86 }) end end)
		b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(b, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = _KR._setCat == name and 0 or 1 }) end)
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if _KR._setCat ~= name then showCat(name, true, true) end end)
		items[name] = { btn = b, txt = tx }
		local pg = new("ScrollingFrame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.line, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, Visible = false, Parent = pagesHost })  -- no UIPadding: inside a ScrollingFrame it did NOT narrow scale-sized children, so rows ran 4px past the edge and lost their right corners
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 30), Text = name, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 20, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = pg })  -- large page title, like System Settings
		local body = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 40), Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = pg }); vlist(body, 8); pad(body, 0, 0, 0, 14)  -- -14 = room for the scrollbar; bottom pad so the last row clears the edge
		pages[name], bodies[name] = pg, body
	end
	do  -- Reset lives at the foot of the sidebar (was its own one-button "Actions" section)
		local rs = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, Text = "Reset to defaults", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = T.bad or T.accent, Parent = side }); corner(rs, 8); _KR.press(rs)
		rs.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showModal("Reset UI settings?", "Every UI setting goes back to its default. Outfits, body and clothing settings are not touched.", { { text = "Cancel" }, { text = "Reset", kind = "primary", onClick = function() A.apply("reset") end } }) end)  -- V4.5.55: confirm first (one tap used to wipe everything)
	end
	local function P(row, key, label)  -- hover (desktop) or TAP (touch) a control -> preview it; also remembers each category's first preview
		if row then
			if curSec and not first[curSec] then first[curSec] = { key, label } end
			row.MouseEnter:Connect(function() renderPreview(key, label) end)
			row.InputBegan:Connect(function(io) if io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then renderPreview(key, label) end end)
		end
		return row
	end
	local function sec(name) curSec = name; return bodies[name] end
	-- Appearance
	local ap = sec("Appearance")
	do  -- V4.5.57: three sections; each row is tagged and only the open section's rows show
		local G = _KR.apSubTag
		local cur = SET.apSub or "Colour"
		P(UI.seg(ap, { "Colour", "Text", "Surfaces" }, 0, function(o) SET.apSub = o; for _, c in ipairs(ap:GetChildren()) do local g = c:GetAttribute("rcSub"); if g then c.Visible = (g == o) end end; refreshPreview() end, (cur == "Text" and 2) or (cur == "Surfaces" and 3) or 1), "theme", "Appearance")
		-- Colour
		if SET.theme ~= "Custom" then G(P(UI.seg(ap, { "Dark", "Light" }, 1, function(o) SET.mode = o; A.apply("mode") end, (SET.mode == "Light" and 2 or 1), nil, nil, "Mode"), "mode", "Mode"), "Colour") end  -- Custom keeps its own four colours
		G(P(UI.cyc(ap, "Theme", { "Vampiric Noir", "Midnight", "Rose Gold", "Ocean", "Sunset", "Emerald", "Mono", "Crimson", "Ice", "Halloween", "Custom" }, 2, function(o) SET.theme = o; A.apply("theme") end, SET.theme), "theme", "Theme"), "Colour")
		G(P(UI.swatch(ap, "Accent colour", SET.accent, 3, function(c) SET.accent = c; A.apply("accent") end), "accent", "Accent colour"), "Colour")
	end
	if SET.theme == "Custom" then  -- a COMPACT single row of the 4 custom-colour swatches (so the card doesn't elongate off-screen)
		local cr = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 98), LayoutOrder = 4, Parent = ap })  -- V4.5.59 (N10): 2 rows of chips
		_KR.apSubTag(cr, "Colour")
		cr.MouseEnter:Connect(function() renderPreview("accent", "Custom colours") end)
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15), Text = "Custom colours", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = cr })
		local sw = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 80), Parent = cr }); new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(55, 36), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = sw })
		for _, it in ipairs({ { "Accent 2", "accent2" }, { "Card", "card" }, { "Backdrop", "bg" }, { "Text", "text" }, { "Muted text", "text2" }, { "Buttons", "button" }, { "Lines", "line" } }) do
			local ck = it[2]
			local cell = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(55, 36), Parent = sw })
			-- The border is a FILLED FRAME behind the chip (not a UIStroke) so it renders reliably no matter what an
			-- entrance/transparency pass does to stroke transparency -- a plain BackgroundTransparency is simpler here.
			local bord = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 26), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(164, 169, 186), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = cell }); corner(bord, 7)
			local chip = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 22), BackgroundColor3 = SET.custom[ck] or T[({ text = "txt", text2 = "txt2", button = "accentD" })[ck] or ck] or T.card, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bord }); corner(chip, 6)
			lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12), Text = it[1], TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 9.5, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = cell })
			chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() openColorPicker(chip.BackgroundColor3, function(c) SET.custom[ck] = c; A.apply("theme") end) end)
		end
	end
	-- V4.5.59 (N10): easier colouring. (1) "Customise these colours" copies the CURRENT look into Custom so you tweak
	-- what you see instead of starting from defaults. (2) Saved themes: name the current colours, tap to switch back.
	-- Stored as hex strings (SET is JSON-saved; only SET.accent / SET.custom get Color3 conversion).
	do
		local function hx(c) return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5)) end
		local function unhx(h) local r, g, b = tostring(h):match("^#?(%x%x)(%x%x)(%x%x)$"); if r then return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(r, 16), tonumber(g, 16), tonumber(b, 16)) end end
		if SET.theme ~= "Custom" then
			local cb = UI.button(ap, "Customise these colours", nil, 4, function()
				SET.custom = { accent2 = T.accent2, card = T.card, bg = T.bg, text = T.txt, text2 = T.txt2, button = T.accentD, line = T.line }
				SET.theme = "Custom"; A.apply("theme")
			end)
			if cb then _KR.apSubTag(cb, "Colour") end
		else
			local sb = UI.button(ap, "Save these colours as a theme", nil, 4, function()
				showModal("Save theme", "Name this colour set.", {
					{ text = "Cancel" },
					{ text = "Save", kind = "primary", onClick = function(name)
						name = tostring(name or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
						if name == "" then return end
						local e = { accent = hx(SET.accent) }
						for k, v in pairs(SET.custom) do if typeof(v) == "Color3" then e[k] = hx(v) end end
						SET.savedThemes = SET.savedThemes or {}; SET.savedThemes[name:sub(1, 24)] = e
						pcall(_KR.saveCfg); fillSettings(); toast("Theme saved", name, "ok")
					end },
				}, true, "My theme")
			end)
			if sb then _KR.apSubTag(sb, "Colour") end
		end
		if type(SET.savedThemes) == "table" and next(SET.savedThemes) then
			local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 4, Parent = ap }); pad(row, 12, 12, 0, 6)
			_KR.apSubTag(row, "Colour")
			lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15), Text = "Saved themes", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = row })
			local list = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = row })
			new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 30), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.Name, Parent = list })
			for name, e in pairs(SET.savedThemes) do
				local b = new("TextButton", { Name = name, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = unhx(e.card) or T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = list }); corner(b, 8)
				new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), BackgroundColor3 = unhx(e.accent) or T.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = b })
				lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -54, 1, 0), Text = name, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = unhx(e.text) or T.txt, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = b })
				local x = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "X", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = unhx(e.text2) or T.txt2, Parent = b })
				b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					local c = {}; for k, v in pairs(e) do if k ~= "accent" then c[k] = unhx(v) end end
					SET.custom = c; SET.accent = unhx(e.accent) or SET.accent; SET.theme = "Custom"; A.apply("theme")
				end)
				x.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SET.savedThemes[name] = nil; pcall(_KR.saveCfg); fillSettings() end)
			end
		end
	end
	-- Accent presets: quick-pick swatches that set JUST the accent (your theme's backdrop stays). Tap-to-apply, live.
	do
		local pr = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), LayoutOrder = 5, Parent = ap }); pad(pr, 12, 12, 0, 0)  -- V4.5.57: line up with the rows' text
		_KR.apSubTag(pr, "Colour")
		pr.MouseEnter:Connect(function() renderPreview("accent", "Accent presets") end)
		lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15), Text = "Accent presets", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = pr })
		local chips = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 19), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), Parent = pr }); new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Parent = chips })  -- gap 4 so 8x24 + 7x4 = 220 fits the ~224px column (was 30px+6gap = 282 -> overflowed the card's right edge)
		for _, col in ipairs({ Color3.fromRGB(233, 74, 128), Color3.fromRGB(232, 72, 84), Color3.fromRGB(255, 138, 76), Color3.fromRGB(216, 177, 90), Color3.fromRGB(72, 200, 130), Color3.fromRGB(64, 196, 224), Color3.fromRGB(96, 150, 240), Color3.fromRGB(168, 120, 240) }) do
			local sel = SET.accent == col
			local chip = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), BackgroundColor3 = col, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = chips }); corner(chip, 12); stroke(chip, sel and T.txt or T.line, sel and 2 or 1)  -- 24px: 8 swatches must FIT the column (30px overflowed).
			if sel then local d = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = chip }); corner(d, 4) end  -- V4.5.57: the current preset (the stroke ring never showed: strokes are disabled UI-wide) The whole settings scales uniformly, so logical fit holds on every device.
			chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SET.accent = col; A.apply("accent") end)
		end
	end
	do
		local G = _KR.apSubTag
		local function segIdx(list, v) for i, o in ipairs(list) do if o == v then return i end end; return 1 end
		local GR, AN, TC, CT = { "Off", "Subtle", "Bold" }, { "Off", "Slow", "Fast" }, { "Colourful", "Accent", "Mono" }, { "Standard", "High" }
		G(P(UI.seg(ap, GR, 6, function(o) SET.accentGrad = o; A.apply("accentGrad") end, segIdx(GR, SET.accentGrad), nil, nil, "Gradient accent"), "accentGrad", "Gradient accent"), "Colour")
		G(P(UI.seg(ap, AN, 7, function(o) SET.accentAnim = o; A.apply("accentAnim") end, segIdx(AN, SET.accentAnim), nil, nil, "Animated accent"), "accentAnim", "Animated accent"), "Colour")

-- (the News view is built above by the redesigned renderNews)
-- minimal edge buttons: a big "<" / ">" chevron + a name below, NO box/border.
local function edgeBtn(isL)
	local b = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(isL and 1 or 0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 78), BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", ZIndex = 4, Parent = homeView })
	local chev = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38), Text = isL and "<" or ">", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 30, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = b })
	local nm = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 18, 0, 28), Text = "", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 9.5, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Parent = b })
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(chev, 0.15, { TextColor3 = T.accent }); tween(nm, 0.15, { TextColor3 = T.txt2 }) end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(chev, 0.15, { TextColor3 = T.txt2 }); tween(nm, 0.15, { TextColor3 = T.txt3 }) end)
	return b, nm
end
local leftBtn, leftNm = edgeBtn(true)
local rightBtn, rightNm = edgeBtn(false)
local _active, _homeX = "home", nil
local ORDER = { settings = 0, home = 1, news = 2 }
local function viewOf(n) return n == "home" and homeScroll or (n == "settings" and settingsPanel or newsPanel) end
local function centerP(n) return n == "home" and (_homeX or homeScroll.Position) or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0) end
placeSideButtons = function()  -- pin BOTH nav buttons to the HOME view's edges for EVERY view (the Home menu is the source of truth, so the buttons never jump between Home / Settings / News; only visibility + labels change per view - see updateButtons).
	local px = (_homeX or homeScroll.Position).X.Offset  -- captured Home centre, not the live pos (mid-slide it may be off-screen)
	local w = homeScroll.Size.X.Offset
	if _KR.homeLay() ~= "Dashboard" then  -- V4.5.57: the other Home layouts sit at an edge / fill the screen -> Settings + News use a centred frame for their Home button
		local vw0 = (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X) or vp.X
		w = math.floor(math.min(vw0 - 150, 1040)); px = math.floor((homeView.AbsoluteSize.X - w) / 2)
	end
	leftBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, px - 8, 0.5, 0)       -- Home's LEFT edge  (UI Settings on Home; Home button on News)
	if _active == "news" and newsPanel and newsPanel.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then leftBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.floor((homeView.AbsoluteSize.X - newsPanel.AbsoluteSize.X) / 2) - 8, 0.5, 0) end  -- V4.5.57: on News the Home button hugs the News view (it floated ~100px off once Home's layout moved)
	rightBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, px + w + 8, 0.5, 0)  -- Home's RIGHT edge (News on Home; Home button on Settings)
	-- V4.5.55: Settings is centred on the screen and can be WIDER than Home, so its preview pane ran under this "Home"
	-- button (overlapped 12px at 1914 wide). Cap the settings scale so its right edge stays 28px clear of the button.
	local vw = (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X) or vp.X
	fitSettings()
	if _active == "settings" then rightBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.floor((homeView.AbsoluteSize.X + SET_W * settingsScale.Scale) / 2) + 8, 0.5, 0) end  -- V4.5.57: on Settings the Home button follows SETTINGS' own right edge (Settings no longer shrinks to fit Home's)
end
local function updateButtons()
	leftBtn.Visible = _active ~= "settings"; rightBtn.Visible = _active ~= "news"
	if _active == "home" and _KR.homeLay() ~= "Dashboard" then leftBtn.Visible = false; rightBtn.Visible = false end  -- V4.5.57: the other layouts link UI Settings + News themselves
	leftNm.Text = _active == "home" and "UI Settings" or "Home"
	rightNm.Text = _active == "home" and "News" or "Home"
	placeSideButtons()
end
goTo = function(target)
	if not target or _active == target then return end
	if _active == "settings" and target ~= "settings" then clearPreview() end   -- stop the preview's animation loops when navigating away (goTo doesn't close Home, so closeHome's clearPreview never fires)
	local dir = (ORDER[target] > ORDER[_active]) and 1 or -1  -- +1 = pan toward News (views slide left)
	local VW = ((workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X) or vp.X) + 40  -- LIVE viewport: the load-time vp goes stale (viewport not sized yet at build / window resize), which shrinks the slide + parks side views on-screen (same live-read pattern as fitHome/fitSettings)
	if _active == "home" then _homeX = homeScroll.Position end
	local cur = viewOf(_active)
	tween(cur, 0.44, { Position = centerP(_active) + UDim2.fromOffset(-dir * VW, 0) }, QUINT)  -- current slides away
	local tv = viewOf(target)
	tv.Position = centerP(target) + UDim2.fromOffset(dir * VW, 0)                              -- target starts off-screen
	tween(tv, 0.44, { Position = centerP(target) }, QUINT)                                     -- ...and slides into view
	_active = target
	updateButtons()
	if _KR.homeLay() ~= "Dashboard" and A.applyBackdrop then A.applyBackdrop() end  -- V4.5.57: the side Home layouts show the game; Settings / News go back to the full backdrop
	if target == "home" then  -- back on Home: resume the header wave (pointless while Home is slid off-screen behind a side view)
		if homeOpen and SET.wave and not SET.reduceMotion then startWave(_KR._homeLetters) end
	else
		stopWave()  -- leaving Home for Settings/News: stop the per-frame wave on the now-invisible header
	end
	if target == "settings" and not _KR._prevKey then renderPreview("theme", "Theme") end  -- re-seed the preview if a close cleared it
end
resetSides = function()
	_active = "home"; _homeX = nil  -- forget any stale centre so the buttons use the fresh (fitHome) home position
	local far = UDim2.new(0.5, ((workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X) or vp.X) + 40, 0.5, 0)  -- LIVE viewport (see goTo): stale load-time vp parked side panels only ~40px off-centre → overlapped Home in Studio / early-inject / after resize
	settingsPanel.Position = far; newsPanel.Position = far
	updateButtons()
end
leftBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() goTo(_active == "home" and "settings" or "home") end)
rightBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() goTo(_active == "home" and "news" or "home") end)
_KR.goTo = goTo; _KR.updateButtons = updateButtons  -- V4.5.57: the Home layouts' UI Settings / News links
_KR.homeClickConn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(io, gp)  -- V4.5.57: the side Home layouts (Start menu / Widgets / Glance) close on a click or tap out in the game, like a real Start menu
	if gp or not homeOpen or _active ~= "home" or _KR._homeBusy then return end
	if io.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and io.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
	local L = _KR.HOMES[_KR.homeLay()]; if not (L and L.side) then return end
	local p, a, z = io.Position, homeScroll.AbsolutePosition, homeScroll.AbsoluteSize
	if p.X >= a.X - 8 and p.X <= a.X + z.X + 8 and p.Y >= a.Y - 8 and p.Y <= a.Y + z.Y + 8 then return end
	_KR._homeBusy = true; task.delay(math.max(0.6, 0.9 * SPEED), function() _KR._homeBusy = false end)
	closeHome()
end)
pcall(function() _KR.homeBlur = Instance.new("BlurEffect"); _KR.homeBlur.Size = 0; _KR.homeBlur.Enabled = false; _KR.homeBlur.Parent = game:GetService("Lighting"); GUIObject.HomeBlur = _KR.homeBlur end)  -- stash on GUIObject so the BREAKER teardown can destroy this Lighting BlurEffect too (else a re-execute leaves the whole screen blurred with no UI)
-- ── Theme + backdrop (driven by the UI Settings → Appearance card) ───────────────────────────────────────
-- (A.themes is defined earlier, just above fillSettings, so the boot-time preview seed can read it - see note there)
A.curBg = function()  -- {light, mid, dark} backdrop colours + accent for the current theme (handles Custom)
	if SET.theme == "Custom" then local b = SET.custom.bg; return { b:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.1), b, b:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.22) }, SET.accent end
	local th = A.themes[SET.theme] or A.themes["Vampiric Noir"]; return th.bg, th.accent
end
-- Backdrop opacity per style. Low = opaque (hides the game behind). "Dim only" stays intentionally see-through;
-- the others are near-opaque so opening Home/News/Settings doesn't leave the game world visible around the panel.
A.bgDim0 = function() return (SET.bg == "Clear" and 1) or (SET.bg == "Solid" and 0) or (SET.bg == "Gradient" and 0.06) or (SET.bg == "Dim only" and 0.34) or 0.08 end
A.bgDim = function()  -- V4.5.57: per Home layout. Start / Widgets / Glance keep the game visible beside them; Typographic is type over the (blurred) game
	local base, L = A.bgDim0(), _KR.homeLay()
	if _active ~= "home" then return base end  -- UI Settings / News are full views: they keep the normal backdrop (their text sat on the bright game)
	if L == "Start" then return math.max(base, 0.72) elseif L == "Widgets" then return math.max(base, 0.55) elseif L == "Glance" then return math.max(base, 0.8) elseif L == "Type" then return math.max(base, 0.3) end
	return base
end
_KR.blurSize = function() return math.floor(56 * math.clamp((SET.blurAmt or 50) / 100, 0, 1) + 0.5) end  -- V4.5.57 Blur strength: 50% = the old fixed 28
A.wantBlur = function() local L = _KR.homeLay(); if _active ~= "home" then return SET.bg == "Blur" and SET.blur == true end; if (_KR.HOMES[L] or {}).side then return false end; if L == "Type" then return SET.blur == true and SET.bg ~= "Clear" end; return SET.bg == "Blur" and SET.blur == true end
-- Repaint the full-screen home backdrop + blur for the current SET.bg + SET.theme (LIVE - no rebuild needed).
A.applyBackdrop = function()
	local g, acc = A.curBg()
	if _KR.light and _KR.light() then g = { g[1]:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.86), g[2]:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.9), g[3]:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.88) } end  -- V4.5.57 light mode
	if SET.bg == "Gradient" then
		homeBg.Color = ColorSequence.new({ ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, acc:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.5)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, g[2]) })
	else
		homeBg.Color = ColorSequence.new({ ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, g[1]), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, g[2]), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, g[3]) })
	end
	if homeOpen then tween(homeView, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = A.bgDim() }) end
	if _KR.homeBlur and homeOpen then
		if A.wantBlur() then _KR.homeBlur.Enabled = true; tween(_KR.homeBlur, 0.3, { Size = _KR.blurSize() }) else tween(_KR.homeBlur, 0.3, { Size = 0 }) end
	end
end
-- designparser dark-mode: high-chroma colours "glow" on a near-black bg (Helmholtz-Kohlrausch). Soften the applied
-- accent ~18% toward its luminance-matched grey - reduces chroma while holding hue + luminance (so contrast is kept).
-- SET.accent (the stored pick + the swatches) stays vivid; only the RENDERED T.accent is softened for the dark UI.
A._softenAccent = function(c)  -- on A (not a main-chunk local: the RoClothes chunk is at the 200-register ceiling)
	local l = 0.2126 * c.R + 0.7152 * c.G + 0.0722 * c.B
	return c:Lerp(Color3.new(l, l, l), 0.18)
end
-- V4.5.57 palette layer. _KR.palette() derives EVERY token from theme + accent + mode + contrast + panel tint;
-- _KR.repaint(old) swaps each old token colour for its new value on every live RoClothes GUI (exact Color3 match),
-- so the bar, panels, dialogs and toasts follow too - before, only the rebuilt surfaces (Settings / Home / MP) did.
_KR.TOKENS = { "bg", "bg2", "card", "cardHi", "line", "lineSoft", "txt", "txt2", "txt3", "accent", "accent2", "accentD", "good", "bad", "warn" }
_KR.hueShift = function(c, deg) local h, sv, v = c:ToHSV(); return Color3.fromHSV((h + deg / 360) % 1, sv, v) end
_KR.palette = function()
	local th = A.themes[SET.theme] or A.themes["Vampiric Noir"]
	local tint, acc, p = th.bg[2], SET.accent or th.accent, {}
	local W, K = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	if _KR.light() then
		p.bg = Color3.fromRGB(246, 245, 248):Lerp(tint, 0.06); p.bg2 = p.bg:Lerp(K, 0.04)
		p.card = W:Lerp(tint, 0.02); p.cardHi = p.card:Lerp(K, 0.05)
		p.line = Color3.fromRGB(214, 214, 222); p.lineSoft = Color3.fromRGB(228, 228, 234)
		p.txt = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30); p.txt2 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 92); p.txt3 = Color3.fromRGB(104, 104, 116)
	else
		for _, k in ipairs({ "bg", "bg2", "card", "cardHi", "line", "lineSoft", "txt", "txt2", "txt3" }) do p[k] = TDEF[k] end
	end
	if SET.contrast == "High" then  -- NEAR-black / NEAR-white on purpose: a token equal to pure black / white would drag every hard-coded black shade / white knob along in the next repaint
		if _KR.light() then p.txt, p.txt2, p.txt3, p.line = Color3.fromRGB(2, 2, 6), Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48), Color3.fromRGB(64, 64, 74), Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 162)
		else p.txt, p.txt2, p.txt3, p.line = Color3.fromRGB(253, 253, 255), Color3.fromRGB(226, 226, 234), Color3.fromRGB(196, 196, 206), Color3.fromRGB(96, 96, 110) end
	end
	local k = math.clamp((SET.panelTint or 0) / 100, 0, 0.4)
	if k > 0 then p.card = p.card:Lerp(acc, k); p.cardHi = p.cardHi:Lerp(acc, k); p.bg = p.bg:Lerp(acc, k * 0.6); p.bg2 = p.bg2:Lerp(acc, k * 0.6) end
	local c = _KR.light() and acc:Lerp(K, 0.12) or A._softenAccent(acc)
	p.accent = c
	local gm = SET.accentGrad or "Off"  -- Gradient accent: Off = the pre-feature second shade; Subtle / Bold = a neighbouring hue
	p.accent2 = (gm == "Bold" and _KR.hueShift(c, -42)) or (gm == "Subtle" and _KR.hueShift(c, -18)) or (_KR.light() and c:Lerp(K, 0.2) or c:Lerp(W, 0.22))  -- light Off: DARKER (it is also used as text)
	p.accentD = _KR.light() and c:Lerp(W, 0.62) or c:Lerp(K, 0.34)  -- light mode: accent fills are a SOFT tint, so the many T.txt-on-accentD buttons stay readable
	if _KR.light() then p.good, p.bad, p.warn = Color3.fromRGB(28, 140, 72), Color3.fromRGB(196, 44, 58), Color3.fromRGB(166, 118, 10) else p.good, p.bad, p.warn = TDEF.good, TDEF.bad, TDEF.warn end  -- semantic colours darken on light
	return p
end
_KR.paintRoots = function()
	local t = {}
	for _, s in ipairs({ screen, homeScreen, panelScreen, modalScreen, pickerScreen, MP.screen, GUIObject.hardcoreUI }) do if s then t[#t + 1] = s end end
	if _KR.srchScreen then t[#t + 1] = _KR.srchScreen end
	local intro = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("RoClothesIntro"); if intro then t[#t + 1] = intro end
	return t
end
_KR.repaint = function(old)
	local map, n = {}, 0
	for _, k in ipairs(_KR.TOKENS) do local o, nw = old[k], T[k]; if o and nw and o ~= nw then map[o:ToHex()] = nw; n += 1 end end
	if n == 0 then return end
	local function sw(c) return map[c:ToHex()] end
	for _, root in ipairs(_KR.paintRoots()) do for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local r = sw(d.BackgroundColor3); if r then d.BackgroundColor3 = r end
			if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox") then
				r = sw(d.TextColor3); if r then d.TextColor3 = r end
				if d:IsA("TextBox") then r = sw(d.PlaceholderColor3); if r then d.PlaceholderColor3 = r end end
			elseif d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton") then r = sw(d.ImageColor3); if r then d.ImageColor3 = r end end
			if d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then r = sw(d.ScrollBarImageColor3); if r then d.ScrollBarImageColor3 = r end end
		elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then local r = sw(d.Color); if r then d.Color = r end
		elseif d:IsA("UIGradient") then
			local kp, hit = d.Color.Keypoints, false
			local out = table.create(#kp)
			for i, p in ipairs(kp) do local r = sw(p.Value); if r then hit = true end; out[i] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(p.Time, r or p.Value) end
			if hit then d.Color = ColorSequence.new(out) end
		end
	end end
end
_KR.applyPalette = function()  -- snapshot -> derive -> repaint (no rebuild). Custom keeps its own branch in A.applyTheme.
	local old = {}; for _, k in ipairs(_KR.TOKENS) do old[k] = T[k] end
	if SET.theme == "Custom" then return old end
	for k, v in pairs(_KR.palette()) do T[k] = v end
	pcall(_KR.repaint, old)
	return old
end
-- V4.5.57 animated accent: rotates the accent hue. A SCAN (every 2s) collects each property that currently shows an accent
-- token; the TICK (8 Hz) rewrites just those, so the whole tree is not walked every tick. Off / Reduce Motion = one repaint back.
-- V4.5.70 (mobile perf): the full scan (GetDescendants + ToHex on every GUI object) ran every 2 s. Now: one full scan on
-- start, new objects are classified as they arrive (DescendantAdded queue, drained on the next tick), a hidden ScreenGui
-- is skipped (Enabled change = rescan), and the full rescan (catches colours changed on EXISTING objects) runs every 8 s.
_KR.accAnim = { conn = nil, off = 0, acc = 0, scanT = 9, list = {}, q = {}, hooks = {}, dirty = false }
_KR.accWant = function() return { [T.accent:ToHex()] = "accent", [T.accent2:ToHex()] = "accent2", [T.accentD:ToHex()] = "accentD" } end
_KR.accClassify = function(d, want, L)
	if d:IsA("GuiObject") then
		local k = want[d.BackgroundColor3:ToHex()]; if k then L[#L + 1] = { d, "BackgroundColor3", k } end
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox") then k = want[d.TextColor3:ToHex()]; if k then L[#L + 1] = { d, "TextColor3", k } end end
	elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then local k = want[d.Color:ToHex()]; if k then L[#L + 1] = { d, "Color", k } end
	elseif d:IsA("UIGradient") then
		local names, any = {}, false
		for i, p in ipairs(d.Color.Keypoints) do names[i] = want[p.Value:ToHex()] or false; if names[i] then any = true end end
		if any then L[#L + 1] = { d, "grad", names } end
	end
end
_KR.accUnhook = function()
	local S = _KR.accAnim
	for _, c in pairs(S.hooks) do for _, x in ipairs(c) do x:Disconnect() end end
	S.hooks = {}; S.q = {}
end
_KR.accScan = function()
	local S = _KR.accAnim
	local want = _KR.accWant()
	local L = {}
	S.q = {}
	for _, root in ipairs(_KR.paintRoots()) do
		if not S.hooks[root] then
			S.hooks[root] = {
				root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d) local q = S.q; q[#q + 1] = d end),
				root.Destroying:Connect(function() local c = S.hooks[root]; S.hooks[root] = nil; if c then for _, x in ipairs(c) do x:Disconnect() end end end),
			}
			if root:IsA("ScreenGui") then table.insert(S.hooks[root], root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function() S.dirty = true end)) end
		end
		if not (root:IsA("ScreenGui") and not root.Enabled) then
			for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do _KR.accClassify(d, want, L) end
		end
	end
	S.list = L
end
_KR.accDrain = function()
	local S = _KR.accAnim
	local q = S.q; if #q == 0 then return end
	S.q = {}
	local want, L = _KR.accWant(), S.list
	for _, d in ipairs(q) do if d.Parent then _KR.accClassify(d, want, L) end end
end
_KR.accAnimSync = function()
	local S = _KR.accAnim
	local on = (SET.accentAnim or "Off") ~= "Off" and not SET.reduceMotion and not _destroyed
	if not on then
		if S.conn then S.conn:Disconnect(); S.conn = nil; S.off = 0; S.list = {}; _KR.accUnhook(); if not _destroyed then A.applyTheme(false) end end  -- one full repaint back to the real accent
		return
	end
	if S.conn then return end
	S.scanT = 9
	S.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		S.acc += dt; S.scanT += dt
		if S.acc < 0.125 then return end
		local rate = (SET.accentAnim == "Fast") and 16 or 4
		S.off = (S.off + rate * S.acc) % 360; S.acc = 0
		-- classify against the accent the objects were painted with (this tick's shift is applied below)
		if S.dirty or S.scanT > 8 then S.scanT = 0; S.dirty = false; _KR.accScan() else _KR.accDrain() end
		local base = _KR.palette()
		T.accent = _KR.hueShift(base.accent, S.off); T.accent2 = _KR.hueShift(base.accent2, S.off); T.accentD = _KR.hueShift(base.accentD, S.off)
		local now = { accent = T.accent, accent2 = T.accent2, accentD = T.accentD }
		local L, n = S.list, 0
		for i = 1, #L do
			local e = L[i]
			local o = e[1]
			if o.Parent then
				n += 1; L[n] = e  -- compact: destroyed objects drop out instead of piling up until the next full scan
				if e[2] == "grad" then
					local kp = o.Color.Keypoints; local out = table.create(#kp)
					for j, p in ipairs(kp) do out[j] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(p.Time, (e[3][j] and now[e[3][j]]) or p.Value) end
					o.Color = ColorSequence.new(out)
				else o[e[2]] = now[e[3]] end
			end
		end
		for i = #L, n + 1, -1 do L[i] = nil end
	end)
end
-- Accent/Theme change: re-derive the accent shades in T, repaint the backdrop, rebuild the home so cards re-tint.
A.applyTheme = function(fromPreset)
	if SET.theme == "Custom" then
		local old = {}; for _, k in ipairs(_KR.TOKENS) do old[k] = T[k] end  -- V4.5.57: repaint the live UI from these
		local c, cu = A._softenAccent(SET.accent), SET.custom
		-- SYNC: Custom overrides these T fields; _KR.palette() (the preset branch) re-derives EVERY token, so nothing bleeds back.
		T.accent = c; T.accent2 = cu.accent2; T.accentD = c:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.34)
		T.card = cu.card; T.cardHi = cu.card:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.08)
		T.bg = cu.bg; T.bg2 = cu.bg:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.25)
		T.txt = cu.text; T.txt2 = cu.text2 or cu.text:Lerp(cu.bg, 0.28); T.txt3 = (cu.text2 or cu.text):Lerp(cu.bg, 0.52 - (cu.text2 and 0.24 or 0))
		if cu.button then T.accentD = cu.button end  -- V4.5.59 (N10) per-element colours
		if cu.line then T.line = cu.line; T.lineSoft = cu.line:Lerp(cu.bg, 0.45) end
		pcall(_KR.repaint, old)
	else
		if fromPreset then local th = A.themes[SET.theme]; if th then SET.accent = th.accent end end
		_KR.applyPalette()  -- V4.5.57: every token from theme + accent + mode + contrast + tint, then repaint what's on screen
	end
	A.applyBackdrop()
	fillSettings()                                                    -- re-tint the settings controls with the new accent (live)
	if A.rebuildHome then A.rebuildHome() end
	if MP.retheme then MP.retheme() end  -- re-colour any open multi-panels live (their content was built with the old palette)
	pcall(_KR.embersSync)  -- V4.5.57: Halloween embers follow the theme
end
-- ── Favicon rainbow glow + header-letter fly (the Home open/close special treatment) ─────────────────────
_KR._homeGen = 0  -- gen token: cancels a stale open/close if the user re-toggles mid-transition
-- Rainbow glow on the favicon border: a 2nd UIStroke (leaves the hover stroke `avs` untouched) whose gradient spins.
-- WHITE base is essential: a UIGradient MULTIPLIES the stroke Color, and UIStroke's default Color is black, so a
-- black base would multiply the rainbow to black (invisible - that was the "no glow" bug).
-- _KR._glowStroke, _KR._glowGrad, _KR._glowSpin: favicon glow parts (on _KR to save Luau registers)
local function startGlow()
	if not _KR._glowStroke then
		_KR._glowStroke = new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 3, Transparency = 1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Parent = avatar })
		_KR._glowGrad = new("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 84, 96)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.20, Color3.fromRGB(255, 186, 60)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.40, Color3.fromRGB(120, 232, 120)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.60, Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 255)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.80, Color3.fromRGB(186, 120, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 84, 96)),
		}), Parent = _KR._glowStroke })
	end
	tween(_KR._glowStroke, 0.5, { Transparency = 0.05 })
	if _KR._glowSpin then pcall(function() _KR._glowSpin:Disconnect() end) end
	-- spin the rainbow by advancing the gradient Rotation each frame (~110 deg/s). Directly setting the property
	-- via Heartbeat is more reliable than a TweenService tween on UIGradient.Rotation (which wasn't animating).
	_KR._glowSpin = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) if _KR._glowGrad and _KR._glowGrad.Parent then _KR._glowGrad.Rotation = (_KR._glowGrad.Rotation + dt * 110) % 360 end end)
end
-- V4.5.57 Halloween embers: ~24 small warm dots drifting up behind Home. Only on the Halloween theme, only while Home is
-- open, never under Reduce Motion. One Heartbeat; the dots live in a Frame under homeView so they sit behind the cards.
_KR.embersSync = function()
	local on = SET.theme == "Halloween" and homeOpen and not SET.reduceMotion and not _destroyed
	local E = _KR.embers
	if not on then if E then E.f.Visible = false; if E.c then E.c:Disconnect(); E.c = nil end end; return end
	if not E then
		local f = new("Frame", { Name = "Embers", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 0, Parent = homeView })
		E = { f = f, p = {} }; _KR.embers = E
		for i = 1, 24 do
			local d = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 0, Parent = f }); corner(d, 2)
			E.p[i] = { d = d, x = math.random(), y = math.random(), v = 0.02 + math.random() * 0.05, ph = math.random() * 6 }
		end
	end
	E.f.Visible = true
	if E.c then return end
	E.c = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		for _, q in ipairs(E.p) do
			q.y -= q.v * dt; q.ph += dt * 2; if q.y < -0.02 then q.y = 1.02; q.x = math.random() end
			q.d.Position = UDim2.fromScale(q.x + math.sin(q.ph) * 0.006, q.y); q.d.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 + 0.35 * math.sin(q.ph * 1.7)
		end
	end)
end
local function stopGlow()
	if _KR._glowStroke then tween(_KR._glowStroke, 0.45, { Transparency = 1 }) end
	if _KR._glowSpin then local sp = _KR._glowSpin; _KR._glowSpin = nil; task.delay(0.5, function() pcall(function() sp:Disconnect() end) end) end  -- keep spinning through the fade, then disconnect
end
openHome = function()
	if homeOpen or _destroyed then return end
	homeOpen = true
	if A.applyClock then pcall(A.applyClock) end  -- V4.5.57: the style clock shows the DATE only on Home (krul)
	_KR._homeGen += 1; local gen = _KR._homeGen
	-- V4.5.17 NON-INTRUSIVE: Home no longer disables the Roblox CoreGui (topbar/menu, Backpack + tool hotkeys, EmotesMenu) or hides the host game's own ScreenGuis. That combo broke the game for users ("the game UI + animations broken and impossible to access the special keys ingame"). Home is already a full-screen DIMMED backdrop, so the game UI simply shows (dimmed) behind it and stays fully usable + escapable. `_hiddenGuis` is kept (empty) so closeHome's restore + the teardown CoreGui-re-enable stay safe no-ops.
	_KR._hiddenGuis = {}
	GUIObject._hiddenGuis = _KR._hiddenGuis
	if panelOpen then closePanel() end
	MP.setVisible(false)  -- suspend the multi-panel workspace under the full-screen Home
	stopWave()
	for _, c in ipairs(homeCanvas:GetChildren()) do if not (c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIScale")) then c:Destroy() end end
	local anim = buildHome(homeCanvas)
	_KR._homeCards = anim.cards   -- V4.5.34: kept for the reverse deal-out on close
	_KR._homeLetters = anim.letters                                         -- kept so a live UI-settings change can restart the wave
	local motion = not SET.reduceMotion
	local doCards = SET.cardAnims and motion                            -- animate the card deal-in?
	fitHome()                                                           -- yields; scales the canvas. V4.5.57: measured BEFORE homePrep (its 0.97 card scale under-read the height ~3%, so a bottom-anchored layout overran its slot). homeView is still hidden here, so nothing flashes
	if not homeOpen or gen ~= _KR._homeGen then return end                  -- a close() landed during the yield
	local prep = doCards and homePrep(anim.cards) or nil                -- hide the cards so they don't flash before the reveal
	if doCards then for _, e in ipairs(anim.letters) do e.lbl.TextTransparency = 1 end end  -- hide the letters; they fade in below
	if resetSides then resetSides() end                                 -- side panels start closed each open
	homeView.Visible = true; homeView.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	fitSide(newsPanel)                                                  -- news is a centred card; the settings view scrolls instead
	A.applyBackdrop()                                                   -- tweens transparency→bgDim + blur, for the current bg/theme
	if SET.glow and motion then startGlow() end                         -- favicon rainbow glow (if enabled)
	if SET.wave and motion then startWave(anim.letters) end             -- header waves from the start (if enabled)
	if doCards then
		for i, e in ipairs(anim.letters) do                             -- letters fade in left-to-right (the wave owns their Position)
			local ll = e.lbl; task.delay(i * 0.02, function() if ll.Parent then tween(ll, 0.4, { TextTransparency = 0 }, QUINT) end end)
		end
		homeRevealCards(prep)                                           -- cards deal in
	end
	pcall(_KR.embersSync)  -- V4.5.57 Halloween embers
end
closeHome = function()
	if not homeOpen then return end
	homeOpen = false
	pcall(_KR.embersSync)
	if A.applyClock then pcall(A.applyClock) end  -- V4.5.57: back to time only
	_KR._homeGen += 1; local gen = _KR._homeGen
	-- V4.5.17 NON-INTRUSIVE: closeHome no longer force-enables CoreGui/topbar. openHome disables none, so re-enabling here would only clobber CoreGui the HOST GAME itself disabled (custom-inventory / immersion games). The _hiddenGuis restore below stays (it re-enables only game ScreenGuis WE hid = none now).
	for _, g in ipairs(_KR._hiddenGuis) do pcall(function() g.Enabled = true end) end; _KR._hiddenGuis = {}
	if SET.multiPanel then MP.setVisible(true) end  -- restore + slide the workspace back in when Home closes (setVisible re-tiles for any bar-edge / viewport change, THEN slides the panels in from their edges - so no MP.relayout(false) here, which would snap them and kill the slide-in)
	stopWave(); stopGlow()                             -- wave stops, favicon glow fades out
	do   -- V4.5.34: cards drift away in REVERSE order (shrink + fade, staggered) - the mirror of the deal-in; the header fades
		local cards = _KR._homeCards or {}
		local isCard = {}; for _, c in ipairs(cards) do isCard[c] = true end
		for _, ch in ipairs(homeCanvas:GetChildren()) do if ch:IsA("GuiObject") and not isCard[ch] then cascadeOut(ch, 0.2) end end
		if SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then
			local n = #cards
			for i = n, 1, -1 do
				local c = cards[i]
				task.delay((n - i) * 0.035 * SPEED, function()
					if not (c and c.Parent) then return end
					local sc = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or new("UIScale", { Parent = c })
					tween(sc, 0.28, { Scale = 0.94 }, QUINT); cascadeOut(c, 0.22)
				end)
			end
		else
			for _, c in ipairs(cards) do if c and c.Parent then cascadeOut(c, 0.2) end end
		end
	end
	clearPreview()                                     -- stop any running settings-preview animation loops
	if _active == "settings" then tween(settingsPanel, 0.4, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1.5, 0) }, QUINT)  -- slide the active side view OUT (it was vanishing instantly with no animation)
	elseif _active == "news" then tween(newsPanel, 0.4, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1.5, 0) }, QUINT) end
	leftBtn.Visible = false; rightBtn.Visible = false  -- hide the nav buttons during the close
	tween(homeView, 0.4, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	if _KR.homeBlur then tween(_KR.homeBlur, 0.4, { Size = 0 }) end
	task.delay(0.5 * SPEED, function()   -- V4.5.34: 0.42 -> 0.5 so the staggered deal-out finishes before teardown
		if gen ~= _KR._homeGen then return end             -- a reopen landed during the fade - leave its content alone
		homeView.Visible = false; if _KR.homeBlur then _KR.homeBlur.Enabled = false end
		for _, c in ipairs(homeCanvas:GetChildren()) do if not (c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIScale")) then c:Destroy() end end  -- tear down content so the ambient loops + stats poll stop while hidden
	end)
end
_KR._homeBusy = false  -- V4.5.16: moved off a top-level `local` onto _KR to relieve Luau's 200-live-local ceiling (Volt compiler hit it: "_homeBusy exceeded limit 200")
avatar.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if _KR._homeBusy then return end  -- debounce: ignore rapid re-clicks during the open/close transition (prevents the visual glitches)
	_KR._homeBusy = true; task.delay(math.max(0.6, 0.9 * SPEED), function() _KR._homeBusy = false end)  -- scales with the animation length (the card reveal is ~1.2s at default speed)
	if homeOpen then closeHome() else openHome() end
end)


-- hide/show: the down-chevron (transparent, no black box) COMPRESSES the whole bar into a favicon circle;
-- its content clips away as it shrinks (bar has ClipsDescendants), and tapping the circle expands it back.
_KR.chev = new("TextButton", { Name = "Chevron", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -(BAR_Y + math.floor(BAR_H * UISCALE) + 7)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Visible = false, Parent = screen })  -- hidden until reveal() - else it shows over the intro while the bar is parked off-screen
new("UIScale", { Scale = UISCALE, Parent = _KR.chev })  -- scale + sit just above the scaled bar (was floating far away on mobile)
new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 2), Rotation = 40, Parent = _KR.chev })
new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 3, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 2), Rotation = -40, Parent = _KR.chev })
-- the favicon circle the bar compresses into (and the tap-target to expand again)
-- the reopen puck lives in the TOP ScreenGui (panelScreen) so its click is never eaten by a higher layer.
-- V4.5.57: the puck is a plain surface with the avatar as its OWN child. The image used to BE the puck, so the square favicon
-- was cropped into a 56x22 strip; it also had the grey outline and looked the same in every style. Shape + place: _KR.puckGeo.
_KR.barPuck = new("ImageButton", { Name = "Puck", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -BAR_Y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BAR_H, BAR_H), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false, Image = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, Parent = panelScreen }); _KR.puckCorner = corner(_KR.barPuck, math.floor(BAR_H / 2))
new("UIScale", { Scale = UISCALE, Parent = _KR.barPuck })  -- match the scaled bar
_KR.puckFace = new("ImageLabel", { Name = "Face", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BAR_H - 14, BAR_H - 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ImageTransparency = 1, Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. LocalPlayer.UserId .. "&w=48&h=48", Parent = _KR.barPuck }); _KR.puckFaceC = corner(_KR.puckFace, math.floor((BAR_H - 14) / 2)); useKrulIcon(_KR.puckFace)
_KR.puckArrow = new("Frame", { Name = "Arrow", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -9, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 8), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = _KR.barPuck })  -- Dock: "tap to open" arrow
_KR.puckArms = { new("Frame", { Name = "Arm", BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 2), Parent = _KR.puckArrow }),
	new("Frame", { Name = "Arm", BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 3, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 2), Parent = _KR.puckArrow }) }
_KR.puckInd = new("Frame", { Name = "Indicator", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -4), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 3), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = _KR.barPuck }); corner(_KR.puckInd, 2)  -- Taskbar: the running-app accent line
-- the tap area is a separate invisible button so it can be bigger than the puck (>= 44 screen px; the Dock capsule is only 32 tall)
_KR.puckHit = new("TextButton", { Name = "Hit", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BAR_H, BAR_H), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 2, Parent = _KR.barPuck })
_KR.press(_KR.barPuck, _KR.puckHit)  -- darken on press like every other button
_KR.puckHit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
	if SET.barStyle == "Taskbar" then tween(_KR.puckInd, 0.15, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 3) })
	elseif (SET.barStyle or "Dock") == "Dock" then tween(_KR.puckArrow, 0.15, { Position = UDim2.new(1, -9, 0.5, SET.barTop and 2 or -2) }) end
end)
_KR.puckHit.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(_KR.puckInd, 0.15, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 3) }); tween(_KR.puckArrow, 0.15, { Position = UDim2.new(1, -9, 0.5, 0) }) end)
_KR.barHidden, _KR._barFullW = false, 0  -- on _KR to save Luau registers
_KR.hideBar = function()
	if _KR.barHidden then return end
	_KR.barHidden = true; _KR.dockMag(nil); closePanel(); if homeOpen then closeHome() end  -- V4.5.55: icons rest before the bar compresses
	local _bsc = bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); local _bs = (_bsc and _bsc.Scale > 0) and _bsc.Scale or UISCALE
	_KR._barFullW = bar.AbsoluteSize.X / _bs  -- logical width via the bar's LIVE UIScale (= UISCALE x barSize), so Small/Large don't overshoot the restore tween
	_KR._barFullH = math.max(BAR_H, bar.AbsoluteSize.Y / _bs)  -- V4.5.57: Minimal's column is TALL, so restore both axes
	bar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None; bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(_KR._barFullW, _KR._barFullH); _KR.chev.Visible = false
	if SET.barStyle == "Taskbar" then _KR.sClock.Visible = false end  -- the tray clock belongs to the strip
	-- V4.5.57: each style compresses into its OWN puck (krul approved demo 5JoMeGzMMMtz92hPdBsUWM).
	-- Dock: bar -> circle -> dark capsule (round avatar + open arrow). Taskbar: the strip slides into its left end, which lifts
	-- into a frosted tile with the accent line. Minimal: the column closes into its middle, leaving one quiet circle.
	local st = SET.barStyle or "Dock"
	local rm = SET.reduceMotion and 0 or 1  -- Reduce Motion: straight to the puck (the tweens below never read the setting themselves)
	local bt, dur = _KR.puckGeo("rest").bt, 0.55 * rm
	_KR.puckApply("start"); _KR.barPuck.BackgroundTransparency = 1; _KR.puckFace.ImageTransparency = 1; _KR.barPuck.Visible = true
	if st == "Taskbar" then
		dur = 0.4 * rm; tween(bar, dur, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BAR_H, BAR_H) })  -- anchored at the left edge -> slides into its first button; corners stay square
	elseif st == "Minimal" then
		dur = 0.38 * rm; local lay = bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout"); if lay then lay.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center end  -- icons clip away from both ends, not just the bottom
		tween(bar, dur, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(_KR._barFullW, 0) })
	else
		-- the avatar fades in AT circle size DURING the compress, so it never snaps in at the last second
		tween(_KR.barPuck, 0.5 * rm, { BackgroundTransparency = bt }); tween(_KR.puckFace, 0.5 * rm, { ImageTransparency = 0 })
		tween(bar, dur, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BAR_H, BAR_H) }); tween(barCorner, dur, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(BAR_H / 2)) })
	end
	task.delay(dur * SPEED, function()
		if not _KR.barHidden then return end
		bar.Visible = false
		if st ~= "Dock" then tween(_KR.barPuck, 0.2 * rm, { BackgroundTransparency = bt }); tween(_KR.puckFace, 0.2 * rm, { ImageTransparency = 0 }) end
		_KR.puckApply("rest", 0.42 * rm, BACK)  -- settle into the puck
	end)
end
_KR.showBar = function()
	if not _KR.barHidden then return end
	_KR.barHidden = false
	local st = SET.barStyle or "Dock"
	local rm = SET.reduceMotion and 0 or 1
	-- shrink the puck back into the shape the bar grows out of, then hand off (Dock: circle -> circle; Taskbar: the strip's end; Minimal: a fading dot)
	_KR.puckApply("start", 0.3 * rm)
	if st ~= "Dock" then tween(_KR.barPuck, 0.3 * rm, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }); tween(_KR.puckFace, 0.3 * rm, { ImageTransparency = 1 }) end
	task.delay(0.31 * SPEED * rm, function()
		if not _KR.barHidden then
			-- V4.5.57: measure the bar's REAL size in the CURRENT style first. The style / labels / size may have changed while it was
			-- collapsed, and growing back to the size saved at hide time gave a 541px-wide Minimal column or a 430px-tall Dock bar
			-- (and the old 0.4s styleSize ran BEFORE the 0.55s grow tween finished, so the tween's stale target won).
			A.styleSize(); task.wait()
			local _bsc = bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); local _bs = (_bsc and _bsc.Scale > 0) and _bsc.Scale or UISCALE
			local fw, fh = math.max(BAR_H, bar.AbsoluteSize.X / _bs), math.max(BAR_H, bar.AbsoluteSize.Y / _bs)
			if _KR.barHidden then return end
			_KR.barPuck.Visible = false
			local lay = bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
			bar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
			if st == "Minimal" then if lay then lay.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center end; bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fw, 0)  -- the column opens from its middle
			else bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BAR_H, BAR_H) end
			bar.Visible = true
			tween(bar, 0.55 * rm, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fw, fh) }, BACK)
			tween(barCorner, 0.55 * rm, { CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(bar, _KR.corners[barCorner] or 16) })  -- V4.5.57: the style's radius (Taskbar = square)
			task.delay(0.57 * SPEED * rm, function() if not _KR.barHidden then if lay and SET.barStyle == "Minimal" then lay.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top end; A.styleSize(); _KR.chev.Visible = true; A.applyClock(); if SET.multiPanel then pcall(MP.relayout, false) end end end)  -- after the grow tween ends (else its target overrides the style's own sizing)
		end
	end)
end
_KR.chev.MouseButton1Click:Connect(_KR.hideBar)
_KR.chevSkin = function()  -- V4.5.57: the chevron sits on the GAME (sky) in Taskbar/Minimal, not on a dark bar -> white arms + a dark outline so it reads anywhere
	local onGame = (SET.barStyle or "Dock") ~= "Dock"
	for _, a in ipairs(_KR.chev:GetChildren()) do
		if a:IsA("Frame") then
			a.BackgroundColor3 = onGame and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or T.txt2
			local st = a:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or new("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = a })
			st.Enabled = onGame; st.Transparency = 0.55
		end
	end
end
System._collapseBar = function() pcall(_KR.hideBar) end  -- V4.5.50: "Close UI on Loadup" collapses the bar to its puck (tap to reopen, works on phones too)
_KR.puckHit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if bar.Visible then return end; _KR.showBar() end)
-- V4.5.58 Undo / Redo (Player tab > History): the engine keeps the stack (System.lookUndo / lookRedo); this just reports it.
_KR.lookStep = function(dir)
	local title = (dir < 0) and "Undo" or "Redo"
	local f = System and ((dir < 0) and System.lookUndo or System.lookRedo)
	if not f then toast(title, "RoClothes is still loading.", "warn"); return end
	local ok, res = f()
	toast(title, ok and (((dir < 0) and "Back to: " or "Forward to: ") .. tostring(res)) or tostring(res), ok and "ok" or "info")
end
-- V4.5.58 PHOTO MODE (Player tab > Actions). Hides every RoClothes window but leaves the game fully playable: you walk,
-- jump and turn the camera as normal. A small toolbar (shaped per bar style) adds: Freeze pose (only when you ask for it),
-- Spin (the camera circles you while you can still move), Zoom, Filter, Blur background, Hide (toolbar shrinks to a dot)
-- and Exit. Exit puts everything back: camera type + subject, field of view, effects, frozen animations, the windows.
-- The engine's teardown also calls System._photoExit, so a DESTROY / re-execute never leaves the camera or pose stuck.
_KR.photo = function()
	if _KR.photoOn then return end
	_KR.photoOn = true
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
	local st = { fov = cam and cam.FieldOfView or 70, screens = {} }
	local conns, frozenTracks = {}, {}
	local frozen, spin, blurOn, spinA, spinD, spinH = false, false, false, 0, 12, 3
	local cc, dof
	pcall(closePanel); if homeOpen then pcall(closeHome) end; pcall(MP.closeAll); pcall(UI._dropClose)
	-- record ALL four first: turning the bar's screen off fires the GUI-hotkey listener (screen:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled")),
	-- which switches the other three off too and remembers THEM as off - recording after that saved "off" and Exit left Home dead.
	local others = { homeScreen, panelScreen, MP.screen }
	st.bar = screen.Enabled
	for _, g in ipairs(others) do if g then st.screens[g] = g.Enabled end end
	screen.Enabled = false
	for _, g in ipairs(others) do if g then g.Enabled = false end end
	local style = SET.barStyle or "Dock"
	local vert, square = style == "Minimal", style == "Taskbar"
	local sg = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "RoClothesPhoto", ResetOnSpawn = false, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 1006, Parent = PlayerGui })
	GUIObject.PhotoScreen = sg
	local tb = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BackgroundTransparency = square and 0.12 or 0.08, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = sg })
	local tbScale = math.max(UISCALE, 0.85)
	new("UIScale", { Scale = tbScale, Parent = tb })  -- not below 0.85: the buttons stay finger-sized on a phone
	if vert then  -- Minimal: a slim column on the left edge
		tb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0); tb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 0); tb.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		corner(tb, 14); pad(tb, 6, 6, 6, 6)
		new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = tb })
	elseif square then  -- Taskbar: a full-width strip along the bottom, square corners
		tb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0); tb.Size = UDim2.new(1 / tbScale, 0, 0, 52)  -- the UIScale shrinks a 100% width too: divide it back out so the strip reaches the right edge
		pad(tb, 10, 10, 8, 8)
		new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = tb })
	else  -- Dock: a floating capsule, bottom centre
		tb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -18); tb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 50); tb.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		corner(tb, 25); pad(tb, 7, 7, 7, 7)
		new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = tb })
	end
	local function btn(text, order, cb)
		local b = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BackgroundTransparency = 0.4, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = tb })
		if vert then b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38) else b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 36); b.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X end
		corner(b, square and 4 or (vert and 10 or 18)); pad(b, 14, 14, 0, 0)
		local l = lbl({ Size = vert and UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = vert and Enum.AutomaticSize.None or Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Text = text, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = vert and Enum.TextXAlignment.Left or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = b })
		_KR.press(b)
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(cb)
		local function set(on, t) if t then l.Text = t end; b.BackgroundColor3 = on and T.accentD or T.card; b.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 0.4 end
		return b, set
	end
	local function hum() local ch = LP.Character; return ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
	-- Freeze pose: pause every playing animation (and any that starts while frozen) + RoClothes' own motion
	local function freezeTrack(t) if frozenTracks[t] == nil then frozenTracks[t] = t.Speed end; pcall(function() t:AdjustSpeed(0) end) end
	local setFreezeBtn
	local function setFreeze(on)
		frozen = on
		if conns.anim then conns.anim:Disconnect(); conns.anim = nil end
		local h = hum(); local an = h and h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if on then
			if an then
				for _, t in ipairs(an:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do freezeTrack(t) end
				conns.anim = an.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(t) if frozen then freezeTrack(t) end end)
			end
		else
			for t, sp in pairs(frozenTracks) do pcall(function() if t.IsPlaying then t:AdjustSpeed((sp and sp > 0) and sp or 1) end end) end
			frozenTracks = {}
		end
		if System and System.photoFreeze then pcall(System.photoFreeze, on) end
		if setFreezeBtn then setFreezeBtn(on, on and "Unfreeze" or "Freeze pose") end
	end
	local function setSpin(on)
		spin = on
		local h, root = hum()
		if on and cam and root then
			local off = cam.CFrame.Position - root.Position
			spinA = math.atan2(off.Z, off.X); spinD = math.clamp(Vector3.new(off.X, 0, off.Z).Magnitude, 6, 40); spinH = math.clamp(off.Y, -2, 20)
			cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable  -- you still walk: movement follows the camera, which keeps circling you
		else
			spin = false
			pcall(function() cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom; if h then cam.CameraSubject = h end end)
		end
	end
	local FILTERS = {
		Warm = { Brightness = 0.02, Contrast = 0.08, Saturation = 0.1, TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 214) },
		Cool = { Brightness = 0.01, Contrast = 0.08, Saturation = 0.05, TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(214, 230, 255) },
		Vivid = { Contrast = 0.15, Saturation = 0.45 },
		Mono = { Contrast = 0.1, Saturation = -1 },
		Noir = { Brightness = -0.04, Contrast = 0.45, Saturation = -1 },
	}
	local FORDER = { "None", "Warm", "Cool", "Vivid", "Mono", "Noir" }
	local function applyFilter(name)
		local f = FILTERS[name]
		if not f then if cc then cc:Destroy(); cc = nil end; return end
		cc = cc or new("ColorCorrectionEffect", { Name = "RCPhotoFilter", Parent = cam })
		cc.Brightness = f.Brightness or 0; cc.Contrast = f.Contrast or 0; cc.Saturation = f.Saturation or 0; cc.TintColor = f.TintColor or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	local exit
	local _, setF = btn("Freeze pose", 1, function() setFreeze(not frozen) end); setFreezeBtn = setF
	local _, setS; _, setS = btn("Spin", 2, function() setSpin(not spin); setS(spin) end)
	btn("Zoom in", 3, function() if cam then cam.FieldOfView = math.max(20, cam.FieldOfView - 10) end end)
	btn("Zoom out", 4, function() if cam then cam.FieldOfView = math.min(100, cam.FieldOfView + 10) end end)
	local fi = table.find(FORDER, SET.photoFilter or "None") or 1
	local _, setFl; _, setFl = btn("Filter: " .. FORDER[fi], 5, function()
		fi = fi % #FORDER + 1; SET.photoFilter = FORDER[fi]; pcall(_KR.saveCfg)
		applyFilter(FORDER[fi]); setFl(fi > 1, "Filter: " .. FORDER[fi])
	end)
	setFl(fi > 1); applyFilter(FORDER[fi])
	local _, setB; _, setB = btn("Blur background", 6, function()
		blurOn = not blurOn; setB(blurOn)
		if blurOn then dof = dof or new("DepthOfFieldEffect", { Name = "RCPhotoBlur", FarIntensity = 0.75, NearIntensity = 0, InFocusRadius = 8, FocusDistance = 12, Parent = cam })
		elseif dof then dof:Destroy(); dof = nil end
	end)
	-- Hide: the toolbar shrinks to a small dot in its corner; tap the dot to bring it back
	local dot = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), Visible = false, Parent = sg })
	corner(dot, 17)
	if vert then dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5); dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0)
	elseif square then dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1); dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -12)
	else dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1); dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -18) end
	btn("Hide", 7, function() tb.Visible = false; dot.Visible = true end)
	dot.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() dot.Visible = false; tb.Visible = true end)
	local _, setX = btn("Exit", 8, function() exit() end); setX(true)
	-- per frame: Spin moves the camera around you (following you as you walk); Blur keeps you in focus
	conns.step = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		local _, root = hum()
		if not (cam and root) then return end
		if spin then
			spinA += dt * 0.45
			local c = root.Position
			cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(c + Vector3.new(math.cos(spinA) * spinD, spinH, math.sin(spinA) * spinD), c + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
		end
		if dof then dof.FocusDistance = (cam.CFrame.Position - root.Position).Magnitude end
	end)
	-- respawn: the old animations are gone; drop the freeze (tap Freeze again on the new character)
	conns.char = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() frozenTracks = {}; if frozen then setFreeze(false) end end)
	exit = function()
		if not _KR.photoOn then return end
		_KR.photoOn = false
		pcall(setFreeze, false)
		if spin then pcall(setSpin, false) end
		for _, c in pairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
		pcall(function() if cc then cc:Destroy() end end); pcall(function() if dof then dof:Destroy() end end)
		pcall(function() cam.FieldOfView = st.fov end)
		-- the bar first (its listener restores the others from ITS memory, possibly deferred), then ours - again after a frame so we land last
		pcall(function() screen.Enabled = st.bar end)
		local function back() for g, en in pairs(st.screens) do pcall(function() if g.Parent then g.Enabled = en end end) end end
		back(); task.defer(function() task.wait(); back() end)
		pcall(function() sg:Destroy() end)
		GUIObject.PhotoScreen = nil
		if System then System._photoExit = nil end
	end
	if System then System._photoExit = exit end
end  -- ignore taps during the hide-compress (bar still Visible): the puck sits above the bar + would fire a tween fighting the live shrink

-- ══ UI Settings apply layer ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- The controls in fillSettings() write SET; THESE functions make SET actually change the running UI.
-- Silent live rebuild of the dashboard: used when a content / privacy / visibility / theme setting changes.
-- The user is always on the settings side-view when they change a setting, so the dashboard is parked off-screen;
-- we rebuild it in place, keep it parked, and refresh _homeX so sliding back reveals the new content, centred.
A.rebuildTok = 0
A.refitHome = function()  -- re-fit Home; while UI Settings / News is showing, park it at the SAME slide offset from its NEW resting spot
	-- (V4.5.57: a layout switch moves where Home rests - Glance on the right, Start in the corner - so the old parked position could sit on screen behind Settings)
	local parked, oldX = homeScroll.Position, _homeX
	fitHome()
	local nx = homeScroll.Position; _homeX = nx
	if _active ~= "home" then homeScroll.Position = oldX and (nx + (parked - oldX)) or parked end
	if placeSideButtons then pcall(placeSideButtons) end  -- the side-view nav buttons follow Home's new spot
end
A.rebuildHome = function()
	if not homeOpen then return end
	A.rebuildTok += 1; local tok = A.rebuildTok
	task.delay(0.04, function()  -- coalesce rapid changes (e.g. Streamer flips 4 flags) into a single rebuild
		if tok ~= A.rebuildTok or not homeOpen then return end
		for _, c in ipairs(homeCanvas:GetChildren()) do if not (c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIScale")) then c:Destroy() end end
		local anim = buildHome(homeCanvas)
		_KR._homeLetters = anim.letters
		A.refitHome()                                                -- content size may have changed; re-fit, keep it parked while a side view shows
		if SET.wave and not SET.reduceMotion then startWave(_KR._homeLetters) end  -- new letters -> restart the wave
		if SET.glow and not SET.reduceMotion then startGlow() end             -- re-engage the favicon glow too (Reset sets glow ON but only rebuildHome runs after - startGlow is idempotent, avatar is stable)
	end)
end
-- V4.5.57: the collapsed puck per bar style. "start" = the shape the bar compresses into (and grows back out of),
-- "rest" = the settled puck. Sizes are logical (the puck has the bar's UIScale); positions are screen px like the bar's.
_KR.puckGeo = function(stage)
	local st = SET.barStyle or "Dock"
	local s = _KR.barPuck:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); local f = (s and s.Scale > 0) and s.Scale or UISCALE
	local g = { m = math.ceil(44 / f) }  -- tap area: at least 44 SCREEN px
	if st == "Taskbar" then  -- the strip's left end -> a frosted tile just off the edge
		local ay = SET.barTop and 0 or 1; local sg = SET.barTop and 1 or -1; local topY = SET.barTop and GUI_INSET.Y or 0
		g.ap, g.bg, g.bt, g.fr = Vector2.new(0, ay), _KR.light() and Color3.fromRGB(246, 246, 250) or Color3.fromRGB(34, 36, 44), 0.2, 6
		if stage == "start" then g.pos, g.w, g.h, g.r, g.fs, g.fy = UDim2.new(0, 0, ay, topY), BAR_H, BAR_H, 0, 22, 0
		else g.pos, g.w, g.h, g.r, g.fs, g.fy = UDim2.new(0, 8, ay, topY + sg * 8), 46, 46, 8, 26, -2 end
	elseif st == "Minimal" then  -- one circle centred on the column, the same glass as the column's buttons
		g.ap, g.bg, g.bt, g.fy = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), _KR.light() and Color3.fromRGB(250, 250, 252) or Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 22), _KR.light() and 0.25 or 0.42, 0
		g.pos = UDim2.new(0, 14 + math.floor(BAR_H * f / 2), 0.5, 0)
		if stage == "start" then g.w, g.h, g.fs = 26, 26, 20 else g.w, g.h, g.fs = 44, 44, 32 end
		g.r, g.fr = g.w / 2, g.fs / 2
	else  -- Dock: at the bar's own anchor, so the bar compresses straight into it
		local ax, pxS, pxO = 0.5, 0.5, 0
		if SET.barSide == "Left" then ax, pxS, pxO = 0, 0, 14 elseif SET.barSide == "Right" then ax, pxS, pxO = 1, 1, -14 end
		g.ap, g.bg, g.bt, g.fy = Vector2.new(ax, SET.barTop and 0 or 1), T.bg, _KR.glass or 0, 0
		g.pos = SET.barTop and UDim2.new(pxS, pxO, 0, BAR_Y) or UDim2.new(pxS, pxO, 1, -BAR_Y)
		if stage == "start" then g.w, g.h, g.fx, g.fs = BAR_H, BAR_H, 7, BAR_H - 14 else g.w, g.h, g.fx, g.fs = 72, 32, 4, 24 end
		g.r, g.fr = g.h / 2, g.fs / 2
	end
	return g
end
_KR.puckApply = function(stage, dur, ease)  -- dur nil = instant
	local g, P, F = _KR.puckGeo(stage), _KR.barPuck, _KR.puckFace
	local rest, st = stage == "rest", SET.barStyle or "Dock"
	P.AnchorPoint = g.ap; P.BackgroundColor3 = g.bg
	F.AnchorPoint = g.fx and Vector2.new(0, 0.5) or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	_KR.puckHit.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(g.w, g.m), math.max(g.h, g.m))
	local pp = { Position = g.pos, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(g.w, g.h) }
	local fp = { Position = g.fx and UDim2.new(0, g.fx, 0.5, g.fy) or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, g.fy), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(g.fs, g.fs) }
	if dur then
		tween(P, dur, pp, ease); tween(F, dur, fp, ease)
		tween(_KR.puckCorner, dur, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, g.r) }); tween(_KR.puckFaceC, dur, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, g.fr) })
	else
		P.Position, P.Size, F.Position, F.Size = pp.Position, pp.Size, fp.Position, fp.Size
		_KR.puckCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, g.r); _KR.puckFaceC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, g.fr)
		if rest and _KR.barHidden and not bar.Visible then P.BackgroundTransparency = g.bt; F.ImageTransparency = 0 end  -- style / theme changed while collapsed
	end
	-- the style's extra mark, only on the settled puck: Dock = an arrow pointing where the bar opens, Taskbar = the accent line
	local up = not SET.barTop
	_KR.puckArms[1].Rotation = up and -40 or 40; _KR.puckArms[2].Rotation = up and 40 or -40
	_KR.puckArms[1].BackgroundColor3, _KR.puckArms[2].BackgroundColor3, _KR.puckInd.BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2, T.txt2, T.accent
	local at, it = (rest and st == "Dock") and 0 or 1, (rest and st == "Taskbar") and 0 or 1
	for _, a in ipairs(_KR.puckArms) do tween(a, rest and 0.25 or 0.1, { BackgroundTransparency = at }) end
	tween(_KR.puckInd, rest and 0.25 or 0.1, { BackgroundTransparency = it })
end
-- Move the whole SmartBar (+ puck + chevron) to the top or bottom edge.
A.barPos = function()
	local sh = math.floor(BAR_H * UISCALE * (SET.barSize or 1))
	local ax, pxS, pxO = 0.5, 0.5, 0   -- Dock side (SET.barSide): horizontal anchor + position. Center default; Left/Right hug the edge with a 14px margin.
	if SET.barSide == "Left" then ax, pxS, pxO = 0, 0, 14
	elseif SET.barSide == "Right" then ax, pxS, pxO = 1, 1, -14 end
	A.styleSize()
	_KR.puckApply(_KR.barHidden and "rest" or "start")  -- V4.5.57: the puck's place + shape per style (a style change while collapsed re-skins it)
	local st = SET.barStyle or "Dock"
	if st == "Taskbar" then  -- V4.5.57: full-width strip flush with the edge; puck + chevron at its left end; tray clock at its right end
		local ay = SET.barTop and 0 or 1; local sg = SET.barTop and 1 or -1
		local topY = SET.barTop and GUI_INSET.Y or 0  -- a full-width strip at y=0 would sit UNDER Roblox's own top bar (menu / chat buttons) -> start below it
		bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, ay); bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, ay, topY)
		_KR.chev.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, ay); _KR.chev.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, ay, topY + sg * (sh + 7))
		_KR.sClock.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, ay); _KR.sClock.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, ay, topY + sg * math.floor((sh - 40 * UISCALE) / 2))
		if SET.multiPanel then MP.relayout(true) end
		return
	elseif st == "Minimal" then  -- V4.5.57: a vertical icon column on the left edge; big clock in the top-right corner
		bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5); bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0)
		_KR.chev.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1); _KR.chev.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14 + math.floor(_KR.colW() / 2), 0.5, -math.floor(bar.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2) - 7)
		_KR.sClock.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0); _KR.sClock.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, GUI_INSET.Y + 12)
		if SET.multiPanel then MP.relayout(true) end
		return
	end
	if SET.barTop then
		bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, 0); bar.Position = UDim2.new(pxS, pxO, 0, BAR_Y)
		_KR.chev.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, 0); _KR.chev.Position = UDim2.new(pxS, pxO, 0, BAR_Y + sh + 7)
	else
		bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, 1); bar.Position = UDim2.new(pxS, pxO, 1, -BAR_Y)
		_KR.chev.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, 1); _KR.chev.Position = UDim2.new(pxS, pxO, 1, -(BAR_Y + sh + 7))
	end
	if SET.multiPanel then MP.relayout(true) end  -- docked panels re-tile to the bar's NEW edge (relayout reads SET.barTop). Covers both the "bar" toggle and Reset. No-op when no panels are open.
	if _KR.replacePanel then _KR.replacePanel() end  -- V4.5.57: an open single panel follows the bar too (it stayed at the old edge)
end
-- Auto-hide: while nothing is open and the bar sits idle for 4s, compress it to the puck. Tapping the puck restores it.
A.autoConn = nil; A.lastActive = os.clock()
A.stopAuto = function() if A.autoConn then pcall(function() A.autoConn:Disconnect() end); A.autoConn = nil end end
A.startAuto = function()
	A.lastActive = os.clock()
	if A.autoConn then return end
	A.autoConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not SET.autoHide then return end
		if panelOpen or homeOpen or _KR.barHidden then A.lastActive = os.clock(); return end  -- in use → keep it up
		if os.clock() - A.lastActive > 4 then _KR.hideBar() end                                -- idle → auto-hide
	end)
end
bar.MouseEnter:Connect(function() A.lastActive = os.clock() end)  -- hovering the bar is activity (don't auto-hide out from under the cursor)
-- UI TRANSPARENCY: make the UI SEE-THROUGH by fading each SURFACE (backgrounds / images / outlines / scrollbars) from
-- its crisp base, while TEXT stays fully opaque and gets a dark contrast outline so it reads over the game behind it.
-- History (do not repeat): a CanvasGroup pixelated (low-res offscreen buffer, PC + mobile); fading text made it vanish
-- (GC-compounding) AND fought the hover/entrance/glow text tweens. Surfaces-only + solid outlined text is the method that works.
