_KR.fadeProps, _KR.strokeProps = { "BackgroundTransparency", "ImageTransparency", "ScrollBarImageTransparency" }, { "Transparency" }  -- SURFACE props for GuiObjects (bg / image / scrollbar) vs a UIStroke's OWN .Transparency. *** THE BUG (found 0712): GuiObjects must get ONLY the three named props, NEVER a bare "Transparency". Roblox's GuiObject.Transparency is a COMBINED property whose setter ALSO writes TextTransparency + ImageTransparency -- so fading it silently faded the TEXT. That is why "surfaces-only" STILL killed text. UIStroke.Transparency (strokeProps) is a separate, safe thing, applied only to UIStrokes below.
local function _pruneFadeCache()
	local cache = _KR.fadeCache
	if not cache then _KR.fadeIn = nil; return end
	local seen, write = {}, 1
	for read = 1, #cache do
		local e, o = cache[read], cache[read][1]
		if o and o.Parent then cache[write] = e; write += 1; seen[o] = true end
	end
	for i = write, #cache do cache[i] = nil end
	_KR.fadeIn = seen  -- rebuild the set from retained entries so destroyed UI releases both references
end
-- V4.5.57: the collapsed puck stays solid. It is the only way back into the UI, and the cache captured its HIDDEN state
-- (transparency 1) when transparency was turned on with the bar open, so a later slider tick erased the collapsed puck.
_KR.puckSkip = function(o) return o == _KR.barPuck or o:IsDescendantOf(_KR.barPuck) or (_KR.wall ~= nil and (o == _KR.wall or o:IsDescendantOf(_KR.wall))) end  -- the wallpaper too: UI transparency must not fade it, nor save it hidden
A.applyTrans = function()  -- UI transparency = see-through SURFACES, solid TEXT. PERF: walk the tree + capture each target's crisp BASE only ONCE per engage, into _KR.fadeCache; every later slider tick just re-sets that cached list. (Before, every drag tick did a full GetDescendants + pcall-read + GetAttribute on the WHOLE UI -> thousands of allocations per tick -> the drag lagged.)
	local t = math.clamp((SET.uiTrans or 0) / 100, 0, 0.92)
	if t <= 0 then
		if _KR.fadeCache then for _, e in ipairs(_KR.fadeCache) do if e[1].Parent then e[1][e[2]] = e[3] end end; _KR.fadeCache, _KR.fadeIn = nil, nil end  -- OFF -> restore every target to its crisp base, drop the cache + seen-set (next engage re-walks from the now-crisp UI, so bases stay correct + new UI is picked up)
		return
	end
	-- V4.5.70 (mobile perf): the prune (walk + new seen-set) ran on EVERY slider tick; the hot loop below already skips
	-- dead entries, so prune at most every 2 s (it only releases references to destroyed UI)
	if _KR.fadeCache and os.clock() - (_KR.fadePrunedAt or 0) > 2 then _KR.fadePrunedAt = os.clock(); _pruneFadeCache() end
	if not _KR.fadeCache then  -- ENGAGE (0 -> >0): ONE walk. cache = { {inst, prop, base, isStroke}, ... }; seen = set of cached instances (so _KR.fadeInto can fold a later-opened panel in without double-capturing what's already here). Surfaces fade from base; every text label gets a dark contrast outline (its FILL is never touched).
		local cache, seen = {}, {}
		for _, sg in ipairs({ screen, homeScreen, panelScreen, MP.screen }) do
			if sg then for _, o in ipairs(sg:GetDescendants()) do
				if _KR.puckSkip(o) then continue end
				local props = o:IsA("UIStroke") and _KR.strokeProps or (o:IsA("GuiObject") and _KR.fadeProps)  -- UIStroke -> its own .Transparency; GuiObject -> ONLY bg/image/scrollbar (NEVER the combined .Transparency, which also fades text)
				if props then for _, p in ipairs(props) do
					local ok, cur = pcall(function() return o[p] end)
					if ok and type(cur) == "number" then cache[#cache + 1] = { o, p, cur, false }; seen[o] = true end
				end end
				if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
					cache[#cache + 1] = { o, "TextStrokeTransparency", o.TextStrokeTransparency, true }; seen[o] = true
					pcall(function() o.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0) end)   -- dark outline colour, set ONCE here; its strength (transparency) is driven per-tick below
				end
			end end
		end
		_KR.fadeCache, _KR.fadeIn = cache, seen
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(_KR.fadeCache) do  -- HOT PATH (per tick): cheap re-set. Parent-guarded so a since-destroyed element is skipped (no pcall needed).
		local o = e[1]
		if o.Parent then o[e[2]] = e[4] and math.min(e[3], 1 - t) or (e[3] + (1 - e[3]) * t) end  -- isStroke -> stronger outline as t rises; surface -> fade from its base
	end
end
_KR.fadeInto = function(root)  -- fade a freshly-built subtree (e.g. a panel opened AFTER UI-transparency was turned up) to the current level + add it to the cache so it also tracks the slider. Skips anything already cached (via _KR.fadeIn) so a persistent frame isn't double-captured (which would compound). No-op unless transparency is engaged.
	local t = math.clamp((SET.uiTrans or 0) / 100, 0, 0.92)
	if t <= 0 or not _KR.fadeCache then return end
	_pruneFadeCache()
	local list = root:GetDescendants(); list[#list + 1] = root  -- include the panel frame itself
	for _, o in ipairs(list) do
		if not _KR.fadeIn[o] and not _KR.puckSkip(o) then
			local props = o:IsA("UIStroke") and _KR.strokeProps or (o:IsA("GuiObject") and _KR.fadeProps)
			if props then for _, p in ipairs(props) do
				local ok, cur = pcall(function() return o[p] end)
				if ok and type(cur) == "number" then _KR.fadeCache[#_KR.fadeCache + 1] = { o, p, cur, false }; o[p] = cur + (1 - cur) * t; _KR.fadeIn[o] = true end
			end end
			if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
				_KR.fadeCache[#_KR.fadeCache + 1] = { o, "TextStrokeTransparency", o.TextStrokeTransparency, true }; _KR.fadeIn[o] = true
				pcall(function() o.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0); o.TextStrokeTransparency = math.min(o.TextStrokeTransparency, 1 - t) end)
			end
		end
	end
end
A.reset = function()
	SET.wave, SET.glow, SET.cardAnims, SET.animSpeed, SET.toastAnims, SET.hoverFx, SET.reduceMotion, SET.ambient = true, true, true, 100, true, true, false, true
	SET.uiTrans, SET.density, SET.blur, SET.barTop, SET.autoHide, SET.multiPanel, SET.barAvatar = 0, "Comfy", true, false, false, false, false  -- multiPanel/barAvatar were omitted → Reset left it ON
	SET.privacy, SET.hideName, SET.hideLocation, SET.blurAvatar = false, false, false, false
	SET.bg, SET.theme, SET.accent = "Blur", "Vampiric Noir", A.themes["Vampiric Noir"].accent
	SET.corner = 100; A.applyCorner()   -- restore default roundness across every registered corner
	SET.glass = 0; A.applyGlass()        -- restore fully opaque panels
	SET.clockShow, SET.clock24, SET.barSide = true, true, "Center"; A.applyClock()   -- clock shown + 24h; barSide re-applied by the A.barPos() call below
	SET.barLabels = false; A.applyBarLabels()   -- bar buttons back to drawn icons
	SET.barSize = 1; A.applyBarSize()           -- bar back to default size
	SET.hiddenTabs = {}; A.applyTabs()          -- V4.5.52: every SmartBar tab back
	SET.notify, SET.toastPos = true, "Top-right"; A.applyToast()   -- behavior back to defaults
	SET.toastTime, SET.dockMag, SET.dockMagAmt, SET.pressFx = 100, true, 142, true; _KR.dockMag(nil)  -- V4.5.55 extras
	if SET.uiFont ~= "Gotham" then SET.uiFont = "Gotham"; A.applyFont() end
	SET.mode, SET.contrast, SET.accentGrad, SET.accentAnim, SET.tabColours, SET.tabIntensity = "Dark", "Standard", "Off", "Off", "Colourful", 100
	SET.textScale, SET.blurAmt, SET.wallpaper, SET.wallDim, SET.panelTint, SET.shadows, SET.apSub = 100, 50, "", 45, 0, "Off", "Colour"
	SET.wallOpacity = 100
	pcall(A.applyTextScale)
	pcall(_KR.loadWall)
	pcall(_KR.applyShadows)
	pcall(_KR.accAnimSync)
	SET.custom = { accent2 = TDEF.accent2, card = TDEF.card, bg = TDEF.bg, text = TDEF.txt }
	SPEED = BASE_SPEED
	A.stopAuto(); if _KR.barHidden then _KR.showBar() end; MP.closeAll()   -- reset turns Multi-Panel off → close any docked panels
	SET.barStyle = "Dock"; SET.homeLayout = "Auto"; SET.panelLayout = "Auto"; A.applyStyle()   -- V4.5.57: back to the Dock style + Auto layouts (also runs A.barPos)
	useKrulIcon(avatar)   -- reset → Krul brand icon is the default bar favicon again
	densify()             -- density reset to Comfy → restore full gaps (+ rescale what's on screen) BEFORE the rebuild below, else it re-lays at stale Compact spacing
	A.applyTheme(false)   -- restores T.accent + backdrop; it already rebuilds the settings controls (fillSettings) AND re-fits the home at 100%
	A.applyTrans()        -- clear any UI transparency (uiTrans reset to 0)
	toast("UI Settings", "Reset to defaults.", "warn")
end
A.applyCorner = function()  -- live GLOBAL corner roundness: rescale every registered UICorner from its stored base radius
	_KR.cornerScale = (SET.corner or 100) / 100
	for c, base in pairs(_KR.corners) do pcall(function() c.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(c.Parent, base) end) end  -- clamps to a pill instead of going square
end
A.applyGlass = function()  -- glassy panels: fade the SmartBar + tab/docked panel backdrops AND every cell (rowShell row), all registered in _KR.panels. Text / icons / strokes are children, so they stay crisp; only the FILLS go translucent.
	_KR.glass = (SET.glass or 0) / 100
	for f in pairs(_KR.panels) do if f.Parent then f.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(f:GetAttribute("rcBaseT") or 0, _KR.glass) end end  -- V4.5.57: a style skin's own see-through floor (rcBaseT) stays  -- Parent guard (not pcall): cheaper now that every cell is registered, and a since-destroyed frame is just skipped
end
A.clockText = function()  -- 24h straight from FormatLocalTime; 12h derived MANUALLY (don't rely on locale AM/PM pattern support, which may be why it "didn't change")
	local ok, s = pcall(function() return DateTime.now():FormatLocalTime("HH:mm", "en-us") end)
	if not ok or type(s) ~= "string" or #s < 5 then return "--:--" end
	if SET.clock24 then return s end
	local hh = tonumber(s:sub(1, 2)) or 0; local mm = s:sub(4, 5)
	local ap = hh >= 12 and "PM" or "AM"; local h12 = hh % 12; if h12 == 0 then h12 = 12 end
	return string.format("%d:%s %s", h12, mm, ap)
end
A.applyClock = function()  -- SmartBar clock: show/hide it + its divider, widen for 12h, and REFRESH the text NOW (don't wait up to 5s for the loop)
	local dock = (SET.barStyle or "Dock") == "Dock"  -- V4.5.57: only Dock has the in-bar clock; Taskbar/Minimal use the style clock
	clock.Visible = SET.clockShow and dock
	local d = bar:FindFirstChild("ClockDiv"); if d then d.Visible = SET.clockShow and dock end
	clock.Size = UDim2.new(0, SET.clock24 and 46 or 72, 1, 0)  -- 12h ("12:45 PM") needs more room than 24h ("15:45")
	clock.Text = A.clockText()   -- instant feedback on toggle
	_KR.sClock.Visible = SET.clockShow and not dock and _KR.barShown == true and not (SET.barStyle == "Taskbar" and _KR.barHidden) and (SET.barStyle ~= "Minimal" or (homeOpen == true and not (_KR.HOMES[_KR.homeLay()] or {}).clock))  -- V4.5.57: Minimal's corner clock lives on the Home page only (krul)
	if A.applyToast then pcall(A.applyToast) end  -- notifications re-place around the (now shown / hidden) corner clock
	A.styleClock()
end
A.styleClock = function()  -- V4.5.57: time (always) + day/date (ONLY while Home is open - krul: the date belongs on the Home page)
	_KR.sTime.Text = A.clockText()
	local showDate = homeOpen == true
	_KR.sDate.Visible = showDate
	local big = SET.barStyle == "Minimal"
	if showDate then _KR.sTime.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	else _KR.sTime.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, big and 0 or 9) end  -- Taskbar tray: time alone sits centred in the strip
	local ok, s = pcall(function() return DateTime.now():FormatLocalTime(SET.barStyle == "Minimal" and "dddd, MMM D" or "ddd, MMM D", "en-us") end)
	_KR.sDate.Text = ok and type(s) == "string" and s or ""
end
_KR.replacePanel = function()  -- V4.5.57: after the bar moved / restyled, glide an OPEN single panel to where it opens now (Dock = bar width, centred; Taskbar = start menu; Minimal = beside the column)
	task.defer(function()
		if not (panelOpen and activeTab) then return end
		local pw = PANEL_W; if (SET.barStyle or "Dock") == "Dock" and bar.AbsoluteSize.X > 10 then pw = math.clamp(math.floor(bar.AbsoluteSize.X / UISCALE), 300, math.max(300, ((workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X) or vp.X) - 24)) end
		_KR._panelFullW = pw
		local p, s = panelOpenRect(pw); _KR.spring(panel, "Position", p, 2.6, 1); _KR.spring(panel, "Size", s, 2.6, 1)
	end)
end
A.styleSize = function()  -- V4.5.57: the bar's own size per style (Dock = auto width, Taskbar = full screen width, Minimal = auto height)
	if _KR.barHidden then return end
	local st = SET.barStyle or "Dock"
	local f = UISCALE * (SET.barSize or 1)
	if st == "Taskbar" then
		local w = (screen.AbsoluteSize.X > 0) and screen.AbsoluteSize.X or vp.X
		bar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None; bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.ceil(w / f) + 2, BAR_H)
	elseif st == "Minimal" then
		if SET.barLabels then bar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY; bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) else bar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BAR_H, 0) end  -- Labels: the column is as wide as its longest name
	else
		bar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, BAR_H)
	end
end
A.applyPanelLayout = function()  -- V4.5.57: re-skin the single panel's frame + header and REBUILD every open surface so each row / control picks up the panel layout
	local k = _KR.skin()
	panel:SetAttribute("rcBaseT", k.panelT); _KR.corners[panelCorner] = k.panelR
	_KR.headLay(); pIconHost.Visible = not (panelOpen and _KR.panelLay() == "Sheet")
	if panelOpen and activeTab then panel.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(k.panelT, _KR.glass); panelCorner.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(panel, k.panelR); buildPage(activeTab) end
	if MP.retheme then pcall(MP.retheme) end
	if _KR.barShown then pcall(fillSettings) end  -- the UI Settings rows are rowShell cells too
	if _KR.newsStyle then pcall(_KR.newsStyle) end  -- V4.5.57: News follows the panel layout (reader / Windows page / editorial)
	pcall(_KR.cornerPass, settingsPanel); pcall(_KR.cornerPass, newsPanel); if fitSide then pcall(fitSide, newsPanel) end  -- V4.5.57: the Settings + News views' boxes, and News re-fits around the (new) bar
	_KR.styleCard(_dCard)  -- the option picker
	if _KR.modalCard then _KR.styleCard(_KR.modalCard) end  -- dialogs
	if A.rebuildHome then pcall(A.rebuildHome) end  -- Home cards are tinted with the skin
	pcall(function() local f = (_KR.panelLay() == "Classic") and Enum.Font.Sarpanch or FONTB; if GUIObject.topHPDisplay then GUIObject.topHPDisplay.Font = f end; if GUIObject.bottomHPDisplay then GUIObject.bottomHPDisplay.Font = f end end)  -- the hardcore HP display: the UI font outside Classic

	for _, host in ipairs({ game:GetService("CoreGui"), (gethui and pcall(gethui) and gethui()) or nil }) do pcall(function() for _, c in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do if _KR.FOREIGN[c.Name] then pcall(_KR.restyleForeign, c) end end end) end
end
_KR.paintTabs = function()  -- V4.5.57: re-colour the Dock tiles from _KR.tabCol (no restyle / rebuild, safe while a slider drags)
	if (SET.barStyle or "Dock") ~= "Dock" then return end
	for _, t in pairs(tabs) do local b = t.btn; if b and t.col then local tc = _KR.tabCol(t.col); b.BackgroundColor3 = tc; local g = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient"); if g then g.Color = ColorSequence.new(tc, tc:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.32)) end end end
end
A.applyStyle = function()  -- V4.5.57 UI styles: re-skin the SmartBar (layout, surface, tiles) + place it/the clock via A.barPos
	local st = SET.barStyle or "Dock"
	if _KR.hpSkin then pcall(_KR.hpSkin) end  -- the Hardcore HP card + phone Heal/Tear buttons follow the style
	local lay, bpad = bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout"), bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
	local bstroke, bgrad = bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"), bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
	_KR.dockMag(nil)
	if st == "Minimal" then
		lay.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical; lay.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center; lay.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top; lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
		bpad.PaddingLeft, bpad.PaddingRight, bpad.PaddingTop, bpad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 0), UDim.new(0, 0), UDim.new(0, 12), UDim.new(0, 12)
	else
		lay.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal; lay.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left; lay.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
		lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, st == "Taskbar" and 8 or 14)
		bpad.PaddingLeft, bpad.PaddingRight, bpad.PaddingTop, bpad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, st == "Taskbar" and 14 or 18), UDim.new(0, 18), UDim.new(0, 0), UDim.new(0, 0)
	end
	-- surface: Dock = the themed solid/glassy bar; Taskbar = a dark fade from the edge (no box); Minimal = no surface at all
	_KR.panels[bar] = (st == "Dock") or nil  -- only Dock follows the "glassy panels" setting
	if bstroke then bstroke.Enabled = false end  -- the UI is outline-free (stroke() is created disabled); re-enabling it here drew a border round the Dock bar
	if st == "Dock" then
		bar.BackgroundColor3 = T.bg; bar.BackgroundTransparency = _KR.glass or 0
		if bgrad then bgrad.Rotation = 90; bgrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 212)); bgrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0) end  -- a WHITE-based shade: a UIGradient multiplies the base, so the old (T.bg2, T.bg) pair turned the bar near-black, darker than every panel
	elseif st == "Taskbar" then
		bar.BackgroundColor3 = _KR.light() and Color3.fromRGB(236, 236, 242) or Color3.fromRGB(8, 10, 14); bar.BackgroundTransparency = 0  -- V4.5.57: light strip in Light mode
		if bgrad then bgrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1)); bgrad.Rotation = SET.barTop and -90 or 90; bgrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0.35) end  -- clear at the inner edge -> darker at the screen edge
	else
		bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	end
	_KR.corners[barCorner] = (st == "Taskbar") and 0 or 16; barCorner.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(bar, _KR.corners[barCorner])
	-- tiles: Dock keeps each tab's colour; Taskbar = bare icons; Minimal = round dark glass buttons
	for _, t in pairs(tabs) do
		local b = t.btn; local g = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient"); local c = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
		if st == "Dock" then local tc = _KR.tabCol(t.col) or b.BackgroundColor3; b.BackgroundColor3 = tc; b.BackgroundTransparency = 0; if g then g.Enabled = true; g.Color = ColorSequence.new(tc, tc:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.32)) end  -- V4.5.57 Tab colours
		elseif st == "Taskbar" then b.BackgroundTransparency = 1; if g then g.Enabled = false end
		else b.BackgroundColor3 = _KR.light() and Color3.fromRGB(250, 250, 252) or Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 22); b.BackgroundTransparency = _KR.light() and 0.25 or 0.4; if g then g.Enabled = false end end
		if c then _KR.corners[c] = (st == "Minimal") and 40 or 11; c.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(b, _KR.corners[c]) end
		for _, ch in ipairs(b:GetChildren()) do  -- the hover fill is a full-face Frame with its OWN corner (11) -> a rounded SQUARE glowing inside the round Minimal button (krul). Match the button.
			if ch:IsA("Frame") and ch.Name ~= "PressShade" and ch.Size == UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) then local hc = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner"); if hc then _KR.corners[hc] = _KR.corners[c] or 11; hc.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(ch, _KR.corners[hc]) end end
		end
	end
	do  -- V4.5.57 light mode: white glyphs vanish on the light Taskbar strip / light Minimal tiles -> draw them in the text colour (Dock icons sit on coloured tiles, stay white)
		local icCol = (_KR.light() and st ~= "Dock") and T.txt or IC
		for _, t in pairs(tabs) do
			if t.icon then for _, f in ipairs(t.icon:GetDescendants()) do if f:IsA("Frame") and f.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then f.BackgroundColor3 = icCol elseif f:IsA("UIStroke") then f.Color = icCol elseif f:IsA("TextLabel") then f.TextColor3 = icCol end end end
			if t.label then t.label.TextColor3 = icCol end
		end
	end
	-- the multi-panel "open" dot: Dock = above the tile; Taskbar = an underline (its active-tab language); Minimal = above the circle
	for _, t in pairs(tabs) do
		if t.dot then
			if st == "Taskbar" then t.dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1); t.dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 4); t.dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 3); t.dot.BackgroundColor3 = T.accent  -- same accent underline as the single-panel pill
			else t.dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0); t.dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -7); t.dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6); t.dot.BackgroundColor3 = IC end
		end
	end
	-- style clock: small two-line tray (Taskbar) or a big corner clock (Minimal)
	local big = st == "Minimal"
	_KR.sClock.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, big and 58 or 40)
	_KR.sTime.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, big and 38 or 22); _KR.sTime.TextSize = big and 36 or 16
	_KR.sDate.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, big and 40 or 22); _KR.sDate.TextSize = big and 13 or 12
	if SET.barLabels then pcall(A.applyBarLabels) end  -- label widths differ per style (Minimal = one shared width)
	A.barPos()
	A.applyClock()
	pcall(A.applyToast)  -- notifications step around the style's clock / strip
	if _KR.movePill then pcall(_KR.movePill, activeTab, true) end
	A.applyPanelLayout()  -- panels / rows / Home follow the (Auto) panel + Home layouts
	if panelOpen and activeTab then _KR.replacePanel() end
	A.applyBackdrop()  -- an Auto Home layout may have changed with the style
	if _KR.updateButtons then pcall(_KR.updateButtons) end
	_KR.chevSkin()
	pcall(_KR.applyShadows)  -- V4.5.57: the Dock bar shadow only exists in Dock
	if _KR.srchSkinBtn then pcall(_KR.srchSkinBtn) end  -- V4.5.57: the search button follows the bar style
end
bar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()  -- V4.5.57: Minimal's chevron sits above the column, whose height follows the visible tabs
	if SET.barStyle == "Minimal" and not _KR.barHidden then local sh = math.floor(BAR_H * UISCALE * (SET.barSize or 1)); _KR.chev.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14 + math.floor(_KR.colW() / 2), 0.5, -math.floor(bar.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2) - 7) end
end)
-- V4.5.57: the base UI size (UISCALE) and the panel height were decided ONCE at execute time, so executing in a small window and
-- then maximising left the bar / panels / dialogs tiny (or cut off the other way). On a settled resize: recompute both, move every
-- UIScale that carried the old size to the new one, then re-place the bar, an open panel, Settings and News.
_KR.uiRescale = function()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera; if not cam then return end
	local v = cam.ViewportSize; if v.X < 50 or v.Y < 50 then return end
	local ns = math.clamp(math.min(v.X / 1500, v.Y / 860), 0.58, 1.0)
	pcall(function() if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and UserInputService.AccelerometerEnabled then ns = math.max(0.5, ns * 0.66) end end)  -- same rule as at boot
	vp = v
	PANEL_H = math.max(120, math.floor(math.min(328, v.Y - 124)))
	local old = UISCALE
	if math.abs(ns - old) < 0.01 then return end
	UISCALE = ns
	for _, root in ipairs(_KR.paintRoots()) do for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("UIScale") and math.abs(d.Scale - old) < 1e-4 then d.Scale = ns end
	end end
	pcall(A.applyBarSize)  -- bar + chevron + puck (UISCALE x bar size), re-places the bar and re-fits Home
	pcall(fitSettings); if newsPanel then pcall(fitSide, newsPanel) end
	if _KR.replacePanel then pcall(_KR.replacePanel) end
	if SET.multiPanel and MP.relayout then pcall(MP.relayout, false) end
	if A.applyToast then pcall(A.applyToast) end
	-- the parked side views were pushed off-screen by the OLD width: a wider window brought them on screen (krul: "other UI appears when maximizing")
	pcall(function()
		for _, n in ipairs({ "settings", "news" }) do
			if _active ~= n then local side = (ORDER[n] < ORDER[_active]) and -1 or 1; viewOf(n).Position = UDim2.new(0.5, side * (vp.X + 40), 0.5, 0) end
		end
	end)
	if homeOpen and A.refitHome then pcall(A.refitHome) end  -- Home re-centres (or re-parks at the new offset)
	if placeSideButtons then pcall(placeSideButtons) end  -- the < > nav buttons follow the new edges
end
if workspace.CurrentCamera then MP.styleVpConn = workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
	_KR._rsTok = (_KR._rsTok or 0) + 1; local rtok = _KR._rsTok
	task.delay(0.4, function() if rtok == _KR._rsTok then pcall(_KR.uiRescale) end end)  -- V4.5.57: rescale once the resize settles
	if SET.barStyle == "Taskbar" then A.styleSize() end
	if homeOpen then  -- V4.5.57: Home follows a window resize / phone rotation (it only fitted on open), and switches tall <-> wide arrangement
		_KR._vpTok = (_KR._vpTok or 0) + 1; local tok = _KR._vpTok
		task.delay(0.25, function()
			if tok ~= _KR._vpTok or not homeOpen then return end
			if _KR.HL.wide() ~= _KR._hlWideBuilt then A.rebuildHome() else A.refitHome() end
		end)
	end
end) end  -- the strip follows a window resize
A.applyBarLabels = function()  -- SmartBar buttons show EITHER the drawn icon OR the section name (never both), so the bar never doubles in size
	for _, t in pairs(tabs) do
		if t.icon then t.icon.Visible = not SET.barLabels end
		if t.label then t.label.Visible = SET.barLabels end
		if t.btn then
			if SET.barLabels then
				local w = 44; pcall(function() w = math.ceil(TextService:GetTextSize(t.label.Text, 13, FONTB, Vector2.new(1e4, 1e4)).X) + 26 end)  -- single-line width (no wrap → cross-platform-safe) + padding
				t.btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 40)
			else t.btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40) end
		end
	end
	if SET.barStyle == "Minimal" then  -- V4.5.57: a column of label buttons must share ONE width (they were ragged and the long ones overflowed the icon-wide column)
		local mw = 0; for _, t in pairs(tabs) do if t.btn and SET.barLabels then mw = math.max(mw, t.btn.Size.X.Offset) end end
		if SET.barLabels then for _, t in pairs(tabs) do if t.btn then t.btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(mw, 40) end end end
		if A.barPos then pcall(A.barPos) end  -- re-size the column + re-place the chevron (barPos runs styleSize)
	end
	task.defer(function() if _KR.movePill then pcall(_KR.movePill, activeTab, true) end end)  -- V4.5.57: buttons changed width but a full-width Taskbar never resizes, so the bar-size signal never re-placed the active pill (it sat under the wrong tab)
end
A.applyTabs = function()  -- V4.5.52: show/hide SmartBar tab buttons per SET.hiddenTabs; a hidden tab's open panel closes
	local hid = type(SET.hiddenTabs) == "table" and SET.hiddenTabs or {}
	for id, t in pairs(tabs) do
		local off = id ~= "player" and hid[id] == true
		if t.btn then t.btn.Visible = not off end
		if off then
			if MP.panels[id] then MP.close(id) end
			if activeTab == id and panelOpen then closePanel() end
		end
	end
	if _KR.movePill then pcall(_KR.movePill, activeTab, true) end
end
A.applyBarSize = function()  -- scale the WHOLE SmartBar cluster (bar + collapse chevron + collapsed puck) TOGETHER so they stay matched; reposition + re-fit Home below it
	local f = UISCALE * (SET.barSize or 1)
	for _, o in ipairs({ bar, _KR.chev, _KR.barPuck }) do local s = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); if s then s.Scale = f end end
	A.barPos()
	if homeOpen then task.spawn(function() A.refitHome() end) end  -- mirror A.apply("bar"): re-fit for the new bar space, but RESTORE Home's parked position so it doesn't visibly jump while you're in Settings (this was the glitch)
end
A.applyToast = function()  -- Toast position (Behavior): move the toast stack to the chosen screen corner
	local p = SET.toastPos or "Top-right"
	local ax = (p == "Top-left" or p == "Bottom-left") and 0 or 1
	local ay = (p == "Bottom-left" or p == "Bottom-right") and 1 or 0
	toastHost.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
	local ty = ay == 0 and 14 or -14
	-- V4.5.57: keep notifications off the style clocks - Minimal's big clock owns the top-right corner, Taskbar's tray + strip own the bottom edge
	if SET.barStyle == "Minimal" and _KR.sClock.Visible and ax == 1 and ay == 0 then  -- start below the corner clock: it sits at inset+12 on an IgnoreGuiInset screen, 58 tall (x UISCALE)
		local ins = 0; pcall(function() ins = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset().Y end)
		local sg = toastHost:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui"); local own = (sg and not sg.IgnoreGuiInset) and ins or 0  -- toastHost's own origin may already sit below the inset
		ty = ins + 12 + math.floor(58 * UISCALE) + 10 - own
	end
	if SET.barStyle == "Taskbar" and ay == 1 and not SET.barTop then ty = -(math.floor(BAR_H * UISCALE * (SET.barSize or 1)) + 10) end
	local tx = ax == 0 and 14 or -14
	if SET.barStyle == "Minimal" and ax == 0 then tx = 14 + _KR.colW() + 14 end  -- V4.5.57: left corners start past Minimal's icon column
	toastHost.Position = UDim2.new(ax, tx, ay, ty)
	local lay = toastHost:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
	if lay then lay.HorizontalAlignment = (ax == 0) and Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right; lay.VerticalAlignment = (ay == 0) and Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top or Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom end
end
A.applyTextScale = function()  -- V4.5.57: rescale every RoClothes text object from its base size (rcTS, stored on first scale)
	local k = math.clamp((SET.textScale or 100) / 100, 0.9, 1.2)
	local prev = _KR.textK or 1
	for _, root in ipairs({ screen, homeScreen, panelScreen, modalScreen, pickerScreen, MP.screen }) do
		if root then for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox")) and not d.TextScaled then
				local base = d:GetAttribute("rcTS")
				if d:GetAttribute("rcNoTS") then continue end  -- fixed-size glyphs (the Home wordmark is measured per letter)
				if not base or math.abs(d.TextSize - math.min(100, base * prev)) > 1 then base = d.TextSize / prev; d:SetAttribute("rcTS", base) end  -- no base yet, or code wrote a fresh (unscaled) size since: re-learn it
				d.TextSize = math.min(100, base * k)
				local was = d:GetAttribute("rcAS")
				if k > 1 and not was and not d:IsA("TextButton") and not d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiObject") and not d.TextWrapped and d.Size.Y.Scale == 0 then  -- a fixed-height single line grows to fit (remember what it was)
					if d.AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.None then d.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; d:SetAttribute("rcAS", "None") elseif d.AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.X then d.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY; d:SetAttribute("rcAS", "X") end
				elseif k <= 1 and was then d.AutomaticSize = (was == "X") and Enum.AutomaticSize.X or Enum.AutomaticSize.None; d:SetAttribute("rcAS", nil) end
			end
		end end
	end
	_KR.textK = k
end
A.applyFont = function()  -- V4.5.57: 10 families via FontFace; every RoClothes text object keeps its weight (Gotham = the original faces)
	local name = _KR.FAMS[SET.uiFont] and SET.uiFont or "Gotham"
	_KR.fontFam = (name ~= "Gotham") and _KR.FAMS[name] or nil
	for _, root in ipairs({ screen, homeScreen, panelScreen, modalScreen, pickerScreen, MP.screen }) do
		if root then for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox")) and (d:GetAttribute("rcFW") or _KR.WEIGHT[d.Font]) then
				if _KR.fontFam then _KR.applyFam(d) else d.FontFace = Font.fromName("GothamSSm", Enum.FontWeight[d:GetAttribute("rcFW") or _KR.WEIGHT[d.Font]]) end
			end
		end end
	end
end
A.apply = function(k)
	if k == "animSpeed" then SPEED = BASE_SPEED * (100 / math.max(10, SET.animSpeed))
	elseif k == "wave" then if homeOpen and _active == "home" and SET.wave and not SET.reduceMotion then startWave(_KR._homeLetters) else stopWave() end
	elseif k == "glow" then if homeOpen and SET.glow and not SET.reduceMotion then startGlow() else stopGlow() end
	elseif k == "reduceMotion" then  -- master motion switch: stop/restart the live loops now; individual toggles + the reduceMotion checks at every use-site handle the rest
		if homeOpen and _active == "home" and SET.wave and not SET.reduceMotion then startWave(_KR._homeLetters) else stopWave() end
		if homeOpen and SET.glow and not SET.reduceMotion then startGlow() else stopGlow() end
		pcall(_KR.accAnimSync)  -- V4.5.57 animated accent stops / resumes with Reduce Motion
		pcall(_KR.embersSync)
	elseif k == "ambient" then  -- the Home backdrop sway loop reads SET.ambient live; nothing to rebuild
	elseif k == "blur" then if _KR.homeBlur and homeOpen then if A.wantBlur() then _KR.homeBlur.Enabled = true; tween(_KR.homeBlur, 0.3, { Size = _KR.blurSize() }) else tween(_KR.homeBlur, 0.3, { Size = 0 }) end end  -- 28 = the same strength A.applyBackdrop uses (was 18 → toggling the setting weakened the blur)
	elseif k == "uiTrans" then A.applyTrans()  -- fade the whole UI to the chosen transparency (live)
	elseif k == "bg" then A.applyBackdrop()
	elseif k == "corner" then A.applyCorner()
	elseif k == "font" then A.applyFont()
	elseif k == "glass" then A.applyGlass()
	elseif k == "clock" then A.applyClock(); pcall(A.applyToast)
	elseif k == "barLabels" then A.applyBarLabels()
	elseif k == "barSize" then A.applyBarSize()
	elseif k == "barStyle" then A.applyStyle(); if homeOpen then task.spawn(function() A.refitHome() end) end  -- V4.5.57: Minimal changes Home's side margins
	elseif k == "homeLayout" then A.applyBackdrop(); A.applyClock(); if homeOpen then A.rebuildHome() end; task.delay(0.12, function() pcall(updateButtons) end)  -- V4.5.57
	elseif k == "panelLayout" then A.applyPanelLayout()  -- V4.5.57
	elseif k == "tabs" then A.applyTabs(); if homeOpen and _KR.homeLay() ~= "Dashboard" then A.rebuildHome() end  -- V4.5.57: the Start menu's pinned tiles list the visible tabs
	elseif k == "toast" then A.applyToast()
	elseif k == "accent" then A.applyTheme(false)
	elseif k == "theme" then A.applyTheme(true)
	elseif k == "bar" then A.barPos(); if homeOpen then task.spawn(function() A.refitHome() end) end  -- re-fit so the dashboard moves below/above with the bar
	elseif k == "autoHide" then if SET.autoHide then A.startAuto() else A.stopAuto() end
	elseif k == "multiPanel" then if SET.multiPanel then if panelOpen then closePanel() end else MP.closeAll() end  -- never leave single + multi both live
	elseif k == "barAvatar" then if SET.barAvatar then avatar.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. LocalPlayer.UserId .. "&w=48&h=48" else useKrulIcon(avatar) end  -- swap the bar favicon live: player headshot vs Krul brand icon
	elseif k == "density" then densify(); fillSettings(); A.rebuildHome()  -- densify() LIVE-rescales every list gap (home + settings + all tab pages, incl. their persistent scroll layouts); fillSettings/rebuildHome also re-apply card padding
	elseif k == "privacy" then
		local v = SET.privacy
		SET.hideName, SET.hideLocation, SET.blurAvatar = v, v, v
		fillSettings()   -- reflect the cascade in the Privacy toggles
		A.rebuildHome()
	elseif k == "appearance" then fillSettings()  -- V4.5.57: rebuild the Appearance rows (conditional rows follow SET)
	elseif k == "panelTint" then _KR.applyPalette(); A.applyBackdrop()  -- V4.5.57: a SLIDER - repaint only. A settings rebuild here destroyed the slider being dragged (drag died, only clicks worked)
	elseif k == "tabIntensity" then _KR.paintTabs()  -- slider: bar tiles only (Home re-tints on its next open)
	elseif k == "wallDim" or k == "wallOpacity" then _KR.wallDimApply()  -- slider: only the dim layer (no reload, no rebuild)
	elseif k == "mode" or k == "contrast" then A.applyTheme(false); A.applyStyle()  -- V4.5.57 palette layer (applyStyle re-skins the bar / tiles / icons / puck for the mode)
	elseif k == "accentGrad" then A.applyTheme(false); if A.applyPanelLayout then pcall(A.applyPanelLayout) end  -- V4.5.57: palette re-derives accent2 + repaints; the rebuild re-creates primary buttons with the new end colour
	elseif k == "accentAnim" then _KR.accAnimSync()
	elseif k == "tabColours" then A.applyStyle(); if A.rebuildHome then pcall(A.rebuildHome) end; fillSettings()
	elseif k == "textScale" then A.applyTextScale(); if homeOpen then pcall(A.refitHome) end
	elseif k == "blurAmt" then A.applyBackdrop()
	elseif k == "wallpaper" then _KR.loadWall(); fillSettings()
	elseif k == "shadows" then _KR.applyShadows()  -- placeholders until each feature lands
	elseif k == "reset" then A.reset()
	else A.rebuildHome() end  -- "rebuild" + any content / visibility key
	refreshPreview()  -- the changed setting may be the one being previewed -> re-render so its demo reflects the new state
end

--=================================================================================
-- BOOT
--=================================================================================
bar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, BAR_H + 50)  -- parked off-screen; the intro video's reveal() (below) tweens it in once the video finishes / is skipped
task.spawn(function() while screen.Parent do clock.Text = A.clockText(); pcall(A.styleClock); task.wait(math.clamp(60 - (os.time() % 60) + 0.05, 0.2, 5)) end end)  -- V4.5.57: lands right on the minute so the bar / tray / corner clock and the Home clocks flip together  -- A.clockText formats per SET.clock24 (24h vs manual 12h AM/PM)
-- breathing active-tab indicator: the active tab's dot gently pulses in and out.
task.spawn(function()
	while screen.Parent do
		local t = activeTab and tabs[activeTab]
		if t and t.dot and t.dot.BackgroundTransparency < 0.5 and (SET.barStyle or "Dock") == "Dock" then  -- V4.5.57: the size pulse is for the round Dock dot (it would squash Taskbar's underline)
			tween(t.dot, 1.0, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9) }, QUINT); task.wait(1.0)
			tween(t.dot, 1.0, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6) }, QUINT); task.wait(1.0)
		else
			task.wait(0.35)
		end
	end
end)

		V.hit.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); V.hit.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5); V.hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 16, 1, 16); V.hit.ZIndex = 8; V.hit.Parent = enter  -- V4.5.57: the sign-in screen enters from its Enter button only (a little padding for fingers), not a tap anywhere
		-- the notice as a slim InfoBar (text: _KR.HL.WARN_SHORT), then the four readouts as status cards
		local info = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(640, 586), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(470, 30), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(233, 74, 96), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4, Parent = canvas }); new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4), Parent = info })
		fadeIn(info, "BackgroundTransparency", 0.86, 0.6)
		fadeIn(new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(233, 74, 96), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5, Parent = info }), "BackgroundTransparency", 0, 0.6)
		fadeIn(L({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0), Text = _KR.HL.WARN_SHORT, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 214, 220), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = info }), "TextTransparency", 0, 0.6)

			fadeIn(c, "BackgroundTransparency", 0.93, 0.4 + i * 0.05)
			fadeIn(L({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14), Text = k, TextSize = 11.5, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(174, 176, 189), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = c }), "TextTransparency", 0, 0.4 + i * 0.05)

"</b>"), TextSize = 18, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(207, 208, 220), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left }), "TextTransparency", 0, 0.45)

		pctL = fadeIn(L({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1170, 636), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 18), Text = "000%", Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 12.5, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(231, 231, 239), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right }), "TextTransparency", 0, 0.3)

	function V.open()
		for _, it in ipairs(ins) do
			local o, pr, tg, dl = it[1], it[2], it[3], it[4]
			if animate then task.delay(dl * SPEED, function() if alive and o.Parent then tween(o, 0.5, { [pr] = tg }) end end) else o[pr] = tg end
		end
		if dots and not firstRun then if animate then task.delay(0.4 * SPEED, function() if alive then V._dots() end end) else V._dots() end end
	end
	local function line()  -- the Minimal step / file text beside the hairline
		if style ~= "Minimal" or readyShown then return end
		if firstRun then status.Text = (stageName or "Connecting") .. (fileName ~= "" and ("  ·  " .. fileName) or "") end
	end
	function V.progress(p)
		pNow = math.clamp(p, 0, 1)
		if fill then fill.Size = (style == "Minimal") and UDim2.new(pNow, 0, 0, 2) or UDim2.fromScale(pNow, 1) end
		if pctL then pctL.Text = (style == "Minimal") and string.format("%03d%%", math.floor(pNow * 100 + 0.5)) or (math.floor(pNow * 100 + 0.5) .. "%") end
		if not firstRun and not readyShown and status then status.Text = STEPS[math.clamp(math.floor(pNow * 3) + 1, 1, 3)] end
	end
	function V.stage(_, name) stageName = name; if V._stageL then V._stageL.Text = name end; line() end
	function V.meta(tc, file)
		fileName = file or ""
		if metaL then metaL.Text = (tc or "") .. ((file and file ~= "") and ("   ·   " .. file) or "") end
		line()
	end
	function V.readout(i, txt) if vals[i] then vals[i].Text = txt end end
	function V.place(o)  -- the slow-download / error captions, re-homed onto this screen
		o.Parent = canvas; o.Position = V.warnAt[1]; o.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(V.warnAt[2] == Enum.TextXAlignment.Left and 0 or 0.5, 0.5); o.TextXAlignment = V.warnAt[2]; o.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
	end
	function V.error()
		if status then status.Visible = true; status.Text = "Download failed"; status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 130) end
		if V._stageL then V._stageL.Text = "Download failed"; V._stageL.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 130) end
	end
	function V.ready()
		if readyShown then return end; readyShown = true
		V.progress(1)
		if style == "Taskbar" then
			if dots then dots.Visible = false end
			if status and status.Text ~= "Download failed" then status.Visible = false end
			if barG then barG.Visible = false end
			enter.Visible = true; V._enterL.TextTransparency = 1
			if animate then
				local sc = new("UIScale", { Scale = 0.9, Parent = enter }); tween(sc, 0.4, { Scale = 1 }, BACK)
				tween(enter, 0.35, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }); tween(V._enterL, 0.35, { TextTransparency = 0 })
			else enter.BackgroundTransparency = 0; V._enterL.TextTransparency = 0 end
		else
			if status.Text ~= "Download failed" then status.Text = '<b><font color="#FFFFFF">Tap anywhere to enter</font></b>  <font color="' .. hex(T.accent) .. '">→</font>' end
			if animate then task.spawn(function()  -- a slow breathe on the line so it reads as the call to action
				while alive and status.Parent do tween(status, 1.1, { TextTransparency = 0.35 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine); task.wait(1.1 * SPEED); if not alive then break end; tween(status, 1.1, { TextTransparency = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine); task.wait(1.1 * SPEED) end
			end) end
		end
	end
	function V.exit()
		alive = false
		if blur then tween(blur, 0.45, { Size = 0 }); local b = blur; task.delay(0.5 * SPEED, function() pcall(function() b:Destroy() end) end) end
	end
	return V
end
A.playIntro = function(previewDownload)  -- V4.5.34 RING title screen (krul-approved: cinematic, see-through, the ring IS the Enter button). Runs once at boot; Settings > Actions > "Replay intro" replays it and "Preview download screen" calls it with previewDownload=true (simulated download - never runs the real installer).
	-- REPLAY-SAFE: tear down any prior intro overlay + its Camera-bound ViewportSize conn first so a replay starts clean.
	pcall(function() local ex = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("RoClothesIntro"); if ex then ex:Destroy() end end)
	if MP.introVpConn then pcall(function() MP.introVpConn:Disconnect() end); MP.introVpConn = nil end
	local function reveal()  -- hand off to the SmartBar (unchanged from the previous intro)
		if _KR.cfgLoaded and not _KR.cfgApplied then   -- one-shot: re-skin the built UI to the SAVED config just before the bar slides in
			_KR.cfgApplied = true
			SPEED = BASE_SPEED * (100 / math.max(10, SET.animSpeed))
			local sa = SET.accent
			pcall(A.applyTheme, true); if SET.accent ~= sa then SET.accent = sa; pcall(A.applyTheme, false) end
			for _, fn in ipairs({ A.applyBarSize, A.applyBarLabels, A.applyTabs, A.applyClock, A.applyCorner, A.applyGlass, A.applyTrans, A.applyToast }) do pcall(fn) end
			if SET.uiFont ~= "Gotham" then pcall(A.applyFont) end  -- V4.5.55: literal Gotham fonts (not built from FONT) follow the saved font too
			pcall(densify)
			if SET.autoHide then pcall(A.startAuto) end
		end
		A.applyStyle()  -- V4.5.57: skin + place the bar for the saved style (runs A.barPos)
		_KR.barShown = true; A.applyClock()
		local rest = bar.Position
		if SET.barStyle == "Minimal" then bar.Position = rest + UDim2.new(0, -(BAR_H + 80), 0, 0)  -- the column slides in from the left edge
		else bar.Position = rest + UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, SET.barTop and -(BAR_H + 50) or (BAR_H + 50)) end
		tween(bar, 0.7, { Position = rest }, QUINT)
		if SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion then   -- V4.5.34: tab icons pop in left-to-right as the bar arrives
			for i, sec in ipairs(SECTIONS) do
				local t = tabs[sec.id]
				if t and t.iconScale then
					_KR.springStop(t.iconScale, "Scale"); t.iconScale.Scale = 0.2
					task.delay((0.22 + i * 0.045) * SPEED, function() if t.iconScale.Parent then _KR.spring(t.iconScale, "Scale", 0.9, 2.6, 0.6) end end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.delay(0.5, function() pcall(function() _KR.chev.Visible = true end) end)
		-- V4.5.17 NON-INTRUSIVE: Home never auto-opens; the SmartBar slides in and the user opens what they want.
		task.delay(1.1, function() toast("Welcome to RoClothes:Krul", "Your SmartBar is ready - tap a tab to start, or your avatar for Home.", "ok") end)
	end

	-- Full-screen SEE-THROUGH overlay (krul: the game stays visible). `dim` = screen layer (motes, flashes);
	-- `content` = the 1280x720 design canvas scaled to fit (ring, wordmark, captions).
	local DW, DH = 1280, 720
	local ov = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "RoClothesIntro", IgnoreGuiInset = true, ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 2000, Parent = PlayerGui })
	GUIObject.IntroScreen = ov  -- creation-site stash so a re-execute's BREAKER teardown destroys THIS instance's intro by reference
	local dim = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Parent = ov })
	local content = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(DW, DH), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2, Parent = dim })
	local introScale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = content })
	local AV, altScale  -- V4.5.57: the Taskbar / Minimal intro view (nil = the Dock ring) + its canvas scale
	local function fitIntro()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local vw, vh = (cam and cam.ViewportSize.X) or 1280, (cam and cam.ViewportSize.Y) or 720
		introScale.Scale = math.max(0.3, math.min((vw - 24) / DW, (vh - 24) / DH))
		if altScale then altScale.Scale = introScale.Scale end
	end
	fitIntro(); pcall(function() MP.introVpConn = workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fitIntro) end)

	-- Which run: 1st run (System._firstRunInstallPending) = DOWNLOAD flow driving the REAL installer; otherwise WELCOME.
	local FORCE_FIRST_RUN = false
	local preview = previewDownload == true
	local firstRun = preview or FORCE_FIRST_RUN or (System and System._firstRunInstallPending == true) or false

	local done = false                                  -- finish() guard; every loop checks it
	local animate = SET.cardAnims and not SET.reduceMotion
	local SINE = Enum.EasingStyle.Sine
	local WHITE, BLACK, CYAN, PINK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 180)
	local function W(t) task.wait(math.max(0.03, t * SPEED)) end   -- choreography wait, scaled like every tween
	local function circle(parent, size, z, col, tr)
		local f = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = col or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Parent = parent })
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0), Parent = f })
		return f
	end
	-- the ring is drawn with UIStrokes made HERE on purpose: it is a graphic, not a panel border (the stroke() helper is
	-- deliberately disabled - the rest of the UI stays outline-free).
	local function ringStroke(f, col, th, tr)
		return new("UIStroke", { Color = col, Thickness = th, Transparency = tr or 0, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = f })
	end

	-- ── MOTES ──
	local motes = {}
	local altStyle = (SET.barStyle == "Taskbar" or SET.barStyle == "Minimal") and SET.barStyle or nil  -- V4.5.57: the intro follows the UI style
	if animate and not altStyle then for i = 1, 14 do
		local s = math.random(2, 4)
		local m = circle(dim, UDim2.fromOffset(s, s), 2, (i % 2 == 0) and T.accent or WHITE, 1)
		m.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(), math.random())
		motes[i] = m
	end end

	-- ── THE RING ──
	local D, CY = 380, 0.45                                -- ring diameter (design px) + centre height on the canvas
	local ringBox = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, CY), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(D, D), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 6, Parent = content })
	local ringScale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = ringBox })
	-- soft breathing glow behind the ring: 3 faint concentric discs = a radial falloff without an image
	local glows = {}
	for i, spec in ipairs({ { 1.25, 0.97 }, { 1.0, 0.955 }, { 0.75, 0.94 } }) do
		local g = circle(ringBox, UDim2.fromScale(spec[1], spec[1]), 4, T.accent, 1)
		glows[i] = { f = g, t = spec[2] }
	end
	local track = circle(ringBox, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 5, WHITE, 1)          -- faint full-circle track
	local trackStroke = ringStroke(track, WHITE, 2, 1)
	-- progress arc = two clipped halves of a stroked circle; each half's UIGradient (on the stroke) has a hard 50% step,
	-- and rotating it sweeps the visible arc clockwise from 12 o'clock (right half 0-50%, left half 50-100%).
	local function half(isRight)
		-- clip boxes overhang the ring by 8px on every OUTER side: the stroke draws OUTSIDE the circle's edge, so a box
		-- exactly ring-sized shaved the line thin at 12/6 o'clock and (V4.5.51) at 3/9 o'clock (krul: "bald spots")
		local clip = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(isRight and 0.5 or 0, isRight and 0 or -8, 0, -8), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 8, 1, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 6, Parent = ringBox })
		local c = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(isRight and -D / 2 or 8, 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(D, D), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6, Parent = clip })
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0), Parent = c })
		local st = ringStroke(c, T.accent, 3, 0)
		local seq = isRight
			and NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.501, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
			or NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.501, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
		local gr = new("UIGradient", { Transparency = seq, Rotation = 0, Parent = st })
		return gr, st
	end
	local gradR, strokeR = half(true)
	local gradL, strokeL = half(false)
	-- once the ring is CLOSED, a single unclipped full circle replaces the two halves (no seam / clip artefacts at rest)
	local fullRing = circle(ringBox, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 6, WHITE, 1)
	local fullStroke = ringStroke(fullRing, T.accent, 3, 1)
	-- comet head riding the arc tip
	local comet = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 8, Parent = ringBox })
	local cometGlow = circle(comet, UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), 7, T.accent, 1)
	local cometCore = circle(comet, UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9), 8, WHITE, 1)
	local ringP = 0
	local function setRing(p)   -- p in [0,1]: arc length, clockwise from 12 o'clock + comet at the tip
		p = math.clamp(p, 0, 1); ringP = p
		gradR.Rotation = math.clamp(p * 360, 0, 180)
		gradL.Rotation = math.clamp((p - 0.5) * 360, 0, 180)
		local closed = p >= 0.999
		fullStroke.Transparency = closed and 0 or 1
		strokeR.Enabled = not closed; strokeL.Enabled = not closed
		local a = p * math.pi * 2
		comet.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.sin(a) * D / 2, 0.5, -math.cos(a) * D / 2)
		if AV then AV.progress(p) end
	end
	setRing(0)
	-- ── HUD DIAL (krul): two tick rings around the main ring spinning opposite ways + degree labels on the outer one ──
	local hud = {}
	local function tickRing(radius, n, len, th, tr, labels)
		local holder = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(radius * 2, radius * 2), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 5, Parent = ringBox })
		local parts = {}
		for i = 0, n - 1 do
			local a = i / n * math.pi * 2
			local t = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.sin(a) * radius, 0.5, -math.cos(a) * radius), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(th, len), Rotation = math.deg(a), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5, Parent = holder })
			parts[#parts + 1] = { o = t, prop = "BackgroundTransparency", t = (i % (n / 4) == 0) and math.max(0, tr - 0.25) or tr }
		end
		if labels then for i, txt in ipairs(labels) do
			local a = (i - 1) / #labels * math.pi * 2
			local l = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.sin(a) * (radius + 16), 0.5, -math.cos(a) * (radius + 16)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 12), Rotation = math.deg(a), Text = txt, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 5, Parent = holder })
			parts[#parts + 1] = { o = l, prop = "TextTransparency", t = 0.45 }
		end end
		return { holder = holder, parts = parts }
	end
	hud[1] = tickRing(D / 2 + 22, 48, 6, 1, 0.55)
	hud[2] = tickRing(D / 2 + 46, 12, 12, 2, 0.4)   -- V4.5.54 (krul): degree labels removed
	local hudShown = false
	local function showHud(instant)
		if hudShown then return end; hudShown = true
		for _, r in ipairs(hud) do for _, pt in ipairs(r.parts) do
			if instant or not animate then pt.o[pt.prop] = pt.t else tween(pt.o, 0.8, { [pt.prop] = pt.t }) end
		end end
		if animate then task.spawn(function()   -- slow counter-rotation
			local a1, a2 = 0, 0
			while not done and ringBox.Parent do
				local dt = task.wait()
				a1 = a1 + dt * 6 / SPEED; a2 = a2 - dt * 3.5 / SPEED
				hud[1].holder.Rotation = a1; hud[2].holder.Rotation = a2
			end
		end) end
	end
	-- ── COMET SPARKS (krul): embers shed from the comet, drifting outward and fading (capped for phones) ──
	local sparkLive, sparkLast = 0, 0
	local function spark()
		if not animate or done or sparkLive >= 36 then return end
		local now = os.clock(); if now - sparkLast < 0.025 then return end; sparkLast = now
		sparkLive = sparkLive + 1
		local a = ringP * math.pi * 2
		local sz = math.random(4, 8)
		local e = circle(ringBox, UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz), 7, (math.random() < 0.5) and T.accent or WHITE, 0.05)
		e.Position = comet.Position
		local out = 18 + math.random() * 34
		local jit = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6
		tween(e, 0.7, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.sin(a + jit) * (D / 2 + out), 0.5, -math.cos(a + jit) * (D / 2 + out)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, QUINT)
		task.delay(0.75 * SPEED, function() sparkLive = sparkLive - 1; pcall(function() e:Destroy() end) end)
	end
	-- shockwave ring (fired when the ring closes / download completes)
	local function shockwave()
		if not animate then return end
		local sw = circle(content, UDim2.fromOffset(D, D), 5, WHITE, 1)
		sw.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, CY)
		local ss = ringStroke(sw, T.accent, 7, 0.1)
		tween(sw, 0.8, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(D * 2.6, D * 2.6) }, EXPO); tween(ss, 0.8, { Transparency = 1, Thickness = 1 }, EXPO)
		task.delay(0.9 * SPEED, function() pcall(function() sw:Destroy() end) end)
		task.spawn(function()   -- impact: a short camera shake
			for _, d in ipairs({ { 6, -4 }, { -5, 3 }, { 3, -2 }, { -1, 1 }, { 0, 0 } }) do
				if done then break end
				content.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, d[1], 0.5, d[2]); task.wait(0.035)
			end
			content.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		end)
	end

	local wmScale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = wmBox })
	local wm = lbl({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), RichText = true, Text = WM, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 40, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 255), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 9, Parent = wmBox })

	-- big counting number inside the ring (download run)

	local CAP_Y = CY + (D / 2 + (firstRun and 118 or 40)) / DH
	local status = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, CAP_Y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(700, 20), Text = spaced(firstRun and "first-time setup" or "welcome back") .. ",  " .. spaced(myName), Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(232, 230, 244), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 8, Parent = content })

	local slowWarn = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, CAP_Y, 64), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(640, 36), Text = "Taking a while - a slow download is usually your executor or network, not the script.", Font = FONT, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 130), TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 9, Parent = content })

	end)

		local altC = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(DW, DH), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2, Parent = dim })

	end

	-- ── READOUTS (krul): four dial readouts at the diagonals, joined to the ring by short leader lines ──
	local function execName()
		local ok, n = pcall(function() return (identifyexecutor and identifyexecutor()) or (getexecutorname and getexecutorname()) end)
		return (ok and type(n) == "string" and n ~= "") and n or "Executor"
	end
	local function counts()
		local nb, ni = 0, 0
		pcall(function() for _, v in pairs(System.getBundleCounts()) do nb = nb + (tonumber(v) or 0) end end)
		pcall(function() ni = #System.getClothesList() end)
		return nb, ni
	end
	local readouts = {}
	local RO_R = D / 2 + 92
	for i, spec in ipairs({ { -1, -1, "version" }, { 1, -1, "executor" }, { -1, 1, "bundles" }, { 1, 1, "items" } }) do
		local sx, sy = spec[1], spec[2]
		local cx, cy = sx * RO_R * 0.72, sy * RO_R * 0.72
		local holder = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(sx < 0 and 1 or 0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx + sx * 6, CY, cy), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 8, Parent = content })
		local al = sx < 0 and Enum.TextXAlignment.Right or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		local val = lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), Text = "--", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = al, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 8, Parent = holder })
		local key = lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = spaced(spec[3]), Font = FONT, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 203, 220), TextXAlignment = al, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 8, Parent = holder })
		local r1, r2 = D / 2 + 54, RO_R * 0.72 * math.sqrt(2) - 4      -- leader line from just outside the HUD to the readout
		local mid = (r1 + r2) / 2
		local lead = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, sx * mid / math.sqrt(2), CY, sy * mid / math.sqrt(2)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r2 - r1, 1), Rotation = (sx * sy > 0) and 45 or -45, BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 7, Parent = content })
		readouts[i] = { holder = holder, val = val, key = key, lead = lead, kind = spec[3] }
	end
	local function refreshReadouts(only)   -- only = one readout index (V4.5.53: the scan beam fills them one by one)
		local nb, ni = counts()
		for i, r in ipairs(readouts) do
			if only and only ~= i then -- skip
			elseif r.kind == "version" then r.val.Text = tostring(_RC_VER or "RoClothes"):match("^(V%d+%.%d+%.%d+)") or tostring(_RC_VER)
			elseif r.kind == "executor" then r.val.Text = execName()
			elseif r.kind == "bundles" then r.val.Text = nb > 0 and tostring(nb) or "--"
			elseif r.kind == "items" then r.val.Text = ni > 0 and tostring(ni) or "--" end
			if AV and not (only and only ~= i) then AV.readout(i, r.val.Text) end
		end
	end
	local readoutsShown = false
	local function showReadouts(blank)   -- blank = keep "--" until the scan beam passes (V4.5.53)
		if readoutsShown then return end; readoutsShown = true
		if not blank then refreshReadouts() end
		for i, r in ipairs(readouts) do
			local function go()
				if done then return end
				if animate then
					local p = r.holder.Position; r.holder.Position = p + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 8)
					tween(r.holder, 0.5, { Position = p }, EXPO); tween(r.val, 0.5, { TextTransparency = 0.02 }); tween(r.key, 0.5, { TextTransparency = 0.3 }); tween(r.lead, 0.5, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 })
				else
					r.val.TextTransparency = 0.02; r.key.TextTransparency = 0.3; r.lead.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
				end
			end
			if animate then task.delay((i - 1) * 0.09 * SPEED, go) else go() end
		end
	end
	local function showByline()
		if animate then
			bylineScale.Scale = 0.6
			tween(byline, 0.5, { TextTransparency = 0.05 }); tween(bylineScale, 0.55, { Scale = 1 }, BACK)
		else
			byline.TextTransparency = 0.05
		end
	end

	-- the ring IS the Enter button (round-ish hit area over the ring)
	local hit = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, CY), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(D, D), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Active = false, ZIndex = 12, Parent = content })
	new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0), Parent = hit })
