	-- ── helpers ──
	local STAGES = { "Connecting", "Downloading", "Installing", "Finalizing" }
	local _stageAt = 0
	local function setStage(idx)
		idx = math.clamp(math.floor(idx), 1, #STAGES)
		if idx <= _stageAt then return end
		_stageAt = idx
		status.Text = spaced(STAGES[idx]) .. "   " .. idx .. " / " .. #STAGES
		if AV then AV.stage(idx, STAGES[idx]) end
	end
	local function setProgress(p)
		p = math.clamp(p, 0, 1)
		local moved = math.abs(p - ringP) > 0.0005
		setRing(p); num.Text = math.floor(p * 100 + 0.5) .. '<font size="34">%</font>'
		if moved and p < 1 then spark() end
	end
	local tc, lastFile = "00:00:00", ""
	local function refreshMeta() meta.Text = tc .. (lastFile ~= "" and ("   ·   " .. lastFile) or ""); if AV then AV.meta(tc, lastFile) end end
	local function pushFile(nm) lastFile = nm; refreshMeta() end
	local function showSlowWarn()
		if done or slowWarn.Visible or not slowWarn.Parent then return end
		slowWarn.Visible = true
		if animate then tween(slowWarn, 0.5, { TextTransparency = 0.05 }) else slowWarn.TextTransparency = 0.05 end
	end
	local function punchWordmark()   -- V4.5.54 (krul): the wordmark types in letter by letter, left to right, in place
		wmBox.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, CY); wmScale.Scale = 1
		wm.TextTransparency = 0
		if not animate then wm.MaxVisibleGraphemes = -1; return end
		wm.MaxVisibleGraphemes = 0
		task.spawn(function()
			for n = 1, 14 do   -- "RoClothes:Krul" (RichText tags are not graphemes)
				if done then break end
				wm.MaxVisibleGraphemes = n; W(0.045)
			end
			wm.MaxVisibleGraphemes = -1
		end)
	end

	-- ── READY: the ring becomes the button ──
	local ready = false
	local function showReady()
		if done or ready then return end
		ready = true; hit.Active = true
		if AV then AV.ready(); AV.hit.Visible = true end
		if slowWarn.Visible then if animate then tween(slowWarn, 0.3, { TextTransparency = 1 }) else slowWarn.Visible = false end end
		if firstRun then
			meta.Visible = false
			status.Text = spaced("ready")
		end
		refreshReadouts()
		if animate then
			tween(hint, 0.5, { TextTransparency = 0.05 })
			task.spawn(function()   -- "tap the ring" pulse + the ring breathing scale
				while not done and hint.Parent do
					tween(hint, 1.1, { TextTransparency = 0.45 }, SINE); tween(ringScale, 1.1, { Scale = 1.02 }, SINE); W(1.1); if done then break end
					tween(hint, 1.1, { TextTransparency = 0.05 }, SINE); tween(ringScale, 1.1, { Scale = 1 }, SINE); W(1.1)
				end
			end)
		else
			hint.TextTransparency = 0.15
		end
	end
	local function finish()   -- exit: the ring expands past the screen + flash, bars retract, then hand off (once)
		if done then return end; done = true
		if AV then AV.exit() end
		if MP.introVpConn then pcall(function() MP.introVpConn:Disconnect() end); MP.introVpConn = nil end
		if animate then
			local fl = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 50, Parent = ov })
			tween(fl, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.75 }); task.delay(0.14 * SPEED, function() tween(fl, 0.5, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end)
			tween(ringScale, 0.6, { Scale = 5 }, EXPO, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
			tween(wmScale, 0.5, { Scale = 1.4 }, EXPO, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
		end
		for _, d in ipairs(ov:GetDescendants()) do pcall(function()
			if d:IsA("GuiObject") and d.BackgroundTransparency < 1 and d.ZIndex < 50 then tween(d, 0.45, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end
			if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then tween(d, 0.4, { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }) end
			if d:IsA("UIStroke") then tween(d, 0.45, { Transparency = 1 }) end
			if d:IsA("ImageLabel") then tween(d, 0.4, { ImageTransparency = 1 }) end
		end) end
		task.delay(0.65 * SPEED, function() pcall(function() ov:Destroy() end); reveal() end)
	end
	hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if ready and not done then finish() end end)
	if AV then AV.hit.Visible = false; AV.hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if ready and not done then finish() end end) end  -- shown on ready only, so the game takes input until then
	hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if ready and not done and animate then tween(ringScale, 0.25, { Scale = 1.05 }) end end)
	local function loaderError(msg)
		if done then return end
		for _, o in ipairs({ num, meta }) do pcall(function() o.Visible = false end) end
		pcall(function() slowWarn.Visible = false end)
		status.Text = spaced("download failed"); status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 130)
		if AV then AV.error() end
		errLbl.Text = msg .. "  You can still enter."; errLbl.Visible = true
		if animate then tween(errLbl, 0.4, { TextTransparency = 0.03 }) else errLbl.TextTransparency = 0.03 end
		if not firstRun or wmScale.Scale < 1 then   -- bring the wordmark into the ring so the screen isn't empty
			tween(wmBox, 0.5, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, CY) }, EXPO); tween(wmScale, 0.5, { Scale = 1 }, EXPO)
		end
		showReady()
	end

	-- ── AMBIENT (after the opening): motes rise, a dot orbits the ring, the glow breathes ──
	local function startAmbient()
		if not animate then return end
		for _, m in ipairs(motes) do task.spawn(function()
			while not done and m.Parent do
				local dur = math.random(7, 13)
				m.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(), 1.05)
				tween(m, 1, { BackgroundTransparency = math.random(45, 70) / 100 })
				tween(m, dur, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(m.Position.X.Scale + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1, -0.05) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
				W(dur); if done then break end
			end
		end) end
		task.spawn(function()   -- orbiting dot
			local orb = circle(ringBox, UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5), 8, WHITE, 0.2)
			local a = 0
			while not done and orb.Parent do
				local dt = task.wait()
				a = a + dt * 0.9 / SPEED
				orb.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.sin(a) * (D / 2 + 14), 0.5, -math.cos(a) * (D / 2 + 14))
			end
		end)
		task.spawn(function()   -- glow breathing
			while not done do
				for _, g in ipairs(glows) do tween(g.f, 1.6, { BackgroundTransparency = g.t - 0.03 }, SINE) end; W(1.6); if done then break end
				for _, g in ipairs(glows) do tween(g.f, 1.6, { BackgroundTransparency = g.t + 0.02 }, SINE) end; W(1.6)
			end
		end)
	end
	local function drawRing(dur)   -- the comet races clockwise drawing the ring (welcome run)
		cometCore.BackgroundTransparency = 0; cometGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
		local t0 = os.clock(); local total = dur * SPEED
		while not done do
			local e = math.clamp((os.clock() - t0) / total, 0, 1)
			setRing(1 - (1 - e) ^ 3)   -- ease-out
			spark()
			if e >= 1 then break end
			task.wait()
		end
		tween(cometCore, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }); tween(cometGlow, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	end

	-- ── OPENING CHOREOGRAPHY ──
	local openingDone = false
	task.spawn(function()
		if AV then AV.open() end
		if not animate then   -- reduce-motion: the final frame, no flashes / shake
			for _, g in ipairs(glows) do g.f.BackgroundTransparency = g.t end
			trackStroke.Transparency = 0.85
			wm.TextTransparency = 0; status.TextTransparency = 0.05
			if firstRun then num.TextTransparency = 0.05; meta.TextTransparency = 0.25 else setRing(1) end
			showHud(true); showByline(); showReadouts()
			openingDone = true
			if not firstRun then showReady() end
			return
		end
		-- 1. the glow + track fade up (no letterbox bars - krul removed them)
		if firstRun then ringScale.Scale = 0.35; tween(ringScale, 0.9, { Scale = 1 }, BACK) end   -- V4.5.54 (krul): download ring grows in, not popping up
		for _, g in ipairs(glows) do tween(g.f, 1.2, { BackgroundTransparency = g.t }) end
		tween(trackStroke, 0.8, { Transparency = 0.85 })
		W(0.35); if done then return end
		if not firstRun then
			-- 2. (V4.5.54) dials, byline, readouts and the typed wordmark come up at once
			tween(status, 0.5, { TextTransparency = 0.05 })
			showHud(); showByline(); showReadouts(); punchWordmark()
			-- 3. the comet draws the ring as the checks land; it closes -> shockwave + the wordmark punches in
			drawRing(0.9); if done then return end
			refreshReadouts()
			shockwave()
			W(0.35); if done then return end
			openingDone = true
			startAmbient()
			W(0.2); showReady()
		else
			-- download run: the ring will fill with the real progress; number + captions come up now
			cometCore.BackgroundTransparency = 0; cometGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
			tween(num, 0.6, { TextTransparency = 0.05 }); numScale.Scale = 0.85; tween(numScale, 0.6, { Scale = 1 }, EXPO)
			tween(wm, 0.6, { TextTransparency = 0.1 })
			tween(status, 0.6, { TextTransparency = 0.05 }); tween(meta, 0.6, { TextTransparency = 0.25 })
			showHud(); showByline(); showReadouts()
			openingDone = true
			startAmbient()
		end
	end)

	-- ── DOWNLOAD FLOW: the REAL first-run installer fills the ring (preview = a simulated run) ──
	if firstRun then
		task.spawn(function()
			local t0 = os.clock()
			task.spawn(function()   -- timecode HH:MM:SS
				while not done and meta.Parent do
					local el = math.floor(os.clock() - t0)
					tc = string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", math.floor(el / 3600), math.floor(el / 60) % 60, el % 60); refreshMeta()
					task.wait(0.25)
				end
			end)
			local realP, dispP, installDone = 0, 0, false
			task.spawn(function()   -- ease the displayed value toward the real target so bursts of files don't jump
				while not done and not installDone do
					local dt = task.wait()
					dispP = math.min(realP, dispP + (realP - dispP) * math.clamp(dt * 6, 0, 1))
					setProgress(dispP)
				end
			end)
			setStage(1)
			if (not preview) and System and System._runFirstRunInstall then
				do   -- HTTP definitively blocked → an honest error instead of a ring stuck at 0%
					local ct = os.clock()
					while System._caps.http == nil and not System._capsDone and (os.clock() - ct) < 8 do task.wait(0.2) end
					if System._caps.http == false then
						installDone = true
						loaderError("Your executor can't reach the internet (HTTP is blocked), so RoClothes can't download its content. Most features won't work on this executor.")
						return
					end
				end
				task.delay(30, showSlowWarn)
				task.delay(90, function() if not done and slowWarn.Parent then slowWarn.Text = "Still downloading… big first-time install on a slow connection. If it seems stuck, try another executor or check your network." end end)
				local lastShown
				local pok, installOk = pcall(System._runFirstRunInstall, function(dn, tot, fl, file, sz, stage)
					if done then return end
					if stage == "downloading" then setStage(2) elseif stage == "installing" then setStage(3) elseif stage == "finalizing" then setStage(4) end
					local p = (tot and tot > 0) and (dn / tot) or realP
					if p > realP then realP = p end
					if file and file ~= lastShown then
						lastShown = file
						local base = tostring(file):match("[^/]+$") or tostring(file)
						pushFile(base .. ((type(sz) == "number" and sz > 0) and ("  " .. math.max(1, math.floor(sz / 1024)) .. " KB") or ""))
					end
				end)
				if (not pok) or (installOk == false) then
					installDone = true
					loaderError("Couldn't download RoClothes content. " .. ((System._caps.http == false) and "Your executor's network/HTTP is blocked." or "The download failed - check your connection, or try another executor."))
					return
				end
			else   -- preview / no runner: a smooth simulated install so the screen can be seen
				local names = { "rc_base.json", "breast_vns.rbxm", "torso_sb.rbxm", "intro_ui.png", "bra_overlay.mesh", "tail_physics.rbxm", "catalog_cache.json", "loadv9.png" }
				local start, DUR = os.clock(), 7
				while not done and ov.Parent do
					local e = math.clamp((os.clock() - start) / DUR, 0, 1)
					realP = 1 - (1 - e) * (1 - e)
					setStage(realP >= 0.85 and 4 or realP >= 0.6 and 3 or realP >= 0.12 and 2 or 1)
					if math.random() < 0.12 then pushFile(names[math.random(#names)] .. "  " .. math.random(12, 840) .. " KB") end
					if e >= 1 then break end
					task.wait()
				end
			end
			realP = 1
			local tw = os.clock()
			while not done and dispP < 0.999 and (os.clock() - tw) < 1.5 do task.wait() end
			installDone = true
			if done then return end
			setProgress(1)
			while not openingDone and not done do task.wait() end   -- never finish mid-opening
			if done then return end
			-- 100%: the number dissolves, the wordmark rises into the ring, shockwave
			tween(cometCore, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }); tween(cometGlow, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
			if animate then
				tween(num, 0.3, { TextTransparency = 1 }); tween(numScale, 0.3, { Scale = 0.6 })
				W(0.2); if done then return end
				tween(wm, 0.2, { TextTransparency = 1 })
				W(0.25); if done then return end
				shockwave(); punchWordmark()
			else
				num.Visible = false; wmBox.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, CY); wmScale.Scale = 1
			end
			showReady()
		end)
	end
end
-- V4.5.57 SETTINGS SEARCH (krul approved demo claude.ai/artifact/GU6aTUBvCtwsgruGhW3Taq). One box finds every setting in every
-- tab + UI Settings by its name or its one-line description. Opens from a bar button only (no keyboard shortcut, krul).
-- The index is read from the REAL rows (rowShell buttons): a tab is re-indexed whenever it is built, so new settings appear
-- on their own; tabs never opened are built once off-screen on the first search (not Catalog / Bundles / Edit: live data + 3D).
-- Toggles flip right in the results (the row's own switch, so an open panel updates too); anything else jumps: the tab opens,
-- the right section tab is picked, the row scrolls into view and flashes.
-- A FUNCTION (not a do-block): the builder is at Luau's 200-local ceiling, and a do-block's locals still count toward it.
_KR.srchInit = function()
	local SR = { tabs = {}, hold = {}, ui = {} }
	_KR.srch = SR
	local NOBUILD = { catalog = true, bundles = true, edit = true }
	local function esc(t) return (tostring(t):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")) end
	local function rowName(r)
		local n = r:GetAttribute("rcName"); if n then return n end
		for _, c in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("TextLabel") and c.Text ~= "" and c.Name ~= "Desc" then return c.Text end end
	end
	local function rowValue(r, name)
		for _, c in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do
			if (c:IsA("TextLabel") or c:IsA("TextButton")) and c.Text ~= "" and c.Text ~= name and c.Name ~= "Desc" and c.TextXAlignment ~= Enum.TextXAlignment.Left and not c:GetAttribute("rcOnOff") then return c.Text end
		end
	end
	local function collect(root, tab, catOf)
		local out, seen = {}, {}
		for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("TextButton") and d:GetAttribute("rcBaseT") ~= nil then
				local name = rowName(d)
				if name and #name > 1 and not name:match("^[%d%.%%%s]+$") and not seen[name] then
					seen[name] = true
					local sec; local p = d.Parent
					while p and p ~= root do local t = p:GetAttribute("rcTile"); if t and t ~= "" then sec = t; break end; p = p.Parent end
					local e = { tab = tab, sec = sec, name = name, row = d, kind = d:GetAttribute("rcKind") or "pick", desc = (_KR.SDESC[name] or {})[2] or "" }
					if catOf then e.cat = catOf(d); e.sec = e.cat; e.sub = d:GetAttribute("rcSub") or (d.Parent and d.Parent:GetAttribute("rcSub")) end
					out[#out + 1] = e
				end
			end
		end
		return out
	end
	_KR.srchIndexPage = function(host, id)
		SR.tabs[id] = collect(host, id)
		if SR.hold[id] then pcall(function() SR.hold[id]:Destroy() end); SR.hold[id] = nil end  -- the off-screen copy is no longer needed
	end
	local function catOf(d)  -- UI Settings: the category page title (the first label of the page's ScrollingFrame)
		local p = d.Parent
		while p and p ~= setLeft do if p:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then for _, c in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("TextLabel") then return c.Text end end end; p = p.Parent end
		return "UI Settings"
	end
	local function ensure()  -- off-screen build of tabs never opened yet (once per session per tab)
		for _, sx in ipairs(SECTIONS) do
			if not SR.tabs[sx.id] and not NOBUILD[sx.id] and PAGES[sx.id] then
				local keep = _curPage
				local host = new("ScrollingFrame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 600), CanvasSize = UDim2.new() })
				local sticky = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 40) })
				pcall(function() _curPage = sx.id; PAGES[sx.id](host, sticky) end)
				_curPage = keep
				SR.tabs[sx.id] = collect(host, sx.id)
				SR.hold[sx.id] = host  -- kept (unparented) so its switches still flip from the results; dropped when the tab is really built
			end
		end
	end
	local function hiddenTab(id) return type(SET.hiddenTabs) == "table" and SET.hiddenTabs[id] == true end
	local function all()
		local list = {}
		for _, sx in ipairs(SECTIONS) do
			if not hiddenTab(sx.id) then
				local col = _KR.tabCol(sx.color)
				list[#list + 1] = { tab = sx.id, name = sx.label, kind = "tab", desc = "Open the " .. sx.label .. " tab", col = col, tabLabel = sx.label }
				for _, e in ipairs(SR.tabs[sx.id] or {}) do e.col = col; e.tabLabel = sx.label; list[#list + 1] = e end
			end
		end
		for _, e in ipairs(SR.ui) do e.col = T.accent; e.tabLabel = "UI Settings"; list[#list + 1] = e end
		return list
	end
	local function score(e, words)
		local nm = e.name:lower(); local hay = (e.name .. " " .. (e.desc or "") .. " " .. (e.sec or "") .. " " .. (e.tabLabel or "")):lower()
		local sc = (e.kind == "tab") and 5 or 0
		for _, w in ipairs(words) do
			if not hay:find(w, 1, true) then return -1 end
			local a = nm:find(w, 1, true); sc += (a == 1 and 30) or (a and 20) or 5
		end
		return sc
	end
	local function hl(name, words)
		local low = name:lower()
		for _, w in ipairs(words) do
			local a = low:find(w, 1, true)
			if a then return esc(name:sub(1, a - 1)) .. '<font color="#' .. T.accent:ToHex() .. '">' .. esc(name:sub(a, a + #w - 1)) .. "</font>" .. esc(name:sub(a + #w)) end
		end
		return esc(name)
	end
	-- the window
	local scr = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "RoClothesSearch", ResetOnSpawn = false, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 1004, Enabled = false, Parent = PlayerGui })
	if GUIObject then GUIObject.SearchScreen = scr end  -- V4.5.68: stash for BREAKER.Destroying
	_KR.srchScreen = scr
	local dim = new("TextButton", { Name = "Dim", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = scr })
	local card = new("Frame", { Name = "Card", BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(520, 0), Parent = scr })
	local cc = corner(card, 16)
	local csc = new("UIScale", { Scale = UISCALE, Parent = card })
	new("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = card })
	local inRow = new("Frame", { Name = "In", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50), LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = card }); pad(inRow, 14, 8, 0, 0)
	_KR.srchGlyph = function(f, col)  -- a magnifier: ring + handle
		local ring = new("Frame", { Name = "Ring", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 11), Parent = f }); corner(ring, 6)
		new("UIStroke", { Color = col, Thickness = 2, Parent = ring })
		new("Frame", { Name = "Handle", BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 7), Rotation = -45, Parent = f })
	end
	local mg = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), Parent = inRow }); _KR.srchGlyph(mg, T.txt2)
	local box = new("TextBox", { Name = "Query", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 1, 0), Text = "", PlaceholderText = "Search settings", PlaceholderColor3 = T.txt3, TextColor3 = T.txt, Font = FONT, TextSize = 16, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ClearTextOnFocus = false, Parent = inRow })
	local cancel = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "Cancel", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = T.txt2, Parent = inRow })
	local line = new("Frame", { Name = "Line", BackgroundColor3 = T.line, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = card })
	local list = new("ScrollingFrame", { Name = "Results", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 120), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.line, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = card })
	pad(list, 6, 6, 6, 6)
	local lay = new("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 3), Parent = list })
	local function phone() return UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled end
	local function fitList()  -- results grow with their content, capped so a phone keeps them ABOVE the on-screen keyboard
		local sv = scr.AbsoluteSize; local k = math.max(0.05, csc.Scale)
		local cap = phone() and math.max(120, (sv.Y * 0.5 - GUI_INSET.Y - 70) / k) or math.min(340, (sv.Y * 0.7) / k)
		list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.min(cap, lay.AbsoluteContentSize.Y / k + 14))
	end
	lay:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(fitList)
	SR.skin = function()
		local st, light = SET.barStyle or "Dock", _KR.light()
		local sv = scr.AbsoluteSize; local k = math.max(0.05, UISCALE); csc.Scale = UISCALE
		local maxW = math.max(260, sv.X / k - 24)
		dim.BackgroundTransparency = (st == "Minimal") and 0.35 or 0.5
		box.TextSize = (st == "Minimal") and 24 or 16; box.Font = FONT; inRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, (st == "Minimal") and 56 or 50)
		line.BackgroundColor3 = T.line; line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1); line.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		if st == "Taskbar" then
			card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(520, maxW), 0)
			card.BackgroundColor3 = light and Color3.fromRGB(246, 246, 250) or Color3.fromRGB(32, 33, 40); card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.02; cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
			line.BackgroundColor3 = T.accent; line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2)
		elseif st == "Minimal" then
			card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(560, maxW), 0)
			card.BackgroundTransparency = 1; line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
		else
			card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(520, maxW), 0)
			card.BackgroundColor3 = T.bg; card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.04; cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
		end
		box.TextColor3 = T.txt; box.PlaceholderColor3 = T.txt3; cancel.TextColor3 = T.txt2
		-- V4.5.57 (krul): every style opens search in the MIDDLE of the screen, a fifth of the way down (results grow below without moving the box); a phone keeps it near the top, above the keyboard
		card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		card.Position = phone() and UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, GUI_INSET.Y + 12) or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.2, 0)
	end
	local function clear() for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do if not (c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIPadding")) then c:Destroy() end end end
	local function note(t, order) return lbl({ Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = t, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 12.5, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = list }) end
	local function resultRow(e, words, i)
		local st = SET.barStyle or "Dock"
		local b = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = (st == "Minimal") and Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 22) or T.txt, BackgroundTransparency = (st == "Minimal") and 0.5 or 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), LayoutOrder = i, Parent = list })
		corner(b, (st == "Taskbar") and 4 or ((st == "Minimal") and 23 or 10)); _KR.press(b)
		if st ~= "Minimal" then b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(b, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.93 }) end); b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(b, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end) end
		local ic = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), BackgroundColor3 = e.col or T.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = b }); corner(ic, (st == "Minimal") and 13 or ((st == "Taskbar") and 4 or 7))
		local path = (e.kind == "tab") and "Tab" or ((e.tabLabel or "") .. ((e.sec and e.sec ~= e.tabLabel) and (" > " .. e.sec) or ""))
		lbl({ RichText = true, Position = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -136, 0, 18), Text = hl(e.name, words), Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = b })
		lbl({ Position = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 25), Size = UDim2.new(1, -136, 0, 14), Text = path .. (((e.desc or "") ~= "") and ("  ·  " .. e.desc) or ""), TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 11, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = b })
		local reg = (e.kind == "toggle") and e.row and _KR.tgl[e.row]
		if reg then
			local trk = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 20), BackgroundColor3 = T.bg2, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = b }); corner(trk, 10)
			local kn = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), BackgroundColor3 = T.txt2, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = trk }); corner(kn, 8)
			local function paintSw() local on = reg.get() and true or false; trk.BackgroundColor3 = on and T.accent or T.bg2; kn.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or T.txt2; kn.Position = on and UDim2.new(1, -18, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0) end
			paintSw()
			b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() pcall(reg.flip); paintSw() end)
		else
			local v = (e.kind == "tab") and "Open" or ((e.kind == "action") and "Go to" or (e.row and rowValue(e.row, e.name)) or "")
			lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 18), Text = tostring(v):sub(1, 16), Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextSize = 11.5, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = b })
			lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 18), Text = ">", Font = FONTB, TextColor3 = T.txt3, TextSize = 12, Parent = b })
			b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SR.jump(e) end)
		end
	end
	SR.render = function()
		clear()
		local words = {}; for w in box.Text:lower():gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end
		if #words == 0 then
			note("Search any setting by its name or by what it does, like \"jiggle\", \"tear\" or \"light\".", 1)
			local chips = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = list })
			new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Wraps = true, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = chips })
			for i, sx in ipairs(SECTIONS) do
				if not hiddenTab(sx.id) then
					local w = 24; pcall(function() w = math.ceil(game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(sx.label, 15, FONTB, Vector2.new(400, 40)).X) + 24 end)
					local c = new("TextButton", { AutoButtonColor = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 28), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = sx.label, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = T.txt, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = chips }); corner(c, 14); _KR.press(c)
					c.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SR.jump({ tab = sx.id, kind = "tab" }) end)
				end
			end
			return
		end
		local hits = {}
		for _, e in ipairs(all()) do local sc = score(e, words); if sc >= 0 then hits[#hits + 1] = { e = e, s = sc } end end
		table.sort(hits, function(a, b) if a.s ~= b.s then return a.s > b.s end; return a.e.name < b.e.name end)
		if #hits == 0 then note("No settings match \"" .. box.Text .. "\". Try a shorter word, or what the setting does.", 1); return end
		for i = 1, math.min(30, #hits) do resultRow(hits[i].e, words, i) end
	end
	box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() if scr.Enabled then SR.render() end end)
	SR.open = function()
		if _destroyed then return end
		pcall(function() hideDropdown() end)
		SR.skin(); box.Text = ""; scr.Enabled = true
		SR.ui = collect(setLeft, "uiset", catOf)  -- UI Settings: read live every time (cheap; its rows rebuild often)
		SR.render(); fitList()
		task.defer(function() pcall(function() box:CaptureFocus() end) end)
		task.spawn(function() pcall(ensure); if scr.Enabled then SR.render() end end)  -- unopened tabs join the results a moment later
	end
	SR.close = function() scr.Enabled = false; pcall(function() box:ReleaseFocus() end) end
	dim.MouseButton1Click:Connect(SR.close); cancel.MouseButton1Click:Connect(SR.close)
	SR.flashRow = function(root, e)  -- find the live row, scroll it into view, flash it twice
		local r
		for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("TextButton") and d:GetAttribute("rcBaseT") ~= nil and rowName(d) == e.name then
				local p, vis = d, true
				while p and not p:IsA("ScreenGui") do if p:IsA("GuiObject") and not p.Visible then vis = false; break end; p = p.Parent end
				if vis then r = d; break end
			end
		end
		if not r then return end
		local sf = r:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
		if sf then
			local k, p = 1, sf
			while p and not p:IsA("ScreenGui") do local u = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); if u then k *= u.Scale end; p = p.Parent end
			local delta = (r.AbsolutePosition.Y - sf.AbsolutePosition.Y) - sf.AbsoluteSize.Y * 0.3
			tween(sf, 0.35, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(sf.CanvasPosition.X, math.max(0, sf.CanvasPosition.Y + delta / math.max(0.05, k))) })
		end
		local pd = r:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding"); local l, rr, t, bb = 0, 0, 0, 0
		if pd then l, rr, t, bb = pd.PaddingLeft.Offset, pd.PaddingRight.Offset, pd.PaddingTop.Offset, pd.PaddingBottom.Offset end
		local fl = new("Frame", { Name = "SearchFlash", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-l, -t), Size = UDim2.new(1, l + rr, 1, t + bb), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.55, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = r.ZIndex + 1, Parent = r })
		local rc = r:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner"); if rc then new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = rc.CornerRadius, Parent = fl }) end
		task.spawn(function()
			if SET.reduceMotion then task.wait(1.4) else for _ = 1, 2 do tween(fl, 0.45, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.95 }); task.wait(0.5); tween(fl, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.55 }); task.wait(0.32) end; tween(fl, 0.5, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }); task.wait(0.52) end
			pcall(function() fl:Destroy() end)
		end)
	end
	SR.jump = function(e)
		SR.close()
		task.spawn(function()
			if e.tab == "uiset" then
				if not homeOpen then openHome(); task.wait(0.6) end
				if goTo then pcall(goTo, "settings") end
				_KR._setCat = e.cat; if e.sub then SET.apSub = e.sub end
				pcall(fillSettings); task.wait(0.45)
				SR.flashRow(setLeft, e)
				return
			end
			local sx = SECTION_BY_ID[e.tab]; if not sx then return end
			if e.sec then _KR.secSel[e.tab] = e.sec end
			if not SET.multiPanel and panelOpen and activeTab == e.tab then pcall(buildPage, e.tab)
			else onTabClick(e.tab, sx.label, _KR.tabCol(sx.color), tabs[e.tab] and tabs[e.tab].btn) end
			if e.kind == "tab" then return end
			task.wait(0.6)
			SR.flashRow(SET.multiPanel and MP.screen or panelScreen, e)
		end)
	end
	-- the bar button
	local sb = new("TextButton", { Name = "Search", AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), BackgroundColor3 = T.cardHi, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 999, Parent = bar })
	local sbc = corner(sb, 11); _KR.press(sb)
	local sg = new("Frame", { Name = "Glyph", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), Parent = sb }); _KR.srchGlyph(sg, IC)
	sb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if scr.Enabled then SR.close() else SR.open() end end)
	sb.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if _KR.tipShow then _KR.tipShow(sb, "Search") end end)
	sb.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if _KR.tipHide then _KR.tipHide() end end)
	_KR.srchSkinBtn = function()
		local st, light = SET.barStyle or "Dock", _KR.light()
		sb.LayoutOrder = (st == "Dock" and 999) or (st == "Taskbar" and 1) or -1  -- Dock: after the tabs; Taskbar: next to Start; Minimal: top of the column
		if st == "Taskbar" then sb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		elseif st == "Minimal" then sb.BackgroundColor3 = light and Color3.fromRGB(250, 250, 252) or Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 22); sb.BackgroundTransparency = light and 0.25 or 0.4
		else sb.BackgroundColor3 = T.cardHi; sb.BackgroundTransparency = 0 end
		_KR.corners[sbc] = (st == "Minimal") and 40 or 11; sbc.CornerRadius = _KR.cornerUD(sb, _KR.corners[sbc])
		local col = light and T.txt or IC
		for _, d in ipairs(sg:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("UIStroke") then d.Color = col elseif d:IsA("Frame") and d.Name == "Handle" then d.BackgroundColor3 = col end end
	end
	pcall(_KR.srchSkinBtn)
end
_KR.srchInit()
if SET.mode ~= "Dark" or SET.contrast ~= "Standard" or (SET.panelTint or 0) > 0 then pcall(function() _KR.applyPalette(); A.applyBackdrop(); A.applyStyle() end) end
pcall(_KR.accAnimSync)  -- V4.5.57: a saved animated accent starts at boot
if (SET.textScale or 100) ~= 100 then pcall(A.applyTextScale) end  -- V4.5.57: a saved text size
if (SET.wallpaper or "") ~= "" then pcall(_KR.loadWall) end  -- V4.5.57: a saved wallpaper  -- V4.5.57: a saved light / high-contrast / tinted look paints the boot-built UI
A.playIntro()  -- play once at boot (identical timing to the old inline IIFE)

-- TEST teardown so the script can be re-run cleanly without rejoining. TEMPORARY - the shipped DESTROY (more
-- complete) will replace this. Disconnects the global Heartbeats + picker UIS drag conns, un-hides any game GUIs
-- we hid, drops the Lighting blur, and destroys every ScreenGui (which cascades to descendants → ends the ambient
-- `while <inst>.Parent do` loops and fires the sliders' Destroying disconnects).
destroyUI = function(ox, oy)   -- ox,oy = the DESTROY-button-centre (raw AbsolutePosition space); the shockwave bursts from there
	if _destroyed then return end
	_destroyed = true
	if _KR.accAnim and _KR.accAnim.conn then _KR.accAnim.conn:Disconnect(); _KR.accAnim.conn = nil; pcall(_KR.accUnhook) end  -- V4.5.57 animated accent
	if _KR.embers and _KR.embers.c then _KR.embers.c:Disconnect(); _KR.embers.c = nil end  -- V4.5.57 embers
	stopWave(); stopGlow(); if A.stopAuto then A.stopAuto() end   -- kill ambient loops NOW so nothing re-appears mid-exit
	pcall(function() _pk1:Disconnect() end); pcall(function() _pk2:Disconnect() end)
	pcall(function() _KR.homeClickConn:Disconnect() end); for _, c in ipairs(_KR.foreignConns or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end  -- V4.5.57 listeners (Home click-out, engine-popup restyle)
	pcall(function() MP.vpConn:Disconnect() end); pcall(function() MP.setVpConn:Disconnect() end); pcall(function() MP.styleVpConn:Disconnect() end); pcall(function() MP.introVpConn:Disconnect() end)   -- the 3 previously-uncaptured ViewportSize connections (were stacking on DESTROY + re-run)
	-- The REAL teardown (restore the game's UI + destroy every ScreenGui). Deferred behind the exit animation below.
	local function teardown()
		-- V4.5.17 NON-INTRUSIVE: destroyUI teardown no longer force-enables CoreGui/topbar. openHome disables none, so re-enabling would only clobber CoreGui the host game itself disabled. The _hiddenGuis restore below stays (re-enables only game ScreenGuis WE hid = none now).
		for _, g in ipairs(_KR._hiddenGuis or {}) do pcall(function() g.Enabled = true end) end
		if _KR.homeBlur then pcall(function() _KR.homeBlur:Destroy() end) end
		pcall(function() local i = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("RoClothesIntro"); if i then i:Destroy() end end)  -- tear down the intro overlay too if DESTROY is hit mid-play
		if _KR.srchScreen then pcall(function() _KR.srchScreen:Destroy() end) end  -- V4.5.57 search
		for _, s in ipairs({ screen, homeScreen, panelScreen, pickerScreen, modalScreen, MP.screen, GUIObject.hardcoreUI }) do pcall(function() s:Destroy() end) end  -- V4.5.24 Fix: hardcoreUI (mobile Heal/Tear buttons + hardcore HP group) was missing -> orphan after DESTROY
	end
	if SET.reduceMotion then teardown(); return end   -- reduced motion → no exit animation, tear down immediately
	local ust = SET.barStyle or "Dock"
	if ust == "Taskbar" or ust == "Minimal" then  -- V4.5.57 (krul approved the demo): the exit follows the UI style; Dock keeps the detonation below. Same ~1.4s, same teardown.
		local fx = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "RoClothesDestroyFx", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 2001, Parent = PlayerGui })
		local function fadeIn(root, d)  -- fade every visible piece of a tree (text, images, fills)
			for _, o in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do pcall(function()
				if (o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox")) and o.TextTransparency < 1 then tween(o, d, { TextTransparency = 1 }) end
				if (o:IsA("ImageLabel") or o:IsA("ImageButton")) and o.ImageTransparency < 1 then tween(o, d, { ImageTransparency = 1 }) end
				if o:IsA("GuiObject") and o.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then tween(o, d, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end
			end) end
		end
		local function fadeAll(d) for _, sg in ipairs({ screen, homeScreen, panelScreen, MP.screen }) do pcall(fadeIn, sg, d) end end
		if ust == "Taskbar" then
			-- windows minimise the Windows way (shrink a little, drop toward the taskbar, fade), the taskbar slides away, then a
			-- small "Closing RoClothes" flyout with the Welcome dots
			for _, o in ipairs({ homeScroll, panel }) do pcall(function()
				if not (o and o.Visible and o.AbsoluteSize.X > 0) then return end
				tween(o, 0.26, { Position = o.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 40) }, QUINT)
				local u = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); if u then tween(u, 0.26, { Scale = u.Scale * 0.9 }, QUINT) end
			end) end
			fadeAll(0.26)
			task.delay(0.16, function() pcall(function() tween(bar, 0.3, { Position = bar.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, SET.barTop and -90 or 90) }, QUINT) end) end)
			local card = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.46), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 112), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 31, 38), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = fx }); corner(card, 8)
			new("UIScale", { Scale = UISCALE, Parent = card })
			local cap = lbl({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 72), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), Text = "Closing RoClothes", Font = FONTB, TextSize = 15, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextTransparency = 1, Parent = card })
			local dh = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 42), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = card })
			local dd = {}
			for i = 1, 5 do local d = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = dh }); corner(d, 3); dd[i] = d end
			task.delay(0.38, function()
				if not fx.Parent then return end
				tween(card, 0.22, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.06 }); tween(cap, 0.22, { TextTransparency = 0 })
				local t0 = os.clock()
				while fx.Parent and os.clock() - t0 < 0.95 do
					local t = os.clock() - t0
					for i, d in ipairs(dd) do
						local ph = ((t - (i - 1) * 0.12) % 2.2) / 2.2; local e = math.clamp(ph / 0.86, 0, 1); e = (e < 0.5) and 4 * e ^ 3 or 1 - (-2 * e + 2) ^ 3 / 2
						local a = math.rad(e * 720); d.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.sin(a) * 15, 0.5, -math.cos(a) * 15); d.BackgroundTransparency = (ph < 0.86 and t > (i - 1) * 0.12) and 0 or 1
					end
					task.wait()
				end
			end)
			task.delay(1.15, function() if fx.Parent then pcall(fadeIn, fx, 0.25); tween(card, 0.25, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end end)
		else
			-- Minimal: the panel drifts left as it fades, the icon column leaves one by one from the top, and an accent hairline
			-- draws across the middle then pulls back to a point with a quiet "closed" caption
			for _, o in ipairs({ homeScroll, panel }) do pcall(function() if o and o.Visible then tween(o, 0.32, { Position = o.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(-24, 0) }, QUINT) end end) end
			for i, sec in ipairs(SECTIONS) do local t = tabs[sec.id]; if t and t.btn then task.delay(i * 0.035, function() pcall(fadeIn, t.btn, 0.24); pcall(function() tween(t.btn, 0.24, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end) end) end end
			task.delay(0.3, function() fadeAll(0.3) end)
			local W = math.floor(760 * UISCALE + 0.5)
			local hl = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = T.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = fx })
			local cap = lbl({ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, math.floor(16 * UISCALE)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 16), Text = "ROCLOTHES:KRUL CLOSED", Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = math.max(9, math.floor(12 * UISCALE + 0.5)), TextColor3 = T.txt2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextTransparency = 1, Parent = fx })
			task.delay(0.3, function() if fx.Parent then tween(hl, 0.42, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, 1) }, QUINT); tween(cap, 0.3, { TextTransparency = 0.1 }) end end)
			task.delay(0.9, function() if fx.Parent then tween(hl, 0.42, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, QUINT, Enum.EasingDirection.In); tween(cap, 0.38, { TextTransparency = 1 }) end end)
		end
		task.delay((ust == "Minimal") and 0.62 or 0.45, function() pcall(function() for _, sg in ipairs({ screen, homeScreen, panelScreen, MP.screen }) do sg.Enabled = false end end) end)  -- after the fades land
		task.delay(1.4, function() pcall(function() fx:Destroy() end); teardown() end)
		return
	end
	-- EXIT ANIMATION - the UI COLLAPSES INTO the DESTROY button first (gliding in, swirling + shrinking to a point) while a
	-- core charges and sparks SPIRAL IN; then it DETONATES: a flare, FIVE thick concentric shockwaves, ~54 embers SPIRALLING
	-- out + debris streaks, and a lingering glow. Then teardown.
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local vw, vh = (cam and cam.ViewportSize.X) or 1280, (cam and cam.ViewportSize.Y) or 720
	local tx, ty = ox or (vw / 2), oy or (vh / 2)                                             -- collapse target = the button centre (AbsolutePosition space)
	local cx, cy = (ox and ox + GUI_INSET.X) or (vw / 2), (oy and oy + GUI_INSET.Y) or (vh / 2)   -- fx burst origin (+ inset for the IgnoreGuiInset overlay) = the button's RENDERED centre, so blast + collapse line up
	local fx = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "RoClothesDestroyFx", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 2001, Parent = PlayerGui })
	local orig = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy)
	local function dot(sz, col, z, par) local d = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = orig, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz), BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 12, Parent = par or fx }); corner(d, 999); return d end
	local function spinner(deg, dur, z) local sp = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = orig, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Rotation = 0, ZIndex = z or 13, Parent = fx }); tween(sp, dur, { Rotation = deg }, QUINT); return sp end   -- rotating pivot → children moving radially trace a SPIRAL
	-- PHASE 1 - COLLAPSE INTO THE BUTTON (~0.36s): each container glides to the button, swirls + shrinks to nothing; a core
	-- charges up while sparks SPIRAL IN (spinner pivot + a radial-in tween).
	for _, o in ipairs({ bar, homeScroll, panel }) do pcall(function()
		if not (o and o.AbsoluteSize.X > 0) then return end
		local ac = o.AbsolutePosition + o.AbsoluteSize / 2
		tween(o, 0.36, { Position = o.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(tx - ac.X, ty - ac.Y), Rotation = 24 }, QUINT)   -- glide to the button + swirl
		local u = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); if u then tween(u, 0.36, { Scale = 0 }, QUINT) end            -- shrink into the point
	end) end
	local core = dot(6, Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 245), 16); core.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1; tween(core, 0.36, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54) })
	local inSp = spinner(-150, 0.36, 15)
	for i = 1, 18 do
		local ang, dist = (i / 18) * math.pi * 2, 150 + math.random() * 210
		local s = dot(3 + math.random() * 3, (i % 2 == 0) and T.accent or T.accent2, 15, inSp); s.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.cos(ang) * dist, math.sin(ang) * dist); s.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tween(s, 0.16, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 }); tween(s, 0.36, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1) }, QUINT)
	end
	for _, sg in ipairs({ screen, homeScreen, panelScreen, MP.screen }) do   -- fade text/images so nothing lingers into the blast (the containers shrink; this catches the rest)
		for _, d in ipairs(sg:GetDescendants()) do pcall(function()
			if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox")) and d.TextTransparency < 1 then tween(d, 0.32, { TextTransparency = 1 }) end
			if (d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton")) and d.ImageTransparency < 1 then tween(d, 0.32, { ImageTransparency = 1 }) end
		end) end
	end
	-- PHASE 2 - DETONATION (~0.36s in): hide the collapsed UI (it's a point now), then flare + FIVE thick shockwaves + a
	-- SPIRAL ember blast + streaks + glow.
	task.delay(0.36, function()
		if not fx.Parent then return end
		pcall(function() for _, sg in ipairs({ screen, homeScreen, panelScreen, MP.screen }) do sg.Enabled = false end end)
		tween(core, 0.12, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 150), BackgroundTransparency = 0 }); task.delay(0.12, function() tween(core, 0.42, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 320), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end)
		for r = 1, 5 do task.delay((r - 1) * 0.07, function() if not fx.Parent then return end   -- FIVE thick concentric shockwaves
			local ring = dot(24, T.bg, 11); ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1; local rs = stroke(ring, (r % 2 == 0) and T.accent2 or T.accent, 13)
			tween(ring, 0.65, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(vw * 1.9, vw * 1.9) }, EXPO); tween(rs, 0.65, { Transparency = 1, Thickness = 2 })
		end) end
		local outSp = spinner(155, 0.9, 14)   -- ember blast SPIRALS out (spinner pivot + a radial-out tween)
		local COL = { T.accent, T.accent2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 235) }
		for i = 1, 54 do
			local m = dot(2 + math.random() * 8, COL[(i % 3) + 1], 14, outSp); m.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)   -- start at the pivot
			local ang, dist = math.random() * math.pi * 2, 150 + math.random() * 560
			tween(m, 0.6 + math.random() * 0.4, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.cos(ang) * dist, math.sin(ang) * dist), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, QUINT)
		end
		for i = 1, 16 do   -- streaks: thin elongated debris shooting straight out along its own angle
			local ang = math.random() * math.pi * 2
			local st = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = orig, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 3), Rotation = math.deg(ang), BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and T.accent or Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 235), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 12, Parent = fx }); corner(st, 2)
			local dist = 240 + math.random() * 360
			tween(st, 0.45, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + math.cos(ang) * dist, cy + math.sin(ang) * dist), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, QUINT)
		end
		local glow = dot(90, T.accent, 10); glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22; tween(glow, 0.9, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(440, 440), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	end)
	task.delay(1.4, function() pcall(function() fx:Destroy() end); teardown() end)
end

			data = data or {}
			if kind == "installer" then
				local done, total, failed = tonumber(data.done) or 0, tonumber(data.total) or 0, tonumber(data.failed) or 0
				local pct = (total > 0) and math.floor((done / total) * 100 + 0.5) or 0
				toast("Downloading content", string.format("%d%%   %d / %d files%s", pct, done, total, failed > 0 and ("   (" .. failed .. " failed)") or ""), "info")  -- same title updates in place -> live progress
			elseif kind == "installFail" then
				toast("Content install failed", (data.reason and data.reason ~= "" and tostring(data.reason)) or "Couldn't download content -- try Redownload All, or check your connection.", "err")
			elseif kind == "dataOffline" then
				toast("Data servers unreachable", (data.reason and data.reason ~= "" and tostring(data.reason)) or "Couldn't reach krulhub.dev -- some features may be limited.", "warn")
			end
		end
		System.hideOverlay = function(kind)
			-- The engine calls hideOverlay() no-arg on install-complete.
			pcall(function() local t = _toasts and _toasts["Downloading content"]; if t and t.card and t.card.Parent then toast("Downloading content", "Content ready.", "ok") end end)
		end
	end
