	System.getRotationPhysicsMultiply = function() return RotationPhysicsMultiply end

	-- REDOWNLOAD ALL CONTENT (Options "Redownload All Content" button). Re-runs the
	-- asset installer. Core of the original handler (L~29570-29599): reset the installed
	-- flag, bump the install generation guard, then pcall(Function.InstallContentAssets)
	-- (it is async-safe + shows its own overlay). Re-entry guarded so a double-click can't
	-- stack two installers. The button-text choreography is omitted (the new GUI is momentary).
	System.doRedownload = function(onProgress)  -- onProgress(done,total,failed,file,size,stage): "downloading"/"installing" live, then "complete"/"error" once. Passing it routes progress to the caller (the toast) instead of the raw pill.
		if Function._redlInProgress then return end
		Function._redlInProgress = true
		System._contentInstalled = false
		System._installGen = (System._installGen or 0) + 1
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok = pcall(Function.InstallContentAssets, true, onProgress)  -- V4.4.x: force a full re-fetch so the user sees real progress, not an instant no-op
			Function._redlInProgress = false
			if onProgress then pcall(onProgress, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, ok and "complete" or "error") end  -- final signal so the caller can close out the progress toast
		end)
	end

	-- ============================================================
	-- GIZMO / EDIT-TAB BRIDGE. The Edit tab was 100% demo scaffold after the
	-- GUI merge (mock target list, sliders with no onChange, static Properties).
	-- The continuous gizmo->mesh weld loop SURVIVED the teardown (mesh body
	-- parts L~22849-22859 keyed by Part.Name; accessories L~23075-23135 keyed by
	-- "acc:"..accName) -- it welds C0 = baseC0 * C1Inv * CFrame.new(Pos) * RotCF
	-- * baseC1 from PlayerData[sp].GizmoOffsets[key]. So the GUI only has to WRITE
	-- GizmoOffsets[target] and the loop renders the change live.
	--
	-- These reproduce the ORIGINAL V4.3.576 Edit-tab driving semantics (target
	-- dropdown L25817-25963, MakeGizmoSlider L32123, Clear L26115, Export L26146,
	-- Multi L26186, Copy/Paste-Mirror/Undo L32560-32681, presets L26019/26077).
	-- All public methods are System.* FIELDS = 0 RoClothes registers (PlayerData /
	-- SelectPlayer / GizmoSliderRefreshers / Function / env / hotSwap all in scope
	-- here). The 3 helper locals live inside the `do...end` below so they cost 0
	-- RoClothes registers too (the established "new locals only in do...end" rule,
	-- so this block stays well clear of Luau's 200-local cap). Ranges: Pos -2..2
	-- studs, Rot -180..180 deg (orig L32244-32250). LANDMINE V4.3.135: every write
	-- to a GizmoOffset table is IN-PLACE -- the singular GizmoOffset is a write-
	-- through reference INTO GizmoOffsets[target] and must never be replaced
	-- wholesale, or per-target persistence breaks.
	do
	-- axis ranges + a zero-offset factory shared by the gizmo methods below.
	local _GIZMO_RANGE = { Pos = {-2, 2}, Rot = {-180, 180} }
	local function _gizZero()
		return { PosX=0, PosY=0, PosZ=0, RotX=0, RotY=0, RotZ=0, RotCF=CFrame.new() }
	end
	-- The GUI registers per-slider refreshers here so BOTH the engine's reset
	-- path (System.doReset iterates GizmoSliderRefreshers) AND a gizmo-bridge
	-- mutation can re-sync the sliders + Properties to the live offset in place.
	System.gizmoRegisterRefresher = function(fn)
		if type(fn) == "function" then table.insert(GizmoSliderRefreshers, fn) end
	end
	-- The Edit page is rebuilt on every nav visit (go("edit")), so it deregisters
	-- its prior refresher before registering the fresh one to avoid accumulating
	-- dead closures that point at destroyed sliders.
	System.gizmoUnregisterRefresher = function(fn)
		if type(fn) ~= "function" then return end
		local i = table.find(GizmoSliderRefreshers, fn)
		if i then table.remove(GizmoSliderRefreshers, i) end
	end

	-- Enumerate the REAL selectable targets for the selected player (orig
	-- rebuildGizmoDropdown L25817-25963): body-part mesh names from the live
	-- RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh keys + Roblox accessories (key "acc:"..name).
	-- Returns an ARRAY of {key, label, kind="mesh"|"acc", selected(bool for multi)}.
	System.getGizmoTargets = function()
		local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
		local out = {}
		local char = (Function.ResolveTargetChar and Function.ResolveTargetChar(sp)) or (Player and Player.Character)
		if not char then return out end
		local cur = (PlayerData[sp] and PlayerData[sp].GizmoTarget) or nil
		-- RIG POSER targets = body parts that own a rig joint (Motor6D.Part1). Editing that joint
		-- moves the part + everything Motor6D-d below it (Torso -> whole body). Body-only: arm/leg/head/torso.
		local names, seen = {}, {}
		for _, m in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			-- R6 rigs joint via Motor6D (part = Part1); upgraded-R15 rigs joint via AnimationConstraint (part = Attachment1's parent).
			local p = (m:IsA("Motor6D") and m.Part1) or (m:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and m.Attachment1 and m.Attachment1.Parent)
			if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
				local nm = p.Name
				local _l = nm:lower()
				if not seen[nm] and (_l:find("arm") or _l:find("leg") or _l:find("torso") or _l:find("head") or _l:find("hand") or _l:find("foot")) then
					seen[nm] = true; table.insert(names, nm)
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(names, function(a, b) return a:lower() < b:lower() end)
		for _, nm in ipairs(names) do
			table.insert(out, { key = nm, label = nm, kind = "joint", selected = (cur == nm) })
		end
		return out
	end

	System.getGizmoTarget = function()
		local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
		local pd = PlayerData[sp]
		return pd and pd.GizmoTarget or nil
	end

	-- Select a target. Mirrors the dropdown click
	-- closures (orig L25862-25956): create the per-target offset if absent
	-- (accessories also stash baseC0/baseC1 from the Handle weld), set GizmoTarget,
	-- and LINK the singular GizmoOffset to GizmoOffsets[key] (write-through ref).
	-- Returns true if a single target was selected (caller should reseed sliders),
	-- false for a multi-mode toggle (caller re-renders the dropdown only).
	System.setGizmoTarget = function(key)
		local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
		local pd = PlayerData[sp]
		if not pd or type(key) ~= "string" then return false end
		pd.GizmoOffsets = pd.GizmoOffsets or {}
		if not pd.GizmoOffsets[key] then
			if key:sub(1, 4) == "acc:" then
				-- capture the live accessory weld bases so the gizmo math has a stable frame
				local char = Function.ResolveTargetChar(sp)
				local acc = char and char:FindFirstChild(key:sub(5))
				if not acc then  -- V4.5.59 (N9): Method 2 keeps RoClothes-loaded accessories on the proxy model
					local m2 = System.M2FName and workspace:FindFirstChild(System.M2FName)
					local px = m2 and m2:FindFirstChild(sp)
					acc = px and px:FindFirstChild(key:sub(5))
				end
				local handle = acc and acc:IsA("Accessory") and acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
				local weld = handle and handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Weld")
				if not weld then return false end
				local z = _gizZero()
				z.baseC0 = weld.C0
				z.baseC1 = weld.C1
				pd.GizmoOffsets[key] = z
			else
				pd.GizmoOffsets[key] = _gizZero()
			end
		end
		pd.GizmoTarget = key
		pd.GizmoOffset = pd.GizmoOffsets[key]
		return true
	end




	-- Reset a single axis to 0 (orig MakeGizmoSlider R button L32185-32200):
	-- for Rot, un-multiply the RotCF by the inverse of the old rotation.
	-- =====================================================================
	-- SP2: 3D DIRECT-MANIPULATION GIZMO (engine ArcHandles + Handles), modeled on
	-- the Catalog Avatar Creator gizmo. Adorns the engine gizmo to the live target
	-- pipeline (RenderStepped apply) is reused unchanged. Move + Rotate, toggled.
	-- =====================================================================
	System._giz3dMode = System._giz3dMode or "Pos"
	-- =====================================================================
	-- SP2 GIZMO = RIG POSER, ported 1:1 from the Catalog Avatar Creator PoseTool
	-- (decompiled to GAME_POSETOOL_REFERENCE.md). It edits the selected body
	-- part's rig JOINT (Motor6D.C0), NOT any mesh. Because the rig is a Motor6D
	-- hierarchy, editing a joint moves that part + everything Motor6D-d below it,
	-- rigidly: Torso RootJoint moves the WHOLE body; a leaf (arm/leg/head) moves
	-- only itself. Move + Rotate via engine Handles/ArcHandles, snap-step, HRP
	-- anchored during the drag, animations frozen so the pose holds.
	-- =====================================================================
	local function _giz3dChar()
		local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
		return (Function.ResolveTargetChar and Function.ResolveTargetChar(sp)) or (Player and Player.Character)
	end
	-- JOINT ADAPTER (rig-agnostic): R6 rigs joint via Motor6D; upgraded-R15 rigs joint via AnimationConstraint.
	-- Mirrors the game's JointAdapter so the poser works on BOTH. Motor6D "C0/C1" = .C0/.C1; AnimationConstraint
	-- "C0/C1" = Attachment0/Attachment1.CFrame. _jKinematic (AnimationConstraint only) lets a C0 edit hold as a pose.
	local function _isPoseJoint(j) return j:IsA("Motor6D") or j:IsA("AnimationConstraint") end
	local function _jPart(j) if j:IsA("Motor6D") then return j.Part1 end local a = j.Attachment1; return a and a.Parent end
	local function _jGetC0(j) if j:IsA("Motor6D") then return j.C0 end local a = j.Attachment0; return (a and a.CFrame) or CFrame.new() end
	local function _jSetC0(j, cf) if j:IsA("Motor6D") then j.C0 = cf return end local a = j.Attachment0; if a then a.CFrame = cf end end
	local function _jGetC1(j) if j:IsA("Motor6D") then return j.C1 end local a = j.Attachment1; return (a and a.CFrame) or CFrame.new() end
	local function _jSetC1(j, cf) if j:IsA("Motor6D") then j.C1 = cf return end local a = j.Attachment1; if a then a.CFrame = cf end end
	local function _jKinematic(j) if j:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then pcall(function() j.IsKinematic = true end) end end
	-- part NAME -> its rig joint (Motor6D with Part1==part, OR the AnimationConstraint that moves the part) + the part.
	local function _giz3dResolveJoint(key)
		if type(key) ~= "string" then return nil, nil end
		local char = _giz3dChar(); if not char then return nil, nil end
		local part = char:FindFirstChild(key)
		if not (part and part:IsA("BasePart")) then
			part = nil
			for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name == key then part = d; break end end
		end
		if not part then return nil, nil end
		for _, m in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if _isPoseJoint(m) and _jPart(m) == part then return m, part end
		end
		return nil, part
	end
	local function _giz3dContainer()
		return (Player and Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")) or ((gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui"))
	end
	-- Snap STEP (the game "0.001 studs / 0.001 degrees"): the engine handles track the mouse 1:1;
	-- this only rounds the applied delta (0.001 = smooth, higher = coarser precise steps).
	System._giz3dStep = System._giz3dStep or 0.001
	System.getGizmoStep = function() return System._giz3dStep or 0.001 end
	System.setGizmoStep = function(v) System._giz3dStep = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 0.001, 0.001, 90); return System._giz3dStep end
	local function _snap(v, step) step = step or 0.001; return math.floor(v / step + 0.5) * step end
	System._giz3dOrig = System._giz3dOrig or {}  -- joint -> {C0,C1} captured before first edit, for reset
	-- Freeze/thaw anims so an edited C0 holds statically (animation writes Motor6D.Transform on top
	-- of C0 each frame otherwise). Mirrors the game ToggleCharacterAnimations.
	local function _giz3dSetAnims(char, on)
		if not char then return end
		local an = char:FindFirstChild("Animate"); if an then pcall(function() an.Enabled = on end) end
		pcall(function() char:SetAttribute("PoseApplied", not on) end)
		if on then return end
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if animator then for _, tr in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do pcall(function() tr:Stop(0) end) end end
	end
	-- Bake a joint C1 rotation into C0 so the drag axes are clean (game NormalizeMotorC1Orientation).
	local function _giz3dNormalize(joint)
		if not System._giz3dOrig[joint] then System._giz3dOrig[joint] = { C0 = _jGetC0(joint), C1 = _jGetC1(joint) } end
		local c1 = _jGetC1(joint)
		if c1.Rotation == CFrame.new().Rotation then return end
		_jSetC0(joint, _jGetC0(joint) * c1.Rotation:Inverse())
		_jSetC1(joint, c1 * c1.Rotation:Inverse())
	end
	System.hideGizmo3D = function(keepFrozen)  -- keepFrozen: an INTERNAL handle rebuild (show / mode-switch) keeps the pose frozen; a USER close (Hide Gizmo / Reset Pose / leaving Edit) un-freezes.
		if System._giz3dConns then for _, c in ipairs(System._giz3dConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end System._giz3dConns = nil end
		if System._giz3dHandle then pcall(function() System._giz3dHandle:Destroy() end) System._giz3dHandle = nil end
		-- Restore the HRP anchor from IsClone (clone = stays a frozen statue; PLAYER = un-anchors so they can walk). NEVER read
		-- live hrp.Anchored - it LATCHES `true` after a missed Handles MouseButton1Up, which used to freeze players forever.
		local hrp = System._giz3dHrp or (System._giz3dFrozeChar and System._giz3dFrozeChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
		if hrp then pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = System._giz3dIsClone and true or false end) end
		System._giz3dHrp = nil
		if not keepFrozen and System._giz3dFrozeChar then  -- user closed the gizmo → re-enable animations on the char we actually froze
			pcall(_giz3dSetAnims, System._giz3dFrozeChar, true); System._giz3dFrozeChar = nil
		end
	end
	-- V4.5.59 (N9): ACCESSORIES as gizmo targets ("acc:<name>"). The weld loops already apply GizmoOffsets["acc:<name>"]
	-- as C0 = base * C1^-1 * T * C1 (T = Pos * RotCF), and that table is saved in bundles + synced to peers, so the gizmo
	-- only has to WRITE it. A drag gives the wanted handle CFrame; solve the weld for C0, then T from C0 - that works
	-- whichever side of the weld the handle is on. Size = GizmoOffsets[...].Scale (0.2..5), applied by the same loops.
	local function _giz3dAccRoots()
		local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
		local roots = { _giz3dChar() }
		local m2 = System.M2FName and workspace:FindFirstChild(System.M2FName)
		if m2 and m2:FindFirstChild(sp) then table.insert(roots, m2[sp]) end
		return roots
	end
	local function _giz3dAcc(key)
		local name = key:sub(5)
		for _, r in ipairs(_giz3dAccRoots()) do
			local acc = r and r:FindFirstChild(name)
			local h = acc and acc:IsA("Accessory") and acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			local w = h and h:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Weld")
			if h and w and w.Part0 and w.Part1 then return h, w end
		end
	end
	System.getAccessoryTargets = function()
		local out, seen = {}, {}
		for _, r in ipairs(_giz3dAccRoots()) do
			for _, a in ipairs(r and r:GetChildren() or {}) do
				if a:IsA("Accessory") and not seen[a.Name] and a:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
					seen[a.Name] = true; table.insert(out, { key = "acc:" .. a.Name, label = a.Name })
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(out, function(x, y) return x.label:lower() < y.label:lower() end)
		return out
	end
	local function _accSolve(weld, handle, go, want)
		local PA = weld.C1
		local T = CFrame.new(go.PosX or 0, go.PosY or 0, go.PosZ or 0) * ((typeof(go.RotCF) == "CFrame" and go.RotCF) or CFrame.new())
		local A = weld.C0 * PA:Inverse() * T:Inverse() * PA
		local c0
		if weld.Part0 == handle then c0 = want:Inverse() * weld.Part1.CFrame * weld.C1 else c0 = weld.Part0.CFrame:Inverse() * want * weld.C1 end
		local Tn = PA * A:Inverse() * c0 * PA:Inverse()
		go.PosX, go.PosY, go.PosZ = Tn.Position.X, Tn.Position.Y, Tn.Position.Z
		go.RotCF = Tn.Rotation
		weld.C0 = c0  -- immediate (the weld loop writes the same value next frame)
	end
	local function _giz3dShowAcc(key)
		local handle, weld = _giz3dAcc(key)
		if not handle then return false end
		local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
		local pd = PlayerData[sp]
		if not pd then return false end
		if not (pd.GizmoOffsets and pd.GizmoOffsets[key]) then System.setGizmoTarget(key) end
		local go = pd.GizmoOffsets and pd.GizmoOffsets[key]
		if not go then return false end
		local mode = System._giz3dMode
		local h
		if mode == "Rot" then
			h = Instance.new("ArcHandles"); h.Axes = Axes.new(Enum.Axis.X, Enum.Axis.Y, Enum.Axis.Z)
		else
			h = Instance.new("Handles"); h.Style = (mode == "Size") and Enum.HandlesStyle.Resize or Enum.HandlesStyle.Movement
			h.Faces = Faces.new(Enum.NormalId.Right, Enum.NormalId.Left, Enum.NormalId.Top, Enum.NormalId.Bottom, Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back)
		end
		h.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(13, 105, 172); h.Adornee = handle; h.Parent = _giz3dContainer()
		System._giz3dConns = {}
		local H0, sc0, len0
		table.insert(System._giz3dConns, h.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			local nh, nw = _giz3dAcc(key)  -- a rebuild may have replaced the handle/weld since the gizmo opened
			if nh then handle, weld = nh, nw; h.Adornee = nh end
			H0 = handle.CFrame; sc0 = math.clamp(tonumber(go.Scale) or 1, 0.2, 5)
			len0 = math.max(handle.Size.X, handle.Size.Y, handle.Size.Z, 0.1)
		end))
		local function step() return System._giz3dStep or 0.001 end
		if mode == "Rot" then
			table.insert(System._giz3dConns, h.MouseDrag:Connect(function(axis, ang)
				if H0 then pcall(_accSolve, weld, handle, go, H0 * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.FromAxis(axis), math.rad(_snap(math.deg(ang or 0), step())))) end
			end))
		elseif mode == "Size" then
			table.insert(System._giz3dConns, h.MouseDrag:Connect(function(_, dist)
				if H0 then go.Scale = math.clamp(sc0 * (len0 + _snap(dist or 0, step())) / len0, 0.2, 5) end
			end))
		else
			table.insert(System._giz3dConns, h.MouseDrag:Connect(function(face, dist)
				if H0 then pcall(_accSolve, weld, handle, go, H0 + H0:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.FromNormalId(face) * _snap(dist or 0, step()))) end
			end))
		end
		table.insert(System._giz3dConns, h.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() H0 = nil end))
		System._giz3dHandle = h
		return true
	end
	System.showGizmo3D = function()
		System.hideGizmo3D(true)  -- rebuilding the handle: keep the current freeze (don't restore anims/anchor)
		local key = System.getGizmoTarget and System.getGizmoTarget()
		if not key then return false end
		if key:sub(1, 4) == "acc:" then return _giz3dShowAcc(key) end  -- V4.5.59 (N9)
		local joint, part = _giz3dResolveJoint(key)
		if not (joint and part) then return false end
		local char = part:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model") or _giz3dChar()
		-- V4.5.68: switching the target to ANOTHER character overwrote _giz3dFrozeChar, so the first one (often you) kept
		-- Animate disabled for good. Thaw the previous one first.
		local _prevFroze = System._giz3dFrozeChar
		if _prevFroze and _prevFroze ~= char then pcall(_giz3dSetAnims, _prevFroze, true) end
		_giz3dSetAnims(char, false)     -- freeze so the pose holds
		System._giz3dFrozeChar = char   -- remember EXACTLY who we froze so Hide/Reset un-freeze the right character
		System._giz3dIsClone = false    -- clone (frozen statue) vs real player (must walk after)? Decides the anchor-restore value - NOT the latch-prone live hrp.Anchored.
		if System.NPCs then for _, m in pairs(System.NPCs) do if m == char then System._giz3dIsClone = true; break end end end
		_giz3dNormalize(joint)          -- clean axes (+ stores original C0/C1 for reset)
		_jKinematic(joint)              -- R15 AnimationConstraint: make it kinematic so the C0 edit holds
		local col = Color3.fromRGB(13, 105, 172)
		System._giz3dConns = {}
		local function _anchor(on)
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not hrp then return end
			if on then
				System._giz3dHrp = hrp
				pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = true end)
			else  -- restore: clone stays anchored (statue), player un-anchors (walks). From IsClone, never the latch-prone live value.
				pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = System._giz3dIsClone and true or false end)
				System._giz3dHrp = nil
			end
		end
		-- BACKSTOP: Handles/ArcHandles MouseButton1Up is unreliable (frequently missed when the release lands off the
		-- adornment) - that missed Up is what used to leave the player permanently anchored. A global release ends the drag too.
		table.insert(System._giz3dConns, game:GetService("UserInputService").InputEnded:Connect(function(io)
			if (io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and System._giz3dHrp then _anchor(false) end
		end))
		if System._giz3dMode == "Rot" then
			local h = Instance.new("ArcHandles")
			h.Axes = Axes.new(Enum.Axis.X, Enum.Axis.Y, Enum.Axis.Z)
			h.Color3 = col; h.Adornee = part; h.Parent = _giz3dContainer()
			local startC0 = _jGetC0(joint)
			table.insert(System._giz3dConns, h.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() _anchor(true); startC0 = _jGetC0(joint) end))
			table.insert(System._giz3dConns, h.MouseDrag:Connect(function(axis, relAngle)
				pcall(function() _jSetC0(joint, startC0 * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.FromAxis(axis), math.rad(_snap(math.deg(relAngle or 0), System._giz3dStep or 0.001)))) end)
			end))
			table.insert(System._giz3dConns, h.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() _anchor(false) end))
			System._giz3dHandle = h
		else
			local h = Instance.new("Handles")
			h.Style = Enum.HandlesStyle.Movement
			h.Faces = Faces.new(Enum.NormalId.Right, Enum.NormalId.Left, Enum.NormalId.Top, Enum.NormalId.Bottom, Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back)
			h.Color3 = col; h.Adornee = part; h.Parent = _giz3dContainer()
			local startC0 = _jGetC0(joint)
			table.insert(System._giz3dConns, h.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() _anchor(true); startC0 = _jGetC0(joint) end))
			table.insert(System._giz3dConns, h.MouseDrag:Connect(function(face, distance)
				pcall(function() _jSetC0(joint, startC0 * CFrame.new(Vector3.FromNormalId(face) * _snap(distance or 0, System._giz3dStep or 0.001))) end)
			end))
			table.insert(System._giz3dConns, h.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() _anchor(false) end))
			System._giz3dHandle = h
		end
		-- Re-adorn across character reloads: if the adorned part is destroyed, re-resolve joint + part.
		table.insert(System._giz3dConns, game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local h = System._giz3dHandle; if not h then return end
			local ad = h.Adornee
			if (not ad) or (not ad.Parent) then
				local nj, np = _giz3dResolveJoint(key)
				if nj and np then joint = nj; part = np; h.Adornee = np end
			end
		end))
		return true
	end
	System.setGizmoMode3D = function(mode)
		System._giz3dMode = (mode == "Rot" or mode == "Size") and mode or "Pos"  -- V4.5.59 (N9): Size (accessories)
		System.showGizmo3D()
		return System._giz3dMode
	end
	-- Restore every edited joint to its captured original C0/C1 and re-enable animations.
	System.resetGizmoPose = function()
		for joint, o in pairs(System._giz3dOrig) do
			if typeof(joint) == "Instance" and joint.Parent then pcall(function() _jSetC0(joint, o.C0); _jSetC1(joint, o.C1) end) end
		end
		System._giz3dOrig = {}
		do  -- V4.5.59 (N9): Reset also undoes accessory move/rotate/size (zeroed, not removed, so the weld loop restores the base)
			local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
			local pd = PlayerData[sp]
			for k, go in pairs(pd and pd.GizmoOffsets or {}) do
				if type(k) == "string" and k:sub(1, 4) == "acc:" and type(go) == "table" then
					go.PosX, go.PosY, go.PosZ, go.RotX, go.RotY, go.RotZ, go.RotCF, go.Scale = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, CFrame.new(), 1
				end
			end
		end
		System._clonePoseSnaps = {}  -- V4.5.59 (N3): a reset pose must not come back on the next clone rebuild
		_giz3dSetAnims(System._giz3dFrozeChar or _giz3dChar(), true)  -- re-enable anims on the char we actually froze (not just the currently-selected one)
		local hrp = System._giz3dFrozeChar and System._giz3dFrozeChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp and not System._giz3dIsClone then pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = false end) end  -- the player can walk again
		System._giz3dFrozeChar = nil
	end
	-- V4.5.59 (N3): a clone's gizmo pose was lost whenever the clone got an update (accessory change etc.):
	-- CharacterReset re-applies the clone's original HumanoidDescription, which rebuilds the rig's joints at
	-- rest. Store each posed joint as an offset from its rest (J = C0 * C1^-1; posed = rest * D), keyed by
	-- clone key + joint name + child part, and re-apply it to whatever joints exist after the rebuild.
	System._clonePoseSnaps = System._clonePoseSnaps or {}
	local function _clonePoseKey(j)
		local p1 = j:IsA("Motor6D") and j.Part1 or (j.Attachment1 and j.Attachment1.Parent)
		return j.Name .. "|" .. (p1 and p1.Name or "?")
	end
	System._clonePoseCapture = function(key, rig)
		if not (key and typeof(rig) == "Instance") then return end
		local snap
		for joint, o in pairs(System._giz3dOrig) do
			if typeof(joint) == "Instance" and joint:IsDescendantOf(rig) then
				local ok, d = pcall(function() return (o.C0 * o.C1:Inverse()):Inverse() * (_jGetC0(joint) * _jGetC1(joint):Inverse()) end)
				if ok then snap = snap or {}; snap[_clonePoseKey(joint)] = d end
			end
		end
		-- no live posed joints = keep an earlier snapshot (joints may already have been rebuilt); Reset Pose clears it
		if snap then System._clonePoseSnaps[key] = snap end
	end
	System._clonePoseRestore = function(key)
		local function apply()
			local snap = System._clonePoseSnaps[key]
			local rig = System.NPCs and System.NPCs[key]
			if not (snap and rig) then return end
			for _, j in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
				local d = (j:IsA("Motor6D") or j:IsA("AnimationConstraint")) and snap[_clonePoseKey(j)]
				if d then
					pcall(function()
						local o = System._giz3dOrig[j]
						if not o then o = { C0 = _jGetC0(j), C1 = _jGetC1(j) }; System._giz3dOrig[j] = o end
						local want = (o.C0 * o.C1:Inverse()) * d * _jGetC1(j)
						if not _jGetC0(j):FuzzyEq(want, 1e-4) then _jSetC0(j, want) end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		-- accessory/bundle loads can rebuild the rig again a moment later, so re-check briefly
		apply(); task.delay(1, apply); task.delay(3, apply)
	end
	System.getGizmoMode3D = function() return System._giz3dMode or "Pos" end










	end  -- gizmo bridge do...end (helper locals scoped out of RoClothes register pool)

	-- V4.3.167 fix: PartListDefault must return a FRESH table per call. (see Changelog for full rationale)
	local function deepCloneData(t)
		if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end
		local out = {}
		for k, v in pairs(t) do out[k] = deepCloneData(v) end
		return out
	end

	function Function.PartListDefault()
		--[[ROCLOTHES_DATA_START:PartListDefault]]
		local _data = deepCloneData(_RoClothesData.PartListDefault)
		--[[ROCLOTHES_DATA_END:PartListDefault]]
		if type(_data) ~= "table" then
			error("[RoClothes] PartListDefault: server payload missing 'PartListDefault' key")
		end

		-- ── VNS mesh body types ────────────────────────────────────────────────
		-- Mesh files are local (RClothesContent/_vns/). Only table data is needed
		-- in the script - no server uploads required for the mesh files themselves.
		-- CFrame/Size values mirror Type 1 placement; tune per mesh as needed.
		local _vnsBase = {
			Transparency = 0, Reflectance = 0,
			Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			Color = {Tone="Base", Color="Parent"},
			AdjustScale = {"Size","CFrame1"},
		}
		local function _vnsEntry(name, meshFile, size, cf, cf1, fn, scale)
			local e = {}
			for k,v in pairs(_vnsBase) do e[k]=v end
			e.Instance  = "Mesh"
			e.Name      = name
			e.MeshId    = "rbxasset://RClothesContent/_vns/model/" .. meshFile
			e.Size      = size
			e.CFrame    = cf
			e.CFrame1   = cf1
			e.Parent    = {[1]="Torso"}
			e.Scale     = scale or "BreastsScale"
			if fn then e.Function = fn end
			return e
		end
		-- Breast SB type (BreastsType 6) - body mesh + nipple mesh separate
		local _lbCF  = CFrame.new(-0.246, 0.635, -0.451,  0.321, 0.223,-0.920, -0.185, 0.968, 0.171,  0.929, 0.115, 0.352)
		local _rbCF  = CFrame.new( 0.246, 0.635, -0.451, -0.321,-0.223,-0.920, -0.185, 0.968,-0.171,  0.929, 0.115,-0.352)

		-- VNS breast type 6 uses its own areola texture from _vns/model/breast/1/areola.png
		_data["Left Breast SB1"]   = _vnsEntry("Left Breast",  "breast/1/leftb.mesh",  _bSz,  _lbCF, _bCF1, "AreolaDecalCreateVNS")
		_data["Right Breast SB1"]  = _vnsEntry("Right Breast", "breast/1/rightb.mesh", _bSz,  _rbCF, CFrame.new(-0.200, 0.400, 0), "AreolaDecalCreateVNS")
		_data["Left Nipple SB1"]   = _vnsEntry("Left Nipple",  "breast/1/leftn.mesh",  _nbSz, CFrame.new(-0.246, 0.635,-0.451, 0.321,0.223,-0.920,-0.185,0.968,0.171,0.929,0.115,0.352), CFrame.new(0,0,0))
		_data["Right Nipple SB1"]  = _vnsEntry("Right Nipple", "breast/1/rightn.mesh", _nbSz, CFrame.new( 0.246, 0.635,-0.451,-0.321,-0.223,-0.920,-0.185,0.968,-0.171,0.929,0.115,-0.352), CFrame.new(0,0,0))
		-- Butt SB type (ButtType 6)
		local _btSz  = Vector3.new(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
		local _lbtCF = CFrame.new(-0.215, -0.5, -0.20, -4.37e-8, 0,1, 0,1,0, -1,0,-4.37e-8)
		local _rbtCF = CFrame.new( 0.215, -0.5, -0.20, -4.37e-8, 0,1, 0,1,0, -1,0,-4.37e-8)
		_data["Left Butt SB1"]   = _vnsEntry("Left Butt",  "butt/1/left.mesh",  _btSz, _lbtCF, CFrame.new( 0.4,0.4,0), "NewWomanTorsoPantsClothing", "ButtsScale")
		_data["Right Butt SB1"]  = _vnsEntry("Right Butt", "butt/1/right.mesh", _btSz, _rbtCF, CFrame.new(-0.4,0.4,0), "NewWomanTorsoPantsClothing", "ButtsScale")
		-- Arm SB type (ArmType 5) - arm/1 replacement meshes parented to arm parts
		local _armSz = Vector3.new(1.23, 2.06, 1.01)
		local _vnsArmBase = {Instance="Mesh", Transparency=0, Reflectance=0,
			Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color={Tone="Base",Color="Parent"},
			CFrame1=CFrame.new(0,0,0), ParentTransparency=1, Function="ShirtTexture"}
		do local e = {}; for k,v in pairs(_vnsArmBase) do e[k]=v end
			e.Name="Left Arm Mesh"; e.MeshId="rbxasset://RClothesContent/_vns/model/arm/1/left.mesh"
			e.Size=_armSz; e.CFrame=CFrame.new(0,0,0); e.Parent={[1]="Left Arm"}
			_data["Left Arm5"] = e end
		do local e = {}; for k,v in pairs(_vnsArmBase) do e[k]=v end
			e.Name="Right Arm Mesh"; e.MeshId="rbxasset://RClothesContent/_vns/model/arm/1/right.mesh"
			e.Size=_armSz; e.CFrame=CFrame.new(0,0,0); e.Parent={[1]="Right Arm"}
			_data["Right Arm5"] = e end
		-- Leg SB type (LegsType 8) - leg/1 replacement meshes, uses LegsScale + AdjustScale
		local _legSz = Vector3.new(1.4, 2.25, 1.57)
		local _vnsLegBase = {Instance="Mesh", Transparency=0, Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			Color={Tone="Base",Color="Parent"}, CFrame1=CFrame.new(0,-0.001,0),
			ParentTransparency=1, Scale="LegsScale", AdjustScale={"Size",["CFrame1"]=300},

	-- V4.3.507: wire the file-scope uploader's getters now that PlayerData exists.
	_DIAG_UP_ENABLED_GETTER = function()
		local _pd = PlayerData and PlayerData[Player.Name]
		return _pd and _pd._telemEnabled == true
	end
	_DIAG_UP_INSTALLID_GETTER = function()
		local _pd = PlayerData and PlayerData[Player.Name]
		if not _pd then return nil end
		-- V4.3.511 Fix 5/6/9: shared spawn-persist helper.
		local function _spawnPersistInstallId(targetId, mirrorOnSuccess)
			task.spawn(function()
				local _pdLive = PlayerData and PlayerData[Player.Name]
				if not _pdLive then return end
				if not _pdLive._telemEnabled then return end
				if _pdLive._telemInstallId ~= targetId then return end  -- V4.3.511 Fix 5: superseded
				if not (env and env.writefile and env.readfile and env.isfile and env.delfile) then return end
				if type(_atomicWriteJSON) ~= "function" then return end
				_withSettingsLock(function()
					local HSr = game:GetService("HttpService")
					local merged
					if env.isfile("RClothesLerp/Settings.json") then
						local _okR, _raw = pcall(env.readfile, "RClothesLerp/Settings.json")
						if not _okR then return end
						local _okD, _dec = pcall(HSr.JSONDecode, HSr, _raw)
						if not _okD or type(_dec) ~= "table" then return end
						merged = _dec
					else
						merged = {}
					end
					merged.telemEnabled = _pdLive._telemEnabled
					merged.telemInstallId = targetId
					-- V4.3.531 Fix 2: capture `_atomicWriteJSON`'s OWN return, not pcall's ok-bool. The ...
					local _pcOk, writeOk = pcall(_atomicWriteJSON, "RClothesLerp/Settings.json", merged)
					if _pcOk and writeOk then
						-- V4.3.513 Fix 10: flag disk-verified so the lazy-getter fast-paths
						-- stop spawning redundant persists on every uploader cycle.
						_DIAG_INSTALL_ID_DISK_VERIFIED = true
						if mirrorOnSuccess then
							_DIAG_INSTALL_ID = targetId  -- V4.3.511 Fix 9: cache mirrors disk only on success
						end
					end
				end)
			end)
		end

		if type(_pd._telemInstallId) == "string" and #_pd._telemInstallId > 0 then
			_DIAG_INSTALL_ID = _pd._telemInstallId  -- mirror to file-scope for Phase 1 disk logs
			-- V4.3.512 Fix 3: heal disk symmetrically with path (b). PD may hold the ID but ...
			-- V4.3.513 Fix 10: gate on _DIAG_INSTALL_ID_DISK_VERIFIED so the heal fires AT MOST ...
			if not _DIAG_INSTALL_ID_DISK_VERIFIED then
				_spawnPersistInstallId(_pd._telemInstallId, false)
			end
			return _pd._telemInstallId
		end
		-- Lazy generation: only when needed and only if user is opted in.
		if not _pd._telemEnabled then return nil end
		-- V4.3.508: race protection - if Settings.json restore raced ahead and ...
		if type(_DIAG_INSTALL_ID) == "string" and #_DIAG_INSTALL_ID > 0 then
			_pd._telemInstallId = _DIAG_INSTALL_ID
			-- V4.3.511 Fix 6: the toggle handler relies on getInstallId() to spawn-persist ...
			-- V4.3.513 Fix 10: gated on disk-verified flag - heal once, not every cycle.
			if not _DIAG_INSTALL_ID_DISK_VERIFIED then
				_spawnPersistInstallId(_DIAG_INSTALL_ID, false)
			end
			return _DIAG_INSTALL_ID
		end
		local newId = _diagGenUUIDv4()
		_pd._telemInstallId = newId
		-- V4.3.511 Fix 9: do NOT mirror to _DIAG_INSTALL_ID synchronously. Defer to ...
		_spawnPersistInstallId(newId, true)
		return newId
	end

	--[[ROCLOTHES_DATA_START:Bundle]]
	local Bundle
	do
		Bundle = _RoClothesData.Bundle
		-- V4.3.369: defensive auto-wrap for flattened Save Outfit bundles. The ...
		if type(Bundle) == "table" then
			local _presetKeys = {
				CatalogClothes=true, CatalogAccessory=true, CatalogTail=true,
				CatalogOutfitId=true, CatalogAssetTypes=true,
				BodyPartPhysics=true,
				BreastsType=true, TorsoType=true, ArmType=true, LegsType=true, ButtType=true,
				BreastsScale=true, ButtsScale=true, LegsScale=true, CockScale=true,
				Tone=true, HardcoreHP=true, TopHP=true, BottomHP=true,
				DamageSFX=true, Volume=true,
				TearParticles=true, HealParticles=true,
				RealtimeBodyTransparency=true, Face=true, PhysicsObeyGravity=true,
				AccessorySizeLock=true, MeshSizeLock=true, MeshBasePartInvisible=true,
				BreastsStiffness=true, BreastsDamping=true,
				ButtsStiffness=true, ButtsDamping=true,
				CockStiffness=true, CockDamping=true,
				SmartBoneEnabled=true, StripCategories=true, StripItems=true,
				NippleColor=true, SkinTone=true,
				AutoStripOnRip=true, StripOnRipMap=true,  -- V4.3.370
			}
			for _bName, _b in pairs(Bundle) do
				if type(_b) == "table"
					and _b.Preset == nil
					and _b.ClothingBundle ~= true
					and _b.IsPreset ~= true
					and _b.Clothing == nil
					and (_b.CatalogClothes ~= nil or _b.CatalogAccessory ~= nil)
				then
					local _wrapped = {}
					for _k in pairs(_presetKeys) do
						if _b[_k] ~= nil then
							_wrapped[_k] = _b[_k]
							_b[_k] = nil
						end
					end
					_b.Preset = _wrapped
				end
			end
		end
		-- V4.3.541 Fix 1A: per-user identity routing for community bundles.
		if type(Bundle) == "table" then
			local _mySubsSet = {}
			if env and env.isfile and env.readfile
				and env.isfile("RClothesLerp/MySubmissions.json")
			then
				local _okR, _raw = pcall(env.readfile, "RClothesLerp/MySubmissions.json")
				if _okR and type(_raw) == "string" and #_raw > 0 then
					local _okD, _list = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, _raw)
					if _okD and type(_list) == "table" then
						for _, _n in ipairs(_list) do
							if type(_n) == "string" then _mySubsSet[_n] = true end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local _mineCount, _commCount = 0, 0
			for _bName, _b in pairs(Bundle) do
				if type(_b) == "table"
					and _b.IsPreset ~= true
					and _b.ClothingBundle ~= true
				then
					if _mySubsSet[_bName] then
						_b.Personal = true
						_mineCount = _mineCount + 1
					else
						_b.Personal = false
						_commCount = _commCount + 1
					end
				end
			end
			local _mySubsCount = 0
			for _ in pairs(_mySubsSet) do _mySubsCount = _mySubsCount + 1 end
			_diagPublicCall("bundle.personal_routing", {
				mine = _mineCount, community = _commCount,
				my_subs_total = _mySubsCount,
			})
		end

		-- V4.3.532 Fix 1: deleted-bundles blocklist. Community/builtin bundles come from ...
		if type(Bundle) == "table" and env and env.isfile and env.readfile
				and env.isfile("RClothesLerp/DeletedBundles.json") then
			local _okR, _raw = pcall(env.readfile, "RClothesLerp/DeletedBundles.json")
			if _okR and type(_raw) == "string" and #_raw > 0 then
				local _okD, _list = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, _raw)
				if _okD and type(_list) == "table" then
					local _suppressed = 0
					for _, _name in ipairs(_list) do
						if type(_name) == "string" and Bundle[_name] ~= nil then
							Bundle[_name] = nil
							_suppressed = _suppressed + 1
						end
					end
					if _suppressed > 0 then
						_diagPublicCall("bundle.deleted_suppressed", { count = _suppressed })
						-- V4.3.541 Fix 4: surface the silent suppression count to ...
						System._pendingDeletedBundlesToast = _suppressed
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function Function.CumDripDisplay(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		local attach = Instance.new("Attachment",ObjectInstance)
		attach.Name = "cTrail"
		-- V4.3.441: key by the Attachment instance itself, not the literal string ...
		DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Special[attach] = attach

		local particle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter",attach)
		particle.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular
		particle.Size = NumberSequence.new(
			{NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1.5,1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1.5,1)}
		)
		particle.Texture = Function.GetAsset("rbxasset://RClothesContent/16235774309.png")
		particle.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(
			{NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.2,.5),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)}
		)
		particle.ZOffset = .1
		particle.LightInfluence = 1
		particle.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2,6)
		particle.Rate = 10
		particle.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-360,360)
		particle.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.001)
		task.delay(0,function()
			-- V4.5.24 Fix: 1-frame race guard (particle/ObjectInstance can die in the delay window)
			if ObjectInstance and ObjectInstance.Parent and particle and particle.Parent then
				pcall(function() particle.Color = ColorSequence.new(ObjectInstance.Color) end)
			end
		end)
	end

	function Function.Lactation(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local particle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter",ObjectInstance)
		particle.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel
		particle.LightEmission = .1
		particle.LightInfluence = 1
		particle.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
		particle.Size = NumberSequence.new(.05)
		particle.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=296981321"
		particle.Squash = NumberSequence.new(
			{NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.7),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.752,.95),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.45)}
		)
		particle.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(
			{NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.169),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.251,.557),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.519,.814),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.772,.918),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)}
		)
		particle.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(.8)
		particle.Rate = 50
		particle.Rotation = NumberRange.new(90)
		particle.Speed = NumberRange.new(1,5)
		particle.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(-30,30)
		particle.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0,-25,0)
		particle.Drag = 2
		particle.VelocityInheritance = .3
		task.delay(0,function()
			local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
			if not DataDetail then return end
			-- V4.5.24 (r2) Fix: harden the WHOLE 1-frame race, not just one deref - ObjectInstance/ ...
			if not (ObjectInstance and ObjectInstance.Parent) then return end
			if not particle.Parent then return end
			pcall(function() particle.Color = ColorSequence.new(ObjectInstance.Color) end)
			if DataDetail.BreastsType == 5 then
				particle.Size = NumberSequence.new(.1)
				particle.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
				local _mesh = DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[ObjectInstance]
				local _pp = ObjectInstance.Parent and ObjectInstance.Parent.Parent
				if _mesh and _mesh.Weld then
					if _pp and _pp.Name == "Left Breast" then
						_mesh.Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0.123999998, 0.244960785, -0.0383028984, 0.866025388, 0.5, -0, -0.5, 0.866025388, -0, 0, 0, 1)
						_mesh.CFrame = CFrame.new(0.123999998, 0.244960785, -0.0383028984, 0.866025388, 0.5, -0, -0.5, 0.866025388, -0, 0, 0, 1)
					else
						_mesh.Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(-0.124103546, 0.244960785, -0.0383028984, 0.866027117, -0.499990761, -1.61431331e-06, 0.499992698, 0.866029799, -3.49144102e-06, 2.21932714e-06, 2.92656478e-06, 0.99999994)
						_mesh.CFrame = CFrame.new(-0.124103546, 0.244960785, -0.0383028984, 0.866027117, -0.499990761, -1.61431331e-06, 0.499992698, 0.866029799, -3.49144102e-06, 2.21932714e-06, 2.92656478e-06, 0.99999994)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	function Function.OilUp(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		local function oil(v)
			if RS:IsStudio() then
				local mat
				-- V4.5.24 Fix: MS (MaterialService) is pcall-guarded at file scope (L78) and can be ...
				if MS and MS:FindFirstChild("wetSmoothROCLOTHES") then
					mat = MS["wetSmoothROCLOTHES"]
				elseif MS then
					mat = Instance.new("MaterialVariant", MS)
					mat.Name="wetSmoothROCLOTHES"
					mat.BaseMaterial = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
					mat.MaterialPattern = Enum.MaterialPattern.Organic
					mat.RoughnessMap = "rbxassetid://14142895952"
					mat:AddTag(System.RCTag)
				end

				v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				v.MaterialVariant = "wetSmoothROCLOTHES"
				local sa = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
				if sa and not v:HasTag("ImportantSurfaceAppearance") then
					if sa.AlphaMode == Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency then
						v.TextureID = sa.ColorMap
						v.Transparency = 0.011
						v:SetAttribute("Alpha",0.011)
					elseif sa.AlphaMode == Enum.AlphaMode.Overlay then
						local overlay = v:Clone()
						overlay.Name = v.Name.."OILOVERLAY"
						overlay:ClearAllChildren()
						overlay.Parent = v
						local overlayWeld = Instance.new("Weld",overlay)
						overlayWeld.Part0 = overlay
						overlayWeld.Part1 = v
						overlay.Size = v.Size + Vector3.new(.001,.001,.001)
						overlay.Transparency = 0.01
						DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Link[overlay] = {T=v,Define=.01}
						if v.Parent and v.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[overlay] = {Base=v.Parent,Size=overlay.Size,CFrame=CFrame.new(0,0,0),CFrame1=CFrame.new(0,0,0),Weld=overlayWeld} end  -- V4.5.33: only for overlays on a body-part child; on a VNS rig v.Parent is the RC_VNS_* MODEL (no .Size) and the per-frame mesh loop threw every frame. The overlay is welded to v either way.
						overlay.TextureID = sa.ColorMap
					end
					sa:Destroy()
				end
			else
				v.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
				if v.Transparency >= 1 then
					v:AddTag("RCGlassMat")
					v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				end
				local sa = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
				if sa and not v:HasTag("ImportantSurfaceAppearance") then
					if sa.AlphaMode == Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency then
						v.TextureID = sa.ColorMap
						v.Transparency = 0.011
						v:SetAttribute("Alpha",0.011)
					elseif sa.AlphaMode == Enum.AlphaMode.Overlay then
						local overlay = v:Clone()
						overlay.Name = v.Name.."OILOVERLAY"
						overlay:ClearAllChildren()
						overlay.Parent = v
						local overlayWeld = Instance.new("Weld",overlay)
						overlayWeld.Part0 = overlay
						overlayWeld.Part1 = v
						overlay.Size = v.Size + Vector3.new(.001,.001,.001)
						overlay.Transparency = 0.01
						DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Link[overlay] = {T=v,Define=.01}
						if v.Parent and v.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[overlay] = {Base=v.Parent,Size=overlay.Size,CFrame=CFrame.new(0,0,0),CFrame1=CFrame.new(0,0,0),Weld=overlayWeld} end  -- V4.5.33: only for overlays on a body-part child; on a VNS rig v.Parent is the RC_VNS_* MODEL (no .Size) and the per-frame mesh loop threw every frame. The overlay is welded to v either way.
						overlay.TextureID = sa.ColorMap
					end
					sa:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
		task.delay(0,function()
			for i, v in pairs(DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Organ) do
				oil(v)
			end
		end)
	end

	function Function.OilUpOld(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local function oil(v)
			if RS:IsStudio() then
				local mat
				-- V4.5.24 Fix: MS (MaterialService) is pcall-guarded at file scope (L78) and can be ...
				if MS and MS:FindFirstChild("wetSmoothROCLOTHES") then
					mat = MS["wetSmoothROCLOTHES"]
				elseif MS then
					mat = Instance.new("MaterialVariant", MS)
					mat.Name="wetSmoothROCLOTHES"
					mat.BaseMaterial = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
					mat.MaterialPattern = Enum.MaterialPattern.Organic
					mat.RoughnessMap = "rbxassetid://14142895952"
					mat:AddTag(System.RCTag)
				end

				v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				v.MaterialVariant = "wetSmoothROCLOTHES"
				local sa = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
				if sa and not v:HasTag("ImportantSurfaceAppearance") then
					v.TextureID = sa.ColorMap
					if sa.AlphaMode == Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency then
						v.Transparency = 0.011
						v:SetAttribute("Alpha",0.011)
					end
					sa:Destroy()
				end
			else
				-- V4.3.141: try MaterialVariant (wet smooth look) via pcall since executors may ...
				local matOk = MS ~= nil and MS:FindFirstChild("wetSmoothROCLOTHES") ~= nil
				if not matOk then
					matOk = pcall(function()
						local mat = Instance.new("MaterialVariant", MS)
						mat.Name="wetSmoothROCLOTHES"
						mat.BaseMaterial = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
						mat.MaterialPattern = Enum.MaterialPattern.Organic
						mat.RoughnessMap = "rbxassetid://14142895952"
						mat:AddTag(System.RCTag)
					end)
				end

				local sa = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
				if matOk then
					v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
					v.MaterialVariant = "wetSmoothROCLOTHES"
					if sa and not v:HasTag("ImportantSurfaceAppearance") then
						v.TextureID = sa.ColorMap
						if sa.AlphaMode == Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency then
							v.Transparency = 0.011
							v:SetAttribute("Alpha",0.011)
						end
						sa:Destroy()
					end
				else
					v.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
					if v.Transparency >= 1 then
						v:AddTag("RCGlassMat")
						v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					end
					if sa and not v:HasTag("ImportantSurfaceAppearance") then
						sa:Destroy()
					end
				end
			end
		end
		task.delay(0,function()
			local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
			if not DataDetail then return end
			for i, v in pairs(DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Organ) do
				oil(v)
			end
			for i, v in pairs(DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes) do
				if string.find(string.lower(v.Name),"shirt") then
					oil(v)
					v.Transparency = 0.011
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	function Function.HideBreastPants(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		task.delay(0,function()
			local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
			if not DataDetail then return end
			if not DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants"] 
				and not DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants 2"]
				and not DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants 3"] then
				local void = 100
				repeat
					task.wait()
					void -= 1
				until void <= 0
					or DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants"]
					or DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants 2"]
					or DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants 3"]
			end

			local organ
			local function getOrgan()
				if DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants"] then
					organ = DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants"]
				elseif DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants 2"] then
					organ = DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants 2"]
				elseif DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants 3"] then
					organ = DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Pants 3"]
				end
			end
			getOrgan()

			if organ then
				local void = 100
				repeat
					task.wait()
					void -= 1
					getOrgan()
				until void <= 0 or DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[organ]
				local _mesh = DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[organ]
				if _mesh then
					_mesh.Size = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
					organ.Size = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
				end
				-- V4.3.539 Fix 3: harden HideBreast against KrulHosted 2D-tab race.
				-- Fix: unconditionally scrub any KrulHosted-tagged SA on the organ ...
				for _, child in ipairs(organ:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") and child:GetAttribute("KrulHosted") then
						pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
					end
				end
				if DataDetail.CurrentPartList and DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes then
					for k, v in pairs(DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes) do
						if v == organ then DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes[k] = nil end
					end
				end
			else
				-- V4.3.540 Fix 4: organ-nil fallback. The V4.3.539 Fix 3 KrulHosted ...
				if Character then
					local _hits = 0
					for _, p in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
						if p:IsA("BasePart") and (
							p.Name == "Breasts Pants" or p.Name == "Breasts Pants 2" or p.Name == "Breasts Pants 3"
						) then
							for _, child in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
								if child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") and child:GetAttribute("KrulHosted") then
									pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
									_hits += 1
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if _hits > 0 then
						pcall(Function.diag, "hd.sa_scrub_no_organ", { count = _hits, region = "pants" })
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	function Function.HideBreastShirt(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		task.delay(0,function()
			local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
			if not DataDetail then return end
			if not DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt"] 
				and not DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt 2"]
				and not DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt 3"] then
				local void = 100
				repeat
					task.wait()
					void -= 1
				until void <= 0
					or DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt"]
					or DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt 2"]
					or DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt 3"]
			end

			local organ
			local function getOrgan()
				if DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt"] then
					organ = DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt"]
				elseif DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt 2"] then
					organ = DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt 2"]
				elseif DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt 3"] then
					organ = DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["Breasts Shirt 3"]
				end
			end
			getOrgan()

			if organ then
				local void = 100
				repeat
					task.wait()
					void -= 1
					getOrgan()
				until void <= 0 or DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[organ]
				local _mesh = DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[organ]
				if _mesh then
					_mesh.Size = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
					organ.Size = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
				end
				-- V4.3.539 Fix 3: same KrulHosted SA scrub + CurrentPartList wipe as
				-- HideBreastPants above. See L8917-area comment for full rationale.
				for _, child in ipairs(organ:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") and child:GetAttribute("KrulHosted") then
						pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
					end
				end
				if DataDetail.CurrentPartList and DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes then
					for k, v in pairs(DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes) do
						if v == organ then DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes[k] = nil end
					end
				end
			else
				-- V4.3.540 Fix 4: organ-nil fallback for HideBreastShirt. Same ...
				if Character then
					local _hits = 0
					for _, p in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
						if p:IsA("BasePart") and (
							p.Name == "Breasts Shirt" or p.Name == "Breasts Shirt 2" or p.Name == "Breasts Shirt 3"
						) then
							for _, child in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
								if child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") and child:GetAttribute("KrulHosted") then
									pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
									_hits += 1
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if _hits > 0 then
						pcall(Function.diag, "hd.sa_scrub_no_organ", { count = _hits, region = "shirt" })
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	function Function.addFreckles(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		local oldObjectInstance
		if ObjectInstance.Name == "UnnecessaryPart" then
			oldObjectInstance = ObjectInstance
			ObjectInstance = ObjectInstance.Parent
		end
		for i = 1, 6 do
			local Texture = Instance.new("Decal", ObjectInstance)
			if oldObjectInstance then
				Texture.Color3 = oldObjectInstance.Color
			end
			Texture.Texture = "rbxassetid://7317286674"
			Texture.Transparency = 0.55
			DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Link[Texture] = {T=ObjectInstance,Define=.55}

			if i == 1 then
				Texture.Face = "Left"
			elseif i == 2 then
				Texture.Face = "Right"
			elseif i == 3 then
				Texture.Face = "Back"
			elseif i == 4 then
				Texture.Face = "Front"
			elseif i == 5 then
				Texture.Face = "Bottom"
			elseif i == 6 then
				Texture.Face = "Top"
			end
		end
	end

	function Function.addFrecklesC(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]

		if ObjectInstance.Name == "UnnecessaryPart" then
			oldObjectInstance = ObjectInstance
			ObjectInstance = ObjectInstance.Parent
		end
		local transparency = .55
		if oldObjectInstance then
			transparency = oldObjectInstance.Transparency
			oldObjectInstance.Transparency = 1
		end
		for i = 1, 6 do
			local Texture = Instance.new("Decal", ObjectInstance)
			Texture.Texture = Function.GetAsset("rbxasset://RClothesContent/colorableFreckles.png")
			-- V4.3.511 Fix 10: Parent + pcall guard. The Texture/oldObjectInstance ...
			task.delay(0,function()
				if Texture and Texture.Parent and oldObjectInstance and oldObjectInstance.Parent then
					pcall(function() Texture.Color3 = oldObjectInstance.Color end)
				end
			end)
			Texture.Transparency = transparency
			DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Link[Texture] = {T=ObjectInstance,Define=transparency}

			if i == 1 then
				Texture.Face = "Left"
			elseif i == 2 then
				Texture.Face = "Right"
			elseif i == 3 then
				Texture.Face = "Back"
			elseif i == 4 then
				Texture.Face = "Front"
			elseif i == 5 then
				Texture.Face = "Bottom"
			elseif i == 6 then
				Texture.Face = "Top"
			end
		end
	end

	function Function.nippleCensor(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		local Ui = Instance.new("ScreenGui",GUIObject.Screen)
		Ui.Name = "nCensor"
		Ui.DisplayOrder = -9999
		local objctValue = Instance.new("ObjectValue",Ui)
		objctValue.Value = ObjectInstance
		DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Special[Ui] = Ui  -- V4.3.567 H-11: key by instance, not "nippleCensor" string (2nd nipple overwrote the 1st slot -> first ScreenGui leaked). Cleanup loops iterate by value (L16521/L22581). Mirrors L8971.

		local frame = Instance.new("Frame",Ui)
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0,0)
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
		frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	end

	function Function.twitchEffect(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		task.spawn(function()
			local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
			if not DataDetail then return end
			repeat
				task.wait(math.random(5,40)*0.1)
				-- V4.5.72: collect the springs FIRST, then impulse them. The waits used to sit inside pairs() over the live
				-- BodyPartPhysics table; a part added/removed meanwhile threw "invalid key to next" and killed the loop.
				-- Also stop once PlayerData[Data] is replaced (reset), instead of poking the old springs forever.
				if PlayerData[Data] ~= DataDetail then return end
				local springs = {}
				for Part, Property in pairs(DataDetail.CurrentPartList.BodyPartPhysics or {}) do
					-- Rod Physics Guard: Ensure part still exists before accessing properties like Name
					if Part and Part.Parent and (Part.Name == "Rod" or Part.Name == "HorseRod" or Part.Name == "Main" or Part.Name == "BBC Rod") and Property.Spring then
						springs[#springs + 1] = Property.Spring
					end
				end
				for _, Spring in ipairs(springs) do
					for i=1, math.random(2,10) do
						Spring:Impulse(Vector3.new(0,0.05,0))
						task.wait()
					end
				end
			until ObjectInstance == nil or Function.IsParentNil(ObjectInstance) or Function.FallenPartCheck(ObjectInstance)
		end)
	end

	function Function.NippleType5Mesh(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)

		local type5Scale = System.Transformation.MeshScale.Breasts.Type5

		SpecialMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh

		if ObjectInstance.Parent.Name == "Left Breast" then
			SpecialMesh.MeshId = Function.GetAsset("rbxasset://RClothesContent/13779756984.mesh")
		else
			SpecialMesh.MeshId = Function.GetAsset("rbxasset://RClothesContent/13779756939.mesh")
		end

		if Scale ~= nil then
			SpecialMesh.Scale = Function.Vector3Multiply(type5Scale, {X = Scale, Y = Scale, Z = Scale})
		else
			SpecialMesh.Scale = type5Scale
		end

		SpecialMesh.Parent = ObjectInstance
		DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.SpecialMesh[SpecialMesh] = {
			Base=Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"),
			Size=SpecialMesh.Scale,
		}
		-- V4.3.214: also apply Tone-based coloring to the nipple mesh itself.
		if Extra.Tone == "Dark" then
			local H, S, V = ObjectInstance.Parent.Color:ToHSV()
			ObjectInstance.Color = Color3.fromHSV(H, S, V + (-DarkerColorPercentage * V / 100))
		elseif Extra.Tone == "Use NippleColor" and Extra.NippleColor ~= nil then
			ObjectInstance.Color = Extra.NippleColor
		end
	end

	-- V4.3.451: dead code - grep confirms zero call sites in this file. V4.3.447-449 ...
	function Function.ToarBreastsOffset(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		-- V4.3.447: R6-only function. R15 has UpperTorso (no "Torso"), and the ...
		-- V4.3.448: bail ONLY when neither Torso nor UpperTorso exists (truly unknown ...
		-- V4.3.449: also bail on orphaned character (Parent=nil). Pre-V4.3.449 an ...
		if not Character or not Character.Parent then return end
		if not Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
		   and Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") then
			return  -- R15 confirmed
		end
		local _ok, Torso = pcall(function() return Character:WaitForChild("Torso", 5) end)
		if not _ok or not Torso then return end
		-- V4.3.448: restore generous timeouts. V4.3.447's 0.5s caps assumed R6 ...
		-- V4.3.449: pcall the remaining WaitForChild calls. Same orphan-throw class
		-- as the Torso fetch above.
		local _ok2, LB = pcall(function() return Torso:WaitForChild("Left Breast", 2) end)
		local _ok3, RB = pcall(function() return Torso:WaitForChild("Right Breast", 2) end)
		if not _ok2 or not _ok3 or not LB or not RB then return end
		local _ok4, LBW = pcall(function() return LB:WaitForChild("Left Breast Weld", 2) end)
		local _ok5, RBW = pcall(function() return RB:WaitForChild("Right Breast Weld", 2) end)
		if not _ok4 or not _ok5 or not LBW or not RBW then return end

		local offsets = System.MeshOffsets.ToarBreasts
		local LCF0, LCF1 = offsets.LCF0, offsets.LCF1
		local RCF0, RCF1 = offsets.RCF0, offsets.RCF1

		local XM, YM, ZM = Function.MultiplyCalculate(Torso.Size, BodyPartSize[Torso.Name])

		local RealtimeProperty = DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[LB]
		if RealtimeProperty then
			RealtimeProperty.CFrame = LCF0

			RealtimeProperty.CFrame1 = LCF1

			DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[LB] = RealtimeProperty
		end

		local RealtimeProperty2 = DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[RB]
		if RealtimeProperty2 then
			RealtimeProperty2.CFrame = RCF0
			RealtimeProperty2.CFrame1 = RCF1
			DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[RB] = RealtimeProperty2
		end

		if DataDetail.MeshSizeLock == false then
			LBW.C0 = CFrame.new(LCF0.Position.X * XM, LCF0.Position.Y * YM, LCF0.Position.Z * ZM) * LCF0.Rotation
			LBW.C1 = CFrame.new(LCF1.Position.X * XM, LCF1.Position.Y * YM, LCF1.Position.Z * ZM) * LCF1.Rotation
			RBW.C0 = CFrame.new(RCF0.Position.X * XM, RCF0.Position.Y * YM, RCF0.Position.Z * ZM) * RCF0.Rotation
			RBW.C1 = CFrame.new(RCF1.Position.X * XM, RCF1.Position.Y * YM, RCF1.Position.Z * ZM) * RCF1.Rotation
		else
			LBW.C0 = LCF0
			LBW.C1 = LCF1
			RBW.C0 = RCF0
			RBW.C1 = RCF1
		end
	end

	function Function.BunnyBandPin(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		local BasePart

		if ObjectInstance.Name == "Left Bunny Band" then
			BasePart = Character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
		else
