		end

		local Pin = Instance.new("Part", ObjectInstance)
		Pin.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		Pin.Color = Color3.fromRGB(253, 234, 141)
		Pin.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		Pin.CanCollide = false
		Pin.CanQuery = false
		Pin.CanTouch = false
		Pin.Massless = true
		Pin.CustomPhysicalProperties = System.Physics.DefaultProperties
		Pin.Size = System.Transformation.MeshScale.BunnyBandPin

		local Weld = Instance.new("Weld", Pin)
		Weld.Part0 = ObjectInstance
		Weld.Part1 = Pin
		Weld.C0 = System.MeshOffsets.BunnyBandPin.WeldC0

		DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[Pin] = {Size = Pin.Size, CFrame = Weld.C0, CFrame1 = CFrame.new(0,0,0), Base = BasePart, Weld = Weld}
	end

	function Function.SurfaceTexture(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		if ObjectInstance:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance") then return end
		-- V4.5.2: this converts a part's TextureID into a SurfaceAppearance (moves it to ColorMap ...
		if System._saCMW == false then return end
		local _tex = ObjectInstance.TextureID
		local SP = Instance.new("SurfaceAppearance", ObjectInstance)
		if pcall(function() SP.ColorMap = _tex end) then
			System._saCMW = true
			ObjectInstance.TextureID = ""
		else
			System._saCMW = false
			SP:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- V4.3.319: Roblox shirt/pants application now overwrites an EXISTING (see Changelog for full rationale)
	-- V4.5.2: SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap is a PROTECTED asset property. A plain LocalScript ...
	function Function._ClothingTextureLayer(part)
		local existing = part:FindFirstChild("RCClothingTextureLayer")
		if existing and existing:GetAttribute("RCClothingLayer") then return existing end
		local archivable = part.Archivable
		part.Archivable = true
		local layer = part:Clone()
		part.Archivable = archivable
		layer.Name = "RCClothingTextureLayer"
		for _, child in ipairs(layer:GetChildren()) do
			if not child:IsA("Bone") then child:Destroy() end
		end
		for _, tag in ipairs(game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTags(layer)) do
			game:GetService("CollectionService"):RemoveTag(layer, tag)
		end
		layer:SetAttribute("RCClothingLayer", true)
		layer.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		layer.TextureID = ""
		layer.Anchored = false
		layer.Massless = true
		layer.CanCollide = false
		layer.CanTouch = false
		layer.CanQuery = false
		local connections = {}
		local function bind(object, property, update)
			update()
			table.insert(connections, object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(update))
		end
		bind(part, "Size", function() layer.Size = part.Size * 1.0005 end)
		bind(part, "Transparency", function() layer.Transparency = part.Transparency >= 1 and 1 or 0.011 end)
		bind(part, "Material", function() layer.Material = part.Material end)
		-- Skinned variants need the same bone pose, but must never register a second solver.
		local function bindBones(source, target)
			for _, bone in ipairs(source:GetChildren()) do
				if bone:IsA("Bone") then
					local copy = target:FindFirstChild(bone.Name)
					if copy and copy:IsA("Bone") then
						bind(bone, "CFrame", function() copy.CFrame = bone.CFrame end)
						bind(bone, "Transform", function() copy.Transform = bone.Transform end)
						bindBones(bone, copy)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		bindBones(part, layer)
		layer.CFrame = part.CFrame
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0, weld.Part1 = part, layer
		weld.Parent = layer
		layer.Destroying:Connect(function()
			for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
		end)
		layer.Parent = part
		return layer
	end

	function Function._ClearClothingTextureLayer(part, marker)
		local layer = part:FindFirstChild("RCClothingTextureLayer")
		if layer and layer:GetAttribute("RCClothingLayer") and (not marker or layer:GetAttribute(marker)) then
			layer:Destroy()
		end
	end

	function Function._ClearClothingAppearance(part, marker)
		local layer = part:FindFirstChild("RCClothingTextureLayer")
		local sa = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
		local sm = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
		local painted = layer and layer:GetAttribute(marker) and layer
			or sa and sa:GetAttribute(marker) and sa
			or sm and sm:GetAttribute(marker) and sm
			or part:GetAttribute(marker) and part
		-- Hosted PNGs have no Shirt/Pants instance for the heal path to read.
		-- Keep the removed template on its owning part until healing or rebuild.
		if painted and painted:GetAttribute("KrulHosted") then
			local ok, template = pcall(function()
				return painted == sa and sa.ColorMap or painted == sm and sm.TextureId or painted.TextureID
			end)
			if ok and type(template) == "string" and template ~= "" then
				part:SetAttribute("_RC_HPRestore_" .. marker, template)
				part:SetAttribute("_RC_HPAlpha_" .. marker, painted == part or (painted == sa and sa.AlphaMode == Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency))
				part:SetAttribute("_RC_HPSpecial_" .. marker, painted == sm)
			end
		end
		Function._ClearClothingTextureLayer(part, marker)
		if sa and sa:GetAttribute(marker) then sa:Destroy() end
		if sm and sm:GetAttribute(marker) then
			local original = sm:GetAttribute("_RC_ClothingBaseTexture")
			if original ~= nil then sm.TextureId = original end
			sm:SetAttribute("_RC_ClothingBaseTexture", nil)
			sm:SetAttribute(marker, nil)
			sm:SetAttribute("KrulHosted", nil)
		end
		if part:GetAttribute(marker) then
			local original = part:GetAttribute("_RC_ClothingBaseTexture")
			if original ~= nil then
				pcall(function() part.TextureID = original end)
				part:SetAttribute("_RC_ClothingBaseTexture", nil)
			end
			part:SetAttribute(marker, nil)
			part:SetAttribute("KrulHosted", nil)
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
			if not child:GetAttribute("RCClothingLayer") then
				Function._ClearClothingAppearance(child, marker)
			end
		end
	end

	local function _setOrCreateSA(part, template, alphaMode, marker)
		-- V4.5.68 (krul, Delta mobile: "2D shirt / pants don't show on the meshes"): a SpecialMesh FALLBACK part (built when
		-- CreateMeshPartAsync hangs / rejects a local mesh, see Function.Weld) has no TextureID and draws no SurfaceAppearance,
		-- so both writes below failed inside pcalls and the mesh stayed bare. Paint the FileMesh's own TextureId instead;
		-- _ClearClothingAppearance / _RestoreHPHosted already undo and redo a SpecialMesh paint from _RC_ClothingBaseTexture.
		if not part:IsA("MeshPart") then
			local sm = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
			if sm and sm.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.FileMesh then
				if sm:GetAttribute("_RC_ClothingBaseTexture") == nil then sm:SetAttribute("_RC_ClothingBaseTexture", sm.TextureId) end
				sm.TextureId = template
				for _, oldMarker in ipairs({"RoClothesShirt", "RoClothesPants", "RoClothesTShirt", "KrulHosted"}) do
					sm:SetAttribute(oldMarker, nil)
				end
				sm:SetAttribute(marker, true)
				return "tex"
			end
		end
		if System._saCMW ~= false then
			local sa = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
			local _created = false
			if not sa then
				sa = Instance.new("SurfaceAppearance", part)
				_created = true
			end
			local _ok = pcall(function() sa.ColorMap = template end)
			if _ok then
				System._saCMW = true
				Function._ClearClothingTextureLayer(part)
				if alphaMode then sa.AlphaMode = alphaMode end
				sa:SetAttribute(marker, true)
				return "sa"
			end
			System._saCMW = false
			-- a half-built SA masks TextureID entirely; remove the one WE just made (or a
			-- prior RoClothes-marked one). Never touch a game-baked/unmarked skin SA.
			if _created or sa:GetAttribute(marker) then sa:Destroy() end
		end
		-- fallback (no ColorMap capability): clear any stale RoClothes-marked SA that would
		-- mask TextureID, then paint the template straight onto the part's TextureID.
		local _stale = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
		if _stale and (_stale:GetAttribute("RoClothesShirt") or _stale:GetAttribute("RoClothesPants") or _stale:GetAttribute("RoClothesTShirt") or _stale:GetAttribute("KrulHosted")) then
			_stale:Destroy()
		end
		pcall(function()
			local target = part
			if alphaMode ~= Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency then target = Function._ClothingTextureLayer(part) end
			if target == part and part:GetAttribute("_RC_ClothingBaseTexture") == nil then
				part:SetAttribute("_RC_ClothingBaseTexture", part.TextureID)
			end
			target.TextureID = template
			for _, oldMarker in ipairs({"RoClothesShirt", "RoClothesPants", "RoClothesTShirt", "KrulHosted"}) do
				target:SetAttribute(oldMarker, nil)
			end
			target:SetAttribute(marker, true)
		end)
		return alphaMode == Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency and "tex" or "layer"
	end

	function Function._RestoreHPHosted(part, marker)
		local restored = false
		local template = part:GetAttribute("_RC_HPRestore_" .. marker)
		if template then
			local painted
			if part:GetAttribute("_RC_HPSpecial_" .. marker) then
				painted = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")  -- V4.5.68: never create one (a new SpecialMesh defaults to a HEAD shape)
				if painted then
					painted:SetAttribute("_RC_ClothingBaseTexture", painted.TextureId)
					painted.TextureId = template
					painted:SetAttribute(marker, true)
				end
			else
				local alpha = part:GetAttribute("_RC_HPAlpha_" .. marker) and Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency or Enum.AlphaMode.Overlay
				local mode = _setOrCreateSA(part, template, alpha, marker)
				painted = mode == "layer" and part:FindFirstChild("RCClothingTextureLayer")
					or mode == "sa" and part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance") or part
			end
			if painted then painted:SetAttribute("KrulHosted", true) end
			part:SetAttribute("_RC_HPRestore_" .. marker, nil)
			part:SetAttribute("_RC_HPAlpha_" .. marker, nil)
			part:SetAttribute("_RC_HPSpecial_" .. marker, nil)
			restored = true
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
			if not child:GetAttribute("RCClothingLayer") then
				restored = Function._RestoreHPHosted(child, marker) or restored
			end
		end
		return restored
	end

	function Function.ShirtTexture(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		local template = Extra.Shirt and Extra.Shirt.ShirtTemplate
		if not template and Extra.Pants and Extra.Pants.PantsTemplate then
			template = Extra.Pants.PantsTemplate
		end
		if template and table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "Roblox Shirt") then
			if ObjectInstance:IsA("MeshPart") and ObjectInstance.Material == Enum.Material.Glass then  -- V4.5.68: a SpecialMesh part has no TextureID
				ObjectInstance.TextureID = template
			else
				_setOrCreateSA(ObjectInstance, template, nil, "RoClothesShirt")
			end
		end
	end

	function Function.PantsTexture(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		if Extra.Pants and Extra.Pants.PantsTemplate and table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "Roblox Pants") then
			if ObjectInstance:IsA("MeshPart") and ObjectInstance.Material == Enum.Material.Glass then  -- V4.5.68: a SpecialMesh part has no TextureID
				ObjectInstance.TextureID = Extra.Pants.PantsTemplate
			else
				_setOrCreateSA(ObjectInstance, Extra.Pants.PantsTemplate, nil, "RoClothesPants")
			end
		end
	end

	function Function.TorsoShirtTexture(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data, transparency)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		local template = Extra.Shirt and Extra.Shirt.ShirtTemplate
		-- V4.5.24: Pants-slot fallback exists for legacy torso/breast-shirt routes,
		-- but the two VNS bra meshes are shirt-only clothing overlays.
		if not template and ObjectInstance.Name ~= "BreastClothes" and Extra.Pants and Extra.Pants.PantsTemplate then
			template = Extra.Pants.PantsTemplate
		end
		if template and (table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "Roblox Shirt") or table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "New Woman") or table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "Roblox Breasts Clothing") or table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "Roblox Breasts Clothing Type 2") or table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "Roblox Breasts Clothing Type 3")) then
			if ObjectInstance:IsA("MeshPart") and (ObjectInstance.Material == Enum.Material.Glass or ObjectInstance:HasTag("RCGlassMat")) then  -- V4.5.68: SpecialMesh part -> _setOrCreateSA
				ObjectInstance.TextureID = template
				if (transparency == nil or transparency ~= false) and ObjectInstance.Transparency < 1 then
					ObjectInstance.Transparency = 0.011
				end
			else
				local _mode = _setOrCreateSA(ObjectInstance, template, Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency, "RoClothesShirt")
				if transparency == nil or transparency ~= false then
					-- "tex" fallback: 0.011 enables texture-alpha blending (same equivalence OilUp uses)
					ObjectInstance.Transparency = (_mode == "tex") and 0.011 or 0
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function Function.TorsoPantsTexture(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data, transparency)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		if Extra.Pants and Extra.Pants.PantsTemplate and (table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "Roblox Pants") or table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "New Woman") or table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "Roblox Breasts Clothing") or table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "Roblox Breasts Clothing Type 2") or table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "Roblox Breasts Clothing Type 3")) then  -- V4.3.339: parity with TorsoShirtTexture gate at L5908
			if ObjectInstance:IsA("MeshPart") and (ObjectInstance.Material == Enum.Material.Glass or ObjectInstance:HasTag("RCGlassMat")) then  -- V4.5.68: SpecialMesh part -> _setOrCreateSA
				ObjectInstance.TextureID = Extra.Pants.PantsTemplate
				-- V4.3.343: parity with TorsoShirtTexture L5911 - was `transparency ~= true` (wrong polarity).
				if (transparency == nil or transparency ~= false) and ObjectInstance.Transparency < 1 then
					ObjectInstance.Transparency = 0.011
				end
			else
				local _mode = _setOrCreateSA(ObjectInstance, Extra.Pants.PantsTemplate, Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency, "RoClothesPants")
				-- V4.3.343: parity with TorsoShirtTexture L5916.
				if transparency == nil or transparency ~= false then
					-- "tex" fallback: 0.011 enables texture-alpha blending (parity w/ TorsoShirtTexture)
					ObjectInstance.Transparency = (_mode == "tex") and 0.011 or 0
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function Function.NewWomanShirtClothing(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		-- V4.3.539 Fix 2: structural fix for community-reported "New Woman arm ...
		--
		-- Pre-fix three bugs (all from a stale CharacterMesh-based design):
		-- (1) BLOCKY: CharacterMesh only applies when parented under a Humanoid
		--     that lives in a real character rig consumed by Avatar service. The
		--     handler parented a stub Humanoid+CharacterMesh into a wrapper Model
		--     parented to ObjectInstance (the arm part), NOT the real character
		--     rig. Engine silently ignored the CharacterMesh, so the cloned Arm
		--     rendered as a blocky clone of the original (no SpecialMesh, no
		--     CharacterMesh applied). Switched to SpecialMesh with the same
		--     R6 arm asset IDs (83001137 / 83001181) which DOES apply directly
		--     to a non-character BasePart.
		-- (2) CAN'T REMOVE: The cloned Arm part was never registered in
		--     DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes, so unequip path at L4365-4373
		--     (scrubClothState → mesh sweep) had no handle and skipped it on
		--     destroy. Now registered under "New Woman <armSide>" key.
		-- (3) CAN'T GIZMO-MOVE: The cloned Arm was never registered in
		--     RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh, so the gizmo target dropdown (L24445 reads
		--     this map) couldn't see it and the Weld.C0 write path (L8565/L10164)
		--     had no entry to mutate. Now registered with Base + Size + CFrame +
		--     Weld fields matching sibling Mesh entries.
		-- (4) DEAD HUMANOID: dropped - was residue from the CharacterMesh strategy.
		--     Would otherwise let engine try to ragdoll the wrapper Model.
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		-- V4.5.72: a re-run cloned the previous wrapper (arm + weld) along with the part, so drop it first. Then clone
		-- BEFORE building the new wrapper and strip models / joints from the clone (the old order cloned the fresh empty
		-- Model into the arm). Meshes are left alone so the arm looks exactly as before.
		local _rtMesh = DataDetail and DataDetail.CurrentPartList and DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList and DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh
		for _, c in ipairs(ObjectInstance:GetChildren()) do
			local oldArm = c:IsA("Model") and (c:FindFirstChild("Left Arm") or c:FindFirstChild("Right Arm"))
			if oldArm then
				if _rtMesh then _rtMesh[oldArm] = nil end
				c:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local Arm = ObjectInstance:Clone()
		for _, c in ipairs(Arm:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("Model") or c:IsA("JointInstance") then c:Destroy() end
		end
		local Model = Instance.new("Model", ObjectInstance)
		local weld
		if ObjectInstance.Name == "New Woman Left Arm Mesh" then
			Arm.Transparency = 0
			Arm.Parent = Model
			Arm.Name = "Left Arm"
			weld = Instance.new("Weld", Model)
			weld.Part0 = ObjectInstance
			weld.Part1 = Arm
			-- V4.3.540 Fix 7: explicit identity baseline for weld.C0/C1. Pre-fix ...
			weld.C0 = CFrame.new()
			weld.C1 = CFrame.new()
			-- V4.3.539 Fix 2: SpecialMesh on the cloned part (was CharacterMesh + stub
			-- Humanoid in wrapper Model - non-functional outside real character rig).
			local sm = Instance.new("SpecialMesh", Arm)
			sm.MeshId = "rbxassetid://83001137"
		else
			Arm.Transparency = 0
			Arm.Parent = Model
			Arm.Name = "Right Arm"
			weld = Instance.new("Weld", Model)
			weld.Part0 = ObjectInstance
			weld.Part1 = Arm
			weld.C0 = CFrame.new()  -- V4.3.540 Fix 7: explicit baseline; see Left Arm branch comment
			weld.C1 = CFrame.new()
			local sm = Instance.new("SpecialMesh", Arm)
			sm.MeshId = "rbxassetid://83001181"
		end
		-- V4.3.539 Fix 2: register the spawned Arm so unequip + gizmo can see it.
		-- Mirrors the sibling registration pattern at L13021 (SB dispatcher).
		if DataDetail and DataDetail.CurrentPartList then
			if DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes then
				DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["New Woman " .. Arm.Name] = Arm
				-- V4.3.540 Fix 7: ALSO register the wrapper Model under a distinct ...
				DataDetail.CurrentPartList.Clothes["New Woman " .. Arm.Name .. " Wrapper"] = Model
			end
			if DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList
				and DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh then
				DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[Arm] = {
					Base = ObjectInstance, Size = Arm.Size,
					CFrame = weld.C0, CFrame1 = weld.C1, Weld = weld,
				}
			end
		end
		if Extra.Shirt and table.find(DataDetail.CurrentClothes, "New Woman") then
			Extra.Shirt:Clone().Parent = Model
		end
	end

			SpecialMesh.MeshId = Function.GetAsset("rbxasset://RClothesContent/99196487433776.mesh")

			SpecialMesh.MeshId = Function.GetAsset("rbxasset://RClothesContent/135832822984550.mesh")

		if Scale ~= nil then
			SpecialMesh.Scale = Function.Vector3Multiply(Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), {X = Scale, Y = Scale, Z = Scale})
		else
			SpecialMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
		end

		SpecialMesh.Parent = ObjectInstance
	end

	function Function.BreastPhysics(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		-- V4.3.420: nil guard on stale PlayerData. The sibling physics functions (see Changelog for full rationale)
		if not DataDetail then return end
		if DataDetail.BodyPartPhysics then
			local Torso = Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")

			if Torso then
				Function.SpringCreate(
					ObjectInstance,
					Torso,
					Vector3.new(0,0,0),
					Vector3.new(0,0,0),
					System.Physics.SpringConfigs.Breasts.Speed,
					System.Physics.SpringConfigs.Breasts.Damper,
					{X="X", Y="Y", Z="Z"},
					{X=0, Y=0, Z=0},
					{X="Z", Y="X", Z="Y"},
					System.Transformation.PhysicsRotation.Breasts,
					Data
				)
			end
		end
	end

			RBL.CFrame = CFrame.new(0.0799999982, 0, 0.0700000003, 1, 1.043081e-07, 5.215405e-08, -1.043081e-07, 1, -3.10862362e-15, -5.215405e-08, -2.33146623e-15, 1)

			local l1 = Instance.new("RopeConstraint",LB)
			l1.Thickness = 0.02
			l1.Length = 1.5
			l1.Color = BrickColor.new("Carnation pink")
			l1.Visible = true
			l1.Attachment0 = LBR
			l1.Attachment1 = Left
			local l2 = Instance.new("RopeConstraint",LB)
			l2.Thickness = 0.02
			l2.Length = 1.5
			l2.Color = BrickColor.new("Carnation pink")
			l2.Visible = true
			l2.Attachment0 = LBL
			l2.Attachment1 = Left

			local r1 = Instance.new("RopeConstraint",RB)
			r1.Thickness = 0.02
			r1.Length = 1.5
			r1.Color = BrickColor.new("Carnation pink")
			r1.Visible = true
			r1.Attachment0 = RBL
			r1.Attachment1 = Right
			local r2 = Instance.new("RopeConstraint",RB)
			r2.Thickness = 0.02
			r2.Length = 1.5
			r2.Color = BrickColor.new("Carnation pink")
			r2.Visible = true
			r2.Attachment0 = RBR
			r2.Attachment1 = Right
		end
	end

	function Function.TopLayer(Visible, c, Data)
		local PData = PlayerData[Data]
		local appliedOrgans = {}
		for _, k in ipairs({"Left Arm","Right Arm"}) do
			local v = PData.CurrentPartList["Organ"][k]; if v then table.insert(appliedOrgans, v) end
		end
		local appliedTOrgans = {}
		-- V4.5.24: Bra 1/2 are the two VNS breast clothing-overlay meshes. V4.5.21 ...
		for _, k in ipairs({"Torso Shirt","Breasts Shirt","Breasts Shirt 2","Breasts Shirt 3","Breast Clothes SB1","Breast Clothes SB2"}) do
			local v = PData.CurrentPartList["Clothes"][k]; if v then table.insert(appliedTOrgans, v) end
		end
		-- Hosted shirts can paint the skin torso when no Torso Shirt exists.
		-- Channel ownership keeps the pants layer intact on a shirt rip.
		local torso = PData.CurrentPartList.Organ.Torso
		if torso then
			if Visible == false then Function._ClearClothingAppearance(torso, "RoClothesShirt")
			else Function._RestoreHPHosted(torso, "RoClothesShirt") end
		end
		if Visible == false then
			-- V4.3.526 Fix 4: V4.3.519 Fix 9 changed HPClothes.Shirt storage to number.
			-- Consumer `not tonumber(...)` was always false → texture-apply branch unreachable.
			-- V4.3.526 Fix 4 was ROLLED BACK: the flip would crash on .ShirtTemplate deref when Shirt
			-- is a number, so all 4 Shirt sites below keep `not tonumber(...)`. Deferred to V4.3.527+.
			for i, v in pairs(appliedOrgans) do
				Function._ClearClothingAppearance(v, "RoClothesShirt")
				Function._ClearClothingAppearance(v, "RoClothesTShirt")
				if v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY") then
					local s = v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY")
					if PData.HPClothes.Shirt ~= "" and not tonumber(PData.HPClothes.Shirt) then -- V4.3.526 Fix 4 ROLLBACK: flip would crash on .ShirtTemplate; deferred to V4.3.527+
						s.TextureID = PData.HPClothes.Shirt.ShirtTemplate
					else
						s.Transparency = 1
						s:SetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC",1)
					end
				else
					-- V4.3.347: respect RoClothes marker - don't destroy game-baked SAs (e.g. SB body ...
					local _existingSA = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
					if _existingSA and (_existingSA:GetAttribute("RoClothesShirt") or _existingSA:GetAttribute("RoClothesTShirt")) then
						_existingSA:Destroy()
					end
					if PData.HPClothes.Shirt ~= "" and not tonumber(PData.HPClothes.Shirt) then -- V4.3.526 Fix 4 ROLLBACK: flip would crash on .ShirtTemplate; deferred to V4.3.527+
						Function.ShirtTexture(v,nil,{Shirt = PData.HPClothes.Shirt},Data)
					end
				end
			end
			for i, v in pairs(appliedTOrgans) do
				Function._ClearClothingAppearance(v, "RoClothesShirt")
				Function._ClearClothingAppearance(v, "RoClothesTShirt")
				Function._ClearClothingAppearance(v, "KrulHosted")
				if v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY") then
					local s = v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY")
					if PData.HPClothes.Shirt ~= "" and not tonumber(PData.HPClothes.Shirt) then -- V4.3.526 Fix 4 ROLLBACK: flip would crash on .ShirtTemplate; deferred to V4.3.527+
						s.TextureID = PData.HPClothes.Shirt.ShirtTemplate
					else
						s.Transparency = 1
						s:SetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC",1)
					end
				else
					if PData.HPClothes.Shirt ~= "" and not tonumber(PData.HPClothes.Shirt) then -- V4.3.526 Fix 4 ROLLBACK: flip would crash on .ShirtTemplate; deferred to V4.3.527+
						if v.Name == "Torso Shirt" then
							v:SetAttribute("maxDeterminedRC",false)
							v:SetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC",nil)
							--v.Transparency = v.Parent.Transparency
						end
						Function.TorsoShirtTexture(v,nil,{Shirt = PData.HPClothes.Shirt},Data,false)
					end
				end
			end

		else
			local shirtObj = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
			local pantsObj = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
			local fallbackExtra = shirtObj and {Shirt = shirtObj} or (pantsObj and {Pants = pantsObj} or nil)
			local template = shirtObj and shirtObj.ShirtTemplate or (pantsObj and pantsObj.PantsTemplate)
			for i, v in pairs(appliedOrgans) do
				if Function._RestoreHPHosted(v, "RoClothesShirt") then continue end
				if v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY") then
					local s = v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY")
					if template then
						s:SetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC",nil)
						s.TextureID = template
					end
				else
					-- V4.3.347: respect RoClothes marker (see L6196 comment).
					local sa = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
					if sa and (sa:GetAttribute("RoClothesShirt") or sa:GetAttribute("RoClothesPants") or sa:GetAttribute("RoClothesTShirt") or sa:GetAttribute("KrulHosted")) then
						sa:Destroy()
					end
					if fallbackExtra then
						Function.ShirtTexture(v,c,fallbackExtra,Data)
					end
				end
			end
			for i, v in pairs(appliedTOrgans) do
				if Function._RestoreHPHosted(v, "RoClothesShirt") then continue end
				if v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY") then
					local s = v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY")
					-- VNS bras are shirt-only; never feed the TopLayer pants fallback
					-- into an oil-overlay clone of BreastClothes.
					if template and (shirtObj or v.Name ~= "BreastClothes") then
						s:SetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC",nil)
						s.TextureID = template
					end
				else
					-- V4.3.347: marker-gated SA destroy.
					local sa = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
					if sa and (sa:GetAttribute("RoClothesShirt") or sa:GetAttribute("RoClothesPants") or sa:GetAttribute("RoClothesTShirt") or sa:GetAttribute("KrulHosted")) then
						sa:Destroy()
					end
					if fallbackExtra then
						Function.TorsoShirtTexture(v,c,fallbackExtra,Data,false)
					end
				end
			end

		end
	end

	-- V4.5.52 (krul: "make it work"): a Ripped Shirt Id used to show ONLY through "Roblox Shirt" (the one cloth whose
	-- HPFunction is TopLayer). Bundles built from breast-shirt pieces (e.g. Abeni: "Roblox Breasts Clothing Type 2") just
	-- went bare. With no Roblox Shirt equipped, a top rip now puts the ripped shirt on the shirt pieces it hid + the arms;
	-- heal goes through TopLayer(true), which strips our marked arm SAs and repaints the pieces with the original shirt.
	function Function.RippedShirtNoOwner(ripped, c, Data)
		local PData = PlayerData[Data]
		if not PData or table.find(PData.CurrentClothes, "Roblox Shirt") then return end  -- TopLayer owns it then
		if ripped and Function.IsNaked(PData) then return end  -- V4.5.71: Naked Mode = all clothing off; the HP Ripped Shirt Id was painted onto the bare arms
		if not ripped then
			if PData._ripShirtPainted then
				PData._ripShirtPainted = nil
				for _, k in ipairs({"Left Arm","Right Arm"}) do  -- also clears the no-ColorMap texture-layer fallback
					local v = PData.CurrentPartList["Organ"][k]
					if v and not v:FindFirstChild(v.Name .. "OILOVERLAY") then pcall(Function._ClearClothingAppearance, v, "RoClothesShirt") end
				end
				-- V4.5.68 (krul: heal repaints the shirt pieces with his OWN avatar shirt): TopLayer(true) re-derives the pieces from
				-- c's Shirt object, which is not what they wore: hosted PNG clothing has no Shirt object, and with no bundle / an
				-- Override bundle c's Shirt is the real character's (Method 2 proxy clones it). Put back what the rip painted over;
				-- TopLayer only for a piece whose pre-rip texture could not be read.
				local needTop = false
				for _, k in ipairs({"Torso Shirt","Breasts Shirt","Breasts Shirt 2","Breasts Shirt 3","Breast Clothes SB1","Breast Clothes SB2"}) do
					local v = PData.CurrentPartList["Clothes"][k]
					if v and v:GetAttribute("_RC_RipPainted") and v:GetAttribute("_RC_RipPrev") == nil then needTop = true end
				end
				if needTop then pcall(Function.TopLayer, true, c, Data) end
				for _, k in ipairs({"Torso Shirt","Breasts Shirt","Breasts Shirt 2","Breasts Shirt 3","Breast Clothes SB1","Breast Clothes SB2"}) do
					local v = PData.CurrentPartList["Clothes"][k]
					local prev = v and v:GetAttribute("_RC_RipPrev")
					if prev ~= nil then
						pcall(function()
							if v:IsA("MeshPart") and (v.Material == Enum.Material.Glass or v:HasTag("RCGlassMat")) then v.TextureID = prev
							elseif prev == "" then Function._ClearClothingAppearance(v, "RoClothesShirt")
							else
								local mode = _setOrCreateSA(v, prev, Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency, "RoClothesShirt")
								if v:GetAttribute("_RC_RipPrevHosted") then
									local painted = mode == "sa" and v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
										or (not v:IsA("MeshPart") and v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")) or v
									if painted then painted:SetAttribute("KrulHosted", true) end
								end
							end
						end)
					end
					if v then
						v:SetAttribute("_RC_RipPrev", nil)
						v:SetAttribute("_RC_RipPrevHosted", nil)
						v:SetAttribute("_RC_RipPainted", nil)
					end
				end
			end
			return
		end
		-- the texture a piece wears right now ("" = none), read from the carrier _setOrCreateSA would paint; nil = unreadable
		local function currentTex(v)
			local ok, tex, hosted = pcall(function()
				if v:IsA("MeshPart") and (v.Material == Enum.Material.Glass or v:HasTag("RCGlassMat")) then return v.TextureID, nil end  -- paint() writes glass straight to TextureID
				local sa = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
				if sa then return sa.ColorMap, sa:GetAttribute("KrulHosted") end
				local sm = not v:IsA("MeshPart") and v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
				if sm then
					if sm:GetAttribute("RoClothesShirt") or sm:GetAttribute("RoClothesPants") or sm:GetAttribute("KrulHosted") then return sm.TextureId, sm:GetAttribute("KrulHosted") end
					return "", nil
				end
				if v:GetAttribute("RoClothesShirt") or v:GetAttribute("RoClothesPants") or v:GetAttribute("KrulHosted") then return v.TextureID, v:GetAttribute("KrulHosted") end
				return "", nil
			end)
			if ok and type(tex) == "string" then return tex, hosted end
			return nil
		end
		local rs = PData.HPClothes and PData.HPClothes.Shirt
		if typeof(rs) ~= "Instance" or not rs:IsA("Shirt") then return end
		local tpl = rs.ShirtTemplate
		local function paint(v, pieceAlpha)
			if v:IsA("MeshPart") and (v.Material == Enum.Material.Glass or v:HasTag("RCGlassMat")) then v.TextureID = tpl  -- V4.5.68: SpecialMesh part -> _setOrCreateSA
			else _setOrCreateSA(v, tpl, pieceAlpha, "RoClothesShirt") end
		end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Torso Shirt","Breasts Shirt","Breasts Shirt 2","Breasts Shirt 3","Breast Clothes SB1","Breast Clothes SB2"}) do
			local v = PData.CurrentPartList["Clothes"][k]
			if v and v:GetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC") == 1 then  -- hidden by THIS rip: show it again, ripped
				if not v:GetAttribute("_RC_RipPainted") then  -- V4.5.68: remember what heal must put back (first rip only)
					local prev, hosted = currentTex(v)
					v:SetAttribute("_RC_RipPainted", true)
					if prev ~= nil then
						v:SetAttribute("_RC_RipPrev", prev)
						v:SetAttribute("_RC_RipPrevHosted", hosted and true or nil)
					end
				end
				paint(v, Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency)
				local a = v:GetAttribute("Alpha") or 0
				v:SetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC", a)
				v.Transparency = a
			end
		end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Left Arm","Right Arm"}) do
			local v = PData.CurrentPartList["Organ"][k]
			if v and not v:FindFirstChild(v.Name .. "OILOVERLAY") then paint(v, nil) end
		end
		PData._ripShirtPainted = true
	end

	function Function.BottomLayer(Visible, c, Data)
		local PData = PlayerData[Data]
		local appliedOrgans = {}
		-- V4.5.21 (owner call 2026-08-10): removed "Breast Clothes SB1"/"SB2" (SB bras) from the PANTS-paint ...
		for _, k in ipairs({"Torso","Left Leg","Right Leg","Left Butt","Right Butt","Breasts Pants","Breasts Pants 2","Breasts Pants 3"}) do
			local v = PData.CurrentPartList["Organ"][k] or PData.CurrentPartList["Clothes"][k]; if v then table.insert(appliedOrgans, v) end
		end

		if Visible == false then
			for i, v in pairs(appliedOrgans) do
				Function._ClearClothingAppearance(v, "RoClothesPants")
				if v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY") then
					local s = v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY")
					-- V4.3.531 Fix 1: V4.3.526 Fix 4 ROLLBACK sibling missed at this site. The Shirt ...
					-- V4.3.519 Fix 9 storage form), silently wiping the texture. Restored to match Shirt.
					if PData.HPClothes.Pants ~= "" and not tonumber(PData.HPClothes.Pants) then
						s.TextureID = PData.HPClothes.Pants.PantsTemplate
					else
						s.Transparency = 1
						s:SetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC",1)
					end
				else
					-- V4.3.347: marker-gated SA destroy.
					local _ssa = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
					if _ssa and _ssa:GetAttribute("RoClothesPants") then
						_ssa:Destroy()
					end
					if PData.HPClothes.Pants ~= "" and not tonumber(PData.HPClothes.Pants) then -- V4.3.526 Fix 4 ROLLBACK: flip would crash on .PantsTemplate; deferred to V4.3.527+
						Function.PantsTexture(v,nil,{Pants = PData.HPClothes.Pants},Data)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			for i, v in pairs(appliedOrgans) do
				if Function._RestoreHPHosted(v, "RoClothesPants") then continue end
				if v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY") then
					local s = v:FindFirstChild(v.Name.. "OILOVERLAY")
					if c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants") then
						s:SetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC",nil)
						s.TextureID = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants").PantsTemplate
					end
				else
					-- V4.3.347: marker-gated SA destroy.
					local _ssa = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
					if _ssa and (_ssa:GetAttribute("RoClothesShirt") or _ssa:GetAttribute("RoClothesPants") or _ssa:GetAttribute("RoClothesTShirt") or _ssa:GetAttribute("KrulHosted")) then
						_ssa:Destroy()
					end
					if c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants") then
						Function.PantsTexture(v,c,{Pants = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")},Data)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function Function.HPLactation(Visible, Character, Data)
		local PData = PlayerData[Data]
		local particleOrgans = {
			PData.CurrentPartList["Organ"]["Left Nipple"],
			PData.CurrentPartList["Organ"]["Right Nipple"],
		}
		for i, v in pairs(particleOrgans) do
			if v:FindFirstChild("Lactation") then
				local s = v:FindFirstChild("Lactation")
				if s:FindFirstChildOfClass("ParticleEmitter") then
					s:FindFirstChildOfClass("ParticleEmitter").Enabled = Visible
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function Function.HPPussyCum(Visible, Character, Data)
		local PData = PlayerData[Data]
		if PData.CurrentPartList["Clothes"]["Pussy Cum"] then
			if PData.CurrentPartList["Clothes"]["Pussy Cum"]:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment") then
				local attach = PData.CurrentPartList["Clothes"]["Pussy Cum"]:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
				local emitter = attach:FindFirstChildOfClass("ParticleEmitter")
				if emitter then
					emitter:SetAttribute("Enabled",Visible)
					-- V4.3.318: was unconditionally `false`. Compare with HPLactation ...
					emitter.Enabled = Visible
				end
			end
		end
	end


	function Function.CumBreastTypeSupport(ObjectInstance, Character, Extra, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		local function adjustSize(SIZE,CFRAME,CFRAME1)
			local pList = DataDetail.PartList
			local _entry = pList[ObjectInstance.Name]; if not _entry then return end
			if _entry.Scale then
				local Scale = DataDetail[_entry.Scale]
				for i, Adjust in pairs(_entry.AdjustScale) do
					if Adjust == "Size" and SIZE then
						SIZE = Function.Vector3Multiply(SIZE, {X = Scale, Y = Scale, Z = Scale})
					elseif Adjust == "CFrame" and CFRAME then
						CFRAME = Function.CFrameMultiply(CFRAME, {X = Scale, Y = Scale, Z = Scale})
					elseif Adjust == "CFrame1" and CFRAME1 then
						CFRAME1 = Function.CFrameMultiply(CFRAME1, {X = Scale, Y = Scale, Z = Scale})
					end
				end
				return SIZE,CFRAME,CFRAME1
			end
		end

		task.delay(0,function()
			if not DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[ObjectInstance] then return end
			local SIZE,CFRAME,CFRAME1
			if DataDetail.BreastsType == 5 then
				if ObjectInstance.Name == "Left Breast Cum" then
					SIZE,CFRAME,CFRAME1 = adjustSize(
						Vector3.new(1.0431958436965942, 1.0279223918914795, 1.0504292249679565),
						CFrame.new(-0.0385475159, 0.00672912598, 0.191131592, -0.257634491, -0.0129809687, 0.966147125, 0.2354206, -0.970619977, 0.049738057, 0.937122285, 0.240266144, 0.25312531),
						nil
					)
				else
					SIZE,CFRAME,CFRAME1 = adjustSize(
						Vector3.new(1.0545662641525269, 1.1099238395690918, 1.0778725147247314),
						CFrame.new(0.00855636597, 0.0169401169, 0.177431107, 0.200725764, -0.0731868595, 0.976906657, 0.245940372, -0.961504698, -0.122565337, 0.94827354, 0.26486361, -0.175000176),
						nil
					)
				end
			end
			if CFRAME then
				DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[ObjectInstance].Weld.C0 = CFRAME
				DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[ObjectInstance].CFrame = CFRAME
			end
			if CFRAME1 then
				DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[ObjectInstance].Weld.C1 = CFRAME1
				DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[ObjectInstance].CFrame1 = CFRAME1
			end
			if SIZE then
				DataDetail.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[ObjectInstance].Size = SIZE
			end
		end)
	end

	--module part--

	function Function.Spring.new(initial, clock)
		local target = initial or 0
		clock = clock or os.clock
		return setmetatable({
			_clock = clock;
			_time0 = clock();
			_position0 = target;
			_velocity0 = 0*target;
			_target = target;
			_damper = 1;
			_speed = 1;
		}, Function.Spring)
	end
	function Function.Spring:Impulse(velocity)
		self.Velocity = self.Velocity + velocity
	end
	function Function.Spring:TimeSkip(delta)
		local now = self._clock()
		local position, velocity = self:_positionVelocity(now+delta)
		self._position0 = position
		self._velocity0 = velocity
		self._time0 = now
	end
	function Function.Spring:__index(index)
		if Function.Spring[index] then
			return Function.Spring[index]
		elseif index == "Value" or index == "Position" or index == "p" then
			local position, _ = self:_positionVelocity(self._clock())
			return position
		elseif index == "Velocity" or index == "v" then
			local _, velocity = self:_positionVelocity(self._clock())
			return velocity
		elseif index == "Target" or index == "t" then
			return self._target
		elseif index == "Damper" or index == "d" then
			return self._damper
		elseif index == "Speed" or index == "s" then
			return self._speed
		elseif index == "Clock" then
			return self._clock
		else
			error(("%q is not a valid member of Spring"):format(tostring(index)), 2)
		end
	end
	function Function.Spring:__newindex(index, value)
		local now = self._clock()

		if index == "Value" or index == "Position" or index == "p" then
			local _, velocity = self:_positionVelocity(now)
			self._position0 = value
			self._velocity0 = velocity
			self._time0 = now
		elseif index == "Velocity" or index == "v" then
			local position, _ = self:_positionVelocity(now)
			self._position0 = position
			self._velocity0 = value
			self._time0 = now
		elseif index == "Target" or index == "t" then
			local position, velocity = self:_positionVelocity(now)
			self._position0 = position
			self._velocity0 = velocity
			self._target = value
			self._time0 = now
		elseif index == "Damper" or index == "d" then
			local position, velocity = self:_positionVelocity(now)
			self._position0 = position
			self._velocity0 = velocity
			-- V4.5.24 Fix: clamp Damper exactly like Speed above. A NaN or negative Damping value ...
			self._damper = (value == value and value >= 0) and value or 0
			self._time0 = now
		elseif index == "Speed" or index == "s" then
			local position, velocity = self:_positionVelocity(now)
			self._position0 = position
			self._velocity0 = velocity
			-- V4.5.24 Fix: same NaN defense the Damper branch got - `value < 0` passes NaN through,
			-- which then misses the s==0 guard and NaNs the weld C0 in _positionVelocity.
			self._speed = (value == value and value >= 0) and value or 0
			self._time0 = now
		elseif index == "Clock" then
			local position, velocity = self:_positionVelocity(now)
			self._position0 = position
			self._velocity0 = velocity
			self._clock = value
			self._time0 = value()
		else
			error(("%q is not a valid member of Spring"):format(tostring(index)), 2)
		end
	end
	function Function.Spring:_positionVelocity(now)
		local p0 = self._position0
		local v0 = self._velocity0
		local p1 = self._target
		local d = self._damper
		local s = self._speed

		if s == 0 then return p1, v0*0 end  -- avoid si/s division by zero

		local t = s*(now - self._time0)
		local d2 = d*d

		local h, si, co
		if d2 < 1 then
			h = math.sqrt(1 - d2)
			local ep = math.exp(-d*t)/h
			co, si = ep*math.cos(h*t), ep*math.sin(h*t)
		elseif d2 == 1 then
			h = 1
			local ep = math.exp(-d*t)/h
			co, si = ep, ep*t
		else
			h = math.sqrt(d2 - 1)
			local u = math.exp((-d + h)*t)/(2*h)
			local v = math.exp((-d - h)*t)/(2*h)
			co, si = u + v, u - v
		end

		local a0 = h*co + d*si
		local a1 = 1 - (h*co + d*si)
		local a2 = si/s

		local b0 = -s*si
		local b1 = s*si
		local b2 = h*co - d*si

		return a0*p0 + a1*p1 + a2*v0,b0*p0 + b1*p1 + b2*v0
	end

	-- tail module --

	local modelInstance = Instance.new("Model")
	local modelGetScale = modelInstance.GetScale
	modelInstance:Destroy()  -- only the method reference is needed; destroy the instance

	local cframeIdentity = CFrame.identity
	local cframeToObjectSpace = cframeIdentity.ToObjectSpace
	local cframeVectorToObjectSpace = cframeIdentity.VectorToObjectSpace
	local cframeInverse = cframeIdentity.Inverse
	local cframeToEulerAnglesXYZ = cframeIdentity.ToEulerAnglesXYZ
	local cframeFromEulerAngles = CFrame.fromEulerAngles
	local cframeNew = CFrame.new

	-- Caculate Elasticity
	local function calculateElasticity(
		position: Vector3,
		velocity: Vector3,
		stiffness: number,
		damping: number
	): (Vector3, Vector3)
		local springForce = stiffness * position -- position is the displacement since anchor is (0, 0, 0) otherwise this would be (position - anchor).
		local dampingForce = damping * velocity
		-- v_new = v - (k*x + c*v)*dt  (restoring force opposes displacement; damping opposes velocity)
		local acceleration = springForce + dampingForce

		local newVelocity = velocity - acceleration * timeStep
		local newValue = position + newVelocity * timeStep

		return newValue, newVelocity
	end

	local function vector3ToAngles(vector3:Vector3):CFrame
		return cframeFromEulerAngles(vector3.X, vector3.Y, vector3.Z)
	end

	-- Linear interpolation.
	local function lerp(from:number, to:number, alpha:number):number
		return from + (to - from) * alpha
	end

	local function cframeOrAttachmentOrNilParameterToCFrame(parameter:CFrame|Attachment?):CFrame
		return parameter and (typeof(parameter) == "CFrame" and parameter or parameter.CFrame) or CFrame.identity
	end

	-- V4.3.375: removed dead `Function.getTailPivotOffsetFromRoot(size)` stub.

	-- Converts a string to a wag seed which is used to desync tails.
	local function nameToTailWagSeed(name:string):number
		local wagSeed = 0
		for _, byte:string in {string.byte(name, 1, string.len(name))} do
			wagSeed += (byte * byte)
		end
		return wagSeed
	end


	-- Fast system for checking if an accessory's name is an included accessory.
	local includedAccessoryNames = {}
	local excludeAccessoryNames = {}
	local includedAccessoryNamesValidationSet:{[Instance]:boolean} = {}

	-- The table includedAccessoryNames could have changes and this allows the set to only be computed when necessary.
	local includedAccessoryNamesValidationSetNeedsUpdating = true

	-- Creates the set that allows for indexing with an accessory name to receive true or nil.
	local function updateIncludedAccessoryNamesValidationSet()
		includedAccessoryNamesValidationSet = {}
		for _, accessoryName in includedAccessoryNames do
			includedAccessoryNamesValidationSet[accessoryName] = true
		end
		for _, accessoryName in excludeAccessoryNames do
			includedAccessoryNamesValidationSet[accessoryName] = false
		end
		includedAccessoryNamesValidationSetNeedsUpdating = false
	end

	local function isTailAccessory(accessory:Accessory):boolean
		local _okAT, accessoryType = pcall(function() return accessory.AccessoryType end)  -- BUGFIX: guard like every other AccessoryType read - old executors lack the member and would throw here, killing the accessory-apply pass
		if not _okAT then return false end
		local accessoryName = accessory.Name
		if accessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Back or accessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Waist then
			if includedAccessoryNamesValidationSetNeedsUpdating then updateIncludedAccessoryNamesValidationSet() end
			if string.find(string.lower(accessoryName), "tail", 1, true) then
				if includedAccessoryNamesValidationSet[accessoryName] == nil
					or includedAccessoryNamesValidationSet[accessoryName] == true then
					return true
				end
			elseif includedAccessoryNamesValidationSet[accessoryName] then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	-- R6 Torso tail pivot offset.
	-- Gets the tail pivot offset from a root part for both R15 and R6.
	local function getTailPivotOffsetFromRoot(root:Part):CFrame?
		if root then
			-- R15  LowerTorso and UpperTorso have WaistRigAttachment.
			local waistRigAttachment:Attachment = root:FindFirstChild("WaistRigAttachment")
			if waistRigAttachment then
				return waistRigAttachment.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, root.Size.Z * 0.5)
			end

			-- R6  Torso.
			local waistBackAttachment:Attachment = root:FindFirstChild("WaistBackAttachment")
			if waistBackAttachment then
				return waistBackAttachment.CFrame * System.Transformation.CFramePresets.r6TailPivotOffset
			end
		end
	end

	local function setUpWeld(character:Model, weld:Weld, tailPart:BasePart, customPivotOffset:CFrame|Attachment?, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		-- Get root part.
		local flipAccessoryWeldParts = false
		local root:Part
		local retries = 0
		local function loadRoot(c)
			if c then
				if retries > 10 then
					warn(string.format("[RoClothes] Weld '%s' on character '%s' failed to resolve Part%d after 10 retries.",
						tostring(weld.Name), tostring(character.Name), c))
					return
				else
					retries += 1
					task.wait()
				end
			end

			root = weld.Part0
			if not root then loadRoot(0) end
			if root == tailPart then
				root = weld.Part1
				if not root then loadRoot(1) end
				flipAccessoryWeldParts = true
			end
		end
		loadRoot()
		if not root then return end

		-- Get pivot offset.
		local pivotOffset:CFrame?
		if customPivotOffset then
			pivotOffset = cframeOrAttachmentOrNilParameterToCFrame(customPivotOffset)
		else
			pivotOffset = getTailPivotOffsetFromRoot(root)
		end
		if not pivotOffset then warn("Could not find attachment on part \""..root.Name.."\" for the character \""..character.Name.."\". Make sure the character has finished loading and you've set Part0.") return end

		-- Get weld original cframe.
		local weldOriginalCFrame:CFrame
		if flipAccessoryWeldParts then
			weldOriginalCFrame = weld.C1 * cframeInverse(weld.C0) -- C1 * C0^-1

			-- Switch around because physics tails handles Part0 as the root.
			weld.Part0, weld.Part1 = root, tailPart
		else
			weldOriginalCFrame = weld.C0 * cframeInverse(weld.C1) -- C0 * C1^-1
		end

		-- Update weld.
		weld.C0 = weldOriginalCFrame -- Not really required but theoretically it could render 1 frame before it's updated by the physics tails engine.
		weld.C1 = cframeIdentity -- Clearing C1 is required (merged with C0), the tails do not use C1. Available for people if they want.

		-- Adjust pivot to be relative to weldOriginalCFrame.
		pivotOffset = cframeToObjectSpace(weldOriginalCFrame, cframeNew(pivotOffset.Position))

		-- Get wag seed.
		local wagSeed = nameToTailWagSeed(character.Name)
		local player = PS:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if player then
			wagSeed += player.UserId
		end

		-- Add to physicsTails table.
		local physicsTail = {
			root = root,
			rootPreviousCFrame = root.CFrame,
			rootPreviousDeltaCFrame = cframeIdentity,

			weld = weld,
			weldOriginalCFrame = weldOriginalCFrame,
			weldPreviousCFrame = weldOriginalCFrame,

			weldCurrentCFrame = weldOriginalCFrame,

			currentAngle = Vector3.zero,
			angularVelocity = Vector3.zero,
			wagAnimationBlendAlpha = 0,
			wagSeed = wagSeed,

			--pivotOffset = pivotOffset,
			pivotCFrame = weldOriginalCFrame * pivotOffset,
			inversePivotOffsetCFrame = cframeInverse(pivotOffset),

			character = character,
			-- V4.3.348: guard against modelGetScale returning 0 (mid-respawn / empty model on ...
			inverseCharacterScale = (function() local s = modelGetScale(character); return (s and s > 0) and (1 / s) or 1 end)(),
		}
		DataDetail.CurrentPartList.physicsTails[tailPart.Parent] = physicsTail
	end

	local function setUpTailAccessory(character:Model, accessory:Accessory, Data)
		-- Get weld.
		local handle:Part = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		if not handle then
			-- Accessory is most likely still loading. We will just wait until the handle is added.
			accessory.ChildAdded:Once(function()
				setUpTailAccessory(character, accessory, Data)
			end)
			return
		end

		local weld:Weld = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Weld")
		if not weld then
			-- Accessory is most likely still loading. We will just wait until the weld is added.
			handle.ChildAdded:Once(function()
				setUpTailAccessory(character, accessory, Data)
			end)
			return
		end

		-- Set up accessory weld.
		setUpWeld(character, weld, handle, nil, Data)
	end
	-- V4.5.59 (N4): tails were only set up for accessories RoClothes itself loads (Function.AccessoryAdd: bundle /
	-- catalog), so a tail worn on the user's own Roblox avatar only wagged once a bundle supplied one. Set up the
	-- avatar's own tail accessories too. CharacterReset gives a fresh physicsTails table, so this runs per build.
	function Function.SetUpNativeTails(character, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		local tails = DataDetail and DataDetail.CurrentPartList and DataDetail.CurrentPartList.physicsTails
		if not (tails and character and character.Parent) then return end
		for _, acc in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			if acc:IsA("Accessory") and not acc:HasTag(System.RCTag) and not tails[acc] and isTailAccessory(acc) then
				setUpTailAccessory(character, acc, Data)
			end
		end
	end


	-- Updates the physics tail to display as its static form.
	local function updatePhysicsTailToStatic(physicsTail:physicsTail)
		-- Get character scale.
		local characterScale = physicsTail.inverseCharacterScale * modelGetScale(physicsTail.character)

		local weldOriginalCFrame = physicsTail.weldOriginalCFrame -- Avoiding table lookups is faster.
		physicsTail.weld.C0 = weldOriginalCFrame.Rotation + weldOriginalCFrame.Position * characterScale
	end

	-- Computes a frame of the tail animation.
	local function getTailAnimationOffset(physicsTail:physicsTail,Data):Vector3
		local variables = System.tailVariables[Data]
		local wagAnimationBlendAlpha = physicsTail.wagAnimationBlendAlpha -- Avoiding table lookups is faster.
		if physicsTail.angularVelocity.Magnitude > 0.3 then
			-- Lerp algorithm simplified.
			wagAnimationBlendAlpha = wagAnimationBlendAlpha < 0.01 and 0 or wagAnimationBlendAlpha * (1 - wagAnimationBlendOutAlpha)
		else
			wagAnimationBlendAlpha = wagAnimationBlendAlpha > 0.99 and 1 or lerp(wagAnimationBlendAlpha, 1, wagAnimationBlendInAlpha)
		end
		physicsTail.wagAnimationBlendAlpha = wagAnimationBlendAlpha

		-- Check if it has to do anything otherwise if wagAnimationBlendAlpha is 0 then there is no animation offset.
		if wagAnimationBlendAlpha > 0 then
			local wagTime = variables.tailScaledAnimationTime + physicsTail.wagSeed

			-- FluctuatingWagTime allows the tail to move visually randomly instead of a plain linear timeline.
			local fluctuatingWagTime = wagTime + math.sin(wagTime) * math.sin(wagTime * 0.22727272727272727) * 0.9

			-- Add to newCurrentAngle since it will add to the tail from there anyway.
			return Vector3.new(
				(math.sin(fluctuatingWagTime * 2) + 0.8) * wagAnimationDropAmplitude * wagAnimationBlendAlpha,
				math.cos(fluctuatingWagTime) * wagAnimationSwayAmplitude * wagAnimationBlendAlpha,
				math.sin(fluctuatingWagTime) * -wagAnimationRollAmplitude * wagAnimationBlendAlpha
			)
		end

		return Vector3.zero
	end

	-- Updates the physics tail to display as its interpolated cframe.
	local function updatePhysicsTailToInterpolation(physicsTail:physicsTail, interpolationAlpha:number, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		-- Get character scale.
		local characterScale = physicsTail.inverseCharacterScale * modelGetScale(physicsTail.character)

		-- Interpolate.
		local weldCFrame = physicsTail.weldPreviousCFrame:Lerp(physicsTail.weldCurrentCFrame, interpolationAlpha)

		-- Wag animation.
		if DataDetail.tailSettings.wagAnimationEnabled then
			-- Take the animation-pivoted rotation and figure out what rotation difference it represents in the current tail's space, then apply it to the tail.
			weldCFrame *= cframeInverse(
				cframeToObjectSpace(weldCFrame,
					physicsTail.pivotCFrame * vector3ToAngles(getTailAnimationOffset(physicsTail,Data)) * physicsTail.inversePivotOffsetCFrame
				)
			)
		end

		-- Update weld.
		physicsTail.weld.C0 = weldCFrame.Rotation + weldCFrame.Position * characterScale
	end



	local persistentTailWindUnit:Vector3 = Vector3.zero -- Wind direction (safe default; .Unit on zero vector = NaN).
	local persistentTailWindAlpha:number -- Wind from 0 to 1 defining how significant it is.
	local persistentTailWindAlpha_Times_04:number -- Pre-computation.
	local persistentTailWindAlpha_Squared_Times_006:number -- Pre-computation.
	local persistentTailWindForceRelevant = false -- If wind force magnitude is 0 then this is false.

	local function updateTailPersistentWindForceInformation()
		local persistentTailWindForce = globalWindEnabled and (workspace.GlobalWind + customPersistentWindForce) or customPersistentWindForce

		-- Wind magnitude.
		persistentTailWindAlpha = persistentTailWindForce.Magnitude * 0.5

		-- Wind direction (guard: .Unit on zero vector produces NaN).
		if persistentTailWindAlpha > 0 then
			persistentTailWindUnit = persistentTailWindForce.Unit
		end

		-- Pre-computations.
		persistentTailWindAlpha_Times_04 = persistentTailWindAlpha * 0.4
		persistentTailWindAlpha_Squared_Times_006 = persistentTailWindAlpha * persistentTailWindAlpha * 0.06

		-- Wind relevance.
		persistentTailWindForceRelevant = persistentTailWindAlpha > 0
	end
	updateTailPersistentWindForceInformation()

	-- Update wind information on change.
	-- V4.3.168.14: inlined the Connect-handle local into the GlobalMaid:Give call.
	-- Named RoClothes-scope local was write-once and only referenced once next line.
	System.GlobalMaid:Give(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GlobalWind"):Connect(updateTailPersistentWindForceInformation))

	local gravityForce:Vector3 -- Gravity force.
	local persistentTailLinearForce:Vector3 -- Linear force.
	local persistentTailLinearForceRelevant = false -- If linear force magnitude is 0 then this is false.
	local function updateTailPersistentLinearForceInformation()
		-- Linear force.
		persistentTailLinearForce = gravityEnabled and (gravityForce + customPersistentLinearForce) or customPersistentLinearForce

		-- Linear force relevance.
		persistentTailLinearForceRelevant = persistentTailLinearForce.Magnitude > 0
	end

	local function updateGravityInformation()
		local gravity = workspace.Gravity

		gravityForce = Vector3.new(0,
		--[[
			This calculates the effect of the gravity and returns:
			-1 to 0.1 (tail slightly lifted in low gravity and pulled in high gravity for a nice visual aesthetic).
		]]
			math.max((196.2 - gravity) * 0.004, -1))

		-- Update persistentTailLinearForce after gravityForce update.
		updateTailPersistentLinearForceInformation()
	end
	updateGravityInformation()

	-- Update gravity information on change.
	-- V4.3.168.14: inlined the Connect-handle local into the AllConnect insert.
	table.insert(AllConnect, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Gravity"):Connect(updateGravityInformation))


	local vector3Zero = Vector3.zero
	local vector3Cross = vector3Zero.Cross
	local vector3New = Vector3.new
	-- Update/step a physics tail.
	local function updatePhysicsTail(physicsTail:physicsTail, updateWeld:boolean, interpolationAlpha:number, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		if not DataDetail then return end
		-- V4.3.339: nil-guard destroyed parts. After respawn the prior character's `root` / ...
		if not (physicsTail.root and physicsTail.root.Parent) then return end
		if not (physicsTail.weld and physicsTail.weld.Parent) then return end
		local tailSettings = DataDetail.tailSettings
		local variables = System.tailVariables[Data]

		-- Get new state of the root part.
		local rootCFrame = physicsTail.root.CFrame

		-- Change in position, which is velocity (without change in time).
		local rootDeltaCFrame = cframeToObjectSpace(physicsTail.rootPreviousCFrame, rootCFrame)

		-- Max a tail can have physics from movement.
		if rootDeltaCFrame.Position.Magnitude > math.max(1,physicsTail.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude) --[[movementDistanceThreshold]] then
			-- H-5 fix: removed leftover debug warn() - was firing every frame during teleports/respawns,
			-- spamming the console and allocating strings in the hot path.
			rootDeltaCFrame = rootDeltaCFrame.Rotation -- clear position
		end

		-- Change in velocity, which is acceleration (without change in time).
		local rootAcceleration = cframeToObjectSpace(physicsTail.rootPreviousDeltaCFrame, rootDeltaCFrame)

		-- Force from walking around + any other forces that will be added before calculating it all to angular velocity.
		local tailForce = rootAcceleration.Position * tailSettings.linearAmplitude

		-- Compute wind force fluctuation.
		if persistentTailWindForceRelevant then
			-- Cache sin(unixTime * 4).
			local sinUnixTime4 = math.sin(variables.tailScaledTime * 4)

			-- Jittery effect for when the wind is strong.
			local unstableWindFlow = math.sin(variables.tailScaledTime * 2 * sinUnixTime4) * persistentTailWindAlpha_Times_04

			-- Calm wind effect.
			local stableWindFlow = math.sin(variables.tailScaledTime * 2) * sinUnixTime4

			-- Add wind force.
			tailForce -= cframeVectorToObjectSpace(rootCFrame, persistentTailWindUnit * persistentTailWindAlpha_Squared_Times_006 * (1 + (stableWindFlow + unstableWindFlow) * 0.4))
		end

		-- Add persistent linear force.
		if persistentTailLinearForceRelevant then tailForce -= cframeVectorToObjectSpace(rootCFrame, persistentTailLinearForce) end

		-- Cache pivotCFrame to use in displacement and weld CFrame
		local pivotCFrame = physicsTail.pivotCFrame -- Avoiding table lookups is faster.

		-- Forces for walking around.
		local displacement = pivotCFrame.Position - physicsTail.weldPreviousCFrame.Position
		local torque = vector3Cross(displacement, tailForce)

		-- Forces for turning around.
		local angularAcceleration = vector3New(cframeToEulerAnglesXYZ(rootAcceleration)) * tailSettings.angularAmplitude

		-- Update old forces. Originally had it as: physicsTail.currentAngle, physicsTail.angularVelocity = fun(...) however avoiding table lookups is faster.
		local newCurrentAngle, newAngularVelocity = calculateElasticity(physicsTail.currentAngle, physicsTail.angularVelocity, tailSettings.stiffness, tailSettings.damping)

		-- Update newCurrentAngle before we make further changes to it with the wag animation.
		physicsTail.currentAngle = newCurrentAngle

		-- Get character scale.
		local characterScale = physicsTail.inverseCharacterScale * modelGetScale(physicsTail.character)
		if not (characterScale > 0) then characterScale = 1 end  -- BUGFIX: inverseCharacterScale is guarded at setup (V4.3.348), but this per-tick modelGetScale re-call can still return 0 mid-respawn -> `torque / 0` = NaN poisons angularVelocity forever. Guard 0/neg/NaN.

		-- Update and apply new forces.
		physicsTail.angularVelocity = newAngularVelocity + torque / characterScale - angularAcceleration

		-- Update weld.
		local currentAngleCFrame = vector3ToAngles(newCurrentAngle) -- newCurrentAngle here is the one modified by wag animation.
		local newWeldCurrentCFrame = pivotCFrame * currentAngleCFrame * physicsTail.inversePivotOffsetCFrame
		local newWeldPreviousCFrame = physicsTail.weldCurrentCFrame
		if updateWeld then
			-- Interpolate.
			local weldCFrame = newWeldPreviousCFrame:Lerp(newWeldCurrentCFrame, interpolationAlpha)

			-- Wag animation.
			if tailSettings.wagAnimationEnabled then
				-- Take the animation-pivoted rotation and figure out what rotation difference it represents in the current tail's space, then apply it to the tail.
				weldCFrame *= cframeInverse(
					cframeToObjectSpace(weldCFrame,
						pivotCFrame * vector3ToAngles(getTailAnimationOffset(physicsTail,Data)) * physicsTail.inversePivotOffsetCFrame
					)
				)
			end

			-- Update weld.
			physicsTail.weld.C0 = weldCFrame.Rotation + weldCFrame.Position * characterScale
		end

		-- Update previous.
		physicsTail.rootPreviousCFrame = rootCFrame
		physicsTail.rootPreviousDeltaCFrame = rootDeltaCFrame

		physicsTail.weldPreviousCFrame = newWeldPreviousCFrame
		physicsTail.weldCurrentCFrame = newWeldCurrentCFrame
	end

	local function physicsTailsDistanceToCameraComparer(a:physicsTail, b:physicsTail):boolean
		return a.distanceToCamera < b.distanceToCamera
	end


	--function part--

	function Function.convertToJSON(value:UDim2)
		if typeof(value) == "Color3" then
			return {["R"] = value.R, ["G"] = value.G, ["B"] = value.B}
		elseif typeof(value) == "Vector3" then
			return {["X"] = value.X, ["Y"] = value.Y, ["Z"] = value.Z}
		elseif typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
			-- Serialize an EnumItem as { EnumType = <bare type name>, Value = <number> }, which
			-- convertFromJSON reconstructs via Enum[name] + GetEnumItems. Used for preset/bundle
			-- enums; keybinds take a simpler plain-name path (see saveData / _kbFromSaved).
			-- V4.3.576: tostring of an Enum TYPE is the BARE name ("KeyCode"), NOT "Enum.KeyCode".
			return {["EnumType"] = (tostring(value.EnumType):gsub("^Enum%.", "")), ["Value"] = value.Value}  -- V4.3.576: was :sub(6) -> "de" bug
		elseif typeof(value) == "UDim2" then
			return {["Scale"]={["X"] = value.X.Scale, ["Y"] = value.Y.Scale},
				["Offset"]={["X"] = value.X.Offset, ["Y"] = value.Y.Offset}}
		elseif typeof(value) == "CFrame" then
			-- V4.3.534 F5: CFrame round-trip. Pre-fix HS:JSONEncode silently stripped CFrame ...
			return {["CF"] = {value:GetComponents()}}
		end
		return value
	end

	-- V4.3.518 Fix 2: pcall + ambiguity guard. Pre-fix, any table with R/G/B keys ...
	function Function.convertFromJSON(value)
		if typeof(value) == "table" then
			local _hasRGB = (value.R ~= nil and value.G ~= nil and value.B ~= nil)
			local _hasXYZ = (value.X ~= nil and value.Y ~= nil and value.Z ~= nil)
			if _hasRGB and not _hasXYZ then
				local _r, _g, _b = tonumber(value.R), tonumber(value.G), tonumber(value.B)
				if _r and _g and _b then
					local _ok, _c = pcall(Color3.new, _r, _g, _b)
					if _ok then return _c end
				end
			elseif _hasXYZ and not _hasRGB then
				local _x, _y, _z = tonumber(value.X), tonumber(value.Y), tonumber(value.Z)
				if _x and _y and _z then
					local _ok, _v = pcall(Vector3.new, _x, _y, _z)
					if _ok then return _v end
				end
			elseif value["EnumType"] and value["Value"] then
				-- V4.3.520 Fix 6: backward-compat with the legacy "Enum.Foo" string format
				-- that was silently failing prior. Strip the "Enum." prefix if present.
				local _eName = value.EnumType
				if type(_eName) == "string" then
					_eName = _eName:gsub("^Enum%.", "")
				end
				local _enumType; if type(_eName) == "string" then pcall(function() _enumType = Enum[_eName] end) end  -- V4.5.19: guard - Enum[badName] RAISES (and a non-string EnumType from a corrupt/hostile community bundle skipped the gsub but still indexed Enum), aborting the whole preset/bundle load
				if _enumType then
					-- Reconstruct the EnumItem from {EnumType, Value}. Roblox Enum has NO built-in
					-- :FromValue (only the third-party EnumExtender adds it), so go value->item via
					-- GetEnumItems() (a real API) matching .Value. Used for preset/bundle enums;
					-- keybinds take the simpler plain-name path (see _kbFromSaved in the settings load).
					local _okItems, _items = pcall(_enumType.GetEnumItems, _enumType)
					if _okItems and type(_items) == "table" then
						local _want = tonumber(value.Value)
						for _, _it in ipairs(_items) do
							if _it.Value == _want then return _it, false end
						end
					end
				end
			elseif type(value["CF"]) == "table" and #value.CF == 12 then
				-- V4.3.534 F5: CFrame restore (mirror of convertToJSON's "CF" array form).
				local _cf = value.CF
				local _ok, _c = pcall(CFrame.new,
					tonumber(_cf[1]) or 0, tonumber(_cf[2]) or 0, tonumber(_cf[3]) or 0,
					tonumber(_cf[4]) or 1, tonumber(_cf[5]) or 0, tonumber(_cf[6]) or 0,
					tonumber(_cf[7]) or 0, tonumber(_cf[8]) or 1, tonumber(_cf[9]) or 0,
					tonumber(_cf[10]) or 0, tonumber(_cf[11]) or 0, tonumber(_cf[12]) or 1)
				if _ok then return _c, false end
			elseif value["Scale"] and value["Offset"] then
				if typeof(value.Scale) == "table" and typeof(value.Offset) == "table" then
					local _sx, _ox = tonumber(value.Scale.X), tonumber(value.Offset.X)
					local _sy, _oy = tonumber(value.Scale.Y), tonumber(value.Offset.Y)
					-- V4.3.519 Fix 1: NaN/inf guard. V4.3.518 Fix 2 stopped erroring on bad UDim2 input, ...
					if _sx and _ox and _sy and _oy then
						-- NaN self-compare: NaN ~= NaN
						if _sx == _sx and _ox == _ox and _sy == _sy and _oy == _oy
						   and math.abs(_sx) ~= math.huge and math.abs(_ox) ~= math.huge
						   and math.abs(_sy) ~= math.huge and math.abs(_oy) ~= math.huge then
							local _ok, _u = pcall(UDim2.new, _sx, _ox, _sy, _oy)
							if _ok then return _u end
						else
							_diagPublicCall("convertFromJSON.udim2_invalid", { sx=tostring(_sx), ox=tostring(_ox), sy=tostring(_sy), oy=tostring(_oy) })
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return value,true
	end

	function Function.toFormatString(value)
		if typeof(value) == "Color3" then
			-- V4.3.302: round to integers - `R*255` is float (e.g. 127.5); Color3.fromRGB
			-- expects ints, and float args round inconsistently across executors.
			return string.format("Color3.fromRGB(%d, %d, %d)",
				math.floor(value.R * 255 + 0.5),
				math.floor(value.G * 255 + 0.5),
				math.floor(value.B * 255 + 0.5))
		elseif typeof(value) == "Vector3" then
			return string.format("Vector3.new(%s, %s, %s)", value.X, value.Y, value.Z)
		elseif typeof(value) == "string" then
			return string.format("%q", value)
		elseif typeof(value) == "CFrame" then
			return string.format("CFrame.new(%s)", tostring(value))
		end
		return tostring(value)
	end

	function Function.AttachmentCreate(Character)
		for Attach, ParentName in pairs(AttachmentParent) do
			local Base = Character:FindFirstChild(ParentName)

			if Base and not Base:FindFirstChild(Attach) then
				local Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment", Base)
				Attachment.Name = Attach
				Attachment.CFrame = AttachmentCFrame[Attach]
			end
		end
	end

	function Function.HeadMesh(Part)
		local SpecialMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh", Part)
		SpecialMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Head
		SpecialMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1.25, 1.25, 1.25)
	end

	function Function.SpringCreate(Object, Base, Target, Velocity, Speed, Damper, PositionOffset, Position, RotationOffset, Rotation, Data)
		local DataDetail = PlayerData[Data]
		if not DataDetail then return end
		if not Object then return end

		local Weld = Object:FindFirstChildOfClass("Weld") or Object:FindFirstChildOfClass("WeldConstraint")
		if Weld then
				local CF = Weld.C0
			local CF1 = Weld.C1

			local Spring = Function.Spring.new(Vector3.new(0,0,0))
			Spring.Target = Target;
			Spring.Velocity = Velocity;
			Spring.Speed = Speed;
			Spring.Damper = Damper;

			-- Secondary overtone spring (higher freq, feeds off primary velocity)
			local Spring2 = nil
			if DataDetail.OvertoneEnabled then
				Spring2 = Function.Spring.new(Vector3.new(0,0,0))
				Spring2.Target   = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
				Spring2.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
				Spring2.Speed    = Speed * 3.2
				Spring2.Damper   = math.min(Damper * 2, 0.95)
			end

			DataDetail.CurrentPartList.BodyPartPhysics[Object] = {
				Spring = Spring,
				Spring2 = Spring2,
				Base = Base,
				Weld = Weld,
				CF = CF,
				CF1 = CF1,
				OriginCFrame = Base.CFrame,
				PositionOffset = PositionOffset,
				Position = Position,
				RotationOffset = RotationOffset,
				Rotation = Rotation,
				BreastsType = DataDetail.BreastsType,
				-- V4.3.460: precomputed offset dispatch. Pre-fix, _doPhysicsTickPart ...
				_poX_to = PositionOffset and PositionOffset.X,
				_poY_to = PositionOffset and PositionOffset.Y,
				_poZ_to = PositionOffset and PositionOffset.Z,
				_roX_to = RotationOffset and RotationOffset.X,
				_roY_to = RotationOffset and RotationOffset.Y,
				_roZ_to = RotationOffset and RotationOffset.Z,
			}

		end
	end

	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	-- SmartBone-based body physics (VNS mesh integration) - Phase 2
	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	-- VNS bundle supplies physics modules/assets. RoClothes retains character
	-- rigging and GUI ownership; never invoke the standalone VNS Init/Run path.
	-- V4.3.535 Opt-1: VNS_URLS/VNS_LOCAL_PATH/VNS_CACHE/VNS_CACHE_DIR hoisted to file scope (L4528-4531).

	-- Load only SmartBone once per session, initializing its tag contract first.
	-- Returns true on success, nil on failure. Result cached in System._vnsLoaded.
	-- V4.3.219: re-enabled with a key change. Does NOT call vnsApi:Run() (which (see Changelog for full rationale)
	function Function.LoadSmartBoneApi()
		if not System._sessionAlive or not BREAKER.Parent then return end
		-- V4.3.518 Fix 3: cache load-failure flag. Without this every CharacterReset
		-- on a restricted executor re-fires the 2-tier GitHub fetch + DeserializeAsync.
		if System._vnsLoadFailed then return end
		if System._vnsLoaded then return System._vnsLoaded end
		if System._sbLoading then
			local t = 0
			repeat task.wait(0.05); t += 0.05
			until System._sbApi or not System._sbLoading or t > 10
			return System._sbApi
		end
		System._sbLoading = true
		local _loaderThread = coroutine.running()
		System._sbLoaderThread = _loaderThread
		-- Delegate the heavy load (rbxm fetch + custom require setup + content
		-- patches) to the disabled version's body, but stop it before vnsApi:Run().
		-- We do this by inlining the loader and replacing the Run call.
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			return Function._LoadVnsAndInstallSmartBone_Inner()
		end)
		System._sbLoading = false
		if System._sbLoaderThread == _loaderThread then System._sbLoaderThread = nil end
		if not System._sessionAlive or not BREAKER.Parent then return nil end
		if not ok or err ~= true then
			-- V4.3.261: latch failure for the rest of the session so RigVnsModel's ...
			System._vnsLoadFailed = true
			warn("[RoClothes] LoadSmartBoneApi failed:", err)
			return nil
		end
		System._vnsLoadFailed = nil
		System._vnsLoaded = true
		return true
	end

	function Function._LoadVnsAndInstallSmartBone_Inner()
		local CG = game:GetService("CoreGui")
		local function _sbSessionAlive()
			return System._sessionAlive == true and BREAKER.Parent ~= nil
		end
		if not _sbSessionAlive() then return end
		-- V4.3.497: SerializationService is Synapse-specific; non-Synapse executors throw on GetService.
		local _ssOk, SS = pcall(game.GetService, game, "SerializationService")
		if not _ssOk then
			SS = nil
			-- V4.3.506 telemetry: SerializationService unavailable (non-Synapse).
			Function.diag("exec.serialization_unavailable", {})
		end
		local _gca = getcustomasset or getsynasset

		-- Reuse vnsRoot if already in CoreGui (defensive - boot cleanup destroys it).
		local vnsRoot = CG:FindFirstChild("_RCVns")
		local _ownsVnsRoot = false
		local _ownedVnsToken = System.BreakerName
		local function _abortDeadSmartBoneLoad()
			if _sbSessionAlive() then return false end
			if _ownsVnsRoot and vnsRoot then
				local _owner
				pcall(function() _owner = vnsRoot:GetAttribute("_RCSessionOwner") end)
				if vnsRoot.Parent == nil or _owner == _ownedVnsToken then pcall(function() vnsRoot:Destroy() end) end
			end
			return true
		end
		local function _hasModuleScript(inst)
			if not inst then return false end
			if inst:IsA("ModuleScript") then return true end
			return inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ModuleScript", true) ~= nil
		end
		if vnsRoot and not _hasModuleScript(vnsRoot) then
			pcall(function() vnsRoot:Destroy() end); vnsRoot = nil
		end

		-- V4.3.520 Fix 10: skip disk cache for VNS until SHA-pinned. Disk-cached rbxm ...
		local _skipDiskCache = true
		-- Three-tier load: workspace cache, Roblox content folder, GitHub.
		if not _skipDiskCache and not vnsRoot and _gca and env.isfile and env.isfile(VNS_CACHE) then
			local okU, customUrl = pcall(_gca, VNS_CACHE)
			if okU and type(customUrl) == "string" and #customUrl > 0 then
				local okG, objects = pcall(game.GetObjects, game, customUrl)
				if okG and objects and #objects > 0 and _hasModuleScript(objects[1]) then
					vnsRoot = objects[1]
					_ownsVnsRoot = true
				end
				if _abortDeadSmartBoneLoad() then return end
			end
		end
		if not vnsRoot then
			local okG, objects = pcall(game.GetObjects, game, "rbxasset://" .. VNS_LOCAL_PATH)
			if okG and objects and #objects > 0 and _hasModuleScript(objects[1]) then
				vnsRoot = objects[1]
				_ownsVnsRoot = true
			end
			if _abortDeadSmartBoneLoad() then return end
		end
		if not vnsRoot then
			local raw
			-- V4.3.520 Fix 10: same disk-cache skip - disk rbxm is unpinned and trusted
			-- only via path; readfile would feed it to DeserializeInstancesAsync below.
			if not _skipDiskCache and env.isfile and env.isfile(VNS_CACHE) then
				local okR, data = pcall(env.readfile, VNS_CACHE)
				-- F2: the disk cache was trusted by path alone, so anything else in
				-- this executor that can write it could get its own instances
				-- deserialized. A cache that fails the pin is ignored and the HTTP
				-- path below re-fetches (and overwrites it).
				if okR and _vnsIntegrityOk(data) then raw = data end
			end
			if not raw then
				local ok, data
				for _, _vnsUrl in ipairs(VNS_URLS) do
					ok, data = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, _vnsUrl)
					if _abortDeadSmartBoneLoad() then return end
					if ok and _vnsIntegrityOk(data) then break end
				end
				if ok and _vnsIntegrityOk(data) then
					raw = data
					-- V4.3.521 Fix 4: don't write the disk cache while V4.3.520 Fix 10's _skipDiskCache ...
					if not _skipDiskCache and env.writefile then
						if env.makefolder and env.isfolder and not env.isfolder(VNS_CACHE_DIR) then
							pcall(env.makefolder, VNS_CACHE_DIR)
						end
						pcall(env.writefile, VNS_CACHE, raw)
					end
				end
			end
			if raw and buffer and SS then
				local okD, instances = pcall(function()
					return SS:DeserializeInstancesAsync(buffer.fromstring(raw))
				end)
				if okD and instances and #instances > 0 then
					for _, inst in ipairs(instances) do
						if _hasModuleScript(inst) then vnsRoot = inst; _ownsVnsRoot = true; break end
					end
				end
				if _abortDeadSmartBoneLoad() then return end
			end
		end
		if not vnsRoot then error("vns.rbxm could not be loaded") end
		if _abortDeadSmartBoneLoad() then return end
		pcall(function() vnsRoot:SetAttribute("_RCSessionOwner", _ownedVnsToken) end)

		vnsRoot.Name = "_RCVns"
		-- V4.5.22: strip any GUI baked into the VNS rbxm BEFORE parenting vnsRoot into CoreGui below.
		for _, _d in ipairs(vnsRoot:GetDescendants()) do
			if _d:IsA("LayerCollector") then pcall(function() _d:Destroy() end) end
		end
		if vnsRoot.Parent ~= CG then pcall(function() vnsRoot.Parent = CG end) end
		if _abortDeadSmartBoneLoad() then return end
		System._sbFolder = vnsRoot

		-- Custom require - sandbox env that stubs task.synchronize/desynchronize and
		-- resolves @self/./../etc paths the way require.luau does.
		local _moduleCache = {}
		local _customRequire
		local function _resolvePath(path, base)
			if typeof(path) == "Instance" then return path end
			if type(path) ~= "string" then return nil end
			local current, remaining = nil, path
			local prefixes = {
				{ "@self", function(b) return b end },
				{ "@game", function(_) return game end },
				{ "..",    function(b) return b.Parent and b.Parent.Parent or nil end },
				{ ".",     function(b) return b.Parent end },
			}
			while true do
				local matched = false
				for _, e in ipairs(prefixes) do
					local key, fn = e[1], e[2]
					if remaining:sub(1, #key) == key
					   and (#remaining == #key or remaining:sub(#key + 1, #key + 1) == "/") then
						current = fn(base)
						remaining = (#remaining == #key) and "" or remaining:sub(#key + 2)
						matched = true; break
					end
				end
				if not matched then break end
			end
			if not current then return nil end
			for segment in string.gmatch(remaining, "[^/]+") do
				if segment == ".." then current = current and current.Parent
				else current = current and current:FindFirstChild(segment) end
				if not current then return nil end
			end
			return current
		end
		_customRequire = function(module)
			if _moduleCache[module] then return _moduleCache[module] end
			-- V4.3.496: capability-guard loadstring. Audit Pass D #2: some ...
			local _ls = (getgenv and getgenv().loadstring) or loadstring
			if type(_ls) ~= "function" then
				error("loadstring unavailable on this executor - VNS module '"..tostring(module.Name).."' cannot be loaded.")
			end
			local chunk, lerr = _ls(module.Source, module.Name)
			if not chunk then error("loadstring failed for "..tostring(module.Name)..": "..tostring(lerr)) end
			local moduleEnv = {}
			moduleEnv.script = module
			moduleEnv.require = function(target)
				if typeof(target) == "Instance" and target:IsA("ModuleScript") then
					return _customRequire(target)
				end
				if type(target) == "string" then
					local resolved = _resolvePath(target, module)
					if not resolved then error("path resolve failed: "..tostring(target)) end
					if resolved:IsA("ModuleScript") then return _customRequire(resolved) end
					return require(resolved)
				end
				return require(target)
			end
			moduleEnv.task = setmetatable({
				synchronize = function() end,
				desynchronize = function() end,
			}, { __index = task })
			-- V4.3.339: pcall-guard getfenv/setfenv. Restricted-env executors (Volt/Xeno ...
			pcall(function() setmetatable(moduleEnv, { __index = getfenv(chunk) }) end)
			pcall(setfenv, chunk, moduleEnv)
			local ok, result = pcall(chunk)
			if not ok then error("module "..tostring(module.Name).." errored: "..tostring(result)) end
			if module:IsA("ModuleScript") then _moduleCache[module] = result end
			return result
		end

		local vnsModule = vnsRoot:IsA("ModuleScript") and vnsRoot
