	end)

	-- V4.3.265: inlined as anonymous closure to AllConnect (was `local RunConnect = ...`
	-- + adjacent table.insert). Frees 1 RoClothes-scope register slot.
		-- V4.5.43: write a property only if it differs. renderA re-set LocalTransparencyModifier / Transparency / Color / ...
	function Function._setIf(inst, prop, v)
		if inst[prop] ~= v then inst[prop] = v end
	end
	-- V4.5.43: write a Size/Scale only when it would ACTUALLY change something. Some parts never accept the computed size ...
	function Function._setStable(inst, memo, key, prop, target)
		local cur = inst[prop]
		local lt, la = memo["_st" .. key], memo["_sa" .. key]
		if lt and la and (lt - target).Magnitude <= 1e-4 and (la - cur).Magnitude <= 1e-4 then return end
		if (cur - target).Magnitude > 1e-4 then inst[prop] = target end
		memo["_st" .. key] = target
		memo["_sa" .. key] = inst[prop]
	end
	-- V4.5.43: every CFrame/Size/Scale guard below compares with a 1e-4 TOLERANCE, not exact equality. Roblox stores ...
table.insert(AllConnect, RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		for _, v in pairs(Method2CharacterFolder:GetChildren()) do
			local CharacterValue = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("ObjectValue")

			if CharacterValue and CharacterValue.Value ~= nil and CharacterValue.Value.Parent == nil then
				v:Destroy()
			end
		end

		local lP = PS.LocalPlayer

		-- V4.3.505: hoist _hlSet build out of the per-player loop. `highlights` is a ...
		local _hlSet = {}
		for _, _h in ipairs(highlights) do _hlSet[_h] = true end

		for PlayerName, DataList in pairs(PlayerData) do
			local _methodBuilt = (DataList and DataList.MethodAtBuild) or Method  -- V4.3.449: captured method
		local liveCharacter = ((_methodBuilt == 2 or _methodBuilt == 3) and DataList.Character) or nil
			-- V4.3.375: cache the cache. Pre-fix both tables were freshly allocated ...
			local meshScaleCache = DataList._meshScaleCache or {}
			local accessoryScaleCache = DataList._accessoryScaleCache or {}
			DataList._meshScaleCache = meshScaleCache
			DataList._accessoryScaleCache = accessoryScaleCache
			table.clear(meshScaleCache)
			table.clear(accessoryScaleCache)

			-- Per-frame scale caches: many clothes share the same torso/limb base.
			-- Reusing the multiplier math cuts repeated head/torso recompute cost on mesh-heavy bundles.
			local function getMeshScaleInfo(Base)
				local cached = meshScaleCache[Base]
				if cached then
					return cached
				end

				local BodySize = BodyPartSize[Base.Name]
				local CalcSize = Base.Size
				local specialHead = false

				if Base.Name == "Head" and Base:IsA("MeshPart") then
					local originalSize = Base:FindFirstChild("OriginalSize")
					if originalSize then
						BodySize = originalSize.Value
					else
						BodySize = BodyPartSize["HeadMeshFix"]
					end
				elseif Base.Name == "Head" and Base:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") then
					local SM:SpecialMesh = Base:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
					if SM.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.Head then
						specialHead = true
						BodySize = BodyPartSize["HeadScale"]
					else
						local cachedMesh = DataList.CurrentPartList["TrueMeshSize"]
						if cachedMesh and cachedMesh.MeshId == SM.MeshId then
							CalcSize = cachedMesh.Part.Size * SM.Scale
							BodySize = BodyPartSize["HeadMeshFix"]
						else
							Function.RequestHeadMeshSize(DataList, SM.MeshId)
							CalcSize = SM.Scale
							BodySize = BodyPartSize["HeadScale"]
						end
					end
				end

				local XMultiply, YMultiply, ZMultiply = Function.MultiplyCalculate(CalcSize, BodySize)
				if specialHead then
					local SM:SpecialMesh = Base:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
					if CalcSize.X > CalcSize.Z then
						CalcSize = Vector3.new(CalcSize.Z, CalcSize.Y, CalcSize.Z)
					end
					if CalcSize.Z > CalcSize.X then
						CalcSize = Vector3.new(CalcSize.X, CalcSize.Y, CalcSize.X)
					end
					XMultiply, YMultiply, ZMultiply = Function.MultiplyCalculate(CalcSize, BodySize)

					local S = SM.Scale
					if S.X > S.Z then
						S = Vector3.new(S.Z, S.Y, S.Z)
					end
					if S.Z > S.X then
						S = Vector3.new(S.X, S.Y, S.X)
					end
					local XMS, YMS, ZMS = Function.MultiplyCalculate(S, vector3New(1.25, 1.25, 1.25))

					XMultiply = XMultiply * XMS
					YMultiply = YMultiply * YMS
					ZMultiply = ZMultiply * ZMS
				end

				cached = { XMultiply = XMultiply, YMultiply = YMultiply, ZMultiply = ZMultiply }
				meshScaleCache[Base] = cached
				return cached
			end

			local function getAccessoryScaleInfo(Base)
				local cached = accessoryScaleCache[Base]
				if cached then
					return cached
				end

				local CalcSize = Base.Size
				local BodySize = BodyPartSize[Base.Name]
				local specialHead = false

				if not BodySize then
					if Base.Name == "UpperTorso" or Base.Name == "LowerTorso" then
						BodySize = BodyPartSize["Torso"]
					elseif Base.Name == "LeftUpperArm" or Base.Name == "LeftLowerArm" then
						BodySize = BodyPartSize["Left Arm"]
					elseif Base.Name == "RightUpperArm" or Base.Name == "RightLowerArm" then
						BodySize = BodyPartSize["Right Arm"]
					elseif Base.Name == "LeftUpperLeg" or Base.Name == "LeftLowerLeg" then
						BodySize = BodyPartSize["Left Leg"]
					elseif Base.Name == "RightUpperLeg" or Base.Name == "RightLowerLeg" then
						BodySize = BodyPartSize["Right Leg"]
					end
				elseif Base.Name == "Head" and Base:IsA("MeshPart") then
					local originalSize = Base:FindFirstChild("OriginalSize")
					if originalSize then
						BodySize = originalSize.Value
					else
						BodySize = BodyPartSize["HeadMeshFix"]
					end
				elseif Base.Name == "Head" and Base:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") then
					local SM:SpecialMesh = Base:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
					if SM.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.Head then
						specialHead = true
						BodySize = BodyPartSize["HeadScale"]
					else
						local cachedMeshAcc = DataList.CurrentPartList["TrueMeshSize"]
						if cachedMeshAcc and cachedMeshAcc.MeshId == SM.MeshId then
							local sz = cachedMeshAcc.Part.Size
							local x = 1 - (1.198 / math.max(sz.X, 1.198))
							local y = 1 - (1.202 / math.max(sz.Y, 1.202))
							local z = 1 - (1.198 / math.max(sz.Z, 1.198))
							CalcSize = Vector3.new(SM.Scale.X + x, SM.Scale.Y + y, SM.Scale.Z + z)
							BodySize = BodyPartSize["HeadScale"]
						else
							Function.RequestHeadMeshSize(DataList, SM.MeshId)
							CalcSize = SM.Scale
							BodySize = BodyPartSize["HeadScale"]
						end
					end
				end

				local XMultiply, YMultiply, ZMultiply = Function.MultiplyCalculate(CalcSize, BodySize)
				if specialHead then
					local SM:SpecialMesh = Base:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
					if CalcSize.X > CalcSize.Z then
						CalcSize = Vector3.new(CalcSize.Z, CalcSize.Y, CalcSize.Z)
					end
					if CalcSize.Z > CalcSize.X then
						CalcSize = Vector3.new(CalcSize.X, CalcSize.Y, CalcSize.X)
					end
					XMultiply, YMultiply, ZMultiply = Function.MultiplyCalculate(CalcSize, BodySize)

					local S = SM.Scale
					if S.X > S.Z then
						S = Vector3.new(S.Z, S.Y, S.Z)
					end
					if S.Z > S.X then
						S = Vector3.new(S.X, S.Y, S.X)
					end
					local XMS, YMS, ZMS = Function.MultiplyCalculate(S, vector3New(1.25, 1.25, 1.25))

					XMultiply = XMultiply * XMS
					YMultiply = YMultiply * YMS
					ZMultiply = ZMultiply * ZMS
				end

				cached = { XMultiply = XMultiply, YMultiply = YMultiply, ZMultiply = ZMultiply }
				accessoryScaleCache[Base] = cached
				return cached
			end

			-- V4.3.505: _hlSet hoisted above the per-player loop (single build per frame).
			for Name, Property in pairs(DataList.ConvertedPart) do
				local Part = Property.Part
				local Weld = Property.Weld
				local Base = Property.Base
				local BaseSize = System.R15Size[Base.Name]
				local basePart = DataList.Character and DataList.Character:FindFirstChild(Base.Name)
				local origSize = basePart and basePart:FindFirstChild("OriginalSize")
				if origSize then
					BaseSize = origSize.Value
				end

				if Base:IsA("MeshPart") and Base.MeshId == "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=542765884" then
					BaseSize = System.R15Size["UpperTorsoFemale"]
				end

				local XMultiply, YMultiply, ZMultiply = Function.MultiplyCalculate(Base.Size, BaseSize)

				Function._setIf(Part, "Color", Base.Color)
				Function._setIf(Part, "Material", Base.Material)
				Function._setIf(Part, "Transparency", Base.Transparency)
				Function._setIf(Part, "LocalTransparencyModifier", 1)
				if DataList.MeshSizeLock == false then
					-- V4.3.280: scalar pre-compare so we don't even allocate the Vector3 ...
					local _r6 = System.R6Size[Name]
					local _tx, _ty, _tz = _r6.X * XMultiply, _r6.Y * YMultiply, _r6.Z * ZMultiply
					-- V4.5.68: exact ~= against a float32 readback was almost always true = a Size write (mesh rebuild) per part
					-- per frame on Method 2 proxies; same tolerance + remember-what-stuck guard as the mesh loops
					Function._setStable(Part, Property, "S", "Size", Vector3.new(_tx, _ty, _tz))
					-- V4.5.59 blocky proxy: shift for sculpted bodies, re-measured every 2 s (body swaps change the joints)
					local _bpBase = basePart or Base
					local _now = os.clock()
					if Property._bpoBase ~= _bpBase or (_now - (Property._bpoT or 0)) > 2 then
						Property._bpoBase, Property._bpoT = _bpBase, _now
						Property._bpo = Function.BlockyProxyOffset(Name, _bpBase) or Vector3.zero
					end
					local _wp = System.WeldCFrame[Name].Position + Property._bpo
					local _c0 = CFrame.new(_wp.X * XMultiply, _wp.Y * YMultiply, _wp.Z * ZMultiply) * System.WeldCFrame[Name].Rotation
					if not Weld.C0:FuzzyEq(_c0, 1e-4) then Weld.C0 = _c0 end  -- V4.5.68: was re-set every frame
				end
			end

			-- Highlight replication: run once per player per frame instead of once per mesh part.
			if (((DataList and DataList.MethodAtBuild) or Method) == 2 or ((DataList and DataList.MethodAtBuild) or Method) == 3) and DataList.Character then  -- V4.3.449
				local _hl = DataList.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")
				if _hl and not _hlSet[_hl] then  -- V4.3.504: O(1) hoisted-set lookup (was table.find per part)
					local h:Highlight = _hl
					if not h.Adornee or h.Adornee == h.Parent then
						table.insert(highlights,h)
						_hlSet[h] = true  -- V4.3.504: keep hoisted set coherent within this frame
						local replicate = h:Clone()
						replicate.Parent = Method2CharacterFolder:FindFirstChild(PlayerName) or Method2CharacterFolder
						local changed, destroyingConn
						local closed = false
						local function cleanupHighlight()
							if closed then return end
							closed = true
							for _, connection in ipairs({changed, destroyingConn}) do
								connection:Disconnect()
								local index = table.find(AllConnect, connection)
								if index then table.remove(AllConnect, index) end
							end
							local index = table.find(highlights, h)
							if index then table.remove(highlights, index) end
							_hlSet[h] = nil
							replicate:Destroy()
						end
						changed = h.Changed:Connect(function(c)
							if h.Parent == nil or (h.Parent ~= DataList.Character and (not h.Adornee or h.Adornee ~= DataList.Character)) then
								cleanupHighlight()
								return
							end
							if (not h.Adornee and h.Parent ~= DataList.Character) or (h.Adornee and h.Adornee ~= DataList.Character) then
								replicate.Parent = nil
							else
								if c ~= "Adornee" then replicate[c] = h[c] end
								replicate.Parent = Method2CharacterFolder:FindFirstChild(PlayerName) or Method2CharacterFolder
							end
						end)
						table.insert(AllConnect, changed)
						-- Destroying also covers destruction without a Changed("Parent") event.
						destroyingConn = h.Destroying:Connect(cleanupHighlight)
						table.insert(AllConnect, destroyingConn)
					end
				end
			end

			for Part, Property in pairs(DataList.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh) do
				local Removed = false

				local Base = Property.Base
				if Part.Parent == nil or Function.FallenPartCheck(Part) or not Base then
					if Property.transparencyConn then pcall(function() Property.transparencyConn:Disconnect() end); Property.transparencyConn=nil end  -- V4.4.2 (round 2): disconnect before dropping (was leaked when a proxy part is removed mid-loop while its base survives)
					DataList.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Mesh[Part] = nil
					Removed = true
				end
				if Removed == false and liveCharacter then
					Base = liveCharacter:FindFirstChild(Base.Name)
				end

				if Removed == false then
					local Base = Property.Base
					local CFRAME = Property.CFrame
					local CFRAME1 = Property.CFrame1
					local SIZE = Property.Size
					local Weld = Property.Weld

					if liveCharacter then
						Base = liveCharacter:FindFirstChild(Base.Name)
					end
					-- V4.5.33: BasePart only - a non-part Base (e.g. an RC_VNS_* model) made getMeshScaleInfo throw, which aborted
					-- the rest of this frame's mesh updates for every part.
					if Base and Base:IsA("BasePart") and CFRAME and CFRAME1 and SIZE and Weld then
						local scaleInfo = getMeshScaleInfo(Base)
						local XMultiply, YMultiply, ZMultiply = scaleInfo.XMultiply, scaleInfo.YMultiply, scaleInfo.ZMultiply

						local CCFRAME = CFrame.new(CFRAME.Position.X * XMultiply, CFRAME.Position.Y * YMultiply, CFRAME.Position.Z * ZMultiply) * CFRAME.Rotation
						local CCFRAME1 = CFrame.new(CFRAME1.Position.X * XMultiply, CFRAME1.Position.Y * YMultiply, CFRAME1.Position.Z * ZMultiply) * CFRAME1.Rotation

						do
							-- V4.3.134: per-part persistent offsets. Multi-targets share the primary GizmoOffset.
							-- All other parts use GizmoOffsets[Part.Name] (auto-persisted via table reference).
							local _isMulti = DataList.GizmoMultiTargets and DataList.GizmoMultiTargets[Part.Name]
							local go = _isMulti and DataList.GizmoOffset
								or (DataList.GizmoOffsets and DataList.GizmoOffsets[Part.Name])
							if go then
								local _c1Inv = CCFRAME1:Inverse()
								-- V4.3.526 Fix 8: type-check RotCF to defend against unsanitized peer values.
								CCFRAME = CCFRAME * _c1Inv * CFrame.new(go.PosX or 0, go.PosY or 0, go.PosZ or 0) * ((typeof(go.RotCF) == "CFrame" and go.RotCF) or CFrame.new()) * CCFRAME1
							end
						end

						-- V4.3.168.8: compute target Size once (was allocating 2 Vector3s per ...
						local _targetSize = Vector3.new(SIZE.X * XMultiply, SIZE.Y * YMultiply, SIZE.Z * ZMultiply)
						if DataList.MeshSizeLock == false and not DataList.CurrentPartList.BodyPartPhysics[Part] and not Part:GetAttribute("RCExternalPose") then  -- V4.5.78: a part posed by something else (attribute) keeps its weld
							Function._setStable(Part, Property, "S", "Size", _targetSize)
							if not Weld.C0:FuzzyEq(CCFRAME, 1e-4) then
								Weld.C0 = CCFRAME
							end
							if not Weld.C1:FuzzyEq(CCFRAME1, 1e-4) then
								Weld.C1 = CCFRAME1
							end
						elseif DataList.MeshSizeLock == false and DataList.CurrentPartList.BodyPartPhysics[Part] then
							Function._setStable(Part, Property, "S", "Size", _targetSize)
							if DataList.CurrentPartList.BodyPartPhysics[Part].CF ~= CCFRAME then
								DataList.CurrentPartList.BodyPartPhysics[Part].CF = CCFRAME
							end
							if DataList.CurrentPartList.BodyPartPhysics[Part].CF1 ~= CCFRAME1 then
								DataList.CurrentPartList.BodyPartPhysics[Part].CF1 = CCFRAME1
							end
						end
					end

					if DataList.RealtimeBodyTransparency == true and not Property.FPOnly then  -- FP FIX: skip the base-Transparency mirror for FP-only breast entries (they carry no geometry; mirroring Torso.Transparency onto them would un-hide a bra-hidden breast + spin up a needless signal conn)
						local actualBase = Property.Base
						if liveCharacter then
							actualBase = liveCharacter:FindFirstChild(Property.Base.Name)
						end
						if actualBase then
							-- Lazy-init signal: connect once per part, reconnect if the base instance
						-- changed (e.g. character respawned - new instance, same name).
							if Property.transparencyConn and Property._connectedBase ~= actualBase then
								Property.transparencyConn:Disconnect()
								Property.transparencyConn = nil
							end
							if not Property.transparencyConn then
								Property.transparencyDirty = true
								Property._connectedBase = actualBase
								Property.transparencyConn = actualBase:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(function()
									Property.transparencyDirty = true
								end)
							end
							if Property.transparencyDirty then
								Property.transparencyDirty = false
								local updated = false
								if actualBase.Transparency ~= DataList.OldTransparency[actualBase] then
									Function._setIf(Part, "Transparency", math.clamp(actualBase.Transparency,Part:GetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC") or -math.huge,math.huge))
									updated = true
								end
								if Part.Transparency ~= Part:GetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC") and
									(Part.Transparency ~= actualBase.Transparency or Part.Transparency == actualBase.Transparency and updated == false and Part:GetAttribute("maxDeterminedRC") == false) then
									Part:SetAttribute("maxDeterminedRC",false)
									Part:SetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC",Part.Transparency)
								elseif Part.Transparency ~= Part:GetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC") and
									Part.Transparency == actualBase.Transparency and updated == true then
									Part:SetAttribute("maxDeterminedRC",true)
								end
								Function._setIf(Part, "Transparency", math.clamp(actualBase.Transparency,Part:GetAttribute("MaxTransparencyRC") or -math.huge,math.huge))
								if Part.Transparency == actualBase.Transparency then
									Part:SetAttribute("maxDeterminedRC",true)
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if PlayerName == lP.Name then
						if DataList.LocalTransparency[Property.Base.Name] == true
							or (System.R15ToR6Name[Property.Base.Name] and DataList.LocalTransparency[System.R15ToR6Name[Property.Base.Name]] == true) then  -- FP FIX: a Type-6 breast's Base is the (R15) UpperTorso; map to the R6 name the body-map toggle writes (mirrors the Accessory loop), else the breast stays faded in first person even with the part toggled SHOWN
							Function._setIf(Part, "LocalTransparencyModifier", Part.Transparency)
						elseif ((DataList and DataList.MethodAtBuild) or Method) == 2 then  -- V4.3.449
							if lP.Character and lP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
								local chr = lP.Character

								if currentCamera then
									local distance = (currentFocus.p - currentCFrame.p).magnitude
									local transparency = (distance<2) and (1.0-(distance-0.5)/1.5) or 0
									if transparency < 0.5 then
										transparency = 0
									end

									transparency = math.clamp(Function.Round(transparency, 2), 0, 1)
									if transparency >= 0.85 then
										transparency = 1
									end
									if Part.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= transparency then
										if math.abs(Part.LocalTransparencyModifier-transparency) > .4 or Part.LocalTransparencyModifier > .95 then
											Function._setIf(Part, "LocalTransparencyModifier", transparency)
										else
											Function._setIf(Part, "LocalTransparencyModifier", Part.LocalTransparencyModifier + (transparency - Part.LocalTransparencyModifier) * .2)
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end

					if Part.Material == Enum.Material.Glass and Part.Transparency >= 1 then
						Part:AddTag("RCGlassMat")
						Function._setIf(Part, "Material", Enum.Material.Neon)
					elseif Part.Material == Enum.Material.Neon and Part:HasTag("RCGlassMat") and Part.Transparency < 1 then
						Part:RemoveTag("RCGlassMat")
						Function._setIf(Part, "Material", Enum.Material.Glass)
					end
				end
			end

			for Part, Property in pairs(DataList.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Accessory) do
				local Removed = false

				if Part.Parent == nil or Function.IsParentNil(Part) or Function.FallenPartCheck(Part) then
					DataList.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Accessory[Part] = nil

					Removed = true
				end

				if Removed == false then
					local Base = Property.Base
					local Attach = Property.Attachment
					local PAttach = Property.ParentAttachment
					local CF = Property.CFrame
					local Size = Property.Size
					local Scale = Property.Scale
					local SpecialMesh = Property.SpecialMesh
					local Weld = Property.Weld

					local PAttachCFrame = AttachmentCFrame[PAttach.Name] or CFrame.new()  -- BUGFIX (defensive): a stale/renamed attachment name absent from AttachmentCFrame left this nil, then `.Position` threw every frame in this RenderStepped loop. Default to identity.
					local scaleInfo = getAccessoryScaleInfo(Base)
					local XMultiply, YMultiply, ZMultiply = scaleInfo.XMultiply, scaleInfo.YMultiply, scaleInfo.ZMultiply

					if DataList.RealtimeBodyTransparency == true and not _RC_pendingFadeTweens[Part] then
						local alpha = Part:GetAttribute("_RC_HPHidden") and 1
							or math.max(Base.Transparency, Part:GetAttribute("_RC_HPBaseTransparency") or 0)
						if Part.Transparency ~= alpha then Part.Transparency = alpha end
					end
					if PlayerName == lP.Name then
						local isPartHidden = false
						-- Rig-Aware Transparency Check
						if DataList.LocalTransparency[Base.Name] == true then
							isPartHidden = true
						else
							-- V4.3.460: direct R15→R6 lookup. Pre-fix walked 6 RigMap entries
							-- + table.find per entry, per accessory per player per frame.
							local _r6 = System.R15ToR6Name[Base.Name]
							if _r6 and DataList.LocalTransparency[_r6] == true then
								isPartHidden = true
							end
							-- Legacy pair-walk retained as a safety net for any rig name not in
							-- R15ToR6Name (e.g., future Roblox rig additions). When R15ToR6Name
							-- catches a hit, this loop doesn't execute (isPartHidden already true).
							-- V4.5.70 (mobile perf): the walk ran for every NOT-hidden accessory every frame; RigMap is constant,
							-- so which R6 groups list this part name is worked out once per name (System._rigOwners).
							if not isPartHidden then
							local _own = System._rigOwners[Base.Name]
							if not _own then
								_own = {}
								for r6Name, r15Parts in pairs(RigMap) do if table.find(r15Parts, Base.Name) then _own[#_own + 1] = r6Name end end
								System._rigOwners[Base.Name] = _own
							end
							for _, r6Name in ipairs(_own) do
								if DataList.LocalTransparency[r6Name] == true then
									isPartHidden = true
									break
								end
							end
							end  -- V4.3.460: close `if not isPartHidden then` (skips legacy walk when direct lookup already caught it)
						end

						if isPartHidden and DataList.LocalTransparency["Hat"] == true then
							if Part.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= Part.Transparency then
								Function._setIf(Part, "LocalTransparencyModifier", Part.Transparency)
							end
						elseif ((DataList and DataList.MethodAtBuild) or Method) == 2 then  -- V4.3.449
							if lP.Character and lP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
								local chr = lP.Character

								if currentCamera then
									local distance = (currentFocus.p - currentCFrame.p).magnitude
									local transparency = (distance<2) and (1.0-(distance-0.5)/1.5) or 0
									if transparency < 0.5 then
										transparency = 0
									end

									transparency = math.clamp(Function.Round(transparency, 2), 0, 1)
									if transparency >= 0.85 then
										transparency = 1
									end
									if Part.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= transparency then
										if math.abs(Part.LocalTransparencyModifier-transparency) > .4 or Part.LocalTransparencyModifier > .95 then
											Function._setIf(Part, "LocalTransparencyModifier", transparency)
										else
											Function._setIf(Part, "LocalTransparencyModifier", Part.LocalTransparencyModifier + (transparency - Part.LocalTransparencyModifier) * .2)
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end

					if DataList.AccessorySizeLock == false then
						local _sgo = DataList.GizmoOffsets and Part.Parent and DataList.GizmoOffsets["acc:" .. Part.Parent.Name]  -- V4.5.59 (N9) gizmo Size
						local _sc = (_sgo and math.clamp(tonumber(_sgo.Scale) or 1, 0.2, 5)) or 1
						local targetSize = Vector3.new(Size.X * XMultiply, Size.Y * YMultiply, Size.Z * ZMultiply) * _sc
						Function._setStable(Part, Property, "S", "Size", targetSize)
						if SpecialMesh then
							local targetScale = Vector3.new(Scale.X * XMultiply, Scale.Y * YMultiply, Scale.Z * ZMultiply) * _sc
							Function._setStable(SpecialMesh, Property, "M", "Scale", targetScale)
						end
						if not DataList.CurrentPartList.physicsTails[Part.Parent] then
							local attachCFrame = CFrame.new(CF.Position.X * XMultiply, CF.Position.Y * YMultiply, CF.Position.Z * ZMultiply) * CF.Rotation
							local parentAttachCFrame = CFrame.new(PAttachCFrame.Position.X * XMultiply, PAttachCFrame.Position.Y * YMultiply, PAttachCFrame.Position.Z * ZMultiply) * PAttachCFrame.Rotation
							if not Attach.CFrame:FuzzyEq(attachCFrame, 1e-4) then
								Attach.CFrame = attachCFrame
							end
							if not PAttach.CFrame:FuzzyEq(parentAttachCFrame, 1e-4) then
								PAttach.CFrame = parentAttachCFrame
							end
							do
								local _accKey = "acc:" .. Part.Parent.Name
								local _go = DataList.GizmoOffsets and DataList.GizmoOffsets[_accKey]
								local targetC0 = Attach.CFrame
								if _go then
									local _paCFInv = parentAttachCFrame:Inverse()
									_go.baseC0 = Attach.CFrame
									-- V4.3.526 Fix 8: type-check RotCF (see sibling guards).
									targetC0 = Attach.CFrame * _paCFInv * CFrame.new(_go.PosX or 0, _go.PosY or 0, _go.PosZ or 0) * ((typeof(_go.RotCF) == "CFrame" and _go.RotCF) or CFrame.new()) * parentAttachCFrame
								end
								if not Weld.C0:FuzzyEq(targetC0, 1e-4) then
									Weld.C0 = targetC0
								end
							end
							if not Weld.C1:FuzzyEq(parentAttachCFrame, 1e-4) then
								Weld.C1 = parentAttachCFrame
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- Accessory gimbal offset for accessories NOT tracked in RealtimeUpdateList.Accessory.
			-- RealtimeUpdateList.Accessory only contains accessories re-created on the proxy (bundle loaded).
			-- Without a bundle, accessories live on the real character and need this separate writer.
			-- Skips any handle already written by the size loop above to avoid double-writes.
			do
				local accLoop = DataList.CurrentPartList
					and DataList.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList
					and DataList.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Accessory
				local offsets = DataList.GizmoOffsets
				if offsets then
					local char = Function.ResolveTargetChar(PlayerName)
					if char then
						for key, go in pairs(offsets) do
							if type(key) == "string" and key:sub(1, 4) == "acc:" then
								local acc = char:FindFirstChild(key:sub(5))
								local handle = acc and acc:IsA("Accessory") and acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
								if handle and (not accLoop or not accLoop[handle]) then
									local weld = handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Weld")
									if weld and weld.Part0 then
										-- V4.3.162 H4 fix: recapture base CFrames when the Weld identity changes
										-- (respawn / bundle re-attach) so stale baseC0/baseC1 don't cause orbit regression.
										if go.baseWeld ~= weld then
											go.baseWeld = weld
											go.baseC0 = weld.C0
											go.baseC1 = weld.C1
										end
										if not go.baseC0 then go.baseC0 = weld.C0 end
										if not go.baseC1 then go.baseC1 = weld.C1 end
										local _c1Inv = go.baseC1:Inverse()
										-- V4.3.526 Fix 8: type-check RotCF (see sibling guards).
										-- V4.5.70 (mobile perf): both writes ran every frame (a joint write re-solves the weld). Write only
										-- when the value really differs (tolerance, not ~=, per the per-frame-write lesson).
										local _wantC0 = go.baseC0 * _c1Inv * CFrame.new(go.PosX or 0, go.PosY or 0, go.PosZ or 0) * ((typeof(go.RotCF) == "CFrame" and go.RotCF) or CFrame.new()) * go.baseC1
										if not weld.C0:FuzzyEq(_wantC0, 1e-4) then weld.C0 = _wantC0 end
										if not weld.C1:FuzzyEq(go.baseC1, 1e-4) then weld.C1 = go.baseC1 end
										pcall(Function._accApplyScale, handle, go.Scale)  -- V4.5.59 (N9)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			for SpecialMesh, Property in pairs(DataList.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.SpecialMesh) do
				local Removed = false

				if SpecialMesh.Parent == nil or Function.IsParentNil(SpecialMesh) or Function.FallenPartCheck(SpecialMesh) then
					DataList.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.SpecialMesh[SpecialMesh] = nil

					Removed = true
				end

				if Removed == false then
					local Base = Property.Base
					local SIZE = Property.Size

					if (((DataList and DataList.MethodAtBuild) or Method) == 2 or ((DataList and DataList.MethodAtBuild) or Method) == 3) and DataList.Character then  -- V4.3.449
						Base = DataList.Character:FindFirstChild(Base.Name)
					end
					if Base and SIZE and SpecialMesh then
						local BodySize = BodyPartSize[Base.Name]
						local CalcSize = Base.Size
						local specialHead = false
						if Base.Name == "Head" and Base:IsA("MeshPart") then
							if Base:FindFirstChild("OriginalSize") then
								BodySize = Base:FindFirstChild("OriginalSize").Value
							else
								BodySize = BodyPartSize["HeadMeshFix"]
							end
						elseif Base.Name == "Head" and Base:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") then
							local SM:SpecialMesh = Base:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
							if SM.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.Head then
								specialHead = true
								BodySize = BodyPartSize["HeadScale"]
							else
								CalcSize = SM.Scale
								BodySize = BodyPartSize["HeadScale"]
							end
						end

						local XMultiply, YMultiply, ZMultiply = Function.MultiplyCalculate(CalcSize, BodySize)
						if specialHead == true then
							local SM:SpecialMesh = Base:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")

							if CalcSize.X > CalcSize.Z then
								CalcSize = Vector3.new(CalcSize.Z,CalcSize.Y,CalcSize.Z)
							end
							if CalcSize.Z > CalcSize.X then
								CalcSize = Vector3.new(CalcSize.X,CalcSize.Y,CalcSize.X)
							end
							XMultiply, YMultiply, ZMultiply = Function.MultiplyCalculate(CalcSize, BodySize)

							local S = SM.Scale
							if S.X > S.Z then
								S = Vector3.new(S.Z,S.Y,S.Z)
							end
							if S.Z > S.X then
								S = Vector3.new(S.X,S.Y,S.X)
							end
							local XMS, YMS, ZMS = Function.MultiplyCalculate(S, vector3New(1.25,1.25,1.25))

							XMultiply = XMultiply*XMS
							YMultiply = YMultiply*YMS
							ZMultiply = ZMultiply*ZMS
						end

						if DataList.MeshSizeLock == false then
							-- V4.3.168.8: same per-frame dedup as the Mesh-part loop above - ...
							local _targetScale = Vector3.new(SIZE.X * XMultiply, SIZE.Y * YMultiply, SIZE.Z * ZMultiply)
							Function._setStable(SpecialMesh, Property, "M", "Scale", _targetScale)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			for i, v in pairs(DataList.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Special) do
				local Removed = false

				if v.Parent == nil or Function.IsParentNil(v) then
					-- V4.3.441: Destroy the orphan Attachment + its ParticleEmitter ...
					pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
					DataList.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Special[i] = nil

					Removed = true
				end

				if Removed == false then
					if v.Name == "cTrail" then
						local origin = v.Parent
						local particle = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("ParticleEmitter")
						if not particle then
							pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)  -- V4.3.441
							DataList.CurrentPartList.RealtimeUpdateList.Special[i] = nil
							continue
						end
						if particle:GetAttribute("Enabled") ~= false then
							-- Exclude owned roots: Roblox filters every descendant, including
							-- accessories added after this list is cached.
							System._cTrailIgnoreCache = System._cTrailIgnoreCache or {}
							local _cache = System._cTrailIgnoreCache
							local _curChar = Player.Character
							local changed = _cache.collisionLen ~= #collisionList
								or _cache.lastChar ~= _curChar or _cache.lastFolder ~= Method2CharacterFolder
								or _cache.dirty or not _cache.list
							if not changed then
								for index, part in ipairs(collisionList) do
									if _cache.list[index] ~= part then changed = true; break end
								end
							end
							if changed then
								local list = _cache.list or {}
								table.clear(list)
								for _, part in ipairs(collisionList) do table.insert(list, part) end
								if _curChar then table.insert(list, _curChar) end
								if Method2CharacterFolder then table.insert(list, Method2CharacterFolder) end
								_cache.list, _cache.collisionLen = list, #collisionList
								_cache.lastChar, _cache.lastFolder = _curChar, Method2CharacterFolder
								_cache.dirty = false
							end
							local ignoreList = _cache.list
							-- V4.3.300: reuse a single RaycastParams across cTrail iterations.
							if not System._cTrailGroundParams then
								local _gp = RaycastParams.new()
								_gp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
								System._cTrailGroundParams = _gp
							end
							System._cTrailGroundParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
							local _groundResult = workspace:Raycast(origin.Position, Vector3.new(0,-10000,0), System._cTrailGroundParams)
							local instance = _groundResult and _groundResult.Instance
							local hit = _groundResult and _groundResult.Position
							if hit and instance and instance:IsA("BasePart") then
								if instance.CanCollide == false and not collisionChecks[instance] then
									-- V4.3.441: 256-entry FIFO cap on collisionList so cTrail-only ...
									if #collisionList >= 256 then
										-- V4.3.504: mirror L17227 FPerson-site cleanup. Pre-fix the FIFO ...
										local oldest = table.remove(collisionList, 1)
										if oldest then
											local conn = collisionChecks[oldest]
											if conn then
												local _ci = table.find(AllConnect, conn)
												if _ci then table.remove(AllConnect, _ci) end
												pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
											end
											collisionChecks[oldest] = nil
										end
									end
									table.insert(collisionList,instance)
									_cache.dirty = true  -- V4.3.505: collisionList changed; rebuild ignore list
									-- V4.3.278: mirror the L11904 self-disconnect arm. Without this, ...
									local collisionChange; collisionChange = instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function()
										if instance.CanCollide == false and not table.find(collisionList,instance) then
											table.insert(collisionList,instance)
											_cache.dirty = true  -- V4.3.505: rebuild ignore list on re-insert
										elseif instance.CanCollide == true then
											local idx = table.find(collisionList,instance)
											if idx then table.remove(collisionList,idx) end
											_cache.dirty = true  -- V4.3.505: rebuild ignore list on remove
											local _ci = table.find(AllConnect, collisionChange)
											if _ci then table.remove(AllConnect, _ci) end
											collisionChange:Disconnect()
											collisionChecks[instance] = nil
										end
									end)
									collisionChecks[instance] = collisionChange
									table.insert(AllConnect, collisionChange)
								else
									particle.Enabled = true
									v.WorldCFrame = CFrame.new(hit) --* instance.CFrame.Rotation
								end
							else
								particle.Enabled = false
							end
						else
							particle.Enabled = false
						end
					elseif v.Name == "nCensor" and v:FindFirstChildOfClass("ObjectValue") then
						local origin = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("ObjectValue")
						if origin.Value and origin.Value.Parent ~= nil then
							local tors = origin.Value.Parent
							local LNipple:MeshPart
							local RNipple:MeshPart

							if tors:FindFirstChild("Left Breast") and tors:FindFirstChild("Left Breast"):FindFirstChild("Nipple") then
								LNipple = tors["Left Breast"]["Nipple"]
							end
							if tors:FindFirstChild("Right Breast") and tors:FindFirstChild("Right Breast"):FindFirstChild("Nipple") then
								RNipple = tors["Right Breast"]["Nipple"]
							end
							if tors and LNipple and RNipple and v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame") then
								local angle = math.acos(
									math.clamp(
										currentCFrame.LookVector:Dot(tors.CFrame.LookVector),
										-1, 1)
								)

								if angle > math.pi/2.8 and (LNipple.Transparency < 1 or RNipple.Transparency < 1) then
									local corners = {
										RNipple.CFrame * Vector3.new(-.45, -.3, -.3),
										LNipple.CFrame * Vector3.new(-.45, -.3, .3),
										RNipple.CFrame * Vector3.new(-.45, .3, -.3),
										LNipple.CFrame * Vector3.new(-.45, .3, .3),
										RNipple.CFrame * Vector3.new(.45, -.3, -.3),
										LNipple.CFrame * Vector3.new(.45, -.3, .3),
										RNipple.CFrame * Vector3.new(.45, .3, -.3),
										LNipple.CFrame * Vector3.new(.45, .3, .3)
									}

									local minX, minY = math.huge, math.huge
									local maxX, maxY = -math.huge, -math.huge

									-- V4.5.24 Fix: guard the projection against a nil camera (switch/respawn ...
									local screenBoundingBox
									if currentCamera then
										-- Project to screen space
										for _, corner in ipairs(corners) do
											local screenPos, onScreen = currentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(corner)
											minX = math.min(minX, screenPos.X)
											minY = math.min(minY, screenPos.Y)
											maxX = math.max(maxX, screenPos.X)
											maxY = math.max(maxY, screenPos.Y)
										end
										-- Screen-aligned bounding box
										screenBoundingBox = {

								cDataTable.SkinTone = _prevNPCPD.SkinTone or cDataTable.SkinTone

								cDataTable.RealCharacter = nil
								cDataTable.AnimationsFrozen = _prevNPCPD.AnimationsFrozen
							end
							PlayerData[NPCData] = cDataTable
							Function.CharacterExecute(Part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"), NPCData, nil, cDataTable.LastRequestID)
						else
							-- V4.3.287: clicked target is a real Player (not NPC). Pre-fix this branch (see Changelog for full rationale)
							local _clickName = Part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model").Name
							Function.PlayerDataAdd(_clickName)  -- ensure PlayerData exists before access
							local _clickPD = PlayerData[_clickName]
							local _srcPD = PlayerData[SelectPlayer]
							-- Edge case 1: user clicked themselves - don't overwrite own data with own data.
							-- Edge case 2: source PD missing (rare race) - fall back to original behaviour.
							if _clickName == SelectPlayer or not _srcPD then
								if _clickPD then
									_clickPD.LastRequestID = (_clickPD.LastRequestID or 0) + 1
									Function.CharacterReset(_clickName)
									Function.CharacterExecute(Part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"), _clickName, nil, _clickPD.LastRequestID)
								end
							else
								-- V4.3.295/297/302: DeepClone skip-set. CurrentPartList (overwritten ...
								local _cloned = Function.DeepClone(_srcPD, {
									CurrentPartList = true, ExecutionMaid = true, Connections = true,
									OldestClothings = true, ConvertedPart = true, OldTransparency = true,
									OriginalAttachmentCFrames = true,
									_strippedAccessories = true,  -- V4.3.446: see NPC clone above
									OriginalHumanoidDescription = true,  -- V4.3.537: see NPC clone above
								})
								_cloned.CurrentPartList            = Function.PlayerDataDefault().CurrentPartList
								_cloned.Connections                = {}
								_cloned.OldestClothings            = {Shirt=nil, Pants=nil, ShirtGraphic=nil}
								_cloned.ConvertedPart              = {}
								_cloned.OldTransparency            = {}
								_cloned.OriginalAttachmentCFrames  = {}
								_cloned._strippedAccessories       = {}  -- V4.5.38: strong (see StripReconcile)
								_cloned.OriginalHumanoidDescription = nil  -- V4.3.537: click-target captures its own HD on next CharacterExecute
								_cloned.LastRequestID              = ((_clickPD and _clickPD.LastRequestID) or 0) + 1
								-- Tear down the prior target's Maid before overwriting (else live
								-- connections from a prior click-execute on the same target dangle
								-- until the L3647 periodic sweep - bounded leak).
								if _clickPD and _clickPD.ExecutionMaid and _clickPD ~= _srcPD then
									pcall(function() _clickPD.ExecutionMaid:DoCleaning() end)
								end
								PlayerData[_clickName]  = _cloned
								Function.CharacterReset(_clickName)
								Function.CharacterExecute(Part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"), _clickName, nil, _cloned.LastRequestID)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end)
			if not ok then warn("[RoClothes] ClickExecute error:", err) end
			-- V4.3.282: reverted V4.3.280's `task.delay(0.5, ...)` clear. Per-NPC RID ...
			end)  -- V4.3.526 Fix 12: close pcall(function()
			cooldown = false
			if not _clickOk then _diagPublicCall("click_execute.throw", { err = tostring(_clickErr) }) end
		end
	end))  -- V4.3.265: end closes function(); first ) closes Connect(; second ) closes table.insert(

	-- V4.3.168.14: `local double` wrapped in a do-block so it lives as a closure upvalue ...
	local MouseDown2 do
	local double = false
	MouseDown2 = Mouse.Button2Down:Connect(function()
		MouseDownStart = UIS:GetMouseLocation()

		if ClickExecute == true and cooldown == false then
			-- V4.3.526 Fix 12: pcall-wrap body (mirror of Button1Down fix).
			cooldown = true

			local Part = Mouse.Target

							break

					-- CLONE GUARD (right-click): same descendant match as Button1Down. Right-click reset on a clone

					for _cloneKey, _cloneModel in pairs(System.NPCs) do

					end
					if PS:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")) then
						Function.CharacterReset(Part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model").Name,true)

					double = false

				if Part then

	function Function.compileOvertime()
		if not (env.listfiles and env.readfile and env.writefile and env.delfile and env.isfile) then
			return
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			-- V4.3.515 Fix 6: pcall like sibling sites at L17745/L17750/L17817 - some executors throw on missing folder.
			local _okLF, filesFound = pcall(env.listfiles, "RClothesLerp/Bundles")
			if not _okLF or type(filesFound) ~= "table" then filesFound = {} end
			local t = {}
			for i, v in pairs(filesFound) do
				if env.isfile(v) then
					local _okRB, _rawB = pcall(env.readfile, v)
								if not _okRB then continue end
								local _okDB, b = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, _rawB)
								if not _okDB or type(b) ~= "table" then continue end
					-- V4.3.520 Fix 15: skip entries with missing BundleName (sibling site).
					local storedName = b.BundleName
					if not storedName or type(storedName) ~= "string" or #storedName == 0 then
						continue
					end
					b["BundleName"] = nil

					local function fromJSON(t)
						for i, v in pairs(t) do
							local value,original = Function.convertFromJSON(v)
							t[i] = value
							if typeof(v) == "table" and original then
								fromJSON(v)
							end
						end
					end
					fromJSON(b)

					t[storedName] = b
				end
			end
			local function toJSON(t)
				for i, v in pairs(t) do
					if typeof(v) == "table" then
						toJSON(v)
					else
						t[i] = Function.convertToJSON(v)
					end
				end
			end
			toJSON(t)
			if #filesFound > 0 then
				-- V4.3.504: atomic write.
				-- V4.3.541 Fix 6: capture return; silent disk-write failure here ...
				local _ovOk = _atomicWriteJSON("RClothesLerp/BundleLoader.json", t)
				if not _ovOk then
					_diagPublicCall("bundle.compileovertime_write_fail", {})
				end
			else
				-- V4.3.515 Fix 7: pcall-wrap delfile.
				pcall(env.delfile, "RClothesLerp/BundleLoader.json")
			end
		end)
	end


	-- Register-limit fix: HPButtons moved inside Function.GUIFunc() - it is only used there.
	-- V4.3.288: HPButtons further moved INTO `_buildHPRenderer` (file-scope helper) since ...
		local hotSwapDebounce = false
		local hotSwapPending = false
		-- V4.3.504: bounded-loop refactor. Pre-fix the task.delay closure called ...
		local _HOTSWAP_ITER_CAP = 32
		local function hotSwap()
			if System._cancelBundleLook then System._cancelBundleLook() end  -- V4.5.63: a real build always beats a preview build
			if SelectPlayer == Player.Name and System.AvatarSync then
				System.AvatarSync.forceClear = false
			end
			if hotSwapDebounce then
				-- State changed while an execute is in-flight - schedule one more pass
				-- so the last user action is never silently dropped.
				hotSwapPending = true
				return
			end
			hotSwapDebounce = true
			task.spawn(function()
				-- V4.3.505: wrap the entire loop body in an outer pcall. Pre-fix the inner ...
				-- V4.3.518 Fix 6: hoisted to outer scope so the post-pcall tail can re-fire.
				local _capExitPending = false
				local _ok, _err = pcall(function()
					local _iters = 0
					local _capExit = false  -- V4.3.505: tracks iter-cap exit for cooldown drain below
					local _lastSp = nil
					repeat
						_iters = _iters + 1
						hotSwapPending = false
						-- V4.3.375: capture SelectPlayer at each iter entry (same rationale as ...
						local _capturedSp = SelectPlayer
						_lastSp = _capturedSp
						-- V4.5.x: resolve the target (real player OR synthetic clone/NPC) so hotSwap ...
						local _hsChar = Function.ResolveTargetChar(_capturedSp)
						if _hsChar and PlayerData[_capturedSp] then
							PlayerData[_capturedSp].LastRequestID = PlayerData[_capturedSp].LastRequestID + 1
							local rid = PlayerData[_capturedSp].LastRequestID
							local _hsNPC = System.NPCs and System.NPCs[_capturedSp] ~= nil
							-- CharacterReset resolves an NPC by MODEL, a player by NAME string.
							if _hsNPC and System._clonePoseCapture then pcall(System._clonePoseCapture, _capturedSp, _hsChar) end  -- V4.5.59 (N3)
							pcall(Function.CharacterReset, _hsNPC and _hsChar or _capturedSp)
							local ok, err = pcall(Function.CharacterExecute, _hsChar, _capturedSp, nil, rid)
							if not ok then warn("[RoClothes] hotSwap error:", err) end
							if _hsNPC and System._clonePoseRestore then pcall(System._clonePoseRestore, _capturedSp) end
						end
						if _capturedSp == Player.Name and Function.AvatarSyncPublish then  -- V4.3.375
							pcall(Function.AvatarSyncPublish, true)
						end
						task.wait(0.2)
						-- If state changed during the wait window, drain any in-progress
						-- CharacterExecute cooldown before the next iteration so we don't
						-- CharacterReset mid-build.
						if hotSwapPending then
							local _pd = PlayerData[_capturedSp]
							if _pd and _pd.Cooldown then
								local _t = 0
								while _pd.Cooldown and _t < 50 do
									task.wait(0.1); _t += 1
								end
							end
						end
						if _iters >= _HOTSWAP_ITER_CAP and hotSwapPending then _capExit = true end
					until (not hotSwapPending) or _iters >= _HOTSWAP_ITER_CAP
					-- V4.3.518 Fix 6: when cap-exit happens with pending=true, schedule one ...
					_capExitPending = hotSwapPending
					if hotSwapPending then
						warn("[RoClothes] hotSwap iter cap (" .. _HOTSWAP_ITER_CAP .. ") hit; dropping further pending re-fires.")
						Function.diag("hotswap.iter_cap_hit", {})
						hotSwapPending = false
					end
					-- V4.3.505: on iter-cap exit a fresh CharacterExecute may still be in flight.
					if _capExit and _lastSp then
						local _pd = PlayerData[_lastSp]
						if _pd and _pd.Cooldown then
							local _t = 0
							while _pd.Cooldown and _t < 50 do
								task.wait(0.1); _t += 1
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				if not _ok then warn("[RoClothes] hotSwap loop fatal: " .. tostring(_err)) end
				hotSwapDebounce = false
				if System._lookOnSwap then pcall(System._lookOnSwap) end  -- V4.5.58: snapshot the result for Undo / Recent Looks (debounced, self only)
				-- V4.3.519 Fix 3: removed unconditional `hotSwapPending = false` here - loop body ...
				-- V4.3.518 Fix 6: re-fire if iter-cap dropped the latest pending state.
				if _capExitPending then task.delay(0.1, function() if not hotSwapDebounce then hotSwap() end end) end
				-- V4.3.522 Fix 2: rebuild Configure dropdown after hotSwap. Pre-fix, bundle ...
				-- PHASE 7: re-render the merged GUI's Recolor / per-cloth HP / Auto-strip lists after ...
				if System.renderRecolorList then pcall(System.renderRecolorList) end
				if System.renderHPList then pcall(System.renderHPList) end
				if System.renderStripList then pcall(System.renderStripList) end
				-- PHASE 8: re-paint the Bundles tab list (active-badge + counts) after a hotSwap,
				-- so applying/clearing/peer-sync updates the visible tiles. Self-guards on a stale grid.
				if System.renderBundles then pcall(System.renderBundles) end
				-- V1 parity: refresh the Clothes tab EQUIPPED badges too (peer/bundle/reset mutates CurrentClothes).
				-- getClothesList reads a LOCAL registry (no network); self-guards on a closed page. Replaces V1's GUIUpdate.
				if System.renderClothesList then pcall(System.renderClothesList) end
				-- PHASE 9: re-paint the catalog Equipped sidebar after a hotSwap (peer/bundle/reset can ...
				if System.renderEquipped then pcall(System.renderEquipped) end
				-- GIZMO: re-seed the Edit tab sliders + Properties after a hotSwap (a
				-- bundle apply / peer sync / character reset can mutate GizmoOffsets /
				-- GizmoTarget). PD-only read; self-guards on a stale page (sliders gone).
				if System.renderEdit then pcall(System.renderEdit) end
			end)
		end
		System.hotSwap = hotSwap
		-- Rebuild an explicit target without touching SelectPlayer. HP damage loops
		-- can remove clothing from any rendered player, so parameterless hotSwap
		-- would otherwise rebuild/publish whichever UI target happens to be selected.
		System.hotSwapTarget = function(targetName)
			if type(targetName) ~= "string" then return end
			task.spawn(function()
				local pd = PlayerData[targetName]
				local targetChar = Function.ResolveTargetChar(targetName)
				if not pd or not targetChar then return end
				pd.LastRequestID = (pd.LastRequestID or 0) + 1
				local rid = pd.LastRequestID
				local isNPC = System.NPCs and System.NPCs[targetName] ~= nil
				if isNPC and System._clonePoseCapture then pcall(System._clonePoseCapture, targetName, targetChar) end  -- V4.5.59 (N3)
				pcall(Function.CharacterReset, isNPC and targetChar or targetName)
				if PlayerData[targetName] ~= pd then return end
				targetChar = Function.ResolveTargetChar(targetName)
				if not targetChar then return end
				local ok, err = pcall(Function.CharacterExecute, targetChar, targetName, nil, rid)
				if not ok then warn("[RoClothes] targeted hotSwap error:", err) end
				if isNPC and System._clonePoseRestore then pcall(System._clonePoseRestore, targetName) end
				if targetName == Player.Name and Function.AvatarSyncPublish then
					pcall(Function.AvatarSyncPublish, true)
				end
			end)
		end

		-- V4.5.65 BRA WATCHDOG (krul: SmartBone breasts bare while the Bra control still says "Bra 2", permanent). Evidence on a
		-- live repro: pd.CurrentClothes holds Breast Clothes SB2 and CurrentPartList.Clothes still points at the BreastClothes
		-- MeshPart, but that MeshPart is orphaned (Parent = nil): something destroyed it after the build and nothing rebuilt it, so
		-- every later look at the selection says "fine". Every 2 s: type 6 + a bra selected + its mesh missing/orphaned on 2 checks
		-- in a row + no build running -> rebuild you once (max 3 per minute) and log what was seen, so the next report has the cause.
		task.spawn(function()
			local fixes, windowStart, strikes = 0, os.clock(), 0
			while System._sessionAlive ~= false do
				task.wait(2)
				local ok = pcall(function()
					local pd = PlayerData[Player.Name]
					if not (pd and pd.BreastsType == 6 and type(pd.CurrentClothes) == "table") then strikes = 0; return end
					local name = table.find(pd.CurrentClothes, "Breast Clothes SB1") and "Breast Clothes SB1" or (table.find(pd.CurrentClothes, "Breast Clothes SB2") and "Breast Clothes SB2")
					if not name or pd.Cooldown == true or (System._realBuilds or 0) > 0 then strikes = 0; return end
					local m = pd.CurrentPartList and pd.CurrentPartList.Clothes and pd.CurrentPartList.Clothes[name]
					local alive = typeof(m) == "Instance" and m.Parent ~= nil and m:IsDescendantOf(game)
					if alive then strikes = 0; return end
					strikes += 1
					if strikes < 2 then return end
					strikes = 0
					if os.clock() - windowStart > 60 then windowStart, fixes = os.clock(), 0 end
					if fixes >= 3 then return end
					fixes += 1
					warn(("[RoClothes] %s is selected but its mesh is gone (map=%s parent=%s): rebuilding. Cause unknown, report this line."):format(name, typeof(m), typeof(m) == "Instance" and tostring(m.Parent) or "-"))
					if System.hotSwapTarget then System.hotSwapTarget(Player.Name) end
				end)
				if not ok then strikes = 0 end
			end
		end)

		-- ============================================================================
		-- PHASE 6: CLOTHES TAB BRIDGE (clothes list + equip/unequip + KrulType)
		-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
		-- The new file-scope GUI (_buildKrulHubGUI) cannot see Clothes / PartList /
		-- PlayerData / SelectPlayer / _pendingKrul* / hotSwap (all RoClothes-scope locals),
		-- so they are exposed here as System.* methods. This block sits right after
		-- `System.hotSwap = hotSwap`, where ALL of those names are in scope together
		-- (the same region as the surviving KrulHosted button handler at L23289). Every
		-- member is a System.X assignment => 0 RoClothes registers; the one helper local
		-- lives inside this do...end so it costs no outer register either.
		--
		-- Faithfulness map to the ORIGINAL (Ro-Clothes-Krul-V4.3.576.0627.lua):
		--   * equip / unequip          -> _buildClothesButtonsPanel click handler, orig L4538-4609
		--   * scrubClothState (inline)  -> orig L26218-26237 (not present in the torn-down engine,

		--   * KrulType "always ask"     -> KrulHosted button handler, orig L33595-33612 / engine L23289

		--                                  the engine's debounced CharacterReset->Execute pipeline)

		--   * alphabetical order         -> orig L27422-27424 / L33625 (a.Name < b.Name)
		do
			-- ============================================================================
			-- PHASE 10 (PART A): PORT-BACK of Function.ResetBundleSettableFields.
			-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
			-- This function was trapped in the deleted GUI layer (orig handleBundleClick
			-- region, def at orig L26719-26797) and removed during the headless teardown.
			-- The torn-down engine still REFERENCES it in six places, all guarded with
			-- `if Function.ResetBundleSettableFields then pcall(...)`:
			--   * System.doReset            (engine L~8211, Player page Reset button)
			--   * System.applyBundle        (engine L~24393 / L~24418 / L~24425, the three
			--                                handleBundleClick reset branches)
			--   * System.clearBundle        (engine L~24517, the "nil" tile CLEAR path)
			-- Without the real definition those guards silently no-op, so applying or
			-- resetting a bundle left the previous bundle's scalar / body / clothing fields
			-- bleeding into the next selection (the exact cross-bundle-bleed class the
			-- original V4.3.143/280/534 fixes hardened this list against). Re-added here
			-- 1:1 from the original (same field list, same literal defaults, same V4.3.x
			-- rationale comments) so every reference resolves. Defined inside the P6 do...end
			-- block where Function + PlayerData are in scope (= 0 RoClothes registers); the
			-- block runs during RoClothes() setup, before any of the lazy System.* closures
			-- above can fire on a user action, so the guards now find it present.
			-- Resets the per-player bundle-settable fields on PlayerData[name] back to their
			-- defaults. Faithful reproduction of orig L26719-26797.
			function Function.ResetBundleSettableFields(name)
				local pd = PlayerData[name]
				if not pd then return end
				pd.BreastsType              = 1
				pd.TorsoType                = 1
				pd.ArmType                  = 1

				-- V4.3.422: clear ripped flags on bundle reset. V4.5.71: in the shared on/off record
				Function.ClothesOffClearRip(pd)

				pd.NippleColorFromBundle    = false
				pd.SmartBoneEnabled         = false
				pd.TearParticles            = true
				pd.HealParticles            = true
				pd.MeshSizeLock             = false
				pd.MeshBasePartInvisible    = false
				pd.BreathingEnabled         = false
				pd.OvertoneEnabled          = false
				pd.BreathingAmplitude       = 0.03
				pd.OvertoneAmplitude        = 0.015
				-- V4.3.280: previously-missing fields (cross-bundle bleed sources).
				pd.CatalogAccessory         = {}
				pd.CatalogTail              = {}
				pd.CatalogRemove            = {}
				pd.CatalogClothes           = {Shirt = "", Pants = "", ShirtGraphic = ""}
				pd.CatalogBundleId          = ""
				pd.CatalogUserSnapshot      = nil  -- V4.5.59: a bundle that carries one sets it again (applied after this reset)
				pd.HPClothes                = {Shirt = "", Pants = ""}
				pd.HPClothesUser            = nil  -- V4.5.52: typed ripped ids reset with the bundle, like HPClothes (upstream)
				pd.BundleBodyColor          = true
				-- V4.3.534 F13: FPerson + BodyTransparency reset (cross-bundle bleed sources ...
				pd.FPerson                  = false
				pd.BodyTransparency         = 0
				-- V4.3.534 F11: FPsnap + HeadTracking reset (sibling fields to FPerson, same
				-- cross-bundle bleed pattern now that they are captured + allowlisted).
				pd.FPsnap                   = false
				-- V4.5.59 (first person ignored body movement): this reset said false while the PD default (L14569) and
				-- Save Outfit ("default is ON", saves only false) say true, and the new UI has no Head Tracking switch.
				-- So after ANY bundle apply the first-person eye was a fixed "forward of the root" and animations that
				-- tilt / turn the head (crawl, crouch, run packs) put the camera inside the head/neck.
				pd.HeadTracking             = true
				pd.BreastsStiffness         = 10
				pd.BreastsDamping           = 0.207
				pd.ButtsStiffness           = 10
				pd.ButtsDamping             = 0.1
				pd.CockStiffness            = 8
				pd.CockDamping              = 0.207
				-- V4.3.539 Fix 1: clear ClothesRecolor / ClothesHP / AccessoryHP / StripOnRipMap ...
				pd.ClothesRecolor           = {}
				pd.ClothesHP                = {}
				pd.AccessoryHP              = {}
				pd.StripOnRipMap            = {}
			end

			-- V4.5.65: YOUR body survives a bundle. Removing a bundle ran ResetBundleSettableFields (hard defaults), so the body you
			-- had set (breast / torso / arm / leg / butt types + scales, physics, tone, stiffness ...) was gone for good (krul:
			-- "if I wear a bundle and remove it, I never return to my original body"). applyBundle now snapshots these fields
			-- while NOTHING is worn; _replayBundleLayers puts them back once no layer is left. Only the body fields: catalog /
			-- clothing / HP tables are bundle content and still reset.
			local _BODY_KEYS = { "BreastsType", "TorsoType", "ArmType", "LegsType", "ButtType", "BreastsScale", "ButtsScale", "LegsScale",
				"CockScale", "BodyPartPhysics", "Tone", "RealtimeBodyTransparency", "Face", "AccessorySizeLock", "PhysicsObeyGravity",
				"Volume", "NippleColor", "SmartBoneEnabled", "MeshSizeLock", "MeshBasePartInvisible", "BreathingEnabled", "OvertoneEnabled",
				"BreathingAmplitude", "OvertoneAmplitude", "BodyTransparency", "BreastsStiffness", "BreastsDamping", "ButtsStiffness",
				"ButtsDamping", "CockStiffness", "CockDamping", "BundleBodyColor",
				-- V4.5.69 (krul: removing a bundle must give back YOUR look, the values you had before wearing it): the rest of
				-- what ResetBundleSettableFields wipes that is yours, not bundle content: catalog items you wore before, first
				-- person / head tracking, HP feel. Tables are deep-copied (catalog taps mutate them in place).
				"FPerson", "FPsnap", "HeadTracking", "TearParticles", "HealParticles", "HardcoreHP", "DamageSFX",
				"CatalogAccessory", "CatalogTail", "CatalogRemove", "CatalogClothes", "CatalogBundleId", "CatalogOutfitId", "CatalogUserSnapshot" }
			local function _snapCopy(v, depth)
				if type(v) ~= "table" or depth > 4 then return v end
				local o = {}
				for k2, v2 in pairs(v) do o[k2] = _snapCopy(v2, depth + 1) end
				return o
			end
			function Function.BodySnapshot(pd)
				local s = {}
				for _, k in ipairs(_BODY_KEYS) do s[k] = _snapCopy(pd[k], 0) end  -- nil stays nil: "key absent" restores as absent
				return s
			end
			function Function.BodyRestore(pd, s)
				if type(s) ~= "table" then return end
				for _, k in ipairs(_BODY_KEYS) do pd[k] = _snapCopy(s[k], 0) end
				pd.NippleColorFromBundle = false
			end

			-- Inline reproduction of the original scrubClothState(cloth) (orig L26218-26237):
			-- clear stale per-cloth ClothesHP / ClothesRecolor / StripOnRipMap so a re-equip or
			-- bundle swap never re-fires a dead inverse-HP entry. cloth==nil => full scrub.
			local function _scrubCloth(pd, cloth)
				if not pd then return end
				if cloth == nil then
					pd.ClothesHP = {}; pd.AccessoryHP = {}; pd.ClothesRecolor = {}; pd.StripOnRipMap = {}
				else
					if pd.ClothesHP then pd.ClothesHP[cloth] = nil end
					if pd.ClothesRecolor then pd.ClothesRecolor[cloth] = nil end
					if pd.StripOnRipMap then pd.StripOnRipMap[cloth] = nil end
				end
			end

			-- Returns a sorted array of {name, hidden, krulHosted, equipped}. The GUI skips
			-- `hidden` entries (orig L4531 / L8959: Breast Clothes SB1/SB2 are exposed via the
			-- BreastsCover cycle, not the Clothes tab) and applies tab/search itself. Sorted by
			-- name to match the original button sort (orig L27422-27424 / L33625).
			System.getClothesList = function()
				local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
				local pd = PlayerData[sp]
				local equipped = {}
				if pd and pd.CurrentClothes then
					for _, n in ipairs(pd.CurrentClothes) do equipped[n] = true end
				end
				local out = {}
				if Clothes then
					for name, def in pairs(Clothes) do
						-- guard the sentinel "nil" key + non-table garbage; mirror the builder's skip set
						if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "nil" and type(def) == "table" and not (System.isCockItem and System.isCockItem(name)) then  -- V4.5.77: cock items are picked in Body > Body Types
							out[#out+1] = {
								name = name,
								hidden = def.Hidden == true,
								krulHosted = def.KrulHosted == true,
								equipped = equipped[name] == true,
							}
						end
					end
				end
				table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end)
				return out
			end

			-- V4.5.59 CLOTHES PREVIEWS ("see the meshes"): a model for a Clothes-tab thumbnail = a blocky R6 dummy (with a
			-- Humanoid, so 2D Shirt/Pants render on it) wearing the cloth. 3D clothes: every PartList entry in the cloth's
			-- Weld list, built like Function.Weld (MeshPart via GetAsset -> CachedCreateMeshPartAsync, CFrame =
			-- body * C0 * C1:Inverse(), entry Size/Colour/Texture). KrulHosted 2D clothes: the PNG as a Shirt or Pants.
			-- Cached per cloth (callers get a :Clone()); yields on cold meshes; nil when there is nothing to show.
			System._clothPrevCache = System._clothPrevCache or {}
			-- the blocky R6 preview dummy (Torso at the origin), shared by the cloth previews and the bundle mannequin so their
			-- cloth parts line up when combined. Returns model, { partName = Part }.
			System._previewDummy = function(skin)
				local m = Instance.new("Model"); m.Name = "ClothPreview"
				local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid"); hum.RigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
				hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None; hum.Parent = m
				local body = {}
				for nm, s in pairs({ Head = { Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), Vector3.new(2, 1, 1) }, Torso = { Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Vector3.new(2, 2, 1) },
					["Left Arm"] = { Vector3.new(-1.5, 0, 0), Vector3.new(1, 2, 1) }, ["Right Arm"] = { Vector3.new(1.5, 0, 0), Vector3.new(1, 2, 1) },
					["Left Leg"] = { Vector3.new(-0.5, -2, 0), Vector3.new(1, 2, 1) }, ["Right Leg"] = { Vector3.new(0.5, -2, 0), Vector3.new(1, 2, 1) } }) do
					local p = Instance.new("Part"); p.Name = nm; p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.Size = s[2]
					p.CFrame = CFrame.new(s[1]); p.Color = skin; p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
					p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth; p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth; p.Parent = m
					body[nm] = p
				end
				local hm = Instance.new("SpecialMesh"); hm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Head; hm.Scale = Vector3.new(1.25, 1.25, 1.25); hm.Parent = body.Head
				local face = Instance.new("Decal"); face.Name = "face"; face.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/face.png"; face.Parent = body.Head
				m.PrimaryPart = body.Torso
				return m, body
			end

			-- V4.5.62 BUNDLE MANNEQUIN for the Bundles-tab preview: the preview dummy WEARING the bundle. RoClothes clothing =
			-- each cloth's preview parts merged onto one dummy (same layout, so they line up); Roblox items (Clothes shirt/pants,
			-- Accessory + TailAccessory ids, catalog items, and the items of a saved Roblox outfit id) = game:GetObjects, attached
			-- at the matching R6 attachment like the engine does; body colours from Body Color / SkinTone (else the outfit's).
			-- Body-type meshes are not built (that needs the full character pipeline). Cached per bundle def (a re-saved bundle
			-- is a new def table); loaded catalog objects are cached per id. Yields; returns a Model clone or nil.
			System._bundlePrevCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			System._prevObjCache = System._prevObjCache or {}
			System.getBundleMannequin = function(name)
				local def = type(Bundle) == "table" and Bundle[name] or nil
				if type(def) ~= "table" then return nil end
				local hit = System._bundlePrevCache[def]
				if hit then return hit:Clone() end
				local P = type(def.Preset) == "table" and def.Preset or {}
				local BODY = { Head = "Head", Torso = "Torso", LeftArm = "Left Arm", RightArm = "Right Arm", LeftLeg = "Left Leg", RightLeg = "Right Leg",
					["Left Arm"] = "Left Arm", ["Right Arm"] = "Right Arm", ["Left Leg"] = "Left Leg", ["Right Leg"] = "Right Leg" }
				local m, body = System._previewDummy(typeof(def.SkinTone) == "Color3" and def.SkinTone or Color3.fromRGB(248, 215, 195))
				-- RoClothes clothing (mesh pieces / KrulHosted 2D) from the per-cloth previews
				if type(def.Clothing) == "table" then
					for _, cn in pairs(def.Clothing) do
						local ok, cm = pcall(System.getClothPreview, cn)
						if ok and cm then
							for _, ch in ipairs(cm:GetChildren()) do
								if not (ch:IsA("Humanoid") or BODY[ch.Name]) then ch.Parent = m end
							end
							cm:Destroy()
						end
					end
				end
				-- Roblox items
				local ids, seen = {}, {}
				local function addId(v)
					local n = tonumber(v) or (type(v) == "table" and tonumber(v.id or v.Id or v.AssetId)) or nil
					if n and n > 0 and not seen[n] and #ids < 16 then seen[n] = true; ids[#ids + 1] = n end
				end
				local function addAll(t) if type(t) == "table" then for _, v in pairs(t) do addId(v) end else addId(t) end end
				local C = type(def.Clothes) == "table" and def.Clothes or {}
				local CC = type(P.CatalogClothes) == "table" and P.CatalogClothes or {}
				addId(C.Shirt); addId(C.Pants); addId(CC.Shirt); addId(CC.Pants); addId(CC.ShirtGraphic)
				addAll(def.Accessory); addAll(def.TailAccessory); addAll(P.CatalogAccessory); addAll(P.CatalogTail)
				local outfitColors
				if tonumber(P.CatalogOutfitId) then
					pcall(function()
						local hd = game:GetService("Players"):GetHumanoidDescriptionFromOutfitId(tonumber(P.CatalogOutfitId))
						addId(hd.Shirt); addId(hd.Pants); addId(hd.GraphicTShirt)
						for _, a in ipairs(hd:GetAccessories(true)) do addId(a.AssetId) end
						outfitColors = { Head = hd.HeadColor, Torso = hd.TorsoColor, LeftArm = hd.LeftArmColor, RightArm = hd.RightArmColor, LeftLeg = hd.LeftLegColor, RightLeg = hd.RightLegColor }
					end)
				end
				local loaded, pending = {}, 0
				for i, id in ipairs(ids) do
					local c = System._prevObjCache[id]
					if c ~= nil then loaded[i] = c or nil else
						pending += 1
						task.spawn(function()
							local objs = (Function._catGetObjects and Function._catGetObjects(id)) or {}
							local o = Function._catFindDesc and (Function._catFindDesc(objs, "Accessory") or Function._catFindDesc(objs, "Clothing") or Function._catFindDesc(objs, "ShirtGraphic"))
							System._prevObjCache[id] = o or false
							loaded[i] = o
							pending -= 1
						end)
					end
				end
				local t0 = os.clock()
				while pending > 0 and os.clock() - t0 < 10 and System._sessionAlive ~= false do task.wait(0.05) end
				pcall(Function.AttachmentCreate, m)
				local hasShirt, hasPants = false, false
				for i = 1, #ids do
					local tpl = loaded[i]
					if tpl then pcall(function()
						local o = tpl:Clone()
						if o:IsA("Accessory") then
							local h = o:FindFirstChild("Handle")
							if not h or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer", true) then o:Destroy(); return end  -- layered clothing needs a cage rig
							for _, d in ipairs(o:GetDescendants()) do
								if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint") then d:Destroy() end
							end
							local att = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
							local target
							if att then for _, bp in pairs(body) do local a = bp:FindFirstChild(att.Name); if a then target = a; break end end end
							if target then
								h.CFrame = target.WorldCFrame * att.CFrame:Inverse()
							elseif not att then  -- legacy hat: AttachmentPoint relative to the head top
								h.CFrame = body.Head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0) * o.AttachmentPoint:Inverse()
							else o:Destroy(); return end  -- R15-only attachment: no place for it on the R6 dummy
							h.Anchored = true; h.CanCollide = false; h.CanQuery = false; h.CanTouch = false
							o.Parent = m
						elseif o:IsA("Shirt") then
							if hasShirt then o:Destroy(); return end
							for _, x in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do if x:IsA("Shirt") then x:Destroy() end end
							hasShirt = true; o.Parent = m
						elseif o:IsA("Pants") then
							if hasPants then o:Destroy(); return end
							for _, x in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do if x:IsA("Pants") then x:Destroy() end end
							hasPants = true; o.Parent = m
						elseif o:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then o.Parent = m
						else o:Destroy() end
					end) end
				end
				-- body colours: the bundle's own, else the outfit's (SkinTone already tinted the dummy)
				local cols = (type(def["Body Color"]) == "table" and next(def["Body Color"]) and def["Body Color"]) or (typeof(def.SkinTone) ~= "Color3" and outfitColors) or nil
				if cols then for k, c in pairs(cols) do local p = BODY[k] and body[BODY[k]]; if p and typeof(c) == "Color3" then p.Color = c end end end
				if System._sessionAlive == false then m:Destroy(); return nil end
				System._bundlePrevOrder = System._bundlePrevOrder or {}
				local ord = System._bundlePrevOrder
				ord[#ord + 1] = def
				while #ord > 6 do local d0 = table.remove(ord, 1); local m0 = System._bundlePrevCache[d0]; if m0 then pcall(function() m0:Destroy() end) end; System._bundlePrevCache[d0] = nil end
				System._bundlePrevCache[def] = m
				return m:Clone()
			end

			System.getClothPreview = function(name)
				local def = Clothes and Clothes[name]
				if type(def) ~= "table" then return nil end
				local cached = System._clothPrevCache[name]
				if cached then return cached:Clone() end
				if not System._previewPL then
					local ok, d = pcall(Function.PartListDefault); if not ok or type(d) ~= "table" then return nil end
					System._previewPL = d
				end
				local PL = System._previewPL
				local pdx = PlayerData[Player.Name]
				local skin = (pdx and typeof(pdx.SkinTone) == "Color3" and pdx.SkinTone) or Color3.fromRGB(248, 215, 195)
				local m, body = System._previewDummy(skin)
				local any = false
				if def.KrulHosted and type(def.LocalPath) == "string" then
					local okA, tex = pcall(System.getcustomasset or getcustomasset, def.LocalPath)
					if okA and type(tex) == "string" and tex ~= "" then
						local c = Instance.new(def.ClothType == "Pants" and "Pants" or "Shirt")
						if c:IsA("Shirt") then c.ShirtTemplate = tex else c.PantsTemplate = tex end
						c.Parent = m; any = true
					end
				elseif type(def.Weld) == "table" then
					for _, key in pairs(def.Weld) do
						local e = type(key) == "string" and PL[key]
						if type(e) == "table" then
							pcall(function()
								local parentName = type(e.Parent) == "table" and e.Parent[1] or "Torso"
								parentName = (System.R15ToR6Name and System.R15ToR6Name[parentName]) or parentName
								local base = body[parentName] or body.Torso
								local part
								local meshId = e.MeshId
								if e.Instance == "Mesh" and type(meshId) == "string" and meshId ~= "" and meshId ~= "Parent" then
									local resolved = Function.GetAsset and Function.GetAsset(meshId) or meshId
									part = Function.CachedCreateMeshPartAsync(resolved, Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box, Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance)
									if not part then
										part = Instance.new("Part")
										local sm = Instance.new("SpecialMesh"); sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh; sm.MeshId = resolved; sm.Parent = part
									end
									if type(e.TextureId) == "string" and e.TextureId ~= "" and part:IsA("MeshPart") then
										part.TextureID = Function.GetAsset and Function.GetAsset(e.TextureId) or e.TextureId
									end
								elseif e.Instance == "Part" then
									part = Instance.new("Part")
									if typeof(e.Shape) == "EnumItem" then part.Shape = e.Shape end
								end
								if not part then return end
								for _, d in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do if not (d:IsA("SpecialMesh") or d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")) then d:Destroy() end end
								part.Anchored = true; part.CanCollide = false; part.CanQuery = false; part.CanTouch = false
								if typeof(e.Size) == "Vector3" then part.Size = e.Size end
								local col = type(e.Color) == "table" and e.Color.Color
								part.Color = (typeof(col) == "Color3" and col) or skin
								if typeof(e.Material) == "EnumItem" then part.Material = e.Material end
								part.Transparency = tonumber(e.Transparency) or 0
								local c0 = typeof(e.CFrame) == "CFrame" and e.CFrame or CFrame.new()
								local c1 = typeof(e.CFrame1) == "CFrame" and e.CFrame1 or CFrame.new()
								part.CFrame = base.CFrame * c0 * c1:Inverse()
								part.Parent = m; any = true
							end)
						end
					end
				end
				if not any then m:Destroy(); return nil end
				System._clothPrevCache[name] = m
				return m:Clone()
			end

			System.isClothEquipped = function(name)
				local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
				local pd = PlayerData[sp]
				if not (pd and pd.CurrentClothes and name) then return false end
				return table.find(pd.CurrentClothes, name) ~= nil
			end

			-- Clear the shared KrulType pending markers (used when the GUI KrulType modal is
			-- cancelled, so the engine's own popup path -- which reads the same locals at
			-- L23299-23304 -- is not left armed).
			System.clearClothPending = function()
				_pendingKrulCloth = nil; _pendingKrulPlayer = nil
			end

			-- A KrulHosted cloth always asks Shirt/Pants on equip (orig L33604 comment: "Always
			-- ask shirt or pants even if previously chosen -- lets user change type"). Non-Krul
			-- clothes equip directly via toggleCloth. The GUI calls this BEFORE toggling so it
			-- can route an equip-from-unequipped through the KrulType modal instead.
			System.clothNeedsType = function(name)
				return Clothes ~= nil and Clothes[name] ~= nil and Clothes[name].KrulHosted == true
			end

			-- Equip / unequip a (non-KrulHosted) cloth, reproducing the original click handler
			-- 1:1 (orig L4538-4609): toggle membership in pd.CurrentClothes; on equip set up the
			-- recolor flag (Weld part has PartList[w].Recolor), blacklist removal (+scrub), and the
			-- cycle-format default HP; on unequip scrub state. Then re-render recolor (guarded --
			-- the renderer is Phase 7, absent today) and hotSwap (engine reset->execute pipeline).
			-- Returns the new equipped boolean (true=now on) so the GUI can paint the badge.
			System.toggleCloth = function(name)
				local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
				local pd = PlayerData[sp]
				if not (pd and name and Clothes and Clothes[name]) then return nil end
				if not pd.CurrentClothes then pd.CurrentClothes = {} end
				if not pd.ClothesHP then pd.ClothesHP = {} end
				if not pd.ClothesRecolor then pd.ClothesRecolor = {} end
				local nowEquipped
				if not table.find(pd.CurrentClothes, name) then
					-- Equip path (orig L4543-4593)
					table.insert(pd.CurrentClothes, name)
					if Clothes[name].Weld then
						-- flag a recolor row if any welded part is recolourable (orig L4549-4556)
						for _, w in pairs(Clothes[name].Weld) do
							if PartList and PartList[w] and PartList[w].Recolor then
								if not pd.ClothesRecolor[name] then pd.ClothesRecolor[name] = {} end
								break
							end
						end
						-- blacklist removal + scrub (orig L4558-4572)
						if Clothes[name]["Blacklist"] then
							for _, b in pairs(Clothes[name]["Blacklist"]) do
								local idx = table.find(pd.CurrentClothes, b)
								if idx then
									table.remove(pd.CurrentClothes, idx)
									_scrubCloth(pd, b)
								end
							end
							pd._equippedSetSrc = nil  -- orig L4571: force equipped-set cache rebuild
						end
						-- reset then apply default HP in cycle-format (orig L4577-4592)
						pd.ClothesHP[name] = nil
						if Clothes[name]["HP"] then
							local _hp = Clothes[name].HP
							if _hp == 1 then pd.ClothesHP[name] = {HP = "TopHP",    Inverse = false}
							elseif _hp == 2 then pd.ClothesHP[name] = {HP = "BottomHP", Inverse = false}
							elseif _hp == 3 then pd.ClothesHP[name] = {HP = "TopHP",    Inverse = true}
							elseif _hp == 4 then pd.ClothesHP[name] = {HP = "BottomHP", Inverse = true}
							elseif _hp ~= 0 then pd.ClothesHP[name] = {HP = "TopHP",    Inverse = false}
							end
						end
					end
					nowEquipped = true
				else
					-- Unequip path (orig L4595-4603)
					-- V4.5.24 Fix: table.remove inside pairs() over the same array is UB (can skip/
					-- revisit entries). Reverse-ordered numeric loop keeps remove-then-break safe.
					for j = #pd.CurrentClothes, 1, -1 do
						if pd.CurrentClothes[j] == name then
							table.remove(pd.CurrentClothes, j)
							_scrubCloth(pd, name)
							break
						end
					end
					nowEquipped = false
				end
				-- orig tail L4606-4609: renderRecolorList + renderHPList (Phase 7, now wired via the
				-- GUI's registered callbacks; still guarded so the headless engine never nil-calls) +
				-- hotSwap. GUIUpdate is removed -> not called.
				if System.renderRecolorList then pcall(System.renderRecolorList) end
				if System.renderHPList then pcall(System.renderHPList) end
				if hotSwap then hotSwap() end
				return nowEquipped
			end
			-- V4.5.77 COCK TYPE BEGIN
			-- The cock is a Body type (krul): Body > Body Types > Cock. The 9 items stay clothing under the hood
			-- (build, physics, HP, Avatar Sync unchanged) but are picked there and hidden from the Clothes list.
			-- Old bundles / synced looks need no field: the worn item IS the type; CockNormalize keeps one.
			System.COCK_TYPES = { "Cock", "BBC Cock", "BBC Cock w/ Easter Ball Paint", "Horse Cock", "Furry Knot", "Retracted Knot", "Furry Knot [NEON]", "Retracted Knot [NEON]" }
