						local ok, res = pcall(reqFunc, {
							Url = "https://krulhub.dev/roclothes/submit",
							Method = "POST",
							Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
							Body = body,
						})
						if ok and res and tonumber(res.StatusCode) and tonumber(res.StatusCode) >= 200 and tonumber(res.StatusCode) < 300 then
							return "Submitted for review!"
						end
						if ok and res and tonumber(res.StatusCode) == 429 then  -- V4.5.19: tonumber, matching the 2xx check one line up
							return "Rate-limited -- try again shortly"
						end
						warn("[RoClothes] Submit non-2xx/transport: " .. tostring(res and (res.StatusCode or res) or res))
						-- V4.5.59: say WHY instead of "Submit failed (see console)" for every refusal (players could not tell a
						-- duplicate from a too-big bundle from a bad name, so "some bundles fail to upload" had no next step).
						if not (ok and res) then return "Submit failed -- no connection to KrulHub" end
						local _code = tonumber(res.StatusCode) or 0
						local _okJ, _j = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, tostring(res.Body or ""))
						local _err = (_okJ and type(_j) == "table" and tostring(_j.error or "")) or ""
						local _detail = (_okJ and type(_j) == "table" and _j.detail ~= nil) and tostring(_j.detail):sub(1, 80) or nil
						if _err == "duplicate" then
							local _of = (_okJ and type(_j) == "table" and tostring(_j.existingId or "")) or ""
							if _of:find("^published:") then return "Already in the community list as \"" .. _of:sub(11) .. "\"" end
							return "Not sent: a bundle with the same name or the same outfit is already waiting for review or approved"
						elseif _err == "invalid_submission" then
							if #name > 64 then return "Not sent: the bundle name is too long (64 characters max)" end
							if #body > 60000 then return "Not sent: this bundle is too big to upload (" .. math.floor(#body / 1024) .. " KB, max 64 KB)" end
							return "Not sent: the server could not read this bundle"
						elseif _err == "bad_bundle" or _err == "bad_bundle_shape" then
							return "Not sent: this bundle has data the server does not accept" .. (_detail and (" (" .. _detail .. ")") or "")
						elseif _err == "body_too_large" or _code == 413 then
							return "Not sent: this bundle is too big to upload (" .. math.floor(#body / 1024) .. " KB)"
						elseif _err == "version_outdated" then
							return "Not sent: update RoClothes first"
						elseif _err == "submissions_frozen" or _err == "queue_full" or _code == 503 then
							return "Submissions are paused right now -- try again later"
						end
						return "Submit failed (HTTP " .. tostring(_code) .. (_err ~= "" and (", " .. _err) or "") .. ")"
					end
					return "Unknown export mode"
				end

				-- IMPORT ---------------------------------------------------------------
				-- Reproduces the original import pipeline (orig L29171-29468), trapped in the
				-- deleted GUI: accepts a URL (http... -> GET + JSONDecode + rehydrate) OR a Lua
				-- table literal (size-capped, prefix-gated, sandboxed loadstring with a safelist
				-- env). Validates each bundle (Clothing/Recolor/MeshEdit/HPClothes refs + a
				-- recognized-field gate), skips duplicates, and stages survivors into
				-- System._pendingImports for the Save Bundle modal to finalize (Private = disk;
				-- Community = disk + submit). Returns a status table:
				--   { ok=bool, status=string, pending=int }
				-- so the GUI can show the message and open the Save Bundle modal when pending>0.
				System._pendingImports = System._pendingImports or {}
				System.importBundle = function(text)
					if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then
						return { ok = false, status = "Paste a bundle table or a URL.", pending = 0 }
					end
					-- reset pending queue each paste (orig L29242)
					System._pendingImports = {}
					local fromURL, urlOutput = false, nil
					if text:sub(1, 4) == "http" then
						local reqFunc = _reqFn()
						if not reqFunc then
							return { ok = false, status = "http_request not supported on this executor", pending = 0 }
						end
						local ok, res = pcall(reqFunc, { Url = text, Method = "GET" })
						if not (ok and res and tonumber(res.StatusCode) == 200) then
							return { ok = false, status = ok and ("HTTP error: " .. tostring(res and res.StatusCode)) or "URL fetch failed", pending = 0 }
						end
						if type(res.Body) ~= "string" or #res.Body > 524288 then
							return { ok = false, status = "Response too large (max 512 KB)", pending = 0 }
						end
						local decodeOk, decoded = pcall(function() return HS:JSONDecode(res.Body) end)
						if not (decodeOk and type(decoded) == "table") then
							return { ok = false, status = "URL response is not valid JSON", pending = 0 }
						end
						pcall(function() decoded = rehydrate(decoded) end)
						fromURL, urlOutput = true, decoded
					end

					local success, output
					if fromURL then
						success, output = true, urlOutput
					else
						if #text > 262144 then
							return { ok = false, status = "Paste too large or empty (max 256 KB)", pending = 0 }
						end
						-- prefilter: must look like a table literal (orig L29260)
						if not (text:match("^%s*{") or text:match("^%s*return%s+{")
							or text:match("^%s*local%s+import%s*=%s*{") or text:match("^%s*%[")
							or text:match("^%s*[%w_]+%s*=%s*{")) then
							return { ok = false, status = "Paste must be a bundle table literal (starts with '{' or 'return {')", pending = 0 }
						end
						-- V4.5.24 Fix: getgenv() can return nil/false on some executors - `getgenv().loadstring` ...
						local _ls
						local _gok, _g = pcall(function() return getgenv and getgenv() end)
						_ls = (_gok and type(_g) == "table" and _g.loadstring) or loadstring
						if not _ls then return { ok = false, status = "loadstring unavailable on this executor", pending = 0 } end
						-- V4.5.69: no instruction limit is possible here (Luau has no debug hook), so a paste with a loop
						-- (`while true do end`) froze the game for good. Bundle tables never need code: outside strings and
						-- comments, reject loops / functions. string.rep / table.create could still allocate gigabytes and the real
						-- math / string / table were handed over as-is (writable on some executors), so the sandbox gets small copies.
						do
							local out, i, n = {}, 1, #text
							while i <= n do
								local c = text:sub(i, i)
								local lb = text:match("^%[(=*)%[", i)
								if c == "-" and text:sub(i + 1, i + 1) == "-" then
									local clb = text:match("^%-%-%[(=*)%[", i)
									if clb then
										local _, e = text:find("]" .. clb .. "]", i + 4 + #clb, true); i = (e or n) + 1
									else
										local e = text:find("\n", i, true); i = (e or n) + 1
									end
								elseif lb then
									local _, e = text:find("]" .. lb .. "]", i + 2 + #lb, true); i = (e or n) + 1; out[#out + 1] = " 0 "
								elseif c == '"' or c == "'" then
									local j = i + 1
									while j <= n do
										local d = text:sub(j, j)
										if d == "\\" then j = j + 2 elseif d == c or d == "\n" then break else j = j + 1 end
									end
									i = j + 1; out[#out + 1] = " 0 "
								else
									out[#out + 1] = c; i = i + 1
								end
							end
							local code = table.concat(out)
							for _, kw in ipairs({ "while", "repeat", "for", "function", "goto" }) do
								if code:find("%f[%w_]" .. kw .. "%f[^%w_]") then
									return { ok = false, status = "Paste contains code ('" .. kw .. "'); only bundle tables can be imported.", pending = 0 }
								end
							end
						end
						local function _pick(src, keys) local o = {}; for _, k in ipairs(keys) do o[k] = src[k] end; return o end
						-- safelist sandbox env (orig L29269-29282)
						local _sandbox = {
							Color3 = Color3, Vector3 = Vector3, Vector2 = Vector2,
							CFrame = CFrame, UDim = UDim, UDim2 = UDim2,
							Enum = Enum, BrickColor = BrickColor,
							NumberRange = NumberRange, NumberSequence = NumberSequence,
							ColorSequence = ColorSequence,
							NumberSequenceKeypoint = NumberSequenceKeypoint,
							ColorSequenceKeypoint = ColorSequenceKeypoint,
							Rect = Rect, Region3 = Region3,
							tonumber = tonumber, tostring = tostring,
							pairs = pairs, ipairs = ipairs, next = next,
							type = type, typeof = typeof, select = select,
							math = _pick(math, { "abs", "floor", "ceil", "min", "max", "clamp", "huge", "pi", "rad", "deg", "sqrt", "round" }),
							string = _pick(string, { "format", "sub", "char", "byte", "lower", "upper", "len" }),
							table = _pick(table, { "insert", "concat", "unpack", "pack" }),
						}
						success, output = pcall(function()
							local _chunk, _err = _ls(text)
							if not _chunk then error(_err or "loadstring failed") end
							local _sfOk = pcall(setfenv, _chunk, _sandbox)
							if not _sfOk then error("setfenv failed -- refusing to run unsandboxed chunk") end
							return _chunk()
						end)
						if not success then
							-- second try: wrap as a record (orig L29297-29306)
							local reFormat = "local import = {" .. text .. "} return import"
							success, output = pcall(function()
								local _chunk, _err = _ls(reFormat)
								if not _chunk then error(_err or "loadstring failed") end
								local _sfOk = pcall(setfenv, _chunk, _sandbox)
								if not _sfOk then error("setfenv failed -- refusing to run unsandboxed chunk") end
								return _chunk()
							end)
						end
					end

					if not success then
						return { ok = false, status = tostring(output), pending = 0 }
					end
					if type(output) ~= "table" then
						return { ok = false, status = "Not a bundle. Paste a Lua bundle table.", pending = 0 }
					end
					local _hasAny = false
					for _ in pairs(output) do _hasAny = true; break end
					if not _hasAny then
						return { ok = false, status = "Empty input -- no bundles found in pasted text.", pending = 0 }
					end

					-- per-bundle validation (orig L29338-29434). Reads Clothes / MetaClothes /
					-- _RoClothesData.PartListDefault -- all in scope here.
					local allBundlesSuccess = true
					local s2 = pcall(function()
						for name, input in pairs(output) do
							if type(input) ~= "table" then
								allBundlesSuccess = false; warn("Bundle '" .. tostring(name) .. "' is not a table -- skipped."); continue
							end
							local invalidBundle = false
							local function bWarn(reason) invalidBundle = true; warn(reason) end
							if input["Clothing"] then
								for _, v in pairs(input["Clothing"]) do
									if not (Clothes and Clothes[v]) then bWarn(name .. ": Could not find " .. tostring(v) .. " as Clothing.") end
								end
							end
							if input["Recolor"] then
								for i, v in pairs(input["Recolor"]) do
									if Clothes and Clothes[i] then
										for cType in pairs(v) do
											if cType ~= "Primary" and cType ~= "Secondary" and cType ~= "Tertiary" then
												bWarn(name .. ": " .. tostring(cType) .. " is not a valid color type.")
											end
										end
									else
										bWarn(name .. ": Recolor could not find " .. tostring(i) .. " as Clothing.")
									end
								end
							end
							if input["MeshEdit"] then
								for i, v in pairs(input["MeshEdit"]) do
									if _RoClothesData and _RoClothesData.PartListDefault and _RoClothesData.PartListDefault[i] then
										for property in pairs(v) do
											if not (MetaClothes and MetaClothes.__index and MetaClothes.__index[property]) then
												bWarn(name .. ": " .. tostring(property) .. " is not a valid property.")
											end
										end
									else
										bWarn(name .. ": MeshEdit does not register " .. tostring(i) .. " as a valid part.")
									end
								end
							end
							if input["HPClothes"] then
								for i, v in pairs(input["HPClothes"]) do
									if Clothes and Clothes[i] then
										for property in pairs(v) do
											if property ~= "HP" and property ~= "Inverse"
												and property ~= "Threshold" and property ~= "Type" then
												bWarn(name .. ": " .. tostring(property) .. " isn't registered. Use HP/Threshold/Inverse/Type only.")
											end
										end
									else
										bWarn(name .. ": HPClothes could not find " .. tostring(i) .. " as Clothing.")
									end
								end
							end
							-- recognized-field gate (orig L29408-29415)
							if not input["Clothing"] and not input["Recolor"] and not input["MeshEdit"]
								and not input["HPClothes"] and not input["Preset"]
								and not input["AccessoryHP"] and not input["GizmoOffsets"]
								and not input["Body Color"] and not input["NippleColor"]
								and not input["SkinTone"] and not input["TClothes"]
								and not input["Accessory"] and not input["Clothes"] then
								bWarn(name .. ": no recognized bundle fields -- not a valid RoClothes bundle.")
							end
							if invalidBundle then
								allBundlesSuccess = false
								warn(" Bundle " .. tostring(name) .. " has been aborted! ")
								continue
							end
							if Bundle[name] then
								allBundlesSuccess = false
								warn("Bundle '" .. tostring(name) .. "' already exists -- skipped. Delete it first to re-import.")
								continue
							end
							input.Personal = true
							table.insert(System._pendingImports, { name = name, input = input })
						end
					end)
					if not s2 then
						return { ok = false, status = "Import failed (see console)", pending = 0 }
					end
					local pendingN = #System._pendingImports
					if pendingN > 0 then
						return {
							ok = true,
							status = allBundlesSuccess and "Bundle(s) parsed -- choose where to save"
								or "Some errors found. Choose where to save the rest",
							pending = pendingN,
						}
					elseif allBundlesSuccess then
						return { ok = true, status = "Nothing new to import (all duplicates?)", pending = 0 }
					else
						return { ok = false, status = "Errors found. Check Developer Console.", pending = 0 }
					end
				end

				-- finalize an imported bundle to disk (orig _writeImportedBundleToDisk L27844-27898):
				-- deep-copy, convertToJSON each leaf, stamp BundleName, atomic-write, un-blocklist.
				local function _writeImportedToDisk(name, input)
					if not (env and env.writefile) then return false end
					local t = {}
					local function transfer(n, isNested)
						local newT = {}
						for i, v in pairs(n) do
							if isNested then
								if typeof(v) == "table" then newT[i] = transfer(v, true) else newT[i] = v end
							else
								if typeof(v) == "table" then t[i] = transfer(v, true) else t[i] = v end
							end
						end
						return newT
					end
					transfer(input)
					local function convert(inp)
						for i, v in pairs(inp) do
							if typeof(v) == "table" then convert(v)
							else inp[i] = Function.convertToJSON(v) end
						end
					end
					convert(t)
					t["BundleName"] = name
					local _safe = _bsanitize(name)
					local _wrOk = _atomicWriteJSON("RClothesLerp/Bundles/" .. _safe .. ".json", t)
					if not _wrOk then return false end
					-- un-blocklist if re-saving a previously-deleted name (orig L27880-27894)
					pcall(function()
						local _list = _readDeleted()
						if #_list == 0 then return end
						local _filtered, _removed = {}, false
						for _, _n in ipairs(_list) do
							if _n ~= name then table.insert(_filtered, _n) else _removed = true end
						end
						if _removed then _atomicWriteJSON("RClothesLerp/DeletedBundles.json", _filtered) end
					end)
					return _wrOk
				end

				-- register an imported bundle in-memory (orig _finalizeImport L27939-27980, minus
				-- the GUI button build -- the merged GUI re-renders tiles from Bundle on demand).
				local function _registerImport(name, input)
					Bundle[name] = input
				end

				-- submit an imported bundle to the community queue (orig _submitImportedBundleToCommunity
				-- L27901-27934).
				local function _submitImported(name, input)
					local reqFunc = _reqFn()
					if not reqFunc then return false end
					local lp = PS.LocalPlayer
					local payload = {
						name = name,
						bundle = dehydrate(input),
						scriptVersion = VersionInternal,
						manifestVersion = System.ManifestVersion or "unknown",
						submitter = { userId = lp and lp.UserId or 0, displayName = lp and lp.DisplayName or "Unknown" },
					}
					local okEnc, body = pcall(HS.JSONEncode, HS, payload)
					if not okEnc then return false end
					local ok, res = pcall(reqFunc, {
						Url = "https://krulhub.dev/roclothes/submit", Method = "POST",
						Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }, Body = body,
					})
					return ok and res and tonumber(res.StatusCode) and tonumber(res.StatusCode) >= 200 and tonumber(res.StatusCode) < 300 or false
				end

				-- Save Bundle modal "Save Private" (orig L28024-28040): write each pending bundle to
				-- disk + register it. Returns a status string. Clears the queue.
				System.finalizeImportPrivate = function()
					local pending = System._pendingImports or {}
					local n = 0
					local failed = {}
					for _, p in ipairs(pending) do
						_registerImport(p.name, p.input)
						if _writeImportedToDisk(p.name, p.input) then
							n = n + 1
						else
							table.insert(failed, p)
						end
					end
					if Function.compileOvertime then pcall(Function.compileOvertime) end
					System._pendingImports = failed
					if hotSwap then hotSwap() end
					if #failed > 0 then
						return "Saved " .. n .. " private; " .. #failed .. " memory-only: disk write FAILED. Retry Save Private."
					end
					return n > 0 and ("Saved " .. n .. " private!") or "Nothing to save"
				end

				-- Save Bundle modal "Submit Community" (orig L28041-28113): save locally first,
				-- then submit; append accepted names to MySubmissions.json. Returns a status string.
				System.finalizeImportCommunity = function()
					local pending = System._pendingImports or {}
					local remaining = {}
					local ok, fail, diskFail, indexFail = 0, 0, 0, 0
					for _, p in ipairs(pending) do
						_registerImport(p.name, p.input)
						local diskOK = _writeImportedToDisk(p.name, p.input)
						if not diskOK then diskFail = diskFail + 1 end
						local _submit = {}
						for k, vv in pairs(p.input) do _submit[k] = vv end
						_submit.Personal = false
						if p.communitySubmitted or _submitImported(p.name, _submit) then
							p.communitySubmitted = true
							ok = ok + 1
							-- append to MySubmissions.json (orig L28076-28099)
							local indexOK, indexSaved = pcall(function()
								if not (env and env.writefile) then return false end
								local _list = {}
								if env.isfile and env.readfile and env.isfile("RClothesLerp/MySubmissions.json") then
									local _okR, _raw = pcall(env.readfile, "RClothesLerp/MySubmissions.json")
									if _okR and type(_raw) == "string" and #_raw > 0 then
										local _okD, _dec = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, _raw)
										if _okD and type(_dec) == "table" then _list = _dec end
									end
								end
								local _seen = false
								for _, _n in ipairs(_list) do if _n == p.name then _seen = true; break end end
								if not _seen then
									table.insert(_list, p.name)
									return _atomicWriteJSON("RClothesLerp/MySubmissions.json", _list)
								end
								return true
							end)
							p.communityIndexed = indexOK and indexSaved == true
							if not p.communityIndexed then indexFail = indexFail + 1 end
						else
							fail = fail + 1
						end
						if not diskOK or not p.communitySubmitted or not p.communityIndexed then table.insert(remaining, p) end
					end
					System._pendingImports = remaining
					if Function.compileOvertime then pcall(Function.compileOvertime) end
					if hotSwap then hotSwap() end
					if diskFail > 0 then
						return "Submitted " .. ok .. ", " .. fail .. " submission failed; " .. diskFail .. " memory-only: disk write FAILED. Retry Submit Community."
					end
					if indexFail > 0 then
						return "Submitted " .. ok .. ", " .. fail .. " submission failed; " .. indexFail .. " submission index write FAILED. Retry Submit Community."
					end
					if fail == 0 then return "Submitted " .. ok .. " for review!" end
					return "Submitted " .. ok .. ", " .. fail .. " failed (see console)"
				end

				-- Save Bundle modal "Cancel" (orig L28114-28122): discard everything.
				System.cancelImport = function()
					System._pendingImports = {}
					return "Import cancelled"
				end

				-- REDOWNLOAD -----------------------------------------------------------
				-- Re-fetch personal bundles from disk: delete the BundleLoader.json cache + each
				-- on-disk per-bundle file is the original's "redownload" of LOCAL bundles. Since
				-- local bundles ARE the on-disk JSONs, a faithful "redownload" here = drop the
				-- cache so the on-disk loader (orig L20162-20576) rebuilds from RClothesLerp/Bundles
				-- on the next execute, AND re-instate manifest bundles (Clear-style) so the user's
				-- community list refreshes from _RoClothesData.Bundle live. Returns a status string.
				-- NOTE: full asset/mesh redownload is the separate Options "Redownload All Content"
				-- (System.doRedownload, P4); this is the BUNDLE-list refresh only.
				System.redownloadBundles = function()
					-- drop the quick-load cache so disk is re-read next session (orig L20426 / L27709 style)
					pcall(function()
						if env.delfile and env.isfile and env.isfile("RClothesLerp/BundleLoader.json") then
							env.delfile("RClothesLerp/BundleLoader.json")
						end
					end)
					-- re-instate any manifest bundles missing from the live table (so a stale in-memory
					-- delete/edit doesn't hide community bundles after a refresh)
					local restored = 0
					if _RoClothesData and _RoClothesData.Bundle and type(Bundle) == "table" then
						local _subs = _mySubsSet()
						local _deletedSet = {}
						for _, n in ipairs(_readDeleted()) do _deletedSet[n] = true end
						for _bN, _bV in pairs(_RoClothesData.Bundle) do
							if Bundle[_bN] == nil and type(_bV) == "table" and not _deletedSet[_bN] then
								Bundle[_bN] = _bV
								if _bV.IsPreset ~= true and _bV.ClothingBundle ~= true then
									_bV.Personal = _subs[_bN] == true
								end
								restored = restored + 1
							end
						end
					end
					return "Bundle list refreshed (" .. restored .. " re-added). Restart to re-read disk."
				end

				do
					-- V4.5.33 (krul): EVERY browsable Roblox marketplace category, grouped like the site (live ...

						{label = "Accessories",         cat = 11, sub = nil, ats = {8, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47}},
						{label = "Hats",                cat = 11, sub = 54, ats = {8}},
						{label = "Face Accessories",    cat = 11, sub = 21, ats = {42}},
						{label = "Neck Accessories",    cat = 11, sub = 22, ats = {43}},
						{label = "Shoulder Accessories", cat = 11, sub = 23, ats = {44}},
						{label = "Front Accessories",   cat = 11, sub = 24, ats = {45}},
						{label = "Back Accessories",    cat = 11, sub = 25, ats = {46}},
						{label = "Waist Accessories",   cat = 11, sub = 26, ats = {47}},
						{label = "Gear",                cat = 11, sub = 5,  ats = {19}},
						{label = "All Animations",      cat = 12, sub = nil, ats = {61}, bts = {2}},
						{label = "Animation Bundles",   cat = 12, sub = 38, ats = nil, bts = {2}},
						{label = "Emotes",              cat = 12, sub = 39, ats = {61}},
					}
					-- Return a fresh copy each call so the GUI can hold it without aliasing the
					-- bridge's table. (label/cat/sub/ats per row; ats is itself copied.)
					System.getCatalogCats = function()
						local out = {}
						for i, c in ipairs(_CB_CATS) do
							local _ats
							if c.ats then _ats = {} for _, a in ipairs(c.ats) do table.insert(_ats, a) end end
							local _bts
							if c.bts then _bts = {} for _, b in ipairs(c.bts) do table.insert(_bts, b) end end
							out[i] = {label = c.label, cat = c.cat, sub = c.sub, ats = _ats, bts = _bts}
						end
						return out
					end

					-- Page fetch. Thin wrapper over Function.CatalogFetchPage (orig L16265) with
					-- the EXACT original signature/argument order (orig _CB_loadPage L25186-25191):
					--   CatalogFetchPage(category, subcategory, assetTypes, keyword, cursor, limit, filters)
					-- cat = {cat=,sub=,ats=} descriptor (a row from getCatalogCats); filters =
					-- {freeOnly=,minPrice=,maxPrice=,creator=}. The CALLER (GUI) owns the task.spawn +
					-- in-flight gate + cursor stack -- this is a synchronous (yielding) data call that
					-- never blocks the engine. Returns items[], nextCursor, errMsg (CatalogFetchPage's
					-- own contract; native path returns a per-page "NEXT<n>" sentinel cursor, while
					-- worker cursors are internally tagged so their opaque values cannot be mistaken
					-- for native sentinels. The bridge unwraps before building the HTTP request.
					System.catalogLoadPage = function(cat, keyword, cursor, filters)
						cat = cat or _CB_CATS[1]
						if not (Function and Function.CatalogFetchPage) then return nil, nil, "no CatalogFetchPage" end
						-- V4.5.33: a row's bundle types ride in a COPY of filters (no fetch-signature change; the GUI's
						-- filters table is never mutated). Included in the page-cache key.
						if cat.bts then
							local _f = {}; for k, v in pairs(filters or {}) do _f[k] = v end
							_f.bundleTypes = cat.bts; filters = _f
						end
						local ok, items, nxt, err = pcall(Function.CatalogFetchPage,
							cat.cat, cat.sub, cat.ats, keyword or "", cursor or "", 30, filters)
						if not ok then return nil, nil, tostring(items) end
						return items, nxt, err
					end

					-- Per-asset detail fetch (orig L16360). Returns {name, price, assetType} or nil.
					-- Used by the GUI to async-fill cells whose name/price/type the page response
					-- did not include. Yields; the caller spawns it.
					System.catalogItemDetails = function(id)
						if not (Function and Function.CatalogFetchAssetDetails) then return nil end
						local ok, d = pcall(Function.CatalogFetchAssetDetails, id)
						if not ok then return nil end
						return d
					end

					-- V4.5.68 (krul: the By ID tab is barely used, only username search): the catalog Search box finds PEOPLE too.
					-- Roblox user search (fuzzy, ranked) through the same executor HTTP path as the catalog; the exact username,
					-- if it exists, is always first. Returns { {id, name, displayName}, ... } (max 10).
					System.catalogSearchUsers = function(keyword)
						keyword = tostring(keyword or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
						if #keyword < 3 or #keyword > 50 then return {} end
						local q = HS:UrlEncode(keyword)
						local d = Function.CatalogHttpGet("https://users.roproxy.com/v1/users/search?keyword=" .. q .. "&limit=10")
						if not (type(d) == "table" and type(d.data) == "table") then
							d = Function.CatalogHttpGet("https://users.roblox.com/v1/users/search?keyword=" .. q .. "&limit=10")
						end
						local out = {}
						if type(d) == "table" and type(d.data) == "table" then
							for _, u in ipairs(d.data) do
								if tonumber(u.id) and type(u.name) == "string" and #out < 10 then
									out[#out + 1] = { id = tonumber(u.id), name = u.name, displayName = (type(u.displayName) == "string" and u.displayName ~= "") and u.displayName or u.name }
								end
							end
						end
						if keyword:match("^[%w_]+$") and #keyword <= 20 then
							local okI, uid = pcall(PS.GetUserIdFromNameAsync, PS, keyword)
							if okI and tonumber(uid) then
								for i, u in ipairs(out) do if u.id == uid then table.remove(out, i); break end end
								local okN, nm = pcall(PS.GetNameFromUserIdAsync, PS, uid)
								table.insert(out, 1, { id = uid, name = okN and nm or keyword, displayName = okN and nm or keyword })
								if #out > 10 then table.remove(out) end
							end
						end
						return out
					end

					-- V4.5.68: wear ANY id typed / pasted into the catalog Search box: an asset (shirt, pants, T-shirt, accessory,
					-- head, face...), else a bundle, else an outfit. kind "bundle" / "asset" comes from a pasted catalog link.
					-- Returns ok, message.
					System.catalogSmartId = function(id, kind)
						local n = tonumber(id)
						if not n or n <= 0 or n >= 2^53 or n ~= math.floor(n) then return false, "That is not a valid ID." end
						local sid = tostring(n)
						if kind ~= "bundle" then
							local d = System.catalogItemDetails and System.catalogItemDetails(n)
							local at = d and tonumber(d.assetType)
							if not at then
								local okP, info = pcall(MPS.GetProductInfo, MPS, n)
								if okP and type(info) == "table" then at = tonumber(info.AssetTypeId); d = d or { name = info.Name } end
							end
							if at then
								System.catalogLastError = nil
								local r = System.catalogApplyItem and System.catalogApplyItem({ id = sid, itemType = "Asset", assetType = at, name = d and d.name })
								if r == "equipped" or r == "unequipped" then return true, ((r == "equipped") and "Wearing " or "Removed ") .. tostring(d and d.name or sid) end
								return false, System.catalogLastError or "That item can't be worn."
							end
						end
						if kind ~= "asset" then
							local okB, det = pcall(function() return game:GetService("AssetService"):GetBundleDetailsAsync(n) end)
							if okB and type(det) == "table" then
								System.catalogLastError = nil
								local r = System.catalogApplyItem and System.catalogApplyItem({ id = sid, itemType = "Bundle", name = det.Name })
								if r == "equipped" or r == "unequipped" then return true, ((r == "equipped") and "Wearing " or "Removed ") .. tostring(det.Name or sid) end
								return false, System.catalogLastError or "That bundle can't be worn."
							end
						end
						if kind == nil then
							local okO = pcall(function() return PS:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromOutfitId(n) end)
							if okO and System.setCatalogString then
								System.setCatalogString("CatalogOutfitId", sid)
								return true, "Wearing outfit " .. sid
							end
						end
						return false, "No wearable item, bundle or outfit has that ID."
					end

					-- Equipped-state detection (orig _cb_isEquipped L24543-24565). True when the item
					-- is currently applied via one of pd's catalog fields. Routes by assetType through
					-- Function.CatalogIsAccessoryAssetType (orig L16409). pd defaults to the active player.
					local function _catIsEquipped(item, pd)
						pd = pd or PlayerData[(System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name]
						if not pd or not item or not item.id then return false end
						if item.itemType == "Bundle" and Function._catLive.anim and Function._catLive.anim.id == tostring(item.id) then return true end
						if item.itemType ~= "Bundle" and Function._catLive then
							local _idn = tonumber(item.id)
							if item.assetType == 61 then local e = Function._catLive.emote; return e ~= nil and e.id == _idn and e.track.IsPlaying end
							if item.assetType == 19 then local g = Function._catLive.gear[_idn]; return g ~= nil and g.Parent ~= nil end
						end
						if item.itemType == "Bundle" then
							-- V4.5.33: Shoes bundles are equipped as their accessory assets (see the equip path); they count as
							-- equipped while every one of those ids is in CatalogAccessory. Session cache, filled on equip.
							local _parts = Function._catBundleParts and Function._catBundleParts[tostring(item.id)]
							if _parts then
								if not pd.CatalogAccessory or #_parts == 0 then return false end
								for _, _pid in ipairs(_parts) do
									local _has = false
									for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogAccessory) do if tonumber(v) == _pid then _has = true; break end end
									if not _has then return false end
								end
								return true
							end
							local bundleIdentity = (pd.CatalogBundleId and pd.CatalogBundleId ~= "") and pd.CatalogBundleId or pd.CatalogOutfitId
							return tostring(bundleIdentity or "") == tostring(item.id)
						end
						local atyp = item.assetType
						local idNum = tonumber(item.id)
						if not idNum then return false end
						-- V4.5.59: catalog listings give assetType as a STRING ("Hat", "HairAccessory") or nil; only a
						-- tapped tile got a numeric type (fetched on equip). Switching tabs rebuilt tiles from a fresh
						-- listing and the equipped highlight vanished. Asset ids are unique, so match by id in every slot.
						if type(atyp) ~= "number" then
							local cc = pd.CatalogClothes
							if type(cc) == "table" then
								for _, f in ipairs({ "Shirt", "Pants", "ShirtGraphic", "Face" }) do
									if tonumber(cc[f]) == idNum then return true end
								end
							end
							for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogAccessory or {}) do
								if tonumber(v) == idNum then return true end
							end
							return false
						end
						if atyp == 11 then
							return tonumber(pd.CatalogClothes and pd.CatalogClothes.Shirt) == idNum
						elseif atyp == 12 then
							return tonumber(pd.CatalogClothes and pd.CatalogClothes.Pants) == idNum
						elseif atyp == 2 then
							return tonumber(pd.CatalogClothes and pd.CatalogClothes.ShirtGraphic) == idNum
						elseif atyp == 18 then
							return tonumber(pd.CatalogClothes and pd.CatalogClothes.Face) == idNum
						elseif Function.CatalogIsAccessoryAssetType and Function.CatalogIsAccessoryAssetType(atyp) then
							if not pd.CatalogAccessory then return false end
							for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogAccessory) do
								if tonumber(v) == idNum then return true end
							end
						end
						return false
					end
					System.catalogIsEquipped = function(item)
						return _catIsEquipped(item, nil)
					end

					-- recently-equipped history push (orig _cb_pushHistory L24853-24866): cap 20, dedup by id.
					local function _catPushHistory(pd, item)
						if not (pd and item and item.id) then return end
						pd.CatalogHistory = pd.CatalogHistory or {}
						for i = #pd.CatalogHistory, 1, -1 do
							if pd.CatalogHistory[i] and pd.CatalogHistory[i].id == item.id then
								table.remove(pd.CatalogHistory, i)
							end
						end
						table.insert(pd.CatalogHistory, 1, {
							id = item.id, name = item.name, assetType = item.assetType,
							itemType = item.itemType, priceInRobux = item.priceInRobux,
						})
						while #pd.CatalogHistory > 20 do table.remove(pd.CatalogHistory) end
					end

					-- Apply a tapped catalog item (orig _cb_applyTap L24868-25102). Routes through
					-- PlayerData[sp] + the hotSwap pipeline (NO parallel apply system). Same-item tap
					-- UNEQUIPS. The original also poked the now-deleted GUIObject.Catalog_3 list /
					-- OutfitIdTextbox / per-player removal buttons -- those are gone with the old GUI;
					-- the merged Equipped sidebar rebuilds from PD on the GUI's re-render, so only the
					-- PD mutations + hotSwap are reproduced here. Returns "equipped"/"unequipped"/false.
					-- V4.5.33: live (non-PD) catalog items - animation packs, emotes, gear. They act on the LOCAL player's ...
					Function._catLive = Function._catLive or { anim = nil, emote = nil, gear = {} }
					Function._catAnimSlots = { "idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "fall", "climb", "swim", "swimidle" }
					function Function._catGetObjects(id)
						local ok, objs = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)) end)
						return (ok and type(objs) == "table") and objs or {}
					end
					function Function._catFindDesc(objs, cls)
						for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
							if o:IsA(cls) then return o end
							local d = o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(cls, true); if d then return d end
						end
					end
					-- Write {slot -> {{name, animId}, ...}} into the character's Animate values and restart it. nil = restore
					-- the snapshot taken the first time this Animate was touched (stored as an attribute on it).
					function Function._catAnimWrite(char, slots)
						local an = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate"); if not an then return false end
						local HSv = game:GetService("HttpService")
						if not an:GetAttribute("_RC_AnimOrig") then
							local snap = {}
							for _, slot in ipairs(Function._catAnimSlots) do
								local sv = an:FindFirstChild(slot)
								if sv then local t = {}; for _, a in ipairs(sv:GetChildren()) do if a:IsA("Animation") then t[#t + 1] = { a.Name, a.AnimationId } end end; snap[slot] = t end
							end
							an:SetAttribute("_RC_AnimOrig", HSv:JSONEncode(snap))
						end
						if not slots then local ok, d = pcall(HSv.JSONDecode, HSv, an:GetAttribute("_RC_AnimOrig")); slots = ok and d or {} end
						-- V4.5.59 (synced players saw your OLD animations stuck, blended with the new pack): this used to rewrite the
						-- AnimationId of the very Animation objects the playing tracks came from, THEN stop the tracks. Proven on two
						-- live clients: a stop sent after its Animation's id changed never reaches other players, so the old idle
						-- (and the previous pack) kept looping at full weight on everyone else's screen, forever. Now: stop first,
						-- let the stops replicate, REPLACE (never mutate) the Animation objects, restart Animate, then clear any
						-- ghosts an older version left (others match tracks by animation id: a fresh play+stop of that id ends it).
						local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
						local oldIds, newIds = {}, {}
						for _, list in pairs(slots) do for _, e in ipairs(list) do newIds[tostring(e[2])] = true end end
						if animator then
							for _, t in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
								pcall(function() oldIds[t.Animation.AnimationId] = true; t:Stop(0.1) end)
							end
						end
						for slot in pairs(slots) do
							local sv = an:FindFirstChild(slot)
							if sv then for _, a in ipairs(sv:GetChildren()) do if a:IsA("Animation") then oldIds[a.AnimationId] = true end end end
						end
						task.wait(0.15)  -- the stops leave with their ORIGINAL ids before anything below changes
						for slot, list in pairs(slots) do
							local sv = an:FindFirstChild(slot)
							if sv and #list > 0 then
								local anims = {}; for _, a in ipairs(sv:GetChildren()) do if a:IsA("Animation") then anims[#anims + 1] = a end end
								for i, e in ipairs(list) do
									local a = Instance.new("Animation"); a.Name = e[1]; a.AnimationId = e[2]
									local w = anims[i] and anims[i]:FindFirstChild("Weight")  -- keep the slot's idle weighting, as the in-place edit did
									if w then w:Clone().Parent = a end
									a.Parent = sv
								end
								for _, old in ipairs(anims) do old:Destroy() end
							end
						end
						an.Disabled = true; task.defer(function() if an.Parent then an.Disabled = false end end)
						if animator then
							task.delay(0.4, function()
								for id in pairs(oldIds) do
									if not newIds[id] and animator.Parent then
										pcall(function()
											local a = Instance.new("Animation"); a.AnimationId = id
											local t = animator:LoadAnimation(a); t:Play(0, 0.001); task.wait(); t:Stop(0); a:Destroy()
										end)
									end
								end
							end)
						end
						return true
					end
					-- Resolve an animation bundle to per-slot ids: its UserOutfit HD built on an R15 model carries a
					-- fully resolved Animate script (asset ids -> real animation ids), which is exactly what we need.
					function Function._catAnimResolve(outfitId)
						local hd = game:GetService("Players"):GetHumanoidDescriptionFromOutfitId(outfitId)
						local m = game:GetService("Players"):CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(hd, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
						local an = m and m:FindFirstChild("Animate"); local out = {}
						if an then for _, slot in ipairs(Function._catAnimSlots) do
							local sv = an:FindFirstChild(slot)
							if sv then local t = {}; for _, a in ipairs(sv:GetChildren()) do if a:IsA("Animation") then t[#t + 1] = { a.Name, a.AnimationId } end end; out[slot] = t end
						end end
						if m then m:Destroy() end; pcall(function() hd:Destroy() end)
						return out
					end
					-- Re-apply the chosen pack after a respawn (Animate is rebuilt with the avatar's own animations).
					if not Function._catAnimRespawnConn then
						Function._catAnimRespawnConn = Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
							local pack = Function._catLive.anim; if not pack then return end
							local an = c:WaitForChild("Animate", 10)
							if an and Function._catLive.anim == pack then task.wait(0.5); pcall(Function._catAnimWrite, c, pack.slots) end
						end)
						pcall(function() if System.GlobalMaid and System.GlobalMaid.Give then System.GlobalMaid:Give(Function._catAnimRespawnConn) end end)
					end
					-- V4.5.33: failures carry a user-facing reason (System.catalogLastError) so the grid can toast it.
					function Function._catFail(msg)
						System.catalogLastError = msg
						warn("[RoClothes] " .. msg)
						return false
					end
					-- V4.5.59 (mobile catalog lag): every catalog tap ran a FULL avatar rebuild (CharacterReset +
					-- CharacterExecute: ~13 RoClothes meshes, layered clothing, physics) straight away, so tapping
					-- through items on a phone stacked one heavy rebuild per tap. On touch devices the rebuild now
					-- waits until taps stop for 0.35s and runs once with the last choice. Desktop is unchanged.
					function Function._catHotSwap()
						if not hotSwap then return end
						if not (UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled) then hotSwap(); return end
						Function._catSwapTok = (Function._catSwapTok or 0) + 1
						local tok = Function._catSwapTok
						task.delay(0.35, function() if Function._catSwapTok == tok then hotSwap() end end)
					end
					-- V4.5.68 (krul: unequipping a catalog HEAD made the bundle's shirt / pants vanish): heads are dynamic-head
					-- BUNDLES, and a catalog bundle unequip dropped "Roblox Shirt"/"Roblox Pants" even when the worn RoClothes
					-- bundle is what turned them on. Keep a toggle that any worn bundle layer lists in its Clothing.
					-- V4.5.69: shared with the Equipped drawer's Remove / Remove all (they never dropped the toggles, so the
					-- meshes kept painting the avatar's own shirt / pants after the catalog item was gone).
					function Function._catDropCloth(pd, name)
						if not pd then return end
						for _, n in pairs({ pd.CurrentBundle, pd.CurrentPreset, table.unpack(pd.CurrentClothingBundles or {}) }) do
							local b = type(n) == "string" and type(Bundle) == "table" and Bundle[n]
							if type(b) == "table" and type(b.Clothing) == "table" and table.find(b.Clothing, name) then return end
						end
						if pd.CurrentClothes then
							local _idx = table.find(pd.CurrentClothes, name)
							if _idx then table.remove(pd.CurrentClothes, _idx) end
						end
					end
					System.catalogApplyItem = function(item)
						System.catalogLastError = nil
						if type(item) ~= "table" then return false end
						local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
						local pd = PlayerData[sp]
						if not pd then return false end
						-- Pre-details guard (orig L24873-24880): sync-fetch assetType for a non-Bundle item.
						if item.itemType ~= "Bundle" and type(item.assetType) ~= "number" then
							local ok, d = pcall(Function.CatalogFetchAssetDetails, item.id)
							if ok and d then
								if d.name then item.name = d.name end
								if d.price then item.priceInRobux = d.price end
								if d.assetType then item.assetType = d.assetType end
							end
						end
						-- pre-warm the asset-type cache so the apply pipeline skips the MPS timeout (orig L24886-24888).
		if item.itemType ~= "Bundle" and type(item.assetType) == "number" and Function._catalogAssetTypeCache then
			Function._catalogTypeCachePut(item.id, item.assetType)
		end
						-- helper: keep "Roblox Shirt"/"Roblox Pants" toggles in CurrentClothes (orig _ensureCloth L25036).
						local function _ensureCloth(name)
							pd.CurrentClothes = pd.CurrentClothes or {}
							if not table.find(pd.CurrentClothes, name) then table.insert(pd.CurrentClothes, name) end
						end
						local function _removeFromCurrent(name) Function._catDropCloth(pd, name) end
						-- UNEQUIP path (orig L24889-24960): same-item tap clears its slot.
						if _catIsEquipped(item, pd) then
							local _bparts = item.itemType == "Bundle" and Function._catBundleParts and Function._catBundleParts[tostring(item.id)]
							if item.itemType == "Bundle" and Function._catLive.anim and Function._catLive.anim.id == tostring(item.id) then
								Function._catLive.anim = nil
								pcall(Function._catAnimWrite, Player.Character, nil)  -- restore the avatar's own animations
								return "unequipped"
							elseif item.itemType ~= "Bundle" and item.assetType == 61 then
								local e = Function._catLive.emote; Function._catLive.emote = nil
								if e then pcall(function() e.track:Stop() end) end
								return "unequipped"
							elseif item.itemType ~= "Bundle" and item.assetType == 19 then
								local g = Function._catLive.gear[tonumber(item.id)]; Function._catLive.gear[tonumber(item.id)] = nil
								if g then pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end
								return "unequipped"
							elseif _bparts then
								for _, _pid in ipairs(_bparts) do
									for i = #(pd.CatalogAccessory or {}), 1, -1 do if tonumber(pd.CatalogAccessory[i]) == _pid then table.remove(pd.CatalogAccessory, i) end end
								end
							elseif item.itemType == "Bundle" then
								pd.CatalogOutfitId = ""
								pd.CatalogBundleId = ""
								pd.CatalogRemove = {}
								_removeFromCurrent("Roblox Shirt")
								_removeFromCurrent("Roblox Pants")
							else
								local atyp = item.assetType
								-- V4.5.68: Shirt and T-shirt graphic share the "Roblox Shirt" toggle: drop it only when NEITHER is left
								local function _catSet(k) local v = pd.CatalogClothes and pd.CatalogClothes[k]; return v ~= nil and v ~= "" and v ~= 0 end
								if atyp == 11 then
									if pd.CatalogClothes then pd.CatalogClothes.Shirt = "" end
									if not _catSet("ShirtGraphic") then _removeFromCurrent("Roblox Shirt") end
								elseif atyp == 12 then
									if pd.CatalogClothes then pd.CatalogClothes.Pants = "" end
									_removeFromCurrent("Roblox Pants")
								elseif atyp == 2 then
									if pd.CatalogClothes then pd.CatalogClothes.ShirtGraphic = "" end
									if not _catSet("Shirt") then _removeFromCurrent("Roblox Shirt") end
								elseif atyp == 18 then
									if pd.CatalogClothes then pd.CatalogClothes.Face = "" end
								elseif Function.CatalogIsAccessoryAssetType and Function.CatalogIsAccessoryAssetType(atyp) then
									local idNum = tonumber(item.id)
									if pd.CatalogAccessory and idNum then
										for i, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogAccessory) do
											if tonumber(v) == idNum then table.remove(pd.CatalogAccessory, i); break end
										end
									end
								end
							end
							Function._catHotSwap()
							return "unequipped"
						end
						-- EQUIP path.
						if item.itemType == "Bundle" then
							local bundleId = tonumber(item.id)
							if not bundleId then return false end
							local okDetails, details = pcall(function()
								return game:GetService("AssetService"):GetBundleDetailsAsync(bundleId)
							end)
							if not okDetails or type(details) ~= "table" or type(details.Items) ~= "table" then
								return Function._catFail("Bundle details could not be loaded - try again.")
							end
							-- V4.5.33: animation packs replace the local character's Animate animations (R15 avatars only - catalog
							-- packs are R15 animations). Resolved via the bundle's UserOutfit on a throwaway R15 model.
							if tostring(details.BundleType) == "AvatarAnimations" or tostring(details.BundleType) == "Animations" then
								if sp ~= Player.Name then return Function._catFail("Animation packs only work on your own avatar.") end
								local char = Player.Character; local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
								if not hum or hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then return Function._catFail("Animation packs need an R15 avatar.") end
								local _oid
								for _, bundleItem in ipairs(details.Items) do
									local _tn = tostring(bundleItem and bundleItem.Type or "")
									if _tn == "UserOutfit" or _tn:match("%.UserOutfit$") then _oid = tonumber(bundleItem.Id); break end
								end
								if not _oid then return Function._catFail("This animation pack could not be read.") end
								local okR, slots = pcall(Function._catAnimResolve, _oid)
								if not okR or type(slots) ~= "table" or next(slots) == nil then return Function._catFail("This animation pack could not be loaded.") end
								Function._catLive.anim = { id = tostring(bundleId), slots = slots, name = item.name }
								if not Function._catAnimWrite(char, slots) then return false end
								_catPushHistory(pd, item)
								return "equipped"
							end
							-- V4.5.33: a Shoes bundle is ADDED to the current look as its shoe accessories (asset items), not
							-- applied as its outfit - the outfit path replaced the whole look and the shoes never landed.
							if tostring(details.BundleType) == "Shoes" then
								local _tc = Function.ResolveTargetChar and Function.ResolveTargetChar(sp)
								local _th = _tc and _tc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
								if _th and _th.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then return Function._catFail("Shoes are layered clothing - they need an R15 avatar.") end
								local _ids = {}
								for _, bundleItem in ipairs(details.Items) do
									local _t = bundleItem and bundleItem.Type
									local _tn = (typeof(_t) == "EnumItem" and _t.Name) or tostring(_t or "")
									local _n = tonumber(bundleItem.Id)
									if (_tn == "Asset" or _tn:match("%.Asset$")) and _n then _ids[#_ids + 1] = _n end
								end
								if #_ids == 0 then return Function._catFail("These shoes could not be read.") end
								if PlayerData[sp] ~= pd or ((System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name) ~= sp then return false end
								Function._catBundleParts = Function._catBundleParts or {}
								Function._catBundleParts[tostring(bundleId)] = _ids
								pd.CatalogAccessory = pd.CatalogAccessory or {}
								for _, _n in ipairs(_ids) do
									local _dup = false
									for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogAccessory) do if tonumber(v) == _n then _dup = true; break end end
									if not _dup then table.insert(pd.CatalogAccessory, _n) end
								end
								_catPushHistory(pd, item)
								Function._catHotSwap()
								return "equipped"
							end
							-- V4.5.73: a Full Body bundle lists TWO outfits, the full body and a head-only one, in no guaranteed order.
							-- Take the one that carries body parts (else the first, as before).
							local outfitId
							local _outfits = {}
							for _, bundleItem in ipairs(details.Items) do
								local itemType = bundleItem and bundleItem.Type
								local typeName = (typeof(itemType) == "EnumItem" and itemType.Name) or tostring(itemType or "")
								if typeName == "UserOutfit" or typeName:match("%.UserOutfit$") then
									local _n = tonumber(bundleItem.Id)
									if _n then _outfits[#_outfits + 1] = _n end
								end
							end
							outfitId = _outfits[1]
							if #_outfits > 1 then
								for _, _oid in ipairs(_outfits) do
									local _okH, _h = pcall(function() return game:GetService("Players"):GetHumanoidDescriptionFromOutfitId(_oid) end)
									if _okH and _h and (_h.Torso ~= 0 or _h.LeftArm ~= 0 or _h.RightArm ~= 0 or _h.LeftLeg ~= 0 or _h.RightLeg ~= 0) then outfitId = _oid; break end
								end
							end
							if PlayerData[sp] ~= pd or ((System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name) ~= sp then return false end
							if not outfitId or outfitId <= 0 then
								return Function._catFail("This bundle has no wearable outfit.")
							end
							_ensureCloth("Roblox Shirt")
							_ensureCloth("Roblox Pants")
							pd.CatalogBundleId = tostring(bundleId)
							pd.CatalogOutfitId = tostring(outfitId)
							pd.FullBodyMesh = nil  -- V4.5.73: a new catalog look starts with the base torso / arm / leg meshes hidden
							pd.CatalogRemove = {}
						else
							local atyp = item.assetType
							if atyp == 11 then
								pd.CatalogClothes = pd.CatalogClothes or {}
								pd.CatalogClothes.Shirt = tostring(item.id)
								_ensureCloth("Roblox Shirt")
							elseif atyp == 12 then
								pd.CatalogClothes = pd.CatalogClothes or {}
								pd.CatalogClothes.Pants = tostring(item.id)
								_ensureCloth("Roblox Pants")
							elseif atyp == 2 then
								pd.CatalogClothes = pd.CatalogClothes or {}
								pd.CatalogClothes.ShirtGraphic = tostring(item.id)
								_ensureCloth("Roblox Shirt")
							elseif atyp == 18 then
								local id = tonumber(item.id)
								if not id or id <= 0 or id >= 2^53 or id ~= math.floor(id) then return false end
								pd.CatalogClothes = pd.CatalogClothes or {}
								pd.CatalogClothes.Face = tostring(id)
							elseif Function.CatalogIsAccessoryAssetType and Function.CatalogIsAccessoryAssetType(atyp) then
								if System.LayeredAccessoryEnum and System.LayeredAccessoryEnum[atyp] then
									local _tc = Function.ResolveTargetChar and Function.ResolveTargetChar(sp)
									local _th = _tc and _tc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
									if _th and _th.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then return Function._catFail("Layered clothing needs an R15 avatar.") end
								end
								pd.CatalogAccessory = pd.CatalogAccessory or {}
								local idNum = tonumber(item.id)
								local dup = false
								for _, existing in ipairs(pd.CatalogAccessory) do
									if tonumber(existing) == idNum then dup = true; break end
								end
								if not dup and idNum then table.insert(pd.CatalogAccessory, idNum) end
							elseif atyp == 61 or atyp == 19 then
								-- V4.5.33: emotes play once on your own character (animations on the local character replicate);
								-- gear goes into your Backpack and is equipped. Both load the asset via game:GetObjects.
								if sp ~= Player.Name then return Function._catFail("Emotes and gear only work on your own avatar.") end
								local char = Player.Character; local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
								if not hum then return false end
								local objs = Function._catGetObjects(item.id)
								if atyp == 61 then
									if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then return Function._catFail("Emotes need an R15 avatar.") end
									local anim = Function._catFindDesc(objs, "Animation")
									local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
									if not (anim and animator) then return Function._catFail("This emote could not be loaded on this executor.") end
									local prev = Function._catLive.emote; if prev then pcall(function() prev.track:Stop() end) end
									local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
									track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
									track:Play()
									Function._catLive.emote = { id = tonumber(item.id), track = track }
								else
									local tool = Function._catFindDesc(objs, "Tool")
									local bp = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
									if not (tool and bp) then return Function._catFail("This gear could not be loaded on this executor.") end
									for _, d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do if d.ClassName == "Script" then d:Destroy() end end  -- server Scripts can't run from a client copy
									local old = Function._catLive.gear[tonumber(item.id)]; if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end
									tool.Parent = bp
									Function._catLive.gear[tonumber(item.id)] = tool
									tool:SetAttribute("_RC_CatName", item.name)
									-- V4.5.35: holding / putting away / removing the gear changes what Avatar Sync shows peers
									tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function() if Function.AvatarSyncPublish then pcall(Function.AvatarSyncPublish, true) end end)
									pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(tool) end)
								end
								_catPushHistory(pd, item)
								return "equipped"
							else
								return Function._catFail("This item type can't be worn.")
							end
						end
						_catPushHistory(pd, item)
						Function._catHotSwap()
						return "equipped"
					end

					-- Equipped-sidebar data (orig _cb_renderEquippedPanel collect loop L24659-24677).
					-- Returns an array of {id, kind, slot} for every equipped catalog item.
					--   kind: "Bundle"/"Shirt"/"Pants"/"TShirt"/"Accessory"
					--   slot: "OutfitId"/"Shirt"/"Pants"/"ShirtGraphic"/"Accessory"
					-- The GUI resolves names via catalogItemDetails (cache-first) and filters client-side.
					System.getCatalogEquipped = function()
						local pd = PlayerData[(System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name]
						local out = {}
						if not pd then return out end
						if pd.CatalogOutfitId and pd.CatalogOutfitId ~= "" then
							local bundleIdentity = (pd.CatalogBundleId and pd.CatalogBundleId ~= "") and pd.CatalogBundleId or pd.CatalogOutfitId
							local n = tonumber(bundleIdentity)
							if n then table.insert(out, {id = n, kind = "Bundle", slot = "OutfitId"}) end
						end
						if pd.CatalogClothes then
							local s = tonumber(pd.CatalogClothes.Shirt)
							if s and s > 0 then table.insert(out, {id = s, kind = "Shirt", slot = "Shirt"}) end
							local p = tonumber(pd.CatalogClothes.Pants)
							if p and p > 0 then table.insert(out, {id = p, kind = "Pants", slot = "Pants"}) end
							local t = tonumber(pd.CatalogClothes.ShirtGraphic)
							if t and t > 0 then table.insert(out, {id = t, kind = "TShirt", slot = "ShirtGraphic"}) end
							local f = tonumber(pd.CatalogClothes.Face)
							if f and f > 0 then table.insert(out, {id = f, kind = "Face", slot = "Face"}) end
						end
						if pd.CatalogAccessory then
							for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogAccessory) do
								local n = tonumber(v)
								if n then table.insert(out, {id = n, kind = "Accessory", slot = "Accessory"}) end
							end
						end
						-- V4.5.33: live items (own avatar only) - animation pack + gear, with the names captured at equip time.
						if pd == PlayerData[Player.Name] and Function._catLive then
							local a = Function._catLive.anim
							if a then table.insert(out, {id = tonumber(a.id), kind = "Animation pack", slot = "AnimPack", name = a.name}) end
							for gid, tool in pairs(Function._catLive.gear) do
								if tool.Parent then table.insert(out, {id = gid, kind = "Gear", slot = "Gear", name = tool:GetAttribute("_RC_CatName")}) end
							end
						end
						return out
					end

					-- Remove one equipped catalog item by slot+id (orig X-button handler L24798-24841),
					-- then hotSwap. slot is one of OutfitId/Shirt/Pants/ShirtGraphic/Accessory.
					System.catalogRemoveEquipped = function(id, slot)
						local pd = PlayerData[(System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name]
						if not pd then return false end
						local idNum = tonumber(id)
						local function _catSet(k) local v = pd.CatalogClothes and pd.CatalogClothes[k]; return v ~= nil and v ~= "" and v ~= 0 end
						if slot == "OutfitId" then
							pd.CatalogOutfitId = ""
							pd.CatalogBundleId = ""
							pd.CatalogRemove = {}
							Function._catDropCloth(pd, "Roblox Shirt"); Function._catDropCloth(pd, "Roblox Pants")  -- V4.5.69
						elseif slot == "Shirt" then
							if pd.CatalogClothes then pd.CatalogClothes.Shirt = "" end
							if not _catSet("ShirtGraphic") then Function._catDropCloth(pd, "Roblox Shirt") end  -- V4.5.69
						elseif slot == "Pants" then
							if pd.CatalogClothes then pd.CatalogClothes.Pants = "" end
							Function._catDropCloth(pd, "Roblox Pants")  -- V4.5.69
						elseif slot == "ShirtGraphic" then
							if pd.CatalogClothes then pd.CatalogClothes.ShirtGraphic = "" end
							if not _catSet("Shirt") then Function._catDropCloth(pd, "Roblox Shirt") end  -- V4.5.69
						elseif slot == "Face" then
							if pd.CatalogClothes then pd.CatalogClothes.Face = "" end
						elseif slot == "AnimPack" then
							Function._catLive.anim = nil
							pcall(Function._catAnimWrite, Player.Character, nil)
							return true
						elseif slot == "Gear" then
							local g = Function._catLive.gear[idNum]; Function._catLive.gear[idNum] = nil
							if g then pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end
							return true
						elseif slot == "Accessory" then
							if pd.CatalogAccessory and idNum then
								for i, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogAccessory) do
									if tonumber(v) == idNum then table.remove(pd.CatalogAccessory, i); break end
								end
							end
						end
						if hotSwap then hotSwap() end
						return true
					end

					-- V4.5.33: "Remove all" for the Equipped drawer - clears every catalog slot (and the local live items) with ONE
					-- hotSwap instead of one rebuild per item.
					System.catalogRemoveAllEquipped = function()
						local pd = PlayerData[(System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name]
						if not pd then return false end
						pd.CatalogOutfitId = ""; pd.CatalogBundleId = ""; pd.CatalogRemove = {}
						if pd.CatalogClothes then for k in pairs(pd.CatalogClothes) do pd.CatalogClothes[k] = "" end end
						pd.CatalogAccessory = {}
						Function._catDropCloth(pd, "Roblox Shirt"); Function._catDropCloth(pd, "Roblox Pants")  -- V4.5.69: the toggles stayed on
						if pd == PlayerData[Player.Name] and Function._catLive then
							if Function._catLive.anim then Function._catLive.anim = nil; pcall(Function._catAnimWrite, Player.Character, nil) end
							for _, g in pairs(Function._catLive.gear) do pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end
							Function._catLive.gear = {}
						end
						if hotSwap then hotSwap() end
						return true
					end

					-- STRIP DEFAULT AVATAR (the 8-category boolean map; this is the P7-deferred
					-- catalog strip, orig L25439-25458). Toggle pd.StripCategories[cat] then live-update
					-- via Function.ApplyStripToLiveCharacter (NOT CharacterReset -- orig L25448-25453).
					-- getCatalogStrip returns the current bool map so the GUI paints active buttons red.

					-- V4.5.38: "YOUR AVATAR" section of the Wearing drawer - the wearer's OWN accessories (everything on the body
					-- that RoClothes did not add), each hideable per item. Replaces the 8 category buttons in the UI.
					System._avatarTarget = function()
						local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
						local pd = PlayerData[sp]
						local char
						pcall(function() char = Function.ResolveTargetChar and Function.ResolveTargetChar(sp) end)
						if not char then local plr = PS:FindFirstChild(sp); char = plr and plr.Character end
						return sp, pd, char
					end
					System.getAvatarItems = function()
						local sp, pd, char = System._avatarTarget()
						local out = {}
						if not (pd and char) then return out end
						local seen = {}
						local function add(acc, hidden)
							local skip = false
							pcall(function() skip = acc:GetAttribute("_RC_FromHD") == true or acc:HasTag(System.RCTag) end)
							if skip then return end
							local key = Function.StripItemKey(acc)
							if not key or seen[key] then return end
							seen[key] = true
							local at = "Accessory"
							pcall(function() at = acc.AccessoryType.Name end)
							if at == "Unknown" then  -- older accessories carry no type: name them by where they attach
								local _att = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle") and acc.Handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
								local _an = _att and _att.Name or ""
								at = (_an:find("^Hat") and "Hat") or (_an:find("^Hair") and "Hair") or (_an:find("^Face") and "Face")
									or (_an:find("^Neck") and "Neck") or (_an:find("Shoulder") and "Shoulder") or (_an:find("^BodyFront") and "Front")
									or (_an:find("^BodyBack") and "Back") or (_an:find("^Waist") and "Waist") or "Accessory"
							end
							local layered = false
							pcall(function() layered = acc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer", true) ~= nil end)
							out[#out + 1] = { key = key, inst = acc, type = at, layered = layered, hidden = hidden }
						end
						for _, ch in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if ch:IsA("Accessory") then add(ch, false) end end
						if type(pd._strippedAccessories) == "table" then
							for acc, owner in pairs(pd._strippedAccessories) do
								local pn = false
								pcall(function() pn = acc.Parent == nil end)
								if pn and (owner == char or owner == true) then add(acc, true) end
							end
						end
						-- catalog asset id (for the name): only where the type is unambiguous between the live items and the
						-- snapshot of the avatar taken before RoClothes touched it
						local byType, liveByType = {}, {}
						pcall(function()
							local hd = pd.OriginalHumanoidDescription
							if hd then
								for _, a in ipairs(hd:GetAccessories(true)) do
									local tn = a.AccessoryType and a.AccessoryType.Name or "Unknown"
									byType[tn] = byType[tn] or {}
									table.insert(byType[tn], a.AssetId)
								end
							end
						end)
						for _, it in ipairs(out) do liveByType[it.type] = (liveByType[it.type] or 0) + 1 end
						local idx = {}
						for _, it in ipairs(out) do
							local ids = byType[it.type]
							if ids and #ids == 1 and liveByType[it.type] == 1 then it.assetId = tonumber(ids[1]) end
							idx[it.type] = (idx[it.type] or 0) + 1
							it.label = (liveByType[it.type] > 1) and (it.type .. " " .. idx[it.type]) or it.type
						end
						return out
					end
					-- Fold a legacy category strip into per-item hides, so a tile hidden by a category can be shown again.
					System._avatarMigrateCats = function(pd, char)
						if not (pd and type(pd.StripCategories) == "table" and next(pd.StripCategories)) then return end
						pd.StripItems = pd.StripItems or {}
						pd._stripFromCats = pd._stripFromCats or {}  -- V4.5.59: these came from the BUNDLE's categories -> the next bundle apply drops them
						for _, it in ipairs(System.getAvatarItems()) do
							if Function.StripWants(pd, it.inst) and not pd.StripItems[it.key] then
								pd.StripItems[it.key] = true  -- exactly what the category strip hid
								pd._stripFromCats[it.key] = true
							end
						end
						pd.StripCategories = {}
					end
					System._avatarApply = function(sp, pd, char)
						pcall(Function.StripReconcile, pd, char)
						if sp == Player.Name and Function.AvatarSyncPublish then pcall(Function.AvatarSyncPublish, true) end
					end
					System.toggleAvatarItem = function(key)
						local sp, pd, char = System._avatarTarget()
						if not (pd and char and type(key) == "string") then return false end
						System._avatarMigrateCats(pd, char)
						pd.StripItems = pd.StripItems or {}
						pd.StripItems[key] = (not pd.StripItems[key]) or nil
						if pd._stripFromCats then pd._stripFromCats[key] = nil end  -- your own click: yours now, survives bundle applies
						System._avatarApply(sp, pd, char)
						return pd.StripItems[key] == true
					end
					System.setAllAvatarItems = function(hide)
						local sp, pd, char = System._avatarTarget()
						if not (pd and char) then return false end
						if hide then
							pd.StripItems = pd.StripItems or {}
							for _, it in ipairs(System.getAvatarItems()) do pd.StripItems[it.key] = true end
						else
							pd.StripItems = {}
							pd.StripCategories = {}
						end
						System._avatarApply(sp, pd, char)
						return true
					end

					-- SAVE OUTFIT --------------------------------------------------------
					-- Inline reproduction of the original _buildOutfitPreset (orig L28557-28803) --
					-- it was trapped in the deleted GUI and touches only PD + Function.* survivors,
					-- so the rules permit reproducing it inline. Captures the full preset payload
					-- (catalog fields, body types/scales, tone, HP, recolor, gizmo, physics, FPerson,
					-- mesh edits, etc.) so a saved/published outfit round-trips losslessly.
					local function _shallowClone(t) local _o = {}; for k, v in pairs(t) do _o[k] = v end; return _o end
					local function _depth2Clone(t) local _o = {}; for k, v in pairs(t) do _o[k] = (type(v) == "table") and _shallowClone(v) or v end; return _o end
					local function _dehydratePreset(t)
						if type(t) ~= "table" then return Function.convertToJSON(t) end
						local _o = {}
						for k, v in pairs(t) do
							if type(v) == "table" then _o[k] = _dehydratePreset(v)
							else _o[k] = Function.convertToJSON(v) end
						end
						return _o
					end
					local function _propsEqual(a, b)
						if type(a) ~= type(b) then return false end
						local _ta, _tb = typeof(a), typeof(b)
						if _ta ~= _tb then return false end
						if _ta == "Color3" or _ta == "Vector3" or _ta == "CFrame" or _ta == "UDim2" or _ta == "UDim" then
							return a == b
						end
						if type(a) == "table" then
							for k, v in pairs(a) do if not _propsEqual(v, b[k]) then return false end end
							for k in pairs(b) do if a[k] == nil then return false end end
							return true
						end
						return a == b
					end
					local function _buildOutfitPreset(pd, stripCats)
						if not pd then return {} end
						local preset = {
							CatalogClothes = {
								Shirt        = pd.CatalogClothes and pd.CatalogClothes.Shirt or "",
								Pants        = pd.CatalogClothes and pd.CatalogClothes.Pants or "",
								ShirtGraphic = pd.CatalogClothes and pd.CatalogClothes.ShirtGraphic or "",
								Face         = pd.CatalogClothes and pd.CatalogClothes.Face or "",
							},
							CatalogAccessory = {},
							CatalogTail      = {},
							CatalogOutfitId  = pd.CatalogOutfitId or "",
							BodyPartPhysics  = pd.BodyPartPhysics == true,
						}
						if pd.CatalogAccessory then for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogAccessory) do table.insert(preset.CatalogAccessory, v) end end
						if pd.CatalogTail      then for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogTail)      do table.insert(preset.CatalogTail,      v) end end
						preset.CatalogAssetTypes = {}
						if Function._catalogAssetTypeCache then
							local function _capture(id)
								if not id then return end
								local _key = tonumber(id) or id
								local _t = Function._catalogAssetTypeCache[_key]
								if _t then preset.CatalogAssetTypes[tostring(id)] = _t end
							end
							if pd.CatalogAccessory then for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogAccessory) do _capture(v) end end
							if pd.CatalogTail      then for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogTail)      do _capture(v) end end
						end
						if pd.BreastsType    and pd.BreastsType    ~= 1       then preset.BreastsType    = pd.BreastsType    end
						if pd.ClothesHP and next(pd.ClothesHP) then preset.ClothesHP = _depth2Clone(pd.ClothesHP) end
						if pd.ClothesRecolor and next(pd.ClothesRecolor) then preset.ClothesRecolor = _dehydratePreset(pd.ClothesRecolor) end
						if pd.AccessoryHP and next(pd.AccessoryHP) then preset.AccessoryHP = _depth2Clone(pd.AccessoryHP) end
						if pd.GizmoOffsets and next(pd.GizmoOffsets) then preset.GizmoOffsets = _dehydratePreset(pd.GizmoOffsets) end
						if pd.GizmoOffset and next(pd.GizmoOffset) then preset.GizmoOffset = _dehydratePreset(pd.GizmoOffset) end
						if pd.GizmoPresets and next(pd.GizmoPresets) then preset.GizmoPresets = _dehydratePreset(pd.GizmoPresets) end
						if pd.TorsoType      and pd.TorsoType      ~= 1       then preset.TorsoType      = pd.TorsoType      end
						if pd.ArmType        and pd.ArmType        ~= 1       then preset.ArmType        = pd.ArmType        end
						if pd.LegsType       and pd.LegsType       ~= 1       then preset.LegsType       = pd.LegsType       end
						if pd.ButtType       and pd.ButtType       ~= 1       then preset.ButtType       = pd.ButtType       end
						if pd.BreastsScale   and pd.BreastsScale   ~= 1       then preset.BreastsScale   = pd.BreastsScale   end
						if pd.ButtsScale     and pd.ButtsScale     ~= 1       then preset.ButtsScale     = pd.ButtsScale     end
						if pd.LegsScale      and pd.LegsScale      ~= 1       then preset.LegsScale      = pd.LegsScale      end
						if pd.CockScale      and pd.CockScale      ~= 1       then preset.CockScale      = pd.CockScale      end
						if pd.Tone           and pd.Tone           ~= "Base"  then preset.Tone           = pd.Tone           end
						if pd.HardcoreHP                                       then preset.HardcoreHP    = true              end
						if pd.TopHP          and pd.TopHP          ~= ""      then preset.TopHP         = pd.TopHP          end
						if pd.BottomHP       and pd.BottomHP       ~= ""      then preset.BottomHP      = pd.BottomHP       end
						if pd.DamageSFX      and pd.DamageSFX      ~= ""      then preset.DamageSFX     = pd.DamageSFX      end
						if pd.Volume         and pd.Volume         ~= 1       then preset.Volume        = pd.Volume         end
						if pd.TearParticles  == false                          then preset.TearParticles = false             end
						if pd.HealParticles  == false                          then preset.HealParticles = false             end
						if pd.RealtimeBodyTransparency == false                then preset.RealtimeBodyTransparency = false  end
						if pd.Face           == false                          then preset.Face          = false             end
						if pd.PhysicsObeyGravity == false                      then preset.PhysicsObeyGravity = false        end
						if pd.AccessorySizeLock                                then preset.AccessorySizeLock = true          end
						if pd.MeshSizeLock                                     then preset.MeshSizeLock  = true              end
						if pd.MeshBasePartInvisible                            then preset.MeshBasePartInvisible = true      end
						if pd.BreastsStiffness and pd.BreastsStiffness ~= 10    then preset.BreastsStiffness = pd.BreastsStiffness end
						if pd.BreastsDamping   and pd.BreastsDamping   ~= 0.207 then preset.BreastsDamping   = pd.BreastsDamping   end
						if pd.ButtsStiffness   and pd.ButtsStiffness   ~= 10    then preset.ButtsStiffness   = pd.ButtsStiffness   end
						if pd.ButtsDamping     and pd.ButtsDamping     ~= 0.1   then preset.ButtsDamping     = pd.ButtsDamping     end
						if pd.CockStiffness    and pd.CockStiffness    ~= 8     then preset.CockStiffness    = pd.CockStiffness    end
						if pd.CockDamping      and pd.CockDamping      ~= 0.207 then preset.CockDamping      = pd.CockDamping      end
						if pd.SmartBoneEnabled                                  then preset.SmartBoneEnabled = true                end
						if type(stripCats) == "table" then preset.StripCategories = _shallowClone(stripCats) end  -- V4.5.72: copies, so later setting changes don't edit the saved preset
						if type(pd.StripItems) == "table" and next(pd.StripItems) then preset.StripItems = _shallowClone(pd.StripItems) end  -- V4.5.38
						if pd.NippleColor                                       then preset.NippleColor   = pd.NippleColor  end
						if pd.SkinTone                                          then preset.SkinTone      = pd.SkinTone     end
						if pd.AutoStripOnRip == true                            then preset.AutoStripOnRip = true                  end
						if type(pd.StripOnRipMap) == "table"                   then preset.StripOnRipMap = _shallowClone(pd.StripOnRipMap) end
						if pd.NippleColorFromBundle == true                     then preset.NippleColorFromBundle = true            end
						if pd.BundleBodyColor       == false                    then preset.BundleBodyColor       = false           end
						if pd.BreathingEnabled      == true                     then preset.BreathingEnabled      = true            end
						if pd.OvertoneEnabled       == true                     then preset.OvertoneEnabled       = true            end
						if pd.BreathingAmplitude    and pd.BreathingAmplitude   ~= 0.03  then preset.BreathingAmplitude = pd.BreathingAmplitude end
						if pd.OvertoneAmplitude     and pd.OvertoneAmplitude    ~= 0.015 then preset.OvertoneAmplitude  = pd.OvertoneAmplitude  end
						if pd.BodyTransparency      and pd.BodyTransparency     ~= 0     then preset.BodyTransparency   = pd.BodyTransparency   end
						if pd.FPerson               == true                     then preset.FPerson               = true            end
						if pd.FPsnap                == true                     then preset.FPsnap                = true            end
						if pd.HeadTracking          == false                    then preset.HeadTracking          = false           end  -- V4.5.33: default is ON; capturing only `true` meant OFF could never be saved
						if pd.HPClothes and type(pd.HPClothes) == "table"
							and ((pd.HPClothes.Shirt and pd.HPClothes.Shirt ~= "") or (pd.HPClothes.Pants and pd.HPClothes.Pants ~= "")) then
							preset.HPClothesTemplates = {
								Shirt = (type(pd.HPClothes.Shirt) == "string" or type(pd.HPClothes.Shirt) == "number") and pd.HPClothes.Shirt or "",
								Pants = (type(pd.HPClothes.Pants) == "string" or type(pd.HPClothes.Pants) == "number") and pd.HPClothes.Pants or "",
							}
						end
						if PositionPhysicsMultiply ~= nil and PositionPhysicsMultiply ~= 1 then preset.PositionPhysicsMultiply = PositionPhysicsMultiply end
						if RotationPhysicsMultiply ~= nil and RotationPhysicsMultiply ~= 4 then preset.RotationPhysicsMultiply = RotationPhysicsMultiply end
						-- V4.5.18: capture the self-apply module globals so a PERSONAL save round-trips them.
						-- V4.5.68: Save Outfit no longer stores the render method (bundles do not change it any more)
						if type(includedAccessoryNames) == "table" and #includedAccessoryNames > 0 then
							preset.includedAccessoryNames = {}
							for _, _an in ipairs(includedAccessoryNames) do table.insert(preset.includedAccessoryNames, _an) end
						end
						if type(excludeAccessoryNames) == "table" and #excludeAccessoryNames > 0 then
							preset.excludeAccessoryNames = {}
							for _, _an in ipairs(excludeAccessoryNames) do table.insert(preset.excludeAccessoryNames, _an) end
						end
						if pd.CatalogUsername       and pd.CatalogUsername      ~= "" then preset.CatalogUsername = pd.CatalogUsername end
						if type(pd.CatalogUserSnapshot) == "table" and pd.CatalogUserSnapshot.user == pd.CatalogUsername then preset.CatalogUserSnapshot = pd.CatalogUserSnapshot end  -- V4.5.59
						-- V4.5.33: newer catalog state. CatalogBundleId = which catalog bundle the outfit came from; CatalogAnimPack =
						-- the equipped animation pack (R15, applied live, previously never saved). Restored for self on apply.
						if pd.CatalogBundleId and pd.CatalogBundleId ~= "" then preset.CatalogBundleId = pd.CatalogBundleId end
						if Function._catLive and Function._catLive.anim and Function._catLive.anim.id and pd == PlayerData[Player.Name] then
							preset.CatalogAnimPack = { id = tostring(Function._catLive.anim.id), name = tostring(Function._catLive.anim.name or "Animation pack") }
						end
						if pd.CatalogRemove and #pd.CatalogRemove > 0 then
							preset.CatalogRemove = {}
							for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogRemove) do table.insert(preset.CatalogRemove, v) end
						end
						if pd.CatalogHistory and #pd.CatalogHistory > 0 then preset.CatalogHistory = _shallowClone(pd.CatalogHistory) end
						if pd.LocalTransparency and next(pd.LocalTransparency) then preset.LocalTransparency = _shallowClone(pd.LocalTransparency) end
						if pd.PartList then
							local _defaultPL = Function.PartListDefault and Function.PartListDefault() or {}
							preset.MeshEdit = {}
							local _hasEdit = false
							for partName, partEntry in pairs(pd.PartList) do
								if type(partEntry) == "table" then
									local _d = _defaultPL[partName]
									local _diff = false
									if type(_d) ~= "table" then
										_diff = true
									else
										for k, v in pairs(partEntry) do
