											if not _propsEqual(v, _d[k]) then _diff = true; break end
										end
									end
									if _diff then preset.MeshEdit[partName] = _depth2Clone(partEntry); _hasEdit = true end
								end
							end
							if not _hasEdit then preset.MeshEdit = nil end
						end
						-- V4.4.2: capture tailSettings (custom tail physics) so it round-trips -- it was NEITHER
						-- captured NOR restored before. Exclude the runtime isTailCurrentlyEnabled.
						if type(pd.tailSettings) == "table" then
							preset.tailSettings = {}
							for _tk, _tv in pairs(pd.tailSettings) do if _tk ~= "isTailCurrentlyEnabled" then preset.tailSettings[_tk] = _tv end end
						end
						return preset
					end

					-- Gather up to 8 catalog asset IDs for the website preview thumbnails (orig
					-- _collectThumbnailIds L28808-28824). Order: shirt, pants, graphic, accessories, tail.
					local function _collectThumbnailIds(pd)
						local out, seen = {}, {}
						local function _push(id)
							if #out >= 8 then return end
							local s = tostring(id or ""):match("^%d+$")
							if not s or seen[s] then return end
							seen[s] = true; table.insert(out, s)
						end
						if pd.CatalogClothes then
							_push(pd.CatalogClothes.Shirt); _push(pd.CatalogClothes.Pants); _push(pd.CatalogClothes.ShirtGraphic); _push(pd.CatalogClothes.Face)
						end
						if pd.CatalogAccessory then for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogAccessory) do _push(v) end end
						if pd.CatalogTail      then for _, v in ipairs(pd.CatalogTail)      do _push(v) end end
						return out
					end

					-- POST the preset to the website (orig _publishOutfitToWebsite L28827-28868).
					-- Endpoint VERBATIM: https://krulhub.dev/bundles/publish. Returns ok, code, detail.
					local function _publishOutfit(name, preset, thumbnailIds, author)
						local body = {
							name          = name,
							author        = author,
							scriptVersion = VersionInternal,
							preset        = dehydrate(preset),
							thumbnailIds  = thumbnailIds or {},
						}
						local okEnc, encoded = pcall(HS.JSONEncode, HS, body)
						if not okEnc then return false, 0, "encode failed" end
						if #encoded > 60 * 1024 then
							return false, 413, "preset too large (" .. tostring(math.floor(#encoded / 1024)) .. " KB > 60 KB)"
						end
						local req = _reqFn()
						if not req then return false, 0, "no http_request API on this executor" end
						local okReq, res = pcall(req, {
							Url = "https://krulhub.dev/bundles/publish", Method = "POST",
							Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}, Body = encoded,
						})
						if not okReq then return false, 0, tostring(res) end
						local code = tonumber(res and res.StatusCode) or 0
						local detail, bundleId = "", nil
						if res and res.Body then
							local okJson, parsed = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, tostring(res.Body))
							if okJson and type(parsed) == "table" then
								if parsed.bundleId then bundleId = tostring(parsed.bundleId) end
								if parsed.error then detail = tostring(parsed.error) end
								if parsed.detail then detail = detail .. " " .. tostring(parsed.detail):sub(1, 60) end
							end
						end
						if code >= 200 and code < 300 then return true, code, "Submitted - pending moderation. id=" .. (bundleId or "?") end
						if code == 0 then return false, 0, "network error" end
						return false, code, detail ~= "" and detail or ("HTTP " .. tostring(code))
					end

					-- Build the bundleData {Preset, Personal, Clothing} from live PD (orig _commitOutfitSave
					-- body L28889-28922): preset + Personal=true + Clothing array (CurrentClothes minus the
					-- "nil" sentinel). Shared by both save paths.
					local function _buildOutfitBundle(pd)
						local preset = _buildOutfitPreset(pd, pd.StripCategories)
						local bundleData = {Preset = preset, Personal = true}
						-- V4.4.2 FIX: MeshEdit is captured nested under preset.MeshEdit, but BOTH apply paths read ...
						if preset.MeshEdit then bundleData.MeshEdit = preset.MeshEdit end
						if pd.CurrentClothes and #pd.CurrentClothes > 0 then
							bundleData.Clothing = {}
							for _, _cname in ipairs(pd.CurrentClothes) do
								if type(_cname) == "string" and _cname ~= "nil" then
									table.insert(bundleData.Clothing, _cname)
								end
							end
						end
						return bundleData
					end

					-- Save Outfit (orig _commitOutfitSave L28876-28937 + the Private/Public button
					-- handlers L28941-29013). Captures the live PD into a bundle, registers it + writes
					-- it to disk (reusing the P8 _registerImport / _writeImportedToDisk), and -- when
					-- public==true -- also publishes it to the website. Name is sanitized for collision
					-- (suffix _2,_3,... like the original). Returns finalName, statusMsg.
					-- This is a YIELDING call (publish does HTTP); the GUI runs it in task.spawn.
					System.saveOutfit = function(name, public)
						local sp = (System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name
						local pd = PlayerData[sp]
						if not pd then return nil, "no pending outfit" end
						name = tostring(name or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
						if name == "" then return nil, "name required" end
						if #name > 64 then name = name:sub(1, 64) end
						-- collision-safe name (orig L28883-28888)
						local finalName, suffix = name, 1
						-- V4.5.69: the file is RClothesLerp/Bundles/<_bsanitize(name)>.json, so "my look" and "my_look" (or "A" and
						-- "a" on Windows) shared ONE file and the second save overwrote the first on disk. Taken = same sanitized,
						-- case-folded file name as any loaded bundle.
						local function _taken(n)
							if Bundle[n] then return true end
							local f = _bsanitize(n):lower()
							for k in pairs(Bundle) do
								if type(k) == "string" and _bsanitize(k):lower() == f then return true end
							end
							return false
						end
						while _taken(finalName) do
							suffix = suffix + 1
							finalName = name .. "_" .. tostring(suffix)
							if suffix > 99 then return nil, "too many same-name bundles" end
						end
						Function._ensureUserSnapshot(pd)  -- V4.5.59: freeze a Username avatar as it is right now
						local bundleData = _buildOutfitBundle(pd)
						_registerImport(finalName, bundleData)
						local _diskOk = _writeImportedToDisk(finalName, bundleData)
						if Function.compileOvertime then pcall(Function.compileOvertime) end
						if hotSwap then hotSwap() end
						if _diskOk == false then
							return finalName, "Saved (memory) but disk write FAILED for '" .. finalName .. "'"
						end
						if not public then
							return finalName, "Saved private as '" .. finalName .. "'"
						end
						-- publish path (orig L28983-29006)
						local preset = bundleData.Preset
						local thumbs = _collectThumbnailIds(pd)
						local lp = PS.LocalPlayer
						local _author = ((lp and lp.Name) or "Unknown"):sub(1, 48)
						local ok, code, detail = _publishOutfit(finalName, preset, thumbs, _author)
						if ok then return finalName, "Published! " .. tostring(detail or "") end
						if code == 426 then return finalName, "Saved private; publish blocked: script outdated." end
						if code == 429 then return finalName, "Saved private; rate-limited (5/hour). Try later." end
						if code == 413 then return finalName, "Saved private; " .. tostring(detail) end
						if code == 409 then return finalName, "Saved private; duplicate of a recent submission." end
						if code == 503 then return finalName, "Saved private; moderation queue full." end
						return finalName, "Saved private; publish failed: " .. tostring(detail or code)
					end

					-- V4.5.59 Mine tab: Rename / Update for bundles YOU saved (a file in RClothesLerp/Bundles). Save Outfit never
					-- overwrote (same name -> "_2"), so a saved bundle could not be edited or renamed at all.
					function Function._ownBundleCheck(name)
						if type(name) ~= "string" or type(Bundle[name]) ~= "table" then return nil, "Apply one of your bundles first." end
						if Bundle[name].Personal ~= true then return nil, "Only bundles you saved can be changed." end
						local path = "RClothesLerp/Bundles/" .. _bsanitize(name) .. ".json"
						if not (env.isfile and env.isfile(path)) then return nil, "This one has no saved file (it came from the community list)." end
						return path
					end
					System.renameBundle = function(old, new)
						local oldPath, why = Function._ownBundleCheck(old)
						if not oldPath then return false, why end
						new = tostring(new or ""):gsub("^%s+", "")
						new = new:gsub("%s+$", "")
						if new == "" then return false, "Type a new name." end
						if #new > 64 then return false, "Name too long (64 characters max)." end
						if new == old then return true, "Name unchanged." end
						for n in pairs(Bundle) do
							if type(n) == "string" and n ~= old and (n:lower() == new:lower() or _bsanitize(n):lower() == _bsanitize(new):lower()) then return false, 'A bundle called "' .. n .. '" already exists.' end  -- V4.5.69: same file name after sanitizing = same file
						end
						if _writeImportedToDisk(new, Bundle[old]) == false then return false, "Could not save the renamed bundle." end
						-- Windows paths ignore case: "Outfit" -> "outfit" lands on the SAME file, so only delete a different path.
						if _bsanitize(new):lower() ~= _bsanitize(old):lower() then pcall(env.delfile, oldPath) end
						Bundle[new] = Bundle[old]; Bundle[old] = nil
						for _, p in pairs(PlayerData) do
							if type(p) == "table" then
								if p.CurrentBundle == old then p.CurrentBundle = new end
								if p.CurrentPreset == old then p.CurrentPreset = new end
								if type(p.CurrentClothingBundles) == "table" then
									for i, n in ipairs(p.CurrentClothingBundles) do if n == old then p.CurrentClothingBundles[i] = new end end
								end
							end
						end
						if System.getLoadup and System.getLoadup("Bundle") == old and System.setLoadupBundle then
							System.setLoadupBundle(new); if System.persistLoadup then pcall(System.persistLoadup) end
						end
						if Function.compileOvertime then pcall(Function.compileOvertime) end
						return true, 'Renamed to "' .. new .. '".'
					end
					System.updateBundle = function(name)
						local path, why = Function._ownBundleCheck(name)
						if not path then return false, why end
						local pd = PlayerData[(System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name]
						if not pd then return false, "No avatar to save." end
						Function._ensureUserSnapshot(pd)
						local bundleData = _buildOutfitBundle(pd)
						if _writeImportedToDisk(name, bundleData) == false then return false, "Could not save the bundle." end
						_registerImport(name, bundleData)
						if Function.compileOvertime then pcall(Function.compileOvertime) end
						return true, 'Saved your current look into "' .. name .. '".'
					end

					-- V4.5.63: OLD username bundles (saved before V4.5.59) copy that user's LIVE avatar on every wear, so they change
					-- whenever that user changes (or break if the account is gone). This freezes one: today's avatar of that user is
					-- stored in the bundle (Preset.CatalogUserSnapshot, the same snapshot new saves carry) and the file re-saved.
					-- Your own bundles only (community ones are not yours to edit).
					System.freezeBundleUser = function(name)
						local path, why = Function._ownBundleCheck(name)
						if not path then return false, why end
						local def = Bundle[name]
						local P = type(def) == "table" and type(def.Preset) == "table" and def.Preset or nil
						local user = P and P.CatalogUsername
						if type(user) ~= "string" or user == "" then return false, "This bundle doesn't copy a username." end
						local ok, s = pcall(Function._userSnapshot, user)
						s = ok and Function._sanitizeUserSnapshot(s) or nil
						if type(s) ~= "table" then return false, "Couldn't load " .. user .. "'s avatar (account gone or Roblox busy)." end
						local copy = {}
						for k, v in pairs(def) do copy[k] = v end
						local pc = {}
						for k, v in pairs(P) do pc[k] = v end
						pc.CatalogUserSnapshot = s
						copy.Preset = pc
						if _writeImportedToDisk(name, copy) == false then return false, "Could not save the bundle." end
						_registerImport(name, copy)
						return true, 'Froze "' .. name .. '": it keeps ' .. user .. "'s look from today."
					end

					-- V4.5.58 LOOKS: Undo / Redo, Recent Looks and Keep look on teleport share ONE snapshot format: exactly what
					-- Save Outfit captures (_buildOutfitBundle), stored as the JSON text a bundle file holds (same convertToJSON
					-- leaves), so a look round-trips memory -> disk -> a new server unchanged. Wearing one registers it as a HIDDEN
					-- bundle (name starts with "\1look", filtered out of every bundle list) and applies it with System.applyBundle.
					-- Snapshots are taken after each hotSwap (the commit point every look change goes through), debounced 1s.
					-- All state is local to this function so it adds nothing to the enclosing scope's locals (executor = -O0).
					System._looksInstall = function()
						-- The loadstring line a teleport re-runs (queue_on_teleport). krul: put the RoClothes loader here, or the
						-- loader can set getgenv().RC_LOADER. Empty = the look is still saved and comes back on the next execute.
						local LOADER = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://krulhub.dev/s/roclothes-krul"))()'
						local PREFIX = "\1look"
						local RECENT_FILE, TP_FILE = "RClothesLerp/RecentLooks.json", "RClothesLerp/TeleportLook.json"
						local HIST_CAP, RECENT_CAP, STABLE_S, TP_MAX_AGE = 30, 10, 20, 300
						local hist, idx = {}, 0       -- undo stack of { k = json, n = label, c = item count }; hist[idx] = what you wear now
						local restoring = false       -- the next commit is the result of OUR undo/redo (update the slot, do not push)
						local commitGen, hidN, recent, labelOf = 0, 0, nil, {}

						local function myPD() return PlayerData[Player.Name] end
						local function isSelf() return ((System.getSelectPlayer and System.getSelectPlayer()) or Player.Name) == Player.Name end
						local function deepCopy(t) if typeof(t) ~= "table" then return t end; local o = {}; for k, v in pairs(t) do o[k] = deepCopy(v) end; return o end
						local function encode(bd)
							local t = deepCopy(bd)
							local function conv(n) for k, v in pairs(n) do if typeof(v) == "table" then conv(v) else n[k] = Function.convertToJSON(v) end end end
							conv(t)
							local ok, s = pcall(HS.JSONEncode, HS, t)
							return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or nil
						end
						local function decode(s)
							local ok, t = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, s)
							if not ok or type(t) ~= "table" then return nil end
							local function fromJSON(n) for k, v in pairs(n) do local value, original = Function.convertFromJSON(v); n[k] = value; if typeof(v) == "table" and original then fromJSON(v) end end end
							local okC = pcall(fromJSON, t)
							return okC and t or nil
						end
						local function isHidden(nm) return type(nm) == "string" and nm:sub(1, #PREFIX) == PREFIX end
						local function labelFor(pd)
							local cb = pd.CurrentBundle
							if type(cb) == "string" and cb ~= "nil" and cb ~= "" then return isHidden(cb) and (labelOf[cb] or "Custom look") or cb end
							if type(pd.CurrentPreset) == "string" and pd.CurrentPreset ~= "" then return pd.CurrentPreset end
							local names = {}
							for _, c in ipairs(pd.CurrentClothes or {}) do if type(c) == "string" and c ~= "nil" then names[#names + 1] = c; if #names == 2 then break end end end
							return (#names > 0) and table.concat(names, " + ") or "Custom look"
						end
						local function capture()
							local pd = myPD(); if not pd then return nil end
							local ok, bd = pcall(_buildOutfitBundle, pd)
							if not ok or type(bd) ~= "table" then return nil end
							local k = encode(bd); if not k then return nil end
							local n = 0; for _, c in ipairs(pd.CurrentClothes or {}) do if type(c) == "string" and c ~= "nil" then n += 1 end end
							return { k = k, n = labelFor(pd), c = n }
						end
						-- asStep: wearing it is a NEW history step (Recent / teleport); otherwise it is an undo/redo restore
						local function wear(snap, asStep)
							if type(snap) ~= "table" or type(snap.k) ~= "string" then return false, "That look could not be read." end
							if not isSelf() then return false, "Set the Target back to yourself first." end
							if not (System.applyBundle and type(Bundle) == "table") then return false, "RoClothes is still loading." end
							local bd = decode(snap.k); if not bd then return false, "That look could not be read." end
							local pd = myPD(); local old = pd and pd.CurrentBundle
							hidN += 1
							local name = PREFIX .. hidN
							bd.Personal = true; bd.IsPreset = nil; bd.ClothingBundle = nil; bd.BundleName = nil
							Bundle[name] = bd; labelOf[name] = snap.n
							restoring = not asStep
							local ok, r = pcall(System.applyBundle, name)
							if not ok or r == false then restoring = false; Bundle[name] = nil; labelOf[name] = nil; return false, "That look could not be put on." end
							if isHidden(old) and old ~= name then Bundle[old] = nil; labelOf[old] = nil end  -- the previous hidden look is no longer worn by anything
							return true
						end
						local function pushHist(s)
							for i = #hist, idx + 1, -1 do hist[i] = nil end  -- a new change drops the redo branch
							hist[#hist + 1] = s; idx = #hist
							while #hist > HIST_CAP do table.remove(hist, 1); idx -= 1 end
						end
						local function loadRecent()
							if recent then return recent end
							recent = {}
							pcall(function()
								if not (env.isfile and env.readfile and env.isfile(RECENT_FILE)) then return end
								local t = HS:JSONDecode(env.readfile(RECENT_FILE))
								if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
								for _, e in ipairs(t) do
									if type(e) == "table" and type(e.k) == "string" and #recent < RECENT_CAP then
										recent[#recent + 1] = { k = e.k, n = tostring(e.n or "Custom look"), c = tonumber(e.c) or 0, t = tonumber(e.t) or 0 }
									end
								end
							end)
							return recent
						end
						local saveGen = 0
						local function saveRecent()
							saveGen += 1; local g = saveGen
							task.delay(1, function() if g == saveGen and env.writefile then pcall(_atomicWriteJSON, RECENT_FILE, recent or {}) end end)
						end
						local function remember(s)
							local r = loadRecent()
							for i = #r, 1, -1 do if r[i].k == s.k then table.remove(r, i) end end
							table.insert(r, 1, { k = s.k, n = s.n, c = s.c, t = os.time() })
							while #r > RECENT_CAP do table.remove(r) end
							saveRecent()
							if System.renderRecent then pcall(System.renderRecent) end
						end
						local function commit()
							if not isSelf() then return end
							local s = capture(); if not s then return end
							if restoring then
								restoring = false
								if hist[idx] then hist[idx].k = s.k; hist[idx].c = s.c end  -- a rebuild may not come back byte-identical: keep the slot, store the real result
								return
							end
							if hist[idx] and hist[idx].k == s.k then return end
							pushHist(s)
							local g = commitGen
							task.delay(STABLE_S, function() if g == commitGen and hist[idx] == s then remember(s) end end)  -- Recent = a look you kept on for a while
						end
						System._lookOnSwap = function()
							commitGen += 1
							local g = commitGen
							task.delay(1, function() if g == commitGen then pcall(commit) end end)
						end
						System.lookUndo = function()
							if idx <= 1 then return false, "Nothing to undo." end
							local ok, err = wear(hist[idx - 1]); if not ok then return false, err end
							idx -= 1; return true, hist[idx].n
						end
						System.lookRedo = function()
							if idx >= #hist then return false, "Nothing to redo." end
							local ok, err = wear(hist[idx + 1]); if not ok then return false, err end
							idx += 1; return true, hist[idx].n
						end
						System.lookLabel = function(nm) return isHidden(nm) and (labelOf[nm] or "Custom look") or nil end
						System.lookIsHidden = isHidden
						System.lookRecent = function() local o = {}; for i, e in ipairs(loadRecent()) do o[i] = { n = e.n, c = e.c, t = e.t } end; return o end
						System.lookWearRecent = function(i)
							local r = loadRecent(); local e = r[i]
							if not e then return false, "That look is gone." end
							local ok, err = wear(e, true); if not ok then return false, err end
							table.remove(r, i); e.t = os.time(); table.insert(r, 1, e); saveRecent()
							return true, e.n
						end
						System.lookClearRecent = function() recent = {}; saveRecent() end

						-- KEEP LOOK ON TELEPORT: save the look as the teleport starts, queue the loader, put it back on arrival.
						local queued = false
						local function onTeleport(state)
							if state ~= Enum.TeleportState.Started then return end
							if System._keepTeleport and not System._keepTeleport() then return end
							local s = capture(); if not s then return end
							if env.writefile then pcall(_atomicWriteJSON, TP_FILE, { k = s.k, n = s.n, c = s.c, t = os.time(), u = Player.UserId }) end
							if queued then return end  -- a retried teleport keeps the first queue
							local src = LOADER
							pcall(function() local g = getgenv and getgenv().RC_LOADER; if type(g) == "string" and g ~= "" then src = g end end)
							local q = queue_on_teleport or queueonteleport or (syn and syn.queue_on_teleport) or (fluxus and fluxus.queue_on_teleport)
							if type(src) == "string" and src ~= "" and type(q) == "function" then queued = pcall(q, src) end
						end
						pcall(function() System._lookTpConn = Player.OnTeleport:Connect(onTeleport) end)
						-- on load: a fresh teleport look (same user, under 5 min old) is worn instead of the Start bundle
						System._lookTeleportCheck = function()
							if not (env.isfile and env.readfile and env.isfile(TP_FILE)) then return false end
							local ok, t = pcall(function() return HS:JSONDecode(env.readfile(TP_FILE)) end)
							if env.delfile then pcall(env.delfile, TP_FILE) end  -- one use only
							if not ok or type(t) ~= "table" or type(t.k) ~= "string" then return false end
							if tonumber(t.u) ~= Player.UserId or os.time() - (tonumber(t.t) or 0) > TP_MAX_AGE then return false end
							if System._keepTeleport and not System._keepTeleport() then return false end
							task.spawn(function()
								local t0 = os.clock()
								while not (type(Bundle) == "table" and System.applyBundle and Player.Character and myPD()) and os.clock() - t0 < 90 do task.wait(0.5) end
								task.wait(1)
								local okW = wear({ k = t.k, n = t.n, c = tonumber(t.c) or 0 }, true)
								if not okW then warn("[RoClothes] Could not put your look back on after the teleport") end
							end)
							return true
						end
						-- baseline: what you wear once loaded, so the very first change can be undone
						task.spawn(function()
							local t0 = os.clock()
							while not (myPD() and Player.Character) and os.clock() - t0 < 120 do task.wait(1) end
							task.wait(4)
							if #hist == 0 and isSelf() then local s = capture(); if s then pushHist(s) end end
						end)
					end
					pcall(System._looksInstall)
				end
			end
		end



	function Function.RunInitialization()
		-- V4.3.254: prefix sweep `rc_*` (matches BREAKER pattern). Catches orphan tags
		-- from prior crashed sessions whose RCTag hash no live RCTag references.
		do
			local _CS = game:GetService("CollectionService")
			local _allTags = _CS.GetAllTags and _CS:GetAllTags() or nil
			if _allTags then
				for _, _tag in ipairs(_allTags) do
					if type(_tag) == "string" and _tag:sub(1, 3) == "rc_" then
						for _, v in ipairs(_CS:GetTagged(_tag)) do
							pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
						end
					end
				end
			else
				for _, v in ipairs(_CS:GetTagged(System.RCTag)) do
					pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
				end
			end
		end

		-- V4.3.492: SUPPRESSED the GUI build's loading splash + "loading" TextLabel.
		local loadui = _sharedLoadui or Instance.new("ScreenGui", game:GetService("CoreGui"))
		_sharedLoadui = nil
		loadui.Enabled = false  -- stay invisible; brand owns the loading UX
		local load = loadui:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
		if not load then
			load = Instance.new("ImageLabel", loadui)
			local okLoad, loadAsset = pcall(System.getcustomasset, "RClothesContent/loadv9.png")
			load.Image = okLoad and loadAsset or ""
			load.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
			load.Transparency = 1
			load.ImageTransparency = .999
		end
		-- V4.5.59: removed the 1s "is loadv9.png loaded?" wait + its "Assets are not fully loaded yet" warning. The probe
		-- image lives in this ScreenGui, which is Enabled = false since V4.3.492, and a disabled GUI never loads its
		-- images - so IsLoaded was always false: every boot waited the full second and then printed a false warning.

		-- V4.3.258: VNS preload re-enabled. The original V4.3.217 disable was because (see Changelog for full rationale)
		System._sbPreloadHandle = task.spawn(function()
			pcall(Function.LoadSmartBoneApi)
			System._sbPreloadHandle = nil
		end)

		do
			-- V4.5.50: kept as a function so the Loadup Bundle (applied later, async) can re-apply it - a bundle apply
			-- resets the bundle-settable fields (incl. FPerson), which silently undid Loadup FPerson.
			System._applyLoadupFP = function()
				if loadupFPerson > 0 then
					PlayerData[Player.Name].FPerson = true
					if loadupFPerson == 3 or loadupFPerson == 4 then
						PlayerData[Player.Name].FPsnap = true
					end
					if loadupFPerson == 5 or loadupFPerson == 6 then
						PlayerData[Player.Name].HeadTracking = true  -- modes 5/6 = head-tracking tier (since V4.5.59 the reset default is ON too, so this is belt-and-braces)
					end
					if loadupFPerson == 1 or loadupFPerson == 3 or loadupFPerson == 5 then
						PlayerData[Player.Name].LocalTransparency = {
							["Head"] = false,
							["Right Arm"] = true,
							["Left Arm"] = true,
							["Torso"] = true,
							["Right Leg"] = true,
							["Left Leg"] = true,
							["Hat"] = true
						}
					end
				end
			end
			System._applyLoadupFP()
			if loadupClosed == false then
				GUIObject.Screen.Enabled = true
			else
				-- V4.5.50 Fix: "Close UI on Loadup" did nothing in the new UI (this block only ever ENABLED the screen).
				-- Collapse the SmartBar to its puck once the intro is gone. Not Screen.Enabled = false: phones have no
				-- Insert key, and the puck reopens the bar on any device.
				task.spawn(function()
					local _pg = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
					local _t0 = os.clock()
					repeat task.wait(0.5) until not (_pg and _pg:FindFirstChild("RoClothesIntro")) or os.clock() - _t0 > 180
					task.wait(1)
					if System._collapseBar then System._collapseBar() end
				end)
			end
			-- V4.5.50 Fix: the Loadup Bundle setting was saved and shown but never applied (upstream applied it while
			-- building the old GUI, which the new UI no longer runs). Bundle data arrives async from the CDN, so wait
			-- for it. With Execute on Loadup: wear it (applyBundle rebuilds); without: select it like upstream did.
			-- V4.5.58 Keep look on teleport: a look saved as a teleport started is worn instead of the Start bundle
			System._tpTook = false
			if System._lookTeleportCheck then local _ok, _r = pcall(System._lookTeleportCheck); System._tpTook = _ok and _r == true end
			if not System._tpTook and type(loadupBundle) == "string" and loadupBundle ~= "" then
				task.spawn(function()
					local _t0 = os.clock()
					while not (type(Bundle) == "table" and Bundle[loadupBundle] and System.applyBundle) and os.clock() - _t0 < 90 do task.wait(0.5) end
					if not (type(Bundle) == "table" and Bundle[loadupBundle]) then warn('[RoClothes] Loadup bundle "' .. loadupBundle .. '" was not found') return end
					local _pd = PlayerData[Player.Name]
					if not _pd then return end
					if loadupExecute == true and System.applyBundle then
						if _pd.CurrentBundle ~= loadupBundle and _pd.CurrentPreset ~= loadupBundle then pcall(System.applyBundle, loadupBundle) end
						if loadupFPerson > 0 and System._applyLoadupFP then pcall(System._applyLoadupFP); if System._queueHotSwap then System._queueHotSwap() end end
					else
						local _v = Bundle[loadupBundle]
						if not _v.ClothingBundle and not _v.IsPreset then _pd.CurrentBundle = loadupBundle end
					end
				end)
			end
			if loadupExecute == true and Player.Character then
				local InitialID = PlayerData[Player.Name].LastRequestID
				pcall(Function.CharacterExecute, Player.Character, Player.Name, nil, InitialID)  -- V4.5.68: an init build error must not skip loadui:Destroy + the KrulHosted manifest below
				-- V4.3.168: announce loaded bundle to in-server peers (no-op if Avatar Sync is OFF).
				-- V4.3.174: passes `true` because Loadup Bundle is a user-configured action ...
				pcall(Function.AvatarSyncPublish, true)
			end
			loadui:Destroy()

			-- V4.3.189: KrulHosted clothing - ensure cache folder, then async-download
			-- any PNG files listed in the krulhub.dev manifest and register them in Clothes.
			local CLOTHING_DIR = "RClothesContent/KrulClothing"
			if env.isfolder and env.makefolder and not env.isfolder(CLOTHING_DIR) then
				pcall(env.makefolder, CLOTHING_DIR)
			end

			-- V4.3.441: cooperative-stop flag so BREAKER's cancel signal aborts the ...
			System._krulManifestStop = true  -- V4.3.567 H-8: signal any still-yielded PRIOR manifest task to stop BEFORE cancelling it (task.cancel cannot preempt a yielded HttpGet)
			-- V4.3.521 Fix 14: getgenv handoff for re-execute cancellation (mirrors V4.3.514 pattern).
			do
				local _ok_genv, _genv = pcall(function() return (getgenv and getgenv()) or nil end)
				local _prior = _ok_genv and _genv and _genv._RC_krul_manifest_task or nil
				if _prior then pcall(task.cancel, _prior) end
			end
			System._krulManifestTask = task.spawn(function()
				System._krulManifestStop = false  -- V4.3.567 H-8: clear for THIS task, now that the prior one was signalled + cancelled
				local CLOTHING_BASE = "https://krulhub.dev/roclothes/clothing/"
				-- V4.3.349: simple 3-attempt exponential-backoff retry on transient HTTP ...
				local ok, body = false, nil
				for attempt = 1, 3 do
					ok, body = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, CLOTHING_BASE .. "manifest.json")
					if ok and type(body) == "string" and #body > 0 then break end
					task.wait(1.5 * attempt)
				end
				if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" then return end
				local okD, manifest = pcall(game:GetService("HttpService").JSONDecode,
					game:GetService("HttpService"), body)
				if not okD or type(manifest) ~= "table" then return end

				for _, filename in ipairs(manifest) do
					if System._krulManifestStop then return end  -- V4.3.441: BREAKER signalled
					if type(filename) ~= "string" then continue end -- malformed manifest entry
					-- V4.3.520 Fix 9: segment-by-segment path-traversal guard for CDN manifest ...
					-- V4.3.521 Fix 3: V4.3.520 Fix 9 missed backslash + UNC. Reject any path with ...
					if filename:find("\\") or filename:sub(1,2) == "//"
					   or filename:match("[ %.]$") or filename:find("\0") then
						_diagPublicCall("manifest.bad_path", { f = filename, reason = "fs_traversal" })
						continue
					end
					local _badSeg = false
					for _seg in filename:gmatch("[^/]+") do
						if _seg == ".." or _seg == "." or _seg:find("[\\:]") or _seg:sub(2,2) == ":" then
							_badSeg = true; break
						end
					end
					if _badSeg or filename:sub(1,1) == "/" or filename:sub(1,1) == "\\" then
						_diagPublicCall("manifest.bad_path", { f = filename })
						continue
					end
					local localPath = CLOTHING_DIR .. "/" .. filename
					if env.isfile and not env.isfile(localPath) then
						local okH, data = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, CLOTHING_BASE .. filename)
						if okH and type(data) == "string" and #data > 100 and data:sub(1,4) == "\x89PNG" then
							if env.writefile then pcall(env.writefile, localPath, data) end
						end
					end
					local clothName = filename:match("^(.-)%.png$") or filename
					-- Only register if the file is confirmed on disk (or at least downloadable)
					local _fileReady = env.isfile and env.isfile(localPath)
					if Clothes and not Clothes[clothName] and _fileReady then
						local isShirt = clothName:lower():find("shirt") ~= nil
						local isPants = clothName:lower():find("pant") ~= nil
						if isShirt or isPants then
							Clothes[clothName] = setmetatable({
								ClothType = isShirt and "Shirt" or "Pants",
								LocalPath = localPath,
								KrulHosted = true,
							}, MetaClothes)
						else
							warn("[RoClothes] KrulHosted: filename '" .. filename .. "' does not contain 'shirt' or 'pant' - skipped")
						end
					end
				end

				-- Sort once after all buttons inserted (not per-item)
				table.sort(System.ClothesButtons, function(a,b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
				for i, v in ipairs(System.ClothesButtons) do v.LayoutOrder = i end
			end)
			-- V4.3.521 Fix 14: stash krul-manifest handle on getgenv() for cross-exec cancellation.
			do
				local _ok_genv, _genv = pcall(function() return (getgenv and getgenv()) or nil end)
				if _ok_genv and _genv then _genv._RC_krul_manifest_task = System._krulManifestTask end
			end
		end
	end

	-- V4.3.262 fix part 3/3: bail out before mounting the GUI if a newer execute ...
	if not _isActiveSession() then
		pcall(function() if BREAKER then BREAKER:Destroy() end end)
		return
	end

	Function.RunInitialization()


	-- Monitor for external shutdown signal (via Singleton pattern or manual deletion)
	-- Cleanup loop removed: Now handled by BREAKER.Destroying signal
end -- close inner block
end -- close RoClothes

if RS:IsStudio() then
	RoClothes(PS.LocalPlayer)
else
	if RS:IsClient() then
		if not PS.LocalPlayer then
			PS.PlayerAdded:Wait()
		end
		RoClothes(PS.LocalPlayer)
	elseif RS:IsServer() then
		-- Server-side execution is not supported; RoClothes is client-only
		-- PS:WaitForChild("lerp()") was a stale placeholder that hangs forever
	end
end
return nil
